https://jobs.lever.co/fullscript/6d3f9a7.body: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care. That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment. We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care. The Mission: Care Mode at Fullscript Fullscript is evolving from a platform patients use to access care into one that helps them actively follow through on it. What we call Care Mode is at the center of that evolution. It is designed to create a continuous connection between patients and their care teams—helping patients turn recommendations into sustainable actions while giving practitioners greater visibility into what happens between visits. Our goal is to close the loop from recommendation → engagement → adherence → outcomes, using technology to deepen the connection between patients and their care teams at scale. This is not engagement for engagement’s sake. It’s about building thoughtful, trusted experiences that help people take the next right step in their care. The Role We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Patient Experience pod and help shape the technical and product foundations of Care Mode. This role blends engineering leadership, product thinking, and people leadership. You’ll stay close to the work—contributing to technical design and implementation, navigating difficult engineering decisions, and stepping in when deeper context or hands-on support is needed—while creating the conditions for a strong team to do its best work. We believe great engineering leaders are builders at heart. You can zoom out to understand strategy and product intent, then zoom back into the implementation when it matters. You bring clarity to ambiguity, raise the bar through example, and create momentum through trust, context, and shared ownership. The product reflects the team that builds it. This role shapes both. What You’ll Do Build and lead Cross-functional team on patient experience; set technical direction in a complex, evolving domain. Stay meaningfully hands-on through system design, code, reviews, prototyping, and solving difficult technical problems. Set technical direction and evolve architecture in a complex, rapidly developing product domain. Lead design discussions where product, engineering, data, and clinical considerations intersect. Own hard problems Help evolve Fullscript from transactional patient experiences toward a longitudinal, person-centric model of care. Build systems that bring together clinical data, behavioral signals, and real-world patient context. Make deliberate tradeoffs across speed, quality, reliability, safety, and trust. Bring structure and momentum to ambiguous problems without waiting for perfect information. Raise the bar Establish a high bar for technical and product quality through how you build, review, and make decisions. Create an environment that combines psychological safety with meaningful accountability. Develop engineers through coaching, pairing, feedback, technical debate, and hands-on collaboration. Continually challenge the team to ask: Are we solving the right problem? Is the experience worthy of the people who depend on us? Collaborate at scale Partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Data, and Engineering leaders across Fullscript. Influence broader technical direction as Care Mode and patient experiences become increasingly foundational to the Fullscript platform. Champion patient trust, practitioner workflows, and long-term system health in product and technical decisions. How We Expect You to Think We’re looking for a builder with high agency, strong judgment, and a fundamentally optimistic view of what technology can make possible. You: Default to action. When something is unclear, narrow the problem, propose a path, and move — then adjust with data. Enforce a high bar on reliability and trust: bug discipline, instrumentation, dogfooding. Quality is non-negotiable; so is shipping. Take ownership beyond the boundaries of your formal scope. Are comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving forward with incomplete information. Challenge direction thoughtfully when something doesn’t feel right—and help create a better path. Care about outcomes, not simply output. You’re equally comfortable asking “What should we build?” and “How should we build it?” What You Bring Significant experience building and leading software products end-to-end, from early concepts through iteration and operation at scale. Multiple years of engineering management experience, with a clear commitment to people leadership while remaining deeply technical and close to the work. A track record of owning difficult, non-obvious technical problems with meaningful product and user impact. Comfort moving between hands-on engineering and engineering leadership—sometimes within the same day. Strong technical judgment and an ability to communicate why a decision matters, not simply what should be built. Experience building and operating high-scale applications, with a strong appreciation for reliability, performance, maintainability, and user trust. Strong product instincts and the ability to connect engineering decisions to the experience they create for users. Strong signals for this role include: Deep experience building successful consumer-facing web and/or mobile products, where engagement, retention, usability, and product quality were central to the experience. Experience building consumer experiences that proactively give users a reason to return—through timely, relevant, personalized, or context-aware interactions that reduce effort and sustain engagement over time. Fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools, with strong judgment about how to use AI to explore options, challenge assumptions, accelerate implementation, and improve technical decision-making. Strong instincts around responsiveness, fast feedback loops, perceived performance, and the details that make software feel lightweight and intuitive. Experience designing for moments when users may be overwhelmed, disengaged, or uncertain about what to do next. Experience with React, React Native, Rails, GraphQL, Apollo. Specific technologies matter less than depth of technical thinking and craftsmanship. Bonus signals we value: Experience building products in regulated, safety-sensitive, or high-trust domains. A track record of raising quality bars, not simply increasing velocity. An ability to challenge people constructively and leave teams stronger and more energized as a result. How We Build We care deeply about craft, empathy, and trust. Our engineering values are captured in the Fullscript Developer Handbook. We believe complexity should be clarified rather than surfaced, technology should deepen human care rather than replace it, and great teams outperform lone heroes. This is an opportunity to help establish how Fullscript builds and engages patients on mobile. You’ll join an experienced team, strong product leadership, and the opportunity to shape the technical approach, product experience, and engineering practices that take it forward. It combines the scope and ambiguity of a new product with the resources and scale of an established company. What We Can Offer You Generous PTO and competitive pay Fullscript’s RRSP match program for financial health Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives Discount on Fullscript catalog of products Ability to work Wherever You Work Well* Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office — whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡 Why Fullscript Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity
The Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Growth & Expansion (ECSM) owns the full lifecycle of Fullscript's enterprise accounts — from onboarding through long-term account expansion. This role bridges the gap between Fullscript's platform and the complex needs of enterprise clients, but its primary mandate is growth: converting a single-department foothold into a multi-department, system-wide partnership. The ECSM builds and executes the strategic account plan that unlocks new specialties, service lines, and affiliated practices, working at the executive level to do it, while ensuring existing departments continue to realize and expand the value of the platform.
By leveraging a personalized, consultative, and strategic approach, the ECSM will help accounts align their operational goals with Fullscript's capabilities — ensuring immediate value from onboarding and continued, compounding growth across the account. The ECSM will be responsible for achieving key performance and expansion metrics, including prescribing practitioner growth, ordering patients, account-level revenue growth, and new departments/specialties activated.
What you'll do
Account Onboarding & Expansion Strategy
Design tailored onboarding strategies that address the unique needs of multi-location and multi-department organizations, ensuring consistent implementation across all locations
Map the account's full organizational structure — departments, service lines, and affiliated/member practices — to identify and prioritize the highest-value expansion targets beyond the initial contract
Build and execute a multi-year account growth plan that converts a single-department contract into a system-wide, multi-specialty partnership
Translate department-level pilot results into a business case for expansion, tailored to each new department or specialty's priorities
Executive Relationship Management & Account Growth
Position Fullscript's value, technology, and buyer needs to multiple stakeholders — including C-level executives, medical, finance, and operations — via virtual and in-person discovery meetings, training, and business reviews
Serve as the primary and trusted advisor for expansion conversations, building relationships with the executives, service line directors, and clinical leadership who control expansion into new specialties, departments, or affiliated practices
Monitor accounts for key milestones, such as platform adoption rates and revenue growth, to identify opportunities that deepen engagement, foster long-term partnerships, and position underutilized Fullscript features to increase value and revenue
Navigate complex, matrixed governance and procurement processes to secure buy-in and agreements for new departmental rollouts
Relationship Management, Enablement & Cross-Functional Execution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (executive, medical, marketing, support, and data teams) and external stakeholders to create shared goals, including increasing patient engagement, streamlining workflows, and driving platform usage
Coordinate training sessions for practitioners and staff, including live demos, walkthroughs, and ongoing education programs to ensure users understand and maximize the platform's value
Partner with clinical liaisons, marketing, and implementation teams to replicate successful playbooks into new specialties and departments within the same account

  A hands-on approach will enable you to work confidently within our coast-to-coast team, learning about an ever-developing suite of products, and translating that knowledge to consistently provide real customer value.  
   
   Responsibilities and Duties   
  Overall Responsibilities:  
 
  Own the customer relationship post sales  
  Develop a trusted advisor relationship with customers  
  Provide appropriate business outcomes to ensure the achievement of customer goals   
  Ensure customers receive value through business insights not just data  
  Act as a customer advocate within the company and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to ensure customer retention and customer success  
  Appropriate level of client engagement as per Intouch’s client classification  
  Manage Hubspot as appropriate  
  Effectively manage monthly customer invoicing in a timely manner  
  Forecast customer volumes and track monthly project achievements.   
  Complete contract renewals, as applicable  
  Proficiency in market research principles and concepts  
 
     
  Customer Intake:  
 
  Complete full range of onboarding functions and duties   
  Complete presentations and trainings of our product suite  
  Collaborate with the customer and internal team in development of market research questionnaires using market research best practices  
  Maintain and own project timelines  
  Determine client reporting needs and assist in creating custom dashboards and reports as needed  
 
     
  Ongoing Customer Journey:  
 
  Educate customers on continuous platform improvements   
  Promote cross-platform usage of products to find opportunities for upsell/cross sell  
  Increase revenue of current client portfolio  
  Other duties as appropriate to represent our Vision, fulfill our Mission, and live by our Values and guiding principles.  
 
     
   Qualifications, Skills & Attitudes:   
 
  Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience  
  A minimum of 3+ years of experience in Customer Success Management, Client Management or Project Management  
  Detail-oriented and demonstrated commitment to high-quality output  
  Demonstrated ability to proactively contribute value in a team environment.  
  Proficiency with MS suite and Google suite, experience with AI tools.  
  Experience with customer-facing software solutions is preferable  
  Industry-specific experience or even retail experience is an asset  
  French is an asset

The Opportunity  
   
 Intouch Insight provides some of North America’s top brands with actionable insights into their customers’ experiences and helps them achieve operational excellence while earning customer loyalty and improving business outcomes. 
   
 Ideally, you have already gained some practical experience as a Data Analyst in a corporate environment and are now keen to develop your skills further within a growing business that supports your passion for finding meaning within data and is committed to providing advanced analytics and useful insights to its customers. 
   
  Your responsibilities  
 As a Data Analyst at Intouch Insight, you’ll use your skill and experience to identify, analyze and interpret results and trends to provide insights for our clients. You will plan and create reports/presentations and work with our Customer Success and Sales team to communicate findings to our clients and prospects. You will also be invited to review clients’ customer experience objectives and work with our internal teams to determine the best way to deliver high quality data (strategy, processes, tools) that meet our clients’ expectations. Finally, our internal teams including Marketing and Product will be looking for your support on various research projects. 
   
  Required Skills and Experience  
 
 2 years of relevant experience in a data analysis role, with proven analytical and research skills. 
 Proven history of strict attention to quality and detail. 
 Ability to write, explain and present analysis clearly and concisely to internal and external stakeholders. 
 Ability to generate business-relevant insights from raw data, with or without the usage of AI. 
 Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint. 
 Knowledge of statistical principles (ex. correlation, regression, statistical significance, etc.) and experience using BI Tools (especially Tableau) to analyze datasets. 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. French skills are an asset. 
 Ability to perform data cleansing, wrangling and validation. 
 Foundational skills with AI on generation of insights, presentations and charts. 
 Familiarity with Python (data analysis, Pandas, scikit-learn, JSON) is an asset. 
 
   
  Qualifications  
 
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field is preferable, but relevant experience in lieu will be considered. 
 Experience in the CX industry and/or Marketing Studies is an asset. 
 Data analysis/science-related certifications are an asset. 
 
   
 Pay range - $60,000-$70,000 per year 
   
  About our Team  
  At Intouch Insight, you will be joining a team that is passionate about working with customers and experienced in the implementation of customer experience management (CX) programs to help our customers create positive user experiences. Our unique approach to CX management incorporates multiple data sources, including surveys, checklists, mystery shopping and operational audits data, all under a common reporting platform. We enjoy building and sustaining long-term relationships with our impressive client base while helping them grow their brands and delight their customers to achieve CX excellence. We use traditional methods as well as the latest technology to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

The Mission  
  We are looking for a technical leader who views IT as an engineering challenge. Instead of manual ticketing and managing from a distance, you will build the "IT Stack as Code." You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of our IT infrastructure, security, and compliance, ensuring our technology supports business growth through operational efficiency.  
   
  A primary focus for this role is the automation, execution, and ongoing management of the company’s SOC 2 Type 2 compliance program. You will implement IT operations with an automation-first mindset, championing security best practices across the organization.   
   
  What You’ll Do  
 
  Infrastructure as Code (IaC):   Use   Terraform   to manage and provision our cloud identity and security infrastructure, ensuring a reproducible and scalable environment.  
  Automation-First Management:   Oversee the administration and security of our corporate environment, including endpoint management for a mixed Windows and MacOS fleet.  
  Unified Endpoint Management:   Implement and maintain   Jamf   for MacOS and   Microsoft Intune   for Windows to automate device enrollment, patching, and security configuration.  
  Identity & Access (IAM):   Secure and automate user lifecycles within   Microsoft Entra ID   and Google Workspace.  
  Continuous Compliance (SOC 2):   Lead the execution of our SOC 2 Type 2 program. Instead of manual spreadsheets, you will build automated workflows to ensure all controls are documented and operating effectively.  
  Security Engineering:   Establish IT security policies, manage vulnerability remediation, and lead incident response procedures through a lens of automated detection and alerting.  
  Strategic Growth:   Develop an IT roadmap that aligns with long-term business goals while managing the operational budget and vendor relationships.      
 
  What You’ll Need  
 
  Technical Depth:   Professional experience as a Sr. IT Engineer or DevOps Engineer with a focus on infrastructure automation.  
  The "DevOps" Mindset:   Proven ability to use tools like   Terraform   to manage cloud-based identity and access management (IAM), specifically   Microsoft Entra ID  .  
  Modern MDM Expertise:   Deep proficiency in securing endpoints across Windows (  Intune  ) and MacOS (  Jamf  ).  
  SOC 2 Experience:   Demonstrable experience leading or contributing to SOC 2 Type 2 audits, ideally with a focus on automated evidence collection.  
  Platform Mastery:   Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace in a corporate setting.  
  Communication:   Ability to articulate technical strategy to both technical teams and executive leadership.      
 
  Success Measures  
 
  Efficiency via Automation:   Successful achievement of roadmap milestones with a focus on reducing manual overhead.  
  Push-Button Compliance:   Maintaining a continuously auditable SOC 2 environment with zero critical findings during audits.  
  Reliability:   High uptime and reliability of critical IT infrastructure.

Intouch Insight has been helping multi-location brands across North America turn customer feedback and operational data into action since 1992. The Role

We're looking for a Sales Manager to lead and energize a small sales team. This is a player-coach role: part of your week will be spent coaching, motivating, and removing roadblocks for your reps, and part of it may be spent directly securing and managing a book of house accounts.

We are a lean, tight-knit team where everyone's contribution is visible and you will thrive here if you are hands-on by nature, energized by daily sales activity, and good at bringing out the best in a small, nimble team. We sell across the mid-market and enterprise levels, leveraging both inbound and outbound strategies. If you like being close to the action - coaching reps one day, jumping on a client call the next - this is your kind of place.

What You'll Do

• Lead, coach, and motivate a small team of sales reps - running regular 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and call-coaching to build skill and energy and to ensure continuous improvement of key sales metrics (eg close rates).

• Set the tone for the team day to day: hands-on, energetic, and engaged rather than purely strategic or hierarchical.

• Take responsibility for the delivery of the sales department’s quota.

• Professionally respond to RFI’s and RFP’s as required to secure new business

• Take responsibility for the management of house accounts as required.

• Own team-level pipeline health and forecasting and be responsible for the accurate and timely reporting of sales team KPI’s to leadership.

• Help recruit, onboard, and ramp-up new sales reps as the team grows.

• Work closely with marketing, customer success, and product teams to ensure a smooth client hand-off and ensure successful ongoing execution.

• Identify and act on opportunities to improve the sales process, tools, and messaging.

• Jump in on deals directly when needed - helping to close, unblocking a stuck opportunity, or covering for a rep.

• Leverage technology to drive the efficiency and effectiveness of our sales process, utilizing the latest in AI tooling to improve our team’s performance.

•

What We're Looking For

• 3–6+ years of B2B sales experience, with some team leadership or mentorship experience.

• A genuine hands-on style - you'd rather be in the field, on calls, and writing RFP responses than buried in strategy decks.

• Experience motivating and developing a remote team; you know how to keep energy and accountability high without heavy process.

• Comfortable carrying some individual sales responsibility yourself, alongside managing others.

• Ability to travel if/as required to support sales team, prospects and clients.

• Experience in market research, customer experience measurement, SaaS, or a related B2B services space is an asset.

• Strength in utilizing technologies including Microsoft product suite, CRM tools, and emerging AI tools.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

• Excellent communication skills and a natural relationship-builder, both with clients and with your team.

• The ability to work one day of the week in the Kanata Office would be an asset.

•

Compensation

• Base salary of 120k-130k, plus a variable compensation package tied to performance.

Why Intouch Insight

• An entrepreneurial and collaborative environment where your impact is visible and immediate.

• The chance to shape how a sales team operates, rather than inheriting a rigid playbook.

• Work with recognizable, established brands across North America.

Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. 
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview
Are you passionate about security, compliance, and supporting mission-critical work? We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Facilities Security Officer (FSO) to lead and maintain our government security clearance programs. 
In this role, you will serve as the primary administrator of the company's Facility Clearance (FCL) and personnel security clearance program, helping ensure our continued ability to perform classified work for Government customers. You will also play a critical role in managing compliance with Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) requirements, supporting facility clearance eligibility, government reporting obligations, and mitigation activities. You'll partner with employees, leadership, government representatives, and cross-functional teams to maintain compliance, support cleared personnel and strengthen our overall security posture. 
NOTE: Candidate must reside in Virginia. 

Compensation & Benefits
The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you.  If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable).
$80,000 - $130,000 USD
Salary range (min - max)
Position Type: Vacancy

Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as:  
 
- Generous time off policies 
- Competitive compensation 
- Volunteer opportunities  
- Reward and recognition programs   
- Employee committees & resource groups  
- Healthcare and retirement benefits 
 
Indicators of Success 
 
We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
 
How We Work
 
At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
 
We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!
 
The Most Important Thing
 
We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: 
 
CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. 
OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. 
DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. 
EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.
 
Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. 
 
Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact aoda@magnetforensics.com should you require any accommodations.
 
All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.
 
US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

You’re as comfortable designing architecture as you are shipping code, and you care deeply about developer experience, scalability, and performance. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale.
As a Front-End Architect, you’ll help shape the foundation of how all our SaaS products are built and experienced. Our goal is to enable product teams to deliver faster, safer, and more consistent customer experiences, and you’ll play an instrumental role in that journey. You’ll have outsized impact. The work you do will unlock speed and consistency across multiple SaaS products, laying the groundwork for our next-generation unified platform.

You’ll join a culture that values autonomy and trust. We empower experienced engineers to make decisions, move quickly, and see their work make a measurable difference. No ivory towers.

Our sales enablement program is built to make you a product and industry expert in under three months. At March Networks, our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you will enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. You will be part of a growing global technology company that encourages teamwork and innovation, and where friendships are forged with colleagues all over the world. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

## Role overview

This role combines end‑to‑end Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP)) leadership with advanced strategic procurement for March Networks & Vivotek hardware. The director is accountable for aligning demand, supply, and financial plans while building and managing a world‑class supply base that enables successful product hardware build strategies with our global Contract Manufacturing partners, including Delta and Sanmina.

## Key responsibilities

## S&OP / IBP ownership

• Architect, implement, and continuously improve the S&OP / IBP framework, calendar, and governance across Sales, Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

• Define the S&OP key metrics including, standard templates, KPIs, and RACI to ensure a disciplined, repeatable process.

• Lead monthly demand, supply, and executive S&OP reviews; ensure decisions are translated into MPS/MRP, capacity plans, and commercial commitments.

• Integrate demand forecasts, supply plans, and financial plans to deliver revenue, service level, and inventory objectives while managing risk for both March Networks and Vivotek demand (SSS LOB)

• Benchmark and embed best practices, tools, and analytics to support scenario planning and decision quality.

## Demand, supply, and inventory planning

• Lead development of a consensus demand plan by integrating sales input from March and Vivotek sales regions, market intelligence, and statistical forecasts, including NPI demand.

• Oversee forecasting methodologies, forecast accuracy and metrics, and demand risk/opportunity management.

• Lead Operations / Supply Chain to translate demand into capacity, supply, and inventory plans that meet service and working capital targets.

• Lead scenario planning for upside/downside demand, component constraints, customer priorities, inventory investment, and revenue recovery strategies

## Strategic Procurement for SSS LOB

• Provide advanced procurement leadership to the Hardware Engineering organization throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept through volume production for Taipei, Poland, Milan and Ottawa design teams

• Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships across key hardware commodities, including Memory/SOC/ICs/processors, PCBs, connectors, fans, and electro‑mechanical components.

• Lead enterprise supply risk management including geopolitical, sanctions, tariff, lifecycle, allocation, and single-source component risks while developing mitigation strategies.

• Act as the primary business interface between supply partners, Hardware Engineering, Product Line Management, and Operations.

• Lead component price negotiations and manage commercial release milestones to meet build schedules, cost, and margin objectives.

• Evaluate supplier capability, reliability, capacity, financial health, and cost competitiveness to support both NPI and long‑term supply strategies.

## Contract Manufacture and Outsourcing

• Supports global contract manufacturing partners, including Delta, Sanmina, and future partners across North America, Europe, and Asia.

• Drive and negotiate cost model negotiations with existing and new outsource partners to maximize the SSS LOB’s margin contribution.

• Supports global third-party and outsourced logistics locations for inventory management, configuration capabilities, and direct order fulfillment, including inbound, outbound, and intercompany shipment logistics.

• In collaboration with the Technical Operations team, engages contract manufacturers early and formally in DFM/DFA by conducting joint design reviews, BOM rationalization, and component risk assessments to ensure manufacturability, test strategy, and lifecycle/obsolescence considerations are built in.

• Manages a rolling 6–12-month forecast, including fixed, flex, and forecast windows, with MPS/MRP visibility and clear rules for expedites, reschedules, and minimum order quantities to stabilize planning and ensure supply continuity.

• Manages raw material risk and liability exposure by leveraging Kinaxis to provide visibility into work orders, WIP, purchase orders, and inventory, reconciled against demand.

## BOM analysis, risk, and lifecycle management

• Drive component portfolio rationalization across all 4 design teams to reduce the number of suppliers and components being supported.

• Perform in‑depth Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis to inform S&OP and procurement decisions, including long lead‑time risk and early‑purchase strategies.

• Drive end‑of‑life (EOL) component analysis, Product Change Notification (PCN) reviews, and dual‑sourcing strategies to protect continuity of supply.

• Assess manufacturing cost structures for NPI designs and provide component‑level and finished‑goods cost models to Product Line Management and Finance.

• Serve as the point of escalation for material shortages impacting builds, pilot runs, and volume product builds, coordinating mitigation across planning, engineering, and suppliers.

## Commercial and contractual leadership

• Lead procurement contract, NDA, and commercial term negotiations with key suppliers in alignment with corporate policies and risk appetite.

• Conduct business and financial reviews of potential and existing suppliers to support sourcing decisions and S&OP risk reviews.

• Manage pricing updates and verification for Engineering, Product Line Management, and Finance to ensure alignment of standard costs with S&OP assumptions and financial plans.

## Executive engagement and change leadership

• Present S&OP outcomes, supply risks, procurement strategies, and scenario analyses to executive leadership, driving data‑driven decisions.

• Champion cross‑functional alignment between Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Procurement, resolving conflicts and enforcing accountability for inputs and actions.

• Lead change management to elevate S&OP and strategic sourcing maturity, including process improvements, tool adoption, and capability building across the organization.

• Participate in Product Line readiness and gate reviews, clearly articulating status, risks, mitigation plans, and commercial implications.

## Performance management and governance

• Define and monitor KPIs spanning both domains: forecast accuracy and bias, OTIF, inventory turns, capacity utilization, material availability, NPI launch readiness, cost variance, and savings.

• Ensure that S&OP decisions and sourcing strategies are reflected in ERP/APS data, material masters, and procurement records.

• Drive continuous improvement in planning, sourcing, and NPI commercialization, quantifying financial and operational benefits (e.g., reduced expedites, improved fill rates, lower obsolescence, better margins).

## Qualifications and experience

• 10+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or procurement in the high‑tech / networking or electronics industry, including strategic sourcing and supplier management.

• 5+ years of direct experience leading S&OP/IBP or integrated demand/supply planning processes, ideally in a hardware or systems environment.

• Hands‑on experience with NPI processes and BOM analysis, including cost modeling, lifecycle/risk assessment, and supplier selection.

• Demonstrated success negotiating complex commercial agreements, including pricing, contracts, and NDAs with semiconductor and electronics suppliers.

• Strong understanding of MRP/MPS, capacity planning, and inventory management, and how they connect to S&OP and financial planning.

• Proficiency with ERP and planning systems (e.g., SAP or similar), sourcing tools, and advanced Excel/analytics; experience with product lifecycle or Agile/PLM systems is an asset.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and leadership skills; proven ability to influence cross‑functional stakeholders and executives and to drive decisions under time pressure.

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including financial analysis, scenario modeling, and supply risk mitigation.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; Master’s degree is an asset.

## Personal attributes

• Strategic, systems thinker who can connect commercial, technical, and operational decisions end‑to‑end.

• Highly collaborative and team‑oriented, with the presence to lead cross‑functional forums and executive reviews.

• Comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, ambiguous environment with multiple concurrent NPI programs and evolving customer demand.

• Results‑driven with a focus on disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and measurable impact on revenue, margin, and service.

· Global Exposure

· Medical/Dental benefits offered immediately from Day 1

· Health club reimbursement

· Professional development support

· Company holiday closure

Please note March Networks uses AI as part of the recruitment process.

VICE PRESIDENT, PROFESSIONAL SERVICES
Job Description

At March Networks, our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you will enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. You will be part of a growing global technology company that encourages teamwork and innovation, and where friendships are forged with colleagues all over the world. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

Reporting directly to the CEO and President, the Vice President of Professional Services is responsible for leading, scaling, and continuously improving the end-to-end post-sales services organization for the Smart Security Solutions LOB (March Networks and Vivotek), including Professional Services, Technical Support, Network Operations Center (NOC), Cloud Services, Customer Success, Training, and Implementation. This executive will own the operating model, service delivery governance, technical enablement strategy, and financial performance of the services organization, ensuring that customer deployments, managed services, support operations, and adoption programs are delivered with high quality, predictability, and profitability.

The Vice President of Professional Services will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, recurring revenue retention, and business growth by evolving service delivery models, standardizing implementation and support processes, improving resource utilization, and embedding automation, analytics, and AI into the service lifecycle. This leader must also have demonstrated success leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones, establishing common operating standards, escalation frameworks, service-level accountability, and a cohesive culture while ensuring consistent execution and customer outcomes worldwide.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic, data-driven, and AI-enabled leader with deep experience transforming complex service organizations in SaaS, cloud, intelligent edge, IoT, or enterprise technology environments. This individual combines strong commercial judgment, technical fluency, operational discipline, and customer-centric leadership, and can align delivery excellence with strategic business objectives, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

## Key Responsibilities

## Strategic Leadership

• Develop and execute a multi-year services strategy and operating roadmap that advances the organization from reactive execution to standardized, metrics-driven, outcome-based delivery aligned with corporate growth objectives.

• Define the target operating model across Professional Services, Support, NOC, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and Training, including service catalog, engagement models, escalation paths, and ownership boundaries across the customer lifecycle.

• Lead the incorporation of AI, workflow automation, knowledge management, and analytics into core service motions such as case deflection, triage, onboarding, project delivery, health scoring, and incident response to improve efficiency, predictability, and customer experience.

• Partner with Product Management, R&D, IT, Security, and Sales leadership to ensure that product roadmap priorities, for serviceability, and ease of deployment architecture, as well as supportability requirements are reflected in both R&D commitments and execution.

## Operational Excellence

• Oversee the end-to-end delivery of all professional services engagements, implementation programs, onboarding activities, support operations, cloud service processes, and managed services commitments, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, in compliance with contractual obligations, and at target gross margin.

• Establish and enforce delivery governance mechanisms including stage gates, project reviews, technical design reviews, resource management disciplines, and executive escalation processes for high-impact strategic customer programs.

• Build scalable, repeatable delivery methodologies, statements of work, implementation playbooks, support runbooks, and training frameworks that increase scalability, improve quality, and shorten time-to-service.

• Automate ticket management, incident response, root-cause analysis, service restoration, and problem management disciplines, including clear ownership of SLA attainment, backlog aging, response times, and resolution times.

• Implement service performance dashboards and operating cadences that provide visibility into bookings, backlog, capacity, utilization, project margin, support case trends, renewal risk, and customer health.

## Financial Management

• Own services P&L performance, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, utilization, headcount productivity, subcontractor spend, and cost-to-serve.

• Develop robust forecasting, budgeting, and reporting frameworks for bookings, revenue recognition readiness, delivery backlog, staffing demand, and margin performance, enabling proactive business decisions and resource balancing.

• Lead disciplined change-order and scope-governance processes to ensure that out-of-scope work is identified early, documented, approved, priced appropriately, and converted into profitable revenue.

## Organizational Design

• Continuously evolve the organizational structure, role clarity, spans and layers, and regional coverage model across Customer Success, Technical Support, Managed Services, Cloud Operations, and Technical Training to support growth, specialization, and scalability.

• Create standardized operating procedures, knowledge transfer models, and tooling strategies across regions to ensure globally consistent execution between March Networks and Vivotek support staff.

• Work cross-functionally with R&D, Product Management, and IT to improve serviceability, observability, deployment automation, release readiness, and support transition processes, outlining a clear vision for transforming the current services and platform offering into a differentiated, scalable, and efficient operating model.

## Client, Partner Engagement & Vendor Management

• Serve as an executive sponsor and escalation point for strategic customers and complex deployments, building trusted relationships that support adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term account value.

• Partner closely with the Sales organization to strengthen the positioning, packaging, and attach rate of value-added services, recurring support, software, and managed offerings, while ensuring sold engagements are technically sound, commercially viable, and operationally deliverable.

• Optimize customer lifecycle motions across onboarding, implementation, adoption, support, training, and renewal readiness to improve customer outcomes and reduce churn risk. Common SaaS customer success metrics used to manage this include churn, retention, NPS, CSAT, CES, and customer health scoring.

• Manage strategic outsourcing, subcontracting, and service delivery partners, including partner selection, commercial terms, delivery governance, performance management, and compliance with quality and timeline expectations.

## Qualifications

## Education

Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. MBA or other advanced business or technical degree preferred.

## Experience

• Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in professional services, technical services, consulting, customer success, support operations, or managed services within the software, SaaS, cloud, IoT, or enterprise technology sector.

• At least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing complex, multi-function services organizations with global or multi-regional teams.

• Proven track record of transforming service delivery organizations to improve scalability, utilization, delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

• Strong experience with cloud operations, SaaS delivery models, subscription-based customer lifecycle management, and post-sales operating metrics.

• Demonstrated expertise in resource planning, backlog management, utilization management, project margin control, forecasting, and services financial management.

• Experience implementing or optimizing customer success programs, onboarding models, adoption frameworks, and retention strategies using measurable KPIs such as churn, retention, NPS, CSAT, CES, and health scores.

• Familiarity with AI, workflow automation, analytics, and knowledge-centered service strategies that improve support efficiency, delivery quality, and customer experience.

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with R&D, Product Management, IT, Security, Sales, and Finance.

• Experience managing third-party service providers, subcontractors, and global delivery models with clear governance and quality controls.

• Outstanding executive communication, stakeholder management, change leadership, and people development capabilities.

## Preferred Technical and Domain Experience

• Experience in intelligent video, video management systems, cloud video platforms, physical security, IoT-connected devices, edge-to-cloud architectures, or enterprise loss prevention technologies is highly desirable.

• Experience with service organizations supporting hybrid environments that include hardware, firmware, software, SaaS, networking, and cybersecurity considerations is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with service management, CRM, and professional services automation platforms such as Salesforce, Service Cloud, Jira, ServiceNow, ConnectWise, Certinia/PSA, or equivalent tooling is an asset.

• Knowledge of ITIL-based support operations, incident/problem/change management, observability practices, and SLA-driven managed services environments is preferred.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Intermediate Software Developer to join our global Developer Experience and Release Engineering team. This role focuses on evolving our legacy Jenkins-based build environments into a scalable, hybrid CI/CD ecosystem spanning on-premise and cloud infrastructure, improving artifact management, integrating with modern software lifecycle tools, and ensuring smooth, well-governed release processes for major and maintenance updates.

You will support our global R&D teams, who develop cloud and on-premise software solutions across Windows, Linux, and mobile platforms.

## Build Modernization

o Support development teams as they migrate from Bitbucket Server and legacy Windows and Linux Jenkins build machines to GitHub and GitHub Actions on hosted and self-hosted runners, ensuring minimal disruption.

o Improve artifact storage and retrieval processes.

o Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform.

o Monitor performance, optimize costs, and automate everything that can be automated.

## Release Management

o Coordinate with development, QA, and product teams to ensure timely and high-quality releases for a suite of applications:

o Major releases: 2–3 times per year.

o Maintenance releases and hotfixes: As needed.

o Expertise in containerization (Docker).

o Experience with Kubernetes, ArgoCD and Helm.

o Experience with hybrid VM lifecycle/provisioning tools (e.g. HPE Morpheus) spanning AWS and on-premise infrastructure.

o Experience with AWS IAM management – users, groups, roles, policies.

o Familiarity with software lifecycle tools.

o Hands-on experience with release management processes for multi-application environments.

o Understanding of CI/CD best practices and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible).

o Scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash).

o Comfortable using AI to write software.

• College or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering program, or equivalent.

## Nice-to-Have

o Exposure to or interest in building out on-premise self-hosted runner infrastructure (Linux/Windows) is an asset.

o Knowledge of SOC2 compliance or other security standards.

System Architect Verification Engineer

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

ABOUT RANOVUS

Ranovus is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, developing next-generation co-packaged optics (CPO) solutions for AI and data center interconnects. Our Odin optical engine integrates a Quantum Dot Multi-Wavelength Laser, Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC), and ASIC into a single co-packaged module – delivering the performance and density required by hyperscale AI infrastructure.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The System Architect Verification engineer develops and runs behavioral simulations and control verification tests for the optical engine (OE). Working in SystemVerilog and RTL, you will validate control algorithm, bring-up sequences, and link training algorithms before silicon is available – ensuring firmware and ASIC logic are correct before the first chip arrives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and maintain SystemVerilog behavioral models of PIC, ASIC, and Laser subsystems for pre-silicon system simulation.

• Build and run control verification testbenches: mission mode, bring-up sequences, link training, OE calibration, and fault recovery state machines.

• Verify closed-loop (feedback) control algorithms used to calibrate and stabilize PIC components, such as bias and wavelength locking loops.

• Perform RTL-level verification of ASIC control blocks in collaboration with the ASIC team.

• Develop and maintain regression environments for control algorithm and bring-up validation.

• Run corner case simulations across PVT (process, voltage, temperature) conditions and aging scenarios.

• Correlate simulation results against lab measurements to validate model accuracy.

• Support pre-silicon firmware validation in collaboration with the FW team.

• Extend the system simulation environment as new blocks and features are added.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• MSc. in Electrical Engineering or related field with 6+ years of experience, or preferred Ph.D. with 3+ years of experience, in digital or mixed-signal verification using System Verilog.

• Familiarity with RTL simulation tools.

• Understanding of closed-loop (feedback) control concepts for controlling PIC components (e.g., bias/wavelength locking control loops) and hardware bring-up sequencing.

• Basic understanding of optical/photonic components such as micro-ring modulators (MRM), photodetectors, and similar devices.

• Python or MATLAB for scripting, data analysis, and regression automation.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Verilog-A or Verilog-AMS for modeling analog or optical components.

• Experience with optical or photonic system simulation.

• Familiarity with SPICE or mixed-signal analog simulation.

• Understanding of PAM4 link behavior and BER analysis.

• Exposure to SerDes or high-speed interface IP verification.

【募集背景】

生産技術部門は、高品質かつ低コストの製品を安定的に製造するため、半導体前工程での新製品立上げから、品質・生産性・コスト改善までを一貫して推進する部門です。工場運営の要として、技術的リードと改善を牽引しています。

革新的な技術開発への情熱、起業家精神、そして高い当事者意識を持ち、今後の工場運営の中核となるリーダー人材を求めています。   【職種概要】  
以下のいずれかの工程（拡散／LPCVD、PVD／めっき、WET洗浄、ドライエッチング）において、生産装置およびプロセスに関わる業務を担当いただきます。   【主な業務内容】      生産設備の導入および立上げ  
新規・更新装置の据付、条件設定、評価を行い、量産投入に向けた立上げを実施。     量産プロセスの構築および生産パスの確保

歩留・品質を維持向上するための分析、対策立案、異常発生時の処置・原因究明を行う。     設備の処理能力改善および故障診断

We are looking for a talented Snr Staff Digital Design Engineer with a BSc/MSc in Electrical/Computer Engineering (EE/ECE) and industry experience of 10 plus years. Successful candidate will be reporting to the Snr Manager of Design Engineering.  Our team works on the most advanced digital power management ICs in the industry. This is an excellent full-time/permanent role giving the opportunity to work with an expert team pushing the envelope of digital design, verification, debug, simulation, and automation script development and thus contributing to industry leading chips.  Job Duties: 
- Develop, debug, and verify digital designs in pre and post silicon environment 
- Write tests to verify bulk design intent as per specification. 
- Learn, develop and improve scripts to facilitate design automation flows. 
- Manage assigned design blocks in design requirements, architecture, and implementation 
- Research and present new tools in aid of design development process 
- Act as technical mentor for junior engineers. 
- Represent digital design as functional digital design lead in design projects.   - BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering (EE/ECE) and 10+ years of relevant industry experience 
- Prior design project work experience showing collaborative and innovative thinking 
- Proficient in developing CDC / RDC / LINT clean designs in Verilog 
- Comfortable with debugging mixed-signal designs in System Verilog based test benches 
- Exposed to gate level simulation debug. 
- Experience in designing industry standard serial interfaces (I2C, I3C, SPI, I2S etc) 
- Strong analytical skills and debug methodology 
- Good written and verbal communications skills 
- Working experience with Cadence or Synopsys design tool flows. 
- Hands-on technical leadership role resulting in successful projects.  Preferred skills: 
- Proficient in scripting languages such as Python/Perl 
- Knowledge of ARM cortex M-series processor and computer architecture in general. 
- Exposure to mixed signal designs w/ basic understanding of analog circuits. 
- Experience in digital backend design flow (synthesis / STA / P&R) 
- Full design flow experience (specification, micro-architecture, RTL implementation, backend implementation).   The expected annual pay range for this position is €61,000–€82,000. Please note that the final offer will depend on factors such as geographic location, relevant experience, and the candidate’s skill set.  This role is also eligible for a bonus. As an AI Compiler Engineer on the Renesas HPC team, you will be responsible for driving compiler and code generation technologies that unlock the full compute potential of Renesas next-generation automotive System-on-Chip platforms, including advanced 3 nm silicon for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Your work will directly impact how AI workloads — from perception and sensor fusion to in-vehicle assistants and advanced driver assistance — are translated into highly optimized, safe, and power-efficient execution on Renesas hardware. 
This role bridges software compiler development, AI model lowering/optimization, and hardware-software co-design, enabling Renesas SoCs to deliver industry-competitive performance, efficiency, and functional safety required by multi-domain automotive applications..

・Lead AI compiler architecture across model ingestion, graph optimization, lowering, code generation, and runtime integration 
・Design and implement graph‑level optimizations (operator fusion, quantization‑aware rewrites, memory‑aware scheduling, partitioning) 
・Drive performance optimization for target NPUs, including tiling, tensor layout, and multi‑core execution strategies 
・Partner with SoC and AI accelerator architects to influence hardware features through compiler insights 
・Own performance KPIs for real automotive AI workloads using simulators, profilers, and silicon‑correlated models 
・Ensure compiler outputs meet automotive requirements (real‑time behavior, determinism, quality expectations) 
・Mentor senior engineers and set technical direction without people‑management responsibilities  【Impact & Differentiators】

As a Sr. Staff Power Conversion Technologist, you will serve as a key technical thought leader within the Performance Computing Power organization. You will shape and influence strategic product and technology roadmaps, with a focus on the power distribution architecture spanning from the rack bus bar to the ASIC voltage regulator (VR).   Your mission is to drive compelling system level innovation, establish the right factors of merit, and deeply analyze architectural tradeoffs to ensure that Renesas maintains market leadership in high performance power delivery.    Key Responsibilities    In this forward looking, pathfinding role, you will translate market challenges into long term architectural direction and technology strategy. Core responsibilities include:     Engaging deeply with top, market-defining customers to understand emerging system challenges and requirements.       Modeling, simulating, and analyzing power converters and full power distribution architectures.       Evaluating, synthesizing, and comparing technology options required to realize next generation architectures.       Assessing manufacturing flows and identifying critical process considerations for advanced 3D heterogeneous power packaging.       Developing long-term technology roadmaps spanning packaging, manufacturing processes, and IP development.       Identifying opportunities for differentiated, disruptive products and power technology capabilities.       Leading advanced feasibility studies, developing detailed specification documents, and driving early prototyping with cross functional engineering teams.       Creating methodologies and tools to define and track key KPIs and factors of merit that articulate technical value.       Building organizational alignment around strategic direction and clearly communicating the “why” behind the roadmap to inspire execution and enthusiasm.         You bring deep expertise in high performance power conversion, demonstrating strength across theoretical design, modeling, and real world system implementation. You possess broad technical range across key pillars of advanced power engineering, including:     Magnetic design       Passive component selection       Power device/driver interactions       System level implementation constraints and optimization       Thermal design     This role requires both strong engineering depth and excellent executive level communication skills.   Qualifications:     MSEE or PhD in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent experience)       Directly relevant experience in power electronics, power conversion, PDN design, or system architecture.       Proficiency with key industry standard tools is a significant advantage, including: ‑       Ansys Q3D and Si‑Wave (parasitic extraction, PDN modeling)       Ansys Icepak or Siemens Flotherm (thermal simulation)       Ansys Maxwell (3D magnetic modeling)       Simplis / Simetrix (electrical modeling, architecture simulation)       Cadence Allegro or Altium (PCB tools)      The expected annual pay range for this position is €70,000–€95,000. Some markets you join. This one you help build.  AI compute is outgrowing the ground. As GPU and AI-class systems move into space and other demanding high-reliability settings, the power electronics that feed them have to survive radiation, wide temperature swings, and years of operation with no chance of a service call, at volumes well beyond anything the space industry has produced before. Standard commercial-grade parts cannot meet that bar. Renesas can, and we are opening a new high-reliability (Hi-Rel) growth area to do it: radiation-cognizant power management built on our power portfolio and decades of Hi-Rel heritage.  We are looking for a Staff Business Development Specialist to lead the way into this market. This is a market-creation role, not a territory to maintain. You will find where the real opportunities are, build the customer base from the first conversation, and turn early technical engagements into design wins. You will sit across the table from the GPU and AI-silicon vendors, space-systems primes, and hyperscale operators defining this field, and you will work alongside our product, design, applications, and sales teams to turn those relationships into revenue. If you want your fingerprints on an industry while it is still taking shape, this is that job.  Responsibilities  In this role, you will:  • Identify, pursue, and capture new business in a market Renesas is entering for the first time, from first contact through design-in and production.  • Own senior technical and commercial relationships across the target accounts, from AI-silicon vendors to space-systems primes to hyperscale operators.  • Size the addressable and serviceable market, and build the go-to-market plan that prioritizes accounts, applications, and timing.  • Shape customer requirements early, respond to RFIs and RFPs, and lead proposal development in coordination with product and applications teams.  • Develop pricing and value strategy for radiation-cognizant solutions relative to commodity and fully rad-hard alternatives.  • Run competitive intelligence on incumbent power and Hi-Rel suppliers, and use it to sharpen positioning and roadmap input.  • Support executive reviews and corporate funding proposals with market data, revenue projections, and a defensible business case.  • Work cross-functionally with design, applications, product marketing, and regional sales to align the portfolio with customer needs and to drive design-ins to closure.   • 10 or more years in business development, strategic sales, or product marketing, in semiconductors, power management, aerospace and defense, or high-reliability and space markets.  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field. An MBA is a plus.  • A track record of opening new markets and closing design-ins or partnerships, ideally where the market did not yet exist.  • Direct experience working at, or selling into, GPU and AI-accelerator vendors or hyperscale operators is a major plus.  • The ability to hold technical discussions on power delivery and mixed-signal design with customer engineers, and to translate them into commercial strategy.  • Strong proposal, negotiation, and executive-communication skills.  • Comfort operating in an export-controlled, high-reliability environment.  • Willingness to travel to customers and Renesas sites.  • An independent operator who works effectively across US and Japan-based leadership.   This role offers the chance to build a business from the start inside an established semiconductor company, with the resources of a global portfolio behind it and the impact of a market Renesas is helping to create. At Renesas, we are more than just a semiconductor company; we are the engine behind a "safer, smarter, and more sustainable" future. Headquartered locally in the heart of San Jose, our Silicon Valley team is at the forefront of innovation in Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT technologies. Joining our San Jose office means joining a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your work directly impacts the next generation of AI-driven infrastructure and green energy solutions.    We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Analog Engineer to join our Analog Design team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, simulation, verification, and development of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for automotive, industrial, and power management applications. This role requires strong technical expertise in analog circuit design, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary, global engineering teams.   Key Responsibilities     Circuit Design & Optimization: Perform transistor-level circuit design, simulation, and optimization for high-performance analog and mixed-signal blocks.       Block-Level Architecture: Design and develop precision references and bias circuits, operational amplifiers, comparators, LDO regulators, oscillators, timing circuits, data converter support circuits, and power management/isolation-related analog circuits.       Layout & Physical Design Support: Support IC floorplanning and work closely with layout engineers to ensure robust analog layout implementation.       Silicon Validation: Analyze silicon measurement results, conduct lab evaluation, and drive necessary design improvements.       Qualification & Reliability: Support product qualification, characterization, and reliability testing activities.       Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (or B.S. with equivalent, demonstrated technical expertise).    Technical Fundamentals: Deep understanding of CMOS device physics and analog circuit fundamentals.       EDA Tools: Hands-on experience with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, and standard circuit simulation tools.       Process & Reliability: Practical knowledge of semiconductor process technologies and reliability considerations.       Soft Skills: Excellent technical documentation skills, strong verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, global team environment.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with GaN (Gallium Nitride) device applications and driver design.       Experience with isolated IC design methodologies and high-voltage power management circuits.         The expected annual pay range for this position is $135,000 - $160,000. Partner closely with Module Design Engineering, Customer AEs, Module Manufacturing, and the Module Execution team to align capacity with roadmap commitments. The  Senior Implementation Engineer (SIE)  is assigned to customers immediately after a deal is closed and plays a critical role in ensuring they fully understand and experience the value of Altium’s Enterprise Solutions (AES). In this role, the SIE drives successful solution implementation, enabling customers to become productive and confident with AES.  A standout SIE is highly effective at influencing both internal and external stakeholders—this is the single most important characteristic of the role. SIEs consistently demonstrate value, translate systems and processes into practical workflows, and resolve issues efficiently across teams and customer environments.  This position is essential in bridging the gap between Altium’s Sales, Customer Success (Technical Support), and R&D organizations, ensuring a seamless customer journey and strong cross‑functional alignment. 
 
    A Day in The Life of Our Senior Implementation Engineer     Work with Account Managers, Solution Architects, and other SIEs to train, guide, and coach customers through the myAltium engagement process.    Provide detailed project management skills for the implementation and ensure the customer’s ongoing success post-deployment.    Use in-depth knowledge of the client, industry, business processes, and deep knowledge of the product and technical expertise to drive and increase the adoption and usage of AES.    Serve as the post-sale point of contact for customers during AES implementation.     Collaborate with Altium’s Customer Success (Technical Support) and R&D organizations to ensure timely resolution of issues, and to propose solutions that continually add value to the customer.    Handle escalations of implementation and customer productivity blocking issues, and coordinate related activities with Sales, TAMs, R&D, and Customer Success (Tech Support).    Work with Solution Architects and R&D to resolve software issues with the highest impact on customers and Altium’s business.    Build excellent customer relationships and influence them to adopt recommended best practices.    Work with Account Managers to reduce churn and enable client expansion, renewal, and retention.    Be a customer advocate. Promote a customer-focused culture across Altium to continually improve customer relationships and Altium capabilities.       At least 5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role in Electronic Design Automation (EDA)    Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience    Experience with Altium or other PCB ECAD Library/component management required    Ability to engage customers at the business level, drive alignment, and execution    Ability to be highly effective in a matrix management organization    Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal    Ability to travel up to 30%    PLM expertise is preferred    Fluency in German is preferred 
      Key Competencies      Strategic Thinking  — Ability to think strategically, understand Altium’s goals and objectives, and influence decisions and policies that help both Altium  and  the customer achieve their desired outcomes.     Customer Empathy  — Possesses strong emotional intelligence to empathize with customers, understand who they are and how they think, and translate those insights into clear customer requirements.     Action Orientation  — Demonstrates an action‑oriented mindset and leverages project management skills to collaborate effectively with deployment and technical support teams.     Continuous Improvement  — Proactively drives enhancements to systems, processes, products, and solutions.     Deadline Ownership  — Anticipates critical client deadlines and independently organizes, oversees, and fulfills project timelines to ensure consistent, reliable delivery. As a Senior Field Applications Engineer (FAE) you will play a major role in the expansion of our market-leading digital products (MCUs & SoCs), analog and power by providing outstanding application engineering support to our customers. You will also play a key role in the definition of the next generation of Renesas Automotive Products working closely to the customer engineering teams and to Renesas application engineering and marketing teams.  In your new role you will: 
•    Drive the design-in activities of the complete product portfolio in automotive applications such as IVI, ADAS, xEV, Vehicle Controls etc. working with Automotive OEM customers. 
•    Define new products in close cooperation with our innovative customers and our internal technical marketing and applications teams. 
•    Act as a technical interface and consult our customers during the development of all automotive applications with particular focus on OEMs. 
•    Derive customer system requirements and market trends to develop system value propositions together with internal interfaces (Product Marketers, Application Engineers, System Architects). 
•    Build a good understanding of different product architectures and partner ecosystem to suggest/guide customers, to arrive at an optimal system design. 
•    Actively manage projects together with the Sales and Marketing departments to achieve design-in targets for the complete Renesas automotive product portfolio. 
•    Establish and maintain excellent relationships with the customer engineering departments with particular focus on OEMs. 
•    Proactively connect with global cross-functional teams, expand your internal network, and share your experience to drive global business expansion. 
•    Lead technical discussions with System Architects and Application Engineering experts to jointly define application roadmaps and product technical requirements. 
•    Collaborate internally with Application Engineers and Product Marketers and externally with local and global partners to develop documentation (fighting guides, application notes, whitepapers) and system demonstrators combining software and hardware. 
•    Perform measurements in our laboratory within the scope of actual customer projects. 
•    Present Renesas’ technologies, products, and applications in technical seminars. 
    The preferred candidate is someone who actively listens to their business partners and enjoys building trustful relationships. Confident with setting ambitious goals, making use of the knowledge of the team members and sharing knowledge. Furthermore, someone who keeps profitability in mind and can prioritize technical activities from a commercial point of view would excel in this role.    5+ years of related FAE work experience, including experience with automotive applications & customers.  Understand automotive system technical requirements and propose optimized products and solutions.  Knowledge about semiconductors including SoC, MCU, Analog & Power products.  Experience with OS / Frameworks (Linux, QNX, AUTOSAR, RTOS).  Proficient in multi-threaded programming and middleware solution development in different OS environments. Strong in fundamentals of IPC and OS concepts.  Working knowledge on Automotive Functional Safety and Cybersecurity concepts.  Proficient in Power and Thermal management at system level.  Experience in Vehicle Architecture / Networks design.  Hands-on system bring-up, testing, and debugging skills.  Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other standard lab equipment. Operations Engineering (OED) is the central team that builds the software, tools, and factory-automation. In this role, you'll design and deliver custom software and automation for OED and Operations — integrating with MES and equipment on the manufacturing floor — and project-manage their rollout end-to-end, partnering across OED, OPS, ISD, SW&D, and Product Line PGs to ship solutions that move factory efficiency, yield, and productivity.   Key Responsibilities     Build & maintain custom software tools and automation for Operations Engineering and the manufacturing floor.  Integrate shop-floor equipment and MES via SECS/GEM to enable equipment connectivity, tool control, and real-time monitoring.  Develop & deploy containerized applications (Docker/Kubernetes) that connect operations systems and PMO workflows.  Drive projects from initiation through delivery — scope, schedule, risk, resourcing — interfacing with stakeholders across functions.  Define & improve engineering and project-management processes and standards (issue tracking, requirements management, progress metrics).
