As part of Mid-Market Sales, you’ll be a key player on Altium’s championship team of fast-paced, high-volume selling. With our proven sales process and disciplined Stop-at-Nothing execution, Altium has achieved double-digit revenue growth nine out of the last ten years. For high-performers who help drive it even higher, your career potential is nearly unlimited.   This position is based in our Frisco, TX Sales Hub and follows a hybrid schedule, with in-office work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.   YOU THRIVE ON THE INTENSITY OF HIGH-VOLUME SALES     Drive Growth — You’ll exceed sales targets in acquiring new customers and expanding our footprint in existing accounts.    Strategic Product Planning — Follow a disciplined and analytical approach to planning and maintaining a portfolio of use cases and effectively positioning the platform. You’ll keep the pipeline current and progressing and provide effective feedback on strategic considerations such as pricing and positioning.    Sales Strategies — Develop effective and specific account plans to maximize new product revenue growth. Develop and leverage relationships throughout our strong base of existing accounts and your net new customer accounts to drive strategy through the organization.    Creative Marketing and Prospecting — Think outside the box to cultivate awareness of the Altium vision—vital planning and execution of targeted campaigns for your territory.    Customer Acumen — Understand each customer’s strategic growth plans, technology footprint and corresponding technology strategy, internal challenges, and competitive landscape.    Review Public Information — e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, or press releases for the company and its competitors to remain updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect.    Advance and Close Sales Opportunities — Through successfully executing the sales strategy and roadmap.    Net New Revenue, Adoption and Conversion — Execute new business revenue goals for the organization while closely working with our CSM and support organizations to ensure effective adoption.      THE AMBITION TO SEIZE BIG CHALLENGES, THE DISCIPLINE TO SEE THEM THROUGH     4+ years of quota-carrying, technology solution-based direct sales experience, solution engineering, solution architecture, and/or enterprise marketing, penetrating new products.    Strong sales strategy skills and demonstrated experience prospecting and bringing in new business.    Experience and success selling various software solutions across all lines of business.    Demonstrated experience in keeping accurate forecasts of your territory monthly/quarterly/annually, utilizing sales tools and analytics to target customers with higher propensity to buy, and creating strategies that maximize success.    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and effectively collaborate with adjacent teams and enable the ‘scale up’ process        The expected annual pay range for this position is $114,000. ob Description    As a  Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer , you will be responsible for the verification and modeling of mixed-signal power management devices, including PMICs, battery chargers, switching regulators, and related analog IP. You will work closely with design, systems, verification, CAD, and customer teams to drive successful development, integration, and sign-off of complex mixed-signal power chips.   Verification:  Lead chip-level verification of analog and mixed-signal circuits using AMS and DMS methodologies, integrating analog behavioral models with digital RTL and UVM-based environments. Develop verification strategies, drive coverage closure, and support product tapeout milestones.   Modeling:  Create, maintain, and validate behavioral models using SystemVerilog RNM and Verilog-AMS, translating circuit and system requirements into high-performance models suitable for both AMS co-simulation and full-chip DMS verification. Ensure model accuracy through correlation against specifications and schematic references across operating conditions.   Verification Plan Development:  Develop and execute comprehensive verification and modeling plans with full traceability from design requirements through coverage closure and tapeout sign-off. Track verification readiness and proactively identify risks to product schedules.   Debugging:  Own debug and root-cause analysis of mixed-signal verification issues, including failing test cases, model inaccuracies, analog-digital interface problems, convergence issues, and simulation performance bottlenecks. Drive resolution across design, modeling, and verification teams.   Technical Leadership & Collaboration:  Partner with analog and digital designers, system architects, verification engineers, and CAD teams to improve modeling accuracy, simulation efficiency, and verification quality. Participate in architecture and design reviews, influencing design decisions to improve verification effectiveness and reduce project risk.   Design Review & Optimization : Participate in design reviews to evaluate circuit topology and design partitioning from a verification and modeling perspective, recommending architectural choices that simplify behavioral modeling, improve simulation convergence, and reduce verification risk. Support silicon validation and root-cause analysis of complex system-level issues by correlating simulation predictions to bench measurements.   Documentation:  Document verification plans, model validation methodologies, coverage results, and sign-off metrics to ensure clear communication and traceability throughout the product lifecycle.   Customer Interaction:  Interface directly with external customers to present verification status, review coverage results, address technical questions, and ensure verification deliverables meet product and customer requirements.      Education:  B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.   Experience:  8-12+ years of experience in mixed-signal verification, AMS/DMS simulation, behavioral modeling, power management IC development, or related semiconductor design activities. Strong experience with switching regulators, battery chargers, PMICs, SystemVerilog, Verilog-AMS, UVM, Cadence Xcelium, Spectre, and mixed-signal verification sign-off methodologies is highly desirable. Experience developing behavioral models and debugging complex analog-digital interactions is a plus.   Communication:  Strong communication, teamwork, and customer-facing skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across cross-functional engineering teams and present technical information to both internal and external stakeholders.         Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier . Under supervision, operates and supports MOCVD manufacturing processes in a semiconductor cleanroom environment. Performs routine wafer handling, equipment checks, recipe execution, production tracking, data recording, preventive maintenance support, and shift passdown activities while following documented procedures, safety requirements, cleanroom protocols, and quality standards. Escalates abnormalities promptly to supervision, engineering, maintenance, or safety contacts to protect personnel, equipment, product quality, and schedule commitments.  This department is a 24/7 operation.  Candidates must be flexible in working weekend and night shifts as appropriate.   JOB RESPONSIBILITIES   The following list of duties and responsibilities represents the essential functions of the job. An employee may be required to perform additional duties not listed below on an occasional or frequent basis.   Change into cleanroom garments and required PPE per standard operating procedures so cleanroom standards, contamination control, and personal safety requirements are met.  Clean and maintain work surfaces, wafer handling tools, vacuum wands, transfer fixtures, carriers, load stations, wet benches, and related MOCVD support areas per procedure or whenever contamination is suspected, so risk of particle or product contamination is controlled.  Complete assigned lab tasks, daily equipment checks, chamber/support-area cleaning, consumable checks, and scheduled preventive maintenance support for MOCVD tools and associated equipment.  Record production, PM, metrology, recipe, lot, gas, chemical, material, and equipment status data in required systems and logs so process quality, traceability, and equipment readiness can be monitored.  Communicate clearly and promptly so questions, abnormalities, and handoff items are identified and addressed in a timely manner.  Review and provide verbal shift overlap with operators, technicians, engineers, and supervisors as needed.  Read, write, and send accurate shift passdown covering tool status, lot status, open issues, safety concerns, material needs, and next steps.  Notify supervisor, engineering, maintenance, facilities, or ERT contacts of process problems, tool alarms, safety issues, low gases or chemicals, leaks, abnormal tool conditions, wafer damage, or any area of concern.    Perform required pre-run checks per standard operating procedures before processing product so misprocessing, contamination, and unsafe operation are avoided:  Verify MOCVD tool status, chamber readiness, interlocks, alarms, room conditions, chiller status, and required utilities/gases are within acceptable limits.  Confirm the lot is tracked in the applicable manufacturing execution system before processing.  Verify the previous process step is complete, the traveler is current, and the correct recipe, run conditions, and tool are selected.  Verify wafer identification, lot number, carrier, quantity, orientation, and traveler information match before loading.    Handle, load, unload, and transfer wafers carefully using approved tools and procedures so wafers are not broken, scratched, contaminated, misidentified, or misprocessed.  Execute assigned MOCVD production activities such as wafer preparation support, recipe loading/running, growth monitoring, run completion checks, wafer inspection support, and post-run documentation in accordance with approved procedures.  Assist engineers, maintenance personnel, and experienced operators with troubleshooting support, chamber-related tasks, consumable changes, inventory checks, and continuous improvement activities within training and authorization limits.  Prior to the end of shift, organize the work area, update passdown, place work in a safe and clear handoff condition, clean tables and workstations, clear clutter, return tools/materials to proper locations, and communicate open items to the next operator.  Follow all quality, safety, environmental, attendance, cleanroom, chemical handling, gas safety, wafer handling, and company policies as specified in procedures, training, permits, or other applicable requirements so personnel safety, product quality, productivity, and compliance standards are met. Education: High School diploma or equivalent required; technical certificate or Associate degree in Electronics, Semiconductor Technology, Manufacturing Technology, or related field preferred.  Able to read, write, speak, and understand English; able to perform basic math and accurately complete production records, travelers, logs, and system transactions.    Skills - Able to:    Follow written procedures, manufacturing travelers, recipes, safety instructions, and verbal direction with strong attention to detail. Demonstrate basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook/Teams, database entry, and electronic passdown communication.  Monitor MOCVD-related process indicators such as room conditions, chiller status, gas pressures, chemical/material levels, recipe status, alarms, and equipment readiness. Work assigned shifts, weekends, overtime, and schedule changes as needed to support 24/7 manufacturing and MOCVD growth demand. GUI test automation skills with Python and tools such as Qt Squish, SmartBear Test Complete, or similar.   Familiarity with lab test equipment and measurement tools. The STA Engineer is responsible for ensuring robust timing closure and signoff readiness for block- and full-chip designs across all modes and corners. Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals, timing concepts, and semiconductor design flow. Experience in timing constraints development and debugging.  Strong knowledge of SDC, timing exceptions, false paths, multicycle paths, and case analysis. The ability to understand how our products interact with PLM, enterprise data management platforms, identity management systems, and other connected technologies is critical to effectively diagnosing and resolving customer issues. Document all customer issues, case activities, and escalations in accordance with support processes.  Drive root cause analysis efforts for high-impact customer escalations and coordinate with R&D, Product Management, and Engineering teams.  Create technical content such as online help, user guides, video tutorials, knowledge base articles, quick start guides, and similar materials.  Provide live coaching and assistance to team members.  Act as a senior technical escalation resource, independently driving resolution of highly complex customer issues and providing technical leadership across multiple product and workflow domains.  Test pre-release products and features while helping prepare technical teams for upcoming releases. ## Our Team

Semtech's New Product Introduction (NPI) Product Engineering Team is the central engineering function behind every new product we bring to market. Our team of focused and talented engineers takes full ownership of new product development — driving each program from conception through end-of-life with a commitment to flawless execution. Working closely with all internal cross-functional teams, our engineers define and drive DfT testability requirements, test coverage, production characterization (across process, voltage, and temperature variations), ATE-to-bench correlation, cost and yield optimization, test time reduction, project logistics, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing. We take pride in delivering high-quality products that exceed customer expectations and drive business success — and our versatile, results-driven team makes it happen.

## Job Summary

We are currently looking for a Sr. NPI Product Engineer to join our team. This role sits at the heart of new product development — engaged from product concept through end-of-life — collaborating closely with all internal cross-functional teams to drive program success. This is a unique opportunity for a passionate and driven engineer to influence key engineering and product decisions and make a meaningful impact on the cutting-edge products we deliver to our customers worldwide.

This is an exciting opportunity to work within a world-class NPI development team, focused on designing and developing advanced high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductor IC products in cutting-edge CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. Our products are built with purpose and precision — operating at data rates of 25–400Gbps and beyond — delivering faster, more reliable connectivity for AI data centers, PON, and 5G wireless networks. Reporting to the Manager of NPI Product Engineering, the Sr. NPI Product Engineer will take full ownership of all NPI activities — driving and executing from product concept through final product release while maintaining the product life cycle

## Responsibilities

## 1. NPI Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration (25%)

• Lead and drive all NPI activities from product concept through final product release while ensuring product conformance to specifications, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing

• Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Project Lead, Design, Marketing, Validation, Test Engineering, Characterization, Quality & Reliability, Applications Engineering and Operations to ensure successful product development and delivery

• Actively participate in the milestone reviews of NPI program logistics, timelines, and milestones, providing regular updates to management and stakeholders

• Prepare all NPI product release and OSAT related manufacturing documentations for production transfer and product maintenance

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior product engineers

## 2. Design for Testability/Manufacturability (35%)

• Lead team to define Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Testability (DfT) requirements for NPI products and provide feedback to design for implementation to ensure comprehensive and efficient production test coverage

• Support test engineers in the development, implementation, verification and optimization of ATE test programs ensuring the testability/manufacturability features are considered and implemented, and that test coverage and quality is achieved while maintaining accurate cost models

• Lead product characterization, correlation and release activities, ensuring all datasheet specifications are validated and met

## 3. Characterization, Data Analysis & Yield Optimization (30%)

• Develop comprehensive product characterization plans encompassing both wafer-level and bench characterization tests, ensuring thorough test coverage across all product specifications and operating conditions

• Conduct rigorous data analysis of ATE and bench characterization results across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, including ATE-to-bench correlation studies, PCM data analysis, process capability analysis to ensure product conformance to specifications and yield modeling for new products

• Plan and execute Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize product performance, drive yield analysis, test time reduction, and test optimization efforts — identifying and resolving yield limiters in close collaboration with Design, Test, Quality, and Foundry Process teams

• Contribute to product validation and reliability qualification plans working closely with Test, Characterization, Validation, and Reliability Engineering teams to ensure alignment and successful execution

## 4. Manufacturing Quality, Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement (10%)

• Work with foundry process/packaging engineering in the resolution of problems that occur during wafer fabrication, packaging, die sort and final package test processes

• Drive the resolution of failure analysis, root cause and corrective actions for field returns

• Monitor and maintain product life cycle, identifying opportunities for cost reduction and continuous improvement

## Minimum Qualifications:

• BSc in Electrical Engineering or related field and a minimum of 8 years relevant work experience.

• Experience in semi-conductor technology, product, test and/or design engineering.

• Experience with quality systems including corrective actions, 8D reports, non-conformance reports, and failure analysis reports.

• Knowledge and experience with statistical theory and data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, JMP, Galaxy, dataConductor) for design of experiments, yield reporting and modelling.

• Experience in high-speed digital ATE test platforms (e.g. Advantest, Teradyne) or equivalent rack solutions is an asset.

• Strong knowledge of high-speed serial digital interconnect components and test methodologies

• Experience with JEDEC, and/or Mil quality requirements.

About the Role
As a Junior Software Engineer on the Message Spool team, you will work with senior engineers
to build and improve the persistence layer of the Solace Event Broker. This system handles high
volumes of messages and guarantees delivery at scale.
We use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day. They help us build faster and keep our code
quality high. We care more about how you think and solve problems than about years of
experience. If you are quick to learn, comfortable with AI tools, and like figuring things out on
your own, this role is for you.

What You’ll Work On
You will help build new features for the message spool subsystem. You will work with:
• Core Technologies: C and C++ on Linux, multithreading, and storage systems.
• Development Tools: Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review, and AI coding
assistants.
• Learning Opportunities: performance analysis, debugging complex systems, and making
them more reliable and scalable.
You will use AI tools like Claude Code every day, to write code, test, and debug.

Key Requirements
• AI aptitude: you are quick to learn and comfortable using AI tools like Claude Code, GitHub
Copilot, or Cursor to build, test, and debug. If you have not used these tools yet, you are excited
to start.
• Independent problem solving: you can take a task, figure out an approach, and get unstuck
without much hand holding.
• Culture fit: you care about craftsmanship, you are honest about what you know and do not
know, and you work well with a team.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical
Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.
• Solid foundation in C or C++ and comfortable in a Linux environment.
• Good written and verbal communication skills, for code reviews and working in an Agile team.

Preferred Qualifications
Nice to have, not required:
• You have used AI tools to speed up learning or shipping work, in personal projects or a job.
• Personal projects or open source work that show you can drive something on your own.
• Modern C++ (C++11 and later) and the STL.
• Multithreaded programming and a basic understanding of concurrency.
• Debugging or profiling tools, like gdb, valgrind, or perf.
• Familiarity with storage systems, databases, or file I/O.
• Understanding of distributed systems or high availability.

What You’ll Learn
• Production C and C++ systems: work on systems that run in production and handle real
customer traffic.
• Storage and persistence: learn how we persist messages, optimize storage, and keep the system
reliable.
• Modern development practices: learn AI-assisted development, CI/CD automation, and testing.
• Distributed systems: get exposure to scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability.

 At the heart of the Solace Event Broker lies the datapath - the engine responsible for moving messages at high rate, with low latency and utmost reliability. The Dataplane Adapters team owns the protocol surface: the MQTT, AMQP, REST, RDP, and Kafka adapters that let clients and applications connect, publish, and consume messages. Location: London, UK (remote). North America considered with a commitment to EMEA-shifted hours.

Reports to: VP, Sales

About TrueContext

#CareersThatKickSaaS! TrueContext is a field intelligence platform that connects frontline workers to enterprise systems of record, so teams in the field can capture, act on, and learn from structured data in real time. We serve enterprise customers in Med Tech, Building Systems, Utilities, and Oil and Gas. Backed by Battery Ventures, we are scaling the platform and building the defining name in field intelligence.

The Opportunity

This is a new business role. You will be the person responsible for adding enterprise logos across EMEA, working a territory of global manufacturers, service organizations, and utilities who run field operations at scale and are still doing it on paper, on spreadsheets, or on tools that were never built for enterprise complexity.

You are not opening a cold market. Some of our most significant enterprise customers are already in Europe, running critical operations on our platform, which means you sell with real reference customers, proven deployments, and a product that has been tested in the region rather than a pitch deck and a promise.

As the territory matures, we expect this seat to take on commercial ownership of the accounts it lands. We are hiring for that trajectory, which is why we look for candidates who can grow and retain a book as well as win one.

What You'll Own

Pipeline

• Building and working your own outbound pipeline across the region, in partnership with Marketing and our outbound team. The strongest performers here do not wait for leads.

• A territory plan by vertical and account tier, with a clear thesis for where the next three deals come from.

• Representing TrueContext at industry events, customer sites, and executive briefings across EMEA.

Enterprise Sales Cycles

• Full cycle ownership of new enterprise logos, from first contact through signature.

• Multi-threaded cycles across field operations, IT, procurement, security, and legal, typically four to nine months.

• Positioning TrueContext above commodity forms tools and below full FSM platforms, with Sales Engineering running proof-of-value on the customer's real workflows.

• Navigating European procurement realities including GDPR and data residency, security review, and multi-entity contracting.

Landing Well

• Handing off to Implementation and Customer Success with a deal that can actually be delivered: real scope, real success criteria, and the value metric the customer will judge us on.

• Staying close to the accounts you win, including the executive above your champion, so the second purchase is easier than the first.

Forecast Discipline

• A forecast leadership can rely on, and Salesforce accurate enough that no one needs to interpret it.

• EMEA market reality brought back to the business: competitive pressure, pricing, localization, regulation, and product gaps that cost you deals.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years in Enterprise B2B SaaS sales, including 3 years selling into EMEA enterprise accounts.

• A demonstrable new logo record: self-sourced pipeline, six-figure ACV, procurement-heavy multi-stakeholder cycles.

• Experience growing accounts after the initial win, through added capacity, tier upgrades, new business units, or new use cases. We want a closer who does not lose interest once the ink is dry.

• Credible renewal and retention experience, including the commercial conversations that come with it. As this seat takes on a portfolio, you will be trusted with those outcomes.

• Success selling to operational buyers in field service, maintenance, quality, EHS, or manufacturing operations.

• The ability to sell value against a materially cheaper alternative and hold price.

• Willingness to travel up to 40 percent across the region.

• Preferred: regulated or asset-intensive verticals, a second European language, familiarity with ServiceNow, SAP, Maximo, or Salesforce Field Service, and experience at a PE-backed company moving up-market.

Location and Hours

A London-based candidate working remotely is preferred, with regular travel across the UK, DACH, Benelux, the Nordics, and the Middle East. A North America based candidate will be considered with a firm commitment to shifted hours that cover the European business day. That is a standing expectation of the role, and will be discussed openly during the process.

Why This Role

We have a durable enterprise customer base, a platform that solves problems commodity tools cannot, and a mandate to grow substantially. New business in EMEA is the sharpest edge of that plan, and this is the seat with the most direct influence over how fast we get there. You will not inherit a finished playbook. You will write it, with direct access to the executive team.

Some Extra Benefits:

• Competitive base with an uncapped commission plan weighted to new business performance.

• Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day).

• Yearly wellness allowance and a remote-first working model.

• Company-wide & team social events.

TrueContext is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

*Preferably located in Ottawa, ON, open to remote Canada  
   
 #CareersThatKickSaas! TrueContext is a field intelligence platform that connects frontline workers to enterprise systems of record, enabling teams in the field to capture, act on, and learn from structured data in real time. We sit at the intersection of mobility, AI, and enterprise workflow, serving customers in utilities, oil and gas, industrial manufacturing, and other asset-intensive, regulated industries. 
   
  The Opportunity   
 The Sales Engineer is the technical face of TrueContext in every deal. You will partner directly with Account Executives to understand what prospects are trying to solve in the field, translate those problems into compelling product demonstrations, and remove every technical objection standing between a prospect and a signed contract. This is not a back-office support role. You will be in the room (or on the call) for nearly every meaningful sales conversation, shaping how customers experience our platform for the first time.  
 The right person for this role has genuine technical curiosity, can build a demo environment that mirrors a prospect’s real-world operations, and is equally comfortable presenting to a field operations director as to a CIO. You will work across utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, and other verticals where TrueContext wins by proving that our platform solves problems other tools cannot.  
   
  What You’ll Own   
  Technical Discovery and Solution Design   
 
 Lead technical discovery calls to understand the prospect’s field operations, existing systems landscape (FSM, EAM, ERP, CRM), and integration requirements  
 
 
 Map customer business problems to TrueContext capabilities and build solution architectures that address workflow, data capture, and enterprise integration needs  
 
 
 Serve as the subject matter expert on TrueContext’s platform architecture, API and integration framework, offline capabilities, and AI features  
 
   
  Demos and Proof of Value   
 
 Build and deliver customized product demonstrations tailored to each prospect’s industry, use case, and technical environment, following structured demo methodologies (Demo2Win, Great Demo, or equivalent)  
 
 
 Develop and maintain reusable demo environments and industry-specific solution templates for priority verticals (utilities, oil and gas, industrial manufacturing)  
 
 
 Lead proof-of-concept engagements where required, defining success criteria with the prospect and managing execution to close  
 
   
  Sales Partnership and Deal Progression   
 
 Partner with Account Executives to advance opportunities through the pipeline, owning the technical win in each deal  
 
 
 Participate in RFP/RFI responses, providing accurate technical content and competitive positioning  
 
 
 Identify and address technical objections and competitive threats early, escalating product gaps to Product Management with clear business context  
 
 
 Support trade shows, industry events, and field marketing activities as a technical representative of TrueContext  
 
   
  Knowledge and Enablement   
 
 Stay current on TrueContext product releases, platform capabilities, and AI features so you can speak with authority in every conversation  
 
 
 Contribute technical content to sales enablement materials, competitive battle cards, and internal knowledge bases  
 
 
 Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on what you are hearing from prospects, including feature requests, integration gaps, and competitive losses  
 
   
  What We’re Looking For   
 
 3+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales role in B2B SaaS, ideally selling into field operations, field service, or asset-intensive industries  
 
 
 Strong technical foundation: you can speak credibly about APIs, integrations, mobile architecture, and enterprise IT environments without needing a script  
 
 
 Demonstrated ability to build compelling, customized product demonstrations that connect platform capabilities to business outcomes  
 
 
 Experience working alongside enterprise sales teams and presenting to audiences ranging from field supervisors to CIOs  
 
 
 Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to manage multiple active deals in parallel without losing quality or follow-through  
 
 
 Fluent with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) and uses them actively to research prospects, prepare demos, and accelerate technical work  
 
 
 Prior experience with field service platforms, mobile data capture, or workflow automation tools is a strong plus  
 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on technical experience is equally valued  
 
   
  Why This Role   
 TrueContext is at an inflection point. We are investing in AI, expanding into new verticals, and building the sales organization to match our ambition. The Sales Engineer who joins now will have direct influence on how our platform is positioned and sold in the market, working closely with a growing team that has a clear mandate to scale. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with real room to grow. 
   
   
  Some Extra Benefits:  
 
 Company-wide & team social events 
 Wellness yearly allowance 
 Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day) 
 ½ day FriYAYs (from Victoria Day until Labour Day) 
 Catered lunches 2x per week 
 An amazing office space with plenty of snacks, drinks, and space to collaborate 
 Hybrid work environment (3 days a week in the office) if located in Ottawa, ON 
 
   
 This role requires up to 30% travel based on territory alignment. 
   
 Compensation Range: $140,000 - $160,000 annual on target earnings (inclusive of variable compensation) 
   
 If you are looking for the opportunity to embrace and be part of a truly unique company culture, this KickSaaS opportunity might just be for you!

## Worker Sub-Type:
Contract (Fixed Term)

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are You the Person We're Looking For?

Do you enjoy finding complex problems before customers do? Are you passionate about building automation that improves product quality, reliability, and performance? If you're a Software Developer in Test who thrives on solving technical challenges and wants to contribute to software powering some of the world's most critical systems, we'd love to hear from you. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract position providing maternity leave coverage within the QNX Power Management Test Team.

The Power Management Test Team at QNX is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Software Developer in Test to help ensure the quality and reliability of QNX Power Management technologies. In this role, you will do far more than execute tests. You'll develop and enhance automated test frameworks, investigate complex system issues, perform root-cause analysis, and work closely with developers to support high-quality software releases.

Working in a hands-on lab environment, you will validate software on embedded hardware platforms and contribute to all verification activities related to QNX Power Management features. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys software development, automation, debugging, and continuous quality improvement.

## Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and optimize automated test cases to continuously improve test coverage, and efficiency

• Debug, analyze test results, generate and document defects, and verify fixes

• Produce detailed test reports based on the results with high accuracy

• Execute comprehensive test suites on new software builds using reference and customer hardware, and analyze results

• Maintain test lab environments

• Create, update, and maintain test plans and test cases based on product requirements and feature specifications

• Configure, integrate, and validate software deliverables on embedded hardware platforms

• Collaborate closely with software developers, and fellow test engineers

• Reproduce and investigate reported issues using systematic debugging and root-cause analysis techniques

## Essential Skills and Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

• Must have: Strong programming background with expert-level proficiency in Python, C, and shell scripting

• Extensive experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks

• Deep understanding of Linux internals and extensive hands-on experience with system configs, scripting, and debugging in enterprise environments

• Knowledge of Power Management testing on different hardware

• Solid understanding of formal test theory, test methodology, and experience in developing automated tests and testing tools

• Demonstrated experience writing test plans and test cases, executing tests and reporting results

• Proven technical leadership and mentoring experience

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables

• Familiar with source versioning, problem reporting and constant integration systems (SVN, Git, JIRA, Jenkins end-to-end CI/CD pipelines)

• Working knowledge of QNX or other embedded operating system is an asset

• Experience in debugging, root-cause analysis, and system validation for embedded hardware and software environments

## Why Join QNX?

• Work on technology deployed in more than 275 million vehicles worldwide

• Help deliver software used in safety-critical and mission-critical environments

• Solve challenging problems at the intersection of embedded systems, automation, hardware, and software

• Collaborate with highly skilled engineers and embedded software experts

• Influence product quality through innovation in test automation and verification strategies

We are seeking a Sr. Staff Strategic Capacity PM to own long-term capacity gap identification, provide solution proposals, and lead the initiatives to solve capacity constraints. This role will develop integrated demand/capacity models, maintain internal and external supply chain capacity profiles by site, support surge planning, and lead constraint engineering to identify and solve hidden systemic bottlenecks early enough to align capacity, cost, and DFM actions before NPI start and production ramp. 
The ideal candidate combines strong quantitative modeling skills, semiconductor supply chain knowledge, constraint engineering discipline, and program management experience to deliver predictable capacity availability at scale, reduce late capacity escalations, prevent surprise bottlenecks at ramp, and connect capacity investment and qualification roadmaps to business needs. 
 
 Responsibilities:  
 
 Long-term Demand & Capacity Modeling    Develop and maintain component-level demand/capacity models across product lines, technology nodes, manufacturing flows, and planning horizons.  Build scenario-based models for base, upside, downside, and surge demand to support executive capacity decisions.  Establish planning assumptions, model governance, and refresh cadence to improve forecast consistency and decision quality.    Supply Chain Capacity Profiles & Constraint Management    Create and maintain supply chain capacity profiles across internal and external manufacturing sites, including front-end, back-end, test, and critical supplier constraints.  Identify structural capacity constraints early and define mitigation paths before NPI start or production ramp commitments.  Support surge planning by modeling practical upside capacity, recovery timing, qualification dependencies, and risk buffers.  Drive fewer late capacity escalations by converting long-range signals into actionable capacity readiness plans.    Constraint Engineering & Systemic Bottleneck Resolution    Identify hidden systemic bottlenecks across design, manufacturing, test, supplier capability, yield, cost, and capacity interfaces before they impact ramp execution.  Lead data-driven root cause analysis using operational, engineering, supplier, yield, and cycle-time data to isolate constraint drivers and quantify business impact.    Program Management    Program Manage the constraint resolution initiatives from detection through mitigation, closure, and recurrence prevention across cross-functional teams.  Feed structural fixes into DFM, capacity planning, cost reduction, qualification, and supplier readiness roadmaps.  Mitigate systemic scaling failures by converting recurring bottlenecks into durable process, design, sourcing, or capacity solutions.    Facilitate cross-functional capacity reviews to align demand signals, site readiness, supplier capability, and qualification plans.    Risk Management & Analytics    Conduct sensitivity analysis on demand volatility, supplier constraints, site readiness, surge scenarios, and systemic scaling risks.  Drive continuous improvement in modeling methods, data quality, and planning tools to improve capacity predictability at scale.  Improve recovery speed from issues that do occur by establishing decision paths, mitigation playbooks, and feedback loops into capacity and DFM planning.     Required    Bachelor’s degree in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.  7+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, supply chain planning, or operations strategy.  Strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication and supply chain with Program Management leadership experience.  Experience identifying systemic bottlenecks, leading data-driven root cause analysis, and driving solutions across engineering, manufacturing, supplier and planning teams.  Advanced analytical and modeling skills (Excel, VCO, AI Optimization, SQL, Python, or similar tools).  Excellent communication and presentation skills.       Preferred    MBA or Master’s degree in Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain or related field.  Strong stakeholder management, communication, collaboration, and partnership skills across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and OSAT partners.  Familiarity with statistical forecasting methods.  Knowledge of industry cycles and long-lead semiconductor equipment planning. Role Summary   We are seeking a highly motivated Senior EDA Physical Design Engineer with 3 to 8 years of industry experience to develop, deploy, and support advanced physical implementation methodologies for semiconductor designs.   In this role, you will combine hands-on physical design expertise with EDA methodology development and customer-facing technical support. You will evaluate emerging EDA technologies, develop robust and scalable RTL-to-GDSII implementation flows, and help engineering teams achieve their performance, power, area, runtime, and quality objectives.   You will work in a collaborative, global environment with product engineering, EDA teams and EDA vendors. The position is suited to an engineer who enjoys solving challenging implementation problems, developing production-quality design flows, and helping engineering teams adopt effective physical design methodologies.   Key Responsibilities   Physical Design Implementation and Optimization     Perform and support physical implementation activities, including floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, post-route optimization, and signoff preparation.       Analyze and resolve complex issues related to timing closure, congestion, routing, power integrity, design-rule compliance, and implementation quality.       Evaluate quality-of-results trade-offs across timing, power, area, routability, runtime, and design robustness.       Support hierarchical and large-scale SoC implementation methodologies.       Collaborate with relevant teams to achieve physical signoff readiness.     Methodology Development and Deployment     Develop, validate, document, and deploy robust physical implementation methodologies and production-quality EDA flows.       Create reusable flow components, scripts, checks, reporting utilities, and automation infrastructure.       Standardize implementation procedures and reports to improve consistency across projects.       Validate methodology changes using representative designs, regression testing, and measurable quality-of-results criteria.       Support migration and adoption of new implementation platforms, including flow porting, validation, testing, and user onboarding.       Apply disciplined software engineering practices, including version control, modular design, testing, release management, and technical documentation.       Drive improvements in flow robustness, scalability, usability, runtime, and quality of results.     New Technology Evaluation and Proof of Concept     Research and evaluate new EDA tool functions, implementation technologies, and semiconductor design methodologies.       Define technical evaluation criteria and conduct proof-of-concept activities using representative designs.       Compare alternative tools and approaches based on quality of results, runtime, scalability, automation, usability, and integration requirements.       Identify technical limitations, deployment risks, and methodology improvement opportunities.       Document findings and present recommendations to engineering, product, and technical leadership teams.       Convert successful evaluations into repeatable, supportable, and production-ready methodologies.       Explore AI-assisted EDA capabilities and emerging automation technologies to improve engineering productivity and design outcomes.     Cross-Functional Collaboration     Work closely with EDA R&D vendors, product engineering, and design teams to identify requirements and resolve implementation challenges.       Provide structured technical feedback to product and R&D teams based on project deployment and customer experience.       Collaborate across multiple sites and time zones to share best practices and maintain consistency across projects.       Participate in technical reviews, methodology planning, issue prioritization, and continuous-improvement initiatives.       Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, results, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.     Customer Engagement and Technical Support     Provide hands-on technical support to semiconductor customers and internal project teams adopting physical implementation methodologies and EDA flows.       Investigate, reproduce, debug, and resolve complex issues related to tools, scripts, constraints, implementation methodologies, and design quality.       Guide customers through flow setup, methodology adoption, optimization, and issue resolution.       Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, training materials, and implementation recommendations.       Coordinate with product and R&D teams to escalate issues, communicate customer requirements, and track technical resolutions.       Build trusted technical relationships through responsiveness, ownership, sound engineering judgment, and clear communication.       Help ensure that deployed flows remain robust, scalable, and effective across multiple concurrent projects.      Education and Experience     Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical discipline.       3 to 8 years of relevant industry experience in ASIC physical design, semiconductor implementation, EDA or CAD engineering, physical implementation methodology development, or EDA applications engineering.     Technical Expertise     Strong hands-on experience with synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, congestion mitigation, and power and area optimization.       Practical knowledge of RTL-to-GDSII implementation and physical signoff methodologies.       Experience with Synopsys Fusion Compiler, IC Compiler II, Cadence Innovus or equivalent physical design tools.       Strong understanding of static timing analysis, SDC constraints, clocking strategies, and setup and hold timing closure.       Experience optimizing performance, power, area, congestion, runtime, and overall quality of results.       Familiarity with hierarchical SoC implementation, low-power design concepts, physical verification, and EDA flow integration.     Debugging, Automation, and Problem Solving     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex tool, flow, constraint, and design issues.       Proficiency in scripting and automation using Tcl, Python, or shell scripting in a Linux or Unix environment.       Ability to develop maintainable, reusable, and well-documented flow infrastructure.       Experience interpreting implementation reports, log files, timing reports, congestion data, and quality-of-results metrics.       Ability to work independently, prioritize technical issues, and take ownership of deliverables through resolution.       Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new tools, technologies, and methodologies.     Communication and Collaboration     Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.       Ability to explain complex implementation issues, technical trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.       Experience working directly with customers, design teams, or EDA tool users.       Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver technical demonstrations, training, and methodology guidance.       Ability to work effectively in a global, multi-site, and cross-functional engineering environment.       Collaborative working style, customer-support mindset, and commitment to high-quality technical delivery.     Preferred Skills Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.             Job Family:      General Design Services                  Job Profile Title :  Principal Design Engineer     Job Posting Title :    Principal Systems Engineer – Optical Transceivers      Location/ Division Specific Information-     CAN - Ottawa/ P05        How will you make an impact? –       We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to lead the development of next-generation optical transceivers for hyperscale data center and AI networking applications. This individual will play a critical role in driving system-level innovation, translating customer and industry requirements into product specifications, and leading cross-functional teams through product development, qualification, and deployment.  The ideal candidate possesses expertise in optical communications, coherent or direct-detect optical systems, DSP architectures, electrical and optical interfaces, and emerging data center networking standards. This role requires both technical leadership and strong collaboration across silicon, optics, packaging, firmware, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams.  As a Principal Systems Engineer, you will define the architecture and technical direction of next-generation optical interconnect solutions, enabling the massive bandwidth demands of AI clusters and hyperscale data centers. Your work will directly influence product strategy, industry standards, and the future of high-speed optical networking.       What will you do? -       Define system requirements and product architecture for next-generation optical transceivers.    Develop transceiver specifications, link budgets, performance targets, and system trade-off analyses.    Lead architecture decisions involving optical engines, DSPs, laser technologies, packaging, thermal management, and host electrical interfaces.    Evaluate various modulation schemes, lane rates, and optical interconnect architectures to optimize performance, power, cost, and manufacturability.    Serve as the technical lead transceiver product development, influencing technology roadmaps and strategic investments.    Mentor engineers across systems, optics, hardware, firmware, and validation disciplines.    Drive design reviews and resolve complex cross-functional technical issues.    Represent the company in customer engagements and industry technical discussions.    Optical and Electrical System Analysis, including Define and analyze optical link performance, Link budgets/ Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR)/ BER/FEC performance/ Power consumption, and  Reliability margins    Perform system-level modeling and simulation of optical and electrical channels.    Analyze and optimize high-speed interfaces operating at 200G/lane and beyond.    Work closely with DSP and ASIC teams to define equalization, FEC, and signal integrity requirements.    Product Development & Validation, including Collaborate with optics, ASIC, packaging, firmware, and operations teams from concept through production release.    Define validation methodologies and interoperability test plans.    Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for system-level performance issues.    Support customer qualifications, field deployments, and technical escalations         How will you get here? –       Education:      BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or related technical field is required       Experience:      12+ years of experience in optical communications, networking systems, or transceiver development is required    Demonstrated experience developing high-speed optical modules is required       Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:       Strong understanding of:    Optical communication systems    Silicon photonics    High-speed SerDes architectures    DSP-based communication systems    FEC and coding techniques    Experience with optical standards and interoperability requirements    Strong analytical and system-level problem-solving capabilities    Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills    Systems thinking and architecture leadership    Cross-functional collaboration; Customer engagement; Strategic technology planning; Data-driven decision making; Mentoring and team development       Preferred Qualifications:      MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, is preferred    Prior experience with:    1.6T PAM4 optical modules    Co-packaged optics (CPO)    Linear Receive Optics (LRO)    Linear Pluggable Optics (LPO)    Silicon photonics integration    Advanced packaging technologies    Expertise in coding for test and verification in languages such as Python or other, preferably    Proven record of technical leadership and architectural ownership of complex products is a plus                                            BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. We are seeking a Senior Analog Engineering Manager to lead the development of DDR5 and next-generation DDR6 PHY solutions for advanced SoCs. This role requires deep technical expertise in high-speed memory interfaces, combined with strong people leadership and program ownership.  The successful candidate will manage a team responsible for end-to-end delivery of high-performance, low-power DDR PHYs, from architecture through silicon bring-up, while shaping the roadmap for DDR6-class signaling and architecture                                          Technical Leadership (DDR5 / DDR6)   Own and guide the architecture, design, and implementation of DDR5 PHYs and contribute to DDR6-ready architectures.  Provide technical oversight for critical analog and mixed-signal blocks, including:  High-speed TX/RX datapaths  Advanced equalization, termination, and training circuits  DLL/PLL-based clocking solutions for multi-GHz operation  Voltage, reference generation, and power-aware IO design  Drive closure on timing, jitter, noise, SI/PI, and PVT robustness for aggressive DDR5/DDR6 data rates.  Ensure compliance with JEDEC DDR5 specifications and alignment with evolving DDR6 standards and industry direction.  Lead post-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and yield improvement, including lab and customer-system correlation.                                         People & Organization Leadership   Build, lead, and mentor a team of analog and mixed-signal designers focused on high-speed memory interfaces.  Set technical direction, performance expectations, and development plans for senior and principal engineers.  Drive hiring, onboarding, and team scaling aligned with DDR5 production and DDR6 development needs.  Foster a culture of technical rigor, ownership, and execution excellence.                                            Program & Cross-Functional Execution   Own DDR5/DDR6 PHY execution balancing schedule, quality, and risk  Partner closely with: Digital PHY and controller teams SoC integration and system architecture, Package, PCB, SI/PI, and validation teams, Product, program management, and customers  Interface with foundries, IP vendors, and standards bodies as needed to ensure successful delivery and future readiness.                                       Methodology, Quality & Roadmap   Establish robust design and signoff methodologies for next-generation high-speed PHYs. About the Role   Renesas is seeking a Principal FPGA Emulation & Prototyping Engineer to build and own the FPGA-based platforms that emulate our mixed-signal power ASICs before silicon. Working shoulder to shoulder with our silicon RTL and DSP architects, you will bring their designs up on FPGA to validate real-time digital, mixed-signal, and power-control architectures pre-silicon — proving out control loops, catching RTL issues early, and de-risking tape-out.  These FPGA platforms are emulation vehicles, not production hardware. Success is measured by how faithfully and how fast they reproduce the target silicon: functional equivalence to the golden ASIC RTL, real-time (or near-real-time) performance for closed-loop power and DSP validation, and deep visibility for pre-silicon debug.   What You'll Do    Partner closely with silicon RTL and DSP architects to bring ASIC designs up on FPGA — advising on FPGA-ability and turning architectural intent into a working, real-time emulation platform.  Adapt ASIC RTL for FPGA emulation while preserving functional equivalence to the golden design — handling clock-gating conversion, memory/SRAM macro mapping, reset and initialization schemes, tri-state/bus conversion, and stubbing or modeling of analog/mixed-signal blocks.  Map designs onto the FPGA fabric to fit and to hit emulation speed — steering resource inference (DSP/multiplier slices, block vs. distributed memory), clocking, and pipelining so the design achieves the real-time performance the validation requires.  Build the real-time environment around the digital core: model or interface to the analog and power stages (ADC/DAC/PWM, gate drivers, plant/converter models), including hardware-in-the-loop with real or emulated power hardware where needed.  Develop deep pre-silicon debug and visibility — logic analysis, long-run waveform capture, triggering, and assertions — and enable firmware/software co-development ahead of silicon.  Define and continuously improve the emulation methodology, RTL/FPGA-ability guidelines, flows, and automation (TCL/Python).  Provide technical leadership: mentor engineers, lead reviews, and drive emulation and tooling decisions across the silicon and systems teams.     Required Qualifications    Extensive FPGA design and implementation experience (typically 10+ years), including a track record of FPGA prototyping or emulation of ASIC/SoC designs.  Expert-level RTL design in SystemVerilog and/or VHDL, with deep familiarity working from ASIC-style RTL.  Deep understanding of FPGA internal architecture and primitives — DSP/multiplier slices, block and distributed RAM, carry chains, and clocking — and a proven ability to map designs onto these resources to fit large ASIC RTL and reach real-time emulation performance (memory/SRAM macro mapping, DSP inference, clock-enable conversion, control-set and fanout management).  Hands-on experience adapting ASIC RTL for FPGA: clock-gating conversion, memory macro replacement, reset schemes, tri-state conversion, and multi-clock/CDC handling.  Strong command of the full FPGA implementation flow — synthesis, place-and-route, timing analysis, and constraint development (XDC/SDC) — on large Xilinx and/or Intel (Altera) devices, using Vivado and/or Quartus.  Hardware bring-up and debug experience: in-system logic analysis (ILA/SignalTap), lab instrumentation, and long-run pre-silicon debug.  Proficiency scripting for automation (TCL, Python).  Demonstrated technical leadership — mentoring, reviews, and driving cross-team technical decisions.  BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).    Preferred Qualifications    Real-time, hardware-in-the-loop emulation and modeling of analog/mixed-signal and power stages (ADC/DAC/PWM interfaces, plant/converter models).  Understanding of digital power-conversion control and mixed-signal systems — converter topologies, control loops, PWM/PFM, and magnetics — to build faithful models and validate power-control architectures.  FPGA DSP implementation and real-time emulation of DSP datapaths: FIR/IIR/CIC filters, interpolation/decimation, FFT, FEC, including high-throughput techniques such as folding/unfolding.  Experience with commercial FPGA prototyping platforms such as Synopsys HAPS, Cadence Protium, or Siemens Veloce.  Model-based design with Simulink and/or Xilinx System Generator.  High-speed interface experience: JESD204B, PCIe, 1G/10G Ethernet, Aurora.  ASIC design or tape-out exposure, including DFT/scan considerations in emulation.  Ability to architect and build a custom in-house FPGA prototyping platform — board architecture, high-speed PCB design, signal integrity, and bring-up — a plus as we may develop our own hardware in the future.  Embedded/microcontroller and firmware co-development experience (C/assembly); MATLAB, C/C++. The NPI Quality Engineer is responsible for leading quality planning and execution for New Product Introduction (NPI) from development through mass production. https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Renesas.body: We are seeking an experienced Manager of Semiconductor IC Packaging Assembly Engineering to support assembly sustaining engineering and manufacturing execution for advanced semiconductor packaging technologies. This role supports AI/data center infrastructure power packaging applications, including Smart Power Stages, Vertical Power Stages, Power Modules, and Discrete FET packages, with additional exposure to wide-bandgap (WBG) technologies including SiC and GaN, DBC and AMB substrates, and advanced interconnect technologies. This position will focus on yield improvement, process stability, quality support, process change execution, and manufacturing readiness while working closely with Package Engineering, Product Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external OSAT partners to support New Product Introduction (NPI) transfer into high-volume manufacturing (HVM).  The ideal candidate combines strong semiconductor packaging assembly knowledge with hands-on technical execution, structured problem solving, and cross-functional coordination skills to improve manufacturing performance, product quality, and process robustness. This role serves as a technical contributor and coordination point between Package Engineering and manufacturing partners by helping translate package development requirements, qualification plans, process controls, and ramp readiness needs into reliable manufacturing execution.   Key Responsibilities:    Manufacturing & Sustaining Engineering Execution    Support sustaining engineering activities across semiconductor package assembly technologies and assigned product lines.  Execute manufacturing improvement activities related to yield, cycle time, quality, throughput, and cost.  Apply engineering practices for process control, defect reduction, and continuous improvement.  Provide technical input to assembly engineering plans aligned with package technology and product needs.  Work with Package Engineering and OSAT teams to support manufacturable designs and stable production controls.    Yield Monitoring & Continuous Improvement    Monitor assembly yield performance, trends, and corrective action progress.  Support data-driven yield improvement activities using statistical and structured problem-solving methodologies. Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling its AI-focused power delivery business. Products include high-performance digital power VRMs, multiphase controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), Vertical Power Stages (SPS with integrated capacitors and multiple silicon die), Power Towers (power modules integrating multiple SPS-equivalents with capacitors and inductors), and power MOSFETs.    As an Application Engineer for the Renesas Performance Computing Power Application Engineering team, you will be part of a fast-paced power management applications team serving the AI and cloud infrastructure market. You will engage cross-functionally with a diverse team, including marketing, IC design, firmware engineering, and systems engineering teams, to deliver the most innovative power solutions.   Responsibilities    A broad comprehension of DC/DC power conversion is required, including familiarity with digital multiphase PWM controllers. Work with senior applications engineers and evaluate new algorithms in the lab using a combination of FPGA, Microcontrollers, and custom Analog Front End.  Behavioral modeling of DC-DC converters, including IC blocks, using SIMPLIS and/or MATLAB to support the design engineering team with new control architectures.  Develop EVBs, including responsibility for component selection, layout, and thermal design  Develop collateral such as datasheets, performance reports, and application notes to support customer engagement.    This role requires a good understanding of power management, including magnetics, control loop theory, and component selection. Understanding of control loop theory and its application in power converters.  Proficiency in using lab equipment, including network analyzers, oscilloscopes and waveform generators.   Experience with automation of lab testing. 2026年以降の年平均成長率（CAGR）8～12%という中長期的な成長目標を達成するため、産業用ロボット、ビルセキュリティ、ヒューマノイドロボット等のIoTアプリケーション、AIデータセンター・インフラといった主要な成長市場において、製品開発を加速させています。 
 
この成長を支える上で、バックエンド設計能力の強化は不可欠です。そこで、バックエンド開発を主導し、品質・性能・コスト競争力の向上を推進する、経験豊富なタイミング設計エンジニアおよびテスト設計エンジニアを募集します。日本、中国、ドイツ、ベトナム、インドにまたがるグローバルチームの一員として、最先端のEDAやAIを活用した設計技術を駆使し、次世代半導体製品の開発に貢献していただきます。

【募集背景】 
産業・民生・車載市場におけるマイコンへの要求は、従来の性能向上だけでなく、低消費電力、高いセキュリティ・機能安全性、ソフトウェア開発効率の向上など、ますます高度化・複雑化しています。  当部門では、こうした市場要求を将来のMCU製品へ反映するため、システムアーキテクト機能を強化しています。システムアーキテクトは、事業部やマーケティング部門から提示される製品コンセプトや要求仕様をもとに、CPU、バスアーキテクチャ、メモリ構成、周辺機能、電源・クロック構成などMCU全体のアーキテクチャを検討し、製品の実現性、競争力、コスト、消費電力を総合的に最適化する重要な役割を担います。  また、製品構想段階から量産に至るまで、ハードウェア設計、ソフトウェア開発、製品企画などの関係部門と連携しながら、次世代MCUの実現をリードします。自身の技術的なアイデアや判断が製品の方向性や市場競争力に直結するため、MCU開発の最上流から製品化まで一貫して携わることができる、チャレンジングで影響力の大きいポジションです。

https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/2f.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The Director, Cloud Engineering is responsible for the strategy, operation, security, governance, and financial stewardship of Magnet's cloud platform and shared engineering services. This Leader partners closely with Engineering, Product, UX, Security, IT, Compliance, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure our cloud platform enables rapid product innovation while meeting the highest standards for reliability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency. This role combines technical acumen, operational excellence, cloud strategy, AI enablement, Financial Operations ("FinOps") discipline, vendor management, and organizational leadership. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for ensuring Magnet's cloud platform remains secure, reliable, compliant, cost-effective, and capable of powering the next generation of digital investigation products. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada. Compensation & Benefits The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you. If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable). $200,000 - $250,000 CDN a year Salary range (min - max) Position Type: Current Vacancy Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. 提供すると共に、強固な財務体制を構築する。

・PowerBI等のBIツールの経験をお持ちの方。     ルネサスは、「To Make Our Lives Easier（人々の暮らしをより豊かで快適にする）」というPurposeのもと、組込み半導体ソリューションを提供するグローバル企業です。世界30か国以上で活躍する21,000人を超えるエンジニアや課題解決のプロフェッショナルとともに、自動車、産業、インフラ、IoT分野における世界最先端のテクノロジー開発に携わり、より安全で、健康的で、環境にやさしく、スマートな未来の実現に貢献しています。      ルネサスでは、「TAGIE（Transparent、Agile、Global、Innovative、Entrepreneurial）」を企業文化の中核としています。TAGIEは、私たちの働き方や成長のあり方、そしてPurposeの実現に向けた取り組みを支える共通の価値観です。この協調的な精神と挑戦するマインドセットが、半導体技術を通じた産業の変革と、世界中の人々の暮らしへの貢献を可能にしています。      私たちは、競争力のある報酬制度に加え、充実した福利厚生をご用意しています。福利厚生の詳細については、選考プロセスの中でご案内いたします。      私たちとともに未来を創造する挑戦に、ぜひ参加しませんか。皆さまからのご応募をお待ちしております。

Involves test setup, data analysis, failure analysis, and documentation to support process improvement and production efficiency   Key Responsibilities     Investigate yield, quality, issues and implement improvements.  Develop, optimize, and control manufacturing processes.  Drive process improvements, defect reduction, and implement corrective actions  Support test process documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.  Support production testing, analyze test data, identify failures, and implement corrective actions.  Execute, and improve test procedures and systems. Candidates with relevant engineering experience working with Automated Test Systems (ATE); ETS364, 93K ,Diamondx ,ETS800 and Flex module tester is a plus. Fresh graduates are also encouraged to apply.  Good knowledge in basic electronics, including analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits, will add advantage.  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.  Ability to work in a fast-paced semiconductor manufacturing environment.  Good communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.  Eager to adapt well in dynamic working environment, eager to learn new knowledge and able to work independently.   Willingness to support on-call duties if required.     Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier .
