https://caseiq.bamboohr.com/careers/337.body:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team. This role is crucial in managing and optimizing our infrastructure and deployment processes, ensuring high availability and performance of our services. The Case IQ and Lextegrity product suites process millions of transactions, providing risk scores and insights that help compliance users prioritize reviews and proactively avoid risks like fraud, corruption, and bribery.

What You'll Do

• Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize our infrastructure across Azure and AWS, ensuring the seamless operation of services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker Swarm, Azure Application Insights, Amazon ECS, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Application Load Balancers (ALB), API Gateway, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and more. Support platform administration and security while identifying cost-optimization opportunities as we scale.

• Deployment Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD, automating deployment processes to ensure rapid and reliable software delivery.

• AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Drive the adoption of vibe coding, agentic SDLC, and AIOps practices to improve development velocity, observability, incident response, automation, and platform operations.

• Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance and observability metrics and implement improvements to ensure the high availability and scalability of the compliance monitoring platform.

• Security and Compliance: Implement security and compliance best practices, ensuring all systems and processes adhere to industry standards and regulations.

• Quality Assurance: Work closely with QA to define a testing strategy that empowers them to run automated tests and deploy to their own environments and enables high confidence in functionality with each deployment.

• Collaboration: Work closely with development to ensure the seamless integration and deployment of new features and updates.

• Incident Management: Respond to and resolve system incidents, minimizing downtime and ensuring the reliability of our services.

Who You Are

• Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or similar role.

• Technical Expertise: Strong experience with Azure and AWS services and infrastructure as code. Solid familiarity with containerization technologies, particularly Docker. Experience operating modern SaaS web applications, including auto-scaling, load balancing, gateways, monitoring, observability, and secrets management. Multi-cloud experience is a plus.

• Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform and CDK) for managing cloud resources.

• CI/CD Pipelines: Proven experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Github Action and Jenkins, with a focus on automation and efficiency.

• AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Experience with and knowledge of vibe coding, agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and AIOps tools for intelligent monitoring, incident response, automation, and operational optimization.

• Security Practices and Acumen: Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security measures in cloud environments. Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 web application security risks and a strong understanding of software security principles.

• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues.

• Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team and engage stakeholders across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.  We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Senior/Staff/Sr Staff IC Design Engineer (RTL Design) with strong experience in SoC development flows. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in the design and development of advanced integrated circuits that power Renesas MCU products. You will lead complex RTL design efforts, own key IP/subsystem deliverables, mentor junior engineers, and help evolve design methodologies and best practices.   Key Responsibilities    Lead RTL design and development of complex IPs and subsystems within MCU SoCs, ensuring compliance with performance, power, and area (PPA) targets  Drive micro-architecture definition and high-level digital design for assigned blocks  Support SoC integration, delivering high-quality subsystem views and documentation to Back-end and Design Verification teams  Own design quality checks, including lint, CDC, and RDC, and actively support functional verification of assigned blocks  Collaborate closely with system architects, verification engineers, physical design teams, and software teams to define specifications and ensure seamless end-to-end integration  Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, raising overall team capability and design quality  Contribute to continuous improvement of RTL design methodologies, coding guidelines, and design processes     Required Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field  Minimum of 4 to 8 years of hands-on experience in digital IC/ASIC design, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality silicon  Strong expertise in RTL design using Verilog/VHDL  Solid understanding of digital design principles, timing analysis, clocking, resets, and verification methodologies  Experience using industry-standard EDA tools for synthesis, simulation, and static timing analysis  Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to own blocks end-to-end    Preferred Qualifications    Experience owning complex IPs or subsystem designs in large SoCs  Strong background in micro-architecture design and high-level digital design  Hands-on experience with RTL quality tools such as Spyglass (Lint, CDC, RDC)  Experience with low-power design techniques and methodologies  Familiarity with SoC-level design and integration  Understanding of synthesis flows and timing constraints  Scripting experience in Shell, Perl, Python or use of AI for design is a strong plus.    Why Renesas   At Renesas India, you will work on industry-leading MCU platforms, collaborate with global teams, and influence next-generation semiconductor products. This role offers deep technical ownership, growth into architectural leadership, and the opportunity to shape how we design and deliver high-quality silicon.     Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier . With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.  At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.  We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.  Are you ready to join our team and  shape the future  with us?  Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. ## JOB SUMMARY:

The Buyer purchases raw materials, repair and operations (MRO) items from supplier to achieve shipment, margin, quality and inventory goals.

## ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Expedite parts and materials by: processing and obtaining information from Material Requisition Planning (MRP) messages, controls excess inventory, process shortages and open order vendor reports.

• Orders, quote, reschedule and cancel parts and materials from MRP and enter information into computer.

• Maintain accurate procurement records such as: services purchased, costs, delivery and inventories in MRP System.

• Plan, schedule, and monitor movement of materials through the production cycle using company spreadsheets.

• Monitor Correction Action Responses for purchasing items: review, develop and forward responses to Quality, check on system and status of actions regularly, request Certificate of Compliance as needed.

• Meet with vendors and sales representatives to obtain product or service information such as: price, availability and delivery schedule.

• Under management guidance: evaluate and determine the best source of supply based on considerations of cost, delivery, quality, risk/exposure and the ability to supply product in accordance with specified requirements.

• Evaluate potential resources to support demand requirements.

• Under management guidance: locate and set-up new suppliers while dealing with less complex commodities.

## QUALIFICATIONS:

• Education: Associate degree

• Experience Years: 3-5 years

• OR Equivalent combination of education and experience

• Able to read blueprints and drawings

• Understand methods of Purchasing and MRP

• Knowledge of procedures and coordinate requirements to receipts

• Experience with purchasing in manufacturing

• Microsoft Office

## WORK ENVIRONMENT:

• Office and production floor within a manufacturing facility.

Cerio is helping build the infrastructure foundation for the next generation of AI-driven computing.

We are seeking a Vice President, Channel Sales to build and lead Cerio's ecosystem of channel partners across the AI infrastructure, data center, cloud, and digital infrastructure markets. You will develop and execute Cerio's ecosystem strategy, identify and recruit the right strategic channel partners, create compelling partner value propositions, establish scalable programs and enablement, and work closely with sales, technical, marketing, product, and executive teams to turn partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue. You will have significant influence over how Cerio goes to market, develops strategic alliances, builds channel capacity, and establishes its position within the North American AI infrastructure ecosystem.

What you will do

• Build and lead Cerio’s ecosystem strategy by identifying the partners, channels, and market relationships that can accelerate our growth across the AI infrastructure and data center landscape

• Develop partnerships with infrastructure providers, data centers, engineering firms, technology companies, cloud providers, OEMs, distributors, resellers, systems integrators, and other key ecosystem players

• Build relationships with channel partners, creating trusted connections and joint business plans that drive long-term, mutual value

• Create new routes to market by identifying emerging opportunities, partnership models, and ecosystem relationships that expand Cerio’s reach and competitive position

• Transform partnerships into pipeline and revenue by creating partner-sourced, partner-led, and partner-influenced opportunities in collaboration with Sales and developing joint account and go-to-market strategies

• Enable partners to succeed by developing the programs, resources, training, and engagement models they need to effectively position, sell, specify, integrate, and support Cerio’s solutions

• Shape Cerio’s market position by staying ahead of trends across AI infrastructure, data centers, compute, networking, power, cooling, and emerging technologies, and translating market intelligence into actionable growth opportunities

• Accelerate go-to-market initiatives by partnering with Marketing, Sales and Product teams on campaigns, events, thought leadership, account-based initiatives, and partner-specific programs

• Drive measurable ecosystem performance through clear partner priorities, operating rhythms, and KPIs across recruitment, activation, pipeline, revenue, market reach, and strategic relationship development

What we are looking for

• 15+ years of progressive experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem development, business development, channel sales, partner development, alliance management, or related leadership roles.

• Demonstrated success building and growing technology ecosystems, partner programs, or strategic alliance networks.

• Strong understanding of the data center, cloud, AI infrastructure, networking, power, cooling, high-performance computing, or related technology markets.

• Experience working within or alongside the AI infrastructure, digital infrastructure, cloud, data center, technology, energy, or infrastructure sectors.

• An established network of relationships within the data center, AI infrastructure, cloud, technology, or digital infrastructure ecosystem.

• Experience recruiting, onboarding, activating, and managing high-value channel and strategic partners.

• A demonstrated track record of generating revenue through partners, alliances, or ecosystem relationships.

• Strong understanding of distributors, VARs, systems integrators, OEMs, infrastructure providers, engineering partners, and other indirect or ecosystem-based routes to market.

• Experience developing partner programs, incentives, enablement, certification, commercial frameworks, and joint go-to-market plans.

• Strong business acumen and an understanding of channel economics, strategic partnership models, and ecosystem-driven growth.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• The ability to operate strategically while being willing to execute directly.

Total Rewards

Cerio offers a comprehensive total rewards package for this position including salary and incentive bonus plan (range $300,000 - $350,000 OTE), health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth. The salary range provided represents the expected base salary for this position. The final offer amount may be adjusted slightly higher or lower depending on the selected candidate's relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and certifications, as well as the full total compensation package offered. Our People & Culture team welcomes discussions about total rewards during your conversations.

About Cerio

Cerio is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, with offices and projects spanning international markets and Centers of Excellence across Europe and North America. Cerio is creating new scale economics for the AI and cloud era through an open systems platform designed to enable a more sustainable and efficient data center. Our innovation has no boundaries. We have built a culture that embraces flexibility, collaboration, and high performance, supporting both remote and hybrid work environments. Learn more about us at www.cerio.ai

Cerio is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. In addition, Cerio is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities. Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of your candidate experience so we can better support you. You can reach us here: hr@cerio.ai

## Job Summary

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the successful execution of new product development projects within Adtran's Optical Engines organization. This role will partner closely with engineering, product management, operations, quality, and manufacturing teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives.

The successful candidate will have experience leading cross-functional hardware development projects, managing project schedules, mitigating risks, and communicating project status to stakeholders at all organizational levels. The Project Manager will play a key role in driving collaboration across geographically dispersed teams while supporting the development of innovative optical networking solutions.

## Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead cross-functional product development projects from concept through production release.

• Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, resource plans, and project deliverables.

• Coordinate activities across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, test, quality, supply chain, and manufacturing teams.

• Drive project execution to meet scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives.

• Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and proactively manage issues throughout the product lifecycle.

• Monitor project progress and communicate status, risks, dependencies, and key metrics to stakeholders and leadership.

• Facilitate project meetings, technical reviews, design reviews, and phase-gate activities.

• Collaborate with Product Management to support product roadmap planning and prioritization activities.

• Work closely with Operations and Manufacturing teams to support new product introduction (NPI) and production readiness activities.

• Manage changes to project scope, schedules, and resources through established processes.

• Ensure compliance with Adtran product development processes and best practices.

• Foster collaboration across global teams and create alignment among functional stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within project management and product development processes.

• Support customer commitments and strategic business objectives through effective project execution.

• Prepare and deliver executive-level project summaries and presentations.

## Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of project management experience leading cross-functional product development projects.

• Experience managing hardware, optical networking, telecommunications, or technology-focused development programs.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong understanding of product development lifecycle processes.

• Experience utilizing project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or equivalent.

• Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.

• Ability to influence and drive results across cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent project management certification.

• Experience leading optical networking, telecommunications, hardware, or embedded systems development projects.

• Knowledge of Agile, Stage-Gate, and hybrid product development methodologies.

• Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transitions.

• Familiarity with optical transceivers, optical networking systems, or telecommunications infrastructure products.

• Experience working with geographically distributed engineering teams.

• Understanding of hardware development processes, verification testing, and product qualification activities.

## Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to manage ambiguity and changing priorities.

• Excellent facilitation and conflict-resolution capabilities.

• Strong analytical and decision-making skills.

• Detail-oriented with the ability to maintain a strategic perspective.

• Proven ability to build relationships and establish credibility across technical and business organizations.

• Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Results-driven with a continuous improvement mindset.

## Travel Requirements

• Up to 10% travel.
• Domestic travel as required.

• International travel as required.

We are seeking a  Principal Router Architect  with  10 to 15 years of experience  to define the backbone of next-generation  Zonal and Central Compute Automotive architectures . This role focuses on architecting high-bandwidth, ultra-reliable  Ethernet Routing Engines  and  PCIe subsystems  that serve as the primary data fabric for Autonomous Driving (AD) and Cockpit controllers. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-speed data center-grade throughput and the rigorous  Safety (ISO 26262)  and  Deterministic Networking  requirements of the automotive industry.   Responsibilities:     Automotive Ethernet Routing : Architect L2/L3 switch fabrics supporting  Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN)  standards (e.g., IEEE 802.1AS, 802.1Qbv, 802.1Qbu) to ensure deterministic latency for safety-critical traffic.   PCIe Backbone Architecture : Define  PCIe Gen 5/6  integration for high-speed chip-to-chip connectivity between SoCs, AI accelerators, and storage, including support for  SR-IOV  to virtualize resources across multiple Virtual Machines (VMs).   Functional Safety (ASIL) : Integrate hardware safety mechanisms (ECC, Parity, BIST, and End-to-End protection) to meet  ASIL-B/D  requirements within the routing engine and bus fabrics.   Zonal Interconnect & Bus Fabric : Design the interface between Ethernet/PCIe controllers and internal  NoC/CHI fabrics , ensuring efficient data movement for ADAS sensors (Camera, LiDAR) and telemetry.   Virtualization & Security : Architect hardware-assisted isolation and  Secure On-board Communication (SecOC)  to protect the vehicle network from cyber threats while allowing shared access to network resources.   Infrastructure & Power : Define robust  clock, reset, and power management  schemes capable of operating under automotive thermal profiles and supporting rapid "Instant-On" boot requirements         Education:  Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (PhD desirable)   Experience : 12+ years in high-speed networking or SoC architecture, with at least 5 years focused on  Automotive-grade  silicon.   TSN Mastery : Deep expertise in  IEEE 802.1 TSN  protocols and their hardware implementation for real-time traffic shaping and synchronization.   Protocol Expertise : Expert knowledge of  PCIe (Root Complex/Endpoint)  and  Automotive Ethernet (10BASE-T1S to 10G+ levels) .   Automotive Standards : Familiarity with  ISO 26262  functional safety flows and  AEC-Q100  reliability requirements.   System Integration : Proven track record of integrating routing engines into complex SoCs using  AXI/CHI  bus protocols and managing IOMMU configurations. Role Summary Magnet Forensics is seeking a detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support the company's global trade compliance program. This is an entry-level to early-career position responsible for conducting daily compliance reviews and screening activities to ensure compliance with applicable export control, sanctions, and trade regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). The successful candidate will perform Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews, restricted-party screening, sales opportunity reviews, end-user due diligence, and transaction monitoring activities. The position plays a critical role in helping the company identify potential export compliance risks before products, software, services, or technology are provided to customers, partners, vendors, or other third parties. This role will work closely with the Legal, Compliance, Sales Operations, Finance, Customer Success, and Procurement teams and will escalate higher-risk matters to senior compliance personnel for further review. The analyst will be responsible for screening transaction parties using Descartes and ensuring appropriate documentation and records are maintained. Magnet's procedures require screening customers, vendors, banks, brokers, consignees, and other transaction participants against restricted party lists throughout the transaction lifecycle. https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Renesas.body: Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next-generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9.3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world-class team of 22,700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category-defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovation engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real-world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence.   Renesas has a growing presence in India with headcount approaching 1000+ and significant engagement with government, universities, and the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. With the growing importance of India as both a market and talent hub, the India for India division's mission is to create products, including power and analog ICs, mixed-signal devices, software, and system solutions, that address local market needs. This is a unique opportunity to directly influence future products for a fast-growing Indian market with distinct applications, cost structures, and localization requirements.    We are seeking a Senior Staff Layout Design Engineer with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal layout for power and analog IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgment, and the ability to lead layout execution for complex blocks and full-chip designs.   The successful candidate will translate circuit requirements into robust, manufacturable layouts for products such as PMICs, linear and switching regulators, gate drivers, battery-management ICs, and other power and analog devices. The role requires close collaboration with analog designers, CAD, process, package, reliability, and verification teams.   You will be expected to own challenging layout problems, establish best practices, improve methodology and automation, mentor engineers, and drive projects from floor planning through physical verification and tape-out readiness.     Responsibilities     Layout Architecture & Execution     Own floor planning and physical implementation for complex analog, power, and mixed-signal blocks, and contribute to full-chip layout planning.   Collaborate with circuit designers to capture electrical, matching, isolation, current-density, thermal, reliability, and area requirements.   Apply advanced layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, noise isolation, high-current routing, electromigration robustness, thermal behavior, and yield optimization.   Drive routing, integration, and sign-off readiness for block-level and chip-level layouts.     Physical Verification & Sign-off     Own and review DRC, LVS, ERC, PEX, antenna, density, latch-up, and reliability verification as required by the process and product.   Analyse extracted parasitics with designers and support post-layout simulation closure.   Identify physical-design risks early and drive corrective actions with design, CAD, PDK, process, and package teams.   Ensure layout databases, review records, and release documentation meet tape-out quality standards.     Methodology, Automation & IP Reuse     Develop and deploy automation using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar languages to improve quality and turnaround time.   Drive layout methodology improvements, reusable templates, checklists, and portability of IP across products and process technologies.   Work with corporate engineering and CAD teams to resolve tool, PDK, extraction, and process-flow issues.   Evaluate new layout tools and techniques and lead practical adoption within the team.     Technical Leadership & Mentorship     Lead layout reviews and provide clear estimates, progress updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans.   Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers and raise the technical standard of the broader team.   Influence project planning, task allocation, technical decisions, and hiring through demonstrated technical depth.   Operate independently on ambiguous and complex assignments, escalating issues with clear options and recommendations.      Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.   10+ years of relevant experience in analog, power, or mixed-signal IC layout and associated development flows.   Demonstrated ownership of complex block-level layout and meaningful contribution to full-chip integration and tape-out.   Deep understanding of matching, parasitic control, noise isolation, guard rings, latch-up prevention, high-current routing, electromigration, IR drop, thermal effects, and reliability-aware layout.   Hands-on expertise with Cadence Virtuoso and physical verification tools such as Calibre, PVS, or equivalent. Experience with extraction and reliability tools is expected.   Experience working with deep-submicron CMOS and preferably BCD or high-voltage process technologies.   Ability to automate layout or verification tasks using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages.   Proven ability to lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and drive layout methodology improvements.   Strong cross-functional communication skills in a multisite and multicultural environment.   Results-oriented, self-driven, and able to deliver high-quality work under tight schedules with limited supervision.       Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier . safety-related digital functions that interact closely with analog circuitry.   You will be expected to work autonomously, resolve ambiguous specification issues, establish verification flows from scratch where required, mentor engineers, and provide clear evidence that the design meets functional and product requirements before tape-out.     Responsibilities       Verification Strategy & Ownership     Own block-level and full-chip digital verification strategy for power, analog, and mixed-signal IC products.   Develop verification plans from product and design specifications, including feature extraction, test intent, coverage goals, assumptions, and sign-off criteria.   Decompose complex functions into reusable verification components and scalable environments.   Identify specification gaps and drive closure with architecture, analog design, digital design, applications, and test teams.     Environment Development & Execution     Design and develop SystemVerilog/UVM-based testbenches, agents, scoreboards, reference models, assertions, sequences, and coverage models.   Set up verification flows from scratch where needed and own regression execution, triage, debug, and closure.   Apply simulation, assertion-based verification, formal verification, and FPGA or emulation techniques where they provide practical value.   Verify digital behavior across reset, clock, power-state, fault, trim, communication, test-mode, and analog-interaction scenarios.     Mixed-Signal, DFT & Post-layout Support     Collaborate with analog and digital teams to define appropriate models and verify analog-digital interactions at the required abstraction level.   Support DFT verification, scan and ATPG-related checks, production-test vector development, and test-mode verification.   Support gate-level simulation, timing-aware verification, and post-layout verification where required.   Contribute to silicon bring-up, device evaluation, root-cause analysis, and documented workarounds for device errata.     Technical Leadership & Methodology     Drive reusable verification methodology, automation, metrics, documentation, and review standards across projects.   Mentor and train verification engineers through reviews, debug support, and technical guidance.   Provide concise status, coverage, risk, and sign-off assessments to project and technical leadership.   Influence architecture and design choices by identifying verification complexity, observability gaps, and product risks early.      Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.   10+ years of experience in digital verification, including substantial hands-on experience with SystemVerilog and UVM.   Proven ownership of block-level and full-chip verification environments and sign-off for complex semiconductor products.   Strong knowledge of functional verification, assertion-based verification, formal verification, regression frameworks, coverage closure, and debug methodologies.   Experience verifying digital logic embedded in PMICs, power-management, automotive, audio, or other mixed-signal integrated circuits.   Good understanding of RTL, microarchitecture, clocks, resets, low-power states, register interfaces, and common serial interfaces such as SPI, I2C, or UART.   Working knowledge of synthesis, STA, DFT, scan insertion, ATPG, and gate-level verification to collaborate effectively across the development flow.   Experience with scripting or automation using Python, TCL, Perl, shell, or similar languages.   Proven ability to mentor engineers, establish verification methodology, and lead technical reviews without requiring formal 【背景】 
当部門では、今後の製品競争力を左右するCPUアーキテクチャ設計力の強化が急務となっています。 
システムの中核であるCPUは、性能・電力・コスト・安全性のすべてに影響を与えるため、従来以上に高い視点で全体を見渡せるエンジニアが必要です。 
アーキテクチャ検討において最も重要なのは、システム性能を正しく見極める力です。 
単なる理論値や仕様比較ではなく、実際のユースケースやボトルネックを理解し、「どこに性能を割くべきか」「どこを割り切るべきか」を判断できることが求められます。 
そのためには、プログラムを理解し、自ら作れることが不可欠です。 
ソフトウェアの挙動を理解してこそ、CPU構成やメモリ、バス、割り込み設計といったアーキテクチャ上の意思決定が可能になります。 
ハードウェアとソフトウェアの両方を理解した立場から、実効性能に責任を持てるエンジニアを求めています。  【職務概要】 
次世代マイコン／SoC製品に向けたCPUアーキテクチャおよびシステム設計を担当いただきます。 
定量的なKPIに基づくアーキテクチャ策定から、ターゲットアプリケーションを見据えたシステム構築・評価まで、製品競争力の中核を担うポジションです。  【主な業務内容】   CPUアーキテクチャのKPI（性能・電力・面積・拡張性 等）に基づくアーキテクチャ方針の策定  PPA（Performance / Power / Area）ベンチマークの企画・実施および結果分析  ターゲットアプリケーションの要件に沿ったCPU／メモリ／周辺IPを含むシステム構成の設計・構築  アーキテクチャおよびシステム構成におけるトレードオフの整理、技術的根拠に基づく提案  関連部門（ハードウェア設計、ソフトウェア、事業部門 等）との技術的な連携・調整   ※就業場所の変更の範囲、従事すべき業務の変更の範囲については、選考時に詳細をお伝えいたします。       【MUST】    5年以上の実アプリケーション（制御、車載、組込み等）を用いた性能評価・最適化経験  2年以上のCPU IP（ARM、RISC‑V 等）に関する知識・評価経験  論理合成、タイミング解析、電力解析等の設計フローに関する経験  RTLデザイン(VerilogHDL/VHDL設計、検証、論理合成)の経験  英語による技術文書の作成および技術的なディスカッションの実務経験  日本語：ビジネスレベルでの会話・コミュニケーションが可能な方  英語：実務での使用（読み書き・会話）に抵抗のない方    【WANT】    CPUの設計経験  実装経験(タイミング設計、レイアウト)  英語：日常会話ができる (TOEIC 600点程度)      ルネサスは、「To Make Our Lives Easier（人々の暮らしをより豊かで快適にする）」というPurposeのもと、組込み半導体ソリューションを提供するグローバル企業です。世界30か国以上で活躍する21,000人を超えるエンジニアや課題解決のプロフェッショナルとともに、自動車、産業、インフラ、IoT分野における世界最先端のテクノロジー開発に携わり、より安全で、健康的で、環境にやさしく、スマートな未来の実現に貢献しています。      ルネサスでは、「TAGIE（Transparent、Agile、Global、Innovative、Entrepreneurial）」を企業文化の中核としています。TAGIEは、私たちの働き方や成長のあり方、そしてPurposeの実現に向けた取り組みを支える共通の価値観です。この協調的な精神と挑戦するマインドセットが、半導体技術を通じた産業の変革と、世界中の人々の暮らしへの貢献を可能にしています。      私たちは、競争力のある報酬制度に加え、充実した福利厚生をご用意しています。福利厚生の詳細については、選考プロセスの中でご案内いたします。      私たちとともに未来を創造する挑戦に、ぜひ参加しませんか。皆さまからのご応募をお待ちしております。

Cerio is helping build the infrastructure foundation for the next generation of AI-driven computing.

We are looking for a creative, hands-on Marketing Programs Manager to build brand awareness, engage customers and partners, and support our growth through impactful marketing programs. This role can be based in Montreal, Toronto, or Ottawa.

You will be responsible for event planning, marketing communications, digital marketing, content creation, and brand development, while identifying innovative ways to leverage AI and emerging technologies to increase marketing effectiveness and reach.

This is an ideal role for an entrepreneurial marketer who can think strategically but also enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute. You will work closely with Sales, Business Development, Product, and Executive Leadership to create programs that strengthen our market presence and generate meaningful customer engagement.

What you will do

• Develop and execute field marketing and event programs, including conferences, trade shows, webinars, and customer events

• Manage event logistics, sponsorships, vendors, budgets, promotional materials, and post-event follow-up

• Develop compelling marketing communications, content, presentations, sales collateral, newsletters, and social media

• Manage digital marketing initiatives including website, email, social media, SEO/SEM, and digital campaigns

• Build brand awareness and strengthen the company's positioning within target markets

• Partner with Sales to support lead generation, customer engagement, and pipeline development

• Leverage AI tools to enhance content creation, market intelligence, personalization, campaign development, and marketing productivity

• Track marketing performance and use data to optimize campaigns and demonstrate ROI

• Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all marketing activities

What we are looking for

• Someone who is strategic, creative, energetic, and highly execution-oriented - a marketer who can develop the plan, make things happen, and measure the results

• 10+ years of marketing experience, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, deep tech, clean tech, or another complex technology environment

• A proven ability to translate technologies into targeted marketing with well researched buying personas and ideal customer profiles

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools and leveraging AI in the marketing pipeline

• Extensive experience in field marketing, event management, and digital marketing

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technology into compelling customer-focused messaging

• Experience developing content and managing multiple marketing channels

• Demonstrated ability to build brand awareness and support lead generation and sales objectives

• Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Entrepreneurial, creative, highly organized, and comfortable working independently

• Curious and enthusiastic about AI and emerging marketing technologies

• Bilingual English/French is highly desirable

Total Rewards

Cerio offers a comprehensive total rewards package for this position including base salary (range $120,000 - $150,000), incentive bonus plan, health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth. The salary range provided represents the expected base salary for this position. The final offer amount may be adjusted slightly higher or lower depending on the selected candidate's relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and certifications, as well as the full total compensation package offered. Our People & Culture team welcomes discussions about total rewards during your conversations.

About Cerio

Cerio is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, with offices and projects spanning international markets and Centers of Excellence across Europe and North America. Cerio is creating new scale economics for the AI and cloud era through an open systems platform designed to enable a more sustainable and efficient data center. Our innovation has no boundaries. We have built a culture that embraces flexibility, collaboration, and high performance, supporting both remote and hybrid work environments. Learn more about us at www.cerio.ai

Cerio is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. In addition, Cerio is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities. Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of your candidate experience so we can better support you. You can reach us here at hr@cerio.ai.

We are seeking a highly organized and technically skilled person with a deep understanding of En-gineering processes and Configuration Management to support our semiconductor development programs and ensure traceability across the entire product lifecycle. This role will focus on optimiz-ing engineering processes, reporting, and collaboration using Jira and Confluence, ensuring align-ment across cross-functional engineering, design, and manufacturing teams. Your role is essential to ensure that every work product - from Mixed-Signal design files and Digital RTL to Post-Silicon validation reports - is version-controlled and cross-referenced. You ensure that a bug found in the lab can be traced back to the exact design baseline and verification testbench that produced it.   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   · Full-Lifecycle Traceability: Enable and maintain the link between requirements, pre-silicon verification (Simulations/Emulation), and Post-Silicon validation results.  · Mixed-Signal Change Control: Govern Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) that affect both Analog layouts and Digital logic, ensuring all Work Products are synchronized before tape-out.  · Post-Silicon Governance: Manage the configuration of Validation Boards, firmware versions, and test scripts used in the lab to ensure reproducibility of results.  · Standardize project templates and workflows: Ensure consistency across ASIC, SoC, and IP development programs.  · Support compliance: Ensure we meet internal and external quality standards (e.g., ISO, au-tomotive ASPICE).  · Release Artifact Management: Organize and secure all final deliverables, including GDSII, BOMs, test vectors, and compliance documentation.  · Requirements Management: Support the team and ensure that requirements are well doc-umented and tracked across the product lifecycle  · Continuous Audit: Conduct technical audits to ensure that the IC being tested matches the "as-built" digital configuration stored in the CMS (Configuration Management System    PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS   · Holistic Data Management: Expert use of version control systems (e.g., Git/subversion/Clio-Soft) for both large binary analog data and text-based verification scripts.  · Lifecycle Tools: Proficiency in Product/Application Lifecycle Management (PLM/ALM) tools to manage the "Digital Thread" from spec to silicon.  · Verification Knowledge: Familiarity with pre-silicon verification environments and how they relate to post-silicon lab measurements.  · Change Governance: Deep understanding of Change Control Board (CCB) workflows and impact analysis in a high-stakes semiconductor environment.  · Semiconductor Industry: A very solid knowledge of semiconductor development processes and manufacturing is a must-have.  · Education: Master in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical dis-cipline.  · Experience: 4+ years in CCM or Quality Engineering, specifically within the Semiconduc-tor or High-Tech Hardware sectors.  · Strong skills in data visualization and reporting (e.g., Jira dashboards, Power BI).  · Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.   This position is subject to the Collective Agreement of the Electrical and Electronics Industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/leistungen/informations-service/mindestlohne-und-gehalter). The monthly salary is paid 14 times a year. However, we offer a higher salary depending on your experience and qualifications. March Networks is an established global leader in the video surveillance industry and works with the world’s largest retailers and banking institutions. Our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

## Purpose:

Reporting to the Manager, Customer Operations, the Customer Operations Specialist will assist with the achievement of corporate goals and objectives by acting in a support role for all customer related issues within the Customer Operations Department. The Customer Operations Specialist interfaces internally with all levels and departments in the organization to ensure that customers’ orders are entered and fulfilled in a timely manner and customers’ needs are handled in a seamless and professional manner.

Duties:

· Resolves complex and escalated customer issues with a high level of judgment and discretion, serving as a point of escalation for the team, focusing on customer satisfaction, and resulting in a high level of confidence in the company and its products.

· Serves as a subject-matter resource for customer phone and email support, guiding customers on topics regarding our products such as part number verification, pricing, availability, and lifecycle (New product introduction, End of life).

· Liaises with the Sales, Finance, Product Management, Legal and Operations departments to ensure smooth order flow, delivery of product and successful resolution of customer needs (on time delivery and product shortage mitigation).

· Generates all transactions related to order management in SAP while adhering to company processes for hardware, software and subscription services product lines, ensuring process adherence and identifying/correcting errors before they impact customers.

· Provides shipment confirmations and tracking information to customers as required, supporting the customers on complex or high-priority shipments requiring judgment calls (e.g., expedited freight, split shipments, customs issues).

· Provides pro-forma invoices, freight quotes and certifications for international shipments as required, including non-standard or high-complexity cases.

· Functions with a high degree of independence, exercising sound judgment and decision-making authority on daily operations, escalations, and special projects with minimal oversight from the Department Manager

## Education:

· College diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

· At least 5 years’ experience as a customer service representative in a technology environment

## Qualifications and Experience:

· Demonstrated experience working with international customers in various time zones

· SAP experience in Order Management (SD) is required

· Salesforce (Sales Cloud) experience would be an asset

· Sound problem solver and decision maker

· Professional demeanour and excellent customer service focus

· Strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

· Excellent interpersonal, organizational, influencing, and communications skills for both customer and inter-company interactions

· Ability to manage customer expectations

· Ability to work

o Independently and as part of a team

o Well under pressure and meet deadlines

o In a fast-paced, dynamic environment, ability to prioritize and multitask

· Attention to detail, investigative, committed to quality

The "Cybersecurity Requirements Manager" is responsible for deriving and managing cybersecurity requirements for MCU/SoC and software products. In this role, you will establish appropriate cybersecurity goals for our products—based on existing and emerging cybersecurity regulations (primarily UN R155 for automotive applications and other international regulations)—and support efforts to achieve them. 
To this end, you will research and communicate the latest market trends regarding cybersecurity requirements for MCUs/SoCs and software to both internal and external stakeholders, while also coordinating with global product development and quality assurance departments.  1. Derivation and management of cybersecurity requirements for MCU/SoC and software products (threat analysis, creation of requirements specifications) 
2. Research on the latest market trends regarding cybersecurity requirements 
3. Creation and communication of cybersecurity roadmaps (internally and externally) 
4. Proposing improvements to the cybersecurity requirements management process 
5. Demonstrating leadership across departments and in external engagements   ・Experience in cybersecurity development or requirements development for MCUs/SoCs and software products 
・Understanding of cybersecurity development processes 
・Strong communication skills capable of effectively explaining and coordinating technical matters with stakeholders, such as customers and management  ・Deep understanding of MCU/SoC security use cases, including encryption, secure boot, secure updates, and product lifecycles 
・Understanding of automotive E/E architectures and cybersecurity 
・Experience leading product specification definition as a requirements manager in development projects 
・Experience formulating cross-product cybersecurity strategies and roadmaps

https://ranovus.bamboohr.com/careers/77.body:
Job Opportunity: Senior Finance Manager & Analyst

Company: RANOVUS Inc.

Location: Ottawa, Ontario

Department: Finance

Reports To: CFO

About Us:

Ranovus is a semiconductor company with global operations helping power the data behind next generation AI and data center networks. We design and build advanced hardware that moves massive amounts of information quickly and efficiently between computer systems in data centers around the world. Our technology improves performance while reducing energy use and environmental impact, supporting the rapid growth of AI and cloud services.

At Ranovus, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team that values learning, flexibility, and meaningful work with global impact.

Position Overview:

As the Senior Finance Manager & Analyst, you will bridge the gap between corporate finance and our international operational teams. You will lead a small finance team and act as financial partner to R&D, PLM, Sales, and Manufacturing Operations across Canada, Germany, and the USA. Beyond core FP&A duties, this role will spearhead the implementation of a cloud FP&A tool and lead the migration from QuickBooks Online to an enterprise ERP.

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Partnering & FP&A: Build and manage global budgets and rolling forecasts across multi-national teams; deliver variance analysis and financial insight to department heads.

• Project Accounting: Design and execute project accounting for R&D/Operations initiatives, ensuring alignment with SR&ED and grant reporting requirements.

• Cost Accounting: Support Manufacturing on standard costing, inventory valuation, and product-line margin analysis.

• Systems Transformation: Lead selection/implementation of a cloud FP&A tool and scope the QBO-to-ERP migration (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct).

• Financial Reporting & Audit: Manage month/quarter-end reporting, year-end close, external audits, government/SR&ED audits, and GAAP/IFRS-compliant internal controls.

• Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and develop a small finance team; present financial updates to senior leadership and the CFO.

Key Qualifications:

• 12+ years of progressive finance experience, with direct, hands-on ownership of financial analysis, reporting, and consolidation, along with previous experience leading or mentoring a finance team.

• Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams within the technology, manufacturing, and/or R&D sector, with semiconductor industry experience considered an asset.

• Demonstrated experience leading multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation and experience leading or supporting ERP implementations or system migrations.

• Advanced Excel/MS Office skills; working knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Power BI) and ERP systems.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Commerce; CPA designation is an asset.

• Strong business judgment, communication skills, and comfort operating across time zones and cultures in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

What We Offer:

• Competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive benefits, paid time off, professional development, and more.

• The opportunity to join one of Canada’s premier hi-tech leaders at a pivotal moment, playing a direct role in developing world-class, innovative solutions that are actively powering the next generation of global AI infrastructure.

• A collaborative, innovative, and fast-paced international environment where your career can grow alongside the company.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

We are committed to delivering a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage of the process. Ranovus Inc. is committed to leveraging new technologies and working efficiently. As a result, artificial intelligence systems may be used to support elements of our hiring process. These tools are designed to enhance consistency and efficiency, not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in joining Ranovus. We look forward to connecting with you.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/792.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

What You’ll Do in this Role

• Regular Customer contact for all outstanding invoices.

• Review delinquent accounts and create collection strategies to resolve billing / collection disputes.

• Maintain accurate records of Customer interactions.

• Communicate regular status updates to Management on overdue accounts.

• Perform account reconciliations to ensure payments are properly applied.

• Generate or build reports related to collection activities.

• Perform accounts receivable month end close activities.

• Create annual subscription billing renewal opportunities/quotes in salesforce.com for the Solace Sales team.

• Assist in resolving tickets from the Solace Sales team related to renewal quotes.

• Track and update Customer inventory records (annual subscriptions).

• Ad hoc duties as required.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 3+ years of work experience in a similar role.

• Strong business/accounting knowledge.

• Strong Microsoft Excel experience.

• High attention to accuracy and detail in working processes and reports.

• Ability to multi-task, work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

• History of thriving in a rapidly changing environment.

• Friendly and able to work with staff across all departments.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills.

• Experience working with Sales.

Desired Skills:

• Comfortable using software packages (Great Plains, salesforce.com, Maxio, NetSuite)

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

Role Status: EXISTING

Expected Salary Range: Expected salary range for this role is from $60,000 to $68,000. The final offer within this range will reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience.

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

As a GTM Engineer, you will serve as a technical force multiplier across the business, building the AI agents, automations, and applications that scale how every team operates — from Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support to Product, IT, Engineering, Finance, and HR — while sitting within the centralized Business Operations function. This role is responsible for engineering solutions that operationalize data, tooling, and workflows across the organization, replacing manual processes with reliable systems, driving visibility into performance, enabling leadership decision-making, and advancing automation and innovation across the business. You’ll be expected to bring hands-on engineering skill, innovative problem-solving, and a results-oriented approach to support the business in achieving its goals.

You will own key cross-functional tools, integrations, and automations, partner closely with technical and business teams to connect and activate data across platforms, and deliver high-impact applications, reporting, and insights that inform roadmap planning, investment decisions, performance management, and operational excellence.

In this role (remote-first: Canada), you’ll report to our VP, Business Operations & Strategy and work closely with teams across the organization. Expect a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you’ll wear multiple hats, be accountable and recognized for being creative and results-oriented. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we work. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to using AI responsibly to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making. Across all roles, we look for strong human judgment, problem-solving, collaboration, and the ability to thoughtfully apply AI tools while reviewing outputs for accuracy, context, and business impact.

What You’ll Do

• AI Agents & Applications: Architect, build, and deploy AI-powered agents, workflows, and applications that scale the productivity of teams across the organization — Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, IT, Engineering, Finance, and HR. Pair AI-accelerated development with sound software engineering, and for larger applications, act as the Technical Product Manager — partnering with our Engineering team to define requirements, scope solutions, and ensure our software development lifecycle (SDLC) is followed.

• Automation Engineering: Design, build, and maintain production-grade automations and integrations across the business — leveraging the existing tech stack, internal automation platforms, APIs, webhooks, and custom scripting — to replace manual processes with reliable, scalable systems.

• Systems Integration & Data Pipelines: Connect and orchestrate data across the platforms each function relies on — spanning the go-to-market, product, finance, and people systems — and into a central data warehouse, building robust ETL and API pipelines that keep systems in sync and data trustworthy.

• Reporting, Dashboards & Insights: Transform integrated and orchestrated data into standardized, automated reporting and dashboards — a core output of the team — driving visibility, accountability, and data-informed decision-making across every function in the organization.

• GTM Systems & Revenue Automation: Engineer the go-to-market stack end to end — streamlining how the revenue organization attracts, converts, retains, and expands customers — to reduce friction across the customer lifecycle and give Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams greater leverage and efficiency.

• Cross-Functional Tooling: Build and own internal tools, scripts, and applications that serve Business Operations and its partner functions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, IT, Engineering, Finance, and HR, acting as both engineer and product owner.

• Deployment, Reliability & Security: Deploy, host, and operate the automations, agents, and applications you build — managing CI/CD, environments, monitoring, and incident response, and establishing standards for data quality, access, and error handling so solutions run securely and reliably in production.

• Business Partnership & Requirements Engineering: Partner with leaders across Business Operations and the broader organization to translate operational problems into technical solutions, scoping requirements and shipping automations that align with strategic objectives.

• Rapid Prototyping & Experimentation: Use AI-accelerated development to quickly prototype, test, and iterate on new integrations, tools, and automations — then apply real engineering discipline to harden what works into secure, supported systems.

• Documentation & Enablement: Document systems and workflows, and enable teams across the organization to adopt and self-serve on the tooling and automations you build.

What Success Looks Like

• 30 Days: Build relationships with key stakeholders, understand the business systems landscape, and identify high-priority operational pain points.

• 60 Days: Deliver initial automation or reporting improvements and align on a prioritized cross-functional roadmap.

• 90 Days: Launch scalable production solutions for priority workflows, with clear ownership, documentation, and success measures.

• 1 Year: Establish a reliable, secure automation and data foundation that measurably improves efficiency, visibility, and decision-making across the business.

Who We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in software/automation engineering, technical operations, or revenue/business operations, with a proven track record of building technical solutions and driving operational improvements in a B2B SaaS environment.

• Hands-on engineering skills, with proficiency in scripting and programming (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL) and a track record of building integrations against REST APIs and webhooks.

• Experience building AI-powered agents, workflows, and applications, with hands-on use of AI and automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n, and modern LLM/agent frameworks.

• Hands-on experience administering, integrating, or automating core business systems across CRM, ERP, marketing automation, sales engagement, and customer success — such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Marketo, Salesloft, and ChurnZero, or comparable platforms.

• Hands-on experience with data and analytics platforms and warehouses such as Snowflake or similar technologies, including building ETL and API-based data pipelines.

• Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to drive insights from business performance and pipeline data.

• Experience deploying, hosting, and operating applications in production, including familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD, monitoring, and cloud environments.

• Knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and best practices for data handling, security, and compliance in a business environment.

• Proven project management skills with experience running multiple concurrent projects on timelines, using project management tools like Monday.com, Asana, or similar.

• Exceptional attention to detail and problem-solving skills, with a systematic approach to troubleshooting and optimizing workflows.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, IT, Finance, HR, etc.) to ensure alignment on business goals and operational efficiencies.

• Results-driven, with a high sense of urgency and accountability in achieving goals and addressing challenges in a fast-paced environment.

• Growth mindset and adaptability, with a strong drive to learn, evolve with industry trends, and implement best practices to support business success.

• Superior communication skills, capable of clearly articulating insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and able to influence across the organization.

• previous experience in a B2B SaaS organization is highly desirable.

• Creative, proactive problem solver who can anticipate operational challenges, think critically about solutions, and bring new ideas to improve the various business functions.

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans the US and Canada)

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!

• Generous professional development budget

• RRSP/401k matching program and company stock options

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through our BambooHR system (please check your junk mail).

All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

Responsibilities: 
 
T    Test Strategy & Development    Develop cost-effective and high-efficiency test solutions for GaN power discretes, high-voltage GaN FETs, bidirectional switches, and other power semiconductor products, ensuring robust test coverage, optimized test time, high production yield, and low cost of test.  Create, debug, and release test programs on discrete testers and mixed signal ATE platforms. Lead the transition of legacy platforms to new technology nodes.    Hardware Design & Requirements    Lead the design reviews and acceptance of high-performance test interface hardware provided by external vendors.  Design test hardware including load boards, probe heads, and sockets.  Define test hardware requirements based on device specifications and characterization data    Execution & Sustaining    Support New Product Introduction (NPI) through validation, release, and yield ramp activities.  Provide sustaining support for production products and test platforms.  Lead platform conversions and drive efficiency improvements across multiple ATE systems.    Technical Expertise    Apply knowledge of wide bandgap semiconductors, power devices, and analog measurement techniques.  Perform high-voltage and high-current testing safely and efficiently.  Use lab tools such as oscilloscopes, DMMs, spectrum analyzers, and ATE debugging utilities.    Cross-functional Collaboration    Partner with design, product, reliability, test, and operations teams to ensure smooth project execution.  Organize technical data and present findings for engineering and management teams     Experience    5–12+ years in semiconductor test engineering (depending on degree: BS or MS).  Hands-on experience with wafer sort and final test.  Programming background in C++, VBA, or similar languages    Technical Skills    Proficiency with ATE instrumentation and platforms (discrete test systems and mixed-signal testers, e.g., Acco STS8300).  Solid understanding of wide bandgap semiconductors (e.g., GaN).  Experience with power and analog test methodologies.  Familiarity with semiconductor fabrications, assembly, and packaging processes.    Soft Skills    Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally.  Ability to organize, analyze, and present technical information clearly.      Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,  To Make Our Lives Easier . With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.  At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.  We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.  Are you ready to join our team and  shape the future  with us?
