https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/09.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Summary Magnet Forensics is seeking an experienced and technically sophisticated compliance professional to lead the company's product export classification and regulatory compliance efforts. This role requires a unique combination of export controls expertise and technical knowledge of computer engineering, cryptography, cryptanalysis, cybersecurity, and digital forensics technologies. The successful candidate will work directly with product management and engineering teams to understand product architecture, software functionality, source code changes, encryption and cryptanalytic capabilities, and emerging technologies. Based on this technical understanding, the individual will determine and maintain accurate export classifications under the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), and other applicable global trade control regimes. This position serves as the primary bridge between engineering innovation and export compliance, ensuring that Magnet's product classifications, licenses, government filings, and compliance documentation remain accurate and current as products evolve. Position Type: New Position Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact aoda@magnetforensics.com should you require any accommodations. All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment. US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Magnet Forensics handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here.

https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Renesas.body: Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.  Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.   This role is responsible for  leading OSAT  strategic engagement and commercial management, driving cost optimization, ensuring supply continuity, and owning end-to-end supplier strategy. The role requires strong leadership, program management, and cross-functional influence to align business, engineering, and supply chain objectives while driving long-term value creation.   Key Responsibilities     Lead  commercial negotiations including pricing, LTAs, capacity agreements, price adjustments, and payment terms.   Own  OSAT supplier strategy and act as a key decision driver in supplier selection.   Drive  cost optimization initiatives using structured methodologies such as cost breakdown analysis, should-cost modeling, VA/VE, and localization strategies.   Lead cross-functional  program engagement as a product/program management partner, ensuring OSAT readiness across MP, NPI, transfer, ramp-up, and EOL phases.   Ensure  supply continuity and resilience by proactively managing capacity planning, allocation strategies, and supply risk mitigation.   Identify, assess,  and  mitigate  supply chain risks including capacity constraints, geopolitical exposure, cost volatility, and supplier dependency.   Lead  contract governance including MSA, NDA, pricing frameworks, and commercial agreements, ensuring alignment with business strategy.   Drive  supplier performance management through structured reviews, KPI tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.   Lead  escalation management and resolution of critical issues related to quality, delivery, capacity, and commercial disputes, working with stakeholders internally and externally.   Act  as a strategic interface between internal functions (Engineering, Product Group, Supply Chain, and Finance teams) and OSAT partners to ensure alignment of roadmap, cost, and execution priorities.     3+ years of purchasing/procurement experience, preferably in the semiconductor or electronics industry.  Fluent in English is required; Japanese language proficiency is a plus.   Hands-on experience or familiarity with power-related products and components is a strong advantage.   Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; proficient in PowerPoint for executive-level presentations.  Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.  Experience in strategic sourcing, supplier management, or program management is highly preferred. Job Summary    Maintenance Engineer setup new equipment, maintains and troubleshoots semiconductor assembly and inspection equipment to ensure high uptime and production efficiency. https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/a4.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The Senior Federal Account Executive will be responsible for driving new business growth within U.S. Federal Government agencies by leveraging Magnet Forensics’ comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services. This role is aligned to U.S. Federal Government and Intelligence Community accounts and requires a proven track record of selling into the three letter intelligence agencies as well as military service intelligence commands. Compensation & Benefits The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you. If the compensation structure for the role includes an incentive component (i.e. most Sales roles) the range below represents total target compensation (TTC) (base salary + variable). $270,000 - $320,000 (USD) a year Salary range (min - max) Position Type: Current Vacancy Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. Hybrid  - This role may sit in San Jose, CA; Phoenix, AZ; or Chandler, AZ (local candidates to these cities preferred - no relocation)  This role sits within our Low-Voltage GaN Marketing & Systems Group, acting as a Sr Staff System Engineer to define the future of our power semiconductor portfolio. In this strategic role, you will not simply support existing products—you will be the technical authority responsible for driving next-generation IC product definition, silicon architectures, and long-term roadmap strategy.  By leveraging deep expertise in low-voltage (<400V) BLDC and PMSM motor control, you will identify market gaps across high-growth applications (robotics, humanoids, e- mobility, power tools) and translate complex system-level challenges into actionable silicon-level requirements to deliver highly differentiated, system-optimized products.   Key Responsibilities   • Product Definition & Specs: Translate system-level application requirements into detailed IC specifications (e.g., Rds-on targets, gate drive source/sink strength, dead-time control, protection features like OCP/OTP, packaging  thermal constraints, and monolithically integrated features).  • Architecture & Strategy: Develop and influence future chip architectures based on system-level understanding of GaN-based power stage and driver IP and sensing topologies. Drive the multi-year technology roadmap aligned with emerging market trends.  • Silicon & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with IC Design, R&D, and Marketing teams to ensure silicon implementation matches application realities. Balance system performance, silicon die area, cost targets, and time-to- market.  • Prototype & Reference Design Development: Design, schematic-capture, layout, and validate high-power-density system-level prototypes and evaluation  boards (EVBs) to showcase GaN's superior switching performance under real- world operating conditions.  • System Analysis: Perform rigorous technical trade-off analyses, worst-case circuit simulations, and competitive benchmarking to quantify GaN’s value proposition at the system level.  • Customer & Ecosystem Engagement: Support key tier-1 customer engagements at the architecture level, co-designing and influencing their future system topologies rather than merely troubleshooting legacy designs.  Required Hardware, Software & Technical Domain Expertise  1.  Hardware Requirements   · Experience designing integrated circuits with power drivers and related circuitry like slew rate control, current sensing, short circuit protection, high voltage level shifting, bootstrap, and charge pump supplies. Strong knowledge basic infrastructure and communications blocks like current/voltage references, level shifters, SPI, I2C, registers, e-fuse, amplifiers, and comparators.  · Experience designing detailed schematics for motor driver circuits including gate drivers, discrete transistors, and power stages utilizing MOSFETs, IGBTs, or Wide-Bandgap SiC / GaN devices.  · Experience designing motor control hardware protection and diagnostics that can withstand fault conditions like short circuit, ,over current, open circuit, over/under voltage, sudden loss of power, and over temperature.  · Advanced knowledge of PCB layout optimization for high-power switching, including minimizing parasitic inductance, mitigating EMI/EMC, and managing thermal dissipation (via thermal vias, or heatsinks).  2.  Simulation & Software Tools   · Proficiency with model-based design using Mathworks (Matlab, Simulink, Simscape), Saber, PLECS, or PSIM to simulate motor drive system. Alternatively experience with co-simulation of the mechanical and electrical system using a combination like Simplis for the power inverter and Simulink for the motor mechanics and control.  3.  IC Architecture and Specification   · Proven track record of successful product definition and customer support in motor drive / control applications taking a product from conception through mass production.  · Experience driving innovation by identifying and evaluating new concepts that will enable future products that lead the market.  · Expertise translating system-level requirements and customer needs into an IC architecture with concrete electrical specifications documented in the device hardware requirements and the customer datasheet.  · Experience creating and maintaining a specification compliance matrix that covers all product requirements and ensures the device meets the requirements by working with all relevant product groups design, test, validation, FuSa, and quality.  4.  Lab Experience   · Hands-on experience characterizing motors and motor control systems utilizing  motor control hardware and software together with standard lab equipment and a motor test stand.  · Experience debugging and characterizing initial prototypes using standard lab equipment like power supplies, electronic load, oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, SMU, and other related test equipment.  · Expertise identifying the root cause of complex issues, then identifying workarounds to allow users to evaluate and use products and finally identifying fixes for addressing issues long term.    • Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Renesas is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position now or in the future.   • Experience: 5-7+ years of experience in power electronics, semiconductor systems, or motor drive design, with a proven track record of successfully defining and launching motor control ICs or discrete power solutions to market.  • Semiconductor Knowledge: Solid understanding of power semiconductor physics, specifically comparing Wide Bandgap (WBG) materials like GaN against silicon MOSFETs, including gate charge (Qg), reverse recovery (Qrr), and parasitic inductances.  • Education: BS in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field required; MS or PhD preferred.  • Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to confidently present complex architectural concepts to both internal executive stakeholders and external customer engineering team   The expected annual pay range for this position is $160,000 - $235,000. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities.  Please note that the final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.   Renesas offers a full range of elective benefits including medical, health savings account (with applicable medical plan), dental, vision, health and/or dependent care flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, life insurance, AD&D, and pet insurance. We are seeking an experienced Program Management Office (PMO) leader to establish and lead the PMO function for our large automotive semiconductor power management group. In this role, you will drive portfolio governance, project execution excellence, and cross-functional alignment across a complex ecosystem of product development programs, manufacturing ramps, and operational initiatives. You will implement best-in-class program management practices with strong emphasis on functional safety governance and risk management, establish disciplined stage-gate processes that embed functional safety review and compliance tracking, drive on-time and on-budget delivery, and ensure visibility and accountability across the entire program portfolio. This role requires deep automotive semiconductor experience, mature program/portfolio management expertise, strong functional safety knowledge (ISO 26262, SOTIF), and the ability to coordinate effectively with engineering, operations, quality, functional safety, finance, and customer teams.    Responsibilities;     Establish and lead the PMO organization: Define PMO vision, governance structure, processes, tools, and team composition. Build a team of program managers and coordinators capable of supporting 15-25 concurrent programs across design, development, validation, and production phases. Develop PMO operating standards and playbooks aligned with automotive industry best practices.       Implement portfolio management and governance: Establish portfolio-level governance including quarterly portfolio reviews, go/no-go decision frameworks, and resource allocation processes. Create visibility into program status, risks, dependencies, and critical path items across all active programs. Ensure alignment between portfolio strategy and business objectives.       Drive program execution excellence: Partner with program leads and cross-functional teams to establish clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and success criteria for each program. Implement stage-gate processes aligned with product development lifecycle. Track program health (schedule, budget, scope, quality, risk) with real-time dashboards and regular steering reviews.       Manage schedule, budget, and resource allocation: Establish robust program estimating and planning processes. Monitor budget execution and spending forecasts across the program portfolio. Manage resource conflicts and allocation optimization to maximize efficiency and minimize bottlenecks. Escalate critical resource or budget constraints to leadership.       Drive functional safety governance and compliance across program portfolio: Establish functional safety management processes aligned with ISO 26262 and SOTIF requirements. Ensure functional safety reviews are embedded in stage-gate processes and design milestones. Track functional safety metrics including ASIL classifications, safety case development, and FMEA/FTA completion. Collaborate with functional safety and quality teams to ensure compliance evidence is generated and maintained throughout program lifecycle. Ensure functional safety risks are elevated and managed with appropriate rigor.       Identify, track, and mitigate program risks including functional safety and compliance risks: Establish enterprise-wide risk management processes including risk identification, quantification, mitigation planning, and tracking. Facilitate cross-functional issue resolution for critical program blockers. Proactively escalate high-impact risks and interdependencies that threaten schedule, cost, quality, or functional safety objectives. Maintain risk dashboards that highlight functional safety risk status prominently.       Drive on-time, on-budget delivery of design-ins and production ramps: Lead programs through critical transition phases including customer design-ins, pilot production, and volume ramp. Ensure NPI (New Product Introduction) processes are executed with discipline. Build accountability for delivery commitments and establish metrics that track on-time delivery performance across the portfolio.       Build cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder alignment: Facilitate effective communication and alignment across Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Finance, Supply Chain, and Customer Success. Resolve conflicts and trade-offs with transparency and accountability. Serve as central hub for program information and status communication.       Establish metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement: Define KPIs for program portfolio health (on-time delivery, schedule variance, budget variance, risk resolution, quality metrics). Establish reporting cadence and dashboards for executive, functional, and cross-functional stakeholder groups. Drive continuous improvement in PMO processes and tool effectiveness.       12+ years of program and portfolio management experience in semiconductor, automotive electronics, or related complex product development environments.   Demonstrated experience establishing and leading PMO organizations with responsibility for 10+ concurrent programs across design, development, validation, and production phases.   Deep understanding of automotive product development processes, NPI methodologies, design-in cycles, volume production ramps, and supplier management in automotive supply chains.   Proven expertise in establishing stage-gate processes, project governance frameworks, portfolio management, and resource planning aligned with best practices.   Strong command of program management tools and methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent); experience with program management software platforms (Microsoft Project, JIRA, SAP, or similar).   Exceptional organizational and stakeholder management skills with ability to influence and align multiple functional leaders without direct authority. Renesas is seeking a  Senior Manager, Web Engineering  to lead the organization responsible for building, operating, and improving Renesas.com and related digital platforms. This role manages a global team of approximately 30 full-time employees and contractors across development, QA, infrastructure, production operations, and emerging AI-enabled web initiatives.  This is a senior technical leadership role for someone with the depth to understand complex engineering decisions and the desire to lead through strategy, team design, operating discipline, and cross-functional influence. The ideal candidate is highly technical, but does not need to personally own every implementation detail. They should be able to evaluate tradeoffs, set direction, build trust, and ensure the right technical decisions are being made.  The role reports to the Director of Web and Tech Docs at Renesas and requires excellent communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to translate business and technical needs into clear priorities, scalable plans, and credible recommendations for senior stakeholders.   Key Responsibilities    Lead the Web Engineering organization across development, QA, infrastructure, production operations, contractors, and related technical delivery functions.  Manage and develop a global team of approximately 30 full-time employees and contractors, including expectations, coaching, accountability, resource planning, and delivery quality.  Own engineering delivery for Renesas.com and related platforms, ensuring work is prioritized, planned, built, tested, released, and supported effectively.  Set technical direction and operating rhythms for planning, prioritization, release coordination, QA, infrastructure reliability, production support, and leadership reporting.  Drive practical adoption of AI-enabled tools, workflows, and engineering practices that improve productivity, automation, software quality, content delivery, search experience, and site performance.  Partner with product management, content management, digital marketing, technical documentation, IT, security, analytics, and business stakeholders to align web engineering priorities with company goals.  Identify risks, blockers, technical debt, resource constraints, and prioritization conflicts early, then communicate clear options and recommendations.  Create concise, executive-ready updates that make progress, risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and next steps easy to understand.     Required Qualifications    10+ years of experience in web engineering, software development, technical delivery, infrastructure, QA, or related technology leadership roles, including 5+ years managing engineering teams, technical leads, contractors, or similar technical organizations.  Strong technical judgment across modern web development, platform architecture, infrastructure, QA, release management, and production support.  Experience leading web engineering teams that support both CMS-based platforms and newer services, applications, APIs, or front-end experiences built outside the core CMS.  Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted technical leader who can make strategic recommendations, evaluate risks and tradeoffs, and guide the team without needing to personally own every implementation detail.  Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly, align stakeholders, simplify ambiguity, and communicate decisions with confidence and credibility.  Strong organizational skills with attention to detail, follow-through, accountability, and the ability to manage complex cross-functional initiatives.  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.    Preferred Qualifications    Drupal expertise or significant experience leading Drupal-based enterprise web platforms, especially in mixed environments that also include modern front-end frameworks, APIs, cloud services, and non-Drupal applications.  Experience supporting AI, automation, developer productivity, AI-assisted development, or AI-enabled workflow initiatives.  Experience with modern web infrastructure and delivery platforms, including AWS servers, Cloudflare, HTMX, Neon, Vercel, GitHub, and related cloud, hosting, deployment, and developer tooling environments.  Experience in B2B, semiconductor, enterprise technology, web platforms, digital marketing, or globally distributed team environments.  Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid delivery models, prioritization frameworks, operating models, or portfolio-level reporting.    Success in This Role Looks Like    A clear web engineering strategy is established, communicated, and translated into practical priorities, roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable execution.  Engineering priorities, dependencies, risks, delivery status, blockers, tradeoffs, and required decisions are clear, actionable, and visible to leadership.  Development, QA, infrastructure, production, product, and AI stakeholders are aligned around clear ownership, disciplined follow-through, and fewer ownership gaps.  AI initiatives are connected to practical engineering outcomes and scalable operating processes.

Help define the next generation of power delivery solutions for AI and high-performance computing, from architecture exploration and proof of concept through silicon product definition and laboratory validation.    As a Senior Staff Application Engineer in the Renesas Power Computing Business Unit, you will operate at the intersection of power system architecture, converter design and semiconductor product definition.  You will explore state-of-the-art and emerging DC/DC converter topologies that address the rapidly increasing power demands of modern AI and compute ASICs. This fast-moving market rewards strong technical judgment, inventive thinking, quick execution and adaptability.  You will work cross-functionally with Systems Engineering, IC Design, Applications, Packaging, Technology and Marketing teams. In this highly visible technical role, you will provide forward-looking expertise across electrical design, magnetics, power electronics, control and digital technologies, while influencing product roadmaps and solution strategy.  You will join an experienced team focused on power converter architecture, implementation and validation. Your contribution will span the complete development path: creating converter proof-of-concept platforms, developing detailed simulation models, translating system requirements into new silicon product specifications, and optimizing solutions for power density, reliability, cost, scalability and flexibility.     What You Will Do   Define and evaluate next-generation power conversion architectures for AI and high-performance computing platforms.  Lead technology pathfinding, topology studies and proof-of-concept development for high-performance DC/DC converters.  Develop detailed electrical and system-level models using SIMPLIS and other appropriate simulation environments.  Translate system-level and customer requirements into device-level specifications that support new silicon product definition.  Plan and execute converter characterization, including data collection, data analysis and correlation between simulation and bench measurements.  Drive the progressive tuning and improvement of converter performance throughout the development lifecycle.  Develop automated measurement, characterization and validation setups to improve speed, repeatability and data quality.  Guide schematic and PCB implementation, with particular focus on component placement, power-stage layout, signal integrity, thermal performance and manufacturability.  Customize proposed solutions to address customer application requirements and support technical engagement with key stakeholders.  Provide technical leadership across disciplines and communicate complex findings clearly to engineering, product and business teams.     10+ years of relevant experience in power conversion, power management, semiconductor applications or related system design.  Strong experience in the design, modeling, development and laboratory validation of high-performance power converters across low-voltage and high-voltage domains.  Deep understanding of control-loop design, stability analysis, transient response and implementation constraints.  Solid knowledge of resonant and non-resonant power conversion topologies, including the ability to evaluate topology trade-offs at system level.  Experience with magnetic component selection or design and an understanding of the relationship between magnetics, switching frequency, efficiency, thermal performance and power density.  Ability to move effectively from concept and simulation to hardware implementation, measurement and product definition.  Broad technical perspective combined with excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a closely related discipline. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.   Preferred Experience   Power delivery architectures for AI accelerators, high-performance computing, data-center platforms or other high-current digital loads.  Multiphase buck converters, point-of-load regulation, voltage regulator architectures or high-current power stages.  SIMPLIS or equivalent power electronics simulation tools.  Python or similar languages for measurement automation, data processing and visualization.  Semiconductor product definition, customer-facing technical support or cross-functional technology development.    The expected annual pay range for this position is €71,000–€95,000. Please note that the final offer will depend on factors such as geographic location, relevant experience, and the candidate’s skill set. This role is also eligible for a bonus. As an AI Compiler Engineer on the Renesas HPC team, you will be responsible for driving compiler and code generation technologies that unlock the full compute potential of Renesas next-generation automotive System-on-Chip platforms, including advanced 3 nm silicon for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Your work will directly impact how AI workloads — from perception and sensor fusion to in-vehicle assistants and advanced driver assistance — are translated into highly optimized, safe, and power-efficient execution on Renesas hardware. 
This role bridges software compiler development, AI model lowering/optimization, and hardware-software co-design, enabling Renesas SoCs to deliver industry-competitive performance, efficiency, and functional safety required by multi-domain automotive applications.. 
 
【Job Description】 
・Lead AI compiler architecture across model ingestion, graph optimization, lowering, code generation, and runtime integration 
・Design and implement graph‑level optimizations (operator fusion, quantization‑aware rewrites, memory‑aware scheduling, partitioning) 
・Drive performance optimization for target NPUs, including tiling, tensor layout, and multi‑core execution strategies 
・Partner with SoC and AI accelerator architects to influence hardware features through compiler insights 
・Own performance KPIs for real automotive AI workloads using simulators, profilers, and silicon‑correlated models 
・Ensure compiler outputs meet automotive requirements (real‑time behavior, determinism, quality expectations) 
・Mentor senior engineers and set technical direction without people‑management responsibilities  【Impact & Differentiators】 
Renesas’ Gen5 R-Car automotive SoC lineup, including flagship 3 nm devices like the R-Car X5H, is among the first highly integrated multi-domain automotive SoCs built on advanced 3 nm process technology, designed to run ADAS, IVI, gateway, and next-gen SDV workloads on a centralized platform. These platforms deliver high AI performance (e.g., multi-hundreds of TOPS), scalable chiplet-based acceleration, and power efficiency tailored for electrified and autonomous vehicles while meeting stringent functional safety standards.  An AI Compiler Engineer enables this hardware vision by ensuring that state-of-the-art AI models and computational kernels are efficiently mapped to the silicon fabric — directly enhancing performance, reducing latency and energy, and accelerating software adoption in automotive ecosystems where compute efficiency and safety are paramount.   【Must-Have】 
・MS/PhD (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, EE, or related field 
・Deep experience building AI compilers, accelerator backends, or graph optimization frameworks 
・Strong expertise in graph optimization and performance optimization for NPUs or custom accelerators 
・Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TVM‑like systems, or proprietary compiler IRs 
・Excellent C/C++ and Python skills 
・Solid understanding of AI inference workloads (CNNs, transformers, perception or generative models) 
・Strong communication skills are required, e.g. agile development experience in Scrum team (Product Owner or Scrum Master) 
 
【Nice-to-Have】 
・Experience with automotive or safety‑critical systems 
・Background in heterogeneous SoCs (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU)

Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Senior Principal Researcher.

## About the team:

The Emerging Storage Lab is a research group based at Huawei Canada's Toronto Research Centre that is focused on next-generation data and storage technologies and innovations. Our team comprises graduate computer engineers and computer scientists with diverse industry experience, ranging from 0 to over 20 years. This lab investigates various data storage-related topics, including data management, data catalog, data fabric, file systems, storage networks, and AI storage, aiming to advance the field and drive data storage technological progress in the new AI era.

## About the job:

• Define and drive the long-term research agenda for AI-native data platforms, focusing on vector-native data lakes, intelligent caching, and high-performance retrieval infrastructures for LLMs and RAG.

• Pioneer research in Agent memory systems, Knowledge Bases, and RAG-optimized data intelligence, advancing the field of Data-Centric AI.

• Lead research in dynamic data indexing, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), intelligent chunking/parsing strategies, and real-time context freshness.

• Design and prototype next-generation architectures that unify file storage, data lakes, and low-latency vector indexes into a cohesive, AI-ready data stack.

• Publish groundbreaking research at top-tier venues (e.g., VLDB, SIGIR, NeurIPS, SIGMOD) and secure patents for novel approaches.

• Represent the organization as a thought leader through speaking engagements and active participation in the academic and industry community.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate research into production-ready systems with tangible real-world impact.

• Mentor junior researchers and PhD interns, fostering a collaborative, high-impact research environment.

Perform schematic capture using industry-standard EDA tools (Altium). Write clean, maintainable C/C++ code following embedded best practices, including memory management, interrupt handling, and low-power design. Why This Role Matters   Renesas AMS is in the middle of a strategic push to become the sensor and signal-chain vendor of choice inside the fastest-growing platforms in robotics, AI infrastructure, and automotive. That strategy lives or dies on whether we can walk into a customer's lab, integrate our silicon onto their compute platform, and prove it works, fast, credibly, and in code the customer's own engineers trust.  This role is the technical engine behind that proof. You will be the person who takes an inductive position sensor, an impedance-sensing IC, or a configurable mixed-signal device and makes it run on a customer's MCU or SoC, whatever that platform happens to be. This work feeds directly into design win conversations with strategic accounts across robotics, AI infrastructure, and automotive.   What You'll Actually Do    Own hardware/software bring-up of AMS and sensor ICs on customer-selected compute platforms, with no assumption of a friendly Renesas reference design.  Write driver-level firmware in C/C++ (I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, interrupt handling, register-level configuration) directly from datasheets and schematics, often for silicon and platforms outside Renesas's own ecosystem.  Build application-layer demonstration code proving out specific end-use cases: optical encoder replacement via inductive position sensing, through-barrier impedance sensing, power sequencing, force/torque sensing for robotic end effectors.  Lead technical integration for flagship joint development programs (e.g., dexterous robotic hands, industrial robotic arms) alongside strategic partners, working against hard trade-show and customer deadlines.  Debug full signal-chain issues spanning analog front end, digital bus, and host software stack, often live, in a customer's lab.  Partner directly with FAEs, product marketing, business development, and customer engineering counterparts to scope PoC requirements, define technical success criteria, and hit milestones that feed directly into account strategy.  Build reusable driver frameworks and reference architectures that scale across engagements rather than one-off, throwaway integrations.  Represent Renesas technically in front of customer engineering leadership during lab visits and demos.  Produce clear technical documentation (architecture, register maps, bring-up guides) usable by both internal teams and customer engineers.  At the Staff level: provide technical mentorship to other engineers on the team and act as the escalation point for the most technically ambiguous or highest-stakes customer integrations.     Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.  Senior: 7+ years, Staff: 10+ years, of embedded firmware/software development spanning multiple silicon vendors and MCU/SoC ecosystems.  Strong, demonstrable C/C++ skill at both the driver and application level, not just familiarity.  Direct experience bringing up analog/mixed-signal ICs and sensors on third-party platforms you didn't design, from datasheet and schematic alone.  Deep protocol-level command of I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet-based interfaces.  Experience developing in both bare-metal and RTOS environments.  Comfort operating under ambiguity: incomplete documentation, shifting customer requirements, and hard external deadlines tied to trade shows or executive commitments.  Strong communication skills; you'll be explaining technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, sometimes in the same meeting.  Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer lab visits and trade shows.    Preferred Qualifications    Master's degree in a related engineering field.  Robotics or industrial sensing background: position sensing, force/torque sensing, proximity/impedance sensing.  Experience with edge AI compute platforms and their SDK/driver ecosystems.  Exposure to configurable mixed-signal/state-machine-based analog design.  Prior customer-facing technical role: FAE, solutions architect, or applications engineering.  Python for test automation, data logging, or tooling alongside embedded C/C++.  Experience mentoring junior or mid-level engineers.  Experience working inside a matrixed organization with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, marketing, and engineering. What You’ll Be Doing: Reporting to the Director, the Senior Azure Cloud Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, optimization, and operational support of Sienna's Microsoft Azure cloud environment and related cloud platforms. This role provides senior technical leadership for Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, security, backup and disaster recovery, governance, automation, and monitoring, ensuring the availability, performance, security, and cost-effectiveness of enterprise cloud services.

Working closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and application teams, the incumbent leads cloud operations, supports enterprise technology initiatives, and drives the adoption of cloud best practices through automation, standardization, and governance.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Operations

• Serve as the senior technical owner for the enterprise Microsoft Azure platform, providing architectural oversight, operational leadership, and technical direction for cloud infrastructure and platform services.

• Design, implement, and optimize Azure infrastructure services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform services, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, and operational excellence.

• Lead the administration and continuous improvement of Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, hybrid connectivity, VPN Gateways, DNS, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Application Gateways, and Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies. Develop networking standards and lead complex troubleshooting and performance optimization initiatives.

• Own the enterprise Microsoft Entra ID platform, including identity governance, Conditional Access, RBAC, Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and identity lifecycle automation.

• Design and maintain SCIM-based provisioning to support a cloud-first identity strategy and Zero Trust security model.

• Lead operational monitoring, observability, and service reliability initiatives using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and native Azure management tools.

• Drive root cause analysis, problem management, and continual service improvement while serving as the senior escalation point for critical cloud incidents.

• Provide technical leadership for regarding Sienna’s transition from standalone Power BI to Microsoft Fabric.

Security & Governance

• Lead enterprise backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery. Define recovery strategies, validate RTO/RPO objectives, lead recovery testing, and contribute to organizational disaster recovery planning.

• Develop and enforce Azure governance standards, including Azure Policy, management groups, resource organization, tagging strategies, landing zone standards, and cost governance. Continuously optimize cloud consumption through right-sizing, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and Azure Hybrid Benefit while providing executive-level reporting and recommendations.

• Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation solutions using PowerShell and Azure-native tooling to improve consistency, scalability, operational efficiency, and platform reliability. Establish engineering standards, reusable templates, and automation frameworks.

• Partner with Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to implement secure-by-design cloud solutions, lead vulnerability remediation efforts, support regulatory compliance, and strengthen the organization's cloud security posture within a regulated healthcare environment.

• Evaluate emerging Azure technologies and platform capabilities, providing technical recommendations that align with enterprise architecture, business strategy, and cloud modernization objectives.

Platform Enablement

• Serve as the organization's senior Azure subject matter expert, providing technical leadership, architectural guidance, and mentorship to infrastructure and systems administration teams while fostering cloud engineering best practices.

• Lead the development and maintenance of enterprise cloud standards, architecture documentation, operational runbooks, and standard operating procedures to support operational maturity and knowledge transfer.

• Provide technical leadership on enterprise cloud initiatives and strategic transformation projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and support secure, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions.

• Partner with IT leadership to develop and execute the organization's Azure cloud roadmap, contributing to strategic planning, platform modernization, technology evaluation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

## Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer engineering or a related field.

• 8+ years’ progressive infrastructure experience.

• 5+ years’ direct experience of Microsoft Azure Administration in a production environment.

• Demonstrated depth across Azure compute, storage, backup/DR, and networking, including Application Gateway and WAF administration

• Strong Microsoft Entra ID administration experience (conditional access, RBAC, enterprise applications)

• Experience with SCIM-based automated user provisioning/deprovisioning for enterprise applications

• Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, with awareness of privacy obligations (e.g., PHIPA/PIPEDA)

• Experience working with Microsoft Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

We are seeking a Senior Optical Engineer to provide technical leadership for the evaluation, qualification, and lifecycle management of optical technologies used across Ciena's photonic line systems. This role focuses on assessing supplier-driven changes, reviewing technical specifications, leading qualification programs, and ensuring the long-term performance, reliability, and availability of critical optical subsystems.

The successful candidate will possess a strong foundation in optical networking technologies and will become a key technical contributor supporting optical subsystems including Wavelength Selective Switches (WSS), Optical Channel Monitors (OCM), amplifier technologies, and optical transceivers. Working closely with suppliers and cross-functional teams, you will drive technical assessments, qualification strategies, and lifecycle decisions that support Ciena's product portfolio.

The position is based in Ottawa, Ontario.

## Primary Duties & Responsibilities

• Act as the technical owner for optical technologies including: Wavelength Selective Switches (WSS), Optical Channel Monitors (OCM), EDFA and Raman amplifier technologies, Optical transceivers and related photonic subsystems

• Work with internal technology experts and suppliers to evaluate new technologies, review specifications, assess performance, and support product lifecycle decisions.

• Review supplier specifications, qualification reports, reliability data, and technical documentation.

• Lead Product Change Notification (PCN) evaluations and assess the impact of supplier changes on product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and deployed systems.

• Develop qualification strategies, validation plans, and acceptance criteria for new optical technologies, alternate suppliers, and component changes.

• Design and execute laboratory validation activities to characterize optical performance and verify compliance with system requirements.

• Support supplier issue resolution, technology roadmap discussions, and continuous product improvement activities.

• Drive second-source qualification, obsolescence management, and long-term lifecycle planning.

• Analyze field performance data and support root cause investigations involving optical technologies.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, development, and service teams to successfully introduce and support optical technologies throughout the product lifecycle.

• Present technical recommendations, risk assessments, and qualification results to engineering leadership.

## Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience: 8+ years of industry experience in optical networking, photonic systems, optical hardware, or related technologies.

• Strong foundation in optical networking technologies with experience in one or more of the following: Wavelength Selective Switches (WSS), Optical Channel Monitors (OCM), EDFA and Raman amplification technologies, Optical transceivers, DWDM and optical transport systems

• Experience reviewing technical specifications, qualification results, and supplier documentation.

• Experience developing and executing qualification or validation programs.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause investigation skills.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with optical component and subsystem suppliers on qualification, issue resolution, or technology development activities.

• Experience with optical laboratory characterization and performance testing.

• Experience using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for test automation and data analysis.

• Familiarity with reliability engineering, accelerated life testing, and statistical analysis techniques.

Reporting to a Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering, you will work alongside experienced hardware, optical, firmware, reliability, manufacturing, and test engineers responsible for designing, ramping, and sustaining Ciena’s flagship WaveLogic™ optical modems. These products enable data rates of up to 1,600 Gbps and are used by many of the world’s largest telecommunications companies and cloud providers. In this role, you will help improve product yield, support manufacturing ramp, investigate technical issues, and drive hardware, test, or process changes that improve product quality and manufacturability.

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop a deep understanding of WaveLogic optical modems, from product design through manufacturing ramp and volume production. You will gain insight into the processes required to build a high-performance, high-volume product, while making contributions that directly support Ciena’s ability to deliver to customers and grow this flagship product line.

## How You Will Contribute:

In this intermediate engineering role, you will support product ramp and sustaining activities, with a focus on yield improvement through test, design, and process improvements. You will combine manufacturing data analysis with hands-on lab debug and cross-functional execution to identify issues, recommend corrective actions, and help drive them to closure.

• Hands-on lab debug: Perform hardware and optical debug of failed modules to identify root cause, validate hypotheses, and define corrective actions using lab measurements and engineering analysis.

• Yield data analysis: Review large-scale manufacturing and test data to assess design, process, or test changes that improve factory yield. Analyze trends, outliers, and common failure modes, then work with cross-functional teams to define practical corrective actions.

• Change management: Plan, coordinate, validate, and release design, test, or process change orders that support yield improvement, ramp readiness, product quality, and manufacturability.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with hardware, optical, firmware, test, reliability, manufacturing, operations, and supplier-facing teams to drive technical issues to closure.

• Documentation and communication: Summarize data analysis, debug findings, recommendations, validation results, and change plans clearly for technical and program stakeholders.

## The Must Haves:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Engineering Physics, or equivalent.

• 2–5 years of experience in hardware engineering, electrical engineering, optical hardware, telecommunications equipment, networking platforms, manufacturing test, or another complex electronic-product environment.

• Familiarity with product lifecycle stages, including development, qualification, ramp, volume manufacturing, sustaining, field support, or end-of-life.

• Demonstrated proficiency with statistical analysis techniques such as histogram distributions, Q-Q plots, standard deviation, process capability, Cp, Cpk, or related metrics.

• Experience using scripting or programming tools such as Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automation, or engineering debug.

• Ability to work hands-on in a lab environment and interpret electrical, optical, manufacturing, or system-level test results.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to cross-functional engineering and program teams.

## Assets:

• Demonstrated interest in prototyping, embedded hardware, hardware bring-up, or lab-based debug projects.

• Familiarity with coherent optical transceivers, optical modems, DSP-based systems, or high-speed communications hardware.

• Familiarity with high-volume manufacturing, manufacturing test flows, factory yield analysis, or production data systems.

• Experience with optical test equipment, electrical test equipment, automated test platforms, reliability qualification testing, failure analysis, or root-cause corrective action processes.

LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL - Manage, coach, and develop the P2P and O2C team members. - Partner with the Tax & Treasury Specialist to provide accurate, timely inputs (AP/AR timing) for short-term cash flow forecasting. - Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities related to AP/AR, ensuring accurate cutoff. - Identify and lead process improvement and automation initiatives across P2P and O2C workflows. - Maintain and enforce internal controls across both functions. - Report on key operational metrics (DSO, DPO, aging, exception rates) to finance leadership. ## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

You will work at the intersection of embedded engineering and customer support, using your C/C++ and troubleshooting skills to resolve real-world issues, backed by a collaborative team that values clear communication as much as clean code.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Build and optimize multi-threaded and multicore applications, ensuring efficient, reliable performance.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex software and system-level issues.

• Support customer-reported issues by investigating root causes, providing timely resolutions, and communicating findings clearly.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional team members to design, implement, and validate solutions.

• Work with schematics to understand hardware connections and how software interacts with electronic components.

• Contribute to automation, tooling, or scripting tasks using Python where applicable.

## What We’re Looking For

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

## Experience:
Core Requirements:

• 2–4 years of experience in embedded C/C++ software development.

• Solid understanding of multithreaded software design and concurrency concepts

• Strong experience working in Linux-based development environments.

• Willingness to leverage AI tools to automate development and engineering workflows.

• Comfortable working in customer-facing roles and interacting directly with customers.

• Proficiency in object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.

• Strong team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging abilities.

## Skills:

• Experience using operating systems with strong understanding of multithreaded and multicore applications.

• Ability to use a schematic to understand how electronic devices are connected.

• Experience with Python scripting and AI-driven automation.

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $115,000

Welcome! Thank you for your interest in Giatec Scientific Inc. (Giatec)!

Can't find a current open position that truly fits your experience but want to be kept in mind for future opportunities?

Giatec is continually growing and we look forward to adding more talented people across all of our departments. Send us your resume and we'll contact you when the right opportunity opens up and matches your skills and experience.

About Us:

About Giatec: Giatec is a global company revolutionizing the concrete industry by bringing smart testing technologies and real-time collection and analysis of concrete data from production and delivery to placement. Giatec’s suite of hardware & software products has leveraged advanced technologies such as; Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Internet of Things (IoT), including; wireless concrete sensors, mobile apps, and advanced non-destructive technologies (NDT) to drive innovation throughout concrete’s lifecycle and reduce concrete’s carbon footprint. For more information visit https://www.giatecscientific.com/

What it's like to be part of Giatec:

• You'll work with a creative and diverse team who are passionate about what they do.

• You’ll work in an environment where the team members come together, grow, have fun, and make an impact.

• Sustainability is a big focus for Giatec. Our employees all share a passion and commitment of making the world a better place through our innovative products and solutions.

• You'll be part of a team where the Company wants to look out for you today and tomorrow as well. Giatec offers flexible health benefits and a matching program for your retirement savings plan.

• You'll have the opportunity to join a purpose-driven company with lots of opportunities for personal and professional growth.

At Giatec, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to our company, and are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Please contact careers@giatecscientific.com to request specialized accommodation. Do know, all information received in relation to accommodation will be kept confidential.

By subscribing (i.e. providing your resume/ CV which include your personal data information) to Giatec Talent Community, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of the information you have submitted to Giatec as necessary to provide you with information about career opportunities at Giatec and/or company updates.

Join our Student Talent Community! Giatec offers meaningful co-op and internship opportunities in multiple fields from administration to software or hardware development. Our students are actively involved in projects which give them a hands-on experience in their field, helping them to build practical skills. We love having the voice of young talent in the team and believe that we are capable of growing them into great professionals - so much so that we've hired many of them after graduation. Learn about and explore the construction tech industry with us!

We will keep you in mind whenever we have interesting opportunities.

ABOUT GIATEC:

Giatec Scientific Inc. is a global leader in smart concrete testing technologies, bringing real-time data, AI, and IoT solutions to jobsites worldwide. Our core products - SmartRock®, SmartMix®, and MixPilot® - support the full concrete lifecycle, from mix design and production to placement and performance monitoring, helping teams improve quality, efficiency, and sustainability while reducing concrete’s carbon footprint.

Giatec solutions have been used on 15,000+ projects across 85+ countries, and we’ve been recognized as one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies for three consecutive years. We believe our people are key to our success and are always looking for curious, driven individuals to help shape the future of construction technology.

The expected salary range for this role is between $75,000-$115,000. This role represents an existing vacancy within the organization.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

We're looking for an IT Operations Lead who believes great IT is invisible: people get what they need, it just works, and it's secure without getting in anyone's way. You'll lead IT at a fast-moving technology company that is all in on AI, with real room to rethink how we work, automate the repetitive stuff, and build systems our team actually enjoys using.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with 5 to 8 years of IT experience who is ready to own the function, lead and grow a small team, and take initiative without waiting to be asked.

WHO YOU ARE:

- You're an enabler. Your goal is to help people do their best work, and when a request comes in, you look for the secure way to say yes.
- You take security seriously without making it painful. MFA, conditional access and patching are non-negotiable, and you make them feel seamless.
- You take initiative. When something is broken or manual, you fix it or automate it before anyone has to file a ticket.
- You're a team player who brings good energy. You're approachable, patient with non-technical colleagues, and you enjoy a good laugh at work.
- You're curious about AI and already use it to work smarter.

IN YOUR FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL:

- Get to know the team and our systems, and become the trusted go-to person for IT
- Ship at least one automation that saves the team real time every week
- Test our disaster recovery plan end to end and close the gaps you find
- Set a clear IT roadmap that balances security, cost and a great employee experience

About Bedrock

Bedrock is Giatec's dedicated Support & Ops team, the foundation the solutions stand on. Bedrock keeps production healthy across every product, drives system improvements and tech debt reduction, closes the continuous delivery automation gap, owns engineering escalations from our customer experience team, and runs cross-product regression. It is a small, high-trust, high-visibility team operating on continuous flow while the rest of engineering runs on two-week cycles.

We are hiring the permanent operating lead for Bedrock. This is a hands-on, player-coach engineering leadership role. You will own the day-to-day health of the platform, set the standard for how we operate, and build the AI systems that let a small team support a large product portfolio. This is an AI-heavy engineering role: we expect you to design, deploy, and supervise agents that assist with support, auto-remediate recurring issues, and resolve bugs.

What You Will Do

• Build the AI support layer. Design, deploy, and supervise AI agents that triage incoming issues, draft and execute fixes, and auto-remediate recurring production problems. You will build the agentic workflows that let Bedrock resolve more with less.

• Fix bugs with agents. Use AI agents to investigate and resolve bugs end to end, from reproduction to fix to verification, escalating only what genuinely needs deep product knowledge or architectural judgment.

• Own escalations. Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 engineering support. Take escalations from the customer experience team, diagnose product-specific and cross-product issues, deploy fixes, and serve as the escalation point for complex production incidents that span team boundaries.

• Keep production healthy. Monitor application and infrastructure health across all Giatec 360 products. Maintain dashboards, alerting thresholds, and runbooks, and catch anomalies before they become customer-facing incidents.

• Lead on-call. Carry and lead an alternating-week on-call rotation supporting Giatec customers worldwide. During your on-call week you are the point of contact 24/7, including nights, weekends, and holidays, followed by a week off rotation. You will define the rotation, mature the runbooks, and set the incident response standard. This is a core, ongoing requirement of the role.

• Automate delivery. Close gaps in the CI/CD pipeline. Automate manual deployment steps, environment provisioning, and the regression infrastructure that runs on every pull request, in collaboration with DevSecOps.

• Guard the platform. Run the end-of-cycle cross-product automated regression sweep to catch breaks in shared platform behavior such as login, navigation, shared data, and AI support accuracy.

• Coach the team. Mentor and lead a rotating team. You will onboard each rotation, set them up to contribute quickly, and make the assignment a genuine growth experience.

• Champion quality. Represent production reality in the Quality Guild, bringing firsthand insight on what breaks, what customers report, and where quality investment is most needed.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on production support, site reliability, or operations work on a live product.

• Demonstrated experience building with AI agents and LLM-based tooling. You have used agentic coding tools to ship real work, and you have a point of view on where agents help and where they need human supervision.

• Strong debugging skills across the stack, from web applications and APIs to data pipelines and integrations. You are comfortable diving into code you did not write.

• Solid grounding in monitoring and observability, incident response, and CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• A production-minded, ownership-driven mindset. You have a strong sense of urgency, you respect deployment risk, and you close the loop rather than just routing tickets.

• Clear written communication. You write runbooks, handoff notes, and customer-facing updates that other people can actually use.

• Willingness and availability to lead an on-call rotation on an every-other-week basis, with full 24/7 coverage during your assigned weeks, supporting a global customer base.

Why This Role

Bedrock is positioned as a selective, high-trust assignment, and its lead is one of the most visible engineering roles in the company. You will be trusted with the production health of the entire Giatec 360 platform, you will build breadth across every product and integration we ship, and you will define how an AI-native support and operations function actually works. This is a rare chance to build an AI-heavy support engineering practice from the foundation up, and to have real impact on reliability, delivery speed, and the day-to-day experience of every Giatec customer.

Giatec Scientific Inc. is looking for a Customer Success and Solutions Specialist to join the team behind MixPilot, our IoT hardware platform for the ready mix concrete industry. You will be the person our customers count on to get their hardware deployed, keep it healthy, and make sure their voice is heard inside Giatec.

This is a customer success role with a hardware dimension, not an engineering role. You do not need an engineering degree or years of electronics experience. If you have strong people skills, you are organized, and you have some hands-on exposure to hardware in any form, whether that is IT support, field equipment, telecom gear, lab devices, or tinkering with electronics as a hobby, we want to hear from you. We will teach you our technology; what we cannot teach is a genuine customer-first mindset and curiosity about how things work.

Giatec operates with an AI-first mindset, and you will use AI tools daily to accelerate reporting, analysis, and communication. If you are already using tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot in your work, you will feel right at home.

Please note: this role requires regular travel to customer sites in the United States and Canada. Candidates must be authorized to travel to the United States upon hire, without the need for visa sponsorship or pre-employment immigration processing, and must be able to work in a hybrid arrangement from our Ottawa, ON headquarters.

WHY JOIN GIATEC?

• Play a central role in deploying MixPilot, Giatec's hardware platform for the ready mix industry, alongside the broader Giatec portfolio as the team scales.

• Work with a creative, driven team passionate about reducing the carbon footprint of concrete and reshaping the construction industry.

• Join a purpose-driven company recognized as one of the fastest-growing in Canada for three consecutive years.

• Competitive compensation, flexible health benefits, and a matching retirement savings program.

• Structured onboarding and hands-on training on our hardware, tools, and industry. You will not be expected to know concrete or IoT on day one.

• Significant opportunity for personal and professional growth as the Customer and Engineering Success team scales.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Customer Success and Field Engagement

• Build trusted relationships with plant managers, QC engineers, dispatch teams, and operations leads at customer sites, and act as their advocate inside Giatec.

• Serve as the main operational point of contact for customers rolling out or actively using MixPilot hardware, keeping them informed, unblocked, and successful.

• Conduct on-site visits across the United States and Canada to support installations, check system health, and lead customer training sessions.

• Turn field observations and customer feedback into actionable input for the Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.

Hardware Rollouts and Support

• Coordinate MixPilot hardware rollouts across customer accounts in North America, tracking milestones, removing blockers, and escalating risks before they affect the customer.

• Perform first-line troubleshooting of field hardware such as gateways, sensors, and accessories, and determine whether a device can be fixed on site or needs to come back for repair. Full training on our products is provided.

• Maintain a clear, current view of every active rollout and account in Salesforce, with consolidated visibility for leadership and cross-functional teams.

Inventory and Capacity Planning

• Own the hardware inventory picture, including receiving, counting, and reconciling stock, tracking units by serial number, and managing the returns process with the Hardware team.

• Keep an eye on demand versus available stock as the customer base scales, and work with Supply Chain, Operations, and Product to prevent shortages that would delay customer rollouts.

• Build simple dashboards and reports that show leadership how capacity, demand, and deployments are trending.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement

• Centralize hardware-related issues from the field, the support team, and customer channels into one structured tracking view.

• Compile weekly and monthly summaries on rollout status, hardware performance, and customer pain points, and translate the data into clear recommendations.

• Use AI tools to draft communications, synthesize site visit notes, speed up reporting, and spot patterns across accounts.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

Required

• Two or more years of professional experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer success, customer support, account management, field service, technical support, or operations coordination.

• Hands-on exposure to physical hardware or electronic devices in some form. This can come from IT or technical support, field service, telecom, lab equipment, or manufacturing. You should be comfortable opening up a device, know roughly what components like connectors, batteries, sensors, resistors, and capacitors are, and enjoy troubleshooting.

• A strong customer service mindset, with the ability to build trust with operational stakeholders and stay calm and constructive when things go wrong.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.

• Strong organizational skills, with experience keeping structured records and producing clear reports or summaries.

• Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot as part of daily work, or a demonstrated eagerness to build that habit quickly.

• A Bachelor's degree or college diploma in engineering, technology, business, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Authorization to travel to the United States immediately upon hire, without the need for visa sponsorship or pre-employment immigration processing. This is a firm requirement for the role.

• Ability to work in a hybrid arrangement from the Ottawa, ON region.
