• Experience diagnosing electronics with tools such as a multimeter, or a background as an electronics or instrumentation technician.

• Experience with IoT devices, hardware deployment, or physical inventory management, including stock counts and SKU or serial-number tracking.

• Proficiency with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce, and tools such as Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Excel.

• Experience in construction, ready mix concrete, manufacturing, or industrial operations.

The Senior Technical Support Engineer (T3) is the highest tier of our support organization, serving as a bridge between customer support and engineering. You will own the most complex, ambiguous technical escalations that our T1 and T2 teams cannot resolve - including issues that previously required involvement from the Engineering Run Team. As the most senior member of the support team, you’ll also be its on-the-floor leader. You’ll make judgment calls, coach T1/T2 through tough situations, and help build this new tier from the ground up. THE ROLE As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will serve as the final escalation point within the support organization. You bring a software development background and deep technical instincts to diagnose root causes, reproduce edge cases, write or read code to understand issues at depth, and work directly with the Engineering team to drive resolution. This is not a traditional support role - you will spend a significant portion of your time doing technical investigation work that sits at the boundary of support and engineering. This role requires participation on a on-call rotation including weekends and holidays. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the most complex technical escalations from T1 and T2, serving as the final line of defense. - Investigate and reproduce customer-reported bugs, data inconsistencies, and integration failures across Rewind's supported platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and more) - Read and write code (primarily in the context of debugging and scripting) to diagnose issues, test hypotheses, and validate fixes - Work directly with Engineering to clearly articulate bugs, provide reproducible test cases, and track fixes through to resolution - Manage and resolve issues in customer environments involving API integrations, OAuth configurations, webhook failures, and platform-level permissions - Handle data restoration requests and complex recovery scenarios requiring deep knowledge of Rewind's backup architecture - Give direct, constructive feedback to T1/T2 team members when an escalation or error needs a course correction - Lead blameless postmortems that separate process gaps from individual coaching needs, and recommend clear options (training, process changes, guardrails) - Mentor and upskill T1/T2 through pairing, lunch-and-learns and escalation reviews, and set the bar for what a well-prepared escalation looks like - Help define the processes, SLAs and ways of working for Rewind’s new Enterprise Support tier as we build it from scratch - Own enterprise customer onboarding when required, including installation, deployment, and education, ensuring the customer is fully set up for success - Help build and maintain the internal knowledge base for complex issue patterns, enabling T1/T2 to self-serve future resolutions - Participate in on-call rotations for P1 incidents affecting enterprise customers - Identify recurring escalation patterns and proactively surface product improvement opportunities to Engineering and Product WHAT YOU BRING Required - 5+ years of experience in a technical support, solutions engineering, or software development role - Demonstrated informal leadership: you’ve mentored teammates, given peer feedback, or acted as the go-to senior person on a support or engineering team - Computer Science degree or equivalent practical experience (you can read and write code) - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Ruby, JavaScript, or similar) - Strong understanding of REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and modern SaaS integration patterns - Experience with cloud platforms and SaaS ecosystems (Atlassian, GitHub, Shopify, or similar) - AWS - CloudWatch for logs, OpenSearch/Kibana for search infrastructure, SQS/SNS for async processing - Ability to read logs, inspect API responses, and debug issues at the network and application layers - ## Who we’re looking for:

We are looking for a talented Manager, SMB Sales to lead a newly created Rogers Point of Sale Centre of Excellence within Rogers Business. This leader will lead and manage a team of Point of Sale Growth Specialists focused on accelerating adoption of Rogers Point of Sale solutions across the Small and Medium Business organization. We’re seeking someone with deep experience in payment processing, merchant services or financial technology, combined with strong sales leadership, coaching, funnel management and cross-functional execution. An entrepreneurial spirit, customer-focused mindset and ability to lead through influence will be key to making your mark on this growing portfolio.

• Create a high-performance culture centered on customer outcomes, collaboration and disciplined execution.

• Own national Rogers Point of Sale activation, conversion, product penetration, pipeline health and customer-experience objectives, with clear targets and regular performance reporting.

• Develop strategies that grow adoption across the full SMB sales portfolio while minimizing internal channel conflict.

• Oversee lead routing, establish service-level expectations for initial response and follow-up, monitor conversion performance and continuously improve the handling of Rogers.com and marketing-generated leads.

• Establish weekly pipeline inspection, forecasting and deal-review rhythms.

• Partner with Sales, Product, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Compensation and payment partners to remove barriers and improve execution.

• Seven or more years of progressive experience in payment processing, merchant acquiring, merchant services, financial technology, point-of-sale solutions or a closely related industry.

• Experience managing sales funnels, forecasts, conversion performance and operating rhythms.

• Strong coaching, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

• Previous experience developing engaging digital content.

• Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to deliver results independently or as part of a team.

• Ability to meet deadlines and manage project deliverables.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to stay current with GTM-Ex intakes, product launches, offer changes, and shifting business priorities while ensuring timely and accurate updates across enablement platforms and tools.

• Ability to tailor and promote learning solutions based on audience needs.

• Knowledge of business telecommunications products, tools, and systems.

• Telecommunications knowledge within wireless, wireline, data, and cable technologies is considered an asset.

• Experience maintaining structured data sources, trackers, offer grids, and sales enablement tools, with a high level of attention to detail and strong validation skills to ensure offer details, pricing information, eligibility criteria, codes, dates, and other sales-critical data remain accurate and up to date across multiple systems and formats.

Specialists will manage their own opportunities from discovery through activation, maintain a consistent in-market presence with merchants and local business networks, and collaborate with direct sellers on deals that benefit from deeper payments expertise. ## Convert Inbound Demand

• Engage assigned digital and marketing-generated opportunities quickly and professionally.

• Conduct discovery to understand the merchant business, current payment environment, operational needs and growth goals.

• Maintain complete, accurate and timely opportunity records and next steps.

## Partner with SMB Sellers

• Support direct sellers with discovery, qualification, customer presentations, demonstrations, statement reviews and objection handling while maintaining clearly documented ownership, handoffs and next steps.

• Join qualified customer conversations as the payments expert while reinforcing the direct seller as the relationship owner.

• Help sellers identify RPoS opportunities within new and existing customer conversations.

• Provide clear deal guidance, next steps and ownership at each stage of an assisted opportunity.

## Deliver Payments Expertise

• Explain payment processing, merchant acquiring, pricing considerations and POS capabilities in clear business language.

• Assess competitive scenarios and help customers evaluate the operational and commercial value of changing providers.

• Set accurate expectations regarding application, compliance, credit review, order submission, installation and activation.

• Stay current on payments trends, competitor offerings and relevant merchant needs.

## Build Sales Capability

• Lead office hours, deal clinics, demonstrations and short coaching sessions for SMB sellers.

• Share repeatable talk tracks, success stories, competitive insights and lessons from the field.

• Provide feedback to leadership and cross-functional partners on recurring customer, process and product barriers.

## What You Bring

## Required Qualifications

• Experience selling payment processing, merchant services, financial technology or point-of-sale solutions.

• Demonstrated consultative selling and opportunity-management skills.

• Experience engaging business owners and senior decision-makers.

• Ability to explain payment concepts, pricing and operational value in clear customer language.

• Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation and objection-handling skills.

• Collaborative working style and comfort operating in an assisted-selling model.

• Strong CRM discipline, organization and follow-through.

## Preferred Experience

• Experience reviewing merchant statements or supporting competitive payment-provider takeouts.

• Experience selling to restaurant, retail, hospitality, professional services, or health and wellness merchants.

## How Success Will Be Measured

• Activation and conversion performance for assigned inbound opportunities.

• Assisted activations and measurable contribution to field-led opportunities.

• Pipeline accuracy and completeness, follow-up discipline, speed to initial customer engagement and progression of qualified opportunities through defined sales stages.

• Growth in seller confidence, participation and repeat selling within the supported portfolio.

• Customer experience and effective collaboration with direct sellers and partners.

## Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is suited to a payments professional who enjoys both closing business and helping others win. The strongest candidates will be curious, financially confident, customer-focused and comfortable moving between independent ownership and team selling. They will view the success of the full SMB portfolio as a shared outcome.

## Project Manager, Business Modernization

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

About the role
Are you a strategic thinker who thrives on turning ideas into action? The Project Manager, Unclaimed Properties Office (UPO) Modernization plays a key role in shaping the future of the UPO by leading the planning, coordination and implementation of a portfolio of initiatives focused on process improvement, operational effectiveness, governance enhancement, data and reporting, service delivery, and business readiness.

What you will do
Working closely with business leaders, subject matter experts, and partner departments, you will translate operational improvement opportunities and strategic priorities into actionable plans that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will act as a catalyst for change, ensuring initiatives are delivered effectively while maintaining stakeholder engagement, minimizing operational disruption, and supporting long-term organizational success.

More specifically, you will:

• Lead the planning, coordination, and implementation of complex business and operational improvement initiatives.

• Develop and manage project charters, implementation roadmaps, project plans, schedules, and resource requirements.

• Monitor project progress, milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies to ensure successful outcomes.

• Establish and maintain effective governance and reporting structures.

• Prepare executive briefings, status reports, presentations, and decision-support materials for leadership.

• Facilitate workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder meetings to drive alignment and informed decision-making.

• Coordinate cross-functional activities across multiple business units and partner departments.

• Identify and resolve project issues, risks, and implementation barriers.

• Support change management and business readiness activities to ensure successful adoption of new processes and ways of working.

• Champion Lean and continuous improvement practices to enhance operational efficiency and service delivery.

• Capture lessons learned, promote knowledge sharing and best practices across projects, and embed these insights to adapt and improve practices as the project evolves.

What you need to succeed
You are a strategic and highly organized project professional with a proven track record of leading complex initiatives and collaborating effectively with diverse stakeholders. You bring strong expertise in project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and implementation practices, enabling you to translate strategic objectives into actionable plans and measurable results. About the Supervision Department and the Stablecoin Mandate
A stablecoin is a digital asset designed to maintain a stable value relative to an underlying asset, such as those that are pegged to a reference fiat currency (e.g., CAD). Stablecoins are currently primarily used when trading cryptocurrencies but as the payments landscape in Canada and globally evolves stablecoins are introducing innovative ways for consumers and businesses to make payments. Following Royal Assent of the Stablecoin Act, the Bank of Canada will be responsible for regulating and supervising stablecoin issuers and payment service providers using stablecoins. This includes setting and enforcing expectations related to:

• reserve asset management

• redemption

• operational and technology risk.

The Payments and Regulatory Oversight Department is leading the Bank’s preparation for this new mandate, building on the foundation established under the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA).

This position will support the Visitor Services team by delivering onsite and virtual programs as well as assisting with the development of educational programs and resources for schools which is a key initiative of the Museum.

About the Supervision Department
The payments landscape in Canada and globally is evolving rapidly, driven by technological advancements that are introducing innovative ways for consumers and businesses to make payments. Under the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), the Bank of Canada is responsible for registering retail payment service providers (PSPs) that perform retail payment activities, maintaining a public registry of PSPs, and supervising PSPs’ compliance with operational risk management, fund safeguarding and reporting requirements.

The Bank assesses whether PSPs are managing risks effectively, identifies areas for improvement, and promotes compliance through a range of supervisory, compliance and enforcement tools. These positions will support the ongoing implementation and continuous improvement of the Retail Payments Supervisory Framework.

What you will do
As a Supervisor within Retail Payments Supervision, you will contribute to fulfilling the Bank’s regulatory mandate by supporting work across one or more areas of Registration, Risk Supervision and Enforcement. You will apply supervisory judgment, strong analysis and sound recommendations to help implement the Bank’s legislative and regulatory authorities under the RPAA.

Depending on the area of focus, you may assess registration applications and scope questions, evaluate PSPs’ operational risk and fund safeguarding practices, review PSP reporting and incidents, investigate potential non-compliance, or support the use of appropriate supervisory, compliance and enforcement tools. You will also contribute to policies, procedures, guidance, training materials and process improvements that strengthen the Bank’s approach to supervising PSPs.

• Apply technical expertise and knowledge of supervisory concepts, principles, practices and methodologies aligned to the Bank’s Supervisory Framework.

• Analyze complex information, identify issues and trends, and develop recommendations for Senior Supervisors, Principal Supervisors, Directors and Executives.

• Collaborate with colleagues and internal or external partners to support registration, supervision, compliance and enforcement activities.

• Contribute to business documentation, operational policies, procedures, guidance, training materials and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you need
As an innovative and self-motivated problem solver, you can understand, interpret and analyze complex information and issues, exercise sound judgment, and provide clear recommendations. You communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a broad range of audiences. You are equally comfortable working collaboratively within a team or independently, and you bring strong attention to detail while working under tight timelines.

You have the desire to build the knowledge of the broader financial system, the retail payments ecosystem, retail payment service providers, and the role of regulation and supervision in maintaining a well-functioning system. You are flexible, adaptable and able to align your actions with the needs, priorities and goals of a new and evolving mandate.

## What you need to succeed

• Experience interpreting and applying legislation, regulations, guidance, policies or supervisory frameworks.

• Experience conducting analysis, identifying discrepancies or trends, synthesizing information, and recommending practical solutions.

• Experience in one or more of registration, risk management, compliance, enforcement, audit, assurance, controls review, or financial sector supervision.

• Ability to work within ambiguity, manage changing priorities and produce high-quality analysis and documentation.

## Nice to have

• Knowledge of, or experience with, supervisory frameworks that include registration, risk supervision, compliance or enforcement regimes.

• Experience with administrative law regimes or working with or for a regulator, PSP, financial institution, fintech or paytech.

• Experience in operational or cyber risk management, fund safeguarding, client asset protection, trust or custodial account oversight, audit, assurance, controls review, compliance or enforcement.

• Experience working with data sets, reporting, data visualization or business documentation.

• A background or designation in law, finance, accounting, economics, business administration, risk, audit, compliance or enforcement.

• Interest in supervisory technology, including artificial intelligence to support efficient supervisory practices

## Job Description

Location: Northern Virginia / Dulles, VA area
Security Requirement: Active TS/SCI with Full-Scope Polygraph required prior to hire
Work Authorization: U.S. work authorization required; no visa sponsorship available

## Lead the Technology. Own the Customer. Solve the Hard Problems.

Avaya is looking for a Senior Technical Account Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for a critical BAE Systems AP2 environment in Northern Virginia.

This is not a traditional Tier 3 support role. You will be the customer's trusted technical advisor and the senior engineering authority for the account—owning complex technical issues, leading high-priority escalations, strengthening technical governance, and providing hands-on technical leadership across a sophisticated enterprise communications environment.

You will work directly with BAE customer stakeholders while leading and mentoring the engineers supporting the account. You'll be expected to understand the environment end-to-end, diagnose complex problems across Avaya communications platforms, SIP, call flows, network infrastructure, Cisco, Linux, Active Directory, and integrated third-party applications/CPE, and bring the right Avaya resources together to drive issues through resolution.

The role is ideal for an experienced systems, communications, voice, network, or technical support engineer who enjoys being the person customers rely on when the problem is complex, the environment is mission-critical, and the solution requires both deep technical expertise and strong leadership.

## What You'll Own

## Be the Technical Authority for the Account

• Serve as the primary technical SME and customer-facing engineering leader for the BAE AP2 account.

• Develop trusted relationships with customer engineering, IT, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders.

• Understand the customer's technical environment, dependencies, priorities, and risks.

• Act as the senior technical point of contact for complex issues and customer concerns.

• Translate customer requirements and technical challenges into actionable plans for Avaya teams.

• Participate in technical governance and customer meetings, providing status, risk assessments, recommendations, and technical direction.

## Solve Complex Enterprise Communications Problems

This role requires someone who can go beyond individual product troubleshooting and understand how an enterprise environment works as a whole.

You will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues involving:

• Avaya Aura and enterprise communications platforms

• Aura Releases 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10

• SIP and SIP signaling

• Call flows and call-flow troubleshooting

• G650

• Network infrastructure and routing

• Cisco environments

• DNS / DHCP

• LDAP / Active Directory

• Linux

• ServiceNow

• Third-party applications and customer-premises equipment (CPE)

You will perform both Break/Fix troubleshooting and implementation consulting, working across technology layers to isolate root cause and determine the appropriate path to resolution.

## Lead Critical Escalations

• Own high-priority and complex technical escalations from initial assessment through resolution.

• Lead troubleshooting efforts during critical customer-impacting incidents.

• Coordinate Engineering, Product, Support, and other Avaya resources as required.

• Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action.

• Maintain clear and proactive communication with customer stakeholders throughout an escalation.

• Identify recurring issues and proactively address technical risks before they become major customer-impacting events.

## Lead and Mentor the Engineering Team

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the two engineers currently supporting the account.

• Serve as their senior technical escalation point.

• Guide engineers through complex troubleshooting and customer issues.

• Establish technical standards, best practices, and operating procedures.

• Help strengthen the team's technical capabilities and ensure appropriate coverage for the customer environment.

• Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

## Strengthen Technical Governance

• Bring greater technical rigor and operational discipline to the customer relationship.

• Partner with account leadership to identify technical risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Ensure technical commitments and action items are clearly defined, tracked, and communicated.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, escalation processes, and knowledge resources.

• Help ensure the customer's technical priorities remain aligned across Avaya organizations.

## ## What We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical capability with customer leadership.

## Required

• 8+ years of experience in systems engineering, communications engineering, network engineering, technical support, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Hands-on experience supporting Avaya Aura environments.

• Strong SIP knowledge and troubleshooting experience.

## ## Role Overview

As the Senior Manager for Global Revenue Accounting (GRA) and Pune Site Lead, you will serve as a vital Finance Partner driving ASC 606 compliance and site operations. In this dual-capacity leadership role, you will act as the primary operational link between Avaya and key external partners, such as Wipro, to navigate daily activities seamlessly.

Maintaining strong, grounded leadership in Pune is critical to team stability, talent retention, and operational continuity. You will manage a large team of 40+ direct and third-party vendor resources, ensuring high accuracy in monthly, quarterly, and annual statutory closures, balance sheet reconciliations, and SOX control execution.

• Team & Vendor Operations: Manage, mentor, and scale a 40+ person hybrid team comprising internal staff and third-party vendor resources (e.g., Wipro).

• Mindset: Strong time management under tight close-calendar conditions, logical problem-solving, and a "finisher" orientation.

## Position Overview:

As our Thermal Hydraulic Core Design Engineer, you will contribute to a variety of projects in a collaborative team environment, performing thermal analysis of advanced core designs that include a variety of fuel systems, cycle, and coolant types. The Engineer will work within the core design team, interacting with neutronic core design, fuel performance, mechanical, and systems engineers. Depending on the candidate’s qualifications, the role may involve supporting the development of core thermal modeling, simulation, and optimization tools.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Thermal Hydraulic Core Design Engineer:

• Perform thermal analysis of advanced core designs that include a variety of fuel systems, cycle, and coolant types.

• Control a broad scope of studies, from preconceptual through reference design.

• Perform a range of core thermal analysis from quick scoping to design quality.

• Support the development of core thermal modeling, simulation, and optimization.

• Interact with neutronic core design, fuel performance, mechanical, and system engineers.

• Work in a core design team contributing to a variety of projects.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of four (4) years of related experience is required.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• Must be able to learn a variety of new procedures, processes and tools while maintaining various stages of production.

• Must possess understanding of design control and configuration control concepts and project engineering activities (task plans, schedules).

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, which may be required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in nuclear or mechanical engineering with a focus on thermal hydraulics.

• Prior experience with verification and validation of thermal analysis tools.

• Familiarity with physics tools such as Ansys, Relap5-3D, and Flownex.

• Knowledge of programming languages such as FORTRAN, Python, C, and C++.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Position Overview:

The Licensing Director serves as the senior regulatory leader responsible for shaping and driving the licensing strategy for Advanced Technologies. This role provides oversight of all licensing activities, ensuring alignment with U.S. nuclear regulatory requirements and corporate objectives. The Licensing Director provides guidance through complex technical, safety, and regulatory challenges; leads strategic engagement with regulatory authorities, customers, and key partners. This position requires exceptional leadership in cross‑functional environments and the ability to influence organizational direction in support of critical program and business outcomes.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, Virginia.

## Your Day to Day as a Director, Licensing:

• Provide strategic leadership in developing and executing comprehensive licensing plans for advanced reactor technology within the U.S. commercial regulatory framework, guiding organizational direction across nuclear safety, security, emergency planning, reactor design, code development, financial and environmental law, and safeguards.

• Oversee and direct the creation of high-quality regulatory deliverables, including technical reports, topical reports, and license application content to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and regulatory expectations.

• Define and drive regulatory strategy to address major technical and programmatic challenges associated with BWXT AT’s reactor technology development, leading cross functional efforts to resolve complex issues.

• Serve as the executive owner of the licensing basis for one or more reactor technologies, providing leadership in regulatory defense and customer engagement.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to develop technical design bases and integrate regulatory requirements into reactor technology.

• Support the creation of testing programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Lead high level regulatory discussions on technical and programmatic matters, representing the program in strategic interactions with regulators, customers, and key partners.

• Collaborate with project management teams to develop budgets and schedules that achieve regulatory outcomes.

• Facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders concerning the execution of licensing activities and program plans.

• Perform additional organizational leadership duties as needed to advance program and business objectives.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in an engineering or physics discipline is required (i.e. nuclear, mechanical, civil, environmental engineering, or a related field).

• At least twenty (20) years in management or a supervisory role is required.

• A minimum of ten (10) years of experience in nuclear licensing and regulatory matters within a U.S. framework (NRC or DOE) is required.

• Must have demonstrated experience leading the design, evaluation, and technological development of nuclear systems, with a proven ability to guide complex technical programs at an organizational level.

• Must demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, accurately, and timely in both written and verbal formats.

• Must have a proven track record of building and sustaining effective relationships with high level internal and external stakeholders, fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and organizations.

• Must have exceptional interpersonal skills necessary to manage simultaneous licensing activities across various stakeholders.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) and/or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced engineering degree is preferred (M.S. or higher).

• Subject matter expertise in one or more areas (e.g., safety analysis, ASME code implementation, radiation safety) is preferred.

• Experience leading and managing teams within regulatory/licensing or engineering environments is preferred.

• Experience specific to advanced reactor and new nuclear project licensing is preferred.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

## Position Overview:

The Rotordynamics Development and Testing Engineer will spearhead engineering process innovation and rigorous testing activities to support the manufacturing of gas centrifuges for UF6 enrichment. This role demands a proven background in rotordynamics and dynamic testing, coupled with expertise in signal processing and software development. The ideal candidate will adeptly follow established engineering protocols while driving new methodologies for enhanced centrifuge design and production.

## Location:

Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

## Your day to day as a Rotordynamics Development and Testing Engineer:

• Serve as the resident expert on rotordynamics, leveraging current methodologies and developing avant-garde techniques to optimize centrifuge manufacturing and design processes.

• Champion both experimental investigations and model-based simulations to resolve complex rotordynamics challenges, ensuring design robustness and operational efficiency.

• Architect and guide the construction of advanced test systems, encompassing state-of-the-art data acquisition, digital signal processing architectures, and high-speed signal analysis to capture critical performance metrics.

• Lead initiatives in dynamic testing for system balancing, utilizing a spectrum of techniques — from traditional influence coefficient methods to comprehensive experimental modal analysis and innovative hybrid approaches.

• Independently execute sophisticated engineering projects, making informed decisions that reflect a deep understanding of underlying principles and industry best practices.

• Prepare, document, and present both routine and in-depth engineering reports, ensuring clear communication of testing protocols, results, and recommendations to key stakeholders.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering with 6 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering with 3 years of targeted industry experience, or a Doctor of Philosophy degree in Mechanical Engineering.

• Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas:
• Rotordynamics and associated problem-solving techniques

• Dynamic testing methodologies in high-speed systems

• Advanced digital signal processing (DSP) methods

• Software development using languages and tools such as Python, C++, MATLAB, etc.

• Finite Element Analysis (FEA) using platforms like ANSYS

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy ‘Q’ clearance.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degrees (Master of Science or higher) in Mechanical Engineering are highly desirable.

• Candidates with extensive hands-on experience in the field and a proven track record of leading complex engineering projects will be favored.

• Possession of an active DOE Q Clearance is an added advantage.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Join Check Point’s  Workspace Security Group , the business unit behind our award-winning email and collaboration security platform protecting millions of users around the world. As an  SDR within the Workspace Security Group , you will play a critical role in educating prospects on Check Point’s Workspace Security portfolio—including email security, collaboration security, SaaS protection, and data leakage prevention.  Your responsibilities will include:   Engaging with inbound prospects requesting demos, quotes, trials, and information on our Workspace Security solutions. Maintaining a daily outbound call volume of 50–70 calls.  Setting highly qualified demonstrations for Field Sales that convert into pipeline opportunities.  Performing outbound prospecting to marketing-generated leads as well as cold outreach to net-new accounts.  Tracking opportunities and follow-up activities in detail to ensure excellent prospect experience and progression.  Conducting pain discovery and delivering initial demos to prospects evaluating our award-winning Workspace Security platform.  Consistently increasing the volume and quality of opportunities in your territory pipeline. The Verticals Solution Architect serves as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers across Public Sector, Telecommunications, and other key industry verticals. This role is responsible for designing and positioning comprehensive cybersecurity solutions, driving adoption of new technologies, supporting large-scale customer initiatives, and enabling successful business outcomes through technical leadership and architectural expertise.  The Verticals Solution Architect partners closely with sales teams, customers, product management, professional services, support, and executive stakeholders to provide solution guidance throughout the customer lifecycle. The individual will leverage deep expertise in cybersecurity, networking, cloud, and emerging technologies to address complex customer challenges and drive successful project outcomes.      Key Responsibilities    Provide architectural design, solution recommendations, and establish project success criteria for strategic customer engagements.  Design end-to-end security solutions that align with customer business, security, operational, and regulatory requirements.  Serve as the technical lead for complex customer opportunities and strategic initiatives across assigned vertical markets.  Drive adoption of emerging technologies and lead Early Availability (EA) and Proof of Concept (PoC) programs within customer environments.  Partner with sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance opportunities through the sales cycle.  Manage technical escalations associated with major customer projects in conjunction with Solutions Center, Professional Services, Product Management, and Support organizations.  Lead technical workshops, executive briefings, architecture reviews, and customer presentations.  Assist customers with security transformation initiatives involving cloud, network, application, data center, and hybrid architectures.  Act as a trusted advisor for industry-specific security challenges, including government compliance requirements, critical infrastructure protection, and telecommunications security architectures.  Support successful closure of at least 15 strategic customer projects valued at $500,000 or greater annually.  Provide field feedback to product management and engineering teams regarding customer requirements, competitive trends, and market opportunities.  Mentor sales engineers and other technical personnel within the organization.  Represent the company at industry events, customer forums, conferences, and partner engagements.     10+ years of engineering, cybersecurity, architecture, or pre-sales experience within enterprise, public sector, telecommunications, or large-scale commercial environments.  Proven ability to architect and position complex cybersecurity solutions for large and highly regulated organizations.  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.  Extensive knowledge of enterprise networking, routing, switching, security architectures, and hybrid IT environments.  Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).  Strong understanding of virtualization, containers, cloud-native architectures, and modern application environments.  Experience managing complex customer engagements involving multiple stakeholders and project teams.  Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to engage executive and technical audiences.  Ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and measurable customer outcomes.  Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.       Preferred Qualifications    Direct experience with Check Point technologies, platforms, and security solutions.  Check Point certifications (CCSA, CCSE, CCSM, CCTA, or equivalent).  Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCNP, CCIE, AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, or similar.  Experience supporting Public Sector customers, including Federal, State, Local Government, Education (SLED), or Defense organizations.  Knowledge of government security and compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST, FISMA, CJIS, CMMC, and Zero Trust architectures.  Experience supporting telecommunications service providers and large-scale carrier environments.  Understanding of 4G/LTE, 5G network architectures, GTP protocols, mobile core security, and network function virtualization (NFV).  Experience with SaaS, SASE, Zero Trust, AI security, cloud security, and security operations solutions.       Success Measures   The Verticals Solution Architect will be measured by:   Strategic influence on revenue and pipeline growth.  Successful closure of 15 or more customer projects valued at $500,000+ annually.  Customer satisfaction and project success outcomes.  Adoption of new technologies and participation in Early Availability programs.  Technical leadership and contribution to key strategic accounts.  Quality of architectural guidance and customer solution designs.  Cross-functional collaboration and support of sales, engineering, and customer success initiatives.       Travel Requirements    Ability to travel up to  50% , depending on customer and business requirements. Check Point Software Technologies is a global leader in cyber security solutions, dedicated to protecting corporate enterprises and governments worldwide. For over 30 years, our mission has been to secure the digital world for everyone, everywhere. From pioneering stateful firewalls to our AI-powered, cloud-delivered security solutions, we are committed to safeguarding organizations with an industry-leading 99.9% prevention rate.   About the Program  The Check Point Customer Success Program provides a select group of customers with access to headquarter-level resources focused on environment stabilization, process improvement, and long-term operational excellence. As part of this program, Customer Success Managers (CSMs) work closely with strategic customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless coordination, executive visibility, and a proactive approach to customer success.      Key Responsibilities   You will be responsible for:  · Proactively engaging with customers and collaborating with assigned Check Point account teams to coordinate efforts, align resources, and support ongoing challenges and projects.  · Owning the recovery project plan, serving as the single point of contact for all remediation activities.  · Driving rapid and effective escalations, ensuring timely assistance and resolution.  · Coordinating onsite and remote support, based on customer needs and environment dynamics.  · Monitoring support calls (SRs) from the moment they are opened and working in full coordination with technical teams to drive swift resolution.  · Planning and reviewing major upgrades, refresh projects, and new deployments, ensuring minimal disruption and strong alignment with customer environments.  · Developing joint success plans with customers to understand current and future security requirements, operational challenges, and areas for improvement.  · Delivering proactive knowledge transfer to customers, partners, and field teams to support long-term stability and operational readiness.  · Maintaining comprehensive activity tracking and reporting to ensure full visibility for internal teams and customer stakeholders.      What you will bring to the table:  · 8–12 years of experience working with Check Point solutions, including security appliances, software gateways, cloud technologies, management platforms, Endpoint, and mobile solutions.  · Previous experience in Security Engineering, Support, Integration, or Customer Success (advantageous).  · Strong project management expertise, with the ability to drive complex initiatives end-to-end.  · A customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for solving problems and improving customer environments.  · Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence and simplify technical information.  · Fluency in English; familiarity with additional languages is an added advantage.  · Strong organizational skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to managing multiple workstreams.  · Ability to communicate with internal and customer executive leadership, summarizing complex challenges into clear, concise messages.  · Familiarity with ticketing and project management tools.    Our Values   Check Point is committed to making the world a safer and more secure place, and this commitment applies to our work both on the internet and the physical world alike. We promote a safe, healthy, supportive and diverse work environment, with training and development opportunities for all employees. We achieved gender parity in our C-Suite, and we are committed to equal opportunities and equal rewards for all.

Reporting to the Structural Bridge Lead, you will play a key role in the technical delivery and management of bridge projects—from conceptual design and analysis to construction review and inspection. The successful candidate will have the opportunity of designing various structural systems out of steel, concrete, and timber, including the design of prestressed concrete, GFRP reinforced concrete, composite steel/concrete sections, and composite precast/cast-in-place sections.

You will have excellent opportunities to grow and develop your engineering skills with the company, as well as mentor Engineers-in-Training and junior Engineers.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We’re an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm—not too big, not too small. We’re large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

You’re an ideal candidate if you have:

• Initiative to lead projects and drive tasks to completion.

• A collaborative mindset and enjoy working across multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work.

• A commitment to mentoring others.

Every road, bridge, dam, and building starts with what lies beneath it, and that's where you come in. GEMTEC is a growing, employee-owned engineering and environmental consulting firm with offices across Atlantic Canada and Ontario. We're looking for a motivated, hands-on Materials and Geotechnical Technician/Technologist to help make sure the ground, concrete, and asphalt behind our region's infrastructure are built to last. GEMTEC knows that creative, talented people are our greatest asset and as an employee-owned firm, investing in your development is investing in our own future.

We currently have openings for Materials and Geotechnical Technician(s)/Technologist(s) in our Saint John office.

The ideal candidate has some experience in general construction, is comfortable moving between outdoor fieldwork and lab settings, and brings curiosity and attention to detail to everything they do.

What You’ll Bring:

• College diploma in Civil Engineering Technology (or a related field).

• Two years' experience in civil construction.

• Experience with materials testing and inspection.

• Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.

• Strong multi-tasking, organization, and planning skills.

• Comfortable lifting 30–50 lbs on a regular basis.

• Valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle required for work-related travel.

What You’ll Do:

• Laboratory testing of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt.

• Field testing and sampling of aggregates, soils, concrete, and asphalt.

• A mix of office, laboratory, and field work across materials testing and geotechnical engineering projects.

• Conduct construction surveys to support engineering projects.

• Work alongside engineers, technologists, and project teams to keep projects moving.

• Communicate project updates, milestones, and potential issues to clients in a clear and professional manner.

• Other duties as required; no two days look quite the same.

Why GEMTEC?

• Seasonal and term positions are available.

• Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.

• Retirement savings plan with employer match.

• As a 100% employee-owned firm, GEMTEC employees have a real stake in the work you do and the company you help build.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We’re a perfect sized employee-owned, 400-person multi-disciplinary consulting firm that is large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

• Develop and maintain relationships with clients.

• Fair pay plus extra: competitive salary with year-end profit-sharing bonus.

• Complete health & dental coverage including vision, paramedical services, and Teladoc.

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year).

• Bachelor’s degree in earth science, environmental science or geological/geotechnical/civil engineering with an emphasis in water resources or hydrogeology.

• Knowledge and understanding of provincial and federal regulatory frameworks for groundwater withdrawal/use, drinking water supply, contaminated sites assessment and management, and environmental assessment is required.

• Valid NB driver’s license.

Dans ce rôle unique et valorisant, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le soutien du bien-être psychologique de personnes provenant de divers contextes culturels et sociaux. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une clientèle présentant des besoins variés en santé mentale, tout en contribuant à offrir un environnement de soins respectueux, sécuritaire et centré sur la personne.

Que vous souhaitiez compléter votre pratique privée ou diversifier votre expérience clinique, cette opportunité vous permettra d’avoir un impact significatif auprès d’une clientèle souvent confrontée à des défis d’adaptation, de stress et de vulnérabilité.

Pourquoi rejoindre Calian?

• Contribuez concrètement à la santé mentale et au mieux-être de personnes issues de parcours de vie variés.

• Exercez votre profession dans un environnement stimulant, collaboratif et axé sur les meilleures pratiques cliniques.

• Faites partie d’une organisation reconnue pour son excellence dans la prestation de services de santé partout au Canada.

• Travaillez au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire où votre expertise est reconnue et valorisée.

• Offrir des services de psychothérapie individuelle adaptés aux besoins de chaque personne.

• Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et assurer le suivi de plans d’intervention personnalisés.

• Accompagner les clients dans la gestion de divers enjeux de santé mentale, notamment l’anxiété, la dépression, le stress, les traumatismes et les difficultés d’adaptation.

• Évaluer l’évolution des clients et ajuster les interventions au besoin.

• Maintenir une documentation clinique précise et conforme aux normes professionnelles et réglementaires.

• Favoriser un environnement thérapeutique sécuritaire, respectueux et culturellement sensible.

## Qualifications

• Bilinguisme requis (français et anglais).

• Être admissible à une vérification du secteur vulnérable.

• Capacité à établir rapidement une relation de confiance avec une clientèle diversifiée.

• Solide jugement clinique et autonomie professionnelle.

• Aptitude à travailler efficacement au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire.

• Sensibilité aux réalités culturelles et aux enjeux pouvant affecter les populations migrantes.

## Position Overview

We are seeking experienced Nurse Practitioners to join a virtual primary care program supporting patients across Saskatchewan who do not currently have access to a family physician, Nurse Practitioner, or established primary care team.

CareersInnerInfo
This initiative is designed to improve access to timely primary care while providing patients with safe, convenient and clinically appropriate care through secure virtual consultations. The program will support Saskatchewan residents until they can be connected with a permanent primary care provider. Nurse Practitioners will provide comprehensive primary care through virtual encounters, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, diagnostic investigation, referrals and appropriate follow-up.

## Responsibilities

As a Virtual Primary Care Nurse Practitioner, you will independently assess and manage patients presenting with a broad range of primary care concerns through secure virtual consultations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Conduct virtual patient assessments by video and/or telephone.

• Assess symptoms, medical history and presenting concerns and develop appropriate clinical impressions and treatment plans.

• Provide medical advice, treatment and patient education.

• Prescribe and renew medications within your authorized scope of practice.

• Order and review laboratory investigations and diagnostic imaging as clinically appropriate.

• Initiate referrals to specialists and other healthcare services.

• Determine when a patient's condition cannot be safely or effectively managed virtually and facilitate appropriate in-person follow-up.

• Direct patients to primary care clinics, urgent care or emergency departments when clinically indicated.

• Provide appropriate follow-up for investigations, referrals and ongoing clinical concerns.

• Follow evidence-based clinical guidelines and established virtual-care protocols.

• Maintain accurate, timely and complete clinical documentation following each encounter.

• Participate in clinical quality, patient safety, privacy, consent and emergency-response procedures.

## Qualifications

• Hold or be eligible to obtain active licensure as a Nurse Practitioner through the College of Registered Nurses of Saskatchewan (CRNS).

• Be eligible to obtain a formal Appointment to the Practitioner Staff of the Saskatchewan Health Authority (SHA).

• Maintain active professional liability/malpractice insurance with coverage appropriate for the services being provided.

• Be able to successfully complete all required SHA credentialing requirements.

• Provide professional references.

• Provide a current criminal record check, including a vulnerable sector search.

• Provide evidence of professional standing and other credentialing documentation as required.

Experience

The successful candidate will ideally bring:

• Experience practising as a Nurse Practitioner in primary care, family practice, community health, urgent care or a comparable clinical environment.

• Strong clinical assessment and independent decision-making skills.

• Experience managing a broad range of common primary care presentations.

• Demonstrated competence in prescribing, diagnostic investigation, referrals and ongoing patient management.

• Strong understanding of when virtual care is clinically appropriate and when an in-person assessment or higher level of care is required.

• Experience providing virtual care or telehealth services considered an asset.

• Experience working with electronic medical records and digital clinical systems.

• Strong written clinical documentation skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly and compassionately with patients through telephone and video-based encounters.

• Ability to practise independently while collaborating effectively with physicians, clinical support teams and other healthcare providers.

Schedule

The program is expected to provide virtual primary care at minimum during typical weekday office hours, approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional evening and weekend coverage may also be offered based on patient demand.

The Patient Population

The program supports Saskatchewan residents who currently do not have a regular family physician, Nurse Practitioner or primary care team. Virtual care is intended to provide accessible primary care while patients await attachment to a permanent provider.

Compensation

Employee salary $95/hour

Why Join Us?

At Calian, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports your well-being, growth, and long-term success:

• Supportive Team Environment: You will work in a collaborative environment alongside healthcare professionals, coordinators, and case managers who are passionate about improving patient outcomes.

• Professional Growth: We invest in our people. You will have opportunities to expand your knowledge in healthcare systems, and pharmaceutical support services. You will also have access to formal leadership programs designed to help you grow professionally.

• Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits plan, and access to wellness programs that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Mentorship & Collaboration: Participate in events like our speed mentoring sessions to connect with senior leaders and peers across the organization.

Join a team that values collaboration, resilience, excellence, and sustainability—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

## Position Overview

We are seeking a Registered Psychologist to provide psychological risk assessment services within a federal correctional healthcare environment in New Brunswick.

This opportunity is well suited to a psychologist with experience in forensic, correctional, clinical or counselling psychology who is comfortable conducting comprehensive psychological assessments, evaluating risk and treatment needs, and preparing high-quality professional reports.

The psychologist will primarily provide services at Dorchester Complex in Dorchester, New Brunswick, working collaboratively with an interdisciplinary healthcare and case management team.

The role is focused on psychological risk assessment and provides an opportunity to apply specialized clinical expertise within a forensic environment while contributing to informed decisions related to treatment planning, case management, risk management and community reintegration.

The psychologist will collaborate with professionals across psychology, nursing, social work, occupational therapy, case management and other healthcare disciplines.

## Responsibilities

The psychologist will be responsible for conducting comprehensive psychological risk assessments and providing professional consultation as required. Responsibilities may include:

• Conducting psychological and risk assessment interviews.

• Reviewing relevant clinical, health, correctional and case management records.

• Administering, scoring and interpreting appropriate psychological and risk assessment instruments.

• Integrating information obtained through clinical interviews, psychological testing, file review and consultation with other professionals.

• Assessing risk factors, treatment needs, responsivity factors, protective factors and risk-management considerations.

• Preparing comprehensive psychological risk assessment reports and recommendations.

• Communicating assessment findings in accordance with professional and organizational requirements.

• Collaborating with interdisciplinary healthcare professionals and correctional case management teams.

• Participating in case conferences, interdisciplinary meetings, consultations and related activities when required.

• Maintaining complete, accurate and timely clinical documentation.

• Providing services in accordance with applicable professional, ethical, legislative, privacy and practice standards.

## Qualifications

Applicants must meet all of the following requirements to be considered.

• Current Registration or Licensure. You must hold a current and valid licence or registration as a psychologist with the applicable provincial regulatory body in the province where services will be provided.

• Proof of current registration or licensure will be required before placement.

Relevant Professional Experience

Within the past five years, you must have at least two years of professional experience in one of the following areas:

• Correctional or forensic psychology; or

• Clinical psychology and/or counselling psychology.

Psychological Risk Assessment Experience

You must have completed a minimum of five psychological risk assessments within the past five years.

Candidates who progress through the selection process will be asked to provide information allowing this experience to be verified, including the organization where the assessments were completed, the approximate dates of the work and an appropriate professional or administrative reference.

## Additional Requirements

While not mandatory, preference may be given to psychologists with experience in:

• Forensic or correctional environments.

• Structured psychological risk assessment.

• Actuarial or structured professional judgment tools.

• Complex mental health and behavioural presentations.

• Assessment of criminogenic needs and risk factors.

• Working with women in forensic or correctional settings.

• Working with Indigenous and culturally diverse populations.

• Interdisciplinary healthcare or case management teams.

• Preparing psychological reports used to support treatment, correctional, release or risk-management decisions.

• Working within environments involving heightened confidentiality, privacy and security requirements.

The contract requires services to take gender, cultural, religious and linguistic differences into account and to be responsive to the specific needs of women and Indigenous people.

Compensation

Per assessment.

Vacancy

We have 2 available positions.

## Position Overview

We are looking for an HR Advisor, Employee Relations to support a positive and consistent employee experience across Calian. Reporting to the Manager, Employee Relations, this role provides employee relations expertise and guidance to managers and employees, supports complex workplace matters, conducts investigations, and ensures compliance with employment legislation and company policies.

CareersInnerInfo
The HR Advisor plays a key role in advising on performance concerns, terminations, workplace accommodations, attendance management, leaves of absence, workplace complaints, disability management, and other employee relations matters.

This position contributes to a high-performance, employee-focused culture through sound judgment, problem solving, collaboration, and data-driven recommendations. Some roles within the Employee Relations team may be dedicated to supporting specific Calian acquisitions and business units.

## Responsibilities

• Manage employee relations matters of medium to high complexity, including investigations, terminations, workplace complaints, accommodations, attendance management, leaves, and performance concerns

• Partner with HR Business Partners to recommend appropriate resolutions and monitor outcomes

• Collaborate with internal legal counsel to ensure compliance with employment legislation and company policies

• Advise managers and employees on HR policies, procedures, and best practices

• Support the development and implementation of performance improvement plans

• Manage offboarding activities, including exit interviews and related documentation

• Contribute to the development, review, and implementation of HR policies and procedures

• Act as a subject matter expert on HR policies, procedures, and forms

• Monitor employment legislation and recommend updates to maintain compliance across all locations

• Provide proactive HR guidance and communicate employment standards and regulatory requirements

• Analyze HR metrics and trends to identify opportunities for process improvements, risk mitigation, and enhanced employee experience

• Assist employees with inquiries related to benefits programs

• Case manage complex WSIB/WCB claims and leaves of absence from initiation through resolution

• Maintain HRIS data with a high level of accuracy and timeliness

• Prepare HR correspondence, reports, metrics, training materials, and confidential documentation

• Lead or support projects that improve employee experience and optimize HR processes

• Collaborate with HR colleagues and stakeholders to ensure effective communication and resolution of employee matters

## Qualifications

• College diploma in a human resources-related field, such as Business Administration with a specialization in Human Resources Management

• Minimum three years of experience across a broad range of HR functions with a strong focus on employee relations and conflict resolution

• Knowledge of Canadian labour laws and provincial employment standards

• Experience managing employee relations cases from intake through resolution

• Experience advising managers on performance concerns, investigations, terminations, accommodations, attendance management, and leaves

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

• Experience working with HRIS systems, with SAP and SuccessFactors preferred

• Strong critical thinking, independent problem-solving, and decision-making skills

• Exceptional judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential matters

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to coach, influence, and challenge appropriately while maintaining positive working relationships

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment

• High attention to detail with strong analytical and data interpretation skills

• Commitment to continuous improvement, service excellence, and operational efficiency

• Bilingualism in English and French is considered an asset

## Additional Requirements

• Ability to work remotely and collaborate effectively with managers, employees, HR Business Partners, legal counsel, and other stakeholders across the organization

• Ability to work a schedule based on Eastern time zone work hours

• Comfort working in a dynamic environment with ambiguity, competing priorities, and evolving business needs

• Ability to build credibility, develop strong relationships, and navigate complex employee matters with confidence and professionalism

• Strong organizational agility and willingness to learn business operations, stakeholder expectations, systems, and escalation processes

• Experience with disability management, return-to-work programs, WSIB/WCB claims, and leave administration is preferred

Compensation

$70,000 to $75,000 annually

We have 1 available position

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian is looking for an exceptional Primary Care Physician to join our team at CFB Halifax, one of Canada’s largest and most vibrant military bases. Whether you’re seeking a full-time or part-time position, this role offers a unique opportunity to provide comprehensive healthcare to Canada’s dedicated Armed Forces members.

As a physician at CFB Halifax, you’ll be at the heart of an interdisciplinary team, delivering a full spectrum of care to the men and women who serve our country. From primary and occupational health to minor trauma management, disease prevention, and rehabilitation, your work will directly contribute to the health, readiness, and well-being of a highly motivated and appreciative patient population.

Join us at CFB Halifax and take your practice to the next level in a setting where your contributions truly matter. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to make a real impact in the lives of those who proudly serve our nation. Become part of a team that’s passionate about excellence in care and dedicated to supporting our military personnel!

## Responsibilities

• Provide Comprehensive primary medical care to patients with acute and chronic health conditions including referral to other health care providers when warranted.

• Deliver occupational health services such as, but not limited to:

• Referral of patients for participation in programs for the use of indicated personal protective devices – hearing conservation, respiratory protection program.

• Communicate with Senior Medical Authority on relevant clinical matters such as CF Spectrum of Care, complex patients requiring multi- disciplinary intervention, individual operational readiness.

• Maintain patient medical information in Electronic Health Record and patient health records.

## Qualifications

• Licensed and in good standing with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia

• Certification in Family Medicine with the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP)

• Basic Life Support for Health Providers or CPR/AED Level C

## Additional Requirements

• You will be able to obtain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level

## Position Overview

The Contract Security Program Officer will be responsible for coordinating the personnel security screening/clearance program at Calian as established by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP) and other governing bodies.

CareersInnerInfo
The Contract Security Program Officer helps ensure Calian’s ability to meet PSPC and other departmental security requirements as outlined in our contracts.

The incumbent acts as the Alternate Company Security Officer (A/CSO), responsible for Document Safeguarding Capability (DSC) of accredited facilities, associated safeguards, requests for visit and employee training. The incumbent will also act as Designated Official (DO) for Calian's Controlled Goods program.

## Responsibilities

Contract Security

• Is an A/CSO and administers the Contract Security Program for Calian for Gov’t of Canada contracts.

• Ensures Calian’s continued compliance with security standards, processes, and regulations as per the Contract Security Program (CSP) guidelines

• Keeps all records in accordance with the required regulations of the Contract Security Program

• Processes Requests for Visit, ensuring completeness of information on location and visitors as per established procedures of CSP guidelines

• Provides guidance on FOCI (Foreign, Ownership, Control & Influence) matters

• Obtains approval from the CSP for subcontracts with security requirements as per Subcontractor Compliance guidelines

• Provides security awareness, compliance training and briefings to employees and visitors, as required

• Administer contract security requirements for federal government contracts that have department specific security policies

• Administer contract security requirements as detailed by non-federal government and non-government customers

• Reviews RFPs (or alternative pre-contract documentation) that Calian intends to bid on to ascertain whether there are any non-standard security requirements and provides guidance accordingly

• Provides guidance on security requirements on contracts that have been awarded to Calian

• Quarterly and ad-hoc reporting of personnel security files

• Familiarizes themselves with international contract security implications to Calian’s growing presence globally

• DSC and personnel security clearance support for Satellite offices

Controlled Goods

• Act as Designated Official (DO) for Calian’s Controlled Goods Program

• Processes Security Assessments for employees, when required, as per procedures outlined by Controlled Goods Program (CGP) of the Gov’t of Canada

• Provides assistance with the Security Assessment process for Independent Contractors as per procedures outlined by the Controlled Goods Program (CGP)

• Adheres to the responsibilities, procedures, guidelines of the Controlled Goods Program for Calian

• Provides appropriate guidance, context, and briefings to employees to maintain compliance with the Controlled Goods Program

• Quarterly and ad-hoc reporting of personnel Controlled Goods files

• Is back up to CSO, as required

Other duties as required within the context of the role.

## Qualifications

• Grade 12 diploma required; post-secondary education is considered an asset

• 2+ years of Contract Security administration or relevant exposure is an asset

• Experience working in highly confidential, security-sensitive, and compliance-driven environments

## Additional Requirements

• Must be eligible to obtain a Government of Canada Security Clearance.

• Must be comfortable working in a hybrid environment and able to attend either our Ottawa or Saskatoon office as required. Candidates based in either location are encouraged to apply.

Compensation

$58,500-$64,350 per annum

Vacancy

We have 1 position(s) available.

Note: This is a 12-month contract.

## Position Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic and self-motivated embedded code developer and system architect to join our embedded design team in Ottawa. This candidate will have the primary task of guiding embedded system projects through architecture planning and resource allocation. The candidate must also be adept with the embedded C coding environment and lead the resolution of complex challenges within the various programs. This will be an active role which will require innovation and close attention to detail. The candidate will have the opportunity to acquire new skills while engaging in core product application design. A candidate with electronic hardware design understanding would be a significant asset.

CareersInnerInfo
Using a variety of software development tool suites, the candidate will be expected to architect and develop new capabilities on embedded system platforms. The candidate will also need to mentor and assign tasks to the developer team as well as support overall product test systems and customer configuration tool suites.

## Responsibilities

System Architecture & Embedded Development

• Lead the architecture, design, and development of complex embedded systems and firmware solutions from concept through product release.

• Define system-level requirements, architecture frameworks, and technical roadmaps for multiple product programs.

• Establish hardware/software partitioning strategies and overall system design approaches to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability.

• Review and approve technical designs, architecture decisions, and code implementation strategies.

Calian Belgium est une entité juridique enregistrée en Belgique, qui sert de plateforme d'innovation et de collaboration destinée à soutenir la Défense belge dans le domaine des solutions d'entraînement et d'exercices. Aperçu du poste

Dans le cadre de cette initiative, Calian recherche actuellement un Training Development Leader pour soutenir le Centre de simulation des Forces terrestres belges (SIMCEN) à Bourg Léopold, en Belgique.

Responsabilités

• Est responsable, sous l'autorité du Contract Coordinator, de l'ensemble des activités de développement de l'entraînement

• Dirige et gère la Section Développement de l'entraînement

• Supervise les Training Coordinators et le personnel assigné au développement de l'entraînement

• Agit en tant que conseiller principal en matière de conception de l'entraînement, de développement des exercices, d'intégration doctrinale et de développement des capacités d'entraînement

• Coordonne les priorités annuelles et émergentes en matière de développement de l'entraînement avec le SIMCEN et les parties prenantes de la Défense belge

• Établit les objectifs, priorités et calendriers de production en matière de développement de l'entraînement

• Élabore et tient à jour le plan de développement de l'entraînement ainsi que les programmes de travail associés

• Dirige et supervise les writing boards, les activités de développement de scénarios et les travaux de développement des produits d'entraînement

• Attribue les tâches et ressources de développement de l'entraînement aux Training Coordinators et au personnel de soutien

• Veille à ce que l'ensemble des produits d'entraînement soit conforme à la doctrine de la Défense belge, aux objectifs d'entraînement et aux exigences opérationnelles

• Est la principale autorité de révision et d'approbation pour les scénarios d'exercice, les produits de contexte opérationnel, le matériel d'entraînement et les contenus d'entraînement basés sur la simulation
