Forfait avantages, équilibre vie professionnelle et opportunités de croissance

Ce rôle est à temps plein, nécessitant un engagement de 40 heures par semaine. Nous apprécions la flexibilité et comprenons que les candidats peuvent avoir des besoins divers, nous offrons donc des opportunités de travail en semaine, le week-end et en soirée pour accommoder divers horaires. Bien que certains aspects de ce rôle nécessitent la réalisation d'entretiens en personne dans un bureau, notre environnement de travail est hybride, permettant la flexibilité et la possibilité de travailler à distance.

Nous proposons un salaire de base compétitif, des jours de vacances payés et un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux, y compris une couverture médicale et dentaire de groupe. De plus, nous offrons l'accès à un fonds de développement professionnel, vous permettant d'assister à des conférences, des ateliers et des sessions de formation pour améliorer vos compétences et vos connaissances dans le domaine de la psychologie.

Rejoignez Calian aujourd'hui!

Prêt à faire progresser votre carrière? Postulez maintenant et faites partie d'une équipe dynamique engagée à fournir des services psychologiques exceptionnels à travers le Canada.

Responsabilités

• Réaliser des évaluations psychologiques approfondies adaptées aux rôles de l'application de la loi et de la police, afin de déterminer l'aptitude psychologique à l'emploi dans des professions à haut risque.

• Utiliser divers outils d'évaluation, notamment le MMPI-3, le 16PF et d'autres mesures psychométriques, pour évaluer les traits de personnalité, la psychopathologie et la préparation psychologique.

• Examiner les questionnaires pré-entrevues et administrer des entretiens structurés sous stress et des entretiens cliniques pour évaluer davantage la préparation psychologique et l'aptitude aux carrières liées à l'application de la loi.

• Collaborer avec le psychologue clinique principal pour diriger des consultations sur des cas difficiles, fournissant des conseils sur les tests et les entretiens supplémentaires nécessaires pour prendre des décisions finales sur l'aptitude psychologique.

• Préparer des rapports d'évaluation complets détaillant l'aptitude psychologique pour les employeurs potentiels, en veillant à la clarté et au respect des normes professionnelles.

• Fournir des commentaires aux candidats sur les résultats individuels des évaluations, offrant des informations et des conseils basés sur les évaluations psychologiques.

• Réaliser des évaluations psychologiques après le retrait des armes de service, abordant des préoccupations telles que l'abus de substances, la récupération et la gestion de la sobriété.

• Réaliser des évaluations psychologiques pour le réarmement, en utilisant des outils tels que le MAST, le DAST et le DSM-V, et en menant des entretiens cliniques pour garantir la préparation à reprendre pleinement les fonctions.

• Évaluer la préparation psychologique à reprendre ou à continuer pleinement les fonctions après avoir été impliqué dans des incidents critiques, fournissant un soutien et des conseils au besoin.

• Réaliser des examens de l'assurance qualité (QA) des rapports d'évaluation, en veillant au respect de l'exactitude et des normes établies spécifiques aux exigences de l'application de la loi et de la police.

• Contribuer au développement continu et à l'amélioration des programmes d'évaluation pour les rôles de l'application de la loi et de la police, y compris la conception et le raffinement des protocoles d'évaluation basés sur la recherche et les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie dans ce domaine.

## Qualifications

• Diplôme de doctorat (Ph.D. ou Psy.D.) en psychologie de préférence.

• Les candidats titulaires d'une maîtrise en psychologie seront considérés, à condition qu'ils aient une expérience et une expertise pertinentes dans la réalisation d'évaluations psychologiques, en particulier dans le domaine de l'application de la loi ou des domaines connexes.

• Un minimum de 2 ans d'expérience récente au sein d'entités publiques (fédérales, provinciales ou municipales).

• Doit avoir effectué 50 évaluations de la préparation psychologique des candidats pour des emplois à haut risque nécessitant la délivrance d'équipement de défense en service au cours des 10 dernières années.

• Au moins 2 années d’expérience au cours des 5 dernières années dans la réalisation d’évaluations psychologiques auprès d’une clientèle adulte œuvrant dans des milieux professionnels à haut risque, incluant l’utilisation démontrée du MMPI-2, MMPI-2-RF ou MMPI-3.

## Position Overview

Join Calian in Shaping the Future of Psychological Services!

At Calian, we take pride in being one of Canada's largest providers of pre-employment psychological services for federal, provincial, and municipal law enforcement agencies and departments. Trusted by clients nationwide, we conduct assessments ranging from selection services to suitability to carry a firearm and return to work. Our comprehensive psychological services extend across both public and private sectors, ensuring that our clients' teams are equipped with the right individuals for high-risk scenarios.

As part of our strategic growth initiative, Calian is thrilled to announce the expansion of our operations in the Quebec city and Montreal areas. This expansion presents an exciting opportunity for us to further our mission of delivering comprehensive psychological services to a diverse range of clients across Canada. We are actively seeking a dedicated Staff Psychologist to join our team and play a pivotal role in continuing to shape our presence in this region.

Your Impact in Law Enforcement Settings

We are looking for a psychologist with a genuine interest in the complexities of human behavior within law enforcement settings. If you're drawn to the challenges of assessing candidates for high-stakes roles and are eager to contribute to public safety, this opportunity is for you. Our ideal candidate values collaboration, possesses a strong understanding of psychological principles, and is committed to ensuring the well-being and readiness of individuals entering and working in law enforcement and related fields.

Benefits Package, Work-Life Balance & Growth Opportunities

This role is full-time, requiring a commitment of 40 hours per week. We value flexibility and understand that candidates may have diverse needs, so we offer opportunities to work on weekdays, weekends, and evenings to accommodate various schedules. While some aspects of this role require conducting in-person interviews in an office setting, our working environment is hybrid, allowing for flexibility and the opportunity to work remotely.

We offer a competitive base salary, paid vacation days, and a comprehensive benefits package including group medical and dental coverage. Additionally, we provide access to a professional development fund, empowering you to attend conferences, workshops, and training sessions to enhance your skills and knowledge in the field of psychology.

Join Calian Today!

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply now and become part of a dynamic team committed to delivering exceptional psychological services across Canada.

## Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive psychological assessments tailored for law enforcement and policing roles, to determine psychological suitability for employment in high-risk occupations.

• Utilize a variety of assessment tools including the MMPI-3, 16PF, and other psychometric measures to evaluate personality traits, psychopathology, and psychological readiness.

• Review pre-interview questionnaires and administer structured stress interviews and clinical interviews to further assess psychological readiness and suitability for careers involving law enforcement.

• Collaborate with the Senior Clinical Psychologist to lead consultations on challenging cases, providing guidance on additional testing and interviews required for making final determinations on psychological suitability.

• Prepare comprehensive evaluation reports outlining psychological suitability for prospective employers, ensuring clarity and adherence to professional standards.

• Provide feedback to candidates on individual assessment results as requested, offering insight and guidance based on psychological evaluations.

• Conduct psychological assessments following the removal of duty firearms, addressing concerns such as substance abuse, recovery, and sobriety management.

• Perform psychological assessments for re-arming, utilizing tools such as the MAST, DAST, and DSM-V, and conducting clinical interviews to ensure readiness to resume full duties.

• Assess psychological readiness for resuming or continuing full duties following involvement in critical incidents, providing support and guidance as needed.

• Conduct quality assurance (QA) reviews of assessment reports, ensuring adherence to accuracy and established standards specific to law enforcement and policing requirements.

• Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of assessment programs for law enforcement and policing roles, including the design and refinement of assessment protocols based on research and industry best practices in this field.

## Qualifications

• Doctoral-level degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in Psychology is preferred.

• Candidates with a Master's Degree in Psychology will be considered, provided they have relevant experience and expertise in conducting psychological assessments, particularly in law enforcement or related fields.

• Fully licensed for autonomous practice with the College of Psychologists of Quebec.

• A minimum of 2 years of recent experience working for public entities (federal, provincial, or municipal)

• Must have completed 50 assessments for psychological readiness of candidates for high-risk employment requiring the issuance of duty defensive equipment in the last 10 years.

• At least 2 years of experience within the last 5 years conducting psychological assessments with adult clients in high-risk occupational settings, including demonstrated use of the MMPI-2, MMPI-2-RF or MMPI-3.

• Bilingualism in English and French (written and spoken) is required.

## Additional Requirements

• Must obtain and maintain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level.

CareersInnerInfo
Join a network of consultant psychologists across the country and contribute to ensuring organizations are staffed with capable, thoroughly assessed professionals who are ready to perform their duties effectively. Be part of a team committed to excellence in psychological assessment and make a meaningful impact on the success of both our clients and the individuals they hire!

## Position Overview

We are looking for Psychologists across British Columbia to conduct candidate selection assessments for policing agencies. This role is ideal for professionals seeking flexibility and engaging work that does not involve long-term therapy. We coordinate the referral process and schedule assessments based on your availability, allowing you to focus on your core expertise.

You will have the opportunity to conduct structured stress interviews and complete detailed assessment reports. This is an impactful role within the law enforcement community and offers the benefit of a streamlined process designed to support your workflow. This consultant psychologist position is well-suited for those who enjoy varied work, have an interest in public safety and policing, and thrive on diverse and meaningful professional challenges. If you prefer roles that do not require therapeutic alliances and value flexibility, this position offers an excellent fit.

## Responsibilities

• You will interview candidates who have completed written personality assessments administered by Calian. After the interview, you will complete a standardized findings template, with support available from our Senior Consulting Psychologist.

• You will conduct the second part of a two-part assessment process. The first part includes formal testing using the MMPI-3 and 16PF. The second part, performed by you, is a structured clinical interview.

• You will review and interpret testing results, conduct the follow-up clinical interview, and determine whether the candidate meets the required suitability criteria.

• You may be asked to provide feedback on individual results to candidates and defend psychological evaluations when required.

• Ph.D. or Psy.D. in Psychology is preferred; a Master’s degree may be accepted depending on experience.

• Must be fully licensed for autonomous practice as a Registered Clinical Psychologist in BC.

• Minimum 2 years of experience conducting psychodiagnostic assessments with adults in a clinical setting using DSM criteria.

• Assessments may be scheduled on weekdays, weekends, or evenings.

## Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Bilingual Trauma Therapist to provide specialized mental health services in response to critical incidents. The ideal candidate is either a Registered Social Worker or a Registered Psychotherapist.

CareersInnerInfo
We’re seeking a candidate with expertise in trauma-informed care and experience supporting individuals and teams impacted by traumatic events, such as natural disasters, workplace accidents, or violent incidents.

In this role, you will provide immediate crisis intervention and longer-term therapeutic support, helping clients process and recover from traumatic experiences. If you are passionate about helping others through critical moments, this role is for you.

## Responsibilities

• Provide immediate on-site crisis intervention services to individuals and groups affected by critical incidents (e.g., first responders, workplace teams, and survivors).

• Conduct trauma assessments to identify acute and long-term mental health needs following critical events.

• Deliver evidence-based trauma therapies such as EMDR, Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT), Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT), or Critical Incident Stress Debriefing (CISD) to address immediate and ongoing psychological effects.

• Work closely with emergency management teams, organizations, and first responders to develop tailored interventions and recovery plans.

• Offer psychological first aid and guidance to help clients stabilize in the immediate aftermath of traumatic incidents.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure holistic support for affected individuals, including follow-up services and referrals to additional resources as needed.

• Provide group debriefings, psychoeducation, and workshops to organizations and affected communities to build resilience and aid in recovery.

• Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation, including incident reports, treatment plans, and client progress notes.

• Stay updated on best practices in trauma therapy, crisis intervention, and critical incident response.

## Qualifications

• Bilingualism in English and French is required.

• Registration and good standing as either a Registered Social Worker or Registered Psychotherapist in the province of Ontario.

• Experience working in trauma therapy, with a focus on critical incidents or crisis intervention.

• Specialized training in trauma therapies such as EMDR, CPT, TF-CBT, Critical Incident Stress Debriefing (CISD), or Psychological First Aid (PFA).

• Proven ability to respond effectively and calmly in high-stress situations.

• Strong communication, crisis management, and de-escalation skills.

• Ability to collaborate with emergency teams, organizations, and community groups.

• Commitment to maintaining cultural competence and sensitivity when working with diverse populations.

## Additional Requirements

• PSPC Reliability Status is required.

Compensation

• $110-175/hr

• Effectuer des évaluations des traumatismes pour identifier les besoins aigus et à long terme en matière de santé mentale à la suite d'événements critiques.

• Capacité avérée à réagir efficacement et calmement dans des situations de stress élevé.

• Solides compétences en communication, en gestion de crise et en désescalade.

• Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes d'urgence, des organisations et des groupes communautaires.

• Engagement à maintenir la compétence et la sensibilité culturelles lorsque l'on travaille avec des populations

This fulfilling consultant psychologist role is ideal if you crave variety, harbor a keen interest in law enforcement. This position offers a dynamic and diverse work environment, catering to psychologists who thrive on multifaceted challenges. If you're seeking a role that aligns with your preferences for varied tasks and avoids the need for therapeutic alliances, this opportunity provides an ideal platform for your career growth and satisfaction.

## Responsibilities

• You will be responsible for interviewing candidates who have previously completed written personality assessments, which are administered by Calian. After your one-on-one interview, you will complete a template with your findings. You will also have the support of our experienced Senior Consulting Psychologist.

• In this role you will be asked to perform the second part of a two-part assessment. The first part will include formal testing, using MMPI-3 and 16PF, followed by the second part, a structured clinical interview.

• You will be responsible for reviewing and interpreting the results of the testing and then conducting the follow up clinical interview and ultimately determining whether the candidate meets or does not meet the requirements.

• You may also be required to provide feedback on individual assessment results to the candidates and defend psychological evaluations when required.

## Qualifications

• Ph.D. or Psy.D in Psychology is preferred, a Master’s degree may be accepted.

• Being fully bilingual (French and English) is preferred.

• Must be licensed for autonomous practice as a Psychologist in New Brunswick.

• Must have completed a minimum of 25 psychological assessments in the last 5 years for adults in high-risk occupations such as police, military, first responders, armed border agents, or correctional services officers.

• 2 years of experience performing psychodiagnostics assessments with adults in a clinical setting using DSM criteria.

• 3 years of experience using MMPI-2, MMPI-2-RF, or MMPI-3 in psychodiagnostic or psychological suitability assessments.

## Additional Requirements

• Casual contract and flexible working schedule.

• Assessments can be done on weekdays, weekends and/or evenings.

• Must be capable of conducting candidate interviews in person in a private office or virtually in a confidential environment.

## About this opportunity:

We are looking for a Radio Security Developer with strong cybersecurity expertise, hands-on radio verification experience, and a passion for practical software development. This role helps deliver secure, reliable radio products through security engineering, system-level verification, lab ownership, field issue investigation, and AI-enabled automation.

You will work closely with system architects, security specialists, hardware teams, and software development teams to drive security and verification activities from planning through execution and continuous improvement. The role also includes software-based security mitigations and practical guidance to development teams when needed.

## What you will do:

• Lead and prioritize security testing activities across products, releases, and lab environments, ensuring clear scope, coverage, evidence, and reporting.

• Drive application and network security testing, robustness validation, vulnerability analysis, and root-cause investigation using industry-standard tools.

• Contribute to threat and risk assessments at feature and product level, especially where third-party and open-source components are involved.

• Design, implement, and validate software-based security mitigations and hardening measures, especially where hardware constraints need to be considered.

• Drive and contribute to security backlog activities from analysis and refinement through implementation, verification, and continuous improvement.

• Design, build, operate, and maintain nodal and end-to-end verification lab environments.

• Plan and execute system-level verification activities across radio products, releases, and lab setups.

• Reproduce, debug, and support resolution of complex field and customer issues.

• Work closely with hardware, software, and system teams to understand platform constraints, verification gaps, and product-level risks.

• Develop and maintain automation pipelines, including AI-enabled workflows, to orchestrate security and verification tools and generate structured reports.

• Provide technical guidance to software development teams when required, including support for design reviews, implementation discussions, and complex problem resolution.

• Document test strategies, results, recommendations, and supporting evidence clearly, and collaborate with cross-functional teams on remediation and continuous improvement.

## The skills you bring:

• Hands-on experience with nodal-level or virtualized network functions in telecom or similar distributed systems, including lab build, deployment, and system-level verification.

• Strong background in radio security engineering and end-to-end verification, supported by Linux, networking, automation, and field-debugging expertise.

• Minimum 5 yearsof industry experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, vulnerability assessment, secure software development, or related security domains.

• Solid understanding of key network and security protocols such as IPsec/IKEv2, TLS, SNMP, and LDAP, with the ability to interpret protocol traces.

• Practical development experience with C/C++, Python, embedded Linux, Git/Gerrit, code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.

• Experience with security testing workflows and tools such as fuzzing suites, web security tools, vulnerability scanners, SBOM/SCA tools, and packet analyzers.

• Practical experience using AI or scripting to automate security and verification workflows, orchestrate multiple tools, and generate structured reports.

## Nice to have:

• Background in radio or access network hardware, or previous collaboration with hardware design and validation teams.

• Experience integrating security and verification tooling into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps-style environments.

• Familiarity with secure software development models such as SSDF and creating documentation, guidelines, or design rules for development teams.

• Experience with threat and risk analysis at system or feature level.

• A self-driven mindset for continuous security learning, including participation in external security forums, communities, or standards activities.

• Security-related certifications such as CISSP, GSEC, OSCP, or similar.

• Familiarity with cybersecurity standards, regulations, and emerging technologies relevant to radio products, including ISO 27001, ISO 21434, IEC 62443, the EU Radio Equipment Directive, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIST cybersecurity guidance, and post-quantum cryptography principles.

## Horizontal Machining Center Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, Ohio

## Purpose

Operates a horizontal boring mill, with and without continuous path control, performing contouring, boring, facing, turning, counter boring, grooving, undercutting, reaming, milling, drilling and tapping operations to produce quality product in accordance with established quality and procedural guidelines. Makes in-process changes to programs and edits/writes programs, as necessary, under the supervision of a programmer and/or immediate supervisor.

## Minimum Requirements

• A high school diploma or GED equivalency is required. Formal technical education is preferred, but not required. A minimum of three (3) years' technical experience in a similar role is desired.

• Must demonstrate ability to maintain detailed records, complete process documentation and other production records.

• Must be able to demonstrate proper use of instruments such as: dial indicators, verier calipers, precision instruments, micrometers, calipers, jacks, clamps, bolts, shim, jigs, fixtures, and angle plates.

• Must be able to recognize problems as programs are running and demonstrate ability to write/edit programs using both G and M coded controls (experience with Siemens and Fanuc controls preferred).

• Must be able to work with tolerances of .000" and to a microfinish 16 when necessary.

• U.S. citizenship is required.

• Must be open and available to working all shifts.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. ## POSITION SUMMARY:

The Industrial Hygienist 3 serves as an industrial hygiene and safety resource for clean-up operations as a result of past transuranic (TRU) waste processing activities. Specific duties may include, but are not necessarily limited to, the development, maintenance and implementation of IHS policies, procedures, and process related to ES&H Programs. The IHS Professional will collaborate with their peers and the workforce in developing solutions to complex IHS problems that require in-depth analysis of work activities.

426.2: This position is subject to DOE Order 426.2, Personnel Selection, Training, and Qualification Requirements for DOE Nuclear Facilities, which establishes entry-level requirements to ensure candidates selected for specific positions can successfully perform the requirements of the job.

## MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

## Include, but are not limited to:

• Providing Industrial Hygiene & Safety (IHS) technical guidance to operations on environmental remediation problems and issues

• Conducting investigations of the site to determine the extent of contamination and ensure that work will be in accordance with all federal, state regulatory requirements and within N3B's Industrial Hygiene & Safety policies

• Providing input to the N3B Safety and Health Programs team related to developing, maintaining and revising IHS processes/programs necessary for ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements.

• Applying the hierarchy of controls to eliminate or mitigate hazards while ensuring mission success.

• Monitoring and reviewing the Industrial Hygiene & Safety performance of subcontractors in the areas of work planning, work execution, installation, inspections, material control, and other areas of their work to confirm that they are performing in accordance with N3Bs subcontract work program (Exhibit F process).

• Performs other duties as required.

## Minium Qualifications:

Advanced knowledge[DS1] of strategic communications planning, as well as experience in managing EM communications programs.

• Frequent use and application of technical standards, principles, theories, concepts and techniques.in Industrial Hygiene, including use of various sampling and analysis methods, personal exposure monitoring, safety program development, and related recordkeeping.

• Excellent communication skills to effectively convey major elements of IHS, clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing to diverse audiences.

• Experience preparing, reviewing and presenting Industrial Hygiene & Safety protection reports.

• Demonstrated advanced experience in the identification, application and interpretation of federal codes, standards, and regulations in several Industrial Hygiene & Safety program areas, including chemical safety, beryllium, exposure assessment, cryogens, confined spaces, fall protection, and other IHS areas.

• Advanced experience conducting research, investigating alternative solutions, and recommending solutions on problems affecting CH-TRU worker health & safety.

• Experience with and advanced knowledge of IHS sampling and measurement equipment including a comprehensive understanding of functionality, calibration, and interpretation of measurements.

## EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

• A bachelor’s degree in a technical (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physiology, etc.) Five (5) years of related experience. Per DOE O 426.2, this position requires a bachelors’ degree, two (2) of job related and one year of nuclear experience.

## LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS:

• Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) by the Board for Global EHS Credentialing and/or Certified Safety Professional (CSP) by the Board of Certified Safety Professionals is preferred.

## BUSINESS ASSOCIATION:

Represents organization as a prime contact on contracts or projects. Interacts with senior internal and external personnel on significant matters often requiring coordination between organizations.

## IMPACT:

Exerts some influence on the overall objectives and long-range goals of the organization. Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve objectives would normally have serious effect upon the administration of the organization.

## WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL REQUIREME NTS:

• Individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

• This position works in an office environment with low noise levels due mostly to office equipment.

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, walk, stand, and occasionally climb or balance, squat, stoop, twist, turn, push, pull, kneel, crouch, crawl and reach with hands and arms.

• This position frequently must lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and infrequently must lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

• Hearing requirements include ability to listen and respond appropriately to conversations in person, virtually, and over the phone.

• Only electrical hazards and other minor potential hazards normally found in an office environment are anticipated.

## ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

• Maintains required safety, security and operational training; assure procedural and regulatory compliance; make safety, security and quality an integral part of every task; including stopping work if job is unsafe or compromises security.

• This position will ensure all activities and operations are performed in a safe and deliberate manner to include protecting the confidentiality and integrity of Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

## Position Overview:

As an Instrumentation and Control (I&C) System Design Engineer, contribute to a variety of projects, working in a team environment. Depending upon individual project needs, duties will include the development of control system requirements, architectures and interfaces, detailed design of control systems, specification of instruments and sensors, perform setpoint calculations and logic development for a wide variety of systems and subsystems. The role requires a broad, multi-disciplined background in both I&C and electrical systems.

## Location:

Onsite in Lynchburg, Virginia at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as an Instrumentation and Control (I&C) System Design Engineer:

• Work independently and within a team environment to develop innovative solutions to complex problems, infusing best practices and experience.

• Develop algorithms, architectures, and requirements for control systems.

• Utilize system and interface requirements to prepare appropriate design documentation.

• Develop system-level design documents, including requirements, specifications, setpoint documents, control narratives, and system design descriptions.

• Develop component-level design documents to select and specify I&C hardware, including sensors, PLCs, processors, I/O devices and embedded controllers.

• Provide technical oversight of vendors designing and/or implementing components and systems to BWXT specifications.

• Collaborate on the creation, development, and presentation of technical briefings.

• Recognize and solve problems. Recommend solutions to technical problems.

• Interface, coordinate, and support other design disciplines such as mechanical design, system design, procurement, and testing.

• Contribute to proposals, RFQ’s and business development efforts as needed.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of seven (7) years of related experience is required.

• Must have design experience in instrumentation and/or control systems.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills including technical writing.

• Must have working knowledge of nuclear-related IEEE standards, e.g. IEEE-603, -323, etc.

• Must be familiar with standard MS Office applications.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Detailed knowledge of NEC standards, NRC guidelines, and nuclear-related IEEE standards.

• System modeling and simulation experience in Flownex or Simulink and exposure to SysML.

• Expertise in autonomous control algorithms and systems.

• Familiarity with Systems Engineering principles and tools including INCOSE guidelines model-based systems engineering, CAMEO and/or PLM systems such as Enovia.

• Ability to design, develop, and/or specify sensors for extreme operating environments.

• Familiarity with nuclear power plant systems.

• Active DOD or DOE security clearance.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

## Position Overview:

This position is responsible for ensuring that all aspects of the NFS Transportation/Waste Management (T/WM) programs are compliant with federal and state waste regulations. Specific attributes include waste characterization, packaging, storage, and disposition including compliance with RCRA, TSCA, NRC and DOT.

## Location:

Onsite in Erwin, TN.

• Interface with on-site waste generators to develop solutions to technical problems associated with T/WM.

• Develop/revise waste characterization document.

• Prepare sampling and analysis plans in accordance with EPA guidance documents and SW-846.

• Interpret laboratory analytical data and characterize material for disposal in accordance with applicable regulations and disposal/treatment facilities waste acceptance criteria.

Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering, Waste Management, Environmental Science or related science, engineering, or technical field OR 8 years of equivalent experience acceptable in lieu of degree.

## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

The QNX Sensor Framework team develops a middleware software framework that simplifies access to cameras and sensors for automotive, robotics, industrial and embedded applications. The framework facilitates access to cameras and other sensors such as LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU through simple C APIs.

As a member of the team, you'll help deliver production-quality software used by some of the world's leading technology companies. This is an excellent opportunity for new graduates and junior developers to gain hands-on experience with embedded software, real-time operating systems, sensor technologies, and modern software development practices while being mentored by experienced engineers.

## What you will do:

• Develop embedded software written primarily in C and C++

• Add support for new cameras, sensors, and hardware platforms

• Design and implement new framework features and APIs

• Create and enhance sample applications, tools, and utilities

• Investigate and root-cause complex technical problems

• Work directly with hardware including cameras, LiDAR, radar, GPS, and IMU sensors

• Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and collaborative software development

• Support customers integrating sensors and cameras into their products

• Learn from experienced engineers while contributing to production software used worldwide

## What we are looking for:

• Programming skills in C and C++

• Analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills

• Knowledge of operating system fundamentals, computer architecture, and embedded systems concepts

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• Self-motivated with a passion for learning and building high-quality software

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline

## It's great if you have:

• Experience with embedded software development, could be project, coops or professional

• Experience with QNX, Linux or other embedded operating systems

• Experience with device driver and low-level software development

• Familiarity with computer vision, image processing, graphics, or machine learning

• Experience working with cameras, sensors, robotics, or automotive systems

## Why join us?

• Work on technology that makes a real-world impact

• Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge embedded systems

• Learn from experienced engineers while building production software

• Tackle challenging technical problems and broaden your expertise

The work we’re doing is not incremental—it’s foundational, and it’s accelerating the industry. Come join us!

• Work cooperatively with teams of engineers (mechanical, electrical and software) and internal customers to design, build, maintain, and upgrade custom automated process control and data acquisition systems that support manufacturing, quality control, and other plant operations.

• Motion Control (Delta Tau/Omron, Galil, Rockwell)

• Must possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Must be highly self-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.

## Field Operations Production Technician

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview:

As our Field Operations Production Technician 3, you will perform highly technical work in both radiological and industrial environments. This position requires sound radiological work practices, strong trade knowledge and skills, and strict compliance with applicable safety policies, procedures, and regulations.

You will support a broad range of projects, including demolition and decontamination (D&D), new equipment and system installations, modifications, and repairs in various industrial settings. You will work with specialized equipment and tools while applying strong problem-solving skills and collaborating with other members of the project team.

Safety is a critical component of this role. You will be expected to follow established safety protocols, radiological controls, procedures, and regulations while performing work that can have significant implications for personal and public health and safety.

## Location:

On-site at NOG-L Mt. Athos Site in Lynchburg, Virginia.

## Your Day to Day as a Field Operations Production Technician 3:

• Report to the Project Manager and Field Operations Manager.

• Prepare the work site for daily activities, including staging the materials, tools, and equipment required to perform assigned tasks.

• Perform assigned daily tasks using engineering procedures, engineering drawings, and applicable safety procedures and Job Hazard Analyses under the direction of the Field Operations Manager and Field Operations Supervisor.

• Perform project activities using mechanical and electrical trade skills, including new installations, modifications, and repairs of equipment, systems, buildings, and structures.

• Perform radiological work using sound radiological work control practices while adhering to applicable policies and procedures. Work may include equipment removal, decontamination of contaminated equipment, equipment and facility modifications, and radiological waste disposal.

• Wear the appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) necessary for protection from hazards associated with assigned tasks. PPE may include anti-contamination clothing, safety glasses, safety shoes, goggles, face shields, hard hats, safety gloves, safety harnesses, and respirators.

• Comply with applicable health and safety requirements while performing all assigned tasks.

• Maintain a productive and safe pace of work to complete assigned activities within established time constraints.

• Obtain and maintain all certifications and qualifications required for the position.

• Perform field walk-downs to support project estimates, readiness reviews, project closeout, and lessons learned, as directed by the Field Operations Manager.

## Required Qualifications:

• Must be a U.S. citizen

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance.

• Minimum A.S. degree in technical field + 4 years of experience, or minimum 8 years of relevant experience

• Trade experience in at least one of the following areas: electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or plumbing.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering blueprints, drawings, and procedures.

• Ability to build mechanical and/or electrical systems and components using drawings and detailed work instructions.

• Experience using basic hand tools, including power and manual tools.

• Ability to interact with peers in a positive and collaborative manner.

• Must successfully complete applicable BWXT pre-employment requirements, including a security background check and drug screening, and maintain applicable employment requirements.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Applicable military experience.

• Experience across multiple trades, including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and/or plumbing.

• Experience operating equipment such as forklifts, material lifts, aerial lifts, personnel lifts, and scissor lifts.

## Physical Abilities:

• Ability to work at heights and from ladders, scaffolds, and personnel lifts.

• Ability to stand throughout a 10-hour shift and generally remain on your feet while working in the work area.

• Ability to frequently stoop, bend, crouch, crawl, and kneel.

• Ability to frequently push and pull.

• Ability to frequently climb stairs and ladders.

• Ability to maintain balance while performing assigned work.

• Ability to regularly use hands to operate tools and controls.

• Ability to frequently move and lift materials and equipment of varying sizes and weights up to and including 50 pounds.

• Ability to frequently operate various hand and power tools.

• Ability to work in noisy, dirty, isolated, or crowded environments.

• Ability to work in environments that may include temperature variations, fumes, moving machinery, and hazardous materials.

• Ability to don and wear required personal protective clothing and equipment, which may include protective work suits, safety shoes, gloves, foot protection, safety harnesses, and respiratory equipment such as a powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR).

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

• A solid understanding of digital design, including Verilog/RTL, place-and-route, and static timing analysis.

## Grow with us

Location: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada – Ericsson will not provide immigration support.

Approximately 40% of the world’s mobile traffic is carried through an Ericsson network. Our 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions are already connecting billions of devices, and we are actively shaping the evolution toward 6G. Within this context, our L1 Software Development team in RCE RAN Performance designs and implements the Physical Layer baseband functions – the signal‑processing engine at the heart of 5G.

We are looking for a curious, driven junior developer who is passionate about high‑performance embedded software, low‑level programming, and cloud‑ready systems. If you are excited by innovation and want your code to help power networks around the world, we’d like to hear from you.

Within our organization, we work on two Ericsson products, our purpose-built multi-core ASIC and newly deployed, Cloud based Radio Access Network. Our mission is twofold:

• Develop high‑quality L1 features that grow our customers’ businesses and improve network performance.

• Secure the product’s future through cutting‑edge technology, cloud‑native architectures, and continuous innovation.

You will join a collaborative, international team that works closely with global RAN and platform experts, using modern development practices to deliver robust, performant software.

## What you will do:

• Designing, developing, and testing L1 software components on Ericsson’s 5G processing platform and related cloud/COTS environments.

• Implementing and enhancing Physical Layer baseband features across a range of deployment scenarios and frequency bands defined by 3GPP.

• Performing continuous analysis, clarifying requirements, and contributing to technical solutions that balance performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Working in both manual and highly automated environments to integrate new software modules and algorithms, and to troubleshoot complex issues.

• Applying real‑time software development practices and knowledge of wireless communication protocols (for example NR/5G, LTE, WCDMA, WLAN).

• Participating in code reviews, inspections, and design discussions to help maintain high software quality standards.

• Developing and maintaining test coverage to ensure new changes do not degrade existing functionality.

• Exploring cloud‑native platforms and learning how to optimize L1 software for containerized and virtualized environments.

• Using AI/ML tools and techniques where appropriate to accelerate development, improve performance, or enable intelligent automation.

• Contributing to a modern, agile way of working, including sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement activities.

• Documenting system analysis, software designs, and test plans in line with internal standards.

## The skills you will bring:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Communications Systems, AI/ML, or a related field.

• 0–4 years of professional experience in a relevant domain.

• 2+ years of experience with embedded software, low‑level programming, and cloud‑ready systems

• Experience with software development and systems programming, with a strong desire to grow into a technical expert in wireless and L1.

• 3+ years of experience with C/C++, with a focus on embedded or systems‑level software.

• Experience with real‑time or concurrent software development for embedded systems.

• Experience with wireless communication fundamentals, such as quadrature modulation, channel coding, OFDMA, and receiver theory.

• Experience in developing L1 software for major wireless standards (for example NR, LTE, WCDMA, WiMAX, WLAN).

• Comfort working in a Linux development environment.

• Experience with software configuration and delivery tools such as Git, Gerrit, and Jenkins (or similar).

• Awareness of cloud concepts and platforms, and enthusiasm to learn how to build and optimize cloud‑native solutions.

• Curiosity about how AI and machine learning can be applied to software development and wireless systems.

• Strong analytical and critical‑thinking skills, with a methodical approach to debugging and problem solving.

• Clear verbal and written communication skills and a collaborative mindset, comfortable working in a diverse, international, multi‑site team.

• Adaptability and ownership: able to work in a fast‑paced agile environment, respond to changing priorities, and take responsibility for delivering high‑quality results.

• Curiosity about how 5G/6G networks work and a desire to go deep on the technical details

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## What do we do?

The mechanical engineering co-op student will join a multi-disciplinary R&D team that is continually and rapidly advancing new products from conception to their fully-realized, mature state - deployed around the world as the foundation of the optical internet.

The team works on a variety of different products applied in optical communication networks: optical amplifiers, wavelength-selectable switches, optical channel monitors and highly-integrated circuit packs. In addition to designing the products, the team also designs the precision production tooling essential to build the products in volume. Creative, reliable tooling designs are developed, documented and built within tight schedules.

What will you do in this role?

The mechanical engineering co-op student will join a multi-disciplinary R&D team that is continually and rapidly advancing new products from conception to their fully-realized, mature state - deployed around the world as the foundation of the optical internet.

The team works on a variety of different products applied in optical communication networks: optical amplifiers, wavelength-selectable switches, optical channel monitors and highly-integrated circuit packs. In addition to designing the products, the team also designs the precision production tooling essential to build the products in volume. Creative, reliable tooling designs are developed, documented and built within tight schedules.

## Responsibilities:

• Participate in the development of precision production tooling designs.

• Prepare engineering drawings of the required parts and assemblies using 3D solid CAD tools such as Solid Edge to develop fully-documented detailed mechanical designs.

• Apply a solid knowledge of mechanical engineering and manufacturing philosophies to develop new solutions and to evaluate the merits and risks of alternative concepts.

• Apply our mechanical engineering design process to compile design requirements, evaluate conceptual designs, deliver detail design documentation and evaluate performance of realized designs.

• Participate as a positive team member, working effectively with colleagues to ensure that design choices which span multiple disciplines are balanced and optimized for the overall performance, manufacturability and cost-effectiveness of the tooling solutions.

We aim to provide a high-quality learning experience. Depending on the aptitude and interests of the mechanical engineering co-op student, the role will provide opportunities to gain exposure to topics such as opto-mechanical product design, electronics packaging and the application of Finite Element Methods and Computational Fluid Dynamics to product engineering.

What experience will allow you the greatest success in this role?

Recommended Education:

• 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year student in a Mechanical Engineering Bachelor’s Degree program.

• Candidates must be currently enrolled in a recognized Canadian post-secondary institution.

Skills:

• Demonstrated proficiency in producing part and assembly drawings compliant with ANSI drafting standards;

• Proficiency in the use of a 3D solid modeling mechanical CAD tool such as SolidWorks or SolidEdge;

• Ability to demonstrate an aptitude for detailed mechanical design;

• Practical and theoretical knowledge of metal machining processes, design of machined parts, selection of engineering materials, structural mechanics;

• Demonstrated ability to apply excellent design judgment and engineering skills;

• Demonstrated ability to consistently apply attention to detail in pursuit of high quality.

## Desired Qualifications

• Knowledge of and ability to apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GDT) practices;

• Experience with engineering document management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems;

• Practical and theoretical knowledge of a variety of fabrication processes: sheet metal, injection molded plastics, electronic assemblies, optical assemblies, Design for Manufacturability.

• Prayer room

• Games room

ABOUT THE ROLE Solink is looking for a Field & Channel Marketing Manager to own the event calendar and field marketing strategy across a specific region or channel. Rather than running one event at a time, you’ll design the playbook for how events, dinners, and tradeshows are planned, executed, and measured, and you’ll build focused go-to-market programs around Solink’s strategic verticals and accounts, including Restaurant, Financial Institution, and Strategic segments, to grow enterprise pipeline and deepen account penetration. You’ll evaluate ROI across the full portfolio of events and reallocate budget and effort toward what performs, manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships (including performance discussions), and act as the escalation point when vendor, partner, or stakeholder issues can’t be resolved at the individual-contributor level. You’ll also improve the systems, tools, and templates the broader field marketing team plans against. This role suits a senior marketer who thinks in terms of portfolios and systems rather than single events, coaches others on collaborating effectively with sales and partner teams, and instills urgency and accountability across multiple concurrent events and stakeholders. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Strategic Vertical & Account Programs - Build and execute focused GTM event programs around Solink’s strategic verticals and accounts to grow enterprise pipeline and penetration. - Partner with Sales and Account Executives to align the event portfolio and invite strategy to target accounts and verticals. - Evaluate which event formats and investments perform best within each vertical, and reallocate budget accordingly. Event Calendar, Strategy & Portfolio ROI - Own the end-to-end event calendar and strategy across a region or channel, not just individual events. - Design the playbook for how events, dinners, and tradeshows are planned, executed, and measured. - Ensure pre-show, on-site, and follow-up processes are consistent across multiple simultaneous events. - Evaluate ROI across the portfolio of events and reallocate budget/effort toward what performs. - Improve systems and tools (tech stack, automation, templates) to increase team efficiency. Vendor & Partner Portfolio Management - Manage a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships across events and channels, including performance discussions. - Align AEs, CAMs, and partners across multiple events on shared priorities and expectations. - Build standardized stakeholder processes (partner briefing templates, AE requirement docs) to reduce friction. A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU - 6–8 years of B2B field marketing or event marketing experience, including experience owning a portfolio of events or a regional/channel program, ideally in SaaS or technology. - A track record of evaluating ROI across multiple events and reallocating budget or effort toward what performs. - Experience managing a portfolio of vendor and partner relationships, including performance conversations and escalations. - Experience building GTM programs targeted at specific verticals or strategic accounts, ideally including Restaurant or Financial Institution segments. - Demonstrated ability to build systems, playbooks, or templates that other team members plan against. - Experience coaching or mentoring more junior marketers on stakeholder management and event execution. - Comfort acting as the escalation point for vendor, partner, or internal stakeholder issues. NICE TO HAVES - Experience marketing into Restaurant, Financial Institution, or other physical-security-relevant verticals. - Familiarity with event management platforms (e.g., Cvent, Splash) and marketing automation tooling (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot). - Experience supporting enterprise or strategic account segments alongside a direct sales team. - Exposure to account-based marketing (ABM) concepts and vertical-specific campaign design. - Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. ROLE EXPECTATIONS This is a P4 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are a key contributors within their team, they act as a mentor to colleagues, not only within their team, but also cross functionally and can be relied on for strategic collaboration on team and org wide initiatives. In This Role, You'll Be Expected To: - Lead projects as the lead while providing direction and able to keep key stakeholders informed - Coach and mentor other employees through complex problems, goals, tasks and initiatives, giving constructive feedback. - Consistently deliver on their priorities and commitments - Drive process improvements and influence adoption. - Builds frameworks, templates, or standards that scale team effectiveness What Success Looks Like: - Enterprise pipeline and account penetration that visibly grow within Restaurant, Financial Institution, and Strategic segments because of the GTM programs you built - A portfolio ROI framework the team trusts, with budget and effort clearly shifted toward the event formats and vendors that actually perform - A playbook, templates, and processes that the broader field marketing team plans against by default, not just when you're in the room - Vendor, partner, and stakeholder issues that get resolved at your level, with AEs, CAMs, and partners aligned before problems reach leadership SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States. - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work. - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required. - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth. - Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need. - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs. - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together. - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics. - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun. At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

## Position Overview:

BWXT is seeking an experienced Engineering Codes & Methods Platform Lead for our Advanced Technologies (AT) office in Lynchburg, VA. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical lead for a team responsible for the computational tools and methods that underpin our research and engineering efforts. This role requires substantial technical expertise, demonstrated leadership capability, and the ability to coordinate complex activities across multidisciplinary teams. The successful candidate will possess deep knowledge of modeling and simulation requirements, software quality assurance, and the physics associated with reactor and fuel systems—including neutronics, thermal hydraulics, and structural analyses. They must have exceptional interpersonal skills to coordinate multiple activities simultaneously across joint organizational teams.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Engineering Codes and Methods Platform Lead:

• Create models and simulations of nuclear reactors and nuclear fuels with historical, specialty, and modern computational tools.

• Coordinate and/or work with teams in the generation of computational methods, analytical procedures, and organizational / technical processes associated with computational tools and methods.

• Coordinate multiple research and engineering activities simultaneously within a joint organizational team using scrum project management framework.

• Execute project engineering activities (task plans, schedules, etc.).

• Provide technical and strategic direction to teams, ensuring alignment with program objectives and quality standards.

• Foster a high-performing team environment, including collaboration across multiphysics areas of structural mechanics, thermal/hydraulics, and neutronics.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience is required.

• Must have an understanding of nuclear and non-nuclear phenomena that impact the performance and behavior of systems during normal and off-normal events.

• Must have an understanding of static and time-dependent behaviors and attributes of physics behind nuclear and non-nuclear systems.

• Must have knowledge of software configuration, quality, and development best practices and standards is required. Knowledge of revision-controlled software releases through a centralized version control system is required.

• Must be able to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely written and verbal communication.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including:
• Experience facilitating technical teams in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.

• Ability to provide clear direction, constructive feedback, and effective mentorship

• Strong decision-making skills with the ability to prioritize and balance competing demands

• Proven success in fostering collaborative, inclusive, and accountable team culture

• Travel (<25%) domestic and international.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with nuclear modeling and simulation and relevant nuclear quality standards.

• Knowledge of MOOSE applications.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Position Overview
As our Principal Data Engineer for Semantic Modeling & Industrial Knowledge Architecture, you will lead the design, engineering, and governance of large‑scale semantic data models and industrial knowledge systems that support real‑time operational intelligence across advanced manufacturing environments. You will build unified namespaces, enterprise knowledge graphs, and ontology-driven architectures that ensure consistent interpretation, traceability, and interoperability of mission‑critical industrial data. This role partners with controls engineers, data architects, AI/ML teams, and manufacturing SMEs to deliver enterprise-grade foundations for analytics, predictive maintenance, simulation workflows, and AI-driven automation in a high-security DOE/NNSA environment.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee (Q Clearance Required)

Your Day to Day as a Principal Data Engineer
• Design semantic data models and ontologies enabling unified interpretation of industrial data across chemical, aerospace, automotive, and high-throughput manufacturing sectors.
• Develop enterprise knowledge graph components using OWL, RDF, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, and SPARQL.
• Build unified namespaces aligned with ISA‑95 and W3C standards to ensure cross-system interoperability.
• Architect scalable storage solutions including time-series databases, knowledge graphs, and lakehouse systems.
• Engineer pipelines to ingest, reconcile, and contextualize structured, semi-structured, streaming, and unstructured data.
• Apply governance practices including versioning, modularization, URI strategies, and quality gates.
• Map relational models into semantic representations using R2RML/RML.
• Support AI/ML and simulation teams by embedding semantic models into analytics and automation workflows.
• Lead workshops with SMEs to define domain concepts, modeling requirements, and competency questions.
• Implement data quality controls, lineage, validation frameworks, and anomaly detection.
• Develop reusable frameworks for units modeling, hierarchical structures, identifier normalization, and event modeling.
• Mentor engineering teams and contribute to enterprise data modernization strategies.
• Maintain semantic specifications, governance artifacts, workflows, and compliance documentation.
• Participate in DOE/NNSA audits, reviews, and inspections.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Engineering, Information Science, Computer Science, or related STEM field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in data engineering, semantic modeling, ontology design, or knowledge graph development.
• Experience designing ontologies using OWL, RDF, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, and SPARQL.
• Hands-on experience with pipelines for structured, semi-structured, streaming, and unstructured data.
• Experience integrating OT/IoT, edge devices, and SCADA systems into unified data environments.
• Strong knowledge of data architecture principles and modern storage paradigms.
• Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms and Kubernetes.
• Understanding of semantic governance and lifecycle management.
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance.
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Information Science, or related field.
• Experience in automotive, aerospace, chemical, or high‑throughput manufacturing sectors.

This is a newly unified leadership role, bringing Product Marketing and Customer Marketing together so the story we tell to prospects and the story we tell to existing customers reinforce each other. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Positioning & Messaging - Own product positioning, messaging, and narrative across Solink’s platform and key products and industries we serve. - Develop and defend a category point of view that differentiates Solink from adjacent and competing solutions. - Test and refine messaging with customers, prospects, and sales to ensure it resonates and converts. GTM Strategy - Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for major feature and product launches, partnering with Product, Demand Gen, Sales, and Customer Success. - Build launch playbooks and processes that scale across a growing product portfolio. - Identify opportunities to grow adoption and ARPU through positioning, packaging, and GTM for new features and add-ons. Competitive Intelligence - Own Solink’s competitive intelligence program, keeping a current, accurate view of the competitive landscape. - Run a win/loss program that turns deal outcomes into sharper positioning and enablement. - Educate internal teams - Sales, Marketing, Product - on competitive threats and how to respond to them. Sales Enablement - Build and scale sales enablement content — battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and training — that drives rep proficiency and win rate. - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to ensure enablement keeps pace with the roadmap and competitive landscape. - Measure and improve enablement adoption and its impact on ramp time and win rate. Customer Marketing & Advocacy - Own customer marketing strategy - references, case studies, testimonials, and advocacy programs that support both sales, demand gen, channel and brand. - Partner with Demand Gen and Customer Success on programs that drive adoption, expansion, and retention among existing customers. - Build a scalable customer reference and advisory program to support field marketing pg growth, competitive deals and category-building efforts. A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU - 10+ years of experience in product marketing, with meaningful experience in customer marketing, competitive intelligence, or analyst relations. - A proven track record building category positioning that differentiates a product in a competitive market. - Experience leading go-to-market strategy and execution for major product launches end-to-end. - Experience building or scaling a sales enablement function, with measurable impact on win rate or ramp time. - Comfort building new functions from scratch, including Analyst Relations or customer advocacy programs. - Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting positioning and strategy to CMO, executive, and board-level audiences. - Experience building and coaching a team of product and/or customer marketers. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable) 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members 5. Reference Checks 6. #CareersThatKickSaas! When something breaks in a customer's field operation, you are who they reach out to. TrueContext runs the forms, workflows, and data capture that thousands of field technicians depend on every day, so a stalled integration can leave a crew standing around a job site. This role is blended by design: you pick up the ticket, reproduce the issue, and carry it to fix yourself.

The Customer Success Manager owns the customer's outcomes and the Account Manager owns the commercial relationship. You own the problem in front of you: quick acknowledgement, a real diagnosis, and an answer the customer understands. For most users, this is the most visible evidence they have that we are dependable.

What you'll do

Own the ticket, start to finish

Work the queue across email, portal, and phone. Figure out what the customer is actually trying to accomplish, not just what they typed in the ticket, and stay with it through to resolution.

Most of the job is diagnosis. Reproduce the problem, then narrow it:

• Form behavior: conditional logic, repeatable sections, calculated fields, validation rules

• Data Source and Data Destination failures: refresh schedules, mapping errors, payload formatting

• API responses and integration logs, to work out whether the break sits with us, with the customer's connected system, or in the configuration between them

• Mobile issues on iOS and Android: offline sync, device performance, version mismatches

When it turns out to be a configuration choice, show the customer what to change. When it is a bug, write it up well enough that Engineering can act without three rounds of follow-up questions.

Handle escalations and incidents

Escalate early rather than after a customer has run out of patience. Hand Engineering a reproduction path and the real business impact. During platform incidents, keep affected customers posted and close the loop with each one afterward. On-call for urgent evening and weekend issues is shared across the team.

Make the next ticket unnecessary

Recurring problems should end up as help articles and internal runbooks instead of repeat tickets. Keep the ticketing system honest while you are at it: accurate categories, current status, resolution notes someone else could follow.

Be the early warning system

Support sees trouble before anyone else does. Pass ticket patterns and sentiment shifts to the Customer Success Manager and Account Manager so nobody is surprised at renewal. Same with Product: which parts of the platform generate the most friction, and the evidence to back it up. A well-argued support trend is one of the more reliable inputs into our roadmap.

What we're looking for

2 to 4 years in a technical support or a similar customer-facing technical role at a SaaS company. More than anything, you can take a vague description of a problem and narrow it to a cause.

You are comfortable reading API documentation, inspecting a JSON payload, and interpreting error code. Some exposure to REST APIs, webhooks, or integration platforms matters more here than any particular tool on your resume. Low-code, mobile, or field service platforms are a bonus, as is supporting apps on both iOS and Android.

You can explain a technical cause to a non-technical user without making them feel small. You are organized, because this is a queue rather than one problem at a time. You stay steady when a customer is upset and the answer is not obvious yet.

Helpful but not required: Jira Service Management or Salesforce Service Cloud; a background in field service, construction, utilities, or another regulated industry.

Location and Work Model

Ottawa, hybrid, with regular time in the office next to the Support, Product, and Engineering teams. This is a late shift role: 12pm to 8pm ET, Monday to Friday. Occasional weekend coverage is required depending on team availability, and the team shares an on-call rotation for urgent after-hours issues.

Some Extra Benefits

• Company-wide & team social events

• Wellness yearly allowance

• Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day)

• Catered lunches 2x per week

• An amazing office space with plenty of snacks, drinks, and space to collaborate

• Hybrid work environment (3 days a week in the office)

Salary Range

• $60,000 - $75,000 base salary

If you are looking for the opportunity to embrace and be part of a truly unique company culture, this opportunity might just be for you!
