Calian est fier de poursuivre une relation contractuelle de longue date avec le ministère de la Défense nationale (MDN) pour fournir des services de santé aux Forces armées canadiennes. Grâce au contrat de fournisseur de soins de santé, Calian emploie des professionnels de la santé à travers le Canada qui sont essentiels pour soutenir la santé et le bien-être de nos membres militaires.

CareersInnerInfo
À propos du rôle

Calian est à la recherche d’un(e) infirmier(ère) auxiliaire bilingue (français et anglais) pour un poste à temps plein au sein de l’équipe des services de santé à la Base des Forces canadiennes Saint-Jean (BFC Saint-Jean).

Ce rôle offre une excellente conciliation travail-vie personnelle, avec des horaires réguliers de jour dans un environnement de soins primaires. Vous contribuerez directement au bien-être des membres des Forces armées canadiennes.

Horaire à temps plein: 7,5 heures par jour / 37,5 heures par semaine.

Responsabilités

• Effectuer des évaluations de triage pendant les consultations sans rendez-vous: antécédents médicaux, examens physiques, signes vitaux, tests d’acuité visuelle.

• Élaborer un plan de soins infirmiers, communiquer les changements ou résultats anormaux, et référer au médecin ou à un autre professionnel de santé si nécessaire.

• Administrer les médicaments selon les ordonnances et le champ de pratique provincial, tout en observant et documentant les effets thérapeutiques.

• Assister les médecins ou autres professionnels lors de traitements et procédures.

• Effectuer des injections thérapeutiques, soins de plaies, surveiller les thérapies respiratoires et IV, et préparer les patients pour des interventions mineures.

• Répondre aux questions des patients (par écrit ou par téléphone), préparer et gérer les dossiers médicaux.

• Gérer l’inventaire des fournitures médicales, commander et réapprovisionner au besoin.

• Nettoyer les zones de soins entre les patients, stériliser et emballer les instruments chirurgicaux.

## Qualifications

• Diplôme d’un programme de soins infirmiers pratiques reconnu.

• Membre en règle de l’Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers auxiliaires du Québec est obligatoire (OIIAQ).

• Le candidat ou la candidate doit posséder une excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. Cette compétence est essentielle à l’exercice des fonctions et constitue une condition d’admissibilité au poste.

• Certification RCR/SIR pour fournisseur de soins de santé ou RCR niveau C (ou volonté de l’obtenir).

• Minimum 1 an d’expérience à temps plein au cours des 3 dernières années dans un cadre de soins primaires ou ambulatoires auprès d’une population adulte.

• Le candidat retenu doit être admissible à l’obtention d’une cote de sécurité de niveau Fiabilité délivrée par Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).

Informations supplémentaires

• Poste contractuel avec possibilité de prolongation

• Poste à temps plein : 37,5 heures par semaine (7,5 h/jour)

• Horaire stable : du lundi au vendredi, de 7 h 30 à 16 h 00

• Vacances payées et congés selon les normes en vigueur

• Avantages sociaux compétitifs

• Environnement de travail structuré, stimulant et axé sur la collaboration

• L’occasion de contribuer activement à la santé de ceux et celles qui servent notre pays

Prêt(e) à relever le défi?

Joignez-vous à une équipe qui valorise l’excellence, le respect et le service. Postulez dès aujourd’hui pour faire une réelle différence!

About Calian

Calian is proud to continue its long-standing partnership with the Department of National Defence (DND), providing healthcare services to members of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF). Through our Healthcare Provider Contract, Calian employs healthcare professionals across Canada who play a vital role in supporting the health, readiness, and well-being of military personnel.

## About the role

Calian is currently seeking a Bilingual Licensed Practical Nurse (French and English) to join the Health Services team at Canadian Forces Base Saint-Jean (CFB Saint-Jean) in a full-time capacity.

This position offers an excellent work-life balance, featuring consistent daytime hours in a primary care environment. In this role, you will make a meaningful contribution to the health and well-being of Canadian Armed Forces members.

Full-Time Schedule: 7.5 hours per day / 37.5 hours per week

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct triage assessments during walk-in clinics, including obtaining medical histories, performing physical assessments, taking vital signs, and administering visual acuity tests.

• Develop nursing care plans, communicate changes in patient condition or abnormal findings, and refer patients to physicians or other healthcare professionals as required.

• Administer medications in accordance with physician orders and provincial scope of practice, while monitoring and documenting therapeutic outcomes.

• Assist physicians and other healthcare professionals with treatments and clinical procedures.

• Perform therapeutic injections, wound care, monitor respiratory and IV therapies, and prepare patients for minor procedures.

• Respond to patient inquiries by phone or in writing, and maintain accurate medical records and documentation.

• Manage medical supply inventory, including ordering and restocking as required.

• Clean clinical treatment areas between patients and sterilize, package, and maintain surgical instruments.

## Qualifications

• Graduate of a recognized Practical Nursing program.

• Current registration and membership in good standing with the Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers auxiliaires du Québec (OIIAQ) is required.

• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers or CPR Level C certification, or willingness to obtain.

• Minimum of one (1) year of full-time experience within the past three years in a primary care or ambulatory care setting serving an adult population.

• Must be fully bilingual in both French and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.

• Must be eligible to obtain a Reliability Status security clearance issued by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC).

Additional Information

• Contract position with the possibility of extension

• Full-time schedule: 37.5 hours per week (7.5 hours per day)

• Stable daytime schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

• Paid vacation and leave in accordance with applicable standards

• Competitive health and wellness benefits

• Structured, collaborative, and rewarding work environment

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the health and well-being of those who serve our country

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Join a team that values excellence, respect, and service. Apply today and make a real difference in the lives of Canada's military members!

The Photonic Systems Technician supports the development, testing, and sustainment of Ciena's Reconfigurable Line System (RLS) and related photonic products. This hands-on role is responsible for supporting laboratory equipment and automated test environments, supporting optical and system-level testing activities, conducting initial field-return evaluations, and maintaining laboratory hardware and inventory. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering teams to support product development, qualification, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management activities.

## Key Responsibilities

• Perform incoming field-return triage, basic fault isolation, and hardware evaluation using field logs, alarms and test results

• Execute optical, electrical, and system-level testing on photonic networking products.

• Build, configure, operate, and maintain automated photonic laboratory test systems and test setups supporting engineering development, validation, and qualification activities.

• Support the operation and maintenance of automated photonic laboratory test systems and equipment.

• Maintain laboratory inventory, engineering hardware, optical modules, and field-return assets.

• Create and maintain laboratory procedures, test records, and test setup documentation

• Support engineering change activities, component evaluations, and alternate-source qualification testing.

## Required Skills & Qualifications

• Diploma in Electronics Engineering Technology, Photonics, Telecommunications Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related technical field.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience working with optical, telecommunications, networking, or electronic systems in a laboratory, manufacturing, or field support environment

• Experience building, configuring, and troubleshooting laboratory test setups.

• Familiarity with fiber optic handling, inspection, cleaning, and testing practices.

• Experience using electronic and optical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, optical power meters, OTDRs, spectrum analyzers, and digital multimeters.

• Basic understanding of electronics, telecommunications, and optical networking concepts.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage equipment, inventory, and multiple tasks.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with optical transport, ROADM, WSS, OCM, amplifier, or photonic systems.

• Experience with fiber optic troubleshooting and optical performance measurements.

• Experience with automated test environments or scripting tools such as Python.

• Experience supporting product development, manufacturing, repair, or failure-analysis environments.

## 7-Axis CNC HBM Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

We are hiring a 7-Axis CNC Horizontal Boring Mill Operator for our facility in Barberton, Ohio!

The individual hired for this role will operate horizontal boring mills with vertical machining and boring attachments, with continuous path, to perform contouring, trepanning, milling, face milling, drilling, tapping, boring, and other CNC operations necessary for machining large-scale precision components. Additionally, the machinist will:

• Grind and perform handwork to deburr, as necessary

• Use electronic measuring probe to inspect work, as required

• Work from process, drawings, manuscripts, verbal and written instructions

• Obtain necessary tooling and information for tape or manual data input operations

• Position and secure work piece and fixtures on table; properly assembles tooling and connects attachments

• Use precision instruments to physically measure setup; observe digital readout and compensate to orient work piece and machine to tape or MDI

• Make test cut and rechecks setup; make in-process compensations to keep prints, tapes, and manuscripts coordinated at all times

• Keep equipment and work area clean and orderly

• Verify identity and physical characteristics of materials, as required

• Maintain necessary records and complete process documentation and any production records, as required

• Perform minor maintenance on machines and assist maintenance personnel as required during repairs

## Minimum Requirements:

In order to thrive in this role, individuals must possess the necessary skills to safely perform the required tasks. This includes having a high school diploma or GED equivalence coupled with at least three (3) years of experience performing multi-axis CNC HBM machining operations, with and without continuous path. Lesser experience coupled with formal education and/or certification may be considered. Desired applicants must also:

• Be knowledgeable of all machine functions and coded commands (both G and M code)

• Work to 0.000” tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary

• Use higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices

• Have experience with grinders, tool setter, jacks, clamps, bolts, shims, jigs, fixtures, angle plates, rules, micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, lapping equipment, gages, levels, protractors, verniers, and light hand tools

• Be able to pass all proficiency testing for the position

• Be a U.S. citizen

• Must be open and available to working all shifts

• Successfully pass all pre-employment processes, including an extensive criminal background check, a physical examination and drug screen, verification of education and work history, and reference checks.

## Physical Demands

While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required communicate verbally and with written information; to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and use ladders inside and outside of parts being machined. The employee is occasionally required to lift and move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

• Ability to define requirements, design solutions, and streamline business processes.

• Proven risk, issue, scope, and schedule management capability.

Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

Onsite in Lynchburg, VA

Your work will directly contribute to BWXT’s mission of delivering high‑consequence engineering with uncompromising precision.

• Collaborate closely with facility engineers, contractors, and maintenance teams to ensure safe and effective execution.

## Required Minimum Qualifications:

• Working knowledge of National Electric Code, NFPA 70E and 79, and 29 CFR 1910 OSHA Standards.

• Ability to support occasional emergency needs related to power distribution (less than 5% of the time).

• Experience with industrial or facility infrastructure design and industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated superior written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to thrive in a collaborative, team‑oriented environment.

• Proven ability to work independently with minimal guidance, interpret business needs, and recommend practical solutions.

• High self‑motivation with excellent attention to detail.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

As an MSP Sales Specialist, you will be responsible for accelerating the growth of Check Point’s Workspace Security business through our Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) ecosystem.

This is a high-impact, individual contributor sales role for someone who understands how MSPs operate, how they make money, and how to turn strong partner relationships into scalable recurring revenue. You will own the MSP sales motion within your assigned market—from identifying and developing high-potential partners to building joint business plans, creating pipeline, and driving opportunities through close.

Success in this role requires a start-up mentality within a global organization. You must be comfortable building new business, challenging the status quo, moving quickly, and taking ownership of results. You will work closely with MSP leadership, Channel, Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams to expand Check Point’s presence within the MSP/MSSP market.

## What You’ll Do

• Own MSP Revenue Growth: Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue, pipeline, and growth targets across assigned territory.

• Develop Strategic MSP Partners: Identify high-potential partners and build relationships with executive, sales, technical, and operational stakeholders to expand Check Point adoption.

• Recruit & Activate New Partners: Partner with recruitment and channel teams to identify, recruit, onboard, and activate new MSP/MSSP partners with clear expectations for revenue and pipeline generation.

• Build Joint Business Plans: Develop measurable partner business plans covering revenue targets, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, enablement, marketing, and growth opportunities.

• Create Pipeline: Proactively identify opportunities within partner customer bases and whitespace accounts rather than relying solely on partner-generated demand.

• Drive the Full Sales Cycle: Maintain ownership and visibility from opportunity identification through technical validation, commercial negotiation, and close.

• Manage and develop key distribution partner relationship: responsible for growing multiproduct MSP revenue through key distributor.

• Execute Joint GTM Strategies: Develop and execute co-selling, demand-generation, customer acquisition, and partner marketing initiatives designed to create measurable pipeline and revenue.

• Increase Partner Productivity: Help partners expand their security practices, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and increase recurring revenue through Check Point solutions.

• Become a Trusted Advisor: Understand each partner’s business model, customer base, growth strategy, competitive environment, and profitability drivers to position Check Point as a strategic part of their business.

• Lead with Security Expertise: Develop strong knowledge of Workspace Security solutions and clearly articulate their technical and business value to MSP executives, sellers, engineers, and customers.

• Drive Competitive Wins: Understand the competitive landscape and proactively position Check Point against competing cybersecurity and email security platforms.

• Maintain Operational Command: Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, partner plans, opportunity data, and next steps. Identify risks early and take action before they impact results.

• Own Partner Escalations: Serve as a point of escalation for strategic MSP partners, coordinating internal resources to resolve issues quickly while maintaining partner confidence.

• Operate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Sales, Channel, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to remove barriers and accelerate partner growth.

## What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of successful sales experience within MSP/MSSP, cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, or subscription-based technology environments.

• Demonstrated experience selling through and with MSP/MSSP partners, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue and managed services business models.

• Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue and pipeline targets.

• Strong understanding of how MSP/MSSP organizations generate revenue, build service offerings, manage margins, acquire customers, and scale recurring services.

• Experience recruiting, developing, and growing strategic partner relationships.

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships across multiple organizational levels, including MSP owners, executives, sales leaders, technical teams, and frontline sellers.

• Experience developing and executing partner business plans and joint GTM strategies that produce measurable revenue and pipeline.

• Strong prospecting and business-development skills with the ability to create opportunities rather than wait for inbound demand.

• Experience managing complex sales cycles involving partners, customers, technical stakeholders, and internal teams.

• Strong cybersecurity knowledge: experience with email security, endpoint security, SaaS security, or Workspace Security is highly preferred.

• Ability to translate technical cybersecurity capabilities into business outcomes, including risk reduction, operational efficiency, customer retention, recurring revenue, and profitability.

• Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM discipline.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and executive-engagement skills.

• Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment with limited direction.

• Strong business judgment with the ability to prioritize partners and opportunities based on revenue potential and strategic value.

• Bilingual with ability to speak both French and English.

## Must-Have Attributes

Enterprise Ownership: Operates beyond individual responsibilities and makes decisions based on what is best for the overall business. Takes accountability for results and actively helps teammates and partners succeed when support is needed.

Customer & Partner First: Keeps the MSP and end customer at the center of decisions, responding with urgency and working across organizational boundaries to deliver the right outcome.

Relentless Offense: Consistently looks for the next opportunity. Proactively creates pipeline, challenges obstacles, competes aggressively, and does not accept the first "no" as the final answer.

Growth & Agility: Embraces change and finds ways to grow the business without assuming additional resources or headcount. Adapts quickly, takes on new challenges, and uses available resources creatively.

Operational Command: Maintains a strong understanding of the business, including pipeline, forecast, partner performance, risks, priorities, and next actions. Anticipates issues and acts before they become barriers to execution.

Sense of Urgency: Moves quickly on business-critical opportunities, partner needs, and customer issues while proactively escalating blockers that could impact revenue or execution.

## What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building an MSP business that produces predictable, scalable, recurring growth. You will be expected to:

• Meet or exceed assigned quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Maintain sufficient qualified pipeline to support future revenue goals.

• Increase revenue and pipeline production from strategic MSP/MSSP partners.

• Recruit and activate new partners that generate measurable business.

• Build and execute joint business plans with priority partners.

• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM discipline.

• Create measurable pipeline through partner GTM and co-selling activities.

• Expand Check Point adoption across existing MSP customer bases.

• Build strong executive relationships with strategic partners.

• Identify risks early and take ownership of resolving issues that could impact revenue.

## Interview Focus Areas

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate:

• How they have built and grown revenue through MSP/MSSP partners.

• Their understanding of MSP economics and recurring-revenue business models.

• Examples of recruiting, activating, and developing new MSP partners.

• How they have turned underperforming partners into productive revenue relationships.

• Examples of joint GTM programs that produced measurable pipeline or revenue.

• Their approach to pipeline creation, forecasting, and opportunity management.

• Experience navigating complex partner and customer sales cycles.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity and the competitive security landscape.

• Ability to present a cybersecurity solution to both executive and technical audiences.

• Examples of taking ownership and delivering results in a fast-moving or ambiguous environment.

Must be authorized to work in Canada without sponsorship now or in the future.

## ## Job Information

Job Code: 00194001

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

## ## About the Job

We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products.
In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities.

## ## About You

• Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization.

• Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).

• Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry.

• Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).

• Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.

• Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.

## Summary

Reporting to the Production Supervisor, the Quality Control Technician plays a critical role in ensuring all incoming materials, in-process production, finished products, and shipping activities meet established quality standards. This position supports product integrity, customer satisfaction, and manufacturing excellence by performing inspections, maintaining accurate documentation, identifying quality issues, and driving corrective actions throughout the production process.

## Responsibilities

Quality Control & Inspection

• Conduct incoming inspections and testing of raw materials and purchased goods.

• Perform in-process and final product inspections to verify compliance with specifications and quality standards.

• Maintain visual inspection standards and support the development of inspection procedures.

• Ensure measuring and testing equipment is calibrated and maintained according to quality requirements.

• Review and archive production and quality documentation.

## Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

• Identify non-conforming materials and products and ensure appropriate containment and disposition.

• Participate in root cause investigations and corrective action activities.

• Submit and support Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and related quality processes.

• Support internal, customer, ISO, and safety management system audits.

• Collect and analyze quality data to support continuous improvement initiatives.

## Documentation & Communication

• Maintain accurate inspection, testing, and production records.

• Provide quality documentation to internal stakeholders and customers as required.

• Communicate quality issues, corrective actions, and process improvements across departments.

• Support production teams by providing guidance on inspection methods and quality requirements.

## Health, Safety & Team Support

• Follow all company health, safety, and environmental policies and procedures.

• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.

• Support manufacturing initiatives, cross-training activities, and other duties as assigned.

• Act as a key quality resource within the manufacturing operation.

## Qualifications

Education & Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• 6 months to 1 year of related experience in quality control, manufacturing, or a similar environment.

## Skills & Knowledge

• Experience using calibration equipment and precision measuring devices.

• Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in inspections and data entry.

• Ability to interpret procedures, specifications, and quality documentation.

• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to participate in root cause analysis and quality improvement activities.

## Why Join Mattr?

• Competitive wages with paid overtime and incentive bonus plans

• Safety boot allowance, PPE, and full safety training provided

• Flexible health, dental & vision benefits with Health Spending Account (HSA)

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance

• 24/7 Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP)

• Wellness, mental health & resilience programs

• Discounts through Perkopolis & GoodLife Fitness

• Year-round permanent work at one location plus staff social events

Xerxes, a division of Mattr is the largest manufacturer of underground fiberglass storage tanks in the world. With nearly 40 years of direct industry expertise, we are recognized as both a leading innovator and a trusted brand. We are always looking to add great people to the Mattr family, people whose skills and goals match our mission and values. If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic team environment where integrity and passion drives operational excellence, Mattr is for you!

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted. All recruiting activities are managed via our applicant tracking system. Please apply online to be considered for this opportunity.

At Sienna you won’t just fill a position; you will build lasting relationships with residents who call Aspira their home. Join us in a role where knowing each resident not just by name, but by story, is not just possible, it is expected. Our purpose is to cultivate happiness in daily life! We truly believe it is a privilege to serve Canada’s seniors, ensuring they live fulfilling lives with the utmost comfort, dignity, and respect.

## Why you belong here:

We are a purpose driven organization. We aspire to cultivate an environment and culture where team members feel valued, heard and empowered to do meaningful work. We offer a number of programs and benefits that support team members’ financial, personal and professional needs:

• A competitive salary and vacation package

• Health & Dental benefits program

• Share Ownership and Reward Program (SOAR)

• Employee Share Purchase Plan with company match

• Continuous learning and growth so you have the skillset needed to succeed and take on new challenges

• A welcoming culture that values diversity and differing perspectives, experiences and beliefs

## What you’ll be doing:

You will be a welcomed team member, working in a fast-paced environment where you will make a meaningful difference in residents’ lives. As a Resident Engagement Assistant you will do meaningful work everyday ensuring a safe and clean environment for residents’. As an individual and part of a wider team, you will be a strong contributor to the culture of the home, where the focus is always on helping residents live fully, every day.

## What makes you a great fit?

• Track participation and engagement data per organization guidelines

• Support the completion of leisure profiles on new residents within 14 days of move-in, as directed by REM Maintain updates to daily events, posters, and designated leisure bulletin boards

• Assist in the completion and distribution of the monthly event calendar

• Respond to emails within 24-48 hours or on your next scheduled shift

• Attend all required meetings

• Ensure all IPAC and infection control protocols are adhered to

• Order and maintain departmental supplies and equipment as requested by REM

• Maintain and organize leisure areas and equipment to provide a positive “tour ready” experience

• Work cooperatively with volunteers, student, and community groups

• Maintain a positive image of the community through ongoing communications

• Adhere to established departmental policies and procedures regarding resident interaction and documentation of feedback, issues, and concerns

• Follow all health and safety policies and procedures. Work safely to reduce the risk of injury to self, co-workers, and residents

• Maintain a sound working knowledge of the role and your responsibilities during all emergency situations, even when working different shifts

• Participate in drills to prepare for emergencies and attend all education sessions in relation to emergency preparedness

• Immediately advise supervisor or designate of all team member incidents that may result in an Occupational Accident Claim; any concerns with the physical plant, incidents or injuries, and complete required reports

• Work in accordance with the organization’s Health and Safety Policies and Procedures and in compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act

• Perform other duties as required

• A passion and commitment to promote, elevate, and support the health and happiness of seniors through lifestyle wellness experiences, including special events, outings, small and large group programming, and fitness based offerings

• Must be able to set priorities and meet time and calendar deadlines; workload may fluctuate as resident needs and occupancy change

• Effective verbal and written English communication skills required

• A degree/diploma in Gerontology, Kinesiology, Human Kinetics, Therapeutic Recreation, Leisure Studies, Health Promotion, or Health Sciences

• Experience working with seniors, including an understanding of motivational concepts with seniors, as well as health, wellbeing, and leisure principles

• Certified to teach land group fitness, and where necessary aquatic fitness to seniors through a reputable organization, as approved by Sienna and/or willing to obtain within the first 60 days post hire

• Valid driver’s license and/or special class license (or willingness and ability to obtain within the first 6 months of employment) and clean driving record

• Current certificate in CPR and First Aid

• Certificate in Smart Serve/Serving It Right (or willingness and ability to obtain)

• Ability to meet the physical demands of the position, including lifting, portering, driving, leading fitness programs a minimum of twice daily etc.

• Familiarity with the provincial Occupational Health and Safety Act

• Proficiency in Word, Publisher, PowerPoint, and Excel, as well as virtual technologies such as Zoom, Skype, FaceTime etc.

• Additional certifications (i.e., specialized fitness, supporting people with dementia, etc.) considered a valuable asset

• You must be legally eligible to work in Canada or have a valid work/study permit

• You must successfully pass a Vulnerable Sector Check and Criminal Records Check

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Opportunity: Work term of 4 months extendable to 8, starting in January 2027.

Ciena is seeking a student to contribute to the development and evolution of automation infrastructure used for next-generation ASIC devices. The role provides exposure to ASIC design, integration, layout, and verification activities within large-scale DSP ASIC development for optical communications. The position is aligned to a student’s experience, strengths, and technical interests.

## How you will make an impact:

• Contribute to the development of automation infrastructure for ASIC devices.

• Collaborate with developers and team leads to advance ASIC design, layout, integration, and verification activities.

• Develop design blocks and evaluate designs for correctness and performance.

• Implement netlists into silicon-realizable layouts and automate placement and extraction workflows.

• Create constraints, analyze implementation reports, and automate ASIC integration processes.

• Develop reusable SystemVerilog/UVM verification components.

• Enhance Python-based reporting, analysis, build, simulation, and debug workflows.

## The must haves:

• Programming experience using one or more of Java, Python, TCL, Skill/Ocean, or SystemVerilog.

• Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.

## Nice to haves:

• Previous experience with ASIC or FPGA development programs.

• Strong analytical and debugging skills.

• Familiarity with Agile, JIRA, Confluence, and Git.

Ciena’s WaveLogic family of products is a cornerstone of our optical fiber transmission solutions, driving innovation and success in the telecommunications industry. As a Digital ASIC Physical Implementation Engineer, you will play a critical role in developing large mixed-signal SoC ASICs targeting advanced technology nodes. Your contributions will directly impact the performance, power efficiency, and area optimization of our industry-leading WaveLogic ASICs.

In this role, you will:

• Scope and define the physical architecture of designs, utilizing EDA vendor tools to build, adapt, and maintain a robust flow from netlist to full closure and GDSII generation.

• Partner with RTL circuit designers and other layout engineers to create optimal floorplans, design power grids, and clock distribution networks that achieve the best performance and power efficiency.

• Navigate and fine-tune EDA tool settings, parameters, and attributes to ensure signoff-quality results with an optimal balance of performance, power, and area (PPA).

• Identify and propose alternative implementations, trade-offs, and solutions to achieve lower power consumption and higher performance.

• Collaborate with analog designers and ASIC/SoC teams to integrate analog blocks seamlessly into the overall design.

• Conduct initial Place & Route trials to refine design and correlation, influencing circuit architecture by working closely with RTL designers and architects to ensure reliable and closable physical design.

• Generate and implement timing ECOs to achieve timing closure, as well as functional ECOs to address RTL feature fixes when necessary.

• Utilize tools like Formality or Conformal for formal verification, analyzing reports and ensuring design accuracy and integrity.

• Write scripts to enhance productivity and efficiency for yourself and other backend engineers. Collaborate with tool and technology vendors to drive fixes, improve workflows, and evaluate new tools and features.

• Produce concise status reports at various stages of development, highlighting trade-offs and providing actionable insights.

• Resolve timing challenges associated with DFT through scan chain reordering, placement, and CTS constraints.

• Run Static Timing Analysis (STA), analyze timing reports, and debug issues related to timing constraints and correlation between P&R and STA tools.

• Your expertise in physical design, collaboration with cross-functional teams, and ability to innovate will be instrumental in advancing Ciena’s cutting-edge optical networking solutions.

## The Must Haves:

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science or other applicable scientific degree coupled with significant experience in ASIC physical digital design and timing closure

• Understanding of the submicron technology nodes full backend ASIC flow and timing/power/area analysis and trade-offs.

• Proven experience working with Place&Route tools.

• Practical experience developing scripts to automate tasks throughout the backend flow.

• Understanding of UPF and SOCV/POCV concepts

## Nice to Haves:

• Experience in working with multiple power domains

• Experience with physical verification (Calibre).

• Experience with power integrity (EMIR)

• Hand-on experience creating and validating timing constraints

• Experience with Static Timing Analysis (STA)

• Experience with physical synthesis and full RTL-to-GDS flow using industry-standard EDA tools

This is a part-time position where we require someone who can work Mondays and Fridays up to a total of 15 hours per week; work hours are 7:30am to 4pm. We are offering competitive compensation.

As an Operating Room Technician (OR Tech), you’ll play a critical role in supporting life-changing procedures while ensuring the highest standards of care. This is your chance to bring your skills to a unique and meaningful setting where your expertise truly matters.

Operating Room Technicians (OR Tech) assist surgeons, internal medicine specialists, physicians with endoscopy, cystoscopy, and minor surgery procedures. Their work includes providing patient care during all aspects of procedure, preparing for procedures, assisting with procedures, cleaning procedure room, cleaning, disinfecting and sterilizing equipment. OR Tech works under the direction of surgeon internal medicine specialist, physicians during procedures and act as a part of the health care team.

Why Choose This Role?

Exclusive Patient Base: Work solely with Canadian Armed Forces members, making a difference in the lives of those who serve.

Dynamic Environment: Collaborate with a highly skilled team of surgeons, physicians, and healthcare professionals.

Career

Growth: Hone your skills and stay at the forefront of best practices with opportunities for professional development.

## Responsibilities

The required tasks for this occupational group include the following:

a. Assist surgeons, internal medicine specialists, physicians before, during and after endoscopy, cystoscopy, and minor surgery procedures.

b. Assist the patients before, during and after procedures according to best practices and clinic procedures.

c. Perform patient administration and charting according to clinic procedure.

d. Prepare for appropriate procedures in the endoscopy, cystoscopy, and minor procedure rooms.

e. Clean and disinfect procedure rooms in accordance with Canadian Safety Association (CSA) standards.

f. High level disinfect or sterilize endoscopes and cystoscope according to manufacture instructions and CSA standards.

g. Sterilize all equipment according to manufacture instructions and CSA standards.

h. Perform quality assurance test on equipment in medical device reprocessing department according to CSA standards.

i. Perform equipment maintenance in MDRD and procedure rooms according to manufacture instructions and CSA standards.

j. Maintain professional competence in practice by participating in workshops and conferences to learn current best practice in procedures and techniques.

k. Follow the continuing competency program according to the provincial or territorial regulatory authority for LPN/RPNs.

l. Follow CSA standards for the storage of medical supplies.

m. order medical equipment and supplies for medical device reprocessing department (MDRD) and procedure rooms.

n. Ensure proper storage, maintenance, and security of medical supplies within MDRD and procedure rooms according to CSA standards.

o. Maintain stock of medical supplies within MDRD and procedure rooms

p. Ensure that Work Hazardous Materials Information System (WHMIS) standards are followed when working in MDRD and procedure rooms.

q. Maintain records required for quality control and workload statistics; and

r. Other associated tasks relevant to this occupational group.

## Qualifications

All OR Techs must, as a minimum, have:

a. A Certificate of Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Provider or equivalent such as Cardio-pulmonary Resuscitation/Automated External Defibrillator (CPR/AED) Level C. Annual recertification is required; and

c. A certificate from Medical Device Reprocessing Course with a minimum 3 years of experience within the last 5 years medical device reprocessing and endoscope reprocessing; and

d. Have a minimum 3 years of experience within the last 5 years working in a endoscopy, cystoscopy and minor procedure suites; and

You will be able to obtain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level

This position directly supports the Defense Fuels mission space by enabling reliable, high‑speed data acquisition and integrated controls across critical fuel infrastructure, ensuring secure and compliant operations where high‑speed LabVIEW systems interface with low‑speed PLC‑controlled platforms to maintain mission readiness. The engineer leads development of high‑speed LabVIEW data acquisition and control systems, ensures synchronized communication, data integrity, and reliability across multi‑platform control architectures, and provides engineering support for a diverse range of test operations, from small benchtop setups to large‑scale industrial qualification stands. An active DOE Q clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain one, is required.

## Location:

## Your Day to Day as a LabVIEW Systems Engineer:

• Architect, develop, and maintain LabVIEW applications for high-speed data acquisition and real-time control.

• Design communication bridges between high-speed LabVIEW systems and low-speed PLC platforms.

• Collaborate with PLC engineers to align LabVIEW logic with interlocks, alarming, and I/O management.

• Prepare wiring diagrams, loop sheets, channel maps, and system documentation.

• Coordinate with vendors and generate technical reports.

• Implement software configuration management for LabVIEW, FPGA, and test automation code.

• Lead automation initiatives using Python, MATLAB, and AI-supported engineering processes.

• Mentor junior engineers and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

• Provide engineering design, troubleshooting, and commissioning support across multiple test stands of varying scale and complexity.

## Required Qualifications:

• B.S. or M.S. in Engineering or Physics or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience with LabVIEW development and test system integration.

• Experience coordinating LabVIEW applications with PLC-controlled systems.

• Experience supporting both small-scale and large-scale automated test stands.

• Experience designing and validating automated test stands or instrumentation systems.

• Excellent technical communication and documentation skills.

• U.S. citizenship required.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• NI CLD or CLA certification.

• Experience with LabVIEW RT/FPGA and deterministic data streaming.

• Familiarity with PlantPAx, FactoryTalk, OPC UA, Modbus, and industrial networks.

## Position Overview: Quality Assurance Specialist – Enrichment Operations

As a Quality Assurance Specialist supporting BWXT’s Enrichment Operations, you will play an essential role in maintaining and improving ISO 9001 quality processes and ensuring that products meet internal specifications, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements. You will support inspections, audits, corrective actions, document control, and continuous improvement efforts within a high‑precision, manufacturing environment. This role is key to maintaining compliance, supporting operational excellence, and sustaining a strong quality culture across the organization.

## Location

On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee

## Your Day-to-Day as a Quality Assurance Specialist

Quality Management System (ISO 9001)
• Support implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
• Ensure compliance with documented procedures, work instructions, and quality policies.
• Assist with internal and external ISO 9001 audits, including preparation, execution, and follow-up.
• Track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and support root cause analysis activities.

Manufacturing Quality Assurance
• Perform incoming, in-process, and final product inspections according to specifications.
• Review production records, inspection results, and test data for compliance and accuracy.
• Identify nonconforming products and initiate corrective actions following QMS procedures.
• Collaborate with Production, Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve quality‑related issues.

Documentation & Records Control
• Maintain accurate quality records, inspection reports, and audit documentation.
• Ensure controlled documents remain current, approved, and properly distributed.
• Support change management processes and revisions tied to quality documentation.

Continuous Improvement
• Analyze quality metrics and trends including scrap, rework, and defect data.
• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as Lean, Kaizen, and Six Sigma activities.
• Assist with training employees on quality procedures, standards, and best practices.

## Required Qualifications

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• Two (2+) years of experience in a manufacturing quality role.
• Working knowledge of ISO 9001 standards and requirements.
• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and quality control techniques.
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
• Must be a U.S. citizen capable of obtaining and maintaining a DOE Q clearance.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to work cross-functionally in a manufacturing environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting ISO 9001 certification or surveillance audits.
• Internal auditing experience; ISO 9001 internal auditor training preferred.
• Familiarity with root cause analysis tools (5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA).
• Experience using quality management systems (QMS) or related software.
• Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma principles.
• Broad knowledge of quality systems and tools such as ISO 9001, SPC, Lean, and Six Sigma.
• Experience with audits, CAPA processes, and corrective action documentation.

## Skills & Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
• Analytical and problem‑solving skills.
• Effective verbal and written communication.
• Ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a manufacturing environment.
• Organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

## What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance (as applicable).
• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and continuing education support.
• An inclusive workplace that values diverse perspectives and cross‑generational collaboration.
• The chance to contribute to mission‑critical nuclear and national security programs.
• Continuous learning and training opportunities to support long‑term career growth.

A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

Position Overview:
We’re seeking a I&C Engineer to lead major process controls engineering projects spanning digital control systems (PLC/DCS/HMI), complex test stands, and chemical processes. You will take problems from issue to solution, setting expectations for data-driven decision making, automation, and the responsible use of AI/agentic AI to improve workflows, reduce rework, and deliver cost-effective, compliant designs. This role blends hands-on engineering (design, fabrication, assembly, programming, testing) with technical leadership, client engagement, and rigorous software configuration management.

## Location:

On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

## Your Day to Day as an Instrumentation & Controls Engineer:

• Engineers and integrates PLC, DCS, HMI, network switches, and control systems; lead programming and commissioning for Allen-Bradley platforms (ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Studio 5000, FactoryTalk).

• Implements robust controls architectures, safety interlocks, alarming, data logging, recipe management, and historian integrations for test and process systems.

• Develops Functional Requirements and Procurement Specifications for instrumentation and control components and systems.

• Prepares design input documentation for drawings including cable block diagrams, wiring schematics, loop sheets, and detailed I/O maps.

• Helps in creating and maintaining P&IDs and System Design Descriptions (SDDs).

• Interfaces with vendors; prepare and review equipment purchase specifications.

• Produces clear, concise technical reports and engineering studies.

• Establishes and enforce software configuration management (SCM) for PLC/HMI code, scripts, and documentation.

• Reviews design drawings and documentation produced by others.

• Directs process‑improvement initiatives: automate calculations, summarize technical documents, generate design documentation, and guide when/how AI or agentic AI tools are used.

• Oversees engineering automation via Python, MATLAB, or advanced Excel; review and validates automated outputs.

• Champions responsible integration of AI/ML into controls systems, including predictive maintenance and anomaly detection.

• Mentors less experienced I&C engineers and support multidisciplinary engineering teams.

## Required Qualifications:

• B.S. or M.S. in Engineering from an ABET accredited program.

• 5+ years of experience in design engineering for process control systems.

• Hands on expertise with Rockwell/Allen‑Bradley PLCs and FactoryTalk systems.

• Experience designing, fabricating, assembling, programming, and testing test stands and chemical process systems.

• Strong SCM proficiency including Git, versioning, and code reviews.

• Excellent communication skills and experience reviewing design drawings.U.S. citizenship required.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in a related engineering field.

• Experience with PlantPAx, FactoryTalk Analytics, OPC UA, historians, and industrial networking.

• Familiarity with SIS, PHA, ISA standards, and NFPA/NEC codes.

• Experience integrating AI/ML into industrial systems.

• Additional learning such as CS, AI, or Software Engineering certificates or minors.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Position Overview:
The Gas Testing Engineer is responsible for coordinating cross functional system design and gas testing activities supporting the development, optimization, and scale up of gas centrifuge-based systems used in uranium enrichment. This role integrates hands on gas testing, pilot plant operations, systems engineering, and project leadership. The engineer will drive schedule, budget, risk, and change management while ensuring safe, compliant, and high-quality execution across all phases of development.

## Location:

On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

## Your Day to Day as a Gas Testing Engineer:

• Lead a cross functional team, coordinating schedules, budgets, scope, and resources.

• Facilitate recurring team meetings focused on task tracking, issue identification, and resolution.

• Provide technical guidance and conduct detailed reviews of engineering and testing documentation.

• Coordinate with adjacent leads for alignment across mechanical, electrical, and I&C systems.

• Develop and implement gas centrifuge testing protocols; analyze results to improve system throughput, reliability, and separation performance.

• Conduct advanced R&D in gas processing and separation technologies.

• Lead pilot plant design, construction, and operations to validate and scale new processes.

• Integrate pilot plant findings into facility design, including process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), and equipment specifications.

• Ensure cohesive interface control across mechanical, electrical, and I&C systems.

• Identify issues, track risks, and develop mitigation plans; manage change and risk release processes.

• Review and coordinate Design Change Requests (DCRs) and ensure updates are reflected in the integrated schedule.

• Coordinate with Procurement Engineering, Purchasing, Quality, and suppliers to ensure components meet technical, cost, delivery, and quality requirements.

• Communicate with internal and external stakeholders on technical and programmatic issues.

• Drive schedule and budget adherence; support weekly progress reporting (e.g., Quad Chart).

• Provide briefings on risks, issues, and schedule performance.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Nuclear, related Engineering, or Physics discipline.

• Seven (7)+ years of experience in system design, test engineering, and/or process development.

• Experience in gas processing, separation technologies, and precision gas testing environments.

• Hands on pilot plant design and operations experience for chemical or process development.

• Proficiency with process simulation tools (Aspen Plus, HYSYS) and engineering software such as MATLAB or Python.

• Strong skills in scheduling, budgeting, risk and change management, and cross disciplinary coordination.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• U.S. citizenship required.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with gas centrifuge testing or fuel cycle technology development.

• Familiarity with facility design practices (PFDs, P&IDs, equipment specifications).

• Experience with NRC or DOE requirements.

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure.

• Active DOE Q or DoD clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Quality Engineer 3 -- Quality Assurance

## Position Overview:

Develop, implement and audit Quality Assurance and Quality Control to assure compliance to customer requirements or national standards. Maintain the quality of specific products; control (and be knowledgeable of) procedures, analysis, documents and system requirements for the products. Perform system evaluations to ensure compliance with customer, regulatory or internal specifications. Continually strive for improved quality standards that shall lower total costs of products and processes at NFS.

## Location:

Onsite in Erwin, TN

## Your Day to Day as a Quality Engineer 3:

• Coordinate production, laboratory, analytical data, statistical analysis to assure timely release of raw materials, in-process materials, and final product which meets specifications.

• Maintain, coordinate, verify the quality of analytical reports, record retention, product sampling, personnel qualifications non-conformance control, quality trends, etc.

• Review contract specs to ascertain quality requirements; prepare support information for approval submittals to customers; review LOAs, SOPs, shipping documents, and other internal procedures/documents to assure compliance to all quality requirements; prepare, review Certifications of Final Product.

• Prepare, review statistical evaluations, process control charts, and process improvement techniques; make appropriate recommendations to management.

• Plan, perform, and follow-up audits and system evaluations of production, QA, QC, calibration, security, materials control, safety, ALARA, Fitness-for-Duty Program, and vendor QA/QC.

• Supervise, maintain, coordinate the control and calibration of measurements, inspection, and test equipment for the process and laboratory areas.

• Coordinate, maintain off-site analytical services, laboratory qualification, customer cross-checks schedules, nuclear materials vault (quality retention).

• Coordinate (with internal/external organizations) shipping schedules, in-house/off-site analytical services, inventory preparations, and vendor audits. Initiate, recommend projects to achieve better quality for less cost.

## Required Qualifications:

Bachelor of Science OR Bachelor of Arts degree with two additional years of experience in QA/QC.

Six-eight years' experience in quality assurance or quality control (8 years without Engineering Degree) is needed to attain adequate knowledge and competence to fulfill the duties of Quality Engineer 3. If an individual is an ASQC-certified quality engineer or certified quality auditor, four years of Quality Engineering experience (six without Engineering Degree) is acceptable.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

Position Overview:
As our MES Technical Lead, IT you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of digital manufacturing and production information systems to meet evolving business needs. You will partner closely with internal stakeholders to gather and translate functional requirements into scalable solutions that enhance production capabilities and streamline business processes. In this hands-on role, you will drive process optimization initiatives, define target architectures, and oversee the development of control and testing procedures. You will also lead the implementation of new capabilities, support application consolidation and upgrades, guide data migration activities, and ensure systems are effectively configured to deliver operational value, all while collaborating with cross-functional teams and reporting to the Senior Manager, Information Technology, Commercial Operations.

## Location:

Onsite in Melbourne, FL or remote

## Your Day to Day as a MES Technical Lead, IT:

• Leading teams: Leading technical and functional teams throughout project lifecycles.

• System configuration: Performing hands-on configuration in application modules. Establish and enforce MES configuration standards, ensuring sustainable long-term system health.

• Business requirement collection: Collecting, reviewing, and prioritizing business requirements.

• System optimization: Recommending ways to optimize existing systems, and ensure harmonization with ERP, QMS, timekeeping, and other systems.

• System design: Architecting and designing manufacturing solutions to meet business requirements, collaborating with infrastructure and network teams to ensure high availability and operational continuity.

• Meeting facilitation: Facilitating meetings with stakeholders, project teams, and external partners.

• Business process streamlining: Streamlining business processes to improve operational efficiency, ensuring alignment with both best practices and business requirements.

• Problem diagnosis: Diagnosing, troubleshooting, resolving, and testing problems in production systems including SAP, MES, timekeeping systems, quality systems, and other production-centric information systems.

• Security: Ensuring system security best practices are followed.

• Data integrity: Promoting data integrity and solving data consistency issues.

• Technical leadership: Providing technical leadership to project delivery teams.

• Quality assurance: Ensuring the integrity of solutions through quality assurance practices.

• Training: Training end-users on new processes and solutions.

• Team management: Recruiting, developing, and mentoring team members.

• External partner coordination: Coordinating and leading external partners and consultants.

• Collaboration: Leading and working together in teams with differing needs towards a shared goal.

• Project management: Demonstrating project leadership skills and techniques.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant work experience.

• Direct hands-on experience with MES systems such as iBase-t Solumina.

• Strong understanding of MES best practices and how to maximize out-of-the-box capabilities before considering customizations.

• Experience capturing business requirements, developing solution designs, planning and conducting data migrations, information system harmonization, and portfolio shaping.

• Strong understanding of project, portfolio, organizational change management, waterfall, and agile project management techniques.

• Experience participating with a PMO, business steering committee, or similar.

• Excellent technical architecture and technical support documentation skills.

• Excellent in preparing technical and executive level presentations and diagrams.

• Excellent written, oral, and presentation communication skills.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• ERP, Timekeeping, and QMS systems knowledge preferred.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You'll Do

• Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers

• Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation

• Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions

• Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes

• Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices

• Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery

• Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features

• Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities

• Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact

• Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

What Success Looks Like

• 45 days: Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.

• 60 days: Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.

• 90 days: Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation

• 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.

• 1 year: Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

Who You Are

• 2-3 years experience in implementation, project delivery, business analysis, customer onboarding, training, or a related customer-facing role.

• Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to translate requirements into clear plans, workflows, documentation, or customer enablement materials.

• Comfort managing timelines, risks, competing priorities, and customer expectations.

• Solid understanding of data migrations and integration models (APIs, webhooks, batch processing)

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong stakeholder management abilities

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Collaborative team player who can also operate independently

• Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement

• Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, professional services, GRC, compliance, HR, legal, investigations, or risk-related environment (an asset!)

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!

• Generous professional development budget

• RRSP/ 401k matching program

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.
