Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You'll Do

• Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers

• Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation

• Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions

• Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes

• Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices

• Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery

• Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features

• Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities

• Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact

• Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

What Success Looks Like

• 45 days: Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.

• 60 days: Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.

• 90 days: Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation

• 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.

• 1 year: Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

Who You Are

• 2-3 years experience in implementation, project delivery, business analysis, customer onboarding, training, or a related customer-facing role.

• Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to translate requirements into clear plans, workflows, documentation, or customer enablement materials.

• Comfort managing timelines, risks, competing priorities, and customer expectations.

• Solid understanding of data migrations and integration models (APIs, webhooks, batch processing)

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong stakeholder management abilities

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Collaborative team player who can also operate independently

• Growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement

• Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, professional services, GRC, compliance, HR, legal, investigations, or risk-related environment (an asset!)

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)

• Generous professional development budget

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

CareersInnerInfo

Plan, design, test, and deploy log source integrations into Microsoft Sentinel and CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM.

Act as the subject matter expert for Microsoft Sentinel and provide expertise in SIEM engineering and onboarding activities.

Design and maintain Microsoft Sentinel data collection capabilities, including data connectors, Data Collection Rules (DCRs), KQL transformations, custom tables, Azure Monitor Agent deployment, syslog/CEF forwarding, and custom log ingestion.

Design and maintain CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM onboarding capabilities, including data connectors, Falcon Log Collector deployments, HEC ingestion, routing pipelines, and custom parsers.

Build and maintain API-based integrations and automation scripts using technologies such as REST APIs, PowerShell, Python, and Bash.

Optimize data ingestion for quality, completeness, normalization, and cost efficiency.

Validate onboarded data sources, including parsing accuracy, field mapping, data health, latency, and coverage.

Develop and deliver operational handover documentation for the Security Operations Center, including onboarding checklists, data dictionaries, monitoring guidance, known limitations, and operational runbooks.

Maintain log source inventories, technical documentation, and onboarding backlogs.

Perform ad hoc firewall changes and provide recommendations related to network architecture, hardening, segmentation, log transport, and collector placement.

Contribute to the architecture, design, implementation, and integration of the Claroty OT security platform.

Partner with project managers, customers, and technical teams to deliver successful security solutions.

Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute thought leadership to the evolution of SIEM engineering practices.

Perform other related duties as required within the scope of the role.

## Qualifications

Minimum five years of experience in security engineering, SIEM engineering, or enterprise log management.

Demonstrated subject matter expertise with Microsoft Sentinel, including Data Collection Rules, data connectors, Azure Monitor Agent, KQL, and ingestion-time transformations.

Strong experience onboarding and managing enterprise-scale log sources and security telemetry.

Experience with API integrations, authentication technologies, automation, and scripting using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.

Strong Windows and Linux administration experience, including logging, services, agents, system hardening, and troubleshooting.

Working knowledge of enterprise networking and firewall technologies, including rules, NAT, segmentation, and syslog/CEF transport.

Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.

Ability to work independently, solve complex technical challenges, and deliver solutions directly to customers.

Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

Experience in professional services, consulting, or managed service provider environments is considered a strong asset.

Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM is strongly preferred.

Experience with operational technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS), or the Claroty platform is considered an asset.

Experience with observability, log-routing, or data-pipeline technologies is considered an asset.

Familiarity with standards such as ASIM or Elastic Common Schema is considered an asset.

Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, AZ-500, CrowdStrike certifications, Security+, or CISSP are considered assets.

This position is fully remote within Canada.

Occasional after-hours support may be required in response to customer emergencies.

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

As a Senior Software Application Developer you will help set technical direction and deliver durable, secure software for Case IQ’s platform. You will help lead complex cross-functional initiatives, raise engineering standards, and shape how product teams use AI-native and agentic engineering practices to move from idea to production safely and effectively.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You’ll Do

• Own the architecture and technical direction for high-impact platform capabilities, balancing product velocity, reliability, security, maintainability, and long-term operating cost.

• Design and evolve scalable APIs, distributed services, and data flows using TypeScript, Node.js, Redis, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL, and event-driven patterns.

• Lead the engineering of AI-enabled product capabilities, including LLM integrations, retrieval and evaluation pipelines, orchestration, tool use, and human-in-the-loop controls appropriate for enterprise workflows.

• Establish agentic SDLC practices that improve delivery quality and speed: specification driven development, AI assisted design and implementation, automated test generation, code review support, release validation, and incident investigation.

• Build robust evaluation and guardrail systems for AI assisted and agentic workflows, covering quality, safety, security, privacy, observability, cost, regression detection, and rollback.

• Set standards for production readiness across AWS services such as CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, ECS, Lambda, RDS, and related cloud-native infrastructure.

• Drive secure-by-design implementation, including OWASP-aligned practices, tenant isolation, data protection, secrets management, access control, and compliance-aware engineering decisions.

• Lead ambiguous, multi-team initiatives from technical discovery through rollout; make sound trade-offs and communicate rationale clearly to engineering, product, design, QA, and leadership.

• Raise the bar for engineering excellence through architecture reviews, high-signal code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates, reliability practices, and pragmatic documentation.

• Mentor senior and developing engineers, multiply team capability, and help shape technical roadmaps, hiring, and engineering operating practices.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent depth of professional experience.

• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial experience designing and operating large-scale, customer-facing SaaS systems; demonstrated technical leadership across teams is essential.

• Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, API design, distributed systems, and pragmatic system architecture.

• Demonstrated experience building or operating AI-enabled software in production, including LLM application patterns, RAG or retrieval systems, tool calling or workflow orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and risk controls.

• Hands-on experience using and improving AI-native or agentic SDLC workflows while maintaining rigorous human review, test coverage, security controls, and accountable engineering ownership.

• Strong experience with Docker or container platforms, GitHub, CI/CD, observability, and cloud security practices.

• Expert judgment in event-driven architecture, multi-tenancy, performance, reliability, and security; able to choose simple, resilient solutions under real delivery constraints.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence technical direction and explain complex trade-offs to varied audiences.

• A coaching mindset and a track record of raising the effectiveness of teams through mentoring, standards, and collaborative technical leadership.

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (We have employees spanning 7 countries!)

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!

• Generous professional development budget

• RRSP/ 401k matching program

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

In this role you and your team will lead design enablement of advanced high-speed analog circuits in the latest deep-submicron CMOS and/or BiCMOS technologies. You’ll drive and implement best-in-class high-speed analog layouts that extract the highest performance from the world’s most advanced CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. These analog macros include electrical interface-facing DAC and ADC based SERDES solutions for 112G and 224G, optical-line-facing high-speed DAC and ADC circuits working with optical modulators and detectors, transimpedance amplifiers, modulator driver circuits, and critical precision analog circuits for control and monitoring functions.

## How Will You Contribute

• Work closely with Ciena’s international layout, circuit design, and packaging groups across different time zones and regions.

• Plan and schedule projects to ensure successful delivery while maintaining a healthy work–life balance for the team.

• Lead Block and Macro level layout development including floor-planning, layout creation and optimization.

• Perform feasibility work with various circuit topologies working with senior analog designers to achieve a best-in-class solutions to carry through detailed implementation by weighing tradeoffs and discussing these with other members of the team.

• Undertake physical verification and electromigration checks

• Perform PERC verification and debugging for ESD structures.

• Automate layout flows with scripts and pcells.

• Develop and implement template-based layout methodology.

• Provide status updates on a regular basis, participate in team meetings and share experience with the broader team.

• Mentor junior team members and co-op students

## Must Haves

• 15+ years of layout experience

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical or computer engineering, computer science, or in a related field.

• Proven experience in leading analog high-speed layout design within advanced BiCMOS and/or CMOS technologies, with years of industry experience.

• Successful experience in managing and delivering MPWs, test chips, and product chips.

• Ability to thoroughly understand challenging design rules from leading-edge manufacturing processes.

• Proficient in reading and debugging Calibre/ICV verification decks.

• Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.

• Demonstrated ability to methodically solve complex technical challenges.

• Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Advanced proficiency with industry-standard analog design tools such as Cadence, Mentor, and Synopsys (e.g., Virtuoso, Calibre).

Semtech’s Signal Integrity Products group designs high performance optical networking product platforms that enable hyperscale data center applications, enterprise networking, wireless infrastructure including 5G networks, and passive optical network/Fibre-to-the-X markets.

To put it simply, whenever you use your computer to browse the web or use your smartphone to make a video call, most likely, your data is passing through one of many high-speed analog chips designed by the Analog IC teams at Semtech. Our experience and expertise ensures we are always pushing the boundaries of networking speed, ensuring the best experience for our end users – you!

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

## Position Overview:

The Project Manager will support BWXT’s nuclear maritime applications. The Project Manager is responsible for leading, coordinating, and executing project activities across a technically complex and multi disciplinary environment. This role ensures that program objectives are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with all contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements. The PM serves as a central point of contact for internal teams, external customers, and stakeholders supporting AT program initiatives.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, Virginia at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a Project Manager, Civil Maritime:

• Serve as the primary liaison for project, proposal, and contract activities with internal and external customers.

• Lead development, coordination, and submission of proposals, ensuring compliance with technical, cost, and schedule requirements.

• Manage execution of contracts, internal work authorizations, subcontracts, and other formal project documents.

• Develop, maintain, and monitor project risk registers and action item tracking logs.

• Partner with functional groups to establish and maintain project controls, integrated schedules, budgets, performance metrics, and baselines.

• Track and manage project budgets, expenditures, and earned value against approved plans.

• Build and maintain project forecasts, including bookings, revenue, cost performance, and gross margin targets.

• Collaborate closely with technical leads, engineering teams, and supporting organizations to ensure project milestones remain on schedule and within budget.

• Coordinate timely and transparent communication across stakeholders, preparing and delivering technical and commercial briefings as needed.

• Provide proactive issue resolution, develop alternative strategies, and maintain alignment with evolving program and customer needs.

• Ensure all project activities adhere to regulatory, security, and quality requirements associated with the project.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of ten (10) years professional experience is required.

• A minimum of five (5) years project management experience is required.

• Must have experience using Oracle Primavera (P6) schedule management.

• Must have demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both internally and externally.

• Must have strong skills in analyzing, condensing, and developing technical and commercial project information.

• Must have proven ability to develop creative technical and commercial approaches to complex project challenges.

• Must have demonstrable adaptability and resilience in changing project environments.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working within nuclear, radioisotope, or highly regulated technical environments is strongly preferred.

• Experience creating and maintaining project schedules, resource loading, cost controls, and project baselines.

• Experience leading Agile development teams using the Scrum / Kanban process.

• Previous supervisory or mentorship experience is preferred.

• PMP certification and/or MBA is preferred.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Pay: $115,000.00 - $180,000.00

The base salary range for this position in Virginia (US-VA) at the start of employment is expected to be between $115,000.00 and $180,000.00 per year. However, the base salary offered is based on local job market factors, and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to these considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, such as an annual cash incentive in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and/or other benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided at such time the selected job candidate receives an offer of employment. If hired, the selected job candidate will be employed 'at-will,’ unless employed at a location and in a position subject to a collective bargaining agreement. The company further reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment, compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and other market factors.

Calian est fière de poursuivre une relation contractuelle de longue date avec le ministère de la Défense nationale pour fournir des services de soins de santé aux Forces armées canadiennes. Par l'entremise de notre Contrat de Soins de Santé, Calian embauche des professionnels de la santé qui contribuent à la santé et au bien-être de nos militaires partout à travers le Canada. Pour plus d'informations sur ce poste, veuillez contacter Myriam DeRoo, recruteuse bilingue par courriel à myriam.deroo@calian.com.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian recherche actuellement un Technicien en services de Santé publique pour une opportunité de travail à la BFC de Bagotville au Saguenay. Nous comprenons l'importance d'un équilibre sain entre la vie personnelle et professionnelle. Nous cherchons continuellement à créer un impact positif sur la qualité de vie de nos employés. Nous avons des occasions uniques pour travailler dans un environnement avec des défis et enrichissants mettant l'accent sur le travail d'équipe.

Les techniciens en services de santé publique possèdent une expertise, des connaissances et des compétences spécialisées dans les domaines des programmes liés à la santé publique. Leurs principales fonctions comprennent les activités de conformité et de surveillance, les inspections, l'évaluation des risques pour la santé, la résolution des plaintes et la recommandation de mesures à prendre conformément aux lois, aux règlements et aux politiques. L'analyse de données, la préparation de rapports, la formulation de recommandations et la prise de mesures appropriées font également partie des exigences de ce poste. Le technologue en services de santé publique fait partie de l'équipe de soins de santé en effectuant des inspections d'établissements selon des calendriers établis.

## Responsibilities

• Effectuer des inspections de la santé publique pour les installations du MDN et des FAC situées à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de la base ; vérifier la conformité des services alimentaires, de l'hébergement, de l'eau potable et récréative, etc.

• Enquêtes et rapports sur les maladies transmissibles

• Préparation de formations

• Effectuer des échantillonnages

• Préparer et soumettre des rapports de santé publique pour chaque inspection au gestionnaire de tâches dans les 15 jours civils suivant la date de l'inspection.

• Faire fonctionner, calibrer et entretenir le matériel d'échantillonnage

• Maintenir et commander des produits liés à la santé publique et des fournitures consommables

• Le travail peut s'effectuer dans divers environnements et la personne peut être exposée à des niveaux de bruit élevés, à la chaleur, au froid et à des conditions humides/glissantes. Le MDN fournira des EPI non réutilisables (c.-à-d. des protections auditives et oculaires).

## Qualifications

Le technologue en services de santé publique doit avoir au minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans l'un des domaines suivants:

• Inspections ainsi que l'évaluation des risques, la réduction des risques, la communication des risques afin d'atténuer, de réduire ou d'éliminer les dangers pour la santé et l'application des programmes, des règlements, des directives et/ou de la législation en matière de santé publique;

• Présentation de rapports aux ministères provinciaux et fédéraux;

• Rédaction de rapports techniques, de procédures opérationnelles normalisées et de séances d'information dans les domaines de l'environnement et de la santé publique;

• Compétences bien développées en communication verbale, y compris la capacité de faire des présentations ; réalisation d'enquêtes sur l'environnement ou la santé publique;

• Capacite à travailler en équipe multidisciplinaire.

## Additional Requirements

• Contract à temps plein

• Permis de conduire provincial valide (doit être prêt à voyager localement et à l'extérieur de la base vers d'autres lieux de travail dans la zone de responsabilité de l'unité)

• Horaire du lundi au vendredi (7h30AM-4PM)

Do your friends stop talking to you on hikes because you keep identifying every plant and bird? If so, we may have the perfect role for you! We currently have an opening for a permanent full-time Senior Environmental Professional based in any of the following NB offices: Fredericton, Moncton or Saint John.

About Us

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We’re an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm with offices across Atlantic Canada and Ontario. We’re large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team. Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers, without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

About the Role

The position provides the opportunity to primarily support the growing team in New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland and Labrador, and across Canada. You will work with a team of engineers, and environmental scientists on a variety of environmental projects in support of infrastructure and land development, renewable energy development and mine development. Some of the key responsibilities are:

• Planning, development and execution of environmental deliverables including Environmental Impact Assessments, Environmental Monitoring Reports, Permit Applications, etc. for proposed development projects in various industry sectors under provincial and/or federal processes.

• Planning, execution, and management of field programs/surveys relevant to the assessment of terrestrial and/or aquatic biology including avifauna, wildlife, vegetation (including rare plants), aquatics, wetlands, species at risk, etc.

• Involved in coordinating, preparing, and reviewing provincial and federal environmental permitting applications.

• Provide oversight of field and office staff including review of health and safety plans, survey methodology, QA/QC practices, etc.

• Preparation and review of proposals, work plans and budgets as well as contributing or leading the management of projects.

• Collaboration with other GEMTEC staff and offices on environmental permitting and related environmental projects of various sizes.

• Involved in coordinating and completing environmental and socioeconomic studies, Aboriginal, stakeholder, and public consultation programs.

Qualifications

• Completion of an undergraduate degree in related field such as Biology, Environmental Engineering or Environmental Science.

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in a related environmental professional role.

• A demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast paced, multidisciplinary environment.

• Knowledge and understanding of applicable municipal, provincial, and federal policies, guidelines and legislation for environmental assessments.

• Excellent project management skills with the ability to develop scope of works, execution strategies, and experience with overseeing management of environmental related work.

• Certified wetland delineator would be considered an asset

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Prior work experience in environmental consulting will be considered an asset

• Must have a valid driver’s license

• Travel may be required throughout Atlantic Canada

Benefits and Perks:

• Full time permanent salaried position

• Year end profit sharing bonus

• Health and dental benefits

• Employer matching RRSP up to 5%

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days)

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and New Years)

• Work/life balance including a 37.5 hour work week

• Future potential opportunity to become a shareholder

• Opportunities to be involved in a wide variety of technically challenging projects across multiple industries as our office grows

At Calian, we help organizations overcome obstacles, manage risks, and drive progress. Since 1982, we’ve grown from a small consulting firm into a trusted global company across defence, space, health, nuclear energy, public safety, and government.

CareersInnerInfo
We create innovative solutions that tackle complex challenges and help organizations and communities stay resilient, informed, and connected. If you’re driven by purpose and energized by solving real-world challenges, we want you on our team.

## Position Overview

The Field Nurse Case Manager (FCM) is responsible for implementing, managing, and executing a program within the Patient Support Program(s). The FCM optimizes and accelerates positive patient and program outcomes, supporting cross-functional teams. Acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for patients, HCPs, and extended health care teams, the FCM manages daily program activities, supports Health Care Professionals (HCPs) and other stakeholders in the field, and manages patient dossiers while monitoring metrics and KPIs. Please note that this is a one-year contract with possibility of extension.

Key Responsibilities

• Assist the PSP Lead in clinic and remote management, document coordination, and navigation services related to a program within the PSP Program operations.

• Provide bilingual support (French/English) for patients and HCPs.

• Monitor and report KPIs, offering insights for continuous improvement.

• Assist clinic and patient requests with referral paperwork coordination and navigation insurance coverage.

• Offer in-clinic support and follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate and comprehensive patient records while providing effective communication to support and address treatment journey concerns.

• Monitor patient progress and regularly update the healthcare team.

• Ensure ethical interactions and compliance with relevant institutional and provincial regulations.

• Participate in audits to maintain high standards of PSP operations.

• Provide feedback to our client based on field observations and customer feedback regarding service quality, training, and other important areas.

• Collaborate with Calian associates as per guidance and guidelines.

• Attend training as required.

• Develop and implement program tactics and innovative solutions in collaboration with cross-functional teams, including CRM and reporting optimization.

• Assist field and medical teams in efficiently managing HCP requests.

Competencies:

• Patient Support Program experience, ideally in Cardiology or Internal Medicine

• Knowledge of the Canadian, national, and provincial health care systems and environment.

• Customer service experience, ideally at call center level.

• Experience in clinic or hospital settings is an asset.

## Qualifications

• College or university degree.

• Nursing License, in good standing, with appropriate provincial standards.

• English and French bilingualism

• 3-4 years years' experience working in the pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or health care industry.

• Patient Support Program experience is an asset.

Travel Requirements:

• Must be able to travel up to 30% of time, including weekend or overnight. This may extend working hours to support operational and travel requirements.

Compensation

• $80000 - $83000/year, paid vacation, personal days and family benefits plan available.

Vacancy

• We have 1 available position.

## Position Overview

Calian Health is currently seeking experienced Registered Nurses for travel assignments in Remote, Isolated and/or Semi-isolated communities within British Columbia, providing community health services to remote Indigenous communities. These are two-week assignments but can extend longer if you prefer longer assignments.

CareersInnerInfo
This position provides direct primary care services to clients at all life stages by observing, assessing, monitoring and documenting client health and progress to make evidence informed decisions towards health and wellness.

## Responsibilities

• Provides holistic patient assessments that include health history, medication history, and physical evaluations with patience and Cultural Humility.

• Monitors, assesses and documents observations, symptoms, interventions and changes in client health status.

• Where relevant within scope of practice, orders diagnostic testing and/or collects specimens to make evidence informed decisions for care.

• Documents all information in the client’s personal health file.

• Applies health promotion, chronic disease management, advanced care planning, and/or self-care management principles to conduct assessments, identify issues, provide direct care, and address concerns or variances from the plan of care with empathy and Cultural Humility.

• Administers medications, injections and treatments according to established policies and protocols and within the scope of practice.

• Collaborates with clients and families to plan, implement, coordinate, and evaluate client care plans in consultation with members of interprofessional health team as needed.

• Reviews clinical findings with client/family and the interprofessional team, collaboratively identifies client centred goals and plans for care that promote self-management and improved health-related quality of life.

• Champions cultural safety and humility in all aspects of the job, and advocates for and applies culturally relevant and appropriate approaches when building relationships and providing nursing services.

• Maintains competency that reflects current standards of practice, including anti-racism and cultural humility standards as they are developed, by engaging in professional development activities including review of relevant literature, attending educational workshops and in-services, consulting and networking with other health care professionals.

## Qualifications

• Licensed and in good standing with the British Columbia College of Nurses and Midwives (BCCNM)

• Registered Nurses with Emergency or Critical Care experienced

• Must have experience being the First Call and working in remote locations

## Additional Requirements

• PALS (Pediatric Advanced Life Support)

• ENPC (Emergency Nursing Pediatric Course)

• ACLS (Advanced Cardiac Life Support)

• TNCC (Trauma Nursing Core Course (or equivalent)

• ATLS or ITLS (Advanced Trauma Life Support or International Trauma Life Support)

• BLS (Basic Life Support)

• CTAS (Canadian Triage and Acuity Score)

• PEWS (Pediatric Early Warning System)

• Up to date record of relevant immunizations including Covid-19, Tetanus-diphtheria, Hepatitis B, and influenza and TB annual screening. Records must be submitted prior to dispatching to location (upon recruitment hire)

• Valid Driver’s License

• San’yas Cultural Safety Training

• WHMIS 2015

• Transportation of Dangerous Goods (TDG)

• N-95 Mask Fit Test certificate

• Controlled Substance

• Suboxone Training

Compensation

$62- $65/hr. Monday to Friday shifts (7.5 hrs/day), with 24-hour standby and on-call expectations in nursing stations. Travel and accommodations provided for the assignment.

Vacancy

We have 1 available position.

## Analyst, Cyber Assurance

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

## Why join us

You will join an innovative and collaborative team helping shape the future of IT security at Canada’s central bank. You will have opportunities to exercise judgement, work with enterprise cyber security tools, deepen your knowledge across assurance domains, and grow through the Bank’s learning and development programs.

## About the position

Join the Cyber Security Assurance team and help connect people, information and assurance activities in a way that supports clear decisions and effective follow-through. In this role, you will help make cyber assurance information easier to understand, monitor and act on across teams.

You will work closely with ITS portfolios to anticipate demand, align assurance activities with portfolio roadmaps, strengthen risk monitoring, coordinate follow-up on outstanding items, and communicate results to a broad range of stakeholders. This role is well suited to a dynamic communicator who enjoys building partnerships, working with data, and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional work.

Candidates with transferable strengths in communication, analysis, stakeholder engagement, project coordination or risk management are encouraged to apply. Cyber experience is valuable, but curiosity, sound judgement, attention to detail and a strong desire to learn are equally important.

## What you will do

• Build trusted partnerships with ITS and business portfolios to understand priorities, project roadmaps and readiness for cyber assurance activities.

• Maintain and improve assurance and risk dashboards, KPIs, KRIs and reporting views that communicate the status of assurance activities, documented remediation updates and portfolio follow-up.

• Monitor the quality, consistency, timeliness and completeness of risk data, identify gaps, trends or overdue items, and coordinate follow-up with ITS portfolios and accountable stakeholders.

• Track decisions, action items, dependencies and remediation commitments to help ensure portfolio updates are current, clear and ready for governance or executive reporting.

• Prepare clear reports, presentations, briefing materials and awareness communications for operational teams, risk stakeholders, cyber colleagues and governance forums.

• Explain how risk assessment processes, cyber testing, vulnerability management, and third-party risk activities support and connect to the ITS project lifecycle.

• Support recurring portfolio reviews and governance discussions by helping clarify priorities, roles, responsibilities, decisions, action items and escalation paths.

• Maintain risk records, exceptions, remediation updates, follow-up notes and supporting evidence in ServiceNow IRM and related assurance tools, ensuring information remains current and ready for reporting.

• Support continuous improvement of tools and practices for planning, risk management, monitoring, reporting and governance across assurance activities.

• Maintain long-term relationships with internal and external stakeholders while contributing to a collaborative, learning-focused team environment.

## What you need to succeed

You are an effective and adaptable communicator who can make complex information clear, relevant and actionable for different audiences. You combine analytical thinking, attention to detail and strong relationship skills, and you are comfortable bringing structure to evolving information, competing priorities and cross-functional work.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear briefings, reports, presentations, dashboards and awareness materials for a range of technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to build productive relationships, influence without direct authority, and follow up effectively with portfolio teams, project teams and risk stakeholders.

• Experience working with data to monitor status, identify trends, flag gaps or overdue items, support decisions and communicate an evidence-based story.

• Understanding of risk assessment and risk management concepts, including monitoring, reporting, remediation tracking, escalation and follow-up.

• Strong organizational, coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing demands, track commitments, maintain accurate information and drive timely follow-up with appropriate independence.

• Knowledge of the IT project lifecycle and how governance, risk and assurance activities support delivery.

• A collaborative mindset, sound judgement, curiosity, attention to detail and a commitment to learning and continuous improvement.

## Nice to have

• Experience in cyber security, technology risk, operational risk, assurance, audit, governance or a related field.

• Experience building dashboards, KPIs, KRIs or management reporting using risk, performance or portfolio data.

• Experience with ServiceNow IRM, GRC or other workflow, reporting or risk management tools.

• Experience in project coordination, portfolio support or working directly with project managers and technology delivery teams.

## Your education and experience

Your combined education and work experience demonstrate that you have the competencies and skills required for the position. We are ideally seeking candidates with a degree or diploma in a relevant discipline, such as computer science, information systems, cyber security, risk management, business, communications or data analytics, together with three or more years of relevant experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• There will be no relocation assistance provided

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $94,193 to $110,816 (job grade 16)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 5 to 7% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (3%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health and dental coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Researcher.

About the team:

The Distributed Data Storage and Management Lab leads research in distributed data systems, aiming to develop next-generation cloud serverless products that encompass core infrastructure and databases. This lab addresses various data challenges, including cloud-native disaggregated databases, pay-by-query user models, and optimizing low-level data transfers via RDMA. Teams within this lab create advanced cloud serverless data infrastructure and implement cutting-edge networking technologies for Huawei's global AI infrastructure.

## About the job:

• Explore, develop and deploy state-of-the-art networking technologies and protocols for Huawei's global AI infrastructure, cloud and data-center networks, delivering innovations and performance to forge product competitiveness.

• Explore new opportunities with understanding of the company/product line strategies and industry development trends and identification of business problems and core challenges, orchestrating research and technologies across the research and business scene into a single, cohesive technical road-map.

• Maintain effective communication with professionals in both academia and industry and ensure Huawei’s value is being delivered.

The total target annual compensation for this position ranges from $106,000 to $156,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Teams within this lab create advanced cloud serverless data infrastructure and implement cutting-edge networking technologies for Huawei's global AI infrastructure.

## About the job:

Associate Director of Care / Permanent Part-Time
Airdrie Community
Salary: $55,962 - $69,953
This posting is for an existing vacancy

At Sienna you won’t just fill a position; you will build lasting relationships with residents who call Airdrie their home. This dynamic leadership role offers the chance to engage in guiding a clinical team, while also providing compassionate care to residents. It is an environment where you can grow your leadership skills daily, fostering a deeper connection and understanding with both your team and those under your care. Join us in a role where knowing each resident not just by name, but by story, is not just possible, it is expected. Our purpose is to cultivate happiness in daily life! We truly believe it is a privilege to serve Canada’s seniors, ensuring they live fulfilling lives with the utmost comfort, dignity, and respect.

Reporting to the Director of Care, the Associate Director of Care plays a crucial role within the community ensuring that the home operates efficiently and delivers high-quality care to the residents.

## What We Offer:

We are a purpose driven organization. We aspire to cultivate an environment and culture where team members feel valued, heard and empowered to do meaningful work. And we offer a number of programs and benefits that support team members’ financial, personal and professional needs:

• A competitive salary and vacation package

• Health & Dental benefits program

• RRSP with employer match

We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

As a Senior Software Application Developer you will help set technical direction and deliver durable, secure software for Case IQ’s platform. You will help lead complex cross-functional initiatives, raise engineering standards, and shape how product teams use AI-native and agentic engineering practices to move from idea to production safely and effectively.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You’ll Do

• Own the architecture and technical direction for high-impact platform capabilities, balancing product velocity, reliability, security, maintainability, and long-term operating cost.

• Set standards for production readiness across AWS services such as CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, ECS, Lambda, RDS, and related cloud-native infrastructure.

• Drive secure-by-design implementation, including OWASP-aligned practices, tenant isolation, data protection, secrets management, access control, and compliance-aware engineering decisions.

• Lead ambiguous, multi-team initiatives from technical discovery through rollout; make sound trade-offs and communicate rationale clearly to engineering, product, design, QA, and leadership.

• Raise the bar for engineering excellence through architecture reviews, high-signal code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates, reliability practices, and pragmatic documentation.

• Mentor senior and developing engineers, multiply team capability, and help shape technical roadmaps, hiring, and engineering operating practices.

• Hands-on experience using and improving AI-native or agentic SDLC workflows while maintaining rigorous human review, test coverage, security controls, and accountable engineering ownership.

• Strong experience with Docker or container platforms, GitHub, CI/CD, observability, and cloud security practices.

• Expert judgment in event-driven architecture, multi-tenancy, performance, reliability, and security; able to choose simple, resilient solutions under real delivery constraints.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence technical direction and explain complex trade-offs to varied audiences.

• A coaching mindset and a track record of raising the effectiveness of teams through mentoring, standards, and collaborative technical leadership.

Our company was built on the dream of a pioneering entrepreneur, and that spirit continues to empower our work with businesses across Canada today. The Rogers Business team helps organizations of all sizes adapt, scale, and win with network services and other innovative technology solutions that are reliable, secure, and scalable. These solutions are built to allow businesses to operate more efficiently, reduce costs and improve productivity and collaboration. We are looking for team members who have a passion for delivering industry-leading value to customers and businesses in the communities where we live and work, so come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

## Who we’re looking for

Rogers Business is seeking a strategic, data-driven Manager, SMB Wireless Cross-Sell & Lifecycle Growth to accelerate revenue growth and increase product penetration across our existing Small Business customer base.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Business Base Management, this role will own the strategy and performance of cross-sell programs designed to deepen customer relationships and grow share of wallet across Wireless, IoT, Microsoft Teams and Rogers Business Credit Card.

The successful candidate will establish a proactive approach to managing customers through the early and mid stages of the customer lifecycle, identifying opportunities from the point of installation onward to move customers from single-product relationships to deeper, multi-product relationships (1P → 2P → 3P+).

This role will bring together customer insights, segmentation, targeting, campaigns, offers and channel execution to systematically identify and monetize product white space across the existing Rogers Business customer base.

## What you’ll do

• Own the SMB Wireless cross-sell and lifecycle growth strategy, with accountability for increasing Wireless, IoT, Microsoft Teams and Credit Card penetration across the existing Rogers Business customer base.

• Develop and execute an early- and mid-lifecycle cross-sell strategy, identifying the optimal moments from installation onward to introduce customers to additional Rogers Business products and solutions.

• Build a structured 1P → 2P → 3P+ customer growth framework, establishing clear customer cohorts, product pathways and cross-sell opportunities throughout the lifecycle.

• Identify and size product white space across the installed base using customer, product, tenure, behavioural and transactional insights.

• Develop targeted customer segments and prioritize opportunities based on product eligibility, propensity, customer value and expected revenue opportunity.

• Build and execute cross-sell campaigns and programs in partnership with Marketing, Digital, Sales and channel teams to convert identified opportunities into incremental product sales and revenue.

• Establish a disciplined cross-sell funnel, measuring the eligible base, customers targeted, engagement, leads, conversion, product sales, product penetration and incremental revenue.

• Develop comprehensive reporting and dashboards to measure Wireless, IoT, Teams and Credit Card penetration, customer product depth and movement from 1P to 2P to 3P+ relationships.

• Establish product-level performance targets and forecasts and maintain clear accountability for the incremental revenue generated through cross-sell programs.

• Continuously test and optimize targeting, timing, offers, messaging and channel strategy to improve conversion, product penetration and customer outcomes.

• Partner with Analytics and Data Science to develop and evolve propensity-based targeting, next-best-product and next-best-action capabilities.

• Identify opportunities to embed cross-sell into existing customer journeys and touchpoints, creating more systematic and always-on growth motions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Partner closely with Product teams to understand product roadmaps, value propositions, eligibility requirements and emerging opportunities across Wireless, IoT, Teams and Credit Card.

• Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Digital, Product, Analytics, Finance and Customer Experience to remove barriers to cross-sell and improve execution across channels.

• Develop business cases and recommendations for new growth opportunities based on customer insights, performance trends and addressable market opportunity.

• Provide regular performance reporting, insights and recommendations to senior leadership, identifying opportunities to accelerate growth and improve return on investment.

## What you’ll bring

• 5+ years of experience in Base Management, Marketing, Customer Lifecycle Management, Product Management, CRM, Analytics, Sales Strategy or a related discipline.

• Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, cross-sell, segmentation and customer value growth.

• Demonstrated experience translating customer and business insights into actionable growth strategies, campaigns and programs.

• Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of revenue, product penetration, conversion, ARPU, customer economics and business case development.

• Strong analytical skills with experience using data to identify opportunities, establish targets, forecast results and measure performance.

• Experience developing and managing customer campaigns, targeted sales programs or lifecycle growth initiatives.

• Ability to work with large customer populations and translate data into clearly prioritized customer segments and actionable opportunities.

• Proven ability to influence and work cross-functionally across Product, Marketing, Sales, Digital, Analytics, Finance and Customer Experience.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and executive-level storytelling.

• Highly organized and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives while maintaining clear accountability for business outcomes.

• Experience within telecommunications, B2B or subscription-based businesses would be considered an asset.

## What success looks like

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to systematically deepen relationships with existing Rogers Business customers and generate incremental revenue by increasing product penetration across the base.

Key measures of success will include:

• Growth in Wireless, IoT, Microsoft Teams and Credit Card penetration

• Growth in customers with 2P and 3P+ relationships

• Incremental product sales and annualized revenue generated through cross-sell

• Cross-sell campaign and channel conversion

• Growth in products per customer

• Expansion of addressable cross-sell programs across the early and mid customer lifecycle

• Improved effectiveness of targeting, offers and customer journeys

Ultimately, this role will help establish a scalable cross-sell capability that moves Rogers Business from responding primarily to customer events to proactively identifying and capturing growth opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle.

Position Overview:
As our Bearing Cell Operator, you will set up, process, and inspect bearing components by utilizing manual and numerically controlled milling, turning, EDM, and grinding equipment.

## Location:

On-site in Euclid, Ohio

## Your Day to Day as a Bearing Cell Operator:

• Generate, assemble and inspect bearings and bearing components.

• Verify and inspect all features using appropriate inspection methods.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, operating sheets, sketches and other related technical data to determine tooling requirements, setup procedures, control settings and machining method and sequences.

• Mounts, aligns and secures tooling, attachments and work piece on machine.

• Selects and installs cutting tools in machine spindle.

• Loads control media such as tape, card or disk in machine controller or enters commands to retrieve programmed instructions from database.

• Calculates and sets machine controls to position spindle in relationship to work in piece and to regulate factors such as cutting depth, speed, feed, and coolant flow.

• Inputs either through automatic download of manually, all SPC information as defined by the engineering community to establish and maintain process controls.

• Starts machine and monitors displays and machine operation to detect malfunctions or deviations.

• Stops machine to change cutting tools and setup according to required machining sequence or to measure parts for conformance to blueprint specifications.

• Enters commands or manually adjusts machine controls to correct malfunctions or out-of-tolerance machining.

• Operates machine manually to perform non-automated functions and when automatic programming is faulty or machine malfunctions.

• Discusses control media errors with supervisor or programming personnel to resolve problems.

• Cleans machine, tooling and parts.

• Performs machine maintenance, housekeeping and other duties as assigned by supervision.

• Develop, evaluate and improve manufacturing methods, processes, tools, gages and fixtures.

• Ability to setup and operate Manual and CNC Milling, Turning and Grinding equipment.

• Perform maintenance and troubleshooting of equipment, fixtures and gages.

• Capable of being trained to develop N/C programs during setup utilizing "M" code, "G" code, Mazatrol, or Esprit software for EDM.

• Meet all contractual quality requirements including inspection methods and techniques required to meet final blueprint drawings.

• Must have ability to train other technicians on Manual and CNC equipment.

• Ability to move material and racks.

## Required Qualifications:

• Two (2) years of set-up and operation of CNC Milling, Turning and Grinding equipment.

• High School diploma or GED equivalency.

• Must be willing and available to work any shift (2nd shift: 3pm - 11pm, 3rd shift: 11pm - 7am).

• Ability to demonstrate CNC control abilities including; editing speeds, feeds, tool offsets and fixture offsets on milling, turning, EDM and grinding equipment.

• Capable of being able to develop NC programs during set-ups utilizing "G" code, "M" code, mazatrol, or esprit software for EDM.

• Demonstrate above CNC abilities on a test piece.

• Read and interpret complex blueprints and interpret geometric tolerancing per ANSI Y14.5.

• Demonstrate the use of various measuring instruments including: dial bore gages, indicator snap gages, verniers, and .0001 micrometers.

• Possess skills necessary to maintain accurate documentation and the ability to follow complicated procedures and document accordingly.

• Possess the knowledge and ability to use multi axis grinding contouring as well as grinding wheel dressing and grit/size selection to ensure that tight tolerances meet blueprints.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

## Position Overview:

The Technical Procurement Engineer provides specialized technical expertise in support of strategic sourcing, supplier development, and the procurement of complex, highly engineered materials and services. As a key technical resource within BWXT Supply Chain, this position partners closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Program Management to ensure all procured materials, components, and services meet technical, quality, regulatory, cost, and schedule requirements. The role primarily supports BEO and contributes to broader Tennessee Operations initiatives as business needs evolve.

## Location:

On-site in Oak Ridge, TN

## Your Day-to-Day as a Technical Procurement Engineer:

• Support strategic sourcing, negotiation, and procurement of materials and services, including raw materials, machining, fabrication, forgings, welding materials, and other technical commodities.

• Conduct supplier assessments such as audits, competency evaluations, qualification activities, and ongoing surveillance.

• Develop, review, and issue procurement specifications, technical packages, statements of work, subcontractor submittal requirements, and inspection and testing plans.

• Review supplier proposals, technical exceptions, manufacturing plans, inspection results, calibration records, and certifications to ensure full compliance with requirements.

• Serve as the primary engineering interface with suppliers for subcontracted components, ensuring fabrication processes meet all technical and quality standards. Lead and contribute to internal technical teams evaluating supplier performance and resolving issues involving discrepant or degraded materials.

• Collaborate with engineering, purchasing, and quality teams to identify, evaluate, and qualify new suppliers. Support the development of cost estimates and contribute to program efficiencies through process improvements.

• Apply independent judgment to resolve complex technical procurement challenges while meeting cost, schedule, and compliance expectations.

## Required Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree.

• At least 5 years of experience in technical procurement, materials management, or purchasing.

• Experience with supplier qualification, ASME NQA-1, FAR/DFAR/DEAR regulations, and DOE facility operations.

• Strong technical understanding of engineering principles, manufacturing processes, quality control, and failure analysis.

• Strong negotiation, communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, interpret complex technical requirements, and prepare detailed procurement documentation.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Q clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Engineering degree
• Candidates without an engineering degree but with demonstrated technical competency and direct experience supporting engineering, supplier qualification, or technical procurement will also be considered.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

This position is primarily assigned to 2nd Shift; however, flexibility to transition between shifts, departments, and work areas is essential to maintain seamless operations. Scheduled overtime may be required based on operational demand.

On-site in Barberton, Ohio

## Your Day to Day as a Front-Line Manager II

Operational Leadership & Team Management

• Manage the daily activities of multiple production teams, ensuring alignment with schedule, quality, and safety requirements.

• Provide leadership continuity across shifts by establishing production plans, coordinating work execution, and preparing downstream teams for successful follow‑through.

Production Planning & Execution

• Plan, direct, and coordinate activities across multiple buildings, work centers, and product lines to meet production goals.

• Oversee manual, automatic, and robotic welding operations, ensuring adherence to specifications, procedures, and process controls.

• Manage high‑complexity component flows, ensuring clarity, communication, and coordination of technical requirements and change impacts.

Data Management & Systems Use

• Input, analyze, and manage data relating to labor time, production schedules, and workflow management within applicable computer systems.

• Utilize established technology, processes, and precedents to make autonomous operational decisions and solve problems with limited precedent.

Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Evaluate existing operations and recommend improvements to shop efficiency, workflow design, resource utilization, safety, and cost control.

• Apply technical experience and judgment to identify and resolve complex production issues, leveraging broad understanding of fabrication processes and procedures.

• Support implementation of process improvements, new technologies, and updated standards across multiple teams.

Flexibility & Availability

• Work scheduled overtime as required to maintain production continuity and meet customer commitments.

• Proven experience supervising union skilled trades in welding, fitting, stress‑relief, lifting/handling, or heavy fabrication operations within a complex production setting.

• Strong technical background in welding processes, fitting, heavy fabrication methods, and multi‑team coordination across multiple buildings or work centers.

• Ability to work autonomously within established practices, exercising sound judgment to resolve operational and technical issues with limited precedent.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging and influencing employees and leaders of diverse backgrounds and generations.

## Assistant Director, Endpoint Management

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada
