Did you know?
The Bank of Canada is modernizing its digital workplace through a cloud-first approach to endpoint management. As Assistant Director, Endpoint Management, you will help shape the future of how employees work by leading the evolution of device management, virtual workspaces, endpoint security, automation and digital employee experience. You'll lead a high-performing team responsible for keeping thousands of devices secure, resilient and productive, while advancing innovative technologies that support the Bank's mission.

What you will do
As Assistant Director, Endpoint Management, you will lead a team responsible for the full lifecycle management of the Bank's endpoint environment, including laptops, mobile devices, virtual desktops and endpoint services.

In this role, you will:

• Provide leadership, coaching and development opportunities to build a high-performing and engaged team.

• Establish operational priorities and align team objectives with departmental and corporate goals.

• Oversee the reliability, security and continuous improvement of endpoint management platforms and services.

• Lead strategic initiatives that modernize endpoint management through cloud-first technologies, automation and self-service capabilities.

• Drive improvements in endpoint security, compliance, vulnerability management and operational resilience.

• Manage operational planning, resource allocation, budgets and technology investments.

• Build strong partnerships with internal clients and stakeholders to deliver high-quality services and solutions.

• Monitor service performance, identify improvement opportunities and implement corrective actions where required.

• Foster a positive, collaborative and inclusive work environment that supports employee growth and innovation.

What you need to succeed
You demonstrate strong leadership, communication and relationship-building skills, along with experience leading operational technology teams in a complex enterprise environment.

You also have experience with:

• Modern endpoint management platforms, including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM).

• Endpoint security, patch management, compliance management and vulnerability remediation.

• Cloud-first identity and device management, including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and mobile device management.

• Leading technology modernization initiatives and large-scale endpoint transformation projects.

• Using operational data and automation to improve service delivery and user experience.

• Strategic planning, operational management and continuous service improvement.

Nice to have
The following would be considered assets:

• Experience with Patch My PC, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Qualys, Splunk, Sysmon and ServiceNow integrations.

• Experience implementing or supporting Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop environments.

• Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Power BI and workflow automation.

• Knowledge of zero-touch provisioning, endpoint analytics and AI-enabled operational support.

• Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, Security Copilot or related AI-enabled workplace technologies.

Your education and experience
The position requires a university degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or another related field, or a college diploma in Information Technology, and 8 to 15 years of progressively responsible experience in endpoint management and technology operations, including experience managing teams and supporting modern endpoint technologies; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $153,721 to $180,848 (job grade 19)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension

About Giatec

Giatec is the category-defining digital concrete technology platform and the global leader in unifying concrete production, delivery, and placement into one intelligent system. As the intelligence backbone from plant to pour and beyond, Giatec transforms real-time data into measurable performance, accelerating construction, lowering carbon impact, reducing risk, and ensuring long-term concrete performance at scale. For more information, visit www.giatecscientific.com.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our North America RMC Solutions team, reporting to the Manager, Alliance Partnerships and RMC Sales. The ideal candidate will have experience building relationships and driving revenue with Tier 1 national and large regional operators. This role owns a named enterprise patch: landing new logos and expanding our footprint inside existing producer accounts, in equal measure. Simply put, we're looking for someone who can open the door at a national producer and then grow it plant by plant, region by region. If we haven't lost you yet, we're probably speaking the same language. So, let's dive into more specifics! We are looking for someone who communicates well, motivates stakeholders, and loves to solve challenges. Our products — SmartMix™ AI mix optimization and MixPilot™ in-transit slump sensing, both powered by Roxi, Giatec's AI engine trained on 300K+ mix designs — change how producers run quality control, so you'll be selling to QC, operations, dispatch, and the C-suite in the same deal. If you're ready to bring your experience to a company on an amazing growth trajectory – and even grander aspirations going forward – we want to talk! While our team prides itself on surpassing customer expectations, executing as part of a high-performance team, and supporting the career growth of champions, we never forget the importance of a healthy work life balance that gives personal priorities as much weight as the job. When you take care of your own, they come back and crush deliverables with creativity, integrity, and passion.

The expected salary range for this role is between $120,000 -$170,000. This role represents an existing vacancy within the organization.

What You'll Get:

• A welcoming, people first team built to disrupt the market

• The opportunity to drastically improve your skills and experience

• A chance to get your hands on some game-changing products

• Helping producers pour better concrete across North America

Perks and Benefits:

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan

• Generous professional development budget

• Volunteer and Life Days that make work/life balance easier to achieve

• Your birthday off because we want you to celebrate

• RRSP matching program

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Understanding our products and communicating the value to ready-mix producers.

• Identifying the quality-control, operational, and sustainability challenges facing producers and the broader concrete market.

• Maintaining a healthy pipeline through prospecting, up-selling and cross-selling across a named enterprise account list.

• Running MixPilot trials from scope through results review, and converting successful trials into fleet-wide deployments.

• Negotiating conditions and contractual terms on multi-site, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements.

• Landing new enterprise logos and expanding revenue within existing producer accounts.

• Developing in-depth knowledge of each producer's business priorities, plant network, and initiatives that can be translated into opportunities for us to win their business.

• Carrying out presentations and product demos to technical and executive stakeholders.

• Transferring knowledge and wins across accounts and regional markets.

• Following up on inbound inquiries, partner referrals, and requests for quotes.

• Visiting prospects/customers and attending trade shows (NRMCA ConcreteWorks, World of Concrete, Canadian Concrete Expo, and our RMC Technology Summit).

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• A proven track record of closing new enterprise logos and growing revenue in existing accounts

• 4+ years of combined experience which can include any of the following: enterprise or SME sales, business development, ready-mix concrete production, concrete materials/QC, admixtures, or construction technology

• Comfort managing long, complex sales cycles (12+ months) with multiple stakeholders and executive sponsors

• Ability to travel within Canada and USA when necessary.

• Ability to thrive in environments where change is constant, fast-paced, and often with strict deadlines.

• "Growth hacker" or creative, results-oriented mindset with the ability to get stuff done.

• Honest, caring, and candid communication style to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Humility, a willingness to share the credit and receive / consider new ideas from others.

• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong business acumen ideally with comprehensive industry knowledge in ready-mix concrete, concrete materials, or construction technology.

• Experience with our tech stack (or similar): Salesforce, Gong, Apollo, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Dodge, and MS Office among others.

HOW TO APPLY

Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and would love to learn more about you. Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your interest in the role. Applications are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team; due to application volume, response times may vary. We appreciate your interest in being part of Giatec, and thank you for your understanding.

This same codebase runs on hardware appliances, software brokers, and our cloud platform.

We are seeking a software developer with hands-on production experience to contribute across these areas. • Quality Assurance & Build Pipelines: Write and maintain unit tests alongside the code you change, plus end-to-end tests covering High Availability and network deployments.

• Ability to deliver production-quality software backed by automated tests.

• Comfort with debugging and profiling tools such as gdb, perf, tcpdump, strace, or valgrind.

• Independent problem solving: Resourceful and self-directed; you can take an ambiguous problem, design an approach, overcome architectural roadblocks, and maintain momentum with minimal oversight.

• Familiarity with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP) or distributed consensus systems (Raft, Paxos, quorums).

This role will partner with manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, operations, supply chain, cybersecurity, and IT teams to translate operational challenges into secure, scalable, supportable solutions that improve quality, throughput, downtime, process visibility, and data-driven decision making.

## Location:

Onsite in Melbourne, FL or Lynchburg, VA. Fully remote option available.

• Partner with manufacturing and business-unit leaders to identify, prioritize, and define high-value AI and analytics use cases across production, quality, maintenance, supply chain, safety, and operational performance.

• Design practical solutions such as dashboards, alerts, predictive models, anomaly detection, optimization tools, AI assistants, data products, APIs, workflow automation, and lightweight applications.

• Analyze data from ERP, MES, SCADA, historians, PLCs, sensors, quality systems, maintenance systems, production logs, engineering systems, spreadsheets, and other operational sources.

• Support data governance, metadata, data quality, security, regulatory compliance, lifecycle management, and stewardship practices for manufacturing data and analytics.

• Apply MLOps and production support practices such as version control, testing, model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, logging, and documentation.

• Communicate technical concepts, assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations clearly to plant teams, engineers, leaders, and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions constructively, clarifies ambiguous requirements, and helps prioritize solutions that provide practical business value.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including some experience in data architecture, analytics, AI/ML, data engineering, manufacturing systems, and/or solution architecture.

• Experience designing or delivering analytics, AI/ML, data, BI, automation, or decision-support solutions in a professional environment.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.

• Python or similar analytical programming experience using tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, statsmodels, or similar libraries.

• Experience with supervised and unsupervised analytics or machine learning methods, such as classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, forecasting, optimization, or statistical process analysis.

• Experience working with cloud-based data and analytics platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, or similar environments.

• Strong understanding of data architecture, including data modeling, data integration, metadata, data quality, data governance, and data lifecycle management.

• Experience communicating technical findings in business-friendly language and produce clear technical architecture and support documentation.

• Highly self-motivated, collaborative, detail-oriented, and results-driven.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Additional Qualifications:

• Experience applying AI, analytics, data science, or data architecture in manufacturing, industrial, nuclear, aerospace, defense, semiconductor, quality, maintenance, supply chain, or operations environments.

• Experience with manufacturing systems such as MES, SCADA, PLCs, historians, CMMS/EAM, QMS, ERP, industrial IoT platforms, engineering systems, or production scheduling systems.

• Understanding of manufacturing KPIs such as throughput, cycle time, downtime, OEE, scrap, rework, takt time, bottlenecks, quality escapes, first-pass yield, schedule adherence, and safety events.

• Experience with Azure, Azure AI/OpenAI, Databricks, Power BI, SQL Server, Python, APIs, Power Platform, containerized applications, or similar enterprise platforms.

• Experience with real-time or near-real-time anomaly detection, streaming data, event-driven architectures, MQTT, Kafka, Spark, Azure Event Hubs, Azure IoT, or similar technologies.

• Experience building dashboards, internal applications, or decision-support tools using Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, Streamlit, Dash, FastAPI, or similar tools.

• Experience in regulated, high-security, safety-conscious, export-controlled, or mission-critical environments.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

The FLM I provides direct, hands‑on leadership during shift operations, helping prepare machining work for downstream teams and ensuring continuity across multiple departments. The role also supports issue resolution, partners with technical support groups, and contributes to improvements in workflow, safety, and machining processes. Flexibility across shifts and work areas is essential, and scheduled overtime may be required to support operational needs.

## Your Day to Day as a Front-Line Manager I

Operational Leadership & Team Management

• Supervise, mentor, and support union hourly skilled trades in machining and assembly operations.

• Provide clear direction to ensure alignment with safety rules, quality expectations, and machining workflow requirements.

• Maintain strong communication with adjacent shifts to support consistent execution and production continuity.

Production Planning & Execution

• Coordinate machining work across multiple buildings, work centers, and equipment types to meet production goals.

• Work closely with technical support groups to interpret machining work scopes, resolve issues, and ensure teams understand all required specifications and tolerances.

• Assist in resolving machining and assembly challenges using practical experience and knowledge of skilled trade practices.

Safety, Quality & Reporting

• Report regularly on safety performance, quality concerns, and production progress.

• Address safety or quality issues that arise during machining and work with technical support and quality teams to investigate, resolve, and formalize corrective actions.

• Reinforce adherence to standard operating procedures and machining best practices.

Data Management & Systems Use

• Input and manage data related to labor hours, machining schedules, workflow tracking, and maintenance work orders.

• Use established systems and processes to make sound, routine decisions within defined guidelines.

Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Identify opportunities to enhance machining workflow efficiency, resource utilization, safety, and cost control.

• Escalate and help resolve technical issues that affect machining performance or production readiness.

• Support the adoption of new technologies, updated machining standards, and process improvements.

Flexibility & Availability

• Flex between shifts and work areas based on project needs, staffing requirements, or emergent operations.

• Work scheduled overtime as required to maintain production continuity and meet customer commitments.

## AUKUS Engineer 4 - (Design Eng -- Process)

## Position Overview:

Under the general supervision of the manager, has technical responsibility for manufacturing, quality control, or subcontractor processes that must yield acceptable product. May supervise other engineers and technicians engaged in mutual technical work. Applies intensive and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices in broad areas of assignments. Makes decisions to resolve important questions and to plan and coordinate work. Requires the use of advanced techniques and the modification and extension of theories, precepts, and practices of the field and related sciences. Supervision and guidance related largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts, and policy matters.

## Location:

On-site in Erwin, Tennessee.

## Your Day to Day as an AUKUS Engineer 4:

• Plans, develops, and coordinates a large and important engineering project or a number of small projects.

• Performs complex or novel assignments requiring the development of new or improved techniques and procedures.

• May develop and evaluate plans and criteria for a variety of projects and activities to be carried out by others.

• Assesses the feasibility and soundness of proposed engineering evaluation tests, equipment or quality control systems.

• Organizes own work and that of other engineers and technicians who may be assigned as assistants on projects.

• Estimates personnel needs and schedules and assigns work to meet completion dates.

• Provides the technical expertise necessary for making mature and sound engineering or quality control judgments.

• Anticipates and resolves unprecedented engineering problems.

• Provides periodic written reports outlining work to date, problems encountered, and solutions found to be effective.

• Provides the necessary interface between departments to resolve problems affecting assigned projects.

• Performs assigned work in a timely manner with a high degree of accuracy.

• Assists in the training of new engineering personnel.

• Responsible for process ventilation systems and equipment, such as scrubbers, fans, ducts, filters, and associated sensors and control systems.

• Calculates and/or measures technical data such as differential pressures, air and liquid flow, and vibration.

• Completes and maintains appropriate documentation, set point analysis, calculations, and drawings.

• Selects and references relevant published standards and specifications. Supports continuous improvement by developing internal standards, procedures, and specifications.

• Maintains a safety-focused and teamwork-oriented environment.

## Additional Responsibilities:

• Ability to effectively communicate complex technical information in writing and verbally.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a multifunctional team.

• Performance of Engineering Design Authority role with responsibility of approving plant modifications and ownership of the technical design requirements for plant.

• Experience in plant systems and processes in nuclear facility.

• Knowledge/experience in reviewing design documents as it relates to configuration control/management of change for physical plant modifications.

• Familiarity with ANSI/DOE standards for Configuration Management of Nuclear Facilities.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance.

• Must be a U.S. citizen with no dual citizenship.

## Required Qualifications

B. S. -- Engineering

Seven years' engineering experience since B. S. degree (six years with M.S. degree)

## Production Supervisor

Location: Vaughan, ON
Work Model: Onsite
Position Type: Full-time, Permanent

## Summary

As the Production Supervisor, you will play a critical leadership role in ensuring the successful execution of customer orders from intake through delivery. You will lead production operations, guide a team of hourly employees, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, delivery performance, and operational efficiency. This role is instrumental in supporting critical electronic assembly manufacturing while maintaining an incident and injury-free workplace.

## Responsibilities

• Lead all production operations and associated activities, including production planning, project management, testing, logistics, materials management, maintenance, HSE implementation, and third-party operations.

• Review incoming customer orders and develop production schedules that support on-time delivery commitments.

• Conduct daily production meetings, establish priorities, assign work, and monitor team performance.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing waste, improving cycle times, increasing labour utilization, and enhancing operational efficiency.

• Support the introduction of new products, processes, equipment, and manufacturing capabilities.

• Ensure tooling, equipment, materials, and resources are available to meet production requirements.

• Develop capacity plans and optimize labour scheduling, including overtime planning when required.

• Maintain compliance with quality standards, operational procedures, and manufacturing documentation requirements.

• Supervise and support production activities including assembly, soldering, testing, cable preparation, pressure testing, and related manufacturing processes.

• Provide hands-on support in production when required.

• Apply structured problem-solving techniques to resolve manufacturing, quality, delivery, and operational challenges.

• Support inventory accuracy, material availability, and ERP inventory management activities.

• Oversee receiving activities and coordinate shipping requirements to ensure products are packaged and delivered according to customer specifications.

• Serve as a technical point of contact for customer project teams regarding qualification activities, product status updates, and open orders.

• Review RFQs and provide production input related to labour estimates, lead times, and manufacturing feasibility.

• Review purchase orders, quotations, and proposals to ensure compliance with production and quality requirements.

• Approve timesheets and support payroll processing activities.

• Develop, train, certify, and coach production team members while supporting ongoing certification and qualification requirements.

• Conduct performance management activities including employee coaching, development discussions, and performance evaluations.

• Support Health, Safety, and Environmental programs, maintain legislative compliance, and actively participate in safety initiatives.

• Maintain 5S standards, support quality investigations, and reinforce adherence to manufacturing and quality procedures.

• Maintain production documentation, manufacturing records, planning information, and reporting requirements.

• Contribute to operational planning, forecasting, and capital improvement initiatives.

## Qualifications

• Diploma, Associate Degree, or post-secondary education in Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. A university degree is considered an asset.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in manufacturing, production, process, operations, or production engineering environments.

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on manufacturing experience with regular shop floor presence and direct interaction with operators and production teams.

• Experience leading production operations, manufacturing teams, or operational processes in a manufacturing environment.

• Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, capacity management, labour utilization, materials management, and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Experience supervising hourly employees and driving accountability, engagement, and performance.

• Working knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001, AS9100D, or CSA N299 standards.

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, JIT, Kanban, TQM, ERP systems, and other operational excellence tools is preferred.

• Knowledge of IPC standards, NASA manufacturing requirements, and electronic assembly environments is considered a strong asset.

• Strong problem-solving, leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.

• Ability to balance safety, quality, cost, delivery, and customer expectations in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Comfortable working in a hands-on production environment and leading by example.

## Why Join Mattr?

• Flexible health, dental & vision benefits with HSA rollover

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance

• Attractive incentive bonus plans

• 24/7 Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP)

• Wellness and mental health support programs

## Summary

The Quality Manager will lead the Quality function within the Shawflex division of the Connection Technologies Group. This role is accountable for maintaining effective quality management systems, including ISO 9001, N299.2, NQA-1/10CFR50 Appendix B, and AS9100D, while supporting compliance with applicable CSA, UL, customer, and regulatory requirements. The Quality Manager will oversee inspection and laboratory functions, strengthen internal and external quality performance, and promote a quality-focused culture throughout the organization.

As a key member of the Shawflex senior management team, the Quality Manager will have a direct impact on customer satisfaction, the cost of quality, regulatory compliance, and the organization’s Continuous Improvement culture. Through the Mattr Management System, Lean, Six Sigma, and other established methodologies, this leader will improve quality processes, strengthen problem-solving capabilities, and help Shawflex deliver consistently against its business and customer commitments.

## Responsibilities

## Lead quality performance and compliance

• Provide visible leadership in the pursuit of “Utopian (Perfect) Quality” and establish a strong quality mindset across the organization.

• Maintain compliant ISO 9001, N299, NQA-1, and AS9100D quality management systems, including chairing management reviews and serving as the organization’s Quality Management Representative.

• Build and maintain effective internal and external audit capabilities to support compliance, organizational learning, and performance improvement.

• Represent Shawflex on quality matters with customers, nuclear utilities, Sales and Marketing, suppliers, CSA, UL, auditors, and other internal and external parties.

• Serve as the escalation point for nuclear quality issues and concerns, ensuring that risks and required actions receive appropriate leadership attention.

## Strengthen systems and resolve quality issues

• Develop, implement, and maintain corrective and preventive action programs that address customer quality concerns and internal non-conformances.

• Coordinate and delegate corrective-action responsibilities across departments to support timely and effective resolution of quality issues.

• Oversee quality processes and systems covering non-conformance reports, corrective-action reports, customer complaints, document management, and calibration.

• Establish and reinforce a strong problem-solving culture using A3, 8D, 5 Why, and other recognized problem-solving techniques.

• Improve customer satisfaction and reduce the cost of quality by addressing systemic issues and strengthening the effectiveness of quality controls.

## Build inspection, laboratory, and supplier quality capabilities

• Lead laboratory staff and maintain the inspection, laboratory, and audit capabilities needed to support business plans.

• Oversee the supplier quality management process, including supplier selection, performance management, audits, supplier non-conformances, and corrective or preventive action follow-up.

• Develop a strong supplier management system that improves supplier performance and supports business and customer requirements.

• Provide supervision, technical direction, work methods, procedures, and instructions to Quality, laboratory, and inspection personnel.

• Support projects, including new product development and product launches, where quality oversight is required.

## Drive measurable continuous improvement

• Improve and streamline quality processes and systems through digitization and effective process management.

• Use the Mattr Management System, Lean, Six Sigma, and other continuous improvement methodologies to enhance existing processes and organizational performance.

• Coach and mentor teams in continuous improvement and develop effective training programs for the Quality function.

• Strengthen the internal audit function as an organizational self-assessment capability.

• Support the continued improvement and scaling of the nuclear order execution process.

• Maintain accountability for organizational quality metrics and key performance indicators, including monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting and associated performance improvement.

## Lead the function and support business priorities

• Prepare annual departmental fixed-cost and capital-spending budgets and provide quality-related input into strategic and capital plans.

• Maintain performance reporting and management systems, including monthly reports and applicable employee performance systems.

• Support sales goals and initiatives through effective engagement with internal and external groups.

• Complete performance appraisals and salary administration for Quality staff.

• Coach, mentor, and develop team members through training, feedback, and professional-development support.

• Ensure that Mattr operational and financial standards related to Quality, including Bill 198 and NDA requirements, are deployed and maintained.

## Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a relevant technical degree or diploma.

• Additional quality-related education or training is considered an asset.

• Minimum 6 years of relevant experience across quality management, quality systems, laboratory operations, inspection, manufacturing, or regulatory and standards environments.

• Strong working experience with ISO 9001 management systems.

• Experience with N299, NQA-1, and AS9100 quality systems, as well as CSA and UL standards.

• Previous experience supervising or managing laboratory operations and Quality personnel.

• Demonstrated experience providing quality leadership and applying statistical analysis to quality performance and complex issues.

## Certifications and technical capabilities

• Lean Six Sigma certification.

• Internal Auditor certification or training and Lead Auditor certification or training.

• Certified Quality Engineer or Certified Quality Manager designation is considered an asset.

• Highly developed analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with A3, 8D, 5 Why, and related problem-solving methods.

##

## ## Join us at Entrust

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.

## ## Get to Know Us

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.

## Position Overview:

Entrust’s Cryptographic Security Platform helps organizations protect the keys, certificates, and sensitive data their business depends on across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments. Customers increasingly rely on global systems integrators, managed service providers, cloud and marketplace partners, technology partners, and channel partners to commercialize, integrate, deliver, and support these solutions.

As an early member of Partner Product Management, you will lead productization for a small number of strategic ecosystem routes to market.

You will translate partner and customer evidence into clear offers, product requirements, readiness standards, and recommendations for investment. Working closely with Core Product Management and Engineering, you will help make selected partner motions repeatable, commercially viable, and scalable.

This is a hands-on Product Management role for a builder who combines strong product judgment, technical and commercial fluency, and cross-functional leadership. You will influence product roadmaps through evidence and clear tradeoffs, help establish reusable productization standards, and create a feedback loop that improves Entrust’s partner-facing offers over time.

This is not a channel-sales, alliance-management, or individual-customer delivery-management role.

## What you will do:

## Shape strategic partner product opportunities

• Identify and develop a small number of high-value partner opportunities into clear product and offer theses.

• Define the target customer, use case, customer value, partner role, deployment model, and commercial path for each priority motion.

• Build decision-ready business cases that articulate customer and partner evidence, expected outcomes, product investment, operating implications, opportunity cost, and measures of success.

• Recommend where Entrust should invest in reusable capabilities, where a partner or Services-led approach is appropriate, and where the evidence does not justify additional product work.

• Maintain a clear record of product-investment decisions, assumptions, outcomes, and learnings.

## Make selected offers partner-ready

• Define the supported offer, including target customers, use cases, configurations, integrations, dependencies, exclusions, responsibilities, and success criteria.

• Translate route and field evidence into reusable product requirements across interfaces, automation, installation, upgrades, rollback, entitlement, licensing, reporting, audit evidence, documentation, training, support, and escalation.

• Partner with Core Product Management and Engineering to convert requirements into prioritized roadmap work, acceptance criteria, and release decisions.

• Establish product readiness standards and make evidence-based recommendations on whether selected offers are ready to scale.

• Help ensure selected capabilities can be commercialized, deployed, upgraded, supported, and—where applicable—operated by partners with predictable quality.

## Validate and improve repeatable motions

• Design product validation with explicit hypotheses, success criteria, and exit decisions.

• Use deployment, customer, partner, and support evidence to test the path from initial implementation through first customer outcome, day-two administration, upgrades, and support.

• Measure leading indicators of repeatability, including time-to-first-success, standard-path adoption, deployment effort, Engineering intervention, partner and customer experience, and early commercial outcomes.

• Convert evidence into clear recommendations to scale, adjust, hold, or stop an offer.

• Feed learning from pilots, partner feedback, and support activity into product strategy and Core Product roadmaps.

## Lead cross-functional product outcomes

• Bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, Alliances, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, Finance, and Legal around clear product decisions and readiness standards.

• Communicate technical and commercial tradeoffs clearly to senior stakeholders and drive timely decision closure.

• Help establish reusable productization frameworks, evidence models, and readiness criteria that can be applied across multiple partner routes.

• Maintain a current product view of partner-facing offers and recommend when they should be improved, consolidated, or retired.

## Basic Qualifications:

• Seven or more years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, or closely related experience, including full-lifecycle ownership of a complex B2B product, platform, or technical capability.

• Direct product ownership of a capability commercialized, integrated, delivered, or operated through at least one external partner model, with evidence of product decisions and measurable outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to translate customer, partner, commercial, and technical evidence into product investment and prioritization recommendations.

• Technical fluency in enterprise software or platforms, including APIs, integrations, cloud or hybrid deployment, releases and upgrades, security, and supportability.

• Experience leading complex cross-functional work without direct authority.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain product, technical, and commercial tradeoffs clearly to technical and executive audiences.

• Authorization to work in the United States or Canada.

• Ability to travel approximately 15–25%, including international travel.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in enterprise cybersecurity, identity, cryptographic data security, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, key management, encryption, secrets management, or adjacent infrastructure software.

• Experience productizing through one or more GSI, MSP, cloud marketplace, hyperscaler, technology-partner, channel, or other indirect routes to market.

• Experience with cloud platforms or marketplaces; commercial packaging or entitlement; partner-ready releases; reference architectures; or partner-operated services.

• Experience building in regulated or mission-critical enterprise environments.

• A record of using design partners, pilots, readiness gates, and operational metrics to improve adoption and repeatability.

• Strong product discovery and business-case development skills, including the ability to distinguish interest from validated demand and recommend against work that will not scale.

Location: Hybrid in Ottawa, Ontario or Sunrise, Florida, with Tuesday through Thursday onsite.

About Entrust
Entrust keeps the world moving safely by enabling trusted experiences for identities, payments, and digital infrastructure. We offer an unmatched breadth of solutions that are critical to enabling trust for multi-cloud deployments, mobile identities, hybrid work, machine identity, electronic signatures, encryption, and more. With more than 2,800 colleagues, a network of global partners, and customers in over 150 countries, it’s no wonder the world’s most entrusted organizations trust us. ## Help Shape the Future of Talent at Mattr

At Mattr, we believe great businesses are built by great people. We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner who sees recruiting as more than filling positions. This is an opportunity to influence business outcomes, build meaningful partnerships, and help shape the teams that will drive our future growth.

You'll work across a diverse portfolio of operational, technical, engineering, manufacturing, and corporate roles, partnering directly with leaders to identify, attract, and secure exceptional talent. If you're energized by solving complex hiring challenges, uncovering hidden talent, and building relationships that create long-term business value, we'd love to hear from you.

## What You'll Do

## Operate as a Trusted Talent Advisor

The best recruiters don't just fill jobs, they influence decisions.

You'll partner closely with hiring leaders to understand business priorities, challenge conventional thinking, and develop hiring strategies that deliver long-term success. You'll leverage talent market insights, competitive intelligence, and thoughtful consultation to help leaders make informed hiring decisions.

## Find Exceptional Talent Before the Competition Does

We're looking for someone who enjoys the search as much as the hire.

You'll develop creative sourcing strategies, build targeted talent pipelines, and proactively engage high-caliber professionals who may not be actively seeking new opportunities. Your ability to identify and attract talent in competitive markets will be a key driver of success.

## Build Relationships That Matter

Great recruiting is built on trust.

You'll establish strong partnerships with leaders across the business and become known for your ability to understand their challenges, anticipate hiring needs, and deliver solutions. You'll also build meaningful relationships with candidates, creating an experience that reflects the professionalism and values of Mattr.

## Influence the Growth of the Business

Every hire has the potential to impact performance, innovation, and culture.

You'll play a direct role in helping teams grow by attracting talent that strengthens organizational capabilities and supports business objectives. Your work will contribute to operational success today while helping position the organization for future growth.

## Think Beyond Today's Requisitions

This role is about building talent advantage, not simply managing vacancies.

You'll continuously develop talent communities, maintain market awareness, and identify emerging trends that help us stay ahead of changing workforce demands. You'll create pipelines that support both immediate and future hiring needs.

## Improve How We Hire

We're building a modern, scalable Talent Acquisition function, and your ideas will matter.

You'll use data, market insights, candidate feedback, and recruiting best practices to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Whether it's sourcing innovation, recruitment technology, candidate experience, or process improvement, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact.

## What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

• Become a trusted partner to business leaders, known for delivering talent solutions rather than resumes.

• Build strong pipelines of high-quality talent across multiple disciplines.

• Influence hiring decisions through market knowledge, talent insights, and consultative partnership.

• Create a candidate experience that strengthens Mattr's reputation in the marketplace.

• Deliver hiring outcomes that support business growth and operational success.

• Contribute to the continued evolution of a high-performing Talent Acquisition function.

## What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment or talent acquisition, in-house talent experience is considered an asset.

• A proven ability to proactively source and engage talent in competitive markets.

• Strong process discipline to ensure talent activities are tracked against team and company metrics.

• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

• A consultative mindset with the confidence to influence and guide hiring decisions.

• Curiosity about talent markets, workforce trends, and innovative recruiting practices.

• A passion for creating exceptional candidate experiences.

• The ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining a high standard of quality and service.

We welcome applications from internal candidates for this opportunity. To be eligible to apply, internal candidates must be in good standing. Come work with us!
Pleora is the leader in real-time connectivity for industrial automation, security & defense, and medical imaging applications with 25 years of expertise in vision applications with our growing global teams. Our hardware and software solutions are built for performance, enabling low-latency, real-time video and data transport in 1000's of unique systems.

Summary

Pleora Technologies is seeking a Senior Buyer / Planner to lead material planning and procurement activities supporting our manufacturing operations and global supply chain.

This role is responsible for ensuring the right materials are available at the right time and cost to meet customer demand while balancing inventory investment, lead time risk, and operational performance. The Senior Buyer / Planner converts demand into executable supply plans, manages supplier relationships, drives procurement activities, and proactively mitigates supply chain risks that could impact customer delivery commitments.

Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Sales Operations, Finance, and external suppliers, this role plays a critical part in maintaining production continuity, inventory health, and overall supply chain performance.

What You Do

Planning & Inventory Management

• Review and execute MRP recommendations to maintain material availability and support production requirements.

• Develop and maintain material and production plans based on customer demand, forecasts, inventory levels, supplier lead times, and manufacturing capacity.

• Monitor inventory levels and implement inventory strategies that balance customer service, risk mitigation, and working capital objectives.

• Manage planning parameters including safety stock, reorder points, lead times, lot sizes, and planning horizons.

• Analyze forecasts, customer orders, historical demand, and inventory trends to identify supply requirements and risks.

• Coordinate production priorities and material readiness with Manufacturing and Operations teams.

• Support Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) activities through demand and supply analysis.

Procurement & Supplier Management

• Manage purchase orders from creation through delivery, ensuring supplier commitments support business requirements.

• Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships to achieve delivery, quality, cost, and responsiveness expectations.

• Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions related to delivery, shortages, quality, and service issues.

• Negotiate pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and supply agreements where appropriate.

• Evaluate supplier capacity, risk, and continuity of supply for critical components.

• Coordinate supplier escalations, expedites, and recovery plans when material shortages occur.

• Support supplier sourcing, qualification, and onboarding activities.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

• Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies, including alternate sourcing, inventory buffering, and schedule adjustments.

• Support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) by assessing inventory impacts, material transitions, and excess inventory exposure.

• Maintain ERP master data integrity, including item masters, supplier records, lead times, and planning attributes.

• Participate in inventory reviews and support initiatives to reduce excess and obsolete inventory.

• Develop reports and KPI dashboards related to supplier performance, material availability, inventory health, and delivery performance.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives involving ERP optimization, procurement processes, planning methodologies, and operational efficiency.

What You Need

• 5-10 years of experience in purchasing, production planning, material planning, supply chain, or manufacturing operations.

• Post-secondary education in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Strong understanding of MRP, ERP systems, inventory management, procurement, and manufacturing processes.

• Experience managing supplier relationships and purchase orders within a manufacturing environment.

• Advanced Excel skills including Pivot Tables, Power Query, lookups, and data analysis.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

• Demonstrated ability to balance service, cost, inventory, and operational objectives.

Preferred Qualifications / Assets

• APICS / ASCM CPIM, CSCP, or CPSM certification.

• Experience within electronics manufacturing, industrial technology, semiconductor, PCB assembly, or contract manufacturing environments.

• Experience sourcing electronic components and managing global suppliers.

• Knowledge of inventory optimization, demand planning, and forecasting methodologies.

• Experience with Intuitive ERP or similar manufacturing ERP systems.

• Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement principles.

• Knowledge of international logistics, customs, import/export compliance, and supply chain risk management.

• Experience supporting ISO-certified manufacturing environments.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Supplier On-Time Delivery

• Material Availability

• Production Schedule Adherence

• Inventory Accuracy

• Inventory Turns

• Excess & Obsolete Inventory

• Purchase Price Variance (PPV)

• Supplier Lead Time Performance

• Customer Order Fill Rate

• MRP Action Compliance

• Production Line Shortages

• On-Time Customer Delivery

• Excellent work-life balance - and we mean it!

• We offer a diverse and inclusive workplace, in a fast-paced environment without "red tape" - giving you the opportunity to contribute your ideas and make a real contribution to our success

• $100 annual "healthy living" reimbursement

• Employee assistance program

• Competitive market salary

How you'll be rewarded

## Senior Data Scientist, AI Solutions

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

## What you need to know

You will join the Data and Digital Services (DDS) Department and report to the Assistant Director, Data Science. As a hands-on AI expert who thrives in a collaborative, experimentation-driven environment, you will design, build, and deliver end-to-end AI and data science solutions that support AI-focused projects and services across the Bank of Canada. Your work will enable economists and policy teams to access high-quality data, deploy trusted and well-governed models, strengthen analytical tools and processes, and translate insights into real policy impact.

In this role, you directly support the Bank’s core mandate to maintain low and stable inflation and ensure a resilient, efficient financial system.

## What You Will Do

You will design and deliver end-to-end AI and machine learning (ML) solutions within the Bank of Canada's technology ecosystem. Working closely with business partners and multidisciplinary teams, you will develop a deep understanding of business needs and transform them into scalable, secure, and responsible AI capabilities that create measurable value.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership in the design and evolution of AI architectures, helping establish enterprise patterns, standards, and practices that enable AI solutions to scale across the Bank’s policy and research departments. You will ensure AI solutions are effectively integrated, governed, and operated across the Bank’s technology platforms while driving innovation and promoting best practices in AI architecture and delivery.

You will also maintain an active hands-on role in the development and implementation of AI solutions, collaborating with technical teams to translate architectural vision into production-ready capabilities and ensuring solutions deliver sustainable business value.

• Architect, design, and implement AI/ML solutions : Design, build, and implement AI and ML solutions that meet business and technical requirements across platforms such as Azure and Databricks. You will develop scalable architectures, AI orchestration capabilities, and integration patterns that align with the Bank's technology strategy while delivering performance, security, and business value.

• Deliver Trusted AI Services for Policy and Research :Provide and evolve AI services that enable the Bank’s policy and research communities to leverage advanced analytics, ML, and generative AI effectively and responsibly. You will champion governance frameworks, architectural best practices, and model oversight capabilities to ensure solutions are secure, interoperable, scalable, and aligned with the Bank’s strategic objectives.

• Drive innovation and technical leadership : Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies to identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement. You will help shape the Bank's AI direction through technology roadmaps, architectural guidance, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that strengthen organizational expertise.

• Lead solution delivery from concept to operations : Oversee the full lifecycle of AI initiatives, from discovery and architectural design through development, deployment, and operational transition. You will provide technical leadership to ensure solutions are delivered effectively and are positioned for long-term sustainability.

• Partner with stakeholders to deliver business value : Collaborate closely with data scientists, engineers, technology partners, and business lines to understand needs, define solutions, and drive successful outcomes. You will translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations, communicate roadmaps and strategies, and ensure AI investments deliver measurable business impact.

• Promote responsible AI practices : Embed responsible AI principles into solution design by ensuring appropriate levels of explainability, traceability, reproducibility, and human oversight. You will help ensure AI capabilities are developed and deployed in a manner that is transparent, reliable, and aligned with the Bank's governance requirements.

## What You Need to Succeed

• Extensive experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions using platforms such as Azure, Databricks, and Foundry.

• Strong expertise in AI/ML engineering, including Python or R development, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and MLOps/DevOps practices.

• Experience designing AI orchestration solutions, agent-based systems, and integrations using standards and protocols such as MCP.

• Deep understanding of AI architecture, governance, responsible AI principles, and operational considerations including security, scalability, explainability, model validation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects, influence stakeholders, communicate technical concepts effectively, and drive business outcomes.

• Curiosity, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning in the rapidly evolving AI landscape, combined with a passion for coaching and knowledge sharing.

## AI Competencies That Matter

• Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging AI techniques

• Ability to balance experimentation with responsible and ethical AI practices

• Systems thinking and comfort working across complex data and technology ecosystems

## Nice-to-Have

• Experience with ML and statistical predictive models across the full model lifecycle

• Familiarity with MATLAB

## Education and Experience

The position requires a master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related discipline, and a minimum of five (5) years of experience in applied AI/ML solution design and architecture. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “Senior Data Scientist ”

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $111,051 to $130,649 (job grade 17)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension

## About Us:

Behind every innovative new medical device, new healthcare policy, and research into new treatments, there’s a literature review. At DistillerSR Inc., we’re changing the way that scientific research is conducted. Founded in 2008, DistillerSR is the world’s leading AI-enabled workflow automation and evidence management platform for streamlining the production of critical literature-based health research. DistillerSR is used by 80% of the top 10 global medical device and pharmaceutical companies to inform life- changing product research, prepare regulatory submissions and to monitor for safety issues with medical products once in market. At DistillerSR, we have three core values: Always Leading, Always Innovating, and Always Trusted. Our amazing team lives these values every day and our customers trust us to bring them innovative, world-leading solutions that power their important work.

## Scope of the Role:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering, the configuration specialist will be responsible for assisting with the analysis, design, configuration, and testing of DistillerSR solutions to meet client-specific requirements.

Note: Duties are not limited to those listed above. Additional duties may be assigned as required. However, reasonable consultations with personnel will be made if possible, under business conditions.

## Requirements

Required Qualifications

• University degree or college diploma with a concentration in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce, or equivalent.

• An analytical mindset and strong business communication skills.

• Minimum two years of experience in technical software configuration.

• Basic understanding of APIs, REST and GraphQL.

• Basic understanding of probabilistic AI such as naïve bayes and SVM.

• Working knowledge of the software delivery life cycle, including business requirements definition, understanding of functional specifications, development of test plans, testing, user training, and deployment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform well in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of quality and client satisfaction.

• Attention to detail

• Ability to work under pressure with excellent time management and priority handling skills

• Strong communication skills – verbal, written, and presentation

• Planning and organization and able to work well in a team environment

• Sound judgment with ability to learn quickly

• Customer service orientation with positive attitude and drive to succeed

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using DistillerSR products

Position Overview:
The Maintenance Supervisor is responsible for leading, scheduling, and developing the maintenance technician team to ensure all equipment, facilities, and systems operate safely and efficiently. This role oversees daily maintenance activities, prioritizes work orders, coordinates preventive maintenance, and ensures compliance with safety and operational standards.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a Maintenance Supervisor:

• Supervises, coaches, and supports all maintenance technicians, including performance management and skill development.

• Assigns, prioritizes, and reviews daily work orders to ensure timely completion.

• Oversees preventive maintenance programs and ensures documentation is accurate and up to date.

• Troubleshoots mechanical, electrical, and facility-related issues; assists technicians as needed.

• Partners with operations leadership to plan downtime, communicates maintenance needs, and minimizes production disruption.

• Maintains inventory of tools, parts, and supplies; coordinates with vendors as needed.

• Ensures all work is completed in compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and quality standards.

• Monitors equipment performance and recommend improvements to increase reliability and reduce cost.

• Leads root-cause analysis for equipment failures and drive corrective actions.

• Maintains accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment history, and team schedules.

• Supports onboarding and training for new technicians and promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.

## Required Qualifications:

• High school diploma or technical degree; additional certifications in industrial maintenance preferred.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in maintenance and 2 years of experience as a front line manager.

• Knowledge of industrial equipment, facility systems, chemical pumps, valves, control systems, instrumentation and preventive maintenance practices.

• Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

• Ability to read technical manuals, schematics, and blueprints.

• Working knowledge of CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems).

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, manufacturing or facility environment.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Economist, Canadian Economic Analysis Department Rotation Program

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

This staffing process may be used to establish a pool of qualified candidates for permanent or term positions that may become available in the near future.

Interested in launching your career through a rotation?
We are seeking an early-career economist to join the Rotation Program in the Canadian Economic Analysis (CEA) department. This structured program offers a broad experience across CEA while allowing you to contribute from the outset to high-impact analysis that informs monetary policy. Through the rotation, you will learn how economists at the Bank assess economic conditions in Canada, develop the economic outlook, and provide timely advice to support monetary policy decisions.Depending on your placement, you could assess and forecast key economic developments, contribute to staff economic projections or work with economists and researchers on rigorous, policy-relevant research that advances the understanding of the Canadian economy and contributes to the broader economics literature.You could also help develop the data, models, and analytical tools used across the department. You will turn complex economic information into clear briefings, research, and analytical products for senior management and Governing Council. After completing the rotation, you will be placed permanently in one division, where you can build on the expertise and relationships developed through the program.

## What you will do

In this role, you will prepare and deliver insightful briefings to senior management and transform complex economic data into clear, actionable insights. Your analysis will help inform decisions that affect Canada’s economy. You will contribute to the Bank’s publications, including staff analytical papers and major reports like the Monetary Policy Report.

You will have opportunities to spend time on professional development. Whether it’s learning new software or exploring recent economic theories, continuous learning is a part of the role.
As an economist in the Canadian Economic Analysis (CEA) department, you will conduct economic analysis and research that support the Bank’s assessment of the Canadian economy and inform monetary policy advice.

Examples of analytical work include:

• Designing new models and tools to monitor and forecast economic conditions

• Contributing to staff economic projections using large-scale macroeconomic models

• Analyzing information gathered through business and consumer surveys, regional outreach, and consultations to identify emerging economic trends and assess risks to the Canadian economic outlook

• Assessing the implications of major structural changes in the Canadian economy, such as demographic shifts, for growth, productivity, inflation, and the conduct of monetary policy

• Collaborating with economists and researchers on rigorous, longer-term research that advances the understanding of the Canadian economy and contributes to the broader economics literature

• Examining fundamental questions in monetary economics, including the design of Canada’s monetary policy framework

What you need to succeed
You have the ability to initiate and carry out rigorous research and analytical projects, and to use data and quantitative methods, including econometrics and time-series analysis, to develop evidence-based policy advice. You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate alternatives and develop innovative solutions.

You demonstrate a high degree of intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning and self-development. You proactively identify emerging opportunities and translate them into forward-looking model development plans.

You collaborate effectively across teams and contribute to shared objectives. You are able to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely completion. You also have strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to varied audiences.

## Nice-to-have

• Proficiency in programming with tools like Python, R, Stata, SQL, MATLAB, EViews, etc.

• Experience applying AI tools and methodologies to economic analysis, modelling, data processing, coding, and policy-relevant research

• Familiarity with Canadian data sources and concepts

Your education and experience
The position requires a master’s degree in economics or finance.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

## Language requirement

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “Economist ”

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

## Economist

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $78,389 to $111,050 (job grade P1-P4).

• During the progression, you are not eligible for performance pay. Instead performance is rewarded via a faster rate of progression through the salary range.

## Additional benefit information:

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental, disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension plan
