At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
SUMMARY
Jabil is seeking an experienced Senior Photonics Test Development Engineer in Ottawa, Canada. In this role, you will be responsible for developing test solutions for photonics/optics products; including developing the test strategy and test plan, selecting/sourcing test equipment and test fixtures/hardware, developing the test automation software, and deploying the completed test solutions worldwide at Jabil manufacturing sites and/or design verification labs.

You will work closely with customers and Jabil’s extended cross-functional teams (R&D, Manufacturing, Program Management, Quality) to deliver optimized manufacturing test solutions for both customer and Jabil-designed products. You will also support R&D in evaluating performance of early product releases.

You will be a strong team player and play a critical member in defining future test strategies for the Photonics Test Engineering team at Jabil.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop manufacturing and/or design verification test plans for optimal test coverage, test time and cost efficiency. Develop test capacity analyses for product demand forecasts provided by Sales/Business Managers.

• Develop test hardware solutions including selection of test equipment and design of test fixtures/test PCBAs.

• Develop test software solutions including test automation scripts, operator GUI and data analysis using software languages such as Python, C#, MATLAB, etc.

• Verify test station operation, performance, stability and robustness.

• Perform hands-on design verification testing (DVT) of prototypes in R&D labs when requested. Maximize reuse of DVT software for subsequent manufacturing test solution.

• Generate test documentation such as test plans, test hardware descriptions, test software requirements/descriptions, test equipment lists, test procedures, debug/troubleshooting manuals, training plans, etc.

• Provide test/diagnostics training to technicians, test operators and other test engineers as required.

• Support root cause analysis & troubleshooting activities on NPI and volume product in test. Analyze test data to determine issues with product test performance and recommend corrective actions.

• Assist in developing budgets, quoting new projects and estimating cost impact of change requests.

• Collaborate with extended teams to develop project schedules and execute projects to completion.

MANAGEMENT & SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Typically reports to Manager – Photonics Test Engineering.

• On large projects, leads team of Test Development Engineers on Photonics Test Development Projects. Coaches and guides other team members and participates in implementing best test engineering practices throughout the organization.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS - KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS
Mandatory Requirements:

• Demonstrated experience in the testing of photonics technology (devices, modules, line cards, shelves, etc.).

• Strong knowledge of English (both spoken and written). Able to converse on technical topics in English, and to prepare and present reports in English.

• Good understanding of fundamental optical concepts such as optical power, optical power loss/gain, optical wavelength/spectrum, polarization, polarization dependent loss, optical signal-to-noise ratio, etc.

• Good understanding of key test and measurement concepts utilized in assessing the performance of optical transmitters, receivers and transceivers, such as bit error rate, eye diagram characterization, jitter, etc.

• Experience with standard test equipment used for test and characterization of optical products, such as bit error rate testers, optical power meters, optical amplifiers, optical spectrum analyzers, wavelength meters, etc.

• Experience developing software/test scripts using object-oriented software languages: Python (preferred), C++, etc.

Beneficial Requirements:

• Experience with testing photonic products with coherent optical technology.

• Experience with testing pluggable transceivers, such as SFP, QSFP, CFP2/CFP4, etc.

• Past development writing s/w used for test automation: Python, C++, C#, MATLAB, Test Stand, LabVIEW, C/C++, ATEasy, etc.

• Experience with support of manufacturing sites, where optical products are built and tested.

• Some experience with functional testing of PCBAs is desirable.

• Good understanding of manufacturing test strategies for optical products.

• Good understanding of the differences between manufacturing test and design verification test.

• Experience in developing cost-effective test stations for volume manufacturing.

General Requirements:

• Strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting skills.

• Leader. Oversees and/or mentors others. Works well within a team environment.

• Self-starter, highly motivated and with strong desire of accountability and ownership.

• Ability to develop project schedules, budgets and track projects to completion.

• Compliance with Employee Health and Safety policies (EHS), and Corporate IT Security policy

• Willingness to travel world-wide up to 20% of the time.

• Fluent in use of standard Microsoft Office tools.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS - EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

• Electrical Engineering Degree or equivalent.

• Minimum 5 years in photonics/optical test development in an R&D, EMS or OEM environment.

Ericsson is looking for an AI Software & Data Engineering Developer to join our team in Ottawa, Canada. In this role, you will contribute to building new functionality as part of Ericsson's AI transformation within BNEW R&D, helping create scalable, secure, and data-driven AI solutions that improve R&D efficiency and enable customer deployments across RAN.

The RAN Reliability System in Customer Deployment Evolution team is a group of software developers and data scientists building AI solutions to increase R&D efficiency and support customer deployments. You will help transform ideas and prototypes into maintainable software products by combining strong engineering practices, AI/ML knowledge, and practical data engineering skills. We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, open to emerging technologies, and motivated to solve complex challenges collaboratively. This is a hybrid position with an expectation of approximately 60% in-office presence.

• Develop AI solutions to scale and industrialize at the RAN level, transforming troubleshooting on a common foundation to scale from customer to design.

• Take technical ownership for the design, implementation, integration, verification, deployment, and continuous improvement of AI-enabled software solutions.

• Build data engineering capabilities, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, quality checks, metadata handling, reusable pipelines, and reliable processing of engineering data for AI and analytics use cases.

• Work with internal engineering data — such as logs, telemetry, test results, CI/CD results, trouble reports, and code review information — while respecting security, confidentiality, and access control requirements.

• Integrate AI solutions into software development workflows, including Git-based development, Gerrit/code review, continuous integration, automated testing, secure development practices, and vulnerability management.

• Collaborate with developers, data scientists, architects, product owners, and R&D stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with Ericsson's ways of working.

• Support colleagues through mentorship, contribute to design reviews, and help the team adopt AI-assisted development and data-driven approaches responsibly.

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field; equivalent hands-on experience is equally valued.

• Approximately 6+ years of experience in software development, preferably in telecommunications software, with a background in cloud-native and/or custom software using containers, Kubernetes, Python, Java, shell scripting, and Linux environments.

• Demonstrated experience integrating AI/ML into software workflows, including AI-assisted development, automated testing, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and domain-specific model adaptation.

• Solid understanding of CI/CD, Git-based workflows, Gerrit/code review, automated verification, secure development, DevSecOps, and vulnerability management in large-scale R&D environments.

• Practical data engineering experience, including ingestion, transformation, validation, data quality, metadata, traceability, access control, reliable pipelines, and operational monitoring.

• Experience using engineering data from development, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and CI/CD to create AI-ready datasets and actionable insights.

• Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and secure AI solutions and turn prototypes into reusable, well-supported software components.

• Experience contributing to technical direction and improving engineering practices across teams.

• Strong analytical and communication skills; familiarity with 5G NR, LTE RAN, or Cloud RAN is a strong asset.

Aperçu du poste

Le ou la gestionnaire principal(e) de projet bilingue (Nucléaire) est responsable de la direction et de la réalisation de projets au sein de la division Nucléaire et Environnement de Calian, de l’initiation jusqu’à la clôture, tout en assurant un équilibre efficace entre la qualité, la portée, l’échéancier et le budget.

CareersInnerInfo
Responsabilités

Direction des programmes et des projets

• Diriger et mener à bien des programmes de grande envergure, complexes et/ou stratégiques comprenant plusieurs projets, des équipes multidisciplinaires et des sous-traitants.

• Assumer la responsabilité globale de la performance des programmes, notamment en ce qui concerne la portée, les échéanciers, les coûts, la qualité, les risques, la gestion des changements et la mobilisation des parties prenantes.

• Encadrer, guider et superviser les gestionnaires de projet et les gestionnaires de projet juniors afin d’assurer l’application uniforme des meilleures pratiques en gestion de projet.

• Veiller à ce que les gestionnaires de projet assurent une gestion efficace de leurs projets, notamment en matière de planification, d’exécution, de suivi, de production de rapports et de clôture.

Gestion financière et de la performance

• Examiner les rapports d’avancement destinés aux clients présentant l’état et l’avancement globaux des programmes, les risques et problèmes, les sommaires financiers, les prévisions de coûts et les possibilités d’élargissement de la portée.

• Assurer une supervision stratégique des budgets des programmes, des prévisions, de la performance des coûts et de l’analyse des écarts.

• Veiller à ce que les gestionnaires de projet élaborent des prévisions exactes et des plans de redressement lorsque requis.

• Repérer et poursuivre les possibilités d’élargissement de la portée, de services à valeur ajoutée et de travaux subséquents.

Gestion des risques, des problèmes et des changements

• Cerner de façon proactive les risques au niveau des programmes et veiller à ce que les gestionnaires de projet mettent en œuvre et respectent les plans approuvés de réponse aux risques.

• Tenir à jour et gérer un registre des risques des programmes, y compris l’escalade des risques et problèmes importants à la haute direction.

• Traiter les risques et problèmes liés aux projets transmis par l’équipe de gestion de projet et soutenir l’élaboration de stratégies efficaces d’atténuation et de redressement.

• Veiller à ce que les gestionnaires de projet présentent clairement aux clients les risques, les problèmes et les plans de redressement connexes.

• Diriger et superviser les processus de gestion des changements, notamment l’examen et l’approbation des demandes de changement et des registres de changements de portée.

Gestion des clients, des communications et des parties prenantes

• Présider avec assurance de grandes réunions internes et externes (20 participants et plus), en mobilisant des parties prenantes de différents niveaux hiérarchiques.

• Présenter clairement l’état des programmes, les risques et problèmes, les plans de redressement et les possibilités lors des réunions avec les clients et la direction.

• Approuver et diffuser le contenu destiné aux réunions avec les clients, notamment les ordres du jour et les documents de présentation.

• Approuver et diffuser les comptes rendus de discussions afin de veiller à ce que les décisions clés, les mesures à prendre et les éléments de communication soient clairement consignés et mis en évidence.

• Tenir un registre de suivi des mesures des programmes et veiller à ce que les responsables assurent leur clôture.

• Établir et maintenir des relations positives fondées sur la confiance avec les équipes de projet, les clients, les fournisseurs et la direction interne.

• Agir à titre de conseiller principal de confiance auprès des clients et comme point d’escalade clé.

• Repérer et discuter aisément des possibilités de développement des affaires avec les clients, en collaboration avec la direction et les équipes de développement des affaires.

Qualité, gouvernance et amélioration continue

• Mettre en œuvre et faire respecter des contrôles de qualité appropriés dans l’ensemble des programmes, en veillant au respect des règlements de la CCSN, des codes et normes nucléaires et des systèmes de qualité internes.

• Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration continue et veiller à ce que les leçons apprises soient consignées et mises en œuvre dans les projets et les programmes.

• Soutenir les activités d’élaboration des propositions, notamment la stratégie de soumission, la supervision de l’élaboration des propositions, les estimations de coûts, la contribution à la planification et la coordination des équipes de proposition multidisciplinaires.

• Superviser la performance des fournisseurs et des sous-traitants afin de veiller au respect des exigences contractuelles, des échéanciers et des coûts.

• Se déplacer sur les sites des clients au besoin afin de soutenir la réalisation des programmes, les relations avec les clients et les besoins de l’entreprise.

Exigences en matière de formation, d’expérience et de compétences :

• Baccalauréat en génie, en sciences appliquées, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine équivalent.

• Dix (10) années ou plus d’expérience en gestion de projet, y compris la direction de projets et de programmes de grande envergure, complexes ou stratégiques.

• Doit maîtriser le français et l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à la lecture et à l’écrit

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion d’équipes multidisciplinaires de 10 employés ou plus et de plusieurs sous-traitants.

• Une expérience en gestion de programmes ou en supervision de plusieurs projets connexes est fortement souhaitée.

• Expérience dans l’industrie nucléaire canadienne, y compris une connaissance pratique des règlements de la CCSN, des codes nucléaires et des normes de qualité.

• Une certification PMP ou une certification équivalente en gestion de projet est souhaitée.

• Solide expertise en gestion des coûts au niveau des programmes, en prévision, en analyse des écarts et en production de rapports financiers.

• Capacité démontrée à mettre en œuvre et à superviser une gouvernance de projet rigoureuse, une gestion des risques et des contrôles de qualité efficaces.

• Capacités démontrées en leadership et en encadrement, notamment pour accompagner et développer le personnel de gestion de projet.

• Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite — claires, concises, directives et porteuses d’une vision — avec la capacité d’approuver et de diffuser des documents destinés aux clients et des rapports de niveau exécutif.

• Excellentes aptitudes en communication verbale — claires, concises, directives et porteuses d’une vision — avec l’assurance nécessaire pour présider de grandes réunions et présenter des informations à des parties prenantes de haut niveau.

• Solides aptitudes à établir et à maintenir des relations avec les clients, les fournisseurs, les équipes de projet et la direction.

• Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de résoudre des enjeux techniques, commerciaux et liés aux parties prenantes complexes.

• La condition d’emploi comprend la capacité d’obtenir et de maintenir une habilitation de sécurité pour les sites nucléaires.

• Volonté de travailler sur les sites des clients au besoin (notamment à Toronto, Tiverton, dans la région de Durham, à Regina ou à Ottawa).

Exigences supplémentaires

• Doit être admissible à l’obtention d’une cote de sécurité du gouvernement du Canada.

• Doit être en mesure de se déplacer selon les besoins du poste.

• Ce poste est ouvert aux candidats résidant au Québec. Les employés situés à moins de 50 km d’un bureau de Calian devront travailler selon un mode hybride.

• Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) est requis pour ce poste. La personne retenue devra communiquer régulièrement avec des clients et des parties prenantes internes situés à l’extérieur du Québec et de l’Ontario, partout au Canada ainsi qu’à l’international. En tant qu’organisation mondiale, la capacité de communiquer efficacement dans les deux langues officielles est essentielle pour soutenir la collaboration, les relations avec la clientèle et la réalisation des projets.

140 000 $ à 170 000 $ par année.

## Financial Sector Specialist Analyst

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

## Did you know?

The Financial and Enterprise Risk (FER) department supports an enterprise-wide view of risk management across the Bank of Canada. Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, the department is responsible for the oversight of enterprise and financial risks.

## About Team

Within the FER department the Market and Credit Risk Office (MACRO) monitors reports, and advises on financial risks arising from the Bank’s monetary policy and financial stability activities inherent in the Bank’s balance sheet and pension fund. The team also provides independent oversight, risk analysis to support risk‑informed decision‑making and works on projects such as development of risk management frameworks, balance sheet analysis and climate-related financial reporting.

In parallel, MACRO delivers independent in‑house credit risk assessments and credit risk advice through its Credit Risk function, evaluating the credit default risk of assets and other financial exposures, including those related to sovereigns, agencies, supranational organizations, and financial institutions. These assessments support the assignment of internal credit ratings, are governed through Credit Rating Committees. The internal ratings are used in setting Government of Canada guidelines for the management of foreign exchange reserves and Receiver General cash balances.

The FER department is currently seeking an FSS Analyst for the Market Risk function within MACRO. This role is based in Ottawa. This position will primarily be to support market risk function and monitor the Bank's balance sheet risks, with opportunities to cross-train on credit risk depending on business and operational needs.

## What you will do

You will provide financial risk advice and analytical expertise to FER senior management and various FER clients. You will contribute to the team by providing analytic support regarding financial risk topics and issues. You will also conduct in-depth, longer-term analytic projects and undertake joint research assignments designed to improve risk exposure measurement and control techniques. Furthermore, you will assist in the identification and development of information technology (IT) solutions for risk-management issues.

Other responsibilities of the broad MACRO team include:

• monitoring and reporting on financial risks such as interest rate risk, foreign exchange rate risk and credit risk

• building, maintaining, and running complex financial models using various analytic tools (e.g., Python, Matlab. Data Fabric, Databricks)

• conducting analysis and research on risk-management topics and MACRO business issues

• analyzing financial risk exposures within our balance sheet

• contributing to strategy development and measurement methodologies to manage the Bank of Canada’s climate-related financial risks

• developing and implementing risk frameworks

## What you need to succeed

You have a solid understanding of risk-management practices and techniques, finance theory, macroeconomics, quantitative methods, and fixed-income financial market instruments. You have proficiency in analytical tools and are committed to learning and self-development. A desire to seek out innovative solutions to complex problems allows you to contribute to building a stronger risk culture within the Bank. You can develop positive working relationships to help deliver on a variety of commitments, provide insightful feedback for your teammates, and value a diversity of ideas. Lastly, you have a proven track record of communicating clearly and adapting your communication style (both written and oral) for a broad range of audiences, including senior management and external partners.

## Nice-to-have

• a completed professional designation, e.g., Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM)

• advanced quantitative and programming proficiency in one or more statistical or analytical languages (e.g., Python, VBA, and Matlab), and/or ability to leverage tools for data extraction and aggregation (e.g., SQL and PowerQuery)

• experience working with cloud-based analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks and Power BI/Fabric

• ability to use AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to support financial analysis and reporting, with strong judgment to validate outputs, ensure accuracy, and comply with established controls

## Your education and experience

• a completed master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a relevant field of study with a minimum of two years of recent work experience in the area of risk management, portfolio management/trading, or related areas of financial markets in a private or public sector institution.

or

• an equivalent combination of education, professional designation, and experience may be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

## Language requirement

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

## FSS Analyst

• Candidates whose experience and/or educational background may not be at the level being recruited for will be considered for a position within the accelerated progression stream program. Location: Calgary or Toronto, Canada (Primarily Remote with Occasional Onsite Requirements)

## Summary

As an Accounts Payable Coordinator, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and integrity of Mattr's accounts payable operations. Success in this role means vendor and intercompany invoices are processed accurately and on time, payment obligations are met consistently, vendor relationships remain strong, and financial records support audit readiness and sound cash management practices. Working closely with finance, procurement, operations, and business units, you will help maintain reliable payables processes that directly support organizational performance and supplier confidence.

## Responsibilities

## Drive Accurate Invoice Processing

• Process and post vendor invoices to the appropriate general ledger accounts and cost centres with a high degree of accuracy.

• Match invoices to purchase orders and receipts using 2-way and 3-way matching processes.

• Investigate and resolve quantity, pricing, and receipt discrepancies in partnership with procurement and internal stakeholders.

• Maintain complete and audit-ready supporting documentation for all transactions.

## Ensure Timely and Accurate Payments

• Prepare and execute vendor payment runs, including EFT, cheque, and wire payments, on established schedules.

• Verify payment terms, approval requirements, and banking information before payment processing.

• Identify opportunities to capture early-payment discounts while preventing duplicate or late payments.

## Strengthen Vendor Relationships

• Reconcile vendor statements against accounts payable records and resolve discrepancies promptly.

• Respond professionally to vendor and internal inquiries regarding invoice and payment status.

• Maintain accurate vendor master data, including contact details, banking information, and tax records.

## Support Intercompany Transactions

• Process intercompany invoices and ensure appropriate coding and allocation.

• Reconcile intercompany balances and collaborate with divisional finance teams to resolve differences before month-end close.

## Maintain Compliance in Employee Expense Processing

• Review employee expense reports for policy compliance, coding accuracy, and supporting documentation.

• Follow up on missing information and escalate policy exceptions when required.

## Contribute to Month-End Close and Financial Controls

• Generate and analyze accounts payable aging reports.

• Support month-end activities through reconciliations, accruals, reporting, and subledger maintenance.

• Maintain compliance with internal controls, approval policies, and segregation-of-duties requirements.

## Qualifications

## Experience

• 2+ years of full-cycle accounts payable or related accounting experience.

• Experience with invoice processing, PO matching, and vendor statement reconciliation.

• Proficiency with ERP/accounting systems and Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Experience with intercompany processing and month-end AP close in a multi-entity environment.

• Hands-on experience with AP automation and expense-management platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Concur, Coupa).

## Preferred

• College Certificate or Diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Manufacturing industry experience

• Progress toward an accounting designation or AP certification is an asset.

• Familiarity with sales tax coding (GST/HST/PST) on payables.

## Technical Competencies

• Full-cycle accounts payable processing and 2-/3-way PO matching.

• ERP/accounting systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics).

• AP automation and expense platforms (e.g., Concur, Coupa).

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivot tables) and Word/PowerPoint.

• Vendor statement and subledger reconciliation.

• GL coding, cost-centre allocation, and basic sales tax treatment on payables.

## Behavioral Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy under recurring deadlines.

• Effective written and verbal communication with vendors and internal teams.

• Strong organization and time management across high transaction volumes.

• Problem-solving and professional dispute resolution.

Position Overview:
The position involves safely repairing, constructing, and servicing electronic and electrical machinery and equipment. Responsibilities include diagnosing electrical issues, interpreting diagrams, planning workflows, and designing component adaptations. The electrician is also tasked with mechanical repairs, maintaining communication wiring and power distribution systems, and ensuring a clean work environment. Additional duties include reporting errors, maintaining performance records, and performing other assigned tasks as needed.

## Location:

On-site in Mt. Vernon, IN

## Your Day to Day as a Maintenance Technician:

• Performs all work safely, working within established procedures and uses a questioning attitude to prevent and stop unsafe work conditions.

• Repairs, constructs, adjusts, modifies, installs and sets-up and services all types of electronic and electrical machinery and equipment throughout the works as required.

• Make sketches and layouts, performs diagnoses and corrects any and all electronic and electrical difficulties, including all specialized equipment.

• Works from wiring diagrams, drawings, specifications, and written and verbal instructions.

• Analyzes all types of circuits, wiring diagrams and drawings.

• Plans details of working procedure to determine material or replacement needs and selects the most logical approach to trouble shooting and repair problems.

• Designs and constructs adaptations or conversions of component parts.

• Assembles, installs, adjusts, repairs or replaces faulty parts or wiring and all types of electronic designs.

• Make mechanical and electrical repairs in connection with the servicing of electronic equipment.

• Hooks up and moves material, equipment and products to and from work area and building by hand or uses material handling equipment, including overhead cranes.

• Maintains, installs or repairs all communication cables or wiring.

• Maintains primary power distribution system, including power cable splices.

• Plans and performs work requiring a thorough knowledge of electrical and electronic principles, wiring specification codes, properties of various materials and principle of operation and application of equipment.

• Keeps own work area, machinery and equipment clean and orderly.

• Detects and reports faulty operations and defective materials.

• Reports print errors and/or errors in written and verbal instructions.

• Maintains performance and maintenance records of all equipment worked on or assigned duties.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

## Required Qualifications:

• A two-year technical certification, (Significantly directly related work experience or military training can substitute for trade school training), along with a minimum of two years experience in a comparable manufacturing environment.

• Must pass quality control testing, as required.

• Must be able to climb to any height, work in confined spaces, and routinely life 40 lbs.

• Must qualify to use cartridge type respirator.

• Must furnish adequate personal tools to properly perform required duties.

• Applicants selected for this position must comply with all safety and plant rules, regulations and practices and must attend training classes, as required.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• This position requires shift work, and successful applicants must be willing to work any shift.

• PLC Experience, Siemens based preferred

• Industrial electrician experience, such as conduit bending

• Substation switchgear experience

On-site in Jonesborough, TN

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. ## Position Overview:

Our Machinists in Mount Vernon work on large-scale, multi-axis CNC mills and lathes to machine one-of-a-kind precision components for naval nuclear reactors used in submarines and aircraft carriers.

This is a low-volume, highly-engineered manufacturing environment, where you’d be involved in the full life cycle of the build. You’ll work in a safe, clean, and highly-specialized manufacturing environment alongside a great team of skilled colleagues. This is unique work that will allow you to demonstrate your machining skills all while supporting the safety of our nation’s sailors.

Due to the importance of quality in our shop, all of our machinists start out with paid on the job training and mentoring prior to working alone. Overtime is required but flexible in how it is achieved. Additional overtime work is also available if desired. Our machinists receive shift premium for second shift work and premium pay like double time based on hours/days worked in a week. We are also currently offering a sign-on bonus of $4,000. Relocation assistance is available for qualified applicants.

The job will start with training on day shift and then transition to a three (3) day weekend schedule, twelve (12) hour shifts, Friday through Sunday. The pay will be for forty hours, three days per week.

## Location:

On-site in Mt. Vernon, Indiana

## Your Day to Day as a CNC Machinist:

In this role, you will set up and operate CNC machine tools to perform various types of machining operations such as milling, drilling, tapping/thread milling, boring, and turning in order to meet print specifications. Additionally, you would:

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify products meet customer requirements and product specifications

• Work to ±.001” tolerance and 16 microfinish when necessary

• Write/edit programs using both G and M coded controls (experience with Siemens and Fanuc controls preferred)

• Troubleshoot challenges with support of on-site engineering

• Routinely read and comprehend written instructions, technical procedures, prints, sketches, and bills of material

• Work in a team environment by assisting the CNC Programmer as necessary to develop and/or test run programs

• Use advanced mathematical skills to calculate proper speed and feed rates

• Operate crane or assist with the rigging and moving of parts

• Maintain clean work area and daily housekeeping duties

• Collaborate and communicate with opposite shift through face-to-face carryover and log books

• Work with tooling application engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices

• Work in accordance with all applicable company procedures, policies and rules

## Required Qualifications:

• High school equivalency with a minimum of four (4) years relevant experience.

• Associate’s of Applied Science degree in Machining Tool and Die or equivalent training plus two (2) years of on-the-job experience may be considered in lieu of experience.

• Experience with grinders, tool setters, jacks, clamps, bolts, shims, jigs, fixtures, angle plates, rules, micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, gages, levels, protractors, verniers, and light hand tools.

• Ability to maintain detailed records; ability to complete process documentation and other production records.

• Ability to work any shift, to include nights and weekends.

• U.S. citizenship is required for this position.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience machining parts greater than 8-feet diameter and 10-tons is preferred.

• Experience with different machining attachments (i.e. right angle, universal, offset milling) is preferred.

• Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) is preferred.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

• We are also currently offering a sign-on bonus of $4,000!

Position Overview:
As a Process Engineer, you will play a key role in evaluating, improving, and supporting manufacturing processes within assigned work centers and work cells. Your work will ensure material integrity, processing reliability, and product performance across a range of metals and specialty alloys. This role is highly collaborative, working closely with engineering, operations, and quality teams to ensure safe, efficient, and consistent materials processing. You will help drive continuous improvement efforts, support root-cause investigations, and shape material‑related standards across the organization.

Location:
On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

Your Day-to-Day as a Process Engineer:
• Assess manufacturing processes to understand how material properties, behavior, and processing parameters influence product performance and manufacturability.
• Monitor Quality Notifications and partner with engineers to identify material-related failure modes, deviations, or property variances, generating next actions to prevent recurrence.
• Evaluate tooling, fixturing, and material-handling requirements to ensure proper processing, dimensional stability, and material integrity.
• Identify gaps in material specifications, testing requirements, certifications, and supplemental data for work scopes.
• Work directly with operators to assess shift performance and ensure proper handling of material sensitivities such as heat input, deformation, machining behavior, and environmental controls.
• Provide Engineering & Technical Services (E&TS) support to ensure material-readiness actions are completed.
• Review past work scopes and incorporate lessons learned related to material performance, process-material interactions, and specification compliance.
• Collaborate with manufacturing engineers to standardize material-sensitive instructions across product lines for consistent processing.
• Develop supplemental documentation such as material handling guidelines, process windows, setup drawings, and photo instructions.
• Use root-cause analysis techniques to investigate material-related defects, recurring nonconformances, microstructural concerns, and process-driven property variations.
• Interpret complex data sets, identify patterns, and apply statistical reasoning to highlight trends and improvement opportunities.
• Lead continuous improvement projects focused on material flow, processing reliability, yield enhancement, and scrap/rework reduction.
• Collaborate with Operations Managers, Engineering Product Teams, and supporting groups to define or reorganize work centers based on material-processing needs, new materials, or new equipment integration.

Required Qualifications:
• Strong communication skills and an interest in working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and quality teams.
• Proficiency with MRP systems and Microsoft Office programs.
• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science & Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (Materials Science preferred).
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in process engineering, materials engineering, or manufacturing involving critical material requirements.
• Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience in manufacturing environments involving metals, specialty alloys, or complex material systems.
• Advanced understanding of material behavior, microstructure, and process/material interactions.
• Master’s degree is a plus.

What We Offer:
• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance (as applicable for the role).
• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and continuing education support.
• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration across generations.
• The opportunity to contribute to mission-driven work that shapes the future of energy.
• Continuous learning and training opportunities to grow throughout your career.

## Senior Manufacturing Cost Analyst

Work type: Remote

We are seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manufacturing Cost Analyst to oversee and manage financial operations relating to manufacturing costing, inventory management, cost of goods sold (COGS), warranty expenses, freight analysis, and overall cost control within the manufacturing processes. This role will work closely with production, finance, and supply chain teams to provide accurate cost analysis, optimize cost-efficiency, and support decision-making processes related to manufacturing operations.

## ## Key Responsibilities:

• Inventory Management & Costing:

• Oversee the valuation and reporting of inventory, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards (slow moving inventory, obsolesce provision, standard costing, average cost monitoring)

• Develop and implement cost accounting methods for inventory, including standard costing, work-in-process, and finished goods.

• Monitor inventory turnover, manage excess and obsolete inventory, and recommend strategies for inventory reduction and optimization.

• Participate in inventory counts on site with operations Quarterly.

• Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Management:

• Analyze COGS, monitor variances, and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal profit margins.

• Work with production teams to understand cost drivers, identify inefficiencies, and ensure accurate tracking of direct materials, labor, and overhead in the production process.

• Ensure that costing methodologies align with financial reporting and business strategy.

• Manufacturing Cost Analysis:

• Perform detailed analysis of manufacturing cost components (direct labor, materials, overhead) and recommend cost-saving measures.

• Develop reports to track and monitor manufacturing cost performance, identifying trends and areas of improvement.

• Prepare cost estimates for new products, production changes, and capital investments in manufacturing.

• Warranty & Returns Cost Management:

• Oversee the analysis and accounting of warranty expenses, ensuring accurate tracking and financial oversight of warranty projects.

• Collaborate with quality assurance and service teams to assess warranty cost trends and propose strategies for reducing warranty claims.

• Freight & Logistics Cost Control:

• Manage freight costs, ensuring efficient and cost-effective transportation solutions for inbound materials and outbound products.

• Work with logistics teams to analyze freight performance, identify cost-saving opportunities, and optimize distribution networks.

• Analyze and track freight costs as part of overall product cost management.

• Cost Reporting & Financial Analysis:

• Prepare and present regular reports to senior management and plant managers on manufacturing costs, inventory performance, COGS, warranty claims, and freight expenditures.

• Assist with budgeting and forecasting processes related to manufacturing costs.

• Provide financial insights and support for strategic decision-making on production plans and cost control initiatives.

• Process Improvement & Cross-functional Collaboration:

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives within manufacturing costing, ensuring the efficiency of cost control mechanisms.

• Partner with cross-functional teams (Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, etc.) to align manufacturing costs with organizational objectives.

• Identify opportunities to enhance cost-efficiency through process reengineering and automation.

## ## Qualifications:

• Education:

• Certificate/Diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field. A CPA, CMA, or similar professional certification is an asset

• Engineering Degree is acceptable with relevant experience

• Experience:

• Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in cost accounting or financial analysis in a manufacturing environment, with a focus on inventory, COGS, and cost control.

• Demonstrated experience in managing complex cost structures, including direct and indirect manufacturing costs.

• Proven expertise in warranty cost management, freight cost analysis, and inventory management.

• Skills:

• Strong knowledge of cost accounting principles, financial reporting standards, and inventory management systems.

• Proficiency in ERP systems (IFS preferred), Microsoft Excel, and financial modeling.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to drive insights from financial data.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

• Strong organizational skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Personal Attributes:

• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and process optimization.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to think strategically about cost management and operational efficiency.

## Why Join Mattr?

• Medical, dental & vision coverage with HSA contributions

• 401(k) with company match, vested immediately

• Attractive incentive bonus plans

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Long-Term Disability insurance

• Wellness incentives

• Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Discounts on fitness, shopping & travel (Blue365, LifeMart & more)

## Logistics Coordinator

## Department: Supply Chain / Operations

Reports To: Planning & Logistics Manager

Location: Ottawa (on-site)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Description

March Networks is an established global leader in the video surveillance industry and works with the world’s largest retailers and banking institutions. Our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

## Position Summary

Working with our third Party Order Fulfillment partners, the Logistics Coordinator handles the daily movement of goods in both directions. Outbound, that means finished products, components and demo equipment. Inbound and repair, which means customer returns, RMAs and repair orders. Where required, the role does the shipping, receiving, customs and carrier work to get shipments delivered on time, compliantly and at a reasonable cost, and works closely with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, 3PLs and subcontracted repair centers.

## Key Responsibilities

## Transportation & Shipping

• Book domestic and international shipments by air, ocean, ground and courier. Pick the mode and carrier based on cost, transit time and service level.

• Act as the day-to-day contact for carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, 3PLs and repair service providers. Provide them with shipment instructions and direction.

• Track shipments and handle exceptions such as customs holds, delays, damaged goods and carrier issues. Update internal teams and customers on status.

• Give Sales, Customer Service and Professional Services shipment visibility and delivery estimates, and support field requirements.

## Customs & Trade Compliance

• Prepare and manage customs paperwork, including commercial invoices, certificates of origin, HS/tariff classifications, and import/export licenses.

• Run denied party screening and applied export control classifications (ECCN, and ITAR where it applies) and country-specific import restrictions.

• Coordinate customs clearance for international returns and repair shipments, both outbound to repair centers and back to customers.

• Manage our duty accounts around the world to ensure where possible duty exposure is minimized and duty recovery is managed.

• Familiarity with CBP, ACE Portal and CARM Portal

## Reverse Logistics & Repair Orders

• Process customer RMAs and internal and external repair orders, and make sure they are complete, documented and shipped on time.

• Coordinate shipments to and from subcontracted repair centers, following OEM repair instructions and processes.

## Inventory & Records

• Check inventory levels and make stock transfers between warehouses and distribution hubs as needed.

• Keep shipment, repair and inventory transaction records accurate in the ERP/TMS.

• Transact inventory receipt and shipments from suppliers and to customers into and out of the March Networks ERP system (SAP)

## Qualifications

• A diploma or degree in Supply Chain, Materials Management, International Trade or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years in logistics, shipping/receiving, customs or reverse logistics, ideally in a technology, electronics or manufacturing company.

• 2+ years of inventory control experience.

• Working knowledge of Incoterms, customs procedures and export control requirements.

• Experience with freight forwarders, customs brokers and carriers across North America, EMEA and/or APAC.

• Comfortable with ERP and transportation systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or similar, ACE Portal and CARM Portal) and with Excel.

• Strong customer service focus, organization and follow-through. Able to juggle many shipments against tight deadlines.

• Clear written and verbal communication with internal and external contacts, across time zones.

Preferred certifications (asset, not required): CCS, CITP or an equivalent customs or trade certification.

## Work Environment

• Mainly office-based, with regular time in the shipping and receiving area. The role involves using cargo knives, tape dispensers, pallet trucks and hand carts, and some physical effort.

• Requires focused attention and occasionally extra hours to meet shipping deadlines. There will be some early or late calls with overseas partners and carriers.

Why Work at March Networks?

· Global Exposure

· Medical/Dental benefits offered immediately from Day 1

· Health club reimbursement

· Professional development support

· Company holiday closure

March Networks is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Applicants can make their accommodation needs known to us in their application.

Please note March Networks uses AI as part of the recruitment process.

Hiring salary range for this position is between $75,000 - $85,000. This is an existing vacancy with one opening.

## Ottawa, Canada - Hybrid

We are seeking an entry level Engineer (Physical AI) to join the Pathfinding Studio within the Engineering Innovation Office. In this role, you will research and develop next generation physical AI dataflow algorithms, architectures, and virtual system models for humanoid robotics contributing to pathfinding research. You will work across perception, planning, control, and learning to enable intelligent humanoid behaviors, with particular emphasis on hand and arm manipulation.

Responsibilities:

• Research, design, develop, and maintain end-to-end physical AI dataflows for humanoid robotics, connecting simulation, data generation, model training, evaluation, and deployment.

• Develop, deploy and evaluate algorithms and models for humanoid perception, motion planning, manipulation, and learning.

• Build humanoid simulations using MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or comparable tools, including models of articulated hands, arms, sensors, and environments.

• Create and curate simulation and real-world datasets; define interfaces, schemas, synchronization methods, and quality checks for multimodal robotics data.

• Develop domain-randomization, synthetic-data, imitation-learning, reinforcement-learning, sim-to-real and real-to-sim workflows.

• Analyze model and controller behavior, establish performance metrics, identify failure modes, and document results.

• Collaborate with software, AI, robotics, and hardware teams to translate research concepts into reproducible prototypes and deployable solutions.

• Bachelor’s degree with relevant experience, or an advanced degree, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Strong experience in algorithm design and mathematical modeling for humanoid robots or other highly articulated robotic systems.

• Hands-on experience with MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or similar physics-based robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience modeling and controlling humanoid hands and arms, including kinematics, dynamics, grasping, manipulation, trajectory generation, and contact rich interaction.

• Experience with data collection/teleop based sim2real and real2sim pipeline and framework.

• Manage the development of a secure cloud application for exchanging device and product-security information with customers.

• Knowledge of gRPC, gNMI, gNOI, gNSI, TLS, authorization, authentication, and policy enforcement.

• Experience with secure provisioning, ZTP, SZTP, device enrollment, or manufacturing-time device personalization.

• Familiarity with Linux, embedded systems, networking protocols, and cloud-based security services.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

## Position Overview:

As our HPDU Safety Manager, you will report to the Sr. Manager of Safety and will be responsible for overseeing and implementing radiological and industrial safety programs and policies to ensure a safe work environment at the NOG-J site for HPDU pre-production and production activities. This role involves assessing workplace hazards, conducting safety training, and monitoring compliance with federal, state, and company regulations. The role will integrate within an existing safety program to work closely with facility staff, management, and external agencies to promote a culture of safety and health.

## Location:

Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a HPDU Safety Manager at BWXT NOGJ:

## Safety Program Development:

• Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive safety programs and policies in accordance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices

• Regularly review and update safety protocols to ensure relevance and compliance

## Risk Assessment and Compliance:

• Conduct regular safety audits and inspections to identify potential hazards and ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies

• Analyze incident reports and develop strategies to prevent reoccurrence

## Training and Education:

• Design and deliver safety training programs for employees, contractors, and visitors to promote awareness of safety practices and protocols

• Maintain documentation of training programs and employee participation

## Incident Investigation:

• Lead investigations of workplace safety incidents and near misses, documenting findings and developing corrective action plans

• Communicate findings to management and relevant stakeholders, ensuring that follow-up actions are implemented

## Emergency Preparedness:

• Participate in the development and implementation of emergency response plans, ensuring that all facility personnel are familiar with protocols

• Conduct regular drills and training sessions to prepare staff for emergency situations

## Data Management and Reporting:

• Maintain accurate records of safety inspections, incident reports, and training activities

• Prepare and present safety reports and metrics to management, identifying trends and recommending improvements

## Compliance with Regulations:

• Stay informed about changes in safety regulations and industry standards, ensuring that the facility remains compliant

• Liaise with regulatory agencies during inspections and audits

## Collaboration and Communication:

• Collaborate with other departments to integrate safety practices into daily operations

• Foster a culture of safety by promoting open communication about safety concerns and encouraging employee engagement in safety initiatives

• Requires 8+ years of experience in safety management, preferably in a chemical processing facility

• Requires extensive knowledge of safety regulations, policies, and best practices (e.g., OSHA, EPA)

• Requires experience with Process Safety Management (PSM) and Risk Management Programs (RMP) (related to OSHA and EPA requirements)

• Requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risks and implement effective solutions

• Requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence employees at all levels

• Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Occupational Health and Safety Technician (OHST) are preferred

• Must be able to work effectively in a team environment and effectively interface with all levels of personnel internal and external to the Company

• Requires proficiency in safety management software and Microsoft Office Suite

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

• Requires US Citizenship with no dual citizenship

## Position Overview:

BWXT Enrichment Operations is seeking a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) to support the Centrifuge Manufacturing Development Facility (CMDF). This position is responsible for developing and maintaining a qualified supplier network capable of supporting prototype development, manufacturing readiness, and future production operations.

The Supplier Quality Engineer will serve as the primary quality interface between BWXT EO and external suppliers, ensuring purchased materials, components, and services meet technical, quality, schedule, and readiness requirements. The role focuses on supplier qualification, supplier audits, supplier development, source inspection planning, and supplier readiness activities that support the transition of centrifuge technology from development to commercial manufacturing.

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality organizations to identify supplier risks, improve supplier performance, and establish a robust supply chain capable of supporting future manufacturing scale-up.

## Key Responsibilities

• Leads supplier qualification and approval activities.

• Evaluates supplier quality systems, technical capabilities, manufacturing processes, and capacity.

• Conducts supplier risk assessments and determine appropriate supplier classifications.

• Supports maintenance of the Approved Supplier List (ASL).

• Reviews supplier quality documentation and certifications.

• Plans and conducts supplier quality audits and assessments.

• Evaluates supplier compliance with quality requirements and contractual obligations.

• Documents audit findings and verify corrective action implementation.

• Supports risk-based supplier surveillance activities.

• Assesses supplier readiness for prototype and production support.

• Partners with suppliers to improve quality, delivery, and process capability.

• Facilitates supplier corrective actions and root cause investigations.

• Assists suppliers in implementing process controls and quality improvements.

• Supports development of strategic supplier relationships.

• Identifies and mitigates supplier performance risks.

• Develops source inspection strategies for critical suppliers and components.

• Coordinates source inspections and supplier witness points.

• Verifies compliance with technical and quality requirements prior to shipment.

• Supports First Article Inspection (FAI) activities performed at supplier locations.

• Assesses supplier readiness for new product introductions and manufacturing scale-up.

• Evaluates supplier capacity, staffing, equipment, and process maturity.

• Supports Manufacturing Readiness Reviews (MRR) and Technology Transfer Reviews (TTR).

• Identifies supply chain risks affecting program milestones and production readiness.

• Develops and maintains supplier scorecards.

• Monitors supplier quality, delivery, responsiveness, and performance trends.

• Analyzes supplier performance data and identify improvement opportunities.

• Escalates significant supplier risks and performance concerns.

• Collaborates with Engineering on supplier technical evaluations.

• Supports Manufacturing with supplier-related quality issues.

• Partners with Supply Chain on sourcing decisions and supplier selection.

• Supports Configuration Management and Engineering Change activities impacting suppliers.

## Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or related technical discipline (or 8 years experience in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree).

• Minimum five (5) years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Quality Engineering, or Supply Chain Quality.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a D.O.E. security clearance.

• Experience working within an ISO 9001 Quality Management System.

• Experience conducting supplier audits and supplier evaluations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview

BWXT Enrichment Operations (EO) is establishing a world‑class Program Management Office to enable the successful industrialization, deployment, and operation of the nation’s next‑generation enrichment enterprise. The Director of the PMO will serve as the senior executive responsible for enterprise‑level program governance, program controls, integrated master scheduling, risk management, cost/schedule baselining, cross‑functional alignment, and customer reporting across all enrichment programs.

This leader will create and mature EO’s PMO into a high‑performance organization aligned with federal standards such as NNSA’s Enhanced Management B framework, GAO program‑management guidelines, DOE/NRC oversight expectations, and BWXT governance principles.

The Director will ensure EO can accelerate LEU, HALEU, and HEU production by 10 years through disciplined execution, cross‑organizational coordination, robust risk governance, and predictable delivery across a multi‑billion‑dollar enterprise spanning design, manufacturing, nuclear licensing, construction, and operations.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, TN

## Your Day to Day as the Director, Program Management:

## Program Governance & Controls

• Establish and lead the enterprise Program Management Office (EO PMO) covering CMDF, CMF, PEO, OREO, EEO.

• Implement program‑management frameworks, including Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), baseline management, change control, and reporting systems.

• Develop and enforce governance for project initiation, execution, monitoring, and closeout to ensure consistent and compliant delivery.

## Integrated Master Scheduling & Enterprise Planning

• Build and maintain the official EO Integrated Master Schedule linking technology maturation, manufacturing scale-up, licensing, construction, and enrichment operations.

• Coordinate schedule integration across engineering, operations, safety basis, licensing, supply chain, construction, and quality.

• Lead schedule risk analysis, critical path modeling, resource planning, and recovery strategies.

## Cost & Performance Management

• Own enterprise cost baselines, forecasting methodology, and earned-value management (EVMS) reporting.

• Oversee variance analysis, corrective-action plans, performance metrics, and leadership reporting for BWXT and federal customers.

• Lead Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs), EO executive Monthly Progress Reviews (MPR), and customer reporting cycles.

## Risk & Opportunity Management

• Develop EO’s enterprise risk framework including risk registers, burn‑down tracking, mitigation planning, and root‑cause analysis.

• Oversee quantification of technical, schedule, cost, regulatory, and supply chain risks.

• Drive cross-functional risk ownership and monthly risk summits across EO.

## Cross Functional Technical Integration

• Coordinate deeply with engineering, operations, nuclear safety, security, quality, and supply chain to ensure alignment of program execution.

• Maintain configuration control of technical baselines across design, manufacturing, and facility deployments.

## Regulatory & Customer Alignment

• Support licensing schedules, readiness assessments, NRC interactions, DOE/NNSA data calls, audits, and performance reviews.

• Ensure PMO documentation meets DOE, NRC, QA, and BWXT governance requirements.

## Leadership, Culture, and Organizational Development

• Build EO’s PMO team, including Program Controllers, Master Schedulers, Risk Managers, and Project Managers.

• Mentor PM1–PM5 personnel and develop professional pathways for PMO staff.

• Establish a culture of transparency, disciplined execution, and mission-first alignment.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, project management, or related field.

• Minimum 12+ years leading large-scale PMO, program management, or project controls organizations.

• Demonstrated success managing federal programs >$250M+ (preferred >$1B).

• Proven experience implementing integrated master schedules and enterprise program controls.

• Experience with DOE or NNSA programs, NRC licensing environments, nuclear manufacturing, defense programs, or highly regulated industries.

• EVMS mastery (DOE-compliant) and expert proficiency with Primavera P6/MS Project.

• Ability to communicate at executive and federal leadership levels.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance level Q (active clearance strongly preferred).

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree (MS/MBA).

• PMP or PMI‑SP certification.

• Experience delivering programs involving nuclear facilities, NEPA, NQA‑1, DOE Orders, and NRC regulatory processes.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Position Summary

Reporting to the Plant Manager, the Quality Control Technician plays a critical role in protecting product integrity and customer satisfaction by ensuring all incoming materials, in-process work, and finished products meet defined quality standards. This role is responsible for executing inspections, maintaining accurate quality documentation, supporting audits, and driving corrective actions while mentoring production teams on proper inspection methods and quality governance throughout the manufacturing process.

• Communicate quality issues using standard reporting protocols and participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Non-Conformance Reporting (NCR) processes

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and Lean Enterprise (SMS) programs

• Serve as a primary point of contact for quality-related support across manufacturing

• Maintain housekeeping, 5S standards, and a safe, clean work environment

• Actively support workplace safety programs, hazard assessments, and standard operating procedures

## Qualifications

• High School diploma required

• Minimum 1 year of related quality or manufacturing experience

• Experience using calibration equipment and precision measuring devices

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and basic computer applications

• Strong attention to detail for visual inspections, data entry, and documentation accuracy

• Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment with exposure to dust, noise, chemicals, and varying temperatures

## About this opportunity

Help build the next generation of cyber resilience at the Bank. Join the Bank’s Cyber Security team to work on high-priority technical initiatives that strengthen how we detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in a rapidly evolving environment.

Join the Cyber Security Assurance team within the Information and Technology Services (ITS) department, where you will play a key role in strengthening the Bank’s cyber resilience by advancing how third-party risks are assessed and managed. You will contribute to the evolution of assessment methodologies that address increasingly complex supplier, cloud, AI and emerging technology risks.

## What you will do

Working closely with cross-functional partners, including procurement, business owners, legal, privacy, cyber security and technology teams, you will support secure supplier onboarding, ongoing monitoring, and the management of supply-chain risk. Your work will directly influence how the Bank identifies, assesses, and mitigates cyber risks across its third-party ecosystem.

More specifically, you will:

• Modernize vendor assessment and develop risk hypotheses methodologies to better address evolving risks from emerging technologies, including AI, software supply chains, and fourth-party ecosystems.

• Define assessment requirements and assurance techniques for supplier security controls.

• Analyze trends in supplier assessment findings to identify systemic risks and recommend control improvement.

• Research and evaluate new assurance methods, control evidence models, and industry practices.

• Provide guidance for assessing cloud, SaaS, AI, managed service, and critical supplier relationships

• Analyze security attestations, certifications, control evidence, and technical documentation to evaluate supplier security posture.

• Support cyber incident investigations involving suppliers by delivering risk analysis assessment expertise.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of third-party risk management processes, tools, and assessment capabilities.

## What you need to succeed

Demonstrated excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders and handle escalations. Brings a process-driven, proactive approach as a self-starter and innovative problem solver, while contributing positively with collaborative team environment. Remains current on emerging cyber security technologies (e.g., Quantum, GenAI) and the evolving threat landscape to support informed and adaptive decision-making.

More specifically, from a technical perspective: Understanding of third-party and security risk frameworks, such as NIST

• Experience reviewing or interpreting security attestations and certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, CSA STAR, PCI-DSS).

• Knowledge of Canadian data residency and data sovereignty requirements.

• Working knowledge of common threat models and security risks (MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Top 10).

• Ability to analyze complex information, define problems, and provide clear, logical recommendations.

## Nice-to-have

• Experience as a third-party assessor, internal/external auditor, or consultant supporting public sector organizations or Crown corporations.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, Security+, CCSA, CISA, GCCC, or GCED.

## Education and experience

This position requires a university degree or college diploma in computer science, systems engineering, cybersecurity, or a related discipline, and a minimum of 6 years of recent and relevant experience.

Experience should demonstrate your ability to assess technical and non-technical risks, interpret security controls, work with cross-functional stakeholders, and provide clear guidance on complex security issues.

An equivalent combination of education and professional experience may also be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

## Language requirement

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• There will be no relocation assistance provided

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “Senior IT Security Assessment Specialist”

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $111,051 to $130,649 (job grade 17)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health and dental coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service
