## Postion requires in office/field

Rogers Business is seeking experienced Point of Sale Growth Specialists to accelerate adoption of Rogers Point of Sale solutions across Canada. This role balances three core areas: converting assigned inbound and marketing-generated leads, creating opportunities through proactive field activity, and supporting direct sellers as a trusted payments expert on qualified customer opportunities.

Specialists will manage their own opportunities from discovery through activation, maintain a consistent in-market presence with merchants and local business networks, and collaborate with direct sellers on deals that benefit from deeper payments expertise. On assisted opportunities, the direct seller remains the customer relationship owner while the specialist provides payment discovery, solution guidance and support throughout the sales cycle.

## What You'll Do

## Convert Inbound Demand

• Engage assigned digital and marketing-generated opportunities quickly and professionally.

• Conduct discovery to understand the merchant business, current payment environment, operational needs and growth goals.

• Recommend an appropriate Rogers Point of Sale solution and move qualified opportunities through the sales cycle to activation.

• Maintain complete, accurate and timely opportunity records and next steps.

## Partner with SMB Sellers

• Support direct sellers with discovery, qualification, customer presentations, demonstrations, statement reviews and objection handling while maintaining clearly documented ownership, handoffs and next steps.

• Join qualified customer conversations as the payments expert while reinforcing the direct seller as the relationship owner.

• Help sellers identify RPoS opportunities within new and existing customer conversations.

• Provide clear deal guidance, next steps and ownership at each stage of an assisted opportunity.

## Deliver Payments Expertise

• Explain payment processing, merchant acquiring, pricing considerations and POS capabilities in clear business language.

• Assess competitive scenarios and help customers evaluate the operational and commercial value of changing providers.

• Set accurate expectations regarding application, compliance, credit review, order submission, installation and activation.

## PhD Researcher (2026-2027 PhD Job Market)

## Take a central role

We are seeking well-trained PhD economists committed to rigorous research and passionate about central banking. The Bank of Canada has a vision to be “a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada.” No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very centre of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. Successful candidates are the individuals who are enthusiastic to learn about central banking, are keen to influence policy and curious in expanding their expertise in many areas of central banking. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in an environment where we are reinventing central banking, renewing ways of doing business and reinforcing a culture of innovation.

Find out more about the Bank’s current research priorities, explore the broad range of staff research that our people have the intellectual freedom to pursue, and learn about the ways in which the Bank supports and collaborates with the external research community.

## Important Information About this Position

The position title used in this posting may differ from the official internal title of the position.

Successful candidates will be appointed to either the Senior Economist or Senior Financial Sector Specialist Analyst position, as appropriate.

Application Process
Your application must include the following:

• cover letter

• curriculum vitae

• research paper(s) or job market paper

• three letters of recommendation

Requests for additional information and the letters of recommendation should be submitted through Econjobmarket.

To apply, click on the link above or visit www.bankofcanada.ca/careers.

## Your future responsibilities

You will be expected to produce rigorous research and policy work to help the Bank’s senior management make better policy decisions for all Canadians. Your research will inform and help shape the Bank’s research agenda and support your department in providing sound policy advice. Subject to the needs and interests of the Bank and the employee, senior economists or senior analysts may move to other Bank departments to pursue research of relevance in new or needed areas.

More specifically, you will be expected to:

• Develop leading-edge research ideas, produce and disseminate high-quality research papers on Bank priorities.

• Contribute to the core policy responsibilities of your department through model development initiatives, timely policy analysis and briefings to senior management.

• Collaborate with researchers and policy staff within the Bank, and colleagues from other organizations on multi-disciplinary projects.

• Build relationships with external parties-- e.g., government and international agencies, other central banks, financial market participants and organizations, and academia-- to share and receive feedback on research and analysis.

Your education
A recent (completed after January 2021) or forthcoming (completed in 2027) PhD in economics.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Your knowledge and skills
We will evaluate your application against the key requirements listed below and your education, which must be demonstrated in your cover letter, curriculum vitae, three letters of recommendation, and research paper(s) or job market paper.

If you are selected for an interview, you may be evaluated through two interviews, a written assessment and a presentation of your job market paper.

## Key requirements

• Research skills: the ability to undertake in-depth and high-quality research projects that are publishable in peer-reviewed academic journals.

• Alignment of fields of expertise with Bank priorities.

• Writing skills: the ability to produce effective written documents in a style and form likely to appeal to and influence the intended audience.

• Oral communication and presentation skills: the ability to make effective, well-structured presentations adapted to the intended audience, inside or outside the Bank, and the ability to communicate effectively with others by demonstrating active listening skills and conveying information clearly.

• Teamwork and collaboration: the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

• Innovation: the ability to create new insights, devise novel approaches and make innovative decisions through research.

• Analytical and technical skills: strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze complex economic and financial information using empirical and/or modelling skills.

• No minimum post-PhD employment experience required; relevant doctoral research experience will be considered.

Language requirement: English or French essential

In exceptional circumstances, an equivalent combination of a PhD and research experience in an area of current particular relevance or interest to the Bank not listed above may be considered.

## Research support, collaboration and development

The Bank of Canada is committed to employee growth and career development and supports employees in reaching their full potential within their roles.

• As part of the career path in this position, it is possible to progress to a role with an expanded scope at a higher job grade, and a corresponding salary increase, if specific criteria are met.

• Travel for external presentations of ongoing research is centrally funded and managed by a committee comprised of Senior Researchers. Additional funding may be available for working with co-authors, invited discussions, or attending high-profile conferences.

• Support provided by Research Assistants who help gather data, conduct statistical analysis, and prepare materials for presentations and a talented team of administrative, computer, data-scientist, editorial, design, and library professionals.

• Access to numerous data sources, including confidential and administrative data and powerful computing capabilities, including the cluster.

• A variety of vehicles for external distribution of research and analytical work. These include, personal web pages, Staff Working Paper series, Staff Discussion Paper series, Staff Analytical Notes series, and Technical Reports.

• Many opportunities to interact and exchange ideas, provide feedback on ongoing research, and collaborate on research projects with economists from top economic departments and major institutions, with potential referees, and journal editors by offering:

• a steady stream of research conferences, workshops, and visiting speaker seminars throughout the year including the Fellowship Program and the Visiting Scholar Program.

• the opportunity to work along side several Special Advisors whose role is to enhance the research efforts and policy advice by providing guidance on joint research projects (i.e. commenting on papers and policy documents).

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career.

Salary
The Bank offers a competitive total compensation package that is reviewed annually. The starting base salaries are based on qualifications and range annually between CAD $114,952.50 and CAD $156,778.00.

The salaries currently indicated are based on the 2026 salary scales. The Bank’s salary structure is reviewed regularly to ensure that the total compensation (salary and benefits) offered to employees continues to be competitive. In 2027 the salaries indicated above could be adjusted in accordance with the Bank’s annual salary review process and this poster will be updated to reflect any changes.

Hiring bonus
You may be eligible for a hiring bonus payable as a lump sum payment at time of hire and up to two annual additional payments to a total maximum of up to 30% of your base salary.

Performance pay
The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (up to 10%) for those who exceed expectations.

## Additional Benefits

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental, disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs.

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement.

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension plan.

• The Bank offers flexible work arrangements, including teleworking, flexible work hours and work from away.

For more information on key benefits, please visit www.bankofcanada.ca/careers/working-here.

## Additional information

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents.

• Must be eligible for reliability status or secret clearance.

• Work schedule: Full-time (37.5 hours per week).

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required.

• Contact information:

• hrmobility@bank-banque-canada.ca

• North America: 1-800-303-1282

• Outside North America: 613-782-8111

• 234 Wellington Street West, Ottawa, ON K1A 0G9

• Number of available positions: Up to 8.

• Work address: 234 Wellington Street West, Ottawa, ON K1A 0G9.

• Position Type: Permanent/Full time.

Hybrid Work
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a substantial part of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of twelve days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

## Summary

The Production Operator plays a critical role in supporting manufacturing operations by operating, monitoring, and adjusting production equipment to meet customer specifications and production targets. Supporting multiple functional areas—including spooling, extrusion/expansion, and cutting—this role ensures product quality, safety, and efficiency. By adhering to SOPs, maintaining equipment performance, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives, the Production Operator helps deliver consistent, high-quality output in a dynamic production environment.

• Extrusion Operator -responsible for operating and optimizing extrusion/expansion equipment to ensure consistent production of high-quality products that meet customer specifications. This role is critical in maintaining production efficiency, equipment performance, and product integrity within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• Cutting Line Operator - ensures accurate cutting and finishing of materials to meet customer specifications and production requirements. This role plays a key part in final product quality by maintaining precision, efficiency, and adherence to safety standards throughout the cutting process.

• Brady Spooling Operator - responsible for managing spooling operations to ensure materials are properly loaded, processed, and packaged according to customer and production requirements. This role is essential in maintaining workflow efficiency, product quality, and safe handling of materials.

## Responsibilities

• Set up and operate production equipment across spooling, extrusion/expansion, and cutting processes.

• Monitor machine operation and make adjustments as required to ensure quality and efficiency.

• Position, adjust, and manually feed materials to complete work orders.

• Read and interpret work orders to determine product specifications and material requirements.

• Load spools of material and assemble spools and packaging as required.

• Inspect completed workpieces for defects and sort materials based on quality standards.

• Ensure all work is completed within specified control limits and customer requirements.

• Forecast production needs to support scheduling demands and daily orders.

• Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and work instructions.

• Operate equipment safely and effectively at all times.

• Participate in and support Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) initiatives to promote an Incident and Injury Free (IIF) workplace.

• Follow “Leader Standard Work” expectations and contribute to a safe work environment.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the production team.

• Communicate equipment issues to supervisors and collaborate with maintenance to resolve problems.

• Provide training and mentorship to new and junior employees, ensuring adherence to SOPs and safety standards.

• Flex across different production roles and support team needs based on production demands.

• Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

## Qualifications

• High School Diploma or equivalent required.

• Prior manufacturing experience preferred; extrusion, blow molding, or injection molding experience is an asset.

• Ability to read gauges, perform measurements, and calculate differences to specifications.

• Basic computer skills with ability to input production data into tracking systems.

• Strong attention to detail with a focus on quality and safety.

• Effective communication and active listening skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

• High level of manual dexterity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

• Ability to read and interpret safety rules, operating instructions, and procedure manuals.

• Visual ability to inspect and evaluate materials for quality.

## Working Conditions

• Frequent exposure to moving mechanical parts and industrial equipment.

• Moderate noise levels with occasional higher levels for short durations.

• Prolonged standing and repetitive use of hands, wrists, and fingers.

• Frequent lifting of materials up to 50 lbs.

• Occasional sitting, climbing, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

## ## Job Title: Senior Manager, Supply Chain Governance

Mattr Corp. is a global, $1 Billion+ company serving critical infrastructure, energy and transportation markets through two reporting segments: Composite Technologies and Connection Technologies. The Company operates through a global network of manufacturing facilities and is valued for its innovation, technology, and proven operational excellence.

Succeeding in current global markets and pursuing a growth vision is made possible by its people. In addition to acumen, dedication, and professionalism, Mattr looks for individuals who embody its values including innovation, drive, and passion, with a foundation of accountability, respect and doing the right thing.

Mattr, previously known as Shawcor, has traded as a public company for over 40 years. Backed by a strong financial foundation, the company has a growth mandate. This mandate will be met through both organic and inorganic growth in the coming years.

This role is central to strengthening the responsiveness, resilience, risk management capabilities and integrity of Mattr’s global supply chain. Success will depend on translating enterprise risk objectives into practical governance processes that support informed, compliant, and consistent decision-making across business units.

## ## Position Summary

Based in Calgary, Alberta, Toronto, Ontario, Dallas, Texas or Houston, Texas in a hybrid work arrangement, the Senior Manager, Supply Chain Governance will lead the establishment of an enterprise-level supply chain governance framework focused on the oversight of raw material sourcing, supplier lifecycle management, supply chain and product compliance, and geopolitical risk integration.

This role will help develop and implement consistent practices and policies across the supply chain functions for the various business units of Mattr with the goal of enhancing visibility, consistency, scalability and disciplined risk management across Mattr’s global supply chain.

## ## Core responsibilities include advancing the following enterprise objectives:

• Establish an enterprise-level sourcing governance framework

• Define standardized sourcing requirements to manage risk across all business units

• Identify, maintain, and communicate geopolitical supply chain risks through an enterprise risk registry, ensuring timely escalation and visibility to Business Unit Supply Chain leaders to support informed sourcing and operational decisions.

• Develop corporate-level policies, processes, and controls that support consistent, scalable execution and coordinate cross-functional roll-out of same

• Support the development and execution of the global supply chain strategy and annual strategic priorities

• Monitor regulatory developments affecting supply chains and product compliance and coordinate practical responses

• Lead compliance with global supply chain transparency regulations and reporting requirements

• Share supply chain best practices

• Provide practical support to operations facing ongoing supply chain challenges.

The role will partner closely with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Operational leadership to operationalize governance standards within supplier lifecycle activities and related business processes.

## ## Reports To

SVP Legal, General Counsel & Secretary

## ## Key Relationships

The Senior Manager, Supply Chain Governance will exercise their mandate through key internal and external relationships, including:

• Business Unit Supply Chain and Procurement Leadership

• Chief Financial Officer

• Group Presidents Connection Technologies and Composite Technologies

• Chief Compliance Officer

• Operations, Engineering and Quality leaders across Business Units

• Director, Financial Compliance

## ## Duties

Enterprise Supply Chain Governance

• Design and implement an enterprise sourcing governance framework that balances effective oversight with streamlined, practical and user-friendly processes

• Establish cross-business unit coordination to improve visibility, consistency, and accountability in sourcing practices

• Develop governance structures, decision rights, and escalation protocols for sourcing risk issues

• Develop, maintain, and support adoption of corporate-level supply chain policies and process standards, that support consistent execution

• Identify and leverage appropriate technology, automation and artificial intelligence tools to support efficient compliance monitoring, and reduce administrative burden

Sourcing Standards & Risk Management

• Define enterprise-wide minimum sourcing standards, including supplier qualification, onboarding, and lifecycle management requirements

• Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and controls for supplier due diligence and ongoing monitoring

• Support audit and review programs to validate supplier compliance with enterprise standards

• Coordinate tracking and escalation of remediation efforts for identified supplier risks or non-compliance and provide execution support to business-unit supply chain and operations leaders.

• Monitor regulatory developments affecting supply chains and product compliance, assess applicability, assign ownership, and coordinate timely responses

• Define sourcing risk requirements for incorporation into procurement processes and ERP systems in partnership with business-unit process owners and system owners

Geopolitical Risk Framework

• Establish and operationalize a standardized geopolitical risk monitoring framework

• Embed geopolitical risk considerations into:

• Supplier selection and onboarding

• Contracting and sourcing decisions

• Ongoing supplier performance and risk monitoring

• Partner with Legal and Compliance to align geopolitical risk management with sanctions, export controls, and regulatory obligations

Cross-Functional Integration

• Partner with various functional support groups to align governance requirements with operational workflows, digital tools, and supplier platforms

• Partner with business unit Procurement to strengthen strategic supplier collaboration and long-term value creation

• Support integration of governance requirements into commercial agreements and supplier contracts

Executive Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to senior leadership based on operational and financial performance

• Develop and deliver enterprise-level reporting on supply chain risk, compliance, and governance performance

• Provide visibility to senior leadership on key risk exposures, trends, and mitigation strategies

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain transparency, consistency, and resilience

Operational Support

• Provide guidance and support to Business Unit Supply Chain and Operations leaders on procurement best practices, strategic sourcing approaches, supplier management, and continuous improvement opportunities.

• Serve as a mentor and trusted advisor to supply chain teams across the organization, fostering capability development, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of consistent supply chain processes and standards.

## ## Key Deliverables

• Enterprise supplier risk framework

• Supply chain governance policies and standards

• Geopolitical risk monitoring process

• Regulatory compliance reporting framework

• Executive and Board-level supply chain risk reporting

## ## Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Law, Engineering or related field (advanced degree preferred)

• 8–12+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, compliance, or governance roles

• Experience implementing enterprise governance frameworks or risk management programs

• Strong understanding of global sourcing risks, including geopolitical, regulatory, and operational factors

• Experience working in complex, multi-business unit or multinational environments preferred

## ## Key Competencies

• Strong governance and risk management mindset

• Ability to collaborate, influence and align cross-functionally and cross-business unit stakeholders without direct functional ownership

• Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline

• Highly organized and process-driven

• Strong analytical and reporting skills as well as excellent verbal and written English language communication skills

## ## Additional Requirements

• Ability to operate in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities

• Occasional travel as required

## Senior Editor

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

Did you know?
As members of Translation and Editorial Services in the Communications Department, Senior Editors help the Bank of Canada achieve its policy and public communication objectives by ensuring that high-profile publications are clear, coherent, accessible and effective for their intended audiences.

The work of language professionals is evolving rapidly, especially in light of new technologies. The successful candidate will need to combine language expertise with solid skills in project management, relationship management, digital literacy and artificial intelligence. The successful candidate is innovative and has a continuous-improvement mindset.

What you will do
Reporting to the Director, Translation and Editorial Services, you will:

Editing

• edit a wide range of English texts for clarity, accuracy, consistency and impact, adapting the level and type of edit to the product, audience and communication risk

• provide substantive, structural, stylistic and copy editing, including significant rewriting when needed to strengthen logic, flow, voice, tone and accessibility, particularly for complex economic content

• work with authors to clarify objectives, refine key messages and narrative, anticipate how audiences will interpret the content, reduce the risk of misinterpretation and apply Bank style standards and editorial practices consistently

• contribute to developing, maintaining and applying Bank style standards, writing guidance and editorial practices to ensure they meet the organization’s evolving needs

Project management

• plan, coordinate and deliver complex, high-profile editorial projects by defining milestones, responsibilities and deadlines, monitoring progress and identifying issues early

• develop effective work strategies, adjust priorities as operational needs, deadlines or scope change, and keep projects moving by considering the timelines, constraints and communication needs of the teams involved

Relationship management and influence

• build trusted working relationships with internal clients, including with senior management, by understanding their objectives, audiences, constraints and expectations

• promote effective collaboration among stakeholders in complex projects by clarifying expectations, facilitating communication, helping to resolve differing points of view and communicating thoughtfully under tight timelines and high expectations

Digital literacy and artificial intelligence

• use technology, including artificial intelligence tools, critically, safely and responsibly by evaluating outputs, confidentiality risks and the value it adds to editorial work

• help integrate technological tools into the team’s work by participating in trials, making recommendations and sharing best practices

Continuous improvement and innovation

• recommend practical improvements to processes, tools, editorial practices and ways of working to increase efficiency, consistency and quality

• stay informed about trends in editing, plain language, communications and related technologies, and help turn new ideas into team practices, guidelines and internal standards

What you need to succeed
You have a strong understanding of economics and a genuine interest in the subject, enabling you to work confidently with complex economic content and engage meaningfully with authors and subject matter experts.

You bring demonstrated expertise in substantive, structural, stylistic and copy editing, proofreading and project management. You can apply plain-language principles, edit for the web and advise on structure, narrative, tone and audience needs. You are an adaptable, collaborative language advisor who can explain editorial recommendations clearly, build consensus, identify communication risks and opportunities for improvement, and deliver high-quality advice and content within prescribed time frames.

## Nice-to-have

• academic background in economics

• education or training in translation and experience translating from French to English

Your education and experience
This position requires a bachelor’s degree in English, journalism or a related field and 7 to 10 years of experience editing complex, high-profile communications and research publications. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $111,051 to $130,649 (job grade 17)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

## Analyst, Screening Clearances

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
The Security Screening and Access Programs team plays a critical role in protecting the Bank's employees, information, assets, and operations by ensuring that individuals entrusted with access to Bank facilities, information, systems, and assets meet established security requirements. The team delivers personnel security screening services that support informed decision-making while maintaining the highest standards of integrity, fairness, privacy, and security.

As a Security Screening Analyst, you will support the delivery and continuous improvement of the Bank's personnel security screening program. You will manage security screening cases, analyze information from multiple sources, provide advice to stakeholders, and support screening decisions through sound analysis, judgement, and professional recommendations.

In this role, you will:

• Manage and coordinate personnel security screening cases throughout the screening lifecycle while ensuring service standards, timelines, and quality requirements are met.

• Review, analyze, and assess information from multiple sources to support personnel security screening activities and recommendations.

• Conduct research, verification, and fact-finding activities to validate information and support security screening assessments.

• Identify issues, inconsistencies, or concerns requiring additional review, analysis, or follow-up.

• Document findings and prepare clear, concise assessments, recommendations, correspondence, and case summaries.

• Interpret and apply security screening policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines to support consistent and risk-informed decision-making.

• Provide advice, guidance, and responsive client service to hiring managers, applicants, Human Resources partners, and other stakeholders regarding security screening requirements, processes, and timelines.

• Collaborate with internal and external partners to support onboarding, offboarding, access management, and workforce security initiatives.

• Maintain accurate records and case files in accordance with privacy, information management, and security requirements.

• Monitor workload, service standards, and operational performance measures and contribute to reporting and quality assurance activities.

• Support process improvements, modernization initiatives, and technology-enabled solutions that enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and client experience of the Bank's personnel security program.

What you need to succeed
You are a highly organized and client-focused professional who exercises sound judgement and discretion when managing sensitive information. You are able to analyze information, identify key issues, and communicate recommendations clearly and effectively.

You demonstrate:

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

• Sound judgement and decision-making abilities.

• Excellent client service orientation.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.

• Effective oral and written communication skills.

• Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Initiative and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptability and flexibility in a fast-paced environment.

• The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

• A collaborative and team-oriented approach.

• Professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.

Nice-to-have
The following would be considered assets:

• Experience conducting interviews, fact-finding discussions, or investigative activities.

• Experience conducting open-source research and verification activities.

• Knowledge of Government of Canada personnel security standards and practices.

• Knowledge of privacy, information-management, and security principles.

• Experience supporting operational reporting, quality assurance, or continuous improvement initiatives.

Your education and experience
This position requires a university degree or college diploma in criminology, security management, intelligence studies, public administration, business administration, law, risk management, or another related discipline and a minimum of two years of relevant experience in personnel security screening, investigations, security administration, risk assessment, compliance, intelligence, human resources, law enforcement, access management, or a related field.

You must also have experience:

• Reviewing, analyzing, and synthesizing information from multiple sources.

• Preparing written assessments, reports, recommendations, briefing materials, or correspondence.

• Interpreting and applying policies, procedures, standards, directives, or regulatory requirements.

• Providing advice, guidance, or client service to internal or external stakeholders.

• Using Microsoft 365 applications and electronic information-management, workflow, or case-management systems.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $66,179 to $77,858 (job grade 13)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 3 to 5% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (2%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering, you will be an integral part of a strong and vibrant hardware team that performs design, development, and validation of sophisticated printed circuit boards for Ciena’s current and next-generation platforms.

• working with operations to coordinate PCB fabrication and circuit pack assembly.

• lead investigations and draw in expertise from other teams as needed to uncover the root cause and resolution for technical issues as they arise.

• support internal customers and prototype inventory during the development phase and external customers during the production lifetime.

• Bachelor’s, or Master’s, degree in Electrical Engineering, with 10+ years of hardware design experience

• Implementation history as a design lead of high layer count circuit packs and possess a familiarity of technology related to CPU’s, Networking devices, FPGA, timing devices, DDR, PCIe, FLASH memory.

• Expertise in analog and digital circuit design and testing.

• Strong analog circuit design fundamentals: amplifiers, filters, comparators, data converters, Electro-optics circuit (control loops)

• Experience in designing circuits for power conversion and sensitive low-noise circuitry

• Experience in design validation with a focus on lab measurement techniques and test equipment. Ability to parse component datasheets and extract design and verification criteria.

• Proven record of supporting and troubleshooting hardware issues both during development and within production environments.

• Proficiency with Schematic Capture and Layout tools, such as Cadence Concept and Allegro, or equivalent EDA software.

• Excellent communication, documentation, interpersonal and team-working skills

• Project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, collaborate and delegate as necessary to meet schedules and respect internal and external customer commitments.

• Experience with Fiber Optics and Photonic component including SFPs, Photodiodes, APDs and Lasers.

• Experience or interest in using simulation tools like TINA and LTSpice

• Industry experience using synthesis and/or static timing analysis tools within an ASIC development environment

• Knowledge of ASIC implementation flows, including synthesis, timing analysis, logical equivalence checking, and clock domain crossing validation

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/795.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, NSE, BSE, Airtel, HDFC, SBI , PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology and your hard work!

Overview

This position is for a Senior Principal Software Developer - AI Integration. In this role you will be the technical authority for the Solace Agent Mesh: an event-driven Integration and Orchestration Platform for Agentic AI that securely connects, orchestrates, governs and scales AI agents in real-time. You will set the technical direction for how Solace blends advanced AI technologies with our core products and internal tooling, and help shape product strategy alongside Engineering and Product leadership. You will stay deeply hands-on, turning ambiguous, high-stakes problems into working prototypes and shipped capabilities, while raising the technical bar across multiple teams, partnering directly with strategic customers, and representing Solace as a recognized voice in the Agentic AI community.

Are You Someone Who:

• Has a passion for AI and Agentic AI with expert, hands-on command of LLMs, open-weight and specialized models, multi-agent systems, and AI orchestration patterns?

• Can see around corners, tracking the fast-moving AI ecosystem and turning what you learn into a clear point of view on where the product should go?

• Is driven to get new ideas into customers' hands quickly, shipping experimental features early, learning from real usage and iterating fast?

• Thrives on solving the hardest integration, security and governance challenges in distributed AI systems?

• Has deep experience building event-driven architectures and real-time streaming platforms at enterprise scale?

• Leads through influence rather than authority, and makes the engineers around you better?

• Is as comfortable in a design session with a customer's security team as in a pull request? Values innovation, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences?

• Is humble, honest and open?

What You'll Do:

• Set Technical Direction: Own the long-term architectural vision for AI integration across the Solace Agent Mesh, making and documenting the high-impact decisions that span multiple teams and product lines

• Shape Product Strategy: Partner with the VP of Engineering, Product Management and executive leadership to define the roadmap, assess the competitive landscape, weigh build-vs-buy and packaging/pricing trade-offs, and identify where Solace should lead the market

• Architect for Enterprise Trust: Define the security, identity and governance model for agents, including agent identity and delegated authorization (e.g., OAuth/OBO, Entra Agent ID), RBAC, sandboxed tool execution, model access governance, and controls for third-party agents joining the mesh

• Prototype and Ship Fast: Rapidly build working end-to-end prototypes of new capabilities, from SDKs that bring third-party agents into the mesh, to new gateways, workflows and self-improving agent systems; get the strongest ideas out quickly as Early Access features, then carry them through to GA

• Advance AI Quality and Evaluation: Lead the strategy for agent evaluation (LLM-as-judge and decision-model judges), model compatibility across frontier and open-weight models, and deployment in sovereign and air-gapped environments

• Engage Strategic Customers: Serve as the technical consultant on key customer pilots and accounts, author solution proposals, and turn field learnings into platform improvements

• Raise the Bar Across Engineering: Mentor Principal and Senior engineers, review critical designs and code, establish engineering standards, and champion AI-native development practices (coding agents, skills, automated workflows) across the organization

• Be a Voice for Solace: Represent Solace externally through blogs, conference talks, open-source contributions and industry collaboration, and lead internal communities of practice on AI

• Stay Ahead: Continuously scan the AI landscape (new models, frameworks, protocols and competitors) and translate it into concrete opportunities and risks for Solace.

What You Bring:

• Deep AI/ML Expertise: 15+ years of software development experience with 5+ years building production AI/ML systems, including LLMs, multi-agent architectures, and model evaluation

• Programming Skills: Working knowledge of Python and Go or Java (SpringBoot), plus JavaScript/TypeScript (React); deep experience with AI agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., A2A, MCP)

• Cloud and Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code

• AI Operations: Experience running AI systems in production, including model selection and deployment (including self-hosted open-weight models), observability, evaluation and lifecycle management

• Organizational Impact: A track record of setting technical strategy across multiple teams and driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from idea to market without direct authority

• Customer and Executive Presence: Experience as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and senior leadership

• Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to engineers, executives and customers alike

Nice to Have:

• Experience architecting event-driven architectures, message brokers, API design, and microservices in distributed AI environments at

• Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0/OIDC, delegated and on-behalf-of authorization, enterprise identity providers, multi-tenancy and isolation Knowledge of real-time streaming technologies (Apache Kafka, Pulsar, or Solace PubSub+)

• Experience fine-tuning or deploying specialized and open-weight models, including quantization and inference performance trade-offs

• Experience with AI safety, governance, and ethical AI practices, including regulatory and data sovereignty requirements

• A public profile in the AI community: open-source leadership, research publications, patents or conference talks

• Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and middleware technologies

Why You'll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we're all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We're proud of our world-class customer lineup (we're not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We're social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

Role Status: EXISTING

Expected Salary Range: Expected salary range for this role is $150,000 plus. The final offer within this range will reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience.

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.

To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let's Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That's okay — we're more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we're here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Business Development Representative to join our expanding Sales team!

In this role (remote-first), you will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and qualifying target accounts, then converting qualified prospects into meetings for the Account Executive team. You will use phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement cadences to connect with prospective customers, explain the value of Case IQ, and build early-stage pipeline with organizations that align to our ideal customer profile.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You’ll Do

• Respond promptly to inbound leads—including demo requests, webinar attendees, event leads, and other marketing-generated inquiries—to create a strong first impression and maximize conversion opportunities.

• Lead thoughtful qualification conversations to understand each prospect’s business needs, challenges, priorities, and fit with the Case IQ suite of products.

• Identify high-potential opportunities, route qualified prospects to the appropriate Account Executive, and ensure a seamless, well-documented handoff.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date lead and activity records in Salesforce to support effective pipeline management and reporting.

• Partner closely with Marketing to share actionable feedback on lead quality, campaign effectiveness, prospect trends, and messaging.

• Execute consistent follow-up strategies to nurture early-stage leads and re-engage inactive prospects.

• Meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.

• Continuously strengthen knowledge of Case IQ’s products, target markets, customer needs, and competitive positioning to deliver relevant and compelling messaging.

What Success Looks Like

• 30 Days: Learn Case IQ's product positioning, ICP, target personas, sales process, outreach tools, and activity expectations while beginning to build prospect lists, complete onboarding activities, and shadow effective outreach.

• 60 Days: Execute outbound cadences with increasing independence, make consistent cold calls and follow-up touches, maintain clean Salesforce activity records, and begin booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

• 90 Days: Consistently manage daily and monthly KPIs, demonstrate strong call quality and concise communication, use feedback to improve outreach, and contribute to qualified pipeline generation.

• 6 Months: Own a repeatable outbound workflow, maintain reliable activity and meeting performance, understand priority segments and personas, and collaborate effectively with Account Executives and Marketing on targeted campaigns.

• 1 Year: Operate as a high-performing BDR who consistently contributes to pipeline, demonstrates resilience and competitiveness, shares useful market feedback, and helps strengthen the team's outbound playbook.

Who You Are

• 1+ year experience with prospecting, ideally in a SaaS, technology, or B2B sales environment.

• Comfortable making cold calls, writing concise emails, using LinkedIn, and following structured sales cadences.

• Experience handling inbound leads and converting “warm” leads from webinars & tradeshows

• Quota- and metrics-driven, with the motivation and discipline to work toward daily, monthly, and team targets.

• Resilient and able to stay motivated through rejection, low-response periods, and changing priorities.

• Coachability and willingness to learn from feedback, call reviews, performance data, and missed opportunities.

• Proactive, curious, and able to work independently while collaborating with Account Executives, Marketing, and Sales Operations.

• Strong written, verbal, and listening skills, and the ability to communicate clearly and concisely.

• Interest in learning Case IQ's market, including HR, Ethics & Compliance, investigations, and governance, risk, and compliance audiences.

• Competitive spirit, strong money motivation, and ambition to learn, improve, and exceed individual and team goals.

• Experience with Salesloft, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Qualified chatbot, RollWorks, or other ABM / intent data tools (asset)

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 Countries!).

## Position Overview:

As a Safety Analysis Engineer, you will be part of a team supporting the development of several leading technologies for various applications on earth and in space. The Safety Analysis group is responsible for developing methodologies and performing analyses to demonstrate that the various reactor designs satisfy their safety bases and licensing requirements. These types of analyses include deterministic safety evaluations of the reactor core, passive cooling, safety protection system, and radiological releases associated with anticipated operational occurrences (AOOs), design basis accidents (DBAs), and beyond design basis events (BDBEs) as well as probabilistic safety evaluations of the system responses and initiating event frequencies. The Safety Analysis group is responsible for the verification and validation activities associated with the computer codes used in these analyses.

## Location:

The position is located in Lynchburg, VA, with the possibility of remote work depending on the candidate’s specific skill set and experience.

## Your Day to Day as a Safety Analysis Engineer:

• Develop analytical methods and models for the spectrum of AOOs, DBAs, and BDBEs that are applicable to the reactor design being evaluated.

• Perform AOO, DBA, and BDBA simulations for the reactor design.

• Perform engineering calculations related to nuclear safety, fluid flow, probability risk assessment, severe accident analysis, equipment qualification, heat and mass transfer, and other duties.

• Prepare appropriate documentation supporting evaluations and analyses.

• Interface with customers, vendors, and other internal functional groups to obtain information necessary to perform work assignments.

• Identify and recommend improvements in processes on continuing basis and assist in implementation as well as identify and assist in the development of new business opportunities.

• Perform code benchmarking and validation analyses to support code qualification and methodology development.

• Perform pre- and post-test analyses to support Separate Effects and Integral Systems Tests, as needed.

• Develop methodology reports, design criteria, and other licensing documentation to support NRC or DOE review and approval.

• Provide input to planning, tracking, work estimates, and project updates as requested.

• Interact with and explain methods, models, analyses, and safety results to customers, regulators, and subject matter experts that may be advising a project as requested.

• Perform safety analysis tasks including hazard identification, safety basis event identification, and phenomena identification and ranking table development.

• Support development of safety analysis computational models in accordance with best practices and test data.

• Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and scaling analysis in support of evaluation model development as requested.

• Integrate with other engineering groups performing aspects of component, system, fuel, and control system design.

• Evaluate and assess experimental data and describe the applicability of experiments to design projects.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of seven (7) years of related experience is required.

• Must have strong nuclear-thermal-hydraulic analytical skills.

• Must have experience performing safety analysis using industry computer codes such as RELAP5-3D, GOTHIC, TRACE, MELCOR, etc.

• Must have experience in safety analysis.

• Must have demonstrated technical writing skills.

• Must possess effective communication skills.

• Must possess a strong understanding of thermal hydraulic behavior of nuclear power plants under steady state and transient conditions.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• M.S. or PhD in Nuclear or Mechanical Engineering.

• Experience with HTGRs is desired.

• Experience with SNAP computer code is desired.

• Experience with developing and applying numerical methods for nuclear thermal-hydraulic problems.

• Experience with developing complex safety analysis models from scratch.

• Experience working in a nuclear quality environment (e.g., ASME NQA-1).

• Familiarity with Linux operating systems.

• Familiarity with preparing and defending Safety Analysis Reports (SARs) with NRC or DOE.

• Demonstrated ability to apply technical knowledge to plant conditions, regulatory requirements, and analytical evaluations is preferred.

With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. At Enrichment Operations (EO), our mission is to support the nation’s energy security by safely producing enriched uranium products for government and commercial customers. ## Position Overview

As a member of our Maintenance Staff, you will support facility operations by repairing, installing, and maintaining building systems and equipment across the Enrichment Operations site.

## Location

On‑site in Oak Ridge, TN at the Enrichment Operations Facility.

## Your Day‑to‑Day as Maintenance Staff

• Install, commission, troubleshoot, and perform preventive maintenance on building HVAC systems and controls.

• Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, and control system issues to ensure facility reliability.

• Lead or support small facility modification projects, including HVAC, electrical, and mechanical scope, as qualified.

• Interpret schematics, drawings, and technical manuals to execute maintenance and repair tasks accurately.

• Oversee shop operations, including maintaining laboratories and facilities in compliance with applicable codes.

• Support general facilities maintenance activities, including mechanical system upkeep, equipment relocation, and grounds support.

• Operate forklifts, lifts, and other maintenance equipment as needed.

• Occasional off‑hours or weekend coverage may be required to support operational needs.

## Required Qualifications

• A High School diploma or equivalent.

• A minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience (a degree may substitute for experience).

• EPA 608 Refrigeration Certification preferred; if not certified, must be willing and able to obtain certification.

• Demonstrated skill in HVAC commissioning, troubleshooting, and repair.

• Strong proficiency reading and interpreting blueprints and technical documentation.

• Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, as required.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Diploma or certificate in HVAC, controls, electrical, or a related field.

• Journeyman, Master, or Contractor HVAC license.

• Experience working in radiological, laboratory, or chemical handling environments.

• Proficiency with Building Automation Systems (BAS/EMS).

• Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and project management software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Work/life balance supported by paid time off and an employee‑friendly environment.

## Production Assembler/ Molder

## Role Details:

• Full-time, permanent, 50 hours per week, 10 hours per shift

• Molder: Monday - Friday, 2nd Shift: 3:30 PM – 2:00 AM

## Summary

As a Production Assembler / Molder, you will play a key role in manufacturing high-quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) storage tanks and components. Reporting to the Production Manager or Shift Supervisor, you will perform a variety of production tasks that may include molding, assembly, trimming, fitting, laminating, and finishing fiberglass products. You will contribute to a safe, efficient, and quality-focused manufacturing environment while supporting production goals and customer expectations.

## Responsibilities

## Production & Manufacturing

• Manufacture and assemble fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) products, including shells, domes, tanks, and related components.

• Operate machinery, hand tools, measuring devices, grinders, trimmers, rollers, and other production equipment.

• Prepare molds and tooling surfaces using release agents and related materials.

• Apply fiberglass, resin, catalyst, and other materials using hand lay-up and molding processes.

• Cut, shape, splice, fit, and join materials according to drawings, process sheets, and work instructions.

• Install fittings, manways, gauge plates, and other accessories.

• Trim and finish products to required specifications.

• Inspect products for defects and perform minor repairs or adjustments as needed.

• Read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and production documentation.

• Complete required production records, process sheets, and timekeeping documentation accurately.

• Support additional production and assembly activities as business needs require.

## Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain high standards of workmanship and product quality.

• Monitor materials and processes to reduce waste and improve efficiency.

• Identify process improvement opportunities and communicate recommendations to leadership.

## Health & Safety

• Follow all Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental requirements.

• Wear required PPE and use equipment safely.

• Report incidents, hazards, and near misses immediately.

• Participate in safety meetings and investigations as needed.

## Qualifications

• High School Diploma or equivalent required.

• Previous manufacturing experience is preferred but not required.

• Experience in fiberglass, composites, plastics, construction, assembly, production, fabrication, or industrial manufacturing environments is an asset.

• Strong production and quality-focused manufacturing skills.

## Skills & Abilities

• Strong focus on safety, quality, and productivity.

• Ability to read and follow blueprints, diagrams, and work instructions.

• Mechanical aptitude and ability to use hand and power tools.

• Basic math and measurement skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment.

• Willingness to learn new manufacturing processes and equipment.

• Lean manufacturing experience is an asset.

## Physical Requirements

• Frequent standing, walking, climbing, reaching, bending, pushing, pulling, and lifting.

• Ability to use hand tools, power tools, and manufacturing equipment.

• Ability to work safely in a physically demanding production environment.

• Visual acuity and depth perception required for measuring, assembly, and inspection tasks.

## Working Conditions

• Fiberglass reinforced plastic manufacturing facility.

• Exposure to dust, fiberglass fibers, resin and chemical odors, noise, and moving equipment.

• Non-climate-controlled environment with seasonal temperature variations.

• Overtime and weekend work may be required based on production demands.

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with monthly company contributions

## ## Senior Manager, Supply Chain Governance

Mattr Corp. is a global, $1 Billion+ company serving critical infrastructure, energy and transportation markets through two reporting segments: Composite Technologies and Connection Technologies. The Company operates through a global network of manufacturing facilities and is valued for its innovation, technology, and proven operational excellence.

Succeeding in current global markets and pursuing a growth vision is made possible by its people. In addition to acumen, dedication, and professionalism, Mattr looks for individuals who embody its values including innovation, drive, and passion, with a foundation of accountability, respect and doing the right thing.

Mattr, previously known as Shawcor, has traded as a public company for over 40 years. Backed by a strong financial foundation, the company has a growth mandate. This mandate will be met through both organic and inorganic growth in the coming years.

This role is central to strengthening the responsiveness, resilience, risk management capabilities and integrity of Mattr’s global supply chain. Success will depend on translating enterprise risk objectives into practical governance processes that support informed, compliant, and consistent decision-making across business units.

## ## Position Summary

Based in Calgary, Alberta, Toronto, Ontario, Dallas, Texas or Houston, Texas in a hybrid work arrangement, the Senior Manager, Supply Chain Governance will lead the establishment of an enterprise-level supply chain governance framework focused on the oversight of raw material sourcing, supplier lifecycle management, supply chain and product compliance, and geopolitical risk integration.

This role will help develop and implement consistent practices and policies across the supply chain functions for the various business units of Mattr with the goal of enhancing visibility, consistency, scalability and disciplined risk management across Mattr’s global supply chain.

Core responsibilities include advancing the following enterprise objectives:

• Establish an enterprise-level sourcing governance framework

• Define standardized sourcing requirements to manage risk across all business units

• Identify, maintain, and communicate geopolitical supply chain risks through an enterprise risk registry, ensuring timely escalation and visibility to Business Unit Supply Chain leaders to support informed sourcing and operational decisions.

• Develop corporate-level policies, processes, and controls that support consistent, scalable execution and coordinate cross-functional roll-out of same

• Support the development and execution of the global supply chain strategy and annual strategic priorities

• Monitor regulatory developments affecting supply chains and product compliance and coordinate practical responses

• Lead compliance with global supply chain transparency regulations and reporting requirements

• Share supply chain best practices

• Provide practical support to operations facing ongoing supply chain challenges.

The role will partner closely with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Operational leadership to operationalize governance standards within supplier lifecycle activities and related business processes.

## ## Reports To

SVP Legal, General Counsel & Secretary

## ## Key Relationships

The Senior Manager, Supply Chain Governance will exercise their mandate through key internal and external relationships, including:

• Business Unit Supply Chain and Procurement Leadership

• Chief Financial Officer

• Group Presidents Connection Technologies and Composite Technologies

• Chief Compliance Officer

• Operations, Engineering and Quality leaders across Business Units

• Director, Financial Compliance

## ## Duties

Enterprise Supply Chain Governance

• Design and implement an enterprise sourcing governance framework that balances effective oversight with streamlined, practical and user-friendly processes

• Establish cross-business unit coordination to improve visibility, consistency, and accountability in sourcing practices

• Develop governance structures, decision rights, and escalation protocols for sourcing risk issues

• Develop, maintain, and support adoption of corporate-level supply chain policies and process standards, that support consistent execution

• Identify and leverage appropriate technology, automation and artificial intelligence tools to support efficient compliance monitoring, and reduce administrative burden

Sourcing Standards & Risk Management

• Define enterprise-wide minimum sourcing standards, including supplier qualification, onboarding, and lifecycle management requirements

• Develop and maintain policies, procedures, and controls for supplier due diligence and ongoing monitoring

• Support audit and review programs to validate supplier compliance with enterprise standards

• Coordinate tracking and escalation of remediation efforts for identified supplier risks or non-compliance and provide execution support to business-unit supply chain and operations leaders.

• Monitor regulatory developments affecting supply chains and product compliance, assess applicability, assign ownership, and coordinate timely responses

• Define sourcing risk requirements for incorporation into procurement processes and ERP systems in partnership with business-unit process owners and system owners

Geopolitical Risk Framework

• Establish and operationalize a standardized geopolitical risk monitoring framework

• Embed geopolitical risk considerations into:

• Supplier selection and onboarding

• Contracting and sourcing decisions

• Ongoing supplier performance and risk monitoring

• Partner with Legal and Compliance to align geopolitical risk management with sanctions, export controls, and regulatory obligations

Cross-Functional Integration

• Partner with various functional support groups to align governance requirements with operational workflows, digital tools, and supplier platforms

• Partner with business unit Procurement to strengthen strategic supplier collaboration and long-term value creation

• Support integration of governance requirements into commercial agreements and supplier contracts

Executive Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to senior leadership based on operational and financial performance

• Develop and deliver enterprise-level reporting on supply chain risk, compliance, and governance performance

• Provide visibility to senior leadership on key risk exposures, trends, and mitigation strategies

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain transparency, consistency, and resilience

Operational Support

• Provide guidance and support to Business Unit Supply Chain and Operations leaders on procurement best practices, strategic sourcing approaches, supplier management, and continuous improvement opportunities.

• Serve as a mentor and trusted advisor to supply chain teams across the organization, fostering capability development, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of consistent supply chain processes and standards.

## ## Key Deliverables

• Enterprise supplier risk framework

• Supply chain governance policies and standards

• Geopolitical risk monitoring process

• Regulatory compliance reporting framework

• Executive and Board-level supply chain risk reporting

## ## Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Law, Engineering or related field (advanced degree preferred)

• 8–12+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, compliance, or governance roles

• Experience implementing enterprise governance frameworks or risk management programs

• Strong understanding of global sourcing risks, including geopolitical, regulatory, and operational factors

• Experience working in complex, multi-business unit or multinational environments preferred

## ## Key Competencies

• Strong governance and risk management mindset

• Ability to collaborate, influence and align cross-functionally and cross-business unit stakeholders without direct functional ownership

• Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline

• Highly organized and process-driven

• Strong analytical and reporting skills as well as excellent verbal and written English language communication skills

## ## Additional Requirements

• Ability to operate in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities

• Occasional travel as required

Mattr welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. To begin a conversation about your individual accessibility needs throughout our recruitment process, please contact our HR team.

• Attractive incentive bonus plans

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Long-Term Disability insurance

• Wellness incentives
