You will work directly with BAE customer stakeholders while leading and mentoring the engineers supporting the account. You'll be expected to understand the environment end-to-end, diagnose complex problems across Avaya communications platforms, SIP, call flows, network infrastructure, Cisco, Linux, Active Directory, and integrated third-party applications/CPE, and bring the right Avaya resources together to drive issues through resolution.

The role is ideal for an experienced systems, communications, voice, network, or technical support engineer who enjoys being the person customers rely on when the problem is complex, the environment is mission-critical, and the solution requires both deep technical expertise and strong leadership.

## What You'll Own

## Be the Technical Authority for the Account

• Serve as the primary technical SME and customer-facing engineering leader for the BAE AP2 account.

• Develop trusted relationships with customer engineering, IT, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders.

• Understand the customer's technical environment, dependencies, priorities, and risks.

• Act as the senior technical point of contact for complex issues and customer concerns.

• Translate customer requirements and technical challenges into actionable plans for Avaya teams.

• Participate in technical governance and customer meetings, providing status, risk assessments, recommendations, and technical direction.

## Solve Complex Enterprise Communications Problems

This role requires someone who can go beyond individual product troubleshooting and understand how an enterprise environment works as a whole.

You will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues involving:

• Avaya Aura and enterprise communications platforms

• Aura Releases 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10

• SIP and SIP signaling

• Call flows and call-flow troubleshooting

• G650

• Network infrastructure and routing

• Cisco environments

• DNS / DHCP

• LDAP / Active Directory

• Linux

• ServiceNow

• Third-party applications and customer-premises equipment (CPE)

You will perform both Break/Fix troubleshooting and implementation consulting, working across technology layers to isolate root cause and determine the appropriate path to resolution.

## Lead Critical Escalations

• Own high-priority and complex technical escalations from initial assessment through resolution.

• Lead troubleshooting efforts during critical customer-impacting incidents.

• Coordinate Engineering, Product, Support, and other Avaya resources as required.

• Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action.

• Maintain clear and proactive communication with customer stakeholders throughout an escalation.

• Identify recurring issues and proactively address technical risks before they become major customer-impacting events.

## Lead and Mentor the Engineering Team

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the two engineers currently supporting the account.

• Serve as their senior technical escalation point.

• Guide engineers through complex troubleshooting and customer issues.

• Establish technical standards, best practices, and operating procedures.

• Help strengthen the team's technical capabilities and ensure appropriate coverage for the customer environment.

• Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

## Strengthen Technical Governance

• Bring greater technical rigor and operational discipline to the customer relationship.

• Partner with account leadership to identify technical risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Ensure technical commitments and action items are clearly defined, tracked, and communicated.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, escalation processes, and knowledge resources.

• Help ensure the customer's technical priorities remain aligned across Avaya organizations.

## ## What We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced engineer who combines deep technical capability with customer leadership.

## Required

• 8+ years of experience in systems engineering, communications engineering, network engineering, technical support, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Hands-on experience supporting Avaya Aura environments.

• Strong SIP knowledge and troubleshooting experience.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze and troubleshoot call flows.

• Experience with enterprise network infrastructure and integrated third-party applications/CPE.

• Working knowledge of Cisco, Linux, Active Directory/LDAP, DNS, DHCP, routers, and ServiceNow.

• Experience supporting complex enterprise communications or IT environments.

• Experience leading complex technical customer engagements and escalations.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot problems spanning multiple technologies and infrastructure layers.

• Experience providing technical leadership or mentorship to other engineers.

• Strong customer-facing communication and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical audiences and senior customer stakeholders.

• Ability to operate calmly and effectively during high-pressure, customer-impacting incidents.

• Active TS/SCI clearance.

• Active Full-Scope Polygraph — required prior to hire.

• U.S. work authorization required; no visa sponsorship available.

• Ability to work in the Northern Virginia / Dulles, VA area.

##

## Preferred

• Experience supporting BAE Systems or other defense/intelligence customers.

• Experience supporting federal government or mission-critical environments.

• Experience with multiple generations of Avaya Aura.

• SIP certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

• Deep voice/telecommunications and IP networking experience.

• Experience with G650.

• Strong Cisco networking experience.

• Experience with government security or compliance environments.

• Experience with CMMC, FedRAMP, FISMA, or similar frameworks.

• ITIL certification or experience working in an ITIL-based support organization.

• Experience managing major incidents or enterprise technical escalations.

• Experience leading distributed engineering or technical support teams.

##

## Why This Role

This is an opportunity to become the technical owner and trusted advisor for a strategically important customer environment.

You won't simply be working tickets or waiting for escalations to arrive. You'll know the customer's environment, build relationships with its technical leaders, lead the response when critical issues occur, and help shape how the account is technically supported.

If you are the engineer customers call when the problem is complicated, the environment is critical, and someone needs to take ownership, this role is built for you.

## Position Overview:

The Front Line Manager II – Machining & Assembly is responsible for leading multiple skilled trades teams across machining, assembly, and associated precision‑fabrication operations within the Barberton facility. This higher‑tier leadership role carries expanded ownership for cross‑shift coordination, production planning, workflow prioritization, and technical problem‑solving within a complex, multi‑building machining environment.

The FLM II ensures safe, high‑quality, and efficient execution of machining and assembly work scopes, proactively resolves technical and operational challenges, and drives continuous improvement across processes, procedures, technology usage, and workforce effectiveness. This role serves as a key advocate for employee engagement, communication, and accountability while maintaining strong partnerships with technical support groups.

This position is primarily assigned to 2nd Shift; however, flexibility to transition between shifts, departments, and work areas is essential to maintain seamless operations. Scheduled overtime may be required based on operational demand.

## Location:

On-site in Barberton, Ohio

## Your Day to Day as a Front-Line Manager II

Operational Leadership & Team Management

• Supervise, mentor, and develop union hourly skilled trades employees in machining, assembly, and related precision‑fabrication processes.

• Manage the daily activities of multiple machining and assembly teams, ensuring alignment with safety, quality, and production requirements.

• Provide leadership continuity across shifts by establishing production plans, coordinating work execution, and ensuring downstream teams are prepared for follow‑through.

Production Planning & Execution

• Plan, direct, and coordinate machining and assembly activities across multiple buildings, work centers, and product lines.

• Work closely with technical support groups to interpret fabrication work scopes, resolve machining issues, and ensure adherence to specifications and manufacturing requirements.

• Manage complex component flows, ensuring clarity, communication, and coordination of technical requirements, engineering changes, and precision machining tolerances.

Technical Issue Resolution

• Apply technical knowledge of machining, assembly, and skilled trade practices to diagnose and resolve manufacturing issues.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing support, and quality groups to investigate problems, identify root causes, and formalize corrective actions.

• Communicate safety, quality, and production updates verbally and in writing, ensuring transparency and alignment across teams.

Data Management & Systems Use

• Input, analyze, and manage data related to labor time, production schedules, and workflow management within applicable computer systems.

• Utilize established processes, production data, and technology to make autonomous operational decisions and solve problems with limited precedent.

Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Evaluate machining and assembly operations to recommend improvements in workflow design, efficiency, resource utilization, safety, and cost control.

• Support the implementation of new equipment, technologies, and updated standards across machining and assembly teams.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen workforce engagement, skill development, and cross‑functional collaboration.

Flexibility & Availability

• Flex between shifts and work areas based on project needs, staffing requirements, or emergent operations.

• Work scheduled overtime as required to maintain production continuity and meet customer commitments.

## Required Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Five (5) years of relevant machining, assembly, or precision‑manufacturing supervisory experience, preferably in a unionized environment.

• Proven experience supervising union skilled trades in machining, assembly, or precision component fabrication within a complex production setting.

• Strong technical background in machining processes, assembly practices, precision tolerancing, and multi‑team coordination across multiple buildings or work centers.

• Ability to work autonomously within established practices, exercising sound judgment to resolve machining and assembly issues with limited precedent.

• Motivated to support production teams, proactively identify issues, and drive timely resolution.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging and influencing employees and leaders of diverse backgrounds and generations.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with G&M Codes, MS Office, SharePoint, Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing, and overhead cranes a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree is a plus.

• Paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

## CNC VBM Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

We are currently seeking qualified applicants to fill large machining center positions at our facility in Barberton, Ohio. Successful applicants will be able to set up and operate large, CNC Vertical Boring Machines (Vertical Lathes) , as well as any associated auxiliary equipment. Machining operations will include boring, facing, turning, grooving, contouring, taper turning, taper boring, grinding, and other operations to produce quality product in accordance with established procedures. Makes in-process changes to programs and edits/writes programs, as necessary, under the supervision of a programmer and/or immediate supervisor.

## Purpose

• Performs multi-axis machining operations with high precision. Operates equipment while utilizing right angle heads, facing heads, inspection probes, jib cranes, tool attachments, all types of fixtures, any and all set-up equipment, tool setters, tool holders, precision measuring instruments, power tools and any hand tools necessary for the fulfillment of job duties.

• Works with programmer to develop and test run programs. Proof reads programs and notifies supervisor/programmer of potential problems.

• Positions and secures work piece and fixtures on table.

• Obtains drawings and tools from the crib and verifies the tools are correct for the application and matches the tools called for in the program(s).

• Assembles tooling as required.

• Uses higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices.

• Directs and assists crane operator with the rigging and moving of parts to load and unload machine.

• Performs final inspection of features using both the inspection probe and precision measuring equipment.

• Cleans and deburrs job as necessary. Attaches seals and protective covers as required.

• Performs minor maintenance on machine, attachments, and tooling as required.

• Keeps equipment and work area clean and orderly.

• Verifies identity and physical characteristics of materials as required.

• Maintains necessary records and completes process documentation and any other production records as required. Identifies equipment and product as required.

## Minimum Requirements

• High school diploma or GED equivalency required.

• A minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience performing precision machining functions on large machines is desired. Journeyman level machinist designation or equivalent is preferred.

• Must be open and available to working all shifts

• Must be proficient with CNC controls, including G and M coded commands.

• Must be able to edit or modify programs as necessary. Must be able to write minor programs.

• Must have a working knowledge of feeds and speeds for all types of material.

• Must be able to work to ±.001" tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary.

• Must demonstrate ability to read and interpret geometric tolerancing per ANSI Y14.5

## Position Overview:

As a Machinist at BWXT NOGJ, you will perform a variety of duties within the Operations department and will support various programs across the site. This position will report directly to the Manufacturing Operations Supervisor. This position requires the ability to work any shift as dictated by production requirements (1st, 2nd or 3rd), the ability to work overtime, weekends and shifts of 10 to 12 hours per day. This opening has been designated as a 2nd or 3rd shift position. Working under general supervision and following established policies, a Machinist performs assignments in various areas of the facility to fabricate precision-machined, tight tolerance parts while maintaining a safe work environment, meeting quality requirements, customer specifications and shipment schedules. This position is designated as a 2nd shift position.

## Location:

Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a Machinist (2nd shift):

• Operate CNC lathes in manual, semi-automatic and automatic modes

• Operate conventional Engine lathes

• Set-up and Operation of various machinery and shop equipment with little or no supervision

• Fabricate quality product meeting customer specifications

• Use, operate and read inspection gaging equipment including but not limited to micrometers, calipers, comparators, shadow graphs, indicators, and Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM)

• Inspection of products both in process and post process

• Perform machine offsets

• Read and interpret blueprints and drawings

• Screen product lots

• Replace broken or worn tooling as required

• Advanced data collection, analysis and reporting activities

• Collect, analyze and utilize SPC data

• Collect, enter, analyze and utilize SPC data per Customer requirements

• Produce quality products to Customer specifications

• Maintain count and traceability of parts including tagging rejected parts

• Maintain water levels in chip drums and replacing chip drums

• Perform rework of parts when necessary

• Perform routine daily minor preventative maintenance (oil levels, grease, filter changes, etc.)

• Transport materials to and from operation as required

• Load and unload parts/blanks

• Complete and maintain daily production reports and records

• Maintain a clean and neat workspace

• Communicate daily process, machine, product status or other relevant manufacturing information to employee(s) and/or supervisor(s) who report to work on the next shift

• Report abnormalities related to production, maintenance, safety or quality to supervisor

• Troubleshoot processes and report feedback to supervisor

• Identify and escalate out-of-control processes

• Must be able to operate a tow motor and/or forklift

• May be required to wear a respirator in the performance of normal duties and will be required to maintain clean shaven protocol for respirator fit testing

• Perform duties in various areas of the facility as required to support production

## Required Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent and a minimum of 4 years of prior relevant experience or associate degree with 2 years of prior related experience or equivalent combination or education/experience. Relevant experience should be in an industrial or manufacturing environment

• Ability to interface effectively within Operations and with various support groups such as Maintenance, Quality and Engineering

• Must be able work effectively in a team environment

• Must be able to work 10 plus hours per shift. May be required to work any shift, 1st, 2nd or 3rd. Must be available to work overtime and/or on weekends as needed to support production efforts

• Must be a US Citizen with no dual citizenship

• May be required to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) or a Department of Energy (DOE) clearance

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

About the role This role is the steel thread between our product strategy and the sales and marketing work that turns it into results. You'll build our go-to-market strategies and run product launches from plan to launch day, working closely with product managers, partners and sales. We do most of our product marketing through AI skills and agents that we personally build for ourselves. Research, competitive analysis, launch plans, messaging drafts and sales enablement all start with tools like Claude Code, and you'll work that way too. If you already do, great. If you're strong on product marketing fundamentals and curious about AI, we can teach you the rest. We're a small team, so you'll own your products end to end and make a lot of your own calls. Nobody expects that on day one. You'll work closely with the team while you ramp up, and you'll have support the whole way. What you'll do Launches and go-to-market - Plan launches for new products, features and releases, and run the cross-functional plan through to launch. - Develop marketing programs for your products with the marketing team, including the activities and budgets for keeping current customers and winning new ones. - Work with the demand generation and content team on programs that keep demand coming. - Measure how your programs perform, show what's working and what isn't, and report back on what needs to change. Positioning and messaging - Work with product management and marketing communications to develop positioning, messaging and content for our target buyer personas. - Explain in plain terms how our products solve our buyers' problems, and back your thinking with market evidence. - Represent your products externally through speaking engagements and written work. Buyer and competitive insight - Be the expert on our buyers, including who they are, how they buy and what criteria drive their decisions. - Know the competitive landscape: how each competitor positions itself today and where they're heading. - Map our buyer's journey, including where buyers get information and who makes which decisions, when and why. Use what you learn to change how we sell and market. Sales and partner enablement - Support our sales channels. Train them on the problems we solve, build internal tools and external collateral, and show them how and when to use each piece. - Turn your positioning and messaging into material our marketing, partner and sales teams can put to work. AI-powered product marketing - Use AI tools every day to research markets and competitors, draft and test messaging, and build launch and enablement assets. - Build and refine repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, agents) that the wider marketing and sales teams can reuse. - Other responsibilities aligned with the PMA’s definition of a PMM’s responsibilities. AI is a core part of how this role works every day. We weigh PMM fundamentals more heavily than AI expertise, because AI is easier to teach. - Experience working with product teams to define product strategy. - Comfort working with technical teams and translating technical products into buyer value. A technical background is a plus. - Strong quantitative analytical skills, and clear written and spoken communication in positioning, messaging and storytelling. - A customer-centric approach, with experience talking directly to customers. - Diplomacy with cross-functional partners, including knowing when to push back and when to dive in. - Comfort working independently on a small, entrepreneurial team that moves quickly. - Strong organization while managing multiple projects and priorities. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. ## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Job Summary:

The Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations, will play a key role in BWXT's long-term financial planning and strategic decision making. Reporting to the Vice President of Investor Relations & Strategic Finance, the Director will work closely with finance and operational leaders across BWXT to develop the company's long-range financial outlook, understand the financial implications of strategic actions, and provide analysis and recommendations that support capital allocation and long-term value creation.

This position offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of corporate finance, business strategy and capital markets, with significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to influence some of BWXT's most important financial and strategic decisions.

The position will lead and support a broad range of strategic finance initiatives, including long-range forecasting and scenario analysis, capital expenditure allocations, working capital optimization, financial performance analysis and other enterprise-wide priorities.

The Director will be expected to develop a deep understanding of BWXT's businesses and translate complex financial and operational information into clear insights and recommendations for senior management.

In addition, the Director will play a role in BWXT's Investor Relations activities, providing exposure to the investment community and an external perspective on the company's strategy, financial performance and valuation. The role will support quarterly earnings, investor communications, management preparation and capital markets analysis, with opportunities for greater involvement in Investor Relations over time.

## Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position does not initially have direct supervisory responsibilities but will be expected to lead significant cross-functional initiatives and provide leadership and guidance to teams across the organization.

## Duties / Responsibilities:

## 1. Strategic Finance & Long-Range Planning

• Lead BWXT's long-range financial planning and forecasting process, partnering with corporate and business-unit finance teams to develop an integrated view of the company's long-term financial outlook.

• Develop scenario analyses and financial models to evaluate strategic opportunities, key business drivers, risks and potential outcomes.

• Analyze financial and operational performance to identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring management attention.

• Translate complex financial and operational information into clear insights, recommendations and executive-level presentations that support strategic decision-making.

## 2. Capital Allocation

• Evaluate capital allocation alternatives and provide financial analysis supporting decisions related to organic investment, acquisitions and divestitures, share repurchases, dividends and other uses of capital.

• Develop financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate potential returns, risks and strategic implications of major investments and other capital deployment decisions.

• Partner with business and corporate finance teams to evaluate significant capital investments and other strategic opportunities.

• Provide financial insights and recommendations to senior management regarding the implications of strategic initiatives and opportunities for long-term value creation.

## 3. Working Capital & Finance Initiatives

• Lead enterprise-wide working capital optimization efforts in partnership with business-unit finance and operational leadership.

• Analyze working capital performance and key drivers across the businesses, identify opportunities for improvement and help develop actionable plans to improve cash generation.

• Establish analyses and reporting that provide management with greater visibility into working capital performance and opportunities.

• Support finance and accounting process improvement initiatives designed to improve efficiency, analytical capabilities and decision support.

## 4. Investor Relations & Capital Markets

• Partner with Investor Relations leadership in the development and execution of BWXT's investor relations strategy and external financial messaging.

• Play an active role in the quarterly earnings process, including financial analysis, development of key messages, preparation of earnings materials and senior management preparation.

• Support the development of investor presentations, conference materials, earnings call scripts, Q&A documents and other investor communications.

• Help prepare executive leadership for investor meetings, conferences and roadshows through financial analysis, messaging, competitive intelligence and anticipated investor questions.

• Support major investor-facing initiatives, including Investor Days and other strategic presentations.

## Required Skills / Abilities:

• Strong corporate finance and FP&A capabilities, with demonstrated expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, financial statement analysis and scenario analysis.

• Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational and market information into actionable recommendations.

• Ability to develop a strong understanding of business operations and effectively connect operational drivers to financial performance and long-term value creation.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly and concisely to senior executives and other stakeholders.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to develop effective working relationships with senior leadership, business-unit management and cross-functional teams.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with financial market and analytical tools such as OneStream, SAP, and Power BI is a plus.

• Strong project-management skills with demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• High attention to detail and the ability to operate effectively under tight deadlines.

• Understanding of public company financial reporting and capital markets

## Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business or a related field. MBA, CPA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification is a plus.

• 7 or more years of progressive experience in corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance or a related corporate finance role.

• Experience within a publicly traded company is preferred.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy (DOE) security clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Developer/Senior Developer - Payments and Tokenization

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

Shape the Future of Payments and Financial Technology.
We are seeking a motivated Developer to help design and deliver secure solutions across payments, tokenization, blockchain, digital assets, and distributed ledger technologies (DLT). Working closely with the Bank for International Settlements Innovation Hub (BISIH) in Toronto, you will contribute to innovate projects that address complex challenges in the evolving financial technology landscape. We are looking for a collaborative and curious individual with a passion for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.

What you will be working on
You will work collaboratively with our team to help design and deliver scalable, secure and practical technology solutions in payments, tokenisation, digital assets and distributed ledger systems:

• Develop technology solutions and prototypes that explore and advance use cases in payments, tokenisation, digital assets, and distributed ledger systems.

• Contribute to the technical design and implementation of systems involving payment flows, settlement processes, tokenised assets, ledger integrations, smart contract-enabled workflows, wallet interactions and related digital finance infrastructure.

• Build and maintain high-quality backend services, APIs, integration layers, developer tools, and other core platform components.

• Evaluate technical approaches and provide input on architecture, tooling implementation patterns, and the appropriate use of DLTs.

• Collaborate with technical leads and stakeholders to define requirements, solutions options, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.

• Identify technical risks, performance concerns, and design challenges, and propose practical solutions.

• Prepare clear technical documentation and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Contribute to engineering best practices, including code quality, testing, security, observability, maintainability, and release management.

• Stay current on emerging technologies, standards, and industry developments, and translate insights into practical recommendations and solutions.
Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities while contributing to a collaborative, delivery-focused team environment.

What you need to succeed
We are looking for candidates who demonstrate the following skills and competencies. We welcome applicants who may not meet every requirement but have a strong foundation and a willingness to continue learning and growing.

• Familiarity with blockchain concepts, consensus algorithms, smart contracts and DeFi ecosystem including cross-chain and off-chain transfers, atomic swaps and oracle

• Experience or capability of developing tokenized solutions on DLT platforms using Solidity, Move or similar technologies.

• Strong programming skills in one or more modern languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, C#, TypeScript, Python or Rust.

• Knowledge of one or more following areas: payments, transaction flows, settlement, tokenisation, stablecoins, digital assets, market infrastructure or regulated financial systems.

• Understanding of wallet and custody integrations, interoperability approaches, and key security, privacy, identity, access management, and resilience considerations in financial technology environments.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and a pragmatic approach to innovation and delivery.

• Ability to work independently in an dynamic environment while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

## Nice-to-have

• Experience with token standards, token lifecycle design, smart contract review, or related controls supporting safe deployment of contract-based systems.

• Exposure to payment standards, market infrastructure standards or regulated financial technology environments.

• Experience or academic exposure to cloud-native development, containerization technologies, CI/CD pipelines and observability practices.

• Familiarity with cryptography, key management, digital identity or privacy-enhancing technologies or related security concepts

Your education and experience
This position may be staffed at either the JG16 (Developer) or JG17 (Senior Developer) level, depending on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and demonstrated competencies.

Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, along with:
• 4 to 5 years of relevant experience for consideration at the JG16 (Developer) level; or
• 5 to 7 years of relevant experience for consideration at the JG17 (Senior Developer) level.

An equivalent combination of education and practical project experience may also be considered.
Recent graduates from a master's or PhD program in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field who have completed project work in blockchain, tokenization, smart contracts, or distributed ledger technologies (DLT) are encouraged to apply.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “Developer/Senior Developer ”

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $94,193 to $110,816 (job grade 16) and from $111,051 to $130,649 (job grade 17)

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service

## Worker Sub-Type:
Student (Fixed Term)

## Job Description:

QNX is a world leader in the embedded software that drives many of the world's most interesting products. From space cameras to nuclear reactors to autonomous vehicles and sophisticated medical devices, QNX provides the foundation operating system that runs these systems.

## Location: Kanata, Ottawa, ON

Length of Term: 8 Months

## The QNXE (QNX Everywhere) Test Team, our responsibilities include:

• Testing and verifying new features related to the QNXE Project

• Collaborating closely with the QNXE Development Team to ensure that new features are validated correctly

• Automating manual test cases using Python and pytest to decrease the release testing time and improve test reliability

• Designing detailed test cases, test specifications, and test plans

• Testing and verifying new features in different domains (graphics, cameras, hardware, ... etc)

• Porting and building applications from Linux to QNX

• Building and customizing QNX images for various hardware and emulated environment targets

As a co-op student, you will play a vital role in enhancing the automation of test cases by increasing the percentage of automated test cases. Additionally, you will participate in testing new features and porting new applications to QNX.

## What you will do:

• Become familiar with the QNX operating system

• Utilise Python as a test tool

• Write Manual and automated test cases

• Become familiar with the C library API to be tested and how the API could be used

• Debug and Analyze issue and work on the solutions

• Investigate and debug any issues found during the design and implementation of the test cases

• Report any issues to the kernel developers and kernel testers at QNX who are industry experts on embedded real-time systems

## You will have:

• Currently pursuing post-secondary education in a related field

• Familiarity with Linux or other UNIX-like operating systems

• Programming experience in C/python

• Experience in Docker/virtualization technology

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Eagerness to learn and solve problems

## Above & Beyond:

• Experience creating test cases using C and ability to follow our coding standard and verify that the API operates as documented

• Familiarity with targets, real hardware

40

About Calian

At Calian, we help organizations overcome obstacles, manage risks, and drive progress. Since 1982, we've grown from a small consulting firm into a trusted global company serving the defence, space, health, nuclear energy, public safety, and government sectors.

CareersInnerInfo
Our teams create innovative solutions that tackle complex challenges and help organizations and communities stay resilient, informed, and connected. If you're driven by purpose and energized by solving real-world challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking experienced Weapons Technician Instructors to support the training and development of military personnel at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Borden. This is a full-time, on-site contract opportunity where you will deliver practical and theoretical instruction related to small arms, armament systems, maintenance procedures, and weapons repair.

As a subject matter expert, you will play a key role in preparing the next generation of Weapons Technicians through classroom instruction, workshop supervision, student mentorship, assessment activities, and course development support.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver practical and theoretical instruction on small arms and armament repair procedures.

• Instruct students on approved and safe maintenance, inspection, and repair practices.

• Demonstrate inspection and repair procedures for in-service small arms and armament weapon systems.

• Utilize advanced tooling, including Bore Gauges BG-10 and BG-20, and other weapon-specific gauges.

• Provide instruction on Weapons DP3 or USQ qualifications, including platforms such as Leopard Family of Vehicles (Leo FoV), M777, and LG1 systems, as required.

• Deliver classroom and workshop instruction to groups of up to 30 students.

• Provide instruction independently or in conjunction with other instructors.

• Develop training aids using provided boards, equipment, and multimedia resources.

• Monitor workshop activities and immediately correct unsafe practices.

• Identify and report academic or disciplinary concerns to the Section Head.

• Secure and store training aids in designated areas at the end of each training day.

• Apply DP1 and DP2 instructional policies, including tool control, classroom management, material accountability, harassment prevention, and professional conduct standards.

• Utilize the Defence Learning Network (DLN) to monitor student progress.

• Adapt to changing schedules, program updates, and evolving training requirements.

• Comply with all school policies and the Conduct of Training Manual (CTM).

• Maintain classrooms, laboratories, and training facilities in a clean, safe, and serviceable condition.

• Control, mark, and analyze Enabling Checks (ECs) and Performance Checks (PCs).

• Advise Course Directors regarding deficient or unserviceable training aids and facilities.

• Prepare and provide lesson plans, evaluations, assessments, and course documentation.

• Record student performance in Student Record Books (SRBs).

• Assist with counselling students regarding academic and performance concerns.

• Invigilate examinations.

• Participate in course design and development activities.

• Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support as required.

Required Qualifications

Applicants must possess one of the following:

Option 1

• Regular Force QL6 Weapons Technician (DP3/RQ Sergeant) Certificate

OR

Option 2

• Regular Force QL5 (DP2) Weapons Technician Certificate

• Junior Leaders Course (JLC) or Primary Leadership Qualification (PLQ)

• Ability to successfully complete the first available DP3 Weapons Technician Course at the Department of National Defence's expense upon appointment to the position

Experience Requirements

• Minimum 12 years of experience as a Weapons Technician.

• Minimum 2 years of experience teaching adults within the last ten (10) years.

## Additional Requirements

• Must be available to work on-site at CFB Borden, Ontario.

• Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Government of Canada Secret Security Clearance.

Compensation

$38.00 to $45.29 per hour

Vacancy

We have 5 available position(s).

Why Join Calian?

• Competitive hourly compensation.

• Opportunity to contribute directly to the training and readiness of Canadian Armed Forces personnel.

• Work alongside experienced military and civilian professionals.

• Apply your technical expertise while mentoring and developing future Weapons Technicians.

• Join a respected Canadian organization supporting critical defence and training initiatives.

AI Usage Disclosure

At Calian, we do not use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to screen or evaluate candidates. AI tools may support backend administrative tasks; however, they do not influence hiring decisions. All evaluations and hiring decisions are made by members of our recruitment team and hiring managers.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Calian is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/797.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.

You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace: how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.

What You’ll Do

Own the customer relationship

• Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best

• Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after

• Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on

• Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention

• Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly

• Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

• Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them

• Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up

• Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed

• Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

• Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state

• Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly

• Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

• Watch capacity and growth trends and flag what is needed well before it becomes urgent

• Keep deployments on supported, current versions and coordinate upgrades with as little disruption as possible

• Track advisories and known issues, and tell each customer what, if anything, it means for them

Make the practice better

• Improve the playbooks you work from, so the next customer and the next Service Owner both benefit

• Feed product gaps, architecture problems and customer education needs back to Product, Account and Customer Success teams

• Give the account team the technical credibility they need at renewal, and speak up where a customer would genuinely benefit from more Solace. Growth here comes from running the service well and being straight about what you see, not from a pitch

• Use and contribute to the team's operational tooling (Example, Python-based CLIs for monitoring management) to streamline day-to-day service delivery tasks

Location and travel

• This role can be based anywhere in Canada, the United States or Mexico, and the work is mostly remote

• Travel is light but not zero. Expect a handful of customer visits a year for onboarding, service reviews, and the situations where being in the room is worth more than being on the call

About You

• You take ownership. You treat the customer's environment as yours to look after, and you follow up on things without being chased

• You want to know why. Restarting the broker is not a root cause, and you are not satisfied until you can explain what actually happened

• You can write and you can present. A report a director will read, and a troubleshooting call with their engineers, are both well within range

• You work well without scaffolding. Several customer relationships at once, no two days the same, and nobody planning your week for you

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

• 5+ years in professional services, technical consulting, managed services or enterprise infrastructure operations, in a customer facing role

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, messaging middleware or distributed systems (Solace, Kafka, IBM MQ,TIBCO, RabbitMQ or similar)

• Strong troubleshooting instincts across the application, middleware, network and cloud layers, plus the discipline to write down what you found

• Experience with monitoring and observability tooling

• Scripting and automation ability, Python preferred

• Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized deployments and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP

• Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences

• Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running several customer relationships at the same time

Preferred

• Direct Solace Platform experience in any form factor: Solace Cloud, software broker or appliance

• Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, JMS, REST and SMF

• Background in managed services, SRE or a NOC, somewhere you were close to the customer rather than behind a queue

• ITIL or a similar service management framework

• Data center and hardware appliance experience

• Hands-on experience with Datadog or an equivalent enterprise observability platform (dashboards, alerting, monitors, notebooks), Datadog specifically is a strong advantage

• Spanish or French, which comes in handy across our Americas customer base

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

• You know your customers' environments, teams and priorities in detail

• They treat you as their contact at Solace, and reach out to you first

• Your reporting goes out reliably and says something worth reading

In 6 Months

• Problems are getting found and addressed before your customers notice them

• You run onboarding for new customers and land it on schedule

• Support, Customer Success and Sales treat you as the authority on your accounts

In 12 Months

• Service quality across your portfolio is consistent, and does not depend on heroics

• Capacity and upgrade planning happens well ahead of need rather than in reaction to it

• Your customers renew and expand because they can point at what the service did for them

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

## Worker Sub-Type:
Student (Fixed Term)

## Job Description:

QNX is a world leader in the embedded software that drives many of the world's most interesting products. From space cameras to nuclear reactors to autonomous vehicles and sophisticated medical devices, QNX provides the foundation operating system that runs these systems.

To support these rapidly growing industries, we're offering several exciting co-op opportunities in our R&D and Engineering Services teams at our Ottawa office. These roles are ideal for students passionate about cybersecurity and embedded software development and eager to work on impactful, real-world projects.

Location: Kanata, Ottawa, ON
Duration: Minimum of 4 months (ideally 8)
Salary: Dependent on number of academic terms and co-op placements completed

We are seeking a co-op student to contribute to the development and maintenance of cybersecurity tooling for QNX products. In this role, you will help build, improve, and extend tools used by security researchers and engineers to analyze, test, harden, and certify QNX-based systems.

You will gain hands-on experience working at many different levels of the software stack, from the QNX kernel to web applications.

## What You'll Do

• Contribute to internal security tools used for analysis, testing, and validation of QNX components

• Investigate, fix, and improve existing automated security frameworks

• Enhance tooling for both Fuzzing and ISO/SAE 21434 certification activities

• Integrate and maintain security tooling within CI/CD pipelines

• Collaborate closely with security researchers and system developers to align tooling with real needs

## What You'll Learn

• Fundamentals of the QNX microkernel, including services, IPC, and POSIX compatibility

• Techniques for fuzzing, how fuzzers work, and how to integrate them to fuzz existing code bases

• How cybersecurity tooling strengthens the cybersecurity of software

• Practical challenges of maintaining long-lived automation frameworks

## What You Need

• Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related program

• Strong programming skills in several different programming languages and the ability to learn new languages as needed. Our current tooling is a mix of C, Python, C#, and Go

• Experience working in POSIX-based environments such as QNX or Linux

• Ability to read, debug, and modify existing codebases

• Interest in building and improving tools that other engineers rely on

• Comfortable diagnosing failures and improving imperfect systems

## Nice-to-Have Skills (Not Required)

• Exposure to embedded systems, RTOS concepts, or QNX

• Experience with CI/CD systems and source control

• Interest in systems programming or product security tooling

## Why Join Us

• Work on core security tooling that directly supports existing and new products

• Exposure to system-level security in safety-critical environments

• Mentorship from experienced security researchers and engineers

• Make meaningful, lasting contributions to the cybersecurity of QNX products

• Wellness Support: Access to events that support physical, mental and financial wellness. We host wellness sessions, fitness courses, discounts to local gyms and offer a 24/7 Employee Assistant Program (EAP)

• Collaborative Culture: Highly collaborative teams and a supportive workplace environment, with organization-wide events and a student social committee

• Employee Perks: Enjoy snacks, beverages, and discounts at local stores, restaurants, and gyms

## At QNX, it all starts with you!

## Scheduled Weekly Hours:
40

## Compensation Hiring Base Salary Range:
$43,472.00 - $59,280.00Please be advised that the compensation hiring range indicated herein is provided solely as a good-faith estimate of anticipated base compensation for the position. The actual base compensation offered will be determined at the time of hire and will depend on several factors, including but not limited to the student’s completed academic coursework, prior co-op work terms, relevant practical experience, demonstrated skills, and performance in any required evaluations during the hiring process.

## Disclosure of Position Status:
This is an active opening. We are seeking to fill this position immediately

## Disclosure of Artificial Intelligence:

We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of our recruitment process. All applications are reviewed and evaluated by our hiring team.

Jabil is looking for an experienced Senior Test Development Engineer to join our company in Ottawa, Canada.

In this role, you will be required to take ownership of assigned projects, develop test strategies, test plans, test hardware and automation software, as well as implement the test solutions at the desired manufacturing site or in design verification lab.

You will work closely with customers and Jabil’s extended cross-functional teams (design, test, manufacturing, PMO, Quality) to deliver design and manufacturing test solutions.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.

You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace: how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.

What You’ll Do

Own the customer relationship

• Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best

• Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after

• Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on

• Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention

• Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly

• Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

• Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them

• Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up

• Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed

• Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

• Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state

• Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly

• Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

• Watch capacity and growth trends and flag what is needed well before it becomes urgent

• Keep deployments on supported, current versions and coordinate upgrades with as little disruption as possible

• Track advisories and known issues, and tell each customer what, if anything, it means for them

Make the practice better

• Improve the playbooks you work from, so the next customer and the next Service Owner both benefit

• Feed product gaps, architecture problems and customer education needs back to Product, Account and Customer Success

• teams

• Give the account team the technical credibility they need at renewal, and speak up where a customer would genuinely benefit from more Solace. Growth here comes from running the service well and being straight about what you see, not from a pitch

• Use and contribute to the team's operational tooling (Example, Python-based CLIs for monitoring management) to streamline day-to-day service delivery tasks

Location and travel

• This role can be based anywhere in Canada, the United States or Mexico, and the work is mostly remote

• Travel is light but not zero. Expect a handful of customer visits a year for onboarding, service reviews, and the situations where being in the room is worth more than being on the call

About You

• You take ownership. You treat the customer's environment as yours to look after, and you follow up on things without being chased

• You want to know why. Restarting the broker is not a root cause, and you are not satisfied until you can explain what actually happened

• You can write and you can present. A report a director will read, and a troubleshooting call with their engineers, are both well within range

• You work well without scaffolding. Several customer relationships at once, no two days the same, and nobody planning your week for you

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

• 5+ years in professional services, technical consulting, managed services or enterprise infrastructure operations, in a customer facing role

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, messaging middleware or distributed systems (Solace, Kafka, IBM MQ,TIBCO, RabbitMQ or similar)

• Strong troubleshooting instincts across the application, middleware, network and cloud layers, plus the discipline to write down what you found

• Experience with monitoring and observability tooling

• Scripting and automation ability, Python preferred

• Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized deployments and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP

• Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences

• Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running several customer relationships at the same time

Preferred

• Direct Solace Platform experience in any form factor: Solace Cloud, software broker or appliance

• Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, JMS, REST and SMF

• Background in managed services, SRE or a NOC, somewhere you were close to the customer rather than behind a queue

• ITIL or a similar service management framework

• Data center and hardware appliance experience

• Hands-on experience with Datadog or an equivalent enterprise observability platform (dashboards, alerting, monitors, notebooks), Datadog specifically is a strong advantage

• Spanish or French, which comes in handy across our Americas customer base

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

• You know your customers' environments, teams and priorities in detail

• They treat you as their contact at Solace, and reach out to you first

• Your reporting goes out reliably and says something worth reading

In 6 Months

• Problems are getting found and addressed before your customers notice them

• You run onboarding for new customers and land it on schedule

• Support, Customer Success and Sales treat you as the authority on your accounts

In 12 Months

• Service quality across your portfolio is consistent, and does not depend on heroics

• Capacity and upgrade planning happens well ahead of need rather than in reaction to it

• Your customers renew and expand because they can point at what the service did for them

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

· Identify opportunities to improve software reuse, reduce duplicated engineering effort, and standardize effective AI-assisted development practices.

• Preparation and review of welding/fabrication plans (i.e., bead placement sketches, setup sheets, welding instructions)

• Qualification, documentation, and maintenance of welding procedures and welders/weld operators.

• Trouble shooting of welding operations (i.e., weldability issues, welding equipment failures)

• Identification, design, procurement, and implementation of welding equipment and/or fixture needs.

This understanding includes but is not limited to the bulk base metal microstructure, bulk phase transformations of the base metals and weld metal that can occur during a welding process, and the proper selection of filler metals.

• A Bachelors degree in Welding Engineer is required.

## Waste Management Specialist - Nuclear Fuel Services - Erwin, TN

## Summary Description of Job:

This position is responsible for ensuring that all aspects of the NFS Transportation/Waste Management (T/WM) programs are compliant with federal and state waste regulations. Specific attributes include waste characterization, packaging, storage, and disposition including compliance with RCRA, TSCA, NRC and DOT.

## Major Duties and Responsibilities of Job:

• Interface with on-site waste generators to develop solutions to technical problems associated with T/WM.

• Provide direction to waste generators for adherence to on-site and off-site waste acceptance criteria.

• Review and approve work requests, procedures, and drawings detailing proposed process changes and determine waste characterization, packaging, storage and disposal strategies. Waste streams included are RCRA, low level radioactive waste, mixed waste, PCB waste, and sanitary waste.

• Develop/revise waste characterization document.

• Prepare sampling and analysis plans in accordance with EPA guidance documents and SW-846.

• Interpret laboratory analytical data and characterize material for disposal in accordance with applicable regulations and disposal/treatment facilities waste acceptance criteria.

## Educational Requirements of Job:

Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering, Waste Management, Environmental Science or related science, engineering, or technical field OR 8 years of equivalent experience acceptable in lieu of degree.

## Experience Requirements of Job (Beyond educational or equivalent requirements):

Three (3) to Five (5) years experience since degree. Must have a working knowledge of RCRA, DOT, and radioactive waste management pertaining to the packaging and management of hazardous, radioactive, and mixed waste.

• Working knowledge of data and reporting tools and the ability to apply established practices to assigned work.

• Ability to understand key business drivers and translate business needs into clear data and reporting requirements.

• Ability to work with, analyze, and validate data from multiple sources while maintaining accuracy and data quality.

• High attention to accuracy and detail with accountability for the quality of assigned work and contributions to team deliverables.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document processes, requirements, and solutions effectively.

• Ability to prioritize assigned work, collaborate effectively, and perform responsibilities with a moderate level of guidance and direction.

• Demonstrated ability and willingness to continue developing technical skills, business knowledge, and capabilities within the discipline.

• Experience with ETL, data integration, data pipelines, data warehousing, data modeling, or programming/scripting is preferred.

• Experience with SAP, SAP BW, ERP systems, manufacturing operations, or recurring production reporting is preferred.

• Experience with data quality, master data, governance, data lineage, process mapping, agile tools, process automation, or continuous improvement is preferred.

The Expansion/Extrusion Operator is responsible for operating, and maintaining all functions within the department, including the extrusion, expansion, and rewinding. This position will work as part of a team that will flex to other jobs according to production demands.

## Duties & Responsibilities:

• Monitor and supervise machine production in the expansion/extrusion area.

• Changeover and start-up the machinery; initiate and complete shift-to-shift handoff with other operators.

• Responsible for spooling rewind function.

• Complete all paperwork to accurately record material and labor usage as required.

• Support and assist with maintenance and servicing machines.

• Monitor dimensions and quality as part of the worker self-inspection.

• Notifies supervisor of equipment malfunction and works with maintenance if necessary to identify appropriate repairs.

• Routinely checking and complying with work instructions and process parameters.

• Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and work instructions.

• Participate in projects to improve machines and processes as part of the company's internal continuous improvement management system.

• Participate in the planning and implementation of Health Safety & Environmental (HSE) -relevant measures (health, safety and environment) to promote an Incident and Injury Free (IIF) workspace.

• Ensure full adherence to the “Leader Standard Work” profile.

• Operate all equipment in a safe and effective manner.

• Other duties as assigned by management.

• Ability to read gages, perform measurements, calculate differences to specification, and percentages.

• Computer and data entry skills of production metrics into production tracking systems.

• Manual dexterity, high willingness to learn and self-motivation.

• Ability to work independently and in a team with enthusiasm and reliability.

• Ability to learn how to interpret and respond to SPC charts.

• Knowledge of materials, production processes and quality control.

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing dynamics.

• Visual ability to examine or inspect material.

• Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, order jackets, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals.
