## Financial Controller, AmerCable

Location: Houston, Texas
Work Model: Onsite with flexibility
Position Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Travel: Regular travel between Houston, Texas and El Dorado, Arkansas

## Summary

AmerCable, a market-leading and rapidly growing business within Mattr’s Connection Technologies segment, is seeking an experienced finance leader to join its leadership team. As the senior finance leader for the business, the Financial Controller will serve as the primary finance business partner to the President and a key member of the leadership team.

This role is responsible for driving profitable growth, enhancing operational performance, supporting strategic decision-making, improving working capital performance, and providing strong financial stewardship. The successful candidate will influence key business decisions, identify opportunities and risks, and lead a high-performing finance team that supports operations across Houston, Texas and El Dorado, Arkansas.

## Responsibilities

## Strategic Finance Leadership

• Serve as the primary finance advisor to the President and AmerCable leadership team.

• Provide financial leadership and commercial insight to support strategic business decisions.

• Influence business decisions through financial analysis, modeling, and actionable recommendations.

• Partner with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Procurement, and Human Resources leaders to improve business performance.

• Evaluate pricing initiatives, customer opportunities, product portfolio decisions, cost reduction programs, and growth investments.

• Identify risks and opportunities and recommend actions that drive profitability and cash flow improvement.

• Support the development and execution of strategic plans and growth initiatives.

• Foster accountability for financial and operational performance across the organization.

## Financial Performance Management

• Lead forecasting, annual budgeting, long-range planning, and monthly business performance reviews.

• Monitor key financial and operational metrics, including revenue, margins, EBITDA, inventory, working capital, cash flow, and capital expenditures.

• Improve forecast accuracy through robust analysis and proactive business engagement.

• Provide insights and recommendations that support achievement of business objectives.

## Finance Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and develop a geographically dispersed finance organization across Houston and El Dorado.

• Provide coaching, leadership, and performance management to the Accounting Manager and Plant Controller.

• Establish accountability while empowering team leaders to manage day-to-day operations.

• Align priorities, processes, and expectations across locations.

• Build a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership.

• Develop succession plans and strengthen finance capabilities across the organization.

## Controllership & Financial Stewardship

• Provide oversight of accounting, reporting, compliance, and internal control activities.

• Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.

• Review key accounting estimates, reserves, balance sheet positions, and financial reporting outputs.

• Maintain compliance with IFRS, corporate accounting policies, Delegation of Authority requirements, and regulatory obligations.

• Support internal and external audit activities and maintain a strong control environment.

## Manufacturing Finance & Working Capital Management

• Partner with plant leadership to improve operational performance and profitability.

• Oversee costing methodologies, inventory valuation, and manufacturing performance reporting.

• Support initiatives that improve productivity, cost efficiency, material utilization, and margin performance.

• Drive working capital optimization across inventory, receivables, payables, and cash conversion.

• Monitor performance against critical operational and financial metrics.

## Capital Investments & Strategic Initiatives

• Support evaluation of strategic investments and capital projects.

• Review business cases and expected financial returns for significant capital expenditures.

• Ensure appropriate governance over capital spending decisions.

• Participate in system implementations, process improvements, transformation initiatives, and acquisition integration activities.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. OverviewThe AppLogic Team builds core software for the Graykey platform, which Law Enforcement and Government Agencies use to extract data from mobile devices. The AppLogic UI is where examiners do that work. We're a small, senior, hands-on team, and this role leads frontend for it. You'll work alongside our UX Design Team, turn their work into an interface that's fast, reliable, and easy to build on, and set the structure and conventions the rest of the team follows. The UI is a mature, server-rendered application built with plain JavaScript and Jinja templates, with CI/CD and unit tests in place. Examiners use it every day, so the job is steady improvement in place: better structure, better performance, and better data, one change at a time. If you're looking to start fresh on a new framework, this probably isn't the right fit. NOTE: Candidate must reside in Canada. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

## Position Overview:

As our Manufacturing Engineer – Fuel Loading, you will coordinate with customers and suppliers, create SolidWorks designs, and support assembly and testing of electromechanical systems. You will also help develop advanced manufacturing technologies, prepare key documentation, and provide broad engineering support across prototype and production activities.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Manufacturing Engineer – Fuel Loading:

• Create design models and detailed drawings using Solidworks CAD software and other design methods.

• Provide engineering support involving assembly, testing, inspection, and qualification of mechanical components and systems.

• Lead and assist in the development and qualification of advanced manufacturing technologies.

• Support assembling prototype and production equipment.

• Write manufacturing/assembly plans, procedures, and instructions as well as assist with testing/qualification reports.

• Support engineering procurement efforts and control of tooling.

• Support Operations (hand tools, power tools, machining equipment, and automated equipment).

• Inspect and characterize components.

• Lead and coordinate activities with customers, internal and external suppliers, and other stakeholders.

• Provide other engineering and manufacturing support tasks as required.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor's degree in engineering (e.g. Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering other engineering related disciplines) is required.

• A minimum of four (4) year’s of experience in at least one of the following related fields: Tool Design, Prototype Design, or Manufacturing Engineering.

• Must be fluent in 3D modeling using Solidworks.

• Must be able to produce engineering and/or manufacturing drawings with familiarity in GD&T, material specifications, hardware standards, and weld callouts.

• Must have knowledge of product design, fabrication, assembly, tooling, and materials.

• Must be familiar with basic electrical components and how they must interface with mechanical systems.

• Must have general knowledge of project engineering activities (task plans, schedules, etc.).

• Must have hands-on manufacturing experience for industrial equipment and familiarity with both traditional and advanced manufacturing methods.

• Must have demonstrated ability to communicate with teams of technical people.

• Must have strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Must be able to effectively prepare and deliver technical reports and presentations.

• Must have knowledge of relevant codes and standards.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with manufacturing for nuclear reactor applications is desired but not required.

• Tool design specific to Nuclear Power Plants, particularly in: reactor disassembly/reassembly, component inspections and/or repairs, maintenance activities, refueling, or fuel loading.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Position Overview:

As a Security Access Control Specialist, you will manage and oversee all aspects of building access to ensure that personnel, contractors, and visitors are properly authenticated. You will maintain accurate access records, administer badges and credentials, and monitor system alerts for anomalies or unauthorized activity. You support compliance by validating access requests against approved authorization lists and clearance systems. Through consistent oversight and documentation, you help maintain a secure and well‑regulated facility environment.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Security Access Control Specialist:

• Serve as one of the primary points of contact for building access, providing professional support to employees, contractors, and visitors while ensuring all access policies are consistently followed.

• Assist the contractor security officers with verifying the identity, access credentials, and authorization levels of all individuals requesting entry, including visitors, vendors, and temporary personnel.

• Maintain and update electronic access control systems and databases, including visitor registration, badge issuance, access logs, and user profiles.

• Issue, track, and recover temporary badges, and other access credentials in accordance with established access governance procedures.

• Review and validate access requests against approved access lists, clearance databases, and authorization records (including systems such as DISS, NBIS, or CPCI when applicable).

• Monitor access control dashboards, system alerts, and badge activity reports to identify irregularities, unauthorized attempts, or system anomalies.

• Support periodic audits of access permissions, ensuring that employee, contractor, and vendor privileges reflect current job roles and security requirements.

• Process access changes by granting, modifying, or revoking permissions based on verified approvals from management or security leadership.

• Assist the Facility Security Officer (FSO) with conducting initial clearance briefs/debriefs.

• Conduct Facility Security Orientation Training.

• Process foreign travel requests for cleared employees in DISS and provide travel briefs.

• Maintain personnel files in SIMS.

• A high school diploma or equivalent is required.

• A minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience is required.

• Must exercise discretion in handling confidential information.

• Must demonstrate strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Position Overview:

As a Materials Engineer & Additive Manufacturing Lead, you will drive the development, characterization, and qualification of advanced materials for next‑generation nuclear systems. You will guide AM technology maturation, develop process innovations, and support the design, fabrication, and testing of components for terrestrial microreactors, radioisotope power systems, and space nuclear applications. This position is ideal for a research‑driven engineering leader who excels in materials R&D, AM process development, and strategic technology growth.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Materials Engineer & Additive Manufacturing Lead:

• Lead BWXT’s additive manufacturing initiatives, shaping strategy, technical direction, and business growth.

• Operate and optimize AM equipment to meet complex programmatic objectives.

• Support development of advanced material systems, including refractory metals and next‑generation nuclear fuel forms.

• Deliver innovative and economically impactful material solutions aligned with nuclear component design and manufacturing needs.

• Oversee material characterization efforts using SEM, XRD, rheology, impurity analysis, and furnace‑based evaluation techniques.

• Utilize material development metrics to drive continuous improvement.

• Conduct failure analysis and defect‑elimination for manufactured components.

• Prepare material performance specifications, process qualification documentation, and manufacturing guidance.

• Develop and refine process parameters for electron beam and laser powder bed fusion AM processes.

• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to leadership, including director‑ and executive‑level stakeholders.

• Collaborate with design, fabrication, and research teams to resolve challenges related to AM, machining, joining, processing, and fuel‑form manufacturing.

• Develop and maintain materials solutions that meet stringent thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and chemical requirements for nuclear systems.

• Manage research partnerships, supplier engagements, and vendor interactions to support technology maturation and project timelines.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of seven (7) years of relevant experience. An advanced degree may substitute for experience.

• Demonstrated technical leadership and experience managing complex engineering projects.

• Hands‑on experience with additive manufacturing, including LPBF/EBM process development and parameter optimization.

• Strong background in materials processing, testing, and characterization.

Come work with us!
Pleora is the leader in real-time connectivity for industrial automation, security & defense, and medical imaging applications with 25 years of expertise in vision applications with our growing global teams. Our hardware and software solutions are built for performance, enabling low-latency, real-time video and data transport in 1000's of unique systems.

Summary

Pleora is seeking a strategic, market-focused product leader to lead its Product Management organization and product portfolio.

Reporting to the Vice President of Product Marketing, this role is accountable for the overall effectiveness of Product Management, including customer discovery, market validation, portfolio strategy, roadmap development, technology partnership evaluation, commercialization, and product investment prioritization.

The Manager, Product Management leads Pleora's Product Management team and ensures product investments are aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, competitive differentiation, and business objectives. This role serves as the primary bridge between external customers and markets and internal Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Executive Leadership, translating market insight into product strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.

What You Do
Product Management Leadership

• Lead and develop the Product Management organization, establishing priorities, processes, best practices, and operating rhythms.

• Directly manage Product Managers and provide coaching in customer discovery, product validation, business case development, roadmap planning, and commercialization.

• Establish accountability for product performance, portfolio outcomes, customer adoption, and commercial success.

• Build a customer-focused Product Management culture that balances market opportunity, customer value, technical feasibility, and business outcomes.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

• Own portfolio strategy, product roadmap planning, and lifecycle management, including investment recommendations, roadmap prioritization, product introductions, and end-of-life decisions.

• Lead portfolio planning and rationalization activities, including recommendations on where Pleora should invest, expand, partner, maintain, or exit.

• Connect portfolio strategy, roadmap priorities, and commercialization activities to measurable business outcomes.

• Ensure product investments are grounded in customer discovery, validated market needs, competitive differentiation, and commercial viability.

• Define portfolio strategies that balance innovation, customer demand, technical feasibility, resource constraints, and return on investment.

• Monitor portfolio performance through customer adoption, design wins, pipeline contribution, revenue growth, and strategic market impact.

Customer Discovery & Market Validation

• Establish and lead repeatable customer discovery and product validation processes across the organization.

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, technology partners, industry experts, and key stakeholders.

• Develop and manage Voice of Customer programs that identify unmet market needs and validate product-market fit.

• Ensure customer and market requirements are effectively represented in portfolio planning and investment decisions.

• Translate customer insights into strategic product recommendations, business cases, and roadmap priorities.

Technology Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

• Identify, evaluate, and develop technology partnerships that strengthen Pleora's portfolio and competitive position.

• Assess build-versus-buy-versus-partner opportunities to accelerate time-to-market and expand market reach.

• Collaborate with partners to identify joint solution opportunities, ecosystem initiatives, and market expansion strategies.

• Develop business cases and recommendations for strategic partnerships, adjacent market opportunities, and future investments.

Commercialization & Go-to-Market

• Own product value propositions, market requirements, positioning strategy, and commercialization planning, while partnering with Marketing and Sales to execute successful go-to-market initiatives.

• Develop commercialization plans that align product investments with target markets, customer needs, and growth objectives.

• Partner with Marketing and Sales to execute product launches, sales enablement, and commercialization programs that drive market adoption and business growth.

Data-Driven Decision Making & AI Enablement

• Champion the practical use of AI-enabled tools and data-driven processes to improve market research, customer insight generation, competitive analysis, business case development, portfolio planning, and decision-making effectiveness.

• Foster an environment where Product Managers leverage modern tools and methodologies to improve productivity, quality of analysis, and speed of execution.

• Establish metrics and performance indicators that support evidence-based product and portfolio decisions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Drive alignment across Product Management, Engineering, Solution Architecture, Application Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Executive Leadership.

• Lead investment and prioritization discussions that balance customer needs, business objectives, technical realities, and resource constraints.

• Facilitate informed decision-making across stakeholders to ensure alignment on portfolio strategy, investment priorities, and roadmap direction.

• Build strong working relationships across the organization to accelerate execution and business results.

Industry Leadership

• Represent Pleora at industry conferences, trade shows, customer meetings, and partner engagements.

• Contribute to thought leadership through presentations, articles, webinars, and industry participation.

• Strengthen Pleora's visibility, influence, and strategic relationships within key markets and technology ecosystems.

• Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, market trends, competitive activity, and evolving customer requirements.

What You Need
Experience

• 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Product Marketing, or a related technology leadership role.

• 3+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and managing Product Managers or comparable professionals.

• Demonstrated success defining product strategy, portfolio roadmaps, and investment priorities for B2B technology products.

• Proven experience conducting customer discovery, market validation, and Voice of Customer initiatives.

• Experience developing business cases, evaluating market opportunities, and guiding product investment decisions.

• Demonstrated experience owning product positioning, value propositions, messaging, commercialization strategies, and launch planning.

• Proven ability to bring technology products to market through commercialization, go-to-market execution, product launches, and sales enablement.

• Experience working closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership in a cross-functional environment.

• Experience in machine vision, industrial automation, embedded systems, defence, medical imaging, networking, semiconductor, or related technology markets is a strong asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic thinking and portfolio management capabilities.

• Deep understanding of Product Management disciplines, including customer discovery, market validation, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and lifecycle management.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market insights, and technical capabilities into compelling product strategies and business outcomes.

• Strong commercial acumen, including pricing, positioning, value proposition development, commercialization planning, and go-to-market execution.

• Excellent analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance customer value, market opportunity, technical feasibility, and business return.

• Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

• Ability to align and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Strong business case development, financial analysis, and investment prioritization capabilities.

• Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools and data-driven processes to improve decision-making, analysis, and productivity.

Education

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.

• MBA or equivalent business and leadership experience is considered an asset.

What Does Success Look Like in 12 Months?

A successful candidate will:

• Build a high-performing Product Management organization with clear accountability, ownership, and execution discipline.

• Establish a repeatable customer discovery and product validation framework that is consistently applied across the portfolio.

• Deliver a prioritized, customer-validated roadmap aligned with Pleora's strategic growth objectives.

• Improve portfolio focus through clear investment, expansion, partnership, maintenance, and end-of-life recommendations.

• Strengthen relationships with customers, technology partners, and industry stakeholders, resulting in improved market insight and product relevance.

• Improve the quality and speed of business case development, portfolio decisions, and roadmap prioritization through data-driven processes and effective use of AI-enabled tools.

• Deliver measurable improvements in customer adoption, design wins, pipeline contribution, commercialization effectiveness, and business growth.

• Establish Product Management as a trusted strategic partner to Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership.

Leadership Characteristics
Strategic & Market Focused

• Connect customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives to product investment decisions.

• Anticipate market shifts, technology trends, and emerging growth opportunities.

• Balance short-term execution priorities with long-term portfolio strategy.

Business-Oriented Decision Maker

• Evaluate opportunities using customer value, market attractiveness, technical feasibility, competitive differentiation, and commercial return.

• Make recommendations based on customer insight, data, evidence, and business impact.

• Balance innovation, profitability, and execution capacity when making investment decisions.

Customer-Centric Product Leader

• Demonstrate a deep commitment to understanding customer problems before proposing solutions.

• Promote discovery, validation, and continuous market learning as core Product Management disciplines.

• Ensure products are built around real customer needs and measurable business value.

Collaborative Influencer

• Build alignment across Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership.

• Influence decisions and unite stakeholders around strategic priorities.

• Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and trust across teams.

Coach & Team Builder

• Develop Product Managers into stronger strategic, market-driven, and customer-focused leaders.

• Promote accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and professional growth.

• Build a culture of curiosity, market awareness, customer focus, and business-oriented thinking.

Technology-to-Market Leader

• Translate complex technologies into compelling customer value and business outcomes.

• Communicate effectively with customers, partners, executive leaders, and technical teams.

• Connect innovation, portfolio strategy, commercialization, and growth into a unified business vision.

Why work at Pleora?

• We trust our team - you bring the expertise and drive, we give you the freedom to explore and innovate

• Excellent work-life balance - and we mean it!

• We offer a diverse and inclusive workplace, in a fast-paced environment without "red tape" - giving you the opportunity to contribute your ideas and make a real contribution to our success

• Pleora provides a wide range of employee wellbeing initiatives which include:

• $100 annual "healthy living" reimbursement

• Comprehensive benefits plan (medical, dental, HCSA, etc.)

• Employee assistance program

• We offer competitive vacation, pay, and benefits such as:
• Competitive market salary

• Annual company performance bonus

• RRSP contribution matching

• Employee recognition programs

• Referral program for new hires

How you'll be rewarded

Salary Range: $130,000 - $160,000 (commensurate with experience)

We are currently hiring for this position to fill a newly created position.

At Pleora we are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We seek to recruit the best and most talented people for the job and will provide reasonable accommodation to persons with disabilities to allow you to participate in the recruitment process, upon request.

## ## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## ## Job Information

Job Code: 00101655

Job Family: Manufacturing

Job Function: Supply Chain

## ## About the Role

We are seeking a data-driven Supply Chain Analyst to serve as the analytical engine for our global S&OP process. This role bridges the gap between our supply chain systems and our planning team. Your primary objective is to drive cross-functional alignment between demand, supply, inventory, and financial plans. By managing system governance, inventory performance, and metric-based analysis, you will enable our demand and supply planners to focus on their core priorities: forecast improvement, inventory optimization, and strategic supply planning decisions.

## ## About the Responsibilities

• Cross-Functional Alignment & Strategic Enablement: Act as the "glue" between demand, supply, inventory, and finance teams to ensure all planning inputs are synchronized. Protect planner bandwidth by managing process governance and data reconciliation.
• Inventory Performance & Corrective Action: Monitor inventory performance (Turns, DOH (days on hand), Safety Stock, Excess & Obsolete Inventory) to identify risks and opportunities. Implement and track corrective actions to ensure inventory targets are met and reconciled against financial budgets.
• Performance Coaching & S&OP (Sale and Operations Planning or IBP Integrated Business Planning) Support: Partner with leadership to produce the monthly S&OP review, ensuring data accuracy and coherent executive summaries. Provide direct, metric-based guidance to demand planners to help them lead effective S&OP meetings with Product Management.
• Systems Oversight & Data Governance: Act as the primary point of contact for system health (Kinaxis/Apolo (Avaya Internal tool), SAP IBP, Blue Yonder IBP, Xelus). Monitor batch jobs and data integrity; coordinate and escalate issues with internal admin teams. Execute and maintain information related to NPI and End-of-Life (EOL) processes.
• Forecast Performance Analytics & BI: Monitor and communicate performance metrics (wMAPE (weighted Mean absolute percent error), Forecast Accuracy, Bias). Utilize Google Workspace (Looker Studio, Google Sheets (Microsoft Excel) and SQL to build and maintain Executive KPI dashboards (Power BI, Tableau)and translate raw data into actionable insights.

## ## About the Qualifications

• Experience: 3–5 years in global supply chain planning and business intelligence.
• Technical: Medium -Medium-Advanced proficiency in SQL/Python and Google Workspace tools (Looker Studio/Google Sheets). Ability to perform data modeling. Kinaxis experience is a strong plus; we are willing to train.
• Analytical Skills: Expert-level understanding of forecast metrics (wMAPE, Forecast Accuracy, Bias) and statistical/ML-based planning models is a plus.
• Operational Mindset: Strong governance mindset; ability to drive accountability and provide data-backed coaching without direct authority.

## ## Experience

3 - 6 Years of Experience

## ## Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

## ## Footer

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a dynamic team environment where integrity and passion drive operational excellence, AmerCable is the place for you!

AmerCable is an ISO 9001:2015-certified manufacturer of jacketed electrical power, control and instrumentation cables. The company’s core markets, mining, oil and gas, and industrial, require complex cable designs that can operate reliably over long periods of time in harsh operating environments.

As a customer-focused company, AmerCable’s top priority is to help its customers be more productive and profitable with high-quality cable products and services, fast reliable delivery, field engineering support and outstanding customer service.
All cable products are made in El Dorado, Arkansas or Katy, Texas.

## Impact of this Role

As a Jacket Operator, you play a key role in the manufacturing process by operating equipment that applies tubing material to cable products according to production requirements. Your work helps ensure cable orders are completed accurately, safely, and in accordance with established standards.

## What Success Looks Like

• Operate jacketing equipment to apply the correct tubing material to cable products.

• Follow all specifications and requirements outlined in production routers.

• Complete cable orders accurately and efficiently.

About Giatec Scientific

Giatec Scientific Inc. is a global leader in smart concrete testing technologies, bringing real-time data, AI, and IoT solutions to jobsites worldwide. Our core products – SmartRock®, SmartMix®, and MixPilot® – support the full concrete lifecycle, from mix design and production to placement and performance monitoring, helping teams improve quality, efficiency, and sustainability while reducing concrete’s carbon footprint.

SmartMix (AI-driven concrete mix optimization) and MixPilot (in-transit slump sensing technology) are transforming how ready-mix concrete producers optimize operations, reduce waste, and improve quality. We’re headquartered in Ottawa with a growing North American sales organization.

At Giatec, we value innovation, creativity, agility, and integrity. We’re committed to creating a culture of openness and teamwork in which our employees can thrive and leverage their skills, all while making the world a smarter place to live in.

The Role

We’re seeking a Senior Business Development Executive to join our RMC Solutions team as a hunter and technical discovery expert. This is a sophisticated, relationship-driven role that bridges business development and consultative sales. You’ll take ownership of territory expansion, prospecting ready-mix concrete producers across North America, conducting deep discovery conversations about their operations and technology stack, and building the credible network that drives pipeline and long-term customer success.

This role differs from a typical BDR: you’ll focus on discovery quality and market expertise over activity volume, book your own meetings, conduct qualification and sometimes demos, and only hand off opportunities that are ready for Account Executives to close. You’ll be a source of valuable market insights and thought leadership.

Compensation: The expected salary range for this role is $80,000 – $90,000.

What You’ll Do

• Identify and prospect new target accounts within assigned territories; execute outbound campaigns to open doors with decision-makers

• Build strong relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders at ready-mix concrete producers

• Conduct structured discovery conversations to deeply understand customer pain points across mix design, batching, dispatch, in-transit monitoring, fleet management, and quality workflows

• Assess fit and identify whether Giatec’s products or partner solutions align with customer needs and technology stacks

• Book and execute your own discovery/qualification meetings and demos, handing off only when opportunities are qualified and ready

• Own high-quality Salesforce documentation at both account and opportunity levels, capturing critical qualification data and insights

• Develop and maintain deep expertise on ready-mix operations and Giatec solutions; build credible thought leadership in your market

• Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Solutions, and Marketing teams to validate technical feasibility and align on customer insights

• Generate monthly market reports and contribute market insights to social, newsletter, and other thought leadership channels

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in business development, solution selling, or customer-facing roles in construction tech, software, or concrete production

• Strong understanding of ready-mix concrete operations (mix design, batching, dispatch, in-transit monitoring, fleet management) or demonstrated ability to learn technical domains quickly

• Proven track record with outbound prospecting and consultative discovery; comfort making cold calls and opening doors

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with technical, operational, and executive audiences

• Proficiency with CRM systems, particularly Salesforce, and discipline in maintaining accurate documentation

• Self-motivated problem-solver; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships and multiple engagements simultaneously

• Comfort with technical products; ability to speak intelligently about solutions and evaluate customer fit

• North American availability (remote-friendly, with occasional team collaboration and customer travel)

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience in ready-mix concrete operations or concrete production workflows

• Experience with consultative/solutions selling methodologies (MEDDIC, SPIN, value-based selling)

• Track record of generating high-quality discovery documentation and insights from customer interactions

• Experience with social media, content creation, or thought leadership communications

• Appetite to grow into a full sales/account management role (this position can be a stepping stone for high performers)

What Success Looks Like

• Building a large, credible network of contacts in the RMC industry and maintaining relationships through consistent engagement

• Generating high-quality discovery documentation at both account and opportunity level in Salesforce

• Generating a steady stream of well-qualified, ready-to-close opportunities for Account Executives

• Developing expert-level knowledge in Concrete Construction, Concrete In-Transit, and Concrete Materials within one year

• Contributing valuable market insights through monthly market reports, social posts, newsletters, and other thought leadership channels

Why Join Giatec?

You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, creativity, and integrity. We’re committed to developing people and building a culture of openness and collaboration. You’ll have:

• Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives tied to opportunity quality and conversion

• Opportunity to own territory expansion and become the market expert for your region

• Direct mentorship and close partnership with an experienced sales manager who invests in your growth

• Work with cutting-edge AI-powered products solving real problems in the $30B+ concrete construction market

• Comprehensive onboarding, product training, and industry certifications to build expertise

• Flexible, remote-friendly work environment with a collaborative team culture

• Clear growth trajectory: many of our Account Executives started in Business Development Executive roles

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your relevant experience with outbound prospecting, consultative discovery, and business development. Include examples of how you’ve opened doors with new accounts, built strong stakeholder relationships, and generated quality pipeline from scratch. We review applications on a rolling basis.

AI-enabled tools may be used to support parts of the recruitment and screening process.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth, collaboration, and technical excellence. At our Oak Ridge, Tennessee Enrichment Operations site, you will join teams working at the forefront of advanced nuclear manufacturing, precision engineering, and mission‑critical national security programs. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you’ll find opportunities to challenge yourself, partner with seasoned experts, and contribute to innovation shaping the future of nuclear technology. Our work requires a wide range of skills, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who share a passion for meaningful impact and technical advancement.

Position Overview
As our Mechanical Engineer for Test Stands & Processes, you will support engineering and manufacturing efforts associated with the BWXT portion of the DUECE centrifuge program. You will design, develop, and integrate mechanical test stands, process equipment, and mechanical systems used for assembly, testing, and verification of enrichment centrifuges. This role spans concept development through fabrication, installation, operation, and documentation within a DOE/NNSA high-security environment.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee (Q Clearance Required)

Your Day to Day as a Mechanical Engineer – Test Stands & Processes
• Collaborate with engineering teams to design mechanical test stands and unique process equipment.
• Use SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and PDMLink to design and model mechanical systems, fixtures, and tooling.
• Develop functional and interface requirements for new designs.
• Analyze, test, and integrate mechanical components to meet system requirements.
• Evaluate designs for cost, performance, reliability, safety, and compliance.
• Create controlled engineering documentation including P\&IDs, hazard analyses, design packages, and test records.
• Conduct calculations including statics, dynamics, thermal, fluid, and strength analyses.
• Prepare BOMs, part specifications, and procurement packages.
• Lead fabrication, assembly, and integration of mechanical systems.
• Plan and execute component, subsystem, and system testing.
• Author statements of work, reports, and project updates.
• Support schedules, cost tracking, and compliance processes.
• Troubleshoot installation discrepancies and support commissioning activities.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and cross-functional development.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
• Minimum 3 years of mechanical design, test stand development, or industrial equipment experience.
• Proficiency with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and PDMLink.
• Knowledge of statics, dynamics, heat transfer, fluids, and strength analysis.
• Ability to use hand tools, metrology devices, and diagnostic instruments.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
• Ability to interpret mechanical drawings and technical documentation.
• Strong communication and documentation skills.
• Ability to travel up to 10%.
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with new product development or Stage-Gate processes.
• Experience in sensor design, industrial equipment, or thermal systems.
• Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP.
• Experience with DFSS, DFM, requirements decomposition, or safety-driven design.
• Professional certifications (FE, EIT, PE).
• Experience with thermo-mechanical test systems and reliability equipment.
• Experience with CAD best practices, GD\&T, and tolerance analysis.
• Experience with modal analysis, FEA, or dynamic testing.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits.
• Flexible schedules and paid time off (as applicable).
• Professional development and mentorship.
• Inclusive, collaborative culture.
• Mission-driven work that supports national security.
• Continuous technical learning opportunities.

## Position Overview:

As our Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of design, analysis, and prototyping activities for new nuclear systems through testing, documentation review, and oversight.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Quality Assurance Engineer:

• Monitor design and analysis activities of new nuclear systems for compliance with customer, regulatory, and BWXT requirements.

• Provide oversight and support of development, testing, and prototype activities.

• Conduct reviews of engineering documents, drawings, plans, and software to ensure that applicable quality requirements are met.

• Assist with and review disposition of nonconformances.

Position Overview
As our Mechanical Engineer for High-Speed Machinery, you will own the design, development, analysis, and execution of critical rotating subsystems for the BWXT portion of the DUECE centrifuge program. You will work closely with rotodynamic engineers, composites specialists, analysts, and manufacturing teams to deliver high-speed rotating machinery supporting mission-critical nuclear enrichment operations.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee (Q Clearance Required)

• Lead mechanical design and development for high-speed rotating systems.
• Evaluate rotodynamics including critical speeds, Campbell diagrams, frequency response, and stability.
• Coordinate interface design and stiffness modeling with composites teams.
• Perform complex FEA including transient, nonlinear, gyroscopic, and thermal-mechanical simulations.
• Develop models predicting rotor/casing growth, interference fits, and fatigue behavior.
• Produce engineering documentation including design reports and analysis packages.
• Support prototype builds, hardware testing, and correlation with analysis predictions.
• Collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve mechanical issues.
• Drive full lifecycle ownership of rotating hardware.
• Participate in gated reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR).
• Ensure compliance with engineering standards and DOE/NNSA requirements.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Physics (BS + 10 yrs, or MS + 5 yrs).
• Experience with turbomachinery, turbines, compressors, electric motor rotors, or gearboxes.
• Proficiency with Abaqus, ANSYS, or NASTRAN for FEA.
• Experience with Campbell diagrams, critical speed analysis, and gyroscopic models.
• Knowledge of rotor dynamics phenomena and prediction techniques.
• Understanding of thermal-structural coupling and rotor/casing growth.
• Strong documentation and communication skills.
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• MS in Mechanical Engineering with emphasis in dynamics/vibration.
• Aerospace, defense, or turbomachinery experience.
• Background with bearings, rotordynamics, and reliability engineering.
• HPC experience for large analysis workloads.
• Scripting in Python, MATLAB, or APDL.
• Experience correlating FEA predictions to test data.
• Familiarity with ASME Y14.5 GD\&T.
• Experience with 1D fluid-network tools and rotating component design.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits.
• Flexible schedules and PTO (as applicable).
• Professional development opportunities.
• Inclusive and collaborative culture.
• Mission-driven work tied to national security.
• Continuous learning in high-speed machinery engineering.

You will support R\&D through manufacturing execution, ensuring metallic systems meet stability, performance, reliability, and throughput requirements. This role integrates materials science with mechanical, manufacturing, and design engineering in a DOE/NNSA environment.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee (Q Clearance Required)

• Perform failure analysis, root cause investigations, and materials/process improvements.

• Experience with SEM, TEM, XRD, EDS, DSC, and metallographic tools.
• Demonstrated ability to tailor alloy chemistry and optimize processes.
• Experience with process controls and variability reduction.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and documentation.
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Thermo‑Calc, CALPHAD, or JMatPro.
• Background in thermomechanical processing.
• Familiarity with titanium, nickel-based superalloys, aluminum, or high-temperature materials.
• Experience in aerospace, defense, or energy materials programs.
• Six Sigma or PFMEA/statistical process control experience.
• Experience with Minitab or related data tools.
• Hands-on experience with casting tooling, forming dies, or flow-forming equipment.

• Competitive salary and benefits.
• Paid time off and flexible schedules (as applicable).
• Professional development and continuing education support.
• Inclusive and collaborative workplace.
• Mission-driven work supporting national security.
• Continuous technical and materials engineering growth opportunities.

## Position Overview:

BWXT Advanced Technologies is seeking a Mechanical System Design Engineer. This position is focused on system design, not detailed component design, and will report administratively to the Mechanical System Design Supervisor. The System Design Engineering group supports programs for internal and external customers across Advanced Manufacturing, Medical Radioisotopes, and Nuclear Reactor Design.

## Location:

This position is based on-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a Mechanical System Design Engineer:

• Identify relevant system requirements and interface requirements then prepare appropriate system design documentation such as system design descriptions and control narratives.

• Select components (e.g., valves, heat exchangers), perform calculations, and prepare specifications for their detailed design and procurement.

• Design piping systems including line sizing and pressure drop calculations.

• Lead the creation of appropriate output documentation such as process flow diagrams, P&IDs, component data sheets and system test request documentation.

• Utilize appropriate regulations, design codes and standards (e.g., ASME) for fluid systems.

• Coordinate with other interfacing disciplines such as systems engineers, electrical engineers, I&C engineers, mechanical equipment designers, and test engineers.

• Prepare and present system design results to internal and external stakeholders.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, nuclear, or similar discipline) or physics is required.

• A minimum of four (4) years of related work experience is required.

• Must possess a technical background in engineering design, fluid systems, thermodynamics, and process instrumentation.

• Must be proficient with standard Microsoft Office applications.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Must possess the ability to self-direct with minimal day-to-day supervision.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with the design and/or operation of thermo-mechanical fluid systems for nuclear applications.

• Experience with fluid system design and modeling software, such as AFT Arrow/Fathom, FlowMaster, Flownex, or comparable tools.

• Experience with CAD packages, such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD.

• Programming experience with Python, C++, Fortran, Visual Basic, or similar.

• Experience with design verification including interface with component vendors and test engineering organizations.

• System modeling experience in Simulink and exposure to Sysml.

• Familiarity with NRC and/or DOE requirements.

• Knowledge and experience in the application of Systems Engineering principles.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Regional Sales Manager, US West

Location: Remote, based in Arizona or Oregon
Territory Coverage: Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Nevada, California, Utah, and Arizona
Travel: Up to 50%

## Impact of this Role

As Regional Sales Manager, you will influence the profitable growth of Mattr’s DSG-Canusa business across the Western United States. You will build demand with OEMs and end users, strengthen the company’s distribution and sales-agent network, and help customers identify technical solutions that meet their requirements.

Working across Engineering, Customer Service, Operations, Marketing, and Accounting, you will connect customer and market needs with Mattr’s broader commercial strategy. Your decisions involving pricing, margins, delivery, and channel management will directly affect customer relationships, market credibility, and divisional profitability.

## What Success Looks Like

• Develop and execute a regional sales plan that drives profitable growth across Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Nevada, California, Utah, and Arizona.

• Build strong relationships with OEMs, end users, distributors, engineering firms, and sales agents through customer visits, meetings, technical presentations, telephone, and email.

• Generate demand for DSG-Canusa products by targeting new customers, applications, markets, and end-use specifications.

• Develop and manage an effective channel strategy through distributor training, joint customer visits, agent support, and coordinated targeting with the Inside Sales team.

• Manage opportunities from qualification through quotation and order fulfillment while making sound pricing and margin recommendations in accordance with the established approval matrix.

• Monitor sales, bookings, margins, budgets, customer activity, specifications, and agent performance through accurate contact records and monthly reporting.

• Maintain a strong presence in the territory by participating in industry committees, attending trade shows and industry events, and developing professional networks.

• Provide market intelligence on competitive activity, industry trends, new entrants, customer needs, market size, and new product opportunities.

• Collaborate with product managers and senior management to support strategic direction and adjust regional strategies as market conditions evolve.

## What You Bring to the Role

• A bachelor’s degree preferred.

• One or more years of sales or marketing experience in heat-shrinkable tubing, wire and cable, electrical, or electronics.

• Experience with technical selling and channel management concepts.

• The ability to develop relationships with customers, distributors, engineering firms, agents, and internal teams.

• Commercial judgment related to pricing, margins, quotations, distribution, and customer requirements.

• The ability to manage multiple opportunities and projects from qualification through order fulfillment.

• Strong recordkeeping and reporting practices, including maintaining customer profiles and contact information.

• Willingness and flexibility to travel up to 50%.

## Why Join Mattr

• Medical, dental and vision coverage with HSA contributions

• 401(k) with company match, vested immediately

• Attractive incentive bonus plans

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D and Long-Term Disability insurance

• Wellness incentives

• Free Employee Assistance Program

• Discounts on fitness, shopping and travel through Blue365, LifeMart and more

WHAT MATTR OFFERS
• At Mattr, safety comes first! We go the extra mile to ensure our employees are safe and healthy
• We understand times have changed and so have we. Mattr offers flexible work arrangements (where possible) to suit your needs
• Comprehensive total rewards package that includes competitive salaries, annual incentives, medical benefits, retirement savings plans, paid vacation days, education assistance programs, corporate discounts and more!
• Participation in service milestone awards and recognition opportunities
• Access to mental health support resources such as our Headversity mental health and wellness platform and free, confidential access to our Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
• Rewarding growth opportunities (may include global career and travel opportunities) supported by personalized training, development and mentoring programs - including LinkedIn Learning access for all employees!
• Commitment to providing a diverse, inclusive and accessible workplace environment
• We prioritize our Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) values and offer a paid Impact Day, allowing employees an opportunity to support charitable organizations in their communities

• We’re working to create a better world. Join us!

We want you to join our team!

Aperçu du poste

Calian Antenna Solutions, située à Vaudreuil-Dorion (Québec), conçoit et fabrique une vaste gamme de systèmes d'antennes de grande précision destinés aux communications par satellite, à la radioastronomie, aux applications scientifiques et au secteur de la défense.

CareersInnerInfo
Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un Ingénieur principal en conception mécanique. Le candidat retenu dirigera la conception, l'analyse, le développement, la production, la maintenance et l'amélioration de grands systèmes d'antennes. Les projets comprendront notamment la conception et l'analyse de grandes structures mécano-soudées en acier, le dimensionnement et la conception de systèmes d'entraînement, ainsi que la conception de mécanismes de précision plus complexes.

Responsabilités

• Diriger la conception mécanique et structurale à l'aide de logiciels de modélisation 3D.

• Effectuer des analyses structurales à l'aide de la méthode des éléments finis et de calculs classiques.

• Valider et sélectionner les systèmes d'entraînement mécanique.

• Sélectionner les matériaux et les composants mécaniques appropriés.

• Produire des dessins détaillés de pièces et d'assemblages ainsi que les procédures associées.

• Définir les méthodes et procédures de protection contre la corrosion.

• Analyser et vérifier les déformations de la structure des antennes.

• Assurer la liaison technique avec les équipes d'approvisionnement, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Fournir un soutien à l'équipe d'intégration des antennes.

Au sein de l'équipe d'ingénierie, vous aurez également à :

• Soutenir la préparation des propositions de projets et des estimations.

• Diriger des projets de recherche et développement (R-D).

• Interagir avec les clients.

• Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes au niveau des systèmes, qu'ils soient ou non liés à la conception mécanique.

• Préparer et présenter des revues de conception.

• Effectuer occasionnellement des déplacements chez des clients aux États-Unis et à l'international.

Autres tâches connexes selon les besoins du poste.

## Qualifications

• Diplôme universitaire en génie mécanique.

• Excellente maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO (SolidWorks de préférence).

• Minimum de 5 à 7 ans d'expérience avec divers procédés de fabrication (usinage, soudage, tôlerie, matériaux composites, etc.).

• Capacité à produire des dessins de fabrication détaillés, précis et faciles à interpréter.

• Aptitude à mener un projet de conception de l'étape de conception jusqu'à la mise en production, incluant la collaboration avec les équipes d'approvisionnement et la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

• Excellentes aptitudes en analyse, planification et résolution de problèmes.

• Maîtrise de la production de documentation technique.

• Être autorisé à travailler au Canada et être en mesure de satisfaire aux exigences d'une vérification de sécurité.

• Très bonnes compétences en communication en anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Atouts

• Expérience dans la conception de grandes structures mécaniques.

• Connaissance des servomoteurs et de leurs systèmes d'entraînement.

• Expérience en analyse par éléments finis (FEA).

• Familiarité avec diverses techniques d'inspection et de mesure.

• Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) constitue un atout; toutefois, la maîtrise de l'anglais est requise. Le candidat retenu devra communiquer régulièrement avec des clients et des intervenants internes situés à l'extérieur du Québec et de l'Ontario, ailleurs au Canada et à l'international. À titre d'organisation mondiale, la capacité de communiquer efficacement en anglais est essentielle afin de soutenir la collaboration, les relations avec les clients et la réalisation des projets.

Exigences supplémentaires

• Doit être admissible à l'obtention d'une cote de sécurité du gouvernement du Canada.

• Doit être en mesure de travailler à partir de notre bureau de Vaudreuil-Dorion.

• Peut être appelé à effectuer occasionnellement des déplacements au Canada et à l'international afin de soutenir les besoins opérationnels et les projets de l'entreprise.

Rémunération

120 000 $ à 140 000 $ par année, plus des incitatifs basés sur la performance.

## Position Overview

Calian Antenna Solutions, located in Vaudreuil-Dorion, QC, designs and manufactures a wide range of large precision antenna systems for satellite communications, radio astronomy, science and defense applications.

We are currently seeking a candidate for the position of Senior Mechanical Design Engineer. The successful candidate will lead the design, analysis, development, production, maintenance and upgrades of large antenna systems. Projects will include everything from large steel weldment design and analysis, drivetrain sizing and design, and small intricate mechanisms.

## Responsibilities

• Lead the mechanical and structural design using 3D modeling software

• Structural analysis using finite element modeling and classical calculations

• Drivetrain design validation and selection

• Selection of materials and mechanical components

• Producing detailed part and assembly drawings and procedures

• Defining corrosion protection methods and procedures

• Analysis and verification of antenna shape deformation.

• Engineering liaison with procurement, suppliers and subcontractors.

• Providing support to the antenna integration team

As part of the Engineering team you will:

• Support project proposals and estimation.

• Lead R&D projects

• Interface with customers

• Debug system level problems that may or may not be rooted in mechanical design.

• Preparation and presentation of design reviews.

• Occasional travel to customer sites in the US and International

Other duties as required within the context of the role.

## Qualifications

• Degree in Mechanical engineering

• Mastery of CAD software (Solidworks preferred).

• At least 5-7 years experience with a variety of manufacturing methods (machining, welding, sheet metal, composite, etc.)

• Capable of producing clear and detailed manufacturing drawings

• Able to take designs from the computer all the way to the production floor, including interfacing with procurement and the supply chain

• Good analytical, planning and problem-solving skills

• Proficiency with technical documentation production.

• Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada and be able to pass a security check.

• Very good communication skills in English, both verbal and written

Assets

• Experience with the design of large mechanical structure

• Knowledge of servo motors and drives

• Experience with Finite Element Analysis

• Familiar with various inspection and measurement techniques

• Bilingual in English and French is an asset, English is required. The successful candidate will regularly communicate with clients and internal stakeholders located outside of Quebec and Ontario, across Canada and internationally. As a global organization, the ability to communicate effectively in the English language is essential to supporting collaboration, client relationships, and project delivery.

## Additional Requirements

• Must be eligible for government of Canada Security Clearence

• Must be able to work out of our Vaudreuil-Dorion office

• May be required to travel occasionally within Canada and internationally, as required to support business and project needs.

Compensation

$120,000-$140,000 per annum plus performance based incentives.

We have 1 position available.

The Director, Defence Marketing translates Defence business priorities, customer requirements, and Calian's capabilities into compelling market positioning, differentiated narratives, and integrated campaigns that support growth.

This role requires a strong understanding of the defence market, customer environment, competitive landscape, procurement processes, and emerging technologies. The successful candidate will help position Calian as a relevant, differentiated, and trusted defence partner while bringing together expertise across the organization to support coordinated market engagement and business growth.

• Support Defence growth and business planning by aligning marketing priorities and investments with customer needs, strategic pursuits, government engagement, and business development objectives.

• Define and evolve market positioning, value propositions, customer narratives, and messaging across Defence capabilities, technologies, and solutions.

• Maintain a strong understanding of defence policy, customer priorities, modernization programs, procurement environments, and emerging opportunities.

• Identify priority markets, customer segments, and key stakeholder audiences across military, government, industry, and partner ecosystems.

• Lead market and competitive intelligence activities and translate insights into actionable growth strategies.

• Develop integrated campaigns supporting priority Defence growth areas, strategic pursuits, technologies, and solutions.

• Partner with Business Development and Capture teams to support priority opportunities through messaging, positioning, customer insights, and market engagement.

• Collaborate closely with Government Relations to ensure coordinated customer communications, industry engagement, and market positioning.

• Build strong relationships with technical, operational, and military subject matter experts and elevate their expertise through campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement, and events.

• Oversee the development of customer-facing materials that support the full customer journey, from awareness through post-award engagement.

• Develop thought leadership programs that strengthen Calian's market position and demonstrate expertise in the evolving defence environment.

• Lead marketing strategies for key defence trade shows, conferences, demonstrations, customer engagements, and industry events.
