## Solutions Architect

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
We are currently seeking a Solution Architect to join the Financial Market & Banking Operations (FMBO) Portfolio in the Information Technology Services (ITS) Department.

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Banking Operations you will work closely with Scrum Teams to lead the development of Banking Operation technical solution architectures for various projects within the Portfolio. You are accountable for creating architectures for the development and integration of business and information systems to enable streamlined application interfaces, improved application redundancy, efficient distribution of data and improve service reliability in support of business objectives. You ensure that the integration of services, data flow and infrastructure architectures meet evolving business and operational requirements as well as standards for reliability, scalability and availability.

As a member of the Bank of Canada ITS architecture community, you will also work alongside other Solutions Architects and the information technology community to help review and critique other initiative solutions to ensure they are closely aligned with the Bank’s road maps and best practices.

More specifically you will :

• Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, and cloud-enabled solution architectures across all phases of the project lifecycle.

• Serve as the technical authority for architecture initiatives, providing strategic direction, governance, and oversight of solution design and implementation.

• Identify technical risks, security vulnerabilities, and architectural challenges, and define appropriate mitigation strategies.

• Assess current-state environments to identify modernization, simplification, and cloud migration opportunities.

• Define and promote architecture standards, technology roadmaps, and best practices, including the evaluation and selection of platforms, tools, and infrastructure components.

• Research emerging technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions that enhance operational efficiency, security, and business outcomes.

• Provide expert guidance in the resolution of complex application, infrastructure, and operational issues.

• Drive operational excellence through automation, infrastructure-as-code, and the adoption of DevSecOps practices and tooling.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines leveraging Azure DevOps, GitHub Advanced Security, and Nexus to support secure code integration, automated testing, vulnerability management, and deployment automation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security, compliance, and reliability requirements into solution architecture and software delivery processes.

What you need to succeed
As an experienced Solutions Architect, you are a self-starter with the ability to quickly grasp the essence of complex issues. You are an effective communicator, able to clearly convey key points, organize content, and write in a style appropriate to the audience and purpose of the document and presentation. You can quickly grasp the essence of a complex issue and communicate key points. You are self-motivated and independent, requiring little supervision and with the ability to function effectively as part of a team. You will contribute towards creating positive team dynamics by engaging in productive and respectful conversations, dealing with conflict in a timely way, helping team members who may be struggling and having a positive attitude towards the team's goals.

## Nice-to-have

• exposure to diverse work environments, with a broad understanding of multiple business sectors, hardware and software technologies and IT security

• recognized IT industry certification such as TOGAF, Zachman, ITIL and project-management certification

• knowledge of:
• CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Nexus, Jenkins, Tekton, Argo CD, Azure Container Registry, and Azure DevOps[MK1.1]

• Cloud Environment and implementation

• Leading vendor platforms, such as RedHat, Cisco, Oracle, Microsoft and IBM

• Enterprise Java applications

Your education and experience
This position requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, along with a minimum of five years of experience in a solutions architect role within organizations of 200 or more employees utilizing various high-availability solutions, is required. Additionally, candidates should have at least five years of relevant hands-on experience with the Bank’s Infrastructure or Cyber Platforms. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $126,765 to $149,135 (job grade 18)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health and dental coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Welcome to BWXT

BWXT is seeking a Radiochemistry Data Specialist that will be responsible for supporting the Nuclear Operations Group - Technologies (NOG-T) at the Lynchburg Technology Center in Lynchburg, VA. This facility operates several radioactive facilities including a failure analysis laboratory, mechanical testing laboratory, machine shop, radiochemistry laboratory, nuclear counting laboratory, metals analysis laboratory, and four fuel-handling hot cells.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

Position Overview:
As our Radiochemistry Data Specialist will perform data reduction, review and validate datasets generated from environmental and high activity samples.

## Location:

The position will be in the Lynchburg, VA Nuclear Operations Group Technologies office.

## Your Day to Day as a Radiochemistry Data Specialist:

• Organize raw instrument data and bench notes.

• Collaborate with radiochemists and lab technicians to ensure accurate data collection and processing.

• Perform radiochemistry data reduction (e.g. gamma spectroscopy, gross alpha/beta, liquid scintillation, alpha spectroscopy) using Excel based spreadsheets and other programs.

• Maintain and update quality control charts.

• Prepare technical reports and summaries for internal and external customers.

• Support laboratory audits and inspections.

## Required Qualifications:

• A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in chemistry or a related science is required.

• A minimum of six (6) years of experience in radiochemistry is required.

• Must have strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to adapt to the demands of a specialty lab setting.

• Must be proficient in radiochemistry techniques, data reduction/quality assurance, and report preparation.

• Must be able to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Must have good organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Must be proficient using Microsoft office programs, particularly Excel and Word.

• Must be a U.S. citizen with no dual citizenship.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience handling radioactive materials is a plus.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

In this role, you will set up and operate CNC machine tools to perform various types of machining operations such as milling, drilling, tapping/thread milling, boring, and turning in order to meet print specifications.

Position Overview:
Responsible for performing radiological control activities in support of HPDU production operations at BWXT. This role ensures the safe handling of depleted uranium (DU) by conducting radiological surveys, monitoring personnel and work areas, and implementing contamination and exposure controls. The position works closely with operations, safety, and engineering teams to maintain compliance with regulatory requirements and support a strong radiological safety culture.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a HPDU Radiation Control Technician:

• Performs routine and special radiological surveys, including contamination, radiation, and airborne radioactivity monitoring.

• Collects and analyzes air samples and smears to assess radiological conditions.

• Implements and maintains contamination control measures to prevent the spread of radioactive materials.

• Establishes and monitors radiological control boundaries, postings, and access controls.

• Supports personnel dosimetry programs, including issuance, tracking, and collection of dosimeters.

• Performs personnel contamination surveys and ensure proper decontamination when necessary.

• Provides radiological coverage for operations, maintenance, and waste handling activities involving DU.

• Ensures work is performed in accordance with Radiological Work Permits (RWPs) and applicable procedures.

• Ensures compliance with applicable TDEC, OSHA, and site-specific radiological safety requirements.

• Maintains accurate records of radiological surveys, monitoring data, and personnel exposure.

• Operates, maintains, and performs source checks on radiological monitoring instruments.

• Identifies and reports instrument malfunctions or calibration issues.

• Responds to radiological alarms, abnormal conditions, or contamination events.

• Supports investigation and documentation of radiological incidents or near misses.

• Assists in training personnel on radiological safety practices, procedures, and requirements.

• Reinforces proper radiological controls and safe work practices in the field.

• Promotes a strong radiological safety culture by adhering to ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) principles.

• Actively participates in safety meetings, briefings, and continuous improvement initiatives.

## Required Qualifications:

• Associate degree in Health Physics, Radiation Protection, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• 2+ years of experience in radiological control, preferably in nuclear, DU processing, or chemical manufacturing environments.

• Must be able to work any shift.

• Knowledge of radiological protection principles, contamination control, and monitoring techniques.

• Experience with radiological instrumentation and survey methods.

• Ability to interpret procedures, regulations, and technical guidance.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and radiological data systems.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Relevant certifications (e.g., NRRPT) are preferred.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Position Overview:

As a Project Planner/Scheduler you will develop, maintain, and analyze Primavera P6 project schedules to support planning, performance tracking, and informed decision‑making. This role partners with project teams to ensure schedule accuracy, assess risks, provide analytical insights, and communicate schedule performance to stakeholders.

## Your Day to Day as a Project Planner/Scheduler:

• Develop, update, and manage project schedules using Primavera P6 to support project planning, forecasting, and performance tracking.

• Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and functional teams to ensure schedule accuracy and alignment with scope, cost, and resource plans.

• Maintain quality assurance and control on assigned project schedules.

• Participate in project meetings, provide schedule insights, and proactively identify schedule risks and opportunities.

• Must be an effective communicator with internal/external stakeholders and customers.

• Must be able to demonstrate superior written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, including technical writing skills.

• Must have a strong understanding of schedule integration, critical path methodology, and earned value management (EVM).

• Must have experience working in matrixed teams and with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Must be proficient with Microsoft Office products, especially Excel and Word.

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Job Description

## Platform Engineer

## Build the Platform. Automate at Scale.

Are you passionate about building reliable, scalable cloud platforms and eliminating operational complexity through automation? Do you believe in infrastructure as code, modern DevOps practices, and creating platforms that empower engineering teams to deliver with confidence? We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to help build, optimize, and maintain the cloud platform technologies that support our applications and services.

## The Opportunity

As a Platform Engineer, you’ll help design, implement, and evolve the platforms that power our cloud environments. You’ll collaborate with engineering and cloud operations teams to improve platform reliability, streamline deployments, and enable scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure.

You’ll work across modern platform technologies, including Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Ansible, while applying GitOps, automation, and CI/CD best practices. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, improving operational efficiency, and building adaptable platforms that meet evolving business and application needs.

## ## Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud platform solutions using modern architecture principles and infrastructure automation.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Apply automation and configuration management practices to improve platform consistency, repeatability, and operational efficiency.

Containerization & Orchestration: Support and manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes, enabling reliable deployment and operation of applications and microservices.

CI/CD & GitOps: Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, incorporating version control and GitOps practices to support consistent, reliable deployments.

Platform Reliability & Performance: Monitor platform health, performance, availability, and redundancy. Identify opportunities to improve resilience, stability, and scalability.

Cloud Operations Collaboration: Partner with cloud operations and application engineering teams to understand application requirements and ensure platform capabilities align with workload needs.

Security & Risk Management: Implement and maintain platform security practices and controls to help protect systems, applications, and sensitive data.

Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement: Investigate platform issues, perform system debugging, and resolve complex technical problems while identifying opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Maintain clear documentation of platform architecture, configurations, operational procedures, and engineering practices.

Technology Evolution: Stay current with emerging cloud-native technologies, DevOps practices, and platform engineering trends to continually improve platform capabilities.

## ## What You Bring to the Team

The Experience: Proven experience in platform engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or a related software engineering role.

The Platform Mindset: A solid understanding of cloud technologies, modern platform architectures, and the principles behind building scalable, reliable infrastructure.

The Automation Toolkit: Proficiency in scripting and automation using languages and tools such as Python, Bash, Ansible, and Groovy.

The Container Foundation: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization, orchestration, and application deployment.

The Delivery Pipeline: Understanding of CI/CD methodologies and experience with pipeline automation tools such as Jenkins or Travis CI.

The GitOps Approach: A solid understanding of GitOps principles and version-controlled approaches to managing infrastructure and platform configurations.

The Infrastructure Fundamentals: Knowledge of networking concepts and services, including DNS, load balancing, and firewalls.

The Problem Solver: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues and develop practical, sustainable solutions.

The Technical Foundation: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

## Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

Avaya Platform Experience: Familiarity with the Avaya Aura platform and its supporting technologies.

Infrastructure Automation: Experience using Terraform and Ansible to provision, configure, and manage infrastructure.

Cloud-Native Engineering: Experience supporting distributed applications, microservices, and highly available platform environments.

Operational Excellence: A track record of improving platform reliability, reducing manual effort, and streamlining engineering workflows through automation.

## Why Join Us?

Modern Platform Technologies: Work with cloud-native tools and practices, including Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure as code, GitOps, and CI/CD.

Meaningful Engineering Challenges: Help solve complex platform, automation, scalability, and reliability challenges.

Collaborative Engineering: Partner with cloud operations and application engineering teams to deliver platform capabilities that support business and customer needs.

Continuous Innovation: Contribute to the evolution of platform engineering practices and help build more efficient, resilient, and adaptable infrastructure.

The pay range for this opportunity is from $127,100 to $160,000 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies.

## ## About the Job

We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products.
In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities.

## ## About You

• Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization.

• Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).

• Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry.

• Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).

• Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.

• Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.

• Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana.

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Why Join & Who Should Apply
This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you:

• Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle.

• Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights.

• Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines.

• Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership.

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred

Position Overview:
Responsible for performing radiological control activities in support of HPDU production operations at BWXT. This role ensures the safe handling of depleted uranium (DU) by conducting radiological surveys, monitoring personnel and work areas, and implementing contamination and exposure controls. The position works closely with operations, safety, and engineering teams to maintain compliance with regulatory requirements and support a strong radiological safety culture.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a HPDU Radiation Control Technician:

• Performs routine and special radiological surveys, including contamination, radiation, and airborne radioactivity monitoring.

• Collects and analyzes air samples and smears to assess radiological conditions.

• Implements and maintains contamination control measures to prevent the spread of radioactive materials.

• Establishes and monitors radiological control boundaries, postings, and access controls.

• Supports personnel dosimetry programs, including issuance, tracking, and collection of dosimeters.

• Performs personnel contamination surveys and ensure proper decontamination when necessary.

• Provides radiological coverage for operations, maintenance, and waste handling activities involving DU.

• Ensures work is performed in accordance with Radiological Work Permits (RWPs) and applicable procedures.

• Ensures compliance with applicable TDEC, OSHA, and site-specific radiological safety requirements.

• Maintains accurate records of radiological surveys, monitoring data, and personnel exposure.

• Operates, maintains, and performs source checks on radiological monitoring instruments.

• Identifies and reports instrument malfunctions or calibration issues.

• Responds to radiological alarms, abnormal conditions, or contamination events.

• Supports investigation and documentation of radiological incidents or near misses.

• Assists in training personnel on radiological safety practices, procedures, and requirements.

• Reinforces proper radiological controls and safe work practices in the field.

• Promotes a strong radiological safety culture by adhering to ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) principles.

• Actively participates in safety meetings, briefings, and continuous improvement initiatives.

## Required Qualifications:

• Associate degree in Health Physics, Radiation Protection, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• Experience in radiological control, preferably in nuclear, DU processing, or chemical manufacturing environments.

• Must be able to work any shift.

• Knowledge of radiological protection principles, contamination control, and monitoring techniques.

• Experience with radiological instrumentation and survey methods.

• Ability to interpret procedures, regulations, and technical guidance.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and radiological data systems.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Relevant certifications (e.g., NRRPT) are preferred.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Position Overview:

Maintain NRC and state radioactive materials licenses, including change requests and documentation. Serves as regulatory interface on licensing and compliance matters. Coordinates follow-up efforts to NRC and state compliance inspections. Serves as compliance resource for packaging and transport of radioactive materials, including packages requiring NRC approval.

## Location:

On-site in Erwin, Tennessee.

## Your Day to Day as a Licensing Specialist:

1. Plans and organizes the NFS Erwin activities associated with NRC and state licensing, including license applications, amendment and renewal requests, decommissioning requests, and associated documentation.

2. Prepares licensing submittals to regulatory agencies, directs the consolidation of licensing input from all areas of the company for submittal to regulatory agencies and exercises judgement based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.

3. Supports reviews of the NFS licensing programs for compliance with appropriate governmental rules and regulations.

4. Interfaces with and provides assistance to NRC and other regulatory inspectors and licensing personnel.

5. Establishes liaison with and acts as a licensing resource to other team members and groups such as Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Health Physics, Industrial Safety, and Environmental Safety on matters pertaining to license and regulatory compliance.

7. Administers the activities associated with tracking regulatory commitments including entering the commitments into the correction action program systems, generating reports to track the status of the commitments, and ensuring they are properly documented to support closure.

9. Works independently acting as a licensing resource for colleagues with less knowledge of regulatory requirements.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and models.

• Ability to perform field verification and troubleshoot discrepancies.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Must be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q clearance.

• Experience designing tooling, fixtures, and assemblies.
• Experience with rotating machinery or test stands.
• Familiarity with GD\&T, tolerance analysis, and dimensional control.
• Experience supporting fabrication and assembly teams.
• Knowledge of SAP/ECTR, Minitab, or similar tools.
• Experience mentoring junior designers.
• Six Sigma or familiarity with PFMEA and continuous improvement.

• Flexible schedules and paid time off (as applicable).
• Professional development and training support.
• Inclusive work culture with cross-generational collaboration.
• Opportunity to support mission-critical national programs.
• Continuous CAD and engineering development opportunities.

Position Overview:

## Your Day to Day as a Waste Handling Technician:

• Performs solidification and stabilization of DU-containing waste in accordance with approved procedures.

• Operates liquid waste treatment systems, including plant sewer and process effluent systems.

• Handles, transfers, packages, and labels waste in accordance with regulatory and site requirements.

• Prepares waste for storage, shipment, or disposal, ensuring proper documentation and traceability.

• Follows all safety, radiological, environmental, and waste handling procedures.

• Utilizes required PPE and adheres to contamination control and hazardous material handling practices.

• Operates and monitors waste processing equipment, including mixers, pumps, tanks, and solidification systems.

• Maintains clean and organized work areas, ensuring proper waste storage and segregation.

• Supports proper spill prevention and housekeeping practices.

• Responds to spills, leaks, or abnormal conditions involving waste systems.

• Reports incidents, near misses, or unsafe conditions promptly.

• Works closely with waste supervisors, operations, radiological control, and safety personnel.

• Supports continuous improvement initiatives and safe, efficient waste operations.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training or associate degree preferred.

• 2+ years of experience in waste handling, chemical processing, or industrial operations.

• Must be willing to work any shift.

• Experience working with hazardous materials.

• Basic understanding of waste treatment processes and industrial equipment.

• Ability to follow detailed procedures and work in a highly regulated environment.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Ability to wear required PPE and work in controlled or radiological environments.

• Proficiency in basic computer applications for data entry and recordkeeping.

## Your Day to Day as a Manufacturing Development Technologist:

• Support installation, on/off-site testing, and calibration schedules of assigned equipment.

• Assist with analyzing and resolving development/manufacturing issues.

• Must be proficient in reading and interpreting engineering drawings.

## Position Overview:

The Mechanical Maintenance Technician is responsible for installing, troubleshooting, and repairing industrial equipment. This role occasionally requires working in tight or confined spaces while wearing appropriate respiratory protection.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, Virginia

## Your Day to Day as a Mechanical Maintenance Technician:

• Install, troubleshoot, and repair industrial equipment, including work performed in tight or confined spaces while wearing required respiratory protection.

• Safely operate cranes, hoists, power tools, motorized equipment, and hand tools.

• Accurately document daily maintenance activities in the SAP PM module.

• Follow specialized procedures when working in radiological environments.

• Identify, repair, and replace faulty equipment using careful observation, effective troubleshooting, and sound analytical reasoning.

• Collaborate closely with coworkers and the Planning Department to locate parts, coordinate resources, and schedule repairs.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

## Minimum Qualifications:

• Associate’s degree in a technical field plus at least 2 years of relevant industrial experience, OR

• H.S. diploma/GED plus a minimum of 6 years of directly related industrial experience.

• Ability to consistently observe and enforce all safety rules, especially when working in confined spaces, radiological environments, or when operating cranes, hoists, and other equipment.

• Demonstrated understanding of hydraulics, pneumatics, and mechanical systems essential for diagnosing and repairing industrial equipment.

• Basic working knowledge of electrical systems (up to 480V, 3-phase) and PLCs to support troubleshooting and equipment maintenance.

• Proven ability to work both independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively with coworkers and the Planning Department to coordinate repairs and locate necessary parts.

• Self-starter with strong initiative and the ability to follow specialized procedures and document work accurately in SAP PM.

• Willingness to attend ongoing training and seminars to maintain and expand technical skills.

• Ability to obtain and maintain required respirator qualifications for work performed in tight or confined spaces.

• Must be a US Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Additional Qualifications:

• Some knowledge of HVAC, Cryogenics, and basic vacuum and leak detection.

• Some knowledge of CMMS and its attributes.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are You The Person We're Looking For?

Are you passionate about systems software, open-source technologies, and solving complex technical challenges? Do you enjoy working at the intersection of operating systems, developer tools, AI, robotics, and embedded platforms? At QNX, we're on a mission to become the platform of choice for modern embedded software development through our QNX Everywhere initiative. We're building a rich open-source ecosystem that enables developers to leverage many of the technologies traditionally found on Linux, natively on the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to help bridge the gap between QNX and the open-source community by bringing modern frameworks, AI/ML technologies, robotics platforms, and developer tools to QNX. You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy working across a broad technical stack, from operating systems and middleware to developer tooling, AI frameworks, and embedded platforms.

## What You'll Do:

• Develop Software with Broad Range of Technologies: C, C++, Python, and Rust for the QNX RTOS. Projects span a wide array of domains, including:

• System & Web Runtimes: Node.js, GTK, SQLite, Boost.

• Networking & Middleware: SOME/IP, MQTT, DDS, Zenoh.

• Physical AI & Robotics: ROS2, OpenPI, Google MediaPipe, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow.

• Target Platforms: Raspberry Pi, SBCs, QEMU, various robotics kits

• Integrate QNX and Open-Source: Integrate open-source projects with core QNX technologies (graphics, networking, USB, audio, sensors, and multimedia).

• Toolchain Support: Develop OS-specific abstraction layers, shims, and porting libraries; adapt cross-compilation build systems (CMake, Meson, Bazel, Cargo, GN/Ninja, BitBake) for QNX toolchains.

• Performance Optimization: Perform low-level profiling, memory footprint reduction, latency tuning, and performance optimization on embedded target hardware.

• Industry Events and Demonstrations: Develop and deliver demonstrations that showcase QNX solutions at key industry events to customers, partners, and industry peers, with a focus on Physical AI and robotics.

## What You Bring:

• Strong software development experience in C and C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python.

• Proven experience with Linux/Unix development environments and cross-compilation toolchains (CMake, Meson, Ninja, Make, BitBake).

• Solid understanding of operating system internals and POSIX APIs (pthreads, IPC, memory management, networking sockets).

• Excellent communication skills with an interest in collaborating within open-source developer communities.

• Self-motivated with a passion for building software ecosystems.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

## It Would Be Nice If You Had Any of the Following:

• Experience porting, building, or maintaining large open-source projects or Linux distributions.

• Experience or interest in Physical AI, Robotics, or Vision frameworks (e.g., ROS 2, OpenPI, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).

• Experience with GPU / Heterogeneous Compute stacks (NVIDIA CUDA/TensorRT, AMD ROCm, Vulkan Compute, OpenCL) on platforms like NVIDIA Thor/IGX or AMD silicon.

• Knowledge of embedded GUI engines (Qt, GTK), or automotive/industrial middleware (DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT).

• Hands-on experience with RTOS environments (QNX, VxWorks, FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or Linux kernel/driver internals.

• Familiarity with Rust and Cargo build targets for embedded or systems programming.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, NSE, BSE, Airtel, HDFC, SBI , PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology and your hard work!

Overview

This is a position based in Delhi(preferred), Bangalore is an option, ideal for a senior sales professional with experience navigating complex, consultative sales cycles within large organizations.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and securing new enterprise accounts, expanding relationships within existing customers, and positioning Solace as a critical enabler of both traditional event-driven architecture (EDA) and next-generation AI-driven initiatives.

As organizations accelerate their adoption of artificial intelligence, real-time data movement has become a foundational requirement. Solace plays a key role in helping enterprises modernize their integration strategy to support AI workloads by ensuring that data is delivered securely, efficiently, and in real time across distributed systems.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders and executive decision-makers to demonstrate how Solace’s platform can serve as the backbone for modern AI-ready infrastructure.

In This Role, You Will

• Be responsible for establishing, cultivating, and improving Solace’s relationship with clients.

• Identify new business opportunities to grow with both new clients, and within existing clients – and they lead the sales process from start to finish.

• Develop and execute territory and account plans that address short-term and strategic goals which include pipeline building, revenue attainment, profit margin, client wallet share, and customer satisfaction.

• Be a “hunter” and must be a self-starter who is able to work independently. At the same time, be a strong team player — capable of collaborating widely and building a deep relationship with their pre-sales engineer(s) and others.

• Ultimately, accountable to win new business, and in the process will build strong client relationships (at both the working and executive level), negotiate complex deals, and establish long-lasting client relationships.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• Consultative selling

• Ability to build strong executive relationships

• Proven ability to close large, complex, SAAS deals

• Track record in selling middleware products, solutions, and services

• Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven ability to connect with clients

• Ability to pull together a team and lead complex negotiations

Senior Embedded Software Engineer

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

About Us

Social networking, machine learning, and big data analytics demand ever-increasing network connectivity. RANOVUS, with operations in Ottawa, Canada, Nuremberg, Germany, and San Jose, USA, is a solution provider for the next generation data center infrastructures. We aim to deliver advanced technology that minimizes environmental impact through lower power dissipation. Working with world class fabrication partners, RANOVUS is the leader in the application of unique new technologies to fiber-optic communications products for datacenters.

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to work as part of our R&D software-firmware design team.

Position Overview

In this senior technical role, you will take ownership of embedded firmware development for microcontroller‑based systems integrated within high‑speed optical modules.

You will work closely with cross‑functional teams—including hardware, optics, ASIC, systems, and test engineering—to deliver robust, scalable, and production‑ready solutions. This position requires strong technical leadership, deep hands‑on expertise in embedded C development, and the ability to drive projects from concept through production release.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of close collaboration with hardware and electrical teams, experience bringing up and debugging firmware on new hardware platforms, and broad embedded systems expertise developed across a diverse set of projects.

Note: While Ranovus supports a hybrid work model combining remote and on‑site work, this role requires significant on‑site presence at our Kanata, Ontario facility.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Architecture & Development

• Architect, design, and implement low‑level embedded firmware for microcontroller‑based optical communication systems, primarily in C.

• Define firmware requirements, interfaces, and system behavior in collaboration with hardware and system architects.

• Develop device drivers, control loops, diagnostics, telemetry, and communication protocols.

• Optimize firmware for performance, power efficiency, memory utilization, and long‑term reliability.

• Lead board bring‑up, hardware–software integration, and system‑level validation activities.

Software Quality & DevOps

• Establish and promote best practices for secure, scalable, and maintainable firmware development.

• Drive continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) improvements using GitLab and automated build and test pipelines.

• Define and implement unit, integration, and system‑level test strategies.

• Lead complex debugging and root‑cause investigations across firmware, hardware, and system boundaries.

Technical Leadership

• Mentor junior engineers and co‑op students, fostering technical growth and best practices.

• Contribute to technical roadmaps, architectural reviews, and design discussions.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, coding standards, and development processes.

• Interface with external partners and manufacturing teams to support production deployment and sustainment.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• 10+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development.

• Expert‑level proficiency in C for embedded systems.

• Deep experience developing firmware for microcontrollers (ie. PSOC, STM32) and resource‑constrained environments.

• Deep understanding of embedded systems fundamentals, including interrupts, DMA, RTOS concepts, bootloaders, and memory management.

• Proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or system‑level tools.

• Experience with version control and CI/CD workflows (Git, GitLab).

• Strong hands‑on debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related lab instrumentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with optical communication systems or high‑speed networking products.

• Experience with ASIC development, firmware, and chip bring-up.

• Experience deploying commercial embedded systems.

• Experience with automated testing frameworks and verification methodologies.

• Demonstrated proficiency with AI-assisted/agentic development.

• Knowledge of networking protocols and client–server architectures.

• Familiarity with data center interconnect technologies.

• Familiarity with typical integrated development environments, make‑based build systems, and modern build tooling.

Personal Attributes

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Ability to work independently while contributing strategically to team objectives.

• Structured, analytical problem‑solving approach.

• Collaborative team player comfortable working in cross‑functional engineering environments.

You Belong At Ranovus

We appreciate the time you invest in exploring opportunities with us. At Ranovus, we believe diverse perspectives and a strong sense of belonging are essential to building innovative technology and resilient teams. If your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, growth, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity-deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process on request. Reach out to our Talent team at talent@ranovus.com for support.

We are committed to a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage. We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools help with consistency and efficiency, but they don’t replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in this role, an existing vacancy on our team. We look forward to connecting with you.

As a Revenue Operations Manager, you will be a key strategic partner to GTM leadership and will bring the experience and technical expertise required to support a broad and varied enterprise sales motion. We require an experienced Sales Operations professional who can bring structure and discipline to a complex, land-and-expand deal landscape where growth comes through a high volume of interconnected pilots, rollouts, and expansions rather than a handful of long, linear deals. They lead through others, develop strong teams, and are accountable for translating company strategy into clear priorities, execution, and measurable outcomes. In this role, you’ll be expected to: - Help shape the strategic direction and priorities of Revenue Operations, translating company and GTM goals into clear roadmaps, initiatives, and operating priorities for the team. - Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end with a high degree of autonomy, making decisions on prioritization and execution while proactively resolving dependencies and conflicts across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations. - Define clear goals and scope for your team, creating accountability for high-quality execution while ensuring resources and priorities remain focused on the work with the greatest business impact. - Lead and develop a high-performing team, coaching team members and leaders, providing clear feedback, and building development and succession plans that strengthen the long-term capabilities of Revenue Operations. - Act as a trusted strategic partner to GTM leaders, using data, operational expertise, and a strong understanding of the revenue engine to challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and bring forward thoughtful recommendations. - Champion change across the GTM organization, ensuring new processes, systems, and ways of working are supported by thoughtful change management, stakeholder alignment, enablement, and adoption. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - GTM leaders view Revenue Operations as a strategic partner that provides clear insights, thoughtful recommendations, and the operational infrastructure required to make better business decisions. - Revenue processes, systems, and data provide a connected view of the customer journey from acquisition through expansion and enable the business to operate effectively as complexity and scale increase. - Leadership has reliable visibility into pipeline, forecasting, capacity, territories, and operational performance, with insights increasingly supporting scenario planning and forward-looking decisions rather than simply reporting historical activity. - Large cross-functional initiatives are delivered with clear ownership, strong stakeholder alignment, proactive management of dependencies, and successful adoption across impacted teams. - Your team operates with clear priorities and accountability, independently owns its areas of responsibility, and continues to develop the technical, analytical, and business capabilities required to support the organization. - Revenue Operations has the right structure, capabilities, and succession plans to support current business needs while preparing the function for future growth. WHAT YOU BRING Must-Have: - 7+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with hands-on Salesforce administration: workflows, automation, data architecture, and complex reporting - Experience supporting an enterprise sales organization with complex deal structures and deep integration with quoting, billing, contracting and order management - Experience with lead management for ABM and large-scale expansions - Experience designing and executing new sales processes from 0-to-1, with a consideration for scalability - Strong technical fluency: proficient in Excel, BI platforms (eg. ## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

## ## Job Description

## Connect the Enterprise. Engineer for Reliability.

Are you passionate about network engineering, enterprise connectivity, and building resilient infrastructure that keeps critical business applications running? Do you enjoy solving complex routing and switching challenges, optimizing network performance, and supporting secure, highly available cloud environments? We’re looking for a Network Engineer to help design, implement, maintain, and evolve our enterprise network infrastructure.

## The Opportunity

In this role, you’ll support the network infrastructure that connects our enterprise systems, cloud environments, data centers, and business applications. You’ll work across routing, switching, network security, and voice technologies, helping ensure reliable connectivity, strong security controls, and consistent network performance across a distributed enterprise environment.

Working with Juniper routers, Dell switches, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN technologies, and enterprise voice infrastructure, you’ll collaborate with engineering teams, service providers, and business stakeholders to deliver network solutions that meet current operational needs and support future growth.

This role is ideal for an experienced network engineer who combines deep technical knowledge with strong troubleshooting skills, project execution, and a commitment to operational excellence.

## ## Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure Engineering: Configure, implement, maintain, and support enterprise network infrastructure, including Juniper routers, Dell switches, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN tunnels, security appliances, and related data center equipment.

Routing & Switching: Design, configure, and troubleshoot complex routing and switching environments to support reliable connectivity across enterprise networks, cloud infrastructure, and critical business applications.

Network Architecture & Standards: Maintain and enforce enterprise network design, security, and configuration standards. Evaluate existing infrastructure and recommend improvements that support performance, reliability, and business requirements.

Cloud & Enterprise Connectivity: Support network connectivity across LAN, WAN, data center, and cloud environments, helping ensure secure and reliable access to business-critical applications and services.

Network Security: Configure and maintain network security appliances, firewall policies, and VPN connectivity in accordance with established security and infrastructure standards.

Network Protocols & Performance: Apply in-depth knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, SNMP, SMTP, BGP, EIGRP, MPLS, SIP, and related networking technologies to maintain connectivity, investigate issues, and optimize network operations.

Voice & Unified Communications: Support the implementation and maintenance of Juniper and Dell voice-related solutions and associated network infrastructure. Troubleshoot voice connectivity and signaling issues involving SIP, H.323, relevant G-series voice codecs, and PSTN gateways.

Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex network hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Proactively investigate recurring problems, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement effective solutions to restore and maintain service.

Project Delivery & Implementation: Execute assigned network projects, installations, upgrades, and infrastructure changes in accordance with established objectives, schedules, and operational requirements.

Documentation & Configuration Management: Develop and maintain accurate documentation covering network designs, configurations, hardware, firmware, software, installations, upgrades, and operational procedures.

Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with service providers, internal teams, and customers through ticketing systems, email, and telephone to resolve issues, manage service requests, and support successful implementations.

Strategic Planning & Technology Evaluation: Participate in network planning and technology reviews, evaluating existing hardware and software and recommending solutions that align with evolving business and end-user needs.

## ## What You Bring to the Team

The Experience: 5+ years of experience supporting and maintaining network infrastructure in a cloud or enterprise environment.

The Networking Foundation: Expert knowledge of TCP/IP networking, LAN and WAN technologies, IP routing, DNS, MPLS, SNMP, SMTP, BGP, EIGRP, VPNs, and SIP.

The Juniper Expertise: Strong hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting Juniper routers and a thorough understanding of Junos OS.

The Dell Infrastructure Skills: Experience supporting Dell network switches and familiarity with Dell switch operating systems.

The Network Security Toolkit: Practical experience configuring and maintaining Palo Alto firewalls, VPN tunnels, and network security appliances.

The Voice Networking Knowledge: Strong understanding of voice signaling and transport technologies, including SIP, H.323, G.711, G.723, G.729, and PSTN gateways.

The Enterprise Perspective: Demonstrated experience supporting network infrastructure and delivering projects within large, distributed, multi-department organizations.

The Troubleshooter: Ability to analyze complex network issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions that minimize disruption and maintain service availability.

The Project Delivery Mindset: Experience executing infrastructure implementations, upgrades, and configuration changes while meeting established objectives and delivery timelines.

The Documentation Discipline: Ability to produce clear, accurate technical documentation and communicate network changes, findings, and recommendations effectively.

The Educational Foundation: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

## Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

Advanced Network Design: Experience designing and implementing complex enterprise routing and switching architectures across distributed environments.

Cloud Networking: Experience supporting connectivity between enterprise networks, data centers, and cloud-based business applications.

Network Security & Resilience: Experience evaluating network security controls and improving infrastructure availability, reliability, and operational resilience.

Voice Infrastructure Integration: Familiarity with enterprise VoIP environments, SIP signaling, PSTN gateways, and voice quality troubleshooting.

Continuous Improvement: A track record of identifying opportunities to improve network performance, strengthen security standards, and streamline operational processes.

## ## Why Join Us?

Complex Engineering Challenges: Work across enterprise routing, switching, network security, cloud connectivity, and voice infrastructure.

Business-Critical Impact: Help maintain the secure, reliable network services that support essential business applications and enterprise operations.

Collaborative Delivery: Partner with engineering teams, service providers, and business stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve challenging technical issues.

Long-Term Innovation: Contribute to network architecture planning, technology evaluations, and the evolution of enterprise infrastructure.

The pay range for this opportunity is from $143,100 to $198,300 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies.

What success looks like: - Forecasting and planning the executive team and Board trust and act on. - The systems, controls, and team in place to operate credibly at $200M+ in revenue. - Solink positioned and diligence-ready for its next strategic chapter. WHAT YOU BRING Must-Have: - 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, with prior scale-up CFO experience. - Proven track record scaling SaaS or technology companies from ~$50M to $200M+ revenue, with experience navigating different exit paths. - Deep FP&A expertise with strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities. - Direct experience with late-stage fundraising (Series C/D/E) or public markets experience. - Strong command of SaaS metrics and recurring revenue models. - Knowledge of GAAP/IFRS, compliance frameworks, and audit oversight. - Inspirational leader with the ability to develop high-performing finance teams. Nice-to-Have: - M&A experience across due diligence, valuation, and post-close integration. - Experience in a Canadian company with US and international operations, including multi-currency and cross-border tax considerations. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States. - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. OUR VALUES We do things the Solink way: - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too. - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar. - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work. - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required. - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth. - Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need. - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs. - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together. - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics. - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun. WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect: 1. Intro Call with Our Talent Team 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager 3. Interview with Senior Director, People & Culture and Chief Corporate & Legal Officer (Individual 45-Minute Slots) 4. Final Interviews with Two Board Members 5. Reference Checks 6. Offer & Onboarding PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward. NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION. SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

Role Summary Magnet Forensics is seeking a detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support the company's global trade compliance program. This is an entry-level to early-career position responsible for conducting daily compliance reviews and screening activities to ensure compliance with applicable export control, sanctions, and trade regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). The successful candidate will perform Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews, restricted-party screening, sales opportunity reviews, end-user due diligence, and transaction monitoring activities. The position plays a critical role in helping the company identify potential export compliance risks before products, software, services, or technology are provided to customers, partners, vendors, or other third parties. This role will work closely with the Legal, Compliance, Sales Operations, Finance, Customer Success, and Procurement teams and will escalate higher-risk matters to senior compliance personnel for further review. The analyst will be responsible for screening transaction parties using Descartes and ensuring appropriate documentation and records are maintained. Magnet's procedures require screening customers, vendors, banks, brokers, consignees, and other transaction participants against restricted party lists throughout the transaction lifecycle. Position Type: New Position Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. ## Position Overview:

As our CAM Programmer / CNC Machinist, you will serve as a key contributor within our Prototyping & Assembly Operations team. In this role, you will translate SolidWorks models into efficient Mastercam toolpaths, set up and run CNC equipment, and produce precision components for rapid prototypes and low volume builds.

## Location:

Onsite in Lynchburg, Virginia at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a CAM Programmer / CNC Machinist:

• Program, edit, and optimize Mastercam toolpaths from SolidWorks 3D models and drawings.

• Set up and operate CNC mills and lathes (3–5 axis preferred), including workholding design, tool selection, and offsets.

• Interpret engineering drawings and GD&T requirements; select appropriate speeds and feeds for a wide range of materials including aluminum, steels, and plastics.

• Perform prove‑outs and first‑article runs; drive continuous process improvements to reduce cycle time, minimize scrap, and enhance overall machining efficiency.

• Collaborate with engineering and assembly to advise on DFM/DFX and manufacturability.

• Perform in‑process inspections using calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other precision measurement tools; accurately document results.

• Maintain programs, posts, and revision control; keep a clean, safe, and organized workspace.

• Assist with routine machine maintenance and troubleshooting.

## Required Qualifications:

• • A minimum of an associate degree in a technical field plus two (2) years of professional machining experience OR a high school diploma / equivalent plus six (6) years of professional machining experience (CNC programming + hands on operation) is required.

• Must be proficient in CAM programming, Mastercam preferred.

• Must have strong knowledge of machining fundamentals: tooling, workholding, setup, and optimization.

• Must be able to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T; comfortable working with tight tolerances.

• Must have proven problem-solving skills and ownership in a fast-paced prototyping environment.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear, concise, and accurate information.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including customers and suppliers.

• Must be able to thrive in a fast-paced team environment while also working independently when required.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• • Relevant certifications (e.g., NIMS Machining, Mastercam Certification, SolidWorks CSWA/CSWP) are preferred.

• Experience with multi axis programming (4/5 axis) and post processor customization.

• Familiarity with quick turn prototyping/R&D workflows and short lead times.

• Exposure to CMM or advanced metrology; ISO or AS quality environments.

• Basic CNC maintenance and troubleshooting.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## About This Opportunity

This role focuses on 5G and 6G verifications within the System Verification Test Area Performance team at Ericsson Canada. You will contribute to ensuring product quality throughout the RAN system lifecycle, helping validate that solutions meet 3GPP standards, customer requirements, and Ericsson's expectations for performance, reliability, and quality. Working alongside development, integration, and customer project teams, you will support feature-specific system verifications, performance validation, troubleshooting, test automation, and continuous improvements across Ericsson's radio access network solutions. We welcome candidates with 0–10 years of relevant experience. Job level will be based on experience, technical skills, and role scope.

## What You Will Do

• Contribute to end-to-end system verification and validation of 5G/6G RAN features and functionalities

• Support analysis, test design, and feature impact assessments during system verification activities

• Execute system, regression, and performance testing in laboratory and pre-customer environments

• Assist with troubleshooting and root cause analysis using logs, traces, protocol analysis, and performance measurements

• Validate RAN performance across various deployment scenarios and radio conditions

• Support performance investigations and analyze key radio performance indicators to identify bottlenecks, regressions, and optimization opportunities

• Execute and analyze Link Curve verification activities and performance evaluations

• Help design and execute realistic radio scenarios including mobility, fading, interference, carrier aggregation, and MIMO deployments

• Perform software quality assessments using data-driven analysis of KPIs, counters, trace logs, and failure trends

• Support customer validation, acceptance testing, field trials, and customer issue investigations

• Collaborate with development, CI/CD, system integration, and customer project teams to help resolve issues efficiently

• Contribute to continuous improvements in verification methodologies, automation, analytics, and quality assurance practices

## The Skills You Bring

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

• Some experience or academic exposure to 5G NR system verification, validation, or wireless network performance testing is an asset

• Foundational understanding of LTE and 5G NR radio technologies, radio resource management, and RAN performance principles

• Familiarity with 5G NR protocol stack operation, including PHY, MAC, RLC, and PDCP layers

• Exposure to performance behavior across Layer 1 and Layer 2, including link adaptation, scheduling, MIMO, and carrier aggregation

• Familiarity with test and troubleshooting tools such as Viavi TM500/E500, QXDM, Wireshark, or equivalent solutions is an asset

• Basic understanding of IP networking fundamentals, including throughput, latency, and packet loss

• Experience working in Linux-based environments

• Familiarity with configuration management tools such as Git, Gerrit, and Jenkins

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Clear and effective communication skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and globally distributed teams

• Exposure to Cloud RAN, O-RAN architectures, or AI/ML techniques applied to verification or automation is a plus
