Compensation and Benefits at Ericsson
At Ericsson, we know that our people are the key to our success. We offer a competitive package to help with your individual needs and goals.

Your Pay
The salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, and the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience.

The salary range for this position is

• Ottawa: $85,000 - $111,300

Short-Term Variable Compensation Plan: Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus. Actual bonus payouts are based on performance of the business against the unit’s objectives, individual performance, and the individual bonus target. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.

Your Health
Ericsson offers excellent health benefits including the choice of 3 medical and dental plan options that allow an employee to select the level of coverage that suits their needs. Core level coverage is paid for fully by Ericsson.

Your Financial Security
We invest in both your short and long-term financial wellbeing. Ericsson’s Group Retirement & Savings Program offers an automatic 2% company contribution into the Pension Plan. Employees will also receive basic life insurance and basic accidental death and dismemberment coverage at two-times annual base pay at no cost, as well as short-term disability coverage. Employees also have the option to participate in Ericsson’s Stock Purchase Plan.

Please note paid time off is pro-rated based on the employee’s start date. Furthermore, Ericsson provides up to 10 weeks of paid maternity leave and 6 weeks of parental or adoption leave at 100% of pay.

Ericsson offers many other company-paid benefits such as financial wellness programs, educational assistance, matching gifts, wellness account, and recognition programs.

Senior PCB Layout Designer

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

About Us

Ranovus is a semiconductor company with global operations helping power the data behind next generation AI and data center networks. We design and build advanced hardware that moves massive amounts of information quickly and efficiently between computer systems in data centers around the world. Our technology improves performance while reducing energy use and environmental impact, supporting the rapid growth of AI and cloud services. At Ranovus, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team that values learning, flexibility, and meaningful work with global impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Senior PCB Layout Designer to join our engineering team.

The PCB Layout Designer will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing printed circuit board (PCB) and substrate layouts to meet electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing requirements. This role involves close collaboration with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, packaging engineers, and manufacturing teams to ensure that designs meet performance, quality, and compliance standards.

How You’ll Contribute

• Create and develop PCB and substrate layouts based on schematic diagrams and design specifications.

• Collaborate with hardware, mechanical and signal integrity engineers to ensure design accuracy and compliance with requirements.

• Optimize layouts for signal integrity, power distribution, thermal performance, and manufacturability.

• Generate Gerber files, fabrication drawings, and assembly documentation for manufacturing.

• Ensure compliance with industry standards (IPC, UL, RoHS, etc.) and internal design guidelines.

• Perform design rule checks (DRC) and electrical rule checks (ERC) to validate design integrity.

• Work with vendors and fabrication houses to resolve manufacturing issues and ensure high-yield production.

• Maintain version control and design documentation for all layouts.

• Participate in design reviews and provide technical input to improve PCB design processes.

What You’ll Bring

• Proven experience in PCB layout design for analog, digital, RF, or mixed-signal circuits.

• Proficiency with PCB design tools (e.g., Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Mentor Graphics PADS, KiCad, or equivalent).

• Strong knowledge of PCB and substrate manufacturing processes, materials, and design-for-manufacturing (DFM) practices.

• Understanding of high-speed signal design, EMI/EMC considerations, and thermal management.

• Ability to interpret and apply IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-6012, etc.).

• Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

You Belong At Ranovus

We appreciate the time you invest in exploring opportunities with us. At Ranovus, we believe diverse perspectives and a strong sense of belonging are essential to building innovative technology and resilient teams. If your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, growth, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity-deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process on request. Reach out to our Talent team at talent@ranovus.com for support.

We are committed to a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage. We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools help with consistency and efficiency, but they don’t replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in this role, an existing vacancy on our team. We look forward to connecting with you.

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

About Us

Ranovus is a semiconductor company with global operations helping power the data behind next generation AI and data center networks. We design and build advanced hardware that moves massive amounts of information quickly and efficiently between computer systems in data centers around the world. Our technology improves performance while reducing energy use and environmental impact, supporting the rapid growth of AI and cloud services. At Ranovus, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team that values learning, flexibility, and meaningful work with global impact.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Wafer Product Engineer to lead characterization, yield analysis, statistical validation, and manufacture readiness for semiconductor products from NPI through high-volume production. As the technical bridge between Design Engineering, Test Engineering, Fabs, OSATs, and Operations, you will define characterization plans, corner-lot strategies, SPC methodologies, and release criteria, using DOE, GRR, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis, and yield modeling to ensure products are manufacturable, testable, and meet quality, reliability, and cost targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Characterization & Validation: Develop characterization plans and define corner-lot requirements across process, voltage, temperature, and manufacturing lots. Analyze electrical, optical, and functional distributions, set production test limits and guardbands, and drive qualification readiness.

• Statistical Analysis & Process Capability: Analyze product and manufacturing data; monitor and improve Cp/Cpk, yield, parametric distributions, and process stability. Identify sources of variation, drive corrective actions, and issue reports and recommendations supporting production releases.

• Design of Experiments (DOE): Plan, execute, and analyze DOEs covering process variables, test conditions, environmental factors, and manufacturing variation to optimize performance and margins; present recommendations to cross-functional teams.

• MSA & GRR: Lead GRR studies, evaluate measurement capability and repeatability, and improve test robustness and accuracy. Ensure test systems meet statistical requirements and support correlation across engineering systems, ATE, probe, and OSAT test environments.

• Yield & Quality: Analyze wafer sort and final test yield, lead root cause investigations of yield detractors, assess potential test escapes, and recommend screening improvements. Partner with Design and Test to improve quality and test coverage and drive continuous improvement through defect trend reporting and metrics reviews.

• Fab & OSAT Interface: Serve as primary technical interface for product-related manufacturing issues. Work with foundries on process performance, excursions, capability trends, and yield programs, and with OSATs on production performance, yield loss, test program implementation, and efficiency.

• Test Program Quality & Release: Partner with ATE Test Engineers on test effectiveness, guardbands, correlation, characterization coverage, and robustness. Review and approve production test limits, balancing quality, yield, customer requirements, and cost.

• NPI: Collaborate with Design from concept through volume release while driving DFx. Define manufacturing readiness and release-to-production criteria, participate in design, characterization, and production readiness reviews, complete gate review actions on schedule, and drive successful ramps.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical or computer engineering, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, Applied Statistics, or a related technical discipline.

• 5+ years of semiconductor Product Engineering experience, including NPI and production ramp support.

• Strong understanding of wafer fabrication, assembly, and test processes, with direct experience working with foundries and OSAT partners.

• Experience leading characterization and yield improvement programs.

• Technical expertise in characterization methodologies, yield analysis and improvement, Cp/Cpk, SPC, DOE, GRR/MSA, correlation studies, root cause analysis, semiconductor manufacturing processes, wafer sort and final test operations, and product qualification.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with advanced semiconductor technologies, such as photonic integrated circuits (PICs), silicon photonics, high-speed SerDes, analog, mixed-signal, or optical products.

• Knowledge of Advantest V93000 (93K) production test environments.

• Familiarity with JMP, Minitab, MATLAB, Python, and SQL.

• Understanding of automotive or telecom quality methodologies.

Key Competencies

Strong statistical and analytical thinking; data-driven decision making; excellent problem solving; cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence technical direction across organizations; effective communication with internal teams and external partners; and strong project management and prioritization skills.

Success Metrics

Product yield and Cp/Cpk against targets; characterization quality and completeness; DOE effectiveness; GRR and measurement capability improvements; reduced manufacturing excursions; production ramp success and time-to-production readiness; product quality and customer returns; and yield and cost improvements.

## Business Analyst

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

About the position
We are seeking an innovative and skilled Business Analyst to join our Enterprise Customer Relationship Management (CRM) IT team! We are a collaborative and diverse team within ITS responsible for delivering and evolving enterprise business solutions using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure services.

You will join a dynamic Scrum team working with business and technology partners to understand their needs, define requirements, and design and deliver effective CRM solutions. Our team supports existing solutions, including the Bank’s regulatory platform for Retail Payments Supervision, while also developing new CRM solutions to support emerging business needs and mandates across the Bank.

You will have the full support of your leader and teammates to enhance your skills, experiment with new technologies and approaches, and further your career through our customizable Learning & Development programmes across areas such as mentorship, architecture and analytics, as well as relevant certifications.

What you will do
As a Business Analyst, you will support the information gathering, analysis and development of functional and non-functional requirements for the Enterprise CRM, ensuring that it is aligned with business objectives, and driving continuous improvement to achieve better results.

More specifically, you will:

• Elicit, analyze, and document high-quality functional and non-functional requirements with clear acceptance criteria and testability built in.

• Ensure all requirements are traceable, verifiable, and aligned with business objectives and CRM strategy outcomes.

• Assess CRM data models, fields, forms, views and business processes to identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and improve the user experience.

• Facilitate stakeholder discussions and document key decisions to distinguish enterprise-wide requirements from business-area-specific needs and extensions.

• Define and document current-state and future-state processes with a focus on control points, risk areas, and validation needs.

• Translate business requirements into detailed, testable specifications to support solution design, development, and QA activities.

• Collaborate with functional and technical teams to develop test strategies, test scenarios, and test cases based on business requirements.

• Support and actively participate in system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing.

• Establish and support quality metrics and performance indicators to measure CRM solution effectiveness and detect trends

• Conduct regular solution reviews and gap assessments to identify quality risks, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities.

• Validate that enhancements and releases meet defined acceptance criteria and business readiness standards before deployment.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory, legal, security, and organizational policy requirements through requirements controls and validation checks.

• Coordinate with external partners and vendors to verify integration quality, interface requirements, and data validation rules.

• Support development of user training and documentation with accuracy and completeness checks to ensure adoption readiness.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and develop dashboards and reports that track business performance and adoption metrics.

• Promote continuous improvement by feeding testing insights, defect patterns, and user feedback back into requirements and process refinement.

• Provide recommendations for system enhancements, workflow optimization, and adoption initiatives, leveraging 365 Dynamics capabilities to increase operational efficiency.

What you need to succeed
You are a self-starter with strong communication and interpersonal skills who can build and maintain relationships across multiple levels of partners (both internally and externally). You also have a strong attention to detail, are analytical, and capable or solving problems independently or as part of a team.

In addition, you have experience in:

• business analysis and/or process improvement within an IT environment

• validating software solutions and conducting testing as required

• business requirements elicitation and documentation (e.g. functional & non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules)

• utilizing digital tools and digital ways of working (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence, ServiceNow)

As well as functional and testing expertise with Dynamics 365 CRM including a deep understanding of the platform's features and capabilities, as well as the ability to customize and configure the system to meet the unique needs of the organization.

## Nice-to-have

• Relevant Business Analysis designations/certifications (CBAP, etc.)

• Experience in technical writing (e.g. business requirements, test cases)

• Dynamics 365 Certification (MB-200)

• Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity and analytical tools.

Your education and experience
Your combined education and work experience demonstrates that you have the proficiencies and skills for the role. We are ideally seeking candidates with a relevant degree/diploma and 5+ years of relevant experience.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• There will be no relocation assistance provided

## Position Overview

The Product Compliance Specialist is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing certification activities for Calian's aviation GNSS antenna products. This role will lead the certification strategy and compliance process for FAA approval of airborne GNSS antenna systems, including qualification to RTCA DO-160 and other applicable aviation standards.

CareersInnerInfo
Working closely with product development, systems engineering, industrialization, and core engineering teams, the product compliance specialist ensures certification requirements are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle, from initial requirements definition through testing, regulatory approval, product release, and ongoing compliance management. The position serves as the primary interface with certification authorities, designated engineering representatives (DERs), test laboratories, customers, and internal stakeholders.

## Responsibilities

The Product Compliance Specialist leads all activities required to obtain and maintain aviation certification approvals while ensuring efficient execution of certification programs.

Certification Strategy and Planning

• Develop certification roadmaps for airborne GNSS antenna and navigation products.

• Establish certification plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.

• Identify applicable regulations, standards, and guidance documents.

• Define certification basis and compliance strategies for new aviation products.

• Ensure certification requirements are integrated into product development programs from project inception.

Regulatory Compliance Management

• Lead compliance activities for FAA, Transport Canada, EASA, and other regulatory authorities as required.

• Manage qualification programs to RTCA DO-160 and other relevant aviation standards.

• Coordinate certification reviews, audits, and regulatory interactions.

• Maintain certification records, compliance matrices, and technical documentation.

• Monitor regulatory changes and assess impacts on existing and future products.

Test and Certification Execution

• Plan and oversee environmental, electromagnetic, mechanical, and performance qualification testing.

• Coordinate internal engineering teams and external accredited test laboratories.

• Review test procedures, test reports, and compliance evidence packages.

• Manage certification issue resolution and corrective actions.

• Ensure traceability between requirements, verification activities, and certification artifacts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Work closely with Product Development, RF & Antenna Systems, Research & Technology, Industrialization, and Core Engineering teams.

• Provide certification guidance during product architecture, design reviews, and trade studies.

• Support risk assessments related to certification and product compliance.

• Drive resolution of technical and compliance issues affecting certification schedules.

Customer and Business Support

• Support customer discussions involving certification and regulatory compliance.

• Assist business development and sales teams with certification-related proposals and customer requirements.

• Participate in customer audits, technical reviews, and certification presentations.

• Help develop certification strategies for customized aviation products and programs.

Continuous Improvement

• Establish and improve internal certification processes, procedures, and best practices.

• Develop certification templates, compliance documentation standards, and lessons learned databases.

• Promote compliance awareness and certification readiness across engineering organizations.

• Mentor engineering teams on aviation certification requirements and certification-by-design methodologies.

## Qualifications

The successful candidate combines deep aviation certification expertise with strong technical leadership and cross-functional coordination skills.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Master's degree is considered an asset.

Experience

• 6+ years of experience in aerospace certification, avionics, airborne systems, aviation product development, or related regulatory compliance environments.

• Proven experience managing FAA, Transport Canada, EASA, or equivalent certification programs.

• Experience leading qualification programs to RTCA DO-160.

• Experience working with airborne navigation, GNSS, avionics, antennas, communications, surveillance, or aerospace systems.

• Experience leading or supporting certification activities for commercial or military aerospace products.

• Experience coordinating external test laboratories, certification consultants, and regulatory authorities.

Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of FAA certification processes and regulatory frameworks.

• Working knowledge of RTCA DO-160 environmental qualification requirements.

• Familiarity with standards such as:

• TSO processes and approvals

• AC guidance material

• DO-178C

• DO-254

• ARP4754A

• ARP4761

• FAA and EASA certification procedures

• Understanding of RF systems, GNSS technology, antennas, avionics, and aircraft integration considerations.

• Familiarity with quality management systems and configuration management processes.

Leadership and Communication

• Excellent project management and organizational skills.

• Strong ability to communicate with engineering teams, executives, customers, and certification authorities.

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Strong technical writing and documentation capabilities.

• Effective presentation and negotiation skills.

## Additional Requirements

• Experience with antenna certification for aviation or airborne applications is considered an asset.

• Experience with GNSS, avionics, airborne systems, aerospace electronics, or communications systems is considered an asset.

$110,000-$140,000

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview:

The Investor Relations Analyst will play an important role in how BWXT communicates its strategy, financial performance and long-term growth opportunities to the investment community. As a member of a highly visible function within the organization, the Analyst will work closely with the Vice President of Investor Relations and have significant exposure to the Chief Financial Officer, as well as other members of BWXT’s senior leadership team, including the Chief Executive Officer.

This position offers a unique opportunity to develop a deep understanding of BWXT’s businesses, strategy and financial performance while gaining firsthand exposure to the capital markets and the perspectives of institutional investors and equity research analysts.

The Analyst will contribute directly to quarterly earnings, investor presentations, investor meetings and conferences, financial and competitive analysis, and other strategic communications. The role will also support senior management with market intelligence and analysis that help inform the company’s investor messaging and strategic priorities.

## Location:

On site in Charlotte, NC, or Tysons Corner, VA.

## Your Day to Day as an Analyst, Investor Relations:

Investor Messaging

• Support the development of BWXT’s external investor communications, including quarterly earnings releases, earnings call scripts, investor presentations, conference materials and other public disclosures.

• Work directly with Investor Relations leadership, the CFO and other senior executives to develop clear, compelling and fact-based messaging around BWXT’s financial performance, strategy and long-term outlook.

• Develop materials and analyses to prepare senior management for investor meetings, conferences, earnings calls and other interactions with the investment community.

• Help translate complex financial, operational and strategic information into concise and compelling messages for investors and analysts.

Financial & Capital Markets Analysis

• Develop and maintain financial analyses and models evaluating BWXT’s historical performance, outlook and key business drivers.

• Analyze financial results and operating trends to identify key drivers of performance and explain variances versus expectations.

• Monitor BWXT’s valuation, trading performance, investor expectations and relevant capital markets developments.

• Conduct detailed peer and competitive analysis, including financial performance, valuation, strategy, investor messaging and market expectations.

• Analyze sell-side research, investor feedback and market data to identify emerging themes and provide actionable insights to Investor Relations and senior management.

Earnings & Investor Engagement

• Play an active role in the quarterly earnings process, including financial analysis, development of key messages, preparation of supporting materials and senior management preparation.

• Support investor meetings, roadshows, conferences and other engagement with institutional investors and research analysts.

• Prepare executive briefing materials that summarize investor perspectives, analyst expectations, industry developments and other relevant topics.

• Track investor and analyst feedback and helps identify trends in market perception of BWXT and its strategy.

Strategic & Cross-Functional Initiatives

• Develops a deep understanding of BWXT’s businesses by working across finance, strategy, operations, legal, communications and business leadership.

• Supports Investor Relations and senior management on strategic initiatives that may include capital allocation, M&A, portfolio strategy, long-range planning and other activities focused on creating shareholder value.

• Conducts research on industry trends, BWXT’s end markets, competitors and broader financial-market developments to help inform the company’s external messaging and strategic decision-making.

• Supports major investor-facing initiatives, including Investor Days and other strategic presentations.

• Maintains BWXT’s Investor Relations website and helps ensure investor-facing information is accurate, timely and consistent.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.

• Minimum of 6 years of experience in financial analysis, equity research, corporate finance, or investment banking.

• Basic understanding of investment concepts and capital markets dynamics.

• Strong analytical skills with a solid understanding of financial modeling, data analysis, and valuation techniques.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• High attention to detail and the ability to operate under tight deadlines while managing multiple tasks and priorities.

• High proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) L clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• MBA or relevant professional certification (CFA, CPA).

• Knowledge of financial market data software (e.g., Bloomberg, CapIQ, Factset).

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Position Overview:
Responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining health and safety programs within the HPDU program at NOG-J. This role involves conducting risk assessments, ensuring compliance with safety regulations, and promoting a culture of safety across the organization. The role will work closely with employees and management to mitigate risks, improve safety practices, and foster a safe working environment.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a Health & Safety Professional:

• Develops, implements, and maintains health and safety policies and procedures in accordance with applicable regulations and industry standards.

• Ensures that health and safety programs are effectively communicated and implemented throughout the organization.

• Conducts regular risk assessments and safety audits to identify potential hazards and recommends corrective actions.

• Monitors workplace conditions and practices to ensure compliance with safety regulations and standards.

• Designs and delivers training programs on health and safety topics to employees, supervisors, and management.

• Ensures that all employees are informed of safety policies, procedures, and emergency response plans.

• Leads investigations into workplace accidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, documenting findings and recommending corrective actions.

• Prepares reports on incidents and safety performance metrics for management review.

• Stays up to date with changes in health and safety regulations, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal laws.

• Serves as the primary point of contact with regulatory agencies during inspections and audits.

• Fosters a culture of safety within the organization, encouraging employee participation in safety programs and initiatives.

• Collaborates with managers and supervisors to integrate safety into day-to-day operations.

• Analyzes health and safety data and trends to identify areas for improvement and recommend changes to policies or practices.

• Prepares and presents regular reports on safety performance, compliance status, and program effectiveness to management.

• Develops and implements emergency response plans and procedures, ensuring staff are trained and prepared for potential emergencies.

• Conducts regular drills and training sessions to assess readiness and improve response capabilities.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in occupational health and safety, Environmental Science, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in health and safety management, preferably in an industrial or chemical manufacturing environment that utilizes hazardous materials.

• Strong knowledge of safety regulations, procedures, and best practices (e.g., OSHA, EPA).

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage employees at all levels.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and safety management software.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree.

• Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Occupational Health and Safety Technician (OHST)) are preferred.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, NSE, BSE, Airtel, HDFC, SBI , PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology and your hard work!

About the Role

Solace is seeking a dynamic Partner Manager Europe to lead and expand our partner ecosystem across Europe. This management role is pivotal in driving partner-sourced revenue, scaling joint go-to-market initiatives, and strengthening Solace’s position as the partner of choice for enterprise-grade event-driven and agentic AI solutions.

What You’ll Do

• Partner Ecosystem Growth: Execute a regional partner strategy aligned with global objectives. Build and scale relationships with GSIs, ISVs, VARs, cloud providers, and MSPs in Europe.

• Business Development: Identify, onboard, and enable high-potential partners. Drive joint selling, co-marketing, and partner-sourced pipeline growth.

• Operational Excellence: Implement scalable partner programs including enablement, certification, incentives, and MDF. Establish KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure impact.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure seamless partner engagement and execution.

• Leadership: Represent Solace at industry events and executive forums.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 5-10+ years in partnerships, account management (sales), business development, or channel leadership within enterprise technology.

• Deep knowledge and understanding of Integration in general: API management, iPaaS and where Event-Driven-Architecture including Agentic AI fits in the eco-system.

• Proven success in building and scaling partner programs across diverse geographies.

• Strong executive presence and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience with partner-led GTM models and driving measurable revenue outcomes.

• Excellent communication (English), strategic thinking, and leadership skills.

• Ability to work without sponsorship required.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

#CareersThatKickSaaS! TrueContext is a field intelligence platform that connects frontline workers to enterprise systems of record, so teams in the field can capture, act on, and learn from structured data in real time. We serve enterprise customers in Med Tech, Building Systems, Utilities, and Oil and Gas. Backed by Battery Ventures, we are scaling the platform and building the defining name in field intelligence.

About the role

TrueContext is hiring a Product Operations Analyst to help our product team make faster, better-informed decisions. You'll own the data, processes and tools that connect product management with engineering, customer success, sales and support.

You'll report to the SVP of Product and work closely with product managers on planning, launches and customer feedback. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes turning messy inputs into clear systems and useful insight.

What you'll do

• Product data and reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track adoption, feature usage, retention and other product health metrics. Answer ad hoc questions from PMs and leadership with clear, well-sourced analysis.

• Customer feedback loops: Collect, tag and synthesize feedback from support tickets, sales calls, surveys and in-app channels. Turn recurring themes into evidence PMs can use to prioritize.

• Planning and roadmap operations: Run the mechanics of quarterly planning, roadmap reviews and OKR tracking. Keep the roadmap and backlog accurate and visible to stakeholders.

• Launch coordination: Manage release checklists, readiness reviews and internal communication so sales, support and marketing are ready on launch day.

• Process and tooling: Own and improve product tools such as Jira, Confluence and our product analytics platform. Document workflows, set standards and automate repetitive manual work.

• Measurement and experiments: Help PMs define success metrics before a launch and report on results after it. Support in-app surveys, onboarding flows and A/B tests.

• Internal communication: Write release notes, product updates and monthly reports that keep the company informed about what shipped and why.

What you'll bring

• 2 to 4 years of experience in product operations

• Hands-on experience with a BI or product analytics tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Amplitude, Pendo or Userpilot

• Working knowledge of agile development and tools like Jira and Confluence

• Clear writing and speaking, including the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences

• Strong organization and the ability to run several projects at once without dropping details

• A habit of simplifying: you notice repeated manual work and fix it

What success looks like

• First 30 days: Learn the product, our customers and how the team plans and ships. Audit existing dashboards, tools and processes, and meet key partners in engineering, customer success, sales and support.

• By 60 days: Own the core product metrics dashboard and the regular reporting cadence. Ship at least one process or tooling improvement that saves the team measurable time.

• By 90 days: Run a full launch or planning cycle end to end. Deliver a customer feedback synthesis that shapes the next quarter's priorities.

Work Arrangement

• Hybrid (3x per week in office) at our Kanata headquarters

• Open to remote Canada. Occasional travel to headquarters may be required

Some Extra Benefits

• Company-wide & team social events

• Wellness yearly allowance

• Great time off benefits (4 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day)

• Catered lunches 2x per week

• An amazing office space with plenty of snacks, drinks, and space to collaborate

Salary Range

• $90,000 - $130,000 CAD base salary

If you are looking for the opportunity to embrace and be part of a truly unique company culture, this opportunity might just be for you!

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

As a senior technical contributor on the Optical Systems Performance (OSP) Team, the Optical Systems Engineer advances end-to-end optical fiber sensing architectures and system designs spanning coherent modems, optical line systems, telemetry, signal processing, analytics, and application interfaces. The role applies theoretical and experimental optical engineering expertise to current and next-generation platforms, helping translate customer and business needs into integrated sensing system designs.

## How you will make an impact:

• Own end-to-end optical fiber sensing architectures within the OSP team, translating customer and business needs into system requirements, architecture decisions, interface definitions, performance budgets, and technical roadmaps.

• Lead the design and integration of sensing solutions across coherent modems, optical line systems, embedded telemetry, timing and synchronization, data transport, signal processing, analytics, and application interfaces.

• Define sensing performance metrics and system specifications, develop link and noise budgets, identify key trade-offs, and validate designs through analytical modeling, numerical simulation, laboratory experiments, and field trials.

• Provide technical leadership from concept through implementation, verification, deployment, and lifecycle support, including design reviews, risk management, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex cross-domain issues.

• Develop and apply optical engineering expertise in fiber propagation, coherent detection, optical amplification, optical switching, link engineering, impairments, and measurement science to ensure sensing functions coexist with communications performance.

• Plan and execute laboratory and field investigations of modem-based and line-system-based sensing, including experimental design, instrumentation, data acquisition, signal analysis, performance characterization, and interpretation of results.

• Collaborate with hardware, modem, software, systems, product line management, solutions engineering, services, and customer teams to drive architecture alignment, integration priorities, demonstrations, and deployment readiness.

## The must haves:

• Education: Graduate or post-graduate degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline, with application of optical engineering to communications, sensing, or complex photonic systems.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience with optical fiber sensing principles, signal processing, data analysis, and performance characterization, with the ability to connect physical phenomena to system-level requirements and observed measurements.

• Demonstrated ownership of complex system designs through requirements definition, architecture, modeling, prototyping, verification, integration, optimization, and deployment.

• Application of theoretical knowledge of fiber-optic propagation, coherent optical systems, noise and impairments, optical amplification, optical switching, polarization effects, and digital communications.

• Application of experimental optical engineering skills, including laboratory setup design, optical alignment and handling, calibration, uncertainty analysis, and use of oscilloscopes, signal generators, optical power meters, spectrum analyzers, polarization-control equipment, and related test instrumentation in an ESD-protected environment.

• Utilization of MATLAB and Python for development of models, analysis workflows, and reusable engineering tools.

• Proven ability to debug ambiguous, multidisciplinary system issues, make technical decisions with incomplete information, and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

## Nice to haves:

• Education: Advanced degree with research or industry experience in optical communications, distributed fiber-optic sensing, coherent sensing, photonics, or a related discipline.

• 5+ Years experience architecting sensing solutions that use coherent transponders or optical line-system telemetry, including timing, synchronization, data export, signal processing, and analytics.

• 5+ Years experience with laboratory or field trials, customer demonstrations, network planning, optical modeling tools, or deployment of sensing functions over operational telecom fiber.

• Knowledge of distributed acoustic, phase, strain, vibration, or environmental sensing techniques and their implementation or coexistence in optical line systems.

• Familiarity with embedded systems, telemetry pipelines, microservice architectures, cloud or edge analytics, APIs, and distributed-system optimization.

• Experience contributing to technical publications, patents, industry standards, or cross-functional product roadmaps.

• Experience applying LLMs and generative AI to engineering workflows, including technical research, data analysis, software development, automation, and validation of AI-generated outputs.

## Pay Range:

The annual pay range for this position is C$96,600 - C$154,400.

The Opportunity We're looking for a Staff Security Engineer to define and drive Fullscript's defensive threat detection, incident response, and AI-assisted SecOps capability across our cloud infrastructure, identity, endpoints, and application ecosystems. This role sits at the technical core of our Security function. You will architect modern detection systems, leverage AI/ML to automate SecOps workflows, and establish defensive testing practices for AI threat vectors. Partnering with Engineering and Platform teams, you will ensure our detection and response capabilities scale with Fullscript's fast-growing, AI-first infrastructure. The ideal candidate has owned enterprise-scale detection engineering and incident response end-to-end. You are a pragmatic, forward-thinking engineer who excels at designing AI-augmented SOC workflows, conducting targeted AI defensive testing, and converting threat telemetry into automated, high-precision detection and response systems. What You'll Do Detection Engineering & Defensive Strategy Set the multi-quarter technical direction for detection and response, and drive it across Security, Platform, and Engineering teams. Architect, author, and maintain advanced detection logic across SIEM, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, endpoint protection, and AI/ML pipelines. Establish detection coverage and defensive controls against emerging AI and agentic threat vectors (e.g., prompt injection, tool misuse, and data exfiltration patterns). Own the full rule lifecycle, from authoring and testing through tuning and retirement, and measure it against concrete signals: detection coverage, precision (false-positive rate), and time-to-detect. Create and maintain dashboards and reporting that give leadership visibility into alert volume, response times, and trends over time. AI-Augmented Security Operations & Automation Design and deploy AI-assisted investigation workflows that leverage LLMs and automated agents to accelerate triage, context enrichment, and threat containment. Build and extend internal security tooling to support identity resolution, cross-source log correlation, and natural-language querying over security telemetry. Automate the handoff between detection tooling and our ticketing system so investigations move from alert to resolution with minimal manual work. Incident Response & Investigations Lead and support security investigations end-to-end, from initial triage through containment and resolution. Mentor Security Operations team members and set the standards the team builds against, including rule quality, detection-as-code practices, and investigation rigor. Partner with relevant teams across the business to investigate and remediate security escalations surfaced from Customer Support, Customer Delivery, and internal teams. Maintain and improve response playbooks based on lessons learned from real investigations. Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to security incidents outside business hours. AI Defensive Testing & Validation Threat model new and existing systems, including AI agents and services, to identify what could go wrong, what we would need to see to catch it, and how we would respond. Lead defensive testing, purple-teaming, and adversarial validation exercises to test alert fidelity and evaluate detection resilience against AI-driven threats. Partner with Platform and Engineering teams to ensure new AI services and features expose necessary logging and telemetry for effective security monitoring. Evaluate authorization and access-control changes for security-relevant blast radius, and drive remediation with the engineering teams that own the affected systems. Threat Intelligence Operationalize threat intelligence into actionable detections and tracked follow-up work. Coordinate indicator of compromise (IOC) blocking across endpoint, network, and web layers. What You Bring to the Table 8+ years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or security engineering, with demonstrated leadership in shaping organizational security strategy. Practical experience incorporating AI tooling into SecOps workflows, along with familiarity with detection strategies for AI-specific threat vectors. Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, JavaScript, or similar) and experience building workflows in a SOAR-style or workflow automation platform. Experience managing security controls as code (e.g., Terraform), with changes made through peer review rather than manual console changes. Experience securing cloud environments (AWS preferred) and modern SaaS/identity stacks. Hands-on incident response experience: triage, investigation, containment, and postmortem/playbook development. Working knowledge of adversary tradecraft (MITRE ATT&CK) and the ability to translate it into practical, tuned detections rather than noisy alerts. Proven ability to partner directly with engineering and infrastructure teams to define telemetry and control requirements for systems you don't own. Excellent written communication. This role regularly turns investigation findings into clear, factual updates for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. Bonus if You Have Experience contributing to or building from open detection content, such as Sigma rules or community rule repos. Experience collaborating with red/purple-team exercises to validate detection coverage. Experience supporting a healthcare, regulated, or otherwise highly sensitive-data environment. Relevant certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GCTI, GCDA, or equivalent practical experience). Why Fullscript Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door. What to Know Before You Apply We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page. A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly. Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at accommodations@fullscript.com. All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws. ## Job Summary

This pioneering role will be instrumental in identifying high-impact opportunities, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting enterprise applications and AI-enabled solution, and ensuring responsible implementation aligned with our business objectives, security protocols, and compliance standards.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, regulations, and ethical standards.

• An advanced degree may substitute for a portion of the experience requirement.

• Related experience includes work in application/software development, systems engineering, AI/ML implementation, automation, or systems integration. Strong understanding of machine learning, natural language processing, and data engineering, plus a strong application development background, preferably designing and delivering full-stack enterprise applications.

• Proficiency in Python and experience with one or more additional modern programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, or Java.

• Experience with enterprise-grade AI platforms; experience developing solutions within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (e.g., Azure OpenAI/Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, or comparable services) is strongly preferred.

• Deep knowledge of cybersecurity principles, data protection, secure software development, and responsible AI practices, including identity and access management, authentication/authorization, API security, secrets management, vulnerability management, logging, and auditing.

• Experience with modern software engineering and DevSecOps practices, including Git or comparable source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment, Docker/Kubernetes or comparable container technologies, and application monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

## Welding Engineering Unit Manager - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, Ohio

The Weld Engineering Unit Manager leads a diverse team of welding engineers, technicians, and specialists within the Welding Engineering department, ensuring alignment with company and customer objectives related to the fabrication of NOG components. This role is responsible for managing staffing, welding processes, quality, safety, schedule, and cost to achieve high-quality weld fabrication.This supervisory role requires collaboration across departments to optimize weld process efficiency, reduce defects, and support future welding technology initiatives.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Responsible for leading a diverse group of welding engineers, technicians and other specialists within the Welding Engineering (W.E.) department to achieve all company and customer commitments as related to the fabrication of NOG components. Responsible for ensuring the W.E. unit is properly aligned and supportive of all company objectives as it relates to the development, staffing, execution and overall quality of the weld process and associated operations. This alignment includes all aspects of Safety, Quality, Schedule and Cost associated with the weld process.

• Coordinates and controls welding engineers’ job functions to provide uniform, coordinated direction of the company’s short and long range goals.

• Assures staffing levels to support administrative and shop management needs including personnel proposal, requisitioning, interviewing and hiring activities.

• Works collaboratively and takes the lead in assuring welding equipment and welding cells can be operated in a safe manner free of injury.

• Reviews engineering drawings to assure they provide for economic fabrication of highest quality.

• Works within and outside department to pre-plan future needs to assure the timeliness of equipment, weld development, weld and welder qualifications, training, execution, testing and any other aspect of the job associated with the weld overall process.

• Assures technical welding engineering support for shop welding surveillance for all welding processes.

• Works collaboratively with other departments, as required, to identify funding needs, constraints, equipment/parameter problems for assuring the timely completion of the weld process relative to the overall schedule needs.

• Works collaboratively with Operations to define the weld process capability, weld process robustness and weld process limitations to establish expectations associated with the efficient deposition of the weld, while achieving first time quality.

• Works to decrease (or “improve”) weld and associated non-weld repair rates through an active and collaborative management style.

• Works within W.E. unit and department to specify welding processes and procedures to be employed through preparation of weld data sheets in accordance with contract requirements.

• Initiates welding procedure qualifications to support contract requirements.

• Evaluates welding performance through analysis of the Weld Defect Report. Initiates necessary corrective actions after considering economic, scheduler and quality impact.

• Responds to shop welding and welding metallurgical problems to effectively resolve the problem and yet maintain work within contractual obligations and corporate commitments.

• Identifies areas for improving overall weld operation efficiency through a collaborative understanding of the equipment, set-up, personnel, training and weld process capabilities vs the weld process robustness to assure first time quality.

• Provides technical justification for DSRs (Degradation of Specification Reports) and RARs (Repair Approval Requests) on all contracts.

• Identifies the risks associated within the contract and within shop operations associated with welding and works collaboratively to resolve concerns.

• Coordinates and supports proposal activities to assure all aspects of Safety, Quality, Schedule and Cost can be achieved and a gap analysis with guidance where risks exist.

• Organizes and supports the preparation of technical weld related comments to documents referenced in proposals.

• Participates in negotiations, as required, with customer to facilitate fair and equitable solutions assuring schedule, technical and price commitments are achievable and have the appropriate risks identified and accounted for.

• Establishes, analyzes, and negotiates programs or technical changes that result from customer inquiries or internal recommendations.

• Works within department and with associated departments to establish weld wire needs, quantities and special qualification requirements for individual proposals and overall NOG Contracts.

• Negotiates welding related technical requirements at proposal state and throughout contract term.

• Resolves customer concerns with respect to procedure qualifications and weld data sheets.

• Initiates actions for fabrication and testing of welding procedure qualifications.

• Interprets the requirements of NAVSEA 250-1500-1, ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, and customer specifications related to welding to assure that all fabrication meets contract requirements.

• Participates in Planning and evaluating welding research and development related to future program initiatives and manages customer workscopes that apply to future welding technology.

Job Qualifications / Requirements:

• Bachelor of Science Degree preferred in Welding Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or other engineering field and proven leadership and management of others.

• 3 years minimum of experience in the pressure vessel field or equivalent training in the heavy equipment or construction field

• Must be able to obtain government security clearance.

Position Overview: The Welding Specialist is a key technical role focused on providing expert guidance and support in welding operations within a manufacturing setting. This position entails following detailed manufacturing plans while supporting shop personnel to ensure adherence to quality standards and procedural compliance during critical welding activities.

## Location:

On-site in Barberton, Ohio

## Your Day to Day as a Welding Specialist (Back Shift):

• Supports site wide initiatives for streamlining manufacturing for welding related applications (standardization or work scopes, work cell development/ownership, process improvements, etc.).

• Programs welding parameters on programmable equipment.

• Trains and assists welders/operators in production welding environment on process, welding equipment, qualification requirements, etc.

• Follows detailed manufacturing plans, providing direction to shop personnel and supervision.

• Support equipment related improvement projects such as identifying and procuring new welding equipment, coordinating PM activities for existing equipment, evaluating spare parts inventory, etc.

• Prepares and reviews welding/fabrication support material and training aids (i.e., bead placement sketches, setup sheets, welding instructions)

## Required Qualifications:

• High school graduate, or equivalent.

• Ideal applicant has 3 – 5 years of welding experience in a shop environment

• Applicants should have a good understanding/working knowledge of manual, semi-automatic, and mechanized/automatic welding processes such as the following: SMAW, GTAW, AGTAW-CW/HW, AGMAW, SAW, SA-GMAW.

• Hands-on welding experience not required but is desirable to aid in training of shop personnel

• Ability to work on a PC, using Microsoft Office applications (Outlook (email), Word, Excel, etc.)

• Ability to work well with various departments such as hourly personnel, shop supervision, Engineering support, etc.

• Ability to follow detailed manufacturing plans and provide direction to shop personnel

• Ability to demonstrate superior written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Availability to work overtime, some daily and occasional weekend support.

• Must be a U.S. citizen with no dual citizenship.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Formal welding technical education is a plus but not required (i.e. trade school)

• Experience with robotic welding is plus

## Position Overview:

BWXT Advanced Technologies (AT) is seeking a Computer Vision / Machine Learning R&D Engineer with an interest in applications of computer vision to complex manufacturing processes. Your skills in machine vision, analytics, machine learning, sensors or robotics will support the research and development of a wide range of nuclear products for space applications, clean power, and propulsion.

## Location:

This position is based on-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a Computer Vision / Machine Learning R&D Engineer:

• Develop physics informed and constrained machine learning models that are integrated with machine vision classifiers, to identify and classify manufacturing defects and process variation.

• Work on image classifiers, object detectors, video understanding models, multi-modal classifiers, etc.

• Work to develop and improve sensor systems and hardware based directly on model performance.

• Work with engineering teams to implement model pipelines and deploy the services at scale.

• Collaborate with data analysts to understand and find data patterns.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, computer science, data science, or a related field is required.

• A minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience is required.

• Must have experience in computer vision and machine learning, with a strong focus on deep generative models (e.g., GANs, VAEs, diffusion models).

• Must have experience in signal processing with demonstrated knowledge and application of signal processing techniques.

• Must be a self-starter and comfortable supporting multiple teams, systems and developing products.

• Travel (30-40%) domestic and international is required.

• Must be a US Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Position Overview:

The Metallurgical/Materials Engineering Intern supports the engineering team by assisting with materials testing, quality analysis, process improvement initiatives, and research activities related to metals and industrial materials. This role provides hands-on experience in laboratory work, data analysis, and real-world application of materials engineering principles within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, TN

## Your Day to Day as an Engineer Intern at NOGJ:

• Assist with metallurgical testing, including hardness tests, tensile tests, microstructure analysis, and failure investigations.

• Prepare and examine samples using metallurgical equipment such as microscopes, polishing tools, and cutting equipment.

• Support material characterization activities and help maintain accurate testing documentation.

• Collect and analyze data to evaluate material performance, quality trends, and process stability.

• Help identify and troubleshoot issues related to materials, coatings, heat treatment, and production processes.

• Work with engineers and production teams to support continuous improvement projects focused on material performance and reliability.

• Assist in updating material specifications, work instructions, and process records.

• Participate in research activities related to new alloys, material properties, or processing methods.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized laboratory workspace following company safety standards.

## Required Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

• Basic understanding of metals, alloys, material behavior, and testing methods.

• Familiarity with laboratory equipment and safe testing practices.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to collect, interpret, and present technical data clearly.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• U.S. citizenship

## Preferred Qualifications:

• A cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.

• Completed coursework in Statistics, Mechanics of Materials, and/or Solid Modeling.

• A strong passion for engineering innovation and learning in a nuclear environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with data analysis software (Minitab, MATLAB, Python) is a plus.

With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth, collaboration, and technical excellence. At our Oak Ridge, Tennessee Enrichment Operations site, you will join teams working at the forefront of advanced nuclear manufacturing, precision engineering, and mission‑critical national security programs. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you’ll find opportunities to challenge yourself, partner with seasoned experts, and contribute to innovation shaping the future of nuclear technology. Our work requires a wide range of skills, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who share a passion for meaningful impact and technical advancement.

Position Overview
As our Production Manager, you will lead high-volume CNC machining, parts cleaning, and assembly operations within a greenfield startup facility designed to produce 50,000 precision machines per year. Reporting directly to the CEO/COO, you will play a critical leadership role in building the production system from the ground up — establishing the workforce, defining operating rhythms, commissioning the equipment, and driving the facility from initial startup to full-rate production. You will hold full operational ownership for daily manufacturing output, quality, cost, safety, and reliability performance while serving as the primary production voice to executive leadership. This role is ideal for a driven manufacturing leader who thrives in fast-paced, highly technical, and ambiguous startup environments.

Location
On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee

Your Day to Day as a Production Manager
• Lead facility commissioning including equipment installation, tooling readiness, process qualification, and production verification across CNC machining, cleaning, and assembly operations.
• Develop a complete manufacturing ramp plan with milestones, resources, risk mitigation, and execution strategies aligned to launch timelines.
• Establish standard operating procedures, work instructions, control plans, and quality systems prior to first production.
• Build and operate the 2-shift production schedule and coordinate 3-shift maintenance operations to maximize equipment availability.
• Stand up ERP/MES systems and shop-floor data infrastructure to support real-time production visibility.
• Own daily, weekly, and monthly manufacturing output performance against the 50,000 units/year plan.
• Oversee CNC machining, parts cleaning, and assembly departments to ensure balanced capacity and smooth material flow.
• Establish and review KPIs including OEE, throughput, scrap/rework, cycle time, and first-pass yield.
• Drive capacity planning, production scheduling, and material coordination with Supply Chain to meet build requirements.
• Champion 5S, visual management, standardized work, and a highly disciplined operational culture.
• Direct maintenance operations, ensuring PM compliance, uptime performance, MTTR, and MTBF targets are achieved.
• Govern preventive maintenance programs and maintenance inventory strategies.
• Lead rapid response actions to downtime events with formal root cause and corrective action follow-up.
• Maintain in-process inspection protocols, SPC, MSA/Gage R&R, corrective action workflows, and quality checkpoints throughout machining, cleaning, and assembly processes.
• Lead Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma improvement efforts, conducting Kaizen events and eliminating operational waste.
• Ensure readiness for required certifications (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 or equivalent).
• Build the manufacturing workforce including supervisors, technicians, operators, and maintenance staff across all shifts.
• Implement onboarding, training, cross-training, and performance management cadences.
• Foster a safety-first, high-accountability culture with strong leadership presence on the production floor.
• Identify and develop high-potential employees and create succession plans for key roles.
• Serve as the ultimate safety authority; ensure compliance with OSHA, BWXT safety standards, LOTO, machine guarding, PPE, and chemical handling protocols.
• Lead accident investigations, environmental compliance efforts, and systemic corrective actions.
• Own the manufacturing budget including labor, consumables, tooling, MRO, and overhead.
• Build annual operating budgets, rolling forecasts, and capital requests in partnership with Finance.
• Identify cost-reduction opportunities through process optimization, scrap reduction, and labor efficiency improvements.
• Provide manufacturing cost inputs for product costing and business cases.
• Represent production on the executive leadership team, communicating performance, risks, and opportunities.
• Partner with Engineering on DFM reviews, change management, and NPI readiness.
• Collaborate with Supply Chain on material flow, vendor qualification, and supplier quality.
• Provide production capacity and lead-time support to Sales and Customer Service.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related technical field.
• Minimum 12–15 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
• Demonstrated success launching a new manufacturing facility or production line from startup through full-rate production.
• Hands-on expertise with CNC machining environments — turning, milling, multi-axis machining, tooling, fixturing, and machine capability.
• Experience leading parts cleaning operations (aqueous, solvent, ultrasonic) and associated waste-handling requirements.
• Background managing high-volume mechanical or electromechanical assembly operations (≥25,000 units/year).
• Experience managing preventive/predictive maintenance organizations.

• Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a manufacturing startup or rapid-scaling environment.
• Background in aerospace, defense, automotive, medical devices, or advanced industrial machinery.
• Experience implementing ERP/MES systems such as SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Plex, or equivalent.
• Experience with capital equipment procurement, process validation, and facility layout planning.
• Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt certification.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Flexible schedules and paid time off (as applicable for leadership roles).
• Professional development, mentorship, and continuing education support.
• A collaborative, inclusive workplace that values diverse perspectives.
• Opportunities to directly support high-impact national security and nuclear manufacturing missions.
• Continuous learning and long-term career advancement opportunities across BWXT.
