## Position Overview: Director of Engineering – Enrichment Operations

As the Director of Engineering for BWXT Enrichment Operations, you will lead the full engineering function responsible for delivering a production‑ready centrifuge product and a high‑precision, highly automated factory capability. You will oversee engineering strategy from early concept through prototype/pilot phases to full‑rate production, establishing core systems engineering and systems integration practices to ensure disciplined requirements management, interface control, verification/validation, and seamless subsystem integration. This role is pivotal in standing up a modern digital factory, enabling high‑volume production with aerospace‑grade quality and nuclear regulatory rigor.

## Location

On-site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee

## Your Day-to-Day as the Director of Engineering

Engineering Leadership & Organization
• Build, scale, and lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization spanning manufacturing, process, facilities, automation, industrialization, and precision systems.
• Serve as the technical authority for manufacturability, scalability, risk management, and readiness.

Systems Engineering (SE)
• Establish a modern systems engineering capability that includes requirements management, architecture development, interface control (ICDs), configuration management, verification and validation, and model-based systems engineering/digital thread practices.
• Define “Definition of Done” at each development gate and ensure complete, build-ready Product Readiness Packs (e.g., BOMs, routers, test plans).

Systems Integration (SI)
• Lead end‑to‑end integration of subsystems into the centrifuge product and supporting systems.
• Develop integration plans, lab capabilities, fixtures, and test regimes to validate subsystem and system-level performance.
• Collaborate with the CTO and ORNL Design Authority to align qualification evidence and change packages; support seamless integration with CMDF pilot builds and transfer to CMF industrialization.

Factory Design, Construction & Startup
• Lead design, build, and commissioning of a high‑precision manufacturing facility.
• Integrate automation, robotics, and digital factory systems to enable high throughput, traceability, and tightly controlled processes.

Manufacturing Excellence & DFx
• Deliver engineering solutions capable of automotive‑pace production with aerospace‑grade quality.
• Drive design for manufacturability, assembly, quality, cost, and industrialization (DFM/DFA/DFQ/DFC).

Quality, Safety & Compliance
• Ensure all engineering designs and processes meet nuclear regulatory, DOE, safety, and BWXT quality requirements.
• Embed compliance gates, audit readiness, and pre‑release checks throughout development.

Program Controls & Schedule
• Partner with Business Operations and Program Controls to maintain a resource‑loaded critical path schedule.
• Support earned value management (EVM) discipline and weekly KPI reviews (SPI/CPI, cost variance, schedule adherence).

Supply Chain & Technical Readiness
• Define technical acceptance criteria for supplier parts, processes, tooling, and special manufacturing steps.
• Support supplier onboarding speed, delivery performance, and technical readiness to protect schedule-critical components.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with CMDF (prototype/pilot operations), CMF (full-rate industrialization), the CTO/Technology organization, and Operations.
• Drive the transition from low‑rate initial production (LRIP) to full‑rate production (FRP) on cost and schedule.

## Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (advanced degree preferred).
• Fifteen (15+) years of progressive engineering leadership in high‑precision, highly regulated manufacturing environments (nuclear, aerospace, defense, automotive, semiconductor, or similar).
• Demonstrated experience designing, building, commissioning, and scaling a high‑precision manufacturing facility to high‑volume production.
• Strong expertise in advanced manufacturing, automation, precision machining, assembly, metrology, and inspection systems.
• Must be a U.S. citizen capable of obtaining and maintaining a DOE Q clearance; active clearance preferred.
• Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary engineering teams in a fast-paced, highly technical environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with automotive‑scale manufacturing and assembly; Lean/Six Sigma leadership.
• Hands-on experience deploying Industry 4.0, digital thread, digital twin, and smart factory systems.
• Experience guiding organizations from prototype/pilot phases to high‑rate production in startup‑like or greenfield environments.

## What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance (as applicable).
• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs, leadership training, and support for continuing education.
• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates diverse perspectives and enables collaboration across all generations.
• The opportunity to shape a mission‑driven organization advancing the future of energy and national security.
• Continuous learning and development opportunities to support long‑term career growth.

## Project Manager, Cyber Monitoring & Response

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

## What you need to know

The Bank of Canada is committed to protecting Canada's financial system and critical infrastructure through innovative and forward-thinking cybersecurity practices.

The Cyber Monitoring & Response (M&R) Portfolio is responsible for the capabilities that enable the Bank to detect, investigate and respond to cyber threats. As our cyber program continues to evolve, we are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of strategic initiatives that strengthen the Bank's cyber defence capabilities and operational resilience.

In this role, you will work closely with technical specialists, business stakeholders, project teams, vendors and senior leaders to deliver complex cybersecurity projects and achieve their intended business and operational outcomes.

## What you will do

As a Project Manager within the M&R Portfolio, you will:

• Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of complex cybersecurity projects, from initiation and options analysis through implementation, operational transition and benefits realization.

• Tailor delivery approaches to project complexity, risk and operational needs, and establish project charters, integrated plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, governance structures and delivery controls.

• Identify and manage project risks, issues, scope changes and interdependencies, recommend mitigation strategies, delivery trade-offs and decisions to sponsors and governance committees.

• Monitor performance and take corrective action when delivery deviates from approved scope, schedule, budget, quality or intended outcomes.

• Prepare and present concise status reports, options, recommendations and decision material to senior management, project sponsors and governance committees.

• Partner with clients and stakeholders across Cyber Security, Information Technology and other Bank departments, as well as vendors and external partners, to reconcile competing priorities, build effective relationships and establish shared accountability for project outcomes.

• Support portfolio planning by assessing priorities, delivery capacity, resource requirements and dependencies, while ensuring outcomes meet business, cybersecurity, operational-resilience, quality and governance requirements.

• Lead implementation readiness and transition to operations, provide project-management guidance to participants, and improve delivery practices, controls and methodologies across the Cyber Security Division.

## What you need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you bring significant experience applying project-management practices to deliver complex technology, cybersecurity or operational initiatives in a large enterprise environment. You have demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary project teams, managing project budgets and resources, establishing governance, and resolving complex risks, issues and interdependencies.

You can analyze ambiguous situations, develop practical options and recommendations, and communicate the implications of delivery trade-offs to senior leaders and governance bodies. You build productive relationships across organizational boundaries, influence stakeholders with differing priorities and maintain accountability for agreed outcomes.

You are experienced in adapting project-management methodologies to suit different delivery environments and in guiding project participants through planning, governance, risk management, implementation and transition to operations.

## Education and experience

The position typically requires relevant experience normally acquired through:

• six years of relevant experience with a bachelor's degree in a related field; or

• seven years of relevant experience with a college diploma in a related field; or

• an equivalent combination of education and experience.

## Nice-to-have

• Experience delivering cybersecurity, security operations, cloud security or technology infrastructure projects.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts such as threat detection, incident response, security monitoring, identity management or threat intelligence.

• Experience working in Agile, hybrid or iterative delivery environments.

• Familiarity with project portfolio management and strategic planning processes.

• Project-management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum or equivalent.

• Experience working within a highly regulated or critical-infrastructure environment.

## What makes this role exciting

This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of the Bank's cybersecurity capabilities. You will work alongside highly skilled cybersecurity professionals while leading initiatives that directly strengthen the organization’s ability to defend against evolving cyber threats. Your work will contribute to the protection of critical systems and services that support Canada's financial system.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

## Language requirement

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## ## Job Description

## Reduce Risk. Accelerate Remediation. Strengthen Security.

Are you passionate about reducing cybersecurity risk, improving vulnerability remediation, and leading teams that strengthen enterprise security? Do you believe in proactive risk management, operational excellence, and using actionable security intelligence to drive measurable improvements? We’re looking for a Vulnerability Management Lead to help advance vulnerability management and remediation across the cloud environments that support our applications and services.

## The Opportunity

As a Vulnerability Management Lead, you’ll lead a team of vulnerability management engineers responsible for identifying, tracking, prioritizing, and driving vulnerabilities through remediation to resolution. You’ll collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and security partners to reduce exposure, accelerate remediation timelines, and strengthen the security posture of a SaaS cloud environment supporting Unified Communications (UC) services.

You’ll help align vulnerability remediation with enterprise security standards, risk management objectives, and BOD 26-04 requirements. Working across security operations, application engineering, and infrastructure teams, you’ll use vulnerability intelligence, security monitoring, and risk metrics to identify gaps, improve processes, and drive measurable reductions in technology risk.

This role is ideal for a security leader who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, coordinating cross-functional teams, improving operational effectiveness, and building repeatable processes that deliver lasting security improvements.

## ## Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead the identification, tracking, prioritization, and remediation of infrastructure and application vulnerabilities. Maintain visibility into the vulnerability portfolio and drive findings through resolution within established remediation timelines.

Team Leadership & Workload Management: Lead and develop the vulnerability management engineering team. Establish priorities, balance workloads, coordinate assignments, and provide technical guidance to support timely and effective remediation.

Risk Management & Compliance: Drive remediation activities aligned with enterprise risk requirements, security policies, and BOD 26-04 obligations. Partner with application owners, vendor managers, and risk stakeholders to resolve vulnerabilities within required time frames.

Security Operations & Incident Response: Represent infrastructure vulnerability management during incident calls involving application vulnerabilities. Coordinate escalations, communicate remediation status, and collaborate with security teams to address emerging risks and operational concerns.

Vulnerability Intelligence & Threat Analysis: Monitor industry trends, emerging vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to assess potential organizational impact. Apply knowledge of common attack vectors, intrusion techniques, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework to support vulnerability prioritization and risk reduction.

Security Monitoring & Technical Analysis: Leverage vulnerability assessment tools, SIEM platforms, network traffic analysis, and security event correlation to investigate findings, validate remediation progress, and identify potential security gaps.

Risk Metrics & Executive Reporting: Develop, maintain, and quality-assure monthly vulnerability and risk metrics for management and executive stakeholders. Provide clear visibility into remediation progress, outstanding risks, compliance status, and opportunities for continued improvement.

Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in vulnerability management processes, compliance controls, and operational workflows. Develop and implement improvements that strengthen remediation accountability, improve efficiency, and reduce recurring security issues.

Documentation & Knowledge Management: Create and maintain team processes, procedures, operational standards, and training documentation. Ensure vulnerability management practices are consistent, repeatable, and aligned with enterprise security objectives.

Training & Team Development: Support onboarding, training, and ongoing development of vulnerability management engineers. Promote knowledge sharing, technical consistency, and effective collaboration across cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with application engineering, infrastructure operations, security operations, vendor management, and risk teams to resolve technical and process-related challenges and maintain accurate vulnerability records in the system of record.

Operational Excellence & Technology Evolution: Evaluate emerging security tools, assessment methodologies, and industry practices to improve vulnerability detection, remediation workflows, and overall security program effectiveness.

## ## What You Bring to the Team

• The Security Leader: Demonstrated ability to lead vulnerability management engineers, coordinate remediation activities, balance team workloads, and drive accountability across technical teams.

• The Vulnerability Management Expert: Hands-on experience with cybersecurity tools and technologies such as Qualys, Nessus, and Symantec, including vulnerability assessment, prioritization, tracking, and remediation.

• The Risk Management Mindset: Understanding of enterprise risk management, vulnerability remediation requirements, security controls, and compliance frameworks, including BOD 26-04, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS ASV.

• The Threat Intelligence Foundation: Knowledge of common attack vectors, adversary tactics and techniques, threat intelligence, security hardening, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• The Security Operations Toolkit: Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, including Splunk, security event correlation, monitoring programs, and investigation of security-related issues.

• The Technical Troubleshooter: Ability to investigate complex security, network, system, and application issues; analyze network traffic and packets; and identify practical solutions to vulnerability and remediation challenges.

• The Compliance and Reporting Partner: Experience maintaining vulnerability records, preparing risk metrics, supporting management reporting, and communicating remediation status and exposure to technical and executive stakeholders.

• The Process Improvement Driver: Ability to identify operational gaps, develop actionable solutions, establish repeatable processes, and build roadmaps that align vulnerability management activities with broader cybersecurity operations goals.

• The Collaborative Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing priorities, communicate technical findings, and drive remediation through resolution.

• The Technical Foundation: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• The Operationally Ready Professional: Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently and collaboratively, and participate in after-hours and weekend on-call rotations as business needs require.

## ## Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

• Security Certifications: Industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, GIAC certifications, or GCIH.

• Cloud Security & Risk Assessment: Experience with cloud enterprise security tools, risk assessment methodologies, security controls, and vulnerability management in SaaS or other cloud-based environments.

• Security Proxy & Network Analysis: Experience with URL filtering, web proxy technologies, network troubleshooting, packet analysis, and network security controls.

• Executive Reporting & Visualization: Demonstrated experience developing management presentations, executive dashboards, and operational reporting using tools such as PowerPoint and Visio.

• Regulatory & Compliance Expertise: Familiarity with vulnerability remediation mandates, security compliance requirements, and enterprise risk reporting, particularly BOD 26-04

• Operational Excellence: A track record of improving remediation timelines, reducing outstanding vulnerabilities, strengthening compliance, and delivering measurable reductions in security risk over time.

## Why Join Us?

Meaningful Security Challenges: Help protect cloud-based Unified Communications services by reducing vulnerabilities and strengthening enterprise security.

Security Leadership & Impact: Lead a team of engineers and collaborate across application, infrastructure, and security organizations to drive measurable improvements in risk reduction.

Data-Driven Risk Management: Use vulnerability intelligence, security monitoring, and executive metrics to prioritize remediation and improve security decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Shape vulnerability management processes, strengthen compliance practices, and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency and security outcomes.

Collaborative Cybersecurity Operations: Work with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges, improve remediation accountability, and advance cybersecurity operations.

A Culture of Operational Excellence: Help establish scalable, repeatable vulnerability management practices that support a more secure, resilient, and compliant cloud environment.

## Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• 6+ years of relevant IT or cybersecurity experience.

• 5+ years of security experience with hands-on exposure to cybersecurity products such as Qualys, Symantec, or Nessus.

• 3+ years of experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms.

• 3+ years of experience supporting or analyzing adversary tactics and techniques using the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, PCI DSS ASV, and BOD 26-04.

• Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to coordinate multiple initiatives, manage competing priorities, and drive remediation activities across cross-functional teams.

• Ability to support after-hours and weekend on-call rotations as required.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Industry-recognized cybersecurity certification in one or more of the following: CompTIA Security+, CISSP, GIAC, or GCIH.

• Experience with URL filtering, web proxy technologies, and troubleshooting.

• Experience creating executive presentations, developing risk metrics, and supporting management reporting.

• Demonstrated ability to improve vulnerability remediation timelines and deliver sustained, measurable reductions in organizational risk

## Principal Consultant - Open Banking and API Security

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

## What you need to know

We are seeking a Principal Consultant to provide technical leadership and strategic advice for the Bank's work related to open banking and secure financial APIs. Reporting to the Director, Supervision Portfolio, you will help shape architecture and security decisions for a high-trust financial ecosystem, with a particular focus on encryption keys, certificates, API security and interoperability.

As a trusted subject-matter expert, you will work across technology, security, risk and business teams to translate complex requirements into practical architecture, standards and implementation roadmaps. You will challenge assumptions, identify risks early and help ensure solutions are secure, scalable and aligned with industry standards and leading practices.

## What you will do

You will provide strategic and hands-on architectural guidance from early design through implementation. More specifically, you will:

• Shape open banking architecture: Define and evolve the target architecture for secure data sharing, participant connectivity and financial API ecosystems.

• Lead API security design: Establish patterns and controls for financial-grade APIs, including authentication, authorization, consent, token security and secure client onboarding.

• Guide FAPI adoption: Advise on FAPI 1.0 and FAPI 2.0 profiles, including migration considerations, interoperability and implementation choices.

• Strengthen cryptographic trust: Provide expertise in encryption-key lifecycle management, public key infrastructure, certificate issuance and rotation, mutual TLS and related trust services.

• Set standards and guardrails: Develop reference architectures, technical standards, decision records and reusable patterns for APIs, identity and certificate management.

• Challenge and validate solutions: Review designs, test assumptions and identify security, operational and integration risks before implementation.

• Connect technical and business needs: Explain complex security and architecture topics in clear language and provide decision-ready advice to senior leaders and delivery teams.

• Support delivery and capability building: Work with multidisciplinary teams, coach technical specialists and help resolve complex design and implementation issues.

## What you need to succeed

You bring deep technical expertise, sound judgement and the ability to influence decisions across organizational boundaries. You can move comfortably between strategy and implementation, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and produce concise, decision-ready recommendations.

Technical experience we are looking for includes:

• Open banking and financial ecosystems: Experience designing, implementing or governing open banking, consumer-driven banking, payments, fintech or comparable regulated data-sharing ecosystems.

• Financial-grade API security: Strong knowledge of FAPI 1.0 and FAPI 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API authentication and authorization, and secure consent-based data sharing.

• Encryption-key management: Experience with enterprise key-management services and the full cryptographic-key lifecycle, including generation, storage, access, rotation, revocation, recovery and audit.

• Certificates and trust services: Deep understanding of public key infrastructure, certificate authorities, digital certificates, mutual TLS, certificate-bound access and trust-chain management.

• API architecture and governance: Experience with API design, gateways, developer portals, versioning, lifecycle governance, observability and integration patterns.

• Security architecture: Ability to design secure solutions in regulated environments and align technical controls with enterprise risk, privacy and compliance requirements.

• Enterprise architecture: Experience developing target-state architectures, transition roadmaps, standards and reusable design patterns across complex organizations.

• Cloud-native architecture: Experience designing cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure, including scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized solutions.

## Nice-to-have

• Experience with open banking frameworks or ecosystems in Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia or the United States.

• Experience with financial ecosystem registries, accreditation models, digital identity or secure participant onboarding.

• Experience with cloud-based key vaults, hardware security modules and certificate-management platforms.

• Knowledge of payment architectures, financial-market infrastructure or digital-asset platforms.

• Relevant architecture, cybersecurity, cloud or identity certifications.

## Your education and experience

This position requires a degree or diploma in computer science, engineering, cybersecurity, information systems or a related field, together with a minimum of eight years of relevant experience in technology consulting, enterprise architecture, security architecture or solution architecture. A combination of education and experience may also be considered to determine whether you have the knowledge and skills required for the role.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• There will be no relocation assistance provided

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “Principal Consultant ”

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $153,721 to $180,848 (job grade 19)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health and dental coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service

L'équipe des solutions de confidentialité des données de Privacy Analytics recherche un scientifique des données associé pour développer une expertise en confidentialité des données, désidentification des données et contrôle de la divulgation statistique, avec un fort accent sur les données de santé.

En tant que membre de l'équipe des solutions de confidentialité des données, le principal objectif du scientifique des données associé sera d'aider aux engagements clients en se concentrant sur la mesure des risques de désidentification et de réidentification des données des clients. ## Responsabilités :

• Développer une expertise en contrôle de la divulgation statistique et en réglementations et normes de désidentification

The Privacy Analytics Data Privacy Solutions team is seeking an Associate Data Scientist to develop expertise in data privacy, data de-identification and statistical disclosure control, with a strong focus on health care data.

As part of the Data Privacy Solutions team, the primary focus of the Associate Data Scientist will be to assist with client engagements focusing on de-identification and re-identification risk measurement of client data. Further to formal training and on-the-job coaching in this role, responsibilities will include preparing data for measurement of the re-identification risk of client data sets, providing support for deliveries, assisting with delivery of remote coaching to clients and developing a strong understanding of relevant privacy regulations and standards.

A university degree with a strong focus on statistical modeling and/or data analytics is expected. The ability to gain information from various sources and apply them to new problems is important for success and growth within this role. Having good communication skills to present information in a clear and concise manner to internal stakeholders will be needed.

## Responsibilities:

• Develop expertise in statistical disclosure control and de-identification regulations and standards

• Support qualitative and quantitative re-identification risk analysis for a variety of clients in and outside of the healthcare domain, and support documentation of the results of these analyses in client-facing reports

• Validate data received from clients and prepare it for re-identification risk measurement

• Help prepare materials (presentations, reports, etc.) in support of delivery of data de-identification solutions to technical and business audiences

## Essential Qualifications:

• B.Sc in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics or related field

• 1 year of relevant work experience

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Strong math and statistics skills

• Experience performing data analysis, data exploration and data modeling (using SQL and R/Python)

• Knowledge of Privacy Analytics methodology

• Experience anonymizing data and preparing data for anonymization

• Experience supporting and tracking of multiple projects at various stages of development

• Ability to present work and explain findings to senior team members

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent problem-solving skills

## Asset Qualifications:

• A post graduate degree and research experience

• Experience working in a professional services organization, such as consulting

• Knowledge of statistical disclosure control or privacy laws

• Experience working with health, financial, or other consumer data

• Experience working with large data sets (TBs)

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/806.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

We at Solace believe we build the world's best event broker – the backbone of real-time business, trusted to move billions of messages a day across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments with unmatched reliability and performance.

At the heart of the Solace Event Broker lies the Datapath – the engine responsible for moving messages at high rate, with low latency and utmost reliability. The Dataplane Adapters team owns the protocol surface: the MQTT, AMQP, REST, RDP, and Kafka adapters that let clients and applications connect, publish, and consume messages. This work spans our custom hardware appliance – built around FPGAs and a Cavium network processor – and our software broker running on Intel server processors. The code is highly multi-threaded and performance-oriented, and our developers regularly go deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals to deliver features that meet our strict performance and reliability bar.

This position is for a Senior Software Developer on the Dataplane Adapters team. In this role you will be a key technical leader who contributes to the architecture of our protocol adapters and leads the design and delivery of the most complex features for how clients connect to the broker. You will shape technical direction across the hardware and software platforms, mentor other developers, represent the team with customers and other R&D groups, and be a go-to person for the hardest performance and field problems. Your expertise will shape how the world's largest enterprises move their most critical data.

Are You Someone Who:

• Has a passion for high-performance systems with a deep understanding of multi-threaded C++, TCP/IP, and the Linux kernel?

• Thrives on solving complex protocol and performance challenges in distributed messaging systems?

• Has experience building high-throughput, low-latency systems?

• Enjoys mentoring and leading technical teams while contributing to architectural decisions?

• Values craftsmanship, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences?

• Is humble, honest and open?

What You'll Do:

• Lead Adapter Design: Contribute to the architecture of our protocol adapters, lead the design and technical delivery of the most complex features across the hardware appliance and software broker, and own the technical decisions within those features

• Drive Technical Innovation: Research and prototype new protocol features, networking techniques, and performance approaches to keep the Solace datapath ahead of the industry

• Develop Core Platform Features: Design and build the most complex, performance-critical adapter features in multi-threaded C++, going deep into TCP, hardware interfaces, and OS internals when needed

• Mentor and Lead: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to intermediate and junior developers, lead design and code reviews, and establish best practices for the team, including how we use AI-assisted development in performance-critical code

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with product management, other datapath teams, hardware engineering, support, and customers to translate requirements into designs and to influence the product roadmap

• Ensure Quality and Performance: Define the testing and performance strategy for the adapters and lead the resolution of the hardest customer-found defects and performance escalations

• Stay Current: Stay ahead of messaging protocol standards, networking, and hardware trends, and apply this knowledge to drive continuous improvement at Solace

What You Bring:

• Systems Expertise: 10+ years of software development experience with 5+ years writing multi-threaded, performance-oriented code in C++

• Programming Excellence: Expert-level proficiency in C++, concurrency, low-level memory management, and debugging complex applications with core files and code

• Systems Design: Experience designing and building high-throughput, low-latency systems (for example messaging systems, network stacks, storage engines, or trading platforms)

• Networking Depth: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, and a willingness to go deep into protocol specifications, Linux kernel behaviour, and hardware interfaces when a problem needs it

• AI-Assisted Development: Demonstrated proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, and good judgment about where they help and where they do not in performance-critical code

• Technical Leadership: Proven track record of leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving complex technical projects to completion

• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

• Field Experience: Track record of leading the resolution of the hardest customer-found defects and performance escalations

• A team player who enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams

• Detail-oriented to ensure designs meet requirements and are built to high quality

Nice to Have:

• Experience in network programming (POSIX sockets) and HTTP/REST client implementation

• Experience tuning applications for latency on Linux (scheduling, CPU affinity, memory, and I/O)

• Experience with performance profiling tools (perf, flame graphs, hardware counters) and kernel-bypass networking

• Familiar with MQTT, AMQP, REST, Kafka, or other messaging protocols at the specification level

• Familiar with hardware network processors (e.g. Cavium Octeon)

• Familiar with TLS and protocol security

• Contributions to open-source projects, protocol standards bodies, patents, or conference talks

Why You'll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we're all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We're proud of our world-class customer lineup (we're not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We're social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We've got a great sense of humor and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Position Overview:
The Environmental Manager is responsible for the oversight, compliance, and continuous improvement of all environmental programs at the NOG‑J site, including munitions operations, HPDU activities, and waste processing operations. • Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP)

• NPDES

• SARA Title I, II, III (EPCRA reporting)

• Strong knowledge of federal and state environmental laws.

• Ability to interpret complex regulations and communicate requirements clearly to operations.

• Strong problem‑solving, leadership, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work across multiple shifts and manage competing priorities.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Experience working with hazardous waste programs and/or HPDU or radiological materials preferred.

## Position Overview:

As our Manufacturing/Materials Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring materials selected in design, analysis, and prototyping activities for new nuclear systems are compatible and acceptable.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Materials Engineer:

• Perform materials engineering duties in support of procurement, fabrication, joining and testing of raw material commodities.

• Provide innovative, technically significant, and economically critical material solutions in support of design and manufacturing of components.

• Oversee activities associated with material characterization.

• Perform failure analysis activities and identify failure modes of materials.

• Prepare material performance specifications.

• Prepare material evaluations and specifications for use in additive manufacturing applications.

• Communicate material related technical concepts across all levels of the organization and with the customer.

• Provide direction to weld development activities related to material issues.

• Work with design and manufacturing engineering to resolve materials joining, machining and processing issues before and during manufacturing.

• Develop, maintain and apply materials and material solutions to meet project thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and chemical requirements.

• Must have relevant engineering experience along with technical expertise and communication skills to coordinate multiple engineering activities simultaneously.

• Must have additive manufacturing experience.

• Must have hands-on experience and ability to work in a laboratory environment

• Must be able to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely written and verbal communication.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• • Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

As our Sr. Business Analyst – Special Materials, you will be responsible for identifying and maximizing financial opportunities through pricing strategy, cost optimization, capital efficiency and program profitability initiatives. Jonesborough, TN

• Strong knowledge of cost accounting, business forecasting, and investment analysis

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial analysis tools; experience with ERP systems

Position Overview:
The Program Manager – HPDU leads overall execution and performance of the HPDU program at BWXT NOG‑J. Serving as the primary integrator, the role coordinates technical, operational, financial, contractual, quality, supply chain, and schedule activities to meet program commitments. The manager develops execution strategy, translates customer and contractual requirements into actionable plans, and ensures risks, issues, and opportunities are identified and resolved early. Operating at both strategic and tactical levels, the role balances technical understanding with business objectives, cost, schedule, and risk. The manager maintains strong stakeholder interfaces and provides disciplined, timely, decision-focused assessments to senior leadership.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as a Program Manager, HPDU:

• Leads overall HPDU program planning, integration, execution, monitoring, and delivery.

• Establishes program objectives, priorities, execution strategy, and performance expectations aligned with contractual and business requirements.

• Maintains accountability for cost, schedule, technical performance, quality, compliance, customer commitments, and risk.

• Integrates engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, quality, finance, contracts, and project controls into a unified execution framework.

• Identifies and resolves cross-functional constraints, competing priorities, technical challenges, and execution risks.

• Develops and maintains the integrated program plan and master schedule, ensuring realistic sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and critical‑path management.

• Leads recovery strategies when performance deviates from plan, evaluating downstream impacts across the program lifecycle.

• Manages program financial performance through budgets, forecasts, cost monitoring, earned value principles, and timely communication of material changes.

• Ensures engineering decisions, configuration changes, technical risks, and readiness reviews are aligned with program objectives and downstream impacts.

• Synchronizes operational and manufacturing readiness, removing production constraints and supporting recovery when needed.

• Oversees supplier performance, critical procurements, long‑lead items, and supplier risk mitigation strategies.

• Ensures quality requirements, inspection, testing, documentation, and nonconformance management are fully integrated and compliant.

• Owns program risk and opportunity management, ensuring risks are characterized, mitigated, reviewed, escalated, and incorporated into plans.

• Serves as primary customer interface, managing relationships, communications, commitments, challenges, and recovery strategies.

• Administers contractual scope, change proposals, modifications, and ensures alignment of changes across baselines and documentation.

• Ensures disciplined change and configuration management, preventing uncontrolled changes and maintaining decision records.

• Leads the program team, establishing expectations, coaching talent, enabling escalation of concerns, promoting collaboration, and modeling BWXT values.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Program/Project Management, Operations, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.

• Significant progressive experience managing complex technical, engineering, manufacturing, or government programs.

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

• Demonstrated ability to manage programs involving significant technical, schedule, cost, and organizational complexity.

• Strong knowledge of program and project management principles, including scope, schedule, cost, risk, change, and stakeholder management.

• Experience developing and managing integrated schedules and major program milestones.

• Experience with program financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and cost performance.

• Demonstrated ability to identify emerging program problems and drive cross-functional corrective action.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with technical personnel, operations personnel, executives, customers, and external stakeholders.

• Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving capabilities.

• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively with incomplete information and make timely, risk-informed decisions.

• Ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a complex, highly regulated environment.

• Ability to meet applicable BWXT employment, security, access, and regulatory requirements associated with the position.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy (D.O.E.) security clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or advanced degree in an engineering discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Program Management, or a related field.

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or comparable program management credential.

• Experience managing programs within the nuclear, defense, Department of Energy, Department of Defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated industries.

• Experience with nuclear component or complex engineered-product manufacturing.

• Experience managing major government contracts.

• Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS).

• Experience with Integrated Master Scheduling and critical-path analysis.

• Experience with manufacturing planning, production control, supply chain management, and supplier performance.

• Experience with design-to-production transition and manufacturing readiness.

• Experience leading technical and programmatic risk-management processes.

• Experience managing contract changes, proposals, negotiations, and customer commitments.

• Familiarity with applicable nuclear quality requirements and regulated manufacturing environments.

Position Overview:

## Your Day to Day as a Project Manager, HPDU:

• Supports development and maintenance of project execution plans, milestone lists, action registers, risk registers, decision logs, and project status information.

• Coordinates assigned project activities across engineering, procurement, manufacturing/construction, quality, operations, project controls, and other supporting organizations.

• Owns and drives closure of assigned action items; confirm owners, required completion dates, dependencies, and evidence of completion.

• Supports formal change control by gathering scope, schedule, cost, risk, and stakeholder impacts for proposed changes.

• Participates in supplier, subcontractor, or internal work-package coordination meetings and track commitments affecting HPDU milestones.

• Assists in readiness reviews, design or execution reviews, project assessments, turnover activities, and closeout documentation as assigned.

• Develops working knowledge of HPDU project objectives, interfaces, key milestones, governance, applicable procedures, and stakeholder expectations.

• Demonstrates disciplined adherence to safety, quality, procedural compliance, and nuclear safety culture expectations in all project activities.

• Ability to organize information, manage multiple assignments, follow through on commitments, and communicate status accurately.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment.

• Proficiency with standard business applications and ability to learn applicable project management and scheduling tools.

## Position Overview:

The Nuclear Plant Integrated Project Team (IPT) Lead will be responsible for leading the overall plant integration for an advanced reactor development program. This role will coordinate overall plant activities with other IPT leads including System Design, Site, Reactor, and partners to facilitate identification and resolution of technical challenges. The Plant IPT’s scope of work includes integration of all systems and sub-systems comprising electrical, instrumentation and controls, and mechanical systems. This role will work closely with the program Chief Engineer and Lead Systems Engineer and is responsible for the development and execution of project schedules and budgets at the overall plant level.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, Virginia at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a Nuclear Power Plant Integrated Project Team (IPT) Lead:

• Serve as technical project manager leading the integration of the overall power plant project.

• Lead periodic cross-functional team meetings, focusing on task tracking, issue identification, and action tracking.

• Identify issues, monitor risks, and develop mitigation plans, including schedule and budget estimates.

• Lead efforts to identify and document needed project changes via change/risk release process.

• Review Design Change Requests (DCR) for impacts at the overall plant level and coordinate the implementation of the changes upon approval.

• Ensure changes to scope, delivery, and resources are maintained in the project schedule.

• Collaborate with procurement engineering, purchasing, quality, and suppliers to ensure purchased components meet technical, cost, delivery, and quality requirements.

• Drive for task completion, schedule, and budget adherence.

• Report weekly team progress reporting via 'Quad Chart.'

• Support other IPTs through meeting attendance and coordination.

• Coordinate with resource managers and supervisors to ensure adequate staffing and resource distribution.

• Provide regular reporting and briefings to project team, including critical issues, risks, and schedule performance.

• Support team load board efforts, as required.

• Offer technical guidance and oversight for project tasks and deliverables, including conducting thorough technical reviews of documentation.

• Communicate with internal and external customers/stakeholders on technical and programmatic issues.

• Coordinate with external partner technical leads to ensure deliverables and products are compliant with requirements and integrate into the overall plant seamlessly.

• Interface with customer technical leads to ensure customer needs and requirements are met at the overall plant level.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, nuclear or similar discipline) is required.

• A minimum of seven (7) years of related work experience is required.

• Must have a demonstrated technical background in system design and the integration of systems.

• Must be proficient standard Microsoft Office applications.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Must have the ability to self-direct with minimal day-to-day supervision.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Registered Professional Engineer licensure.

• Experience in the nuclear industry.

• Familiarity with NRC and/or DOE requirements.

• Familiarity with ASME BPVC, NQA-1, NFPA, INCOSE/IEEE Systems Engineering, and similar codes and standards.

• Active DOD or DOE security clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Position Overview:

As our Reactor Operations Engineer, you will provide operational insights and guidance to design engineers to ensure the development of reactor technologies employ operational principals. This position will participate in development of reactor plant operating strategies, concepts, and procedures, and will be deeply embedded with all aspects of reactor design and development activities to ensure systems integration and functionality meet the requirements for safe, efficient, and reliable operations. This role will also provide support to terrestrial, maritime, microreactor, and space reactor projects.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as an Reactor Operations Engineer:

• Lead the development and implementation of reactor operating strategies.

• Lead the development of the reactor concept of operations to describe the use of the system from the perspective of the reactor operator, encompassing all modes of operation.

• Lead the preparation of reactor operating procedures, including normal and off-normal conditions and events, surveillance procedures, alarm response procedures, etc.

• Lead the development and preparation of nuclear operations and engineering training materials.

• Integrate and coordinate across disciplines to implement operating approaches for safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations.

• Support reactor simulator development, to include interfacing with multiple organizations and contractors, aggregating design data, and developing scenarios for evaluations.

• Support development of control algorithms for semi-autonomous and/or manual operations.

• Support the evaluation of integrated plant response to various events, accidents, and malfunctions.

• Support the design of plant control and monitoring interfaces, including the Human Machine Interface in the control room as well as other operator interfaces.

• Develop operations training material for internal and external customer use.

• Collaborate with designers for optimized maintainability of the systems.

• Participate in design reviews and provide feedback from an operations and maintenance perspective.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of four (4) years of experience in nuclear operations or engineering is required; on-the-job training in nuclear operations does not count toward the experience requirement.

• Must be familiar with the interrelationships and dependencies of reactor systems, encompassing nuclear, mechanical, I&C and electrical systems – and their response as an integrated power plant system.

• Must be familiar with the operation and maintenance of reactor equipment.

• Must have demonstrated ability to collaborate through influence within matrixed organizations.

• Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• SRO or RO license from a civilian nuclear power plant, or EWS/EOOW qualification from the U.S. Navy.

• Prior experience with the development and implementation of control schemes for nuclear plant operations in normal and off-normal conditions.

• Nuclear Operations Training experience.

• Nuclear Reactor Simulator Design and maintenance experience.

• Familiarity with high temperature gas reactor technologies.

• Experience in the design of fluid systems.

• Experience in the design of I&C systems.

• Experience in the design of electrical systems.

• Experience working with U.S. Government customer (e.g., DOD, DOE, NASA).

## Position Overview:

As our Licensing Manager, you will serve as both a senior-level subject matter expert in advanced reactor licensing and lead others in the execution of licensing activities and regulatory engagements related to BWXT AT’s commercial reactor technology programs. You will collaborate closely with engineering disciplines, commercialization and business development teams, and project personnel to execute licensing plans for BWXT AT and our customers. Your goal will be to ensure that regulatory strategies are developed and implemented, regulatory requirements are identified and integrated into our technology and projects, and support engagements and licensing activities with one or more regulatory authorities.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA or Remote

## Your Day to Day as a Licensing Manager:

• Develop and implement project licensing plans for advanced reactor technology development and delivery, primarily focused on the U.S. commercial regulatory framework. This may involve aspects such as nuclear safety, nuclear security, emergency planning, reactor design and analysis, code development and qualification, financial and environmental law, and safeguards.

• Plan, coordinate, and support development of licensing and regulatory deliverables, including technical and topical reports, license application content, and other documents for regulatory engagement and review.

• Develop regulatory strategies and approaches to address key technical and programmatic issues related to BWXT AT’s reactor technology development, leading efforts to resolve these matters.

• Lead the development and defense of the licensing basis for one or more reactor technologies and associated customer projects.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to develop technical design bases and integrate regulatory requirements into reactor technology.

• Support the creation of testing programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Lead regulatory discussions on technical and programmatic issues in line with program plans.

• Work with project management teams to develop budgets and schedules that achieve regulatory outcomes.

• Facilitate communication with internal and external stakeholders concerning the execution of licensing activities and program plans.

• Perform general office duties as assigned.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering is required (nuclear, mechanical, civil, environmental engineering).

• At least five (5) years in a management or supervisory role is required.

• A minimum of ten (10) years of experience in nuclear licensing and regulatory matters within a U.S. framework (NRC or DOE) is required.

• Experience in the design, evaluation, and technological development of nuclear systems is required.

• Must demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, accurately, and timely in both written and verbal formats.

• Must have proven capacity to develop effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, showcasing a collaborative team-oriented approach.

• Must have exceptional interpersonal skills necessary to manage simultaneous licensing activities across various stakeholders.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) and/or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance.

• Subject matter expertise in one or more areas (e.g., safety analysis, ASME code implementation, radiation safety) is preferred.

• Experience leading and managing teams within regulatory/licensing or engineering environments is preferred.

## Position Overview:

This position offers a unique opportunity to create and improve processes for our organization, shaping the future of engineering in a critical and dynamic industry.

• Two (2) years of relevant experience.

• Strong data and process interpretation and evaluation skills.

• Clear and concise communication, both orally and in writing.

• Technological proficiency to use various computer systems to produce reports and spreadsheets.

• Timely completion of multiple tasks and deadlines set by management in a team environment.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

• Strong grasp of numerical and mechanical practices and processes.
• Working knowledge of statistical methods.
• Exposure to Lean and Six Sigma manufacturing concepts.
• Ability to apply Lean manufacturing principles to production and design processes.
• Experience with engineering theory related to production lines and system/device design or evaluation.
• Awareness of workplace safety regulations and safe‑work practices.
• Understanding of engineering economics and budget planning.
• Familiarity with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

## Position Overview: Systems Engineer – Digital Manufacturing & Systems Integration

As a Systems Engineer supporting BWXT’s High Purity Depleted Uranium (HPDU) production capability, you will play a lead role in developing and integrating the digital, automated, and highly connected manufacturing environment required for pilot, initial-rate, and future full-scale production. You will drive systems architecture, digital manufacturing technology deployment, automation integration, and cross-disciplinary requirements management to establish BWXT’s “Facility of the Future.” This role bridges engineering, IT, operations, quality, and enterprise systems—ensuring they operate cohesively to support a scalable, compliant, and high‑performance production capability.

## Location

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

Your Day-to-Day as a Systems Engineer – Digital Manufacturing & Systems Integration

• Develop and maintain the integrated manufacturing systems architecture for HPDU production.
• Lead integration of manufacturing execution systems (MES), laboratory systems, automation platforms, material tracking technologies, ERP systems, analytics platforms, and engineering tools into a unified operating environment.
• Partner with IT to define and execute a digital roadmap supporting phased manufacturing deployment.
• Evaluate, recommend, and implement advanced technologies including AI-enabled tools, industrial analytics, digital twins, model‑based engineering tools, and advanced automation.
• Support requirements development, interface control, and system integration across engineering and operational disciplines.
• Lead vendor and technology evaluations for manufacturing software, automation systems, analytics platforms, and digital tooling.
• Develop system requirements, functional specifications, interface control documents, and integration plans.
• Ensure manufacturing systems comply with nuclear quality requirements, configuration management standards, cybersecurity controls, and regulatory expectations.
• Support commissioning, operational readiness, and long-term sustainment of digital and manufacturing systems.
• Drive continuous improvement through data analytics and digital-transformation initiatives across the production enterprise.

## Desired Technical Experience

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:
• Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
• Industrial Automation (PLC, SCADA, HMI)
• Manufacturing Data Historians (e.g., OSIsoft PI)
• ERP integration (SAP preferred)
• Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
• Industrial networking, OT/IT integration
• Digital Manufacturing and modernization initiatives
• Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
• Systems Integration and interface control
• Digital twin technologies
• AI applications in manufacturing environments
• Data analytics, industrial BI platforms
• Industrial cybersecurity
• Configuration and requirements management
• Work in nuclear or other highly regulated manufacturing environments

## Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems Engineering, or related discipline.
• Ten (10+) years of industrial manufacturing experience.
• Experience supporting complex manufacturing facilities with integrated digital and operational systems.
• Demonstrated experience integrating engineering, manufacturing, operations, and IT systems and teams.
• Must be a U.S. citizen capable of obtaining and maintaining a DOE clearance.
• Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

## Why This Role Matters

The HPDU program is deploying a first-of-a-kind manufacturing capability through a phased strategy—from pilot production to full-scale operations. Success depends on seamless integration of manufacturing systems, digital tools, automation, quality systems, and enterprise data environments. This Systems Engineer will serve as the technical integrator across these disciplines, ensuring the Jonesborough facility delivers a scalable, digitally enabled manufacturing capability that supports operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and future growth.

## What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance (as applicable).
• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship, continuing education, and technical training.
• A collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives and cross‑generational teamwork.
• The opportunity to help build a first-of-its-kind manufacturing capability supporting national security missions.
• Continuous learning and advancement throughout your career at BWXT.

## Desing Engineering Intern - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

## Welcome to BWXT:

At BWXT, our interns perform challenging tasks in their field of study while developing and delivering unique solutions for use in a nuclear environment. Our interns work collaboratively as part of our teams and will create/update drawings and procedures, assist with product and/or tooling designs, perform testing and analysis, and assist with project management and the procurement of materials as needed. A BWXT internship not only provides valuable on the job training but allows you to be a part of something bigger!

BWXT offers paid internships along with a housing stipend for those interns whose home of record is more than 50 miles from Barberton, OH. Internships will last approximately 10-12 weeks. At the end of the internship, each intern has the opportunity to present their completed work/ assigned projects to the leadership team.

## Your Day to Day as a Desing Engineering Intern:

The Design Stress Engineer Intern’s main assignments will be to support the design team perform stress analyses of nuclear pressure vessels and other highly engineered products. The intern will support the Design Engineering Team with various tasks including but not limited to:

• Support in performing stress analyses of nuclear pressure vessels and other highly engineered products.

• Assist with conducting finite element analysis, custom post-processing software, and closed form analytical techniques.

• Assist with perform standard and advanced structural analysis methods including linear elastic sizing, fatigue, elastic-plastic, fracture mechanics, shock and vibration, and thermal/mechanical.

• Work with members of other engineering disciplines (manufacturing, quality, welding, drafters, thermal fluids, etc.) in a team environment to generate component designs to meet code requirements and to optimize the design for manufacturability.

• Work closely with on-site manufacturing to resolve real time fabrication related issues.

• Communicate effectively in presentations and written technical reports.

## Required Qualifications:

• Must be enrolled full time in an accredited university/college in mechanical, aerospace, civil engineering or similar degree.

• Ability to communicate effectively in presentations and written technical reports.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Word, Excel and PowerPoint is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior internship experience

• Experience in the use of finite element analysis (FEA) software (preferably Abaqus or Ansys).

• Experience of computer programming codes (ex. C++, Fortran, Python, etc.)

• Housing Stipend available for those who live 50 miles away.

• Flexible work schedule with every other Friday off.
