Waco 6000 - VMC Operator (Weekend Shift) - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

Candidates please note: This position is available on our weekend shift which consists of twelve (12) hours on Saturday and Sunday and eight (8) hours on Monday (the eight hour shift could be Friday instead of Monday); work thirty two (32) hours and get paid for forty (40) hours. Scheduled off days are Tuesday through Friday or Monday through Thursday depending upon the shift. Training will be on the Monday - Friday crew before being assigned to the weekend crew.

We are currently seeking qualified applicants to fill a large machining center position at our facility in Barberton, Ohio. Successful applicants will be able to set up and operate large, CNC machining centers with both horizontal and vertical machining capabilities, as well as any associated auxiliary equipment. Machining operations will include contour turning and milling, trepanning, boring, drilling, tapping, thread milling, milling with right angle attachments and contour turning with facing head attachments.

## Purpose

• Performs multi-axis machining operations with high precision to operate and maintain machine, right angle heads, facing heads, inspection probe, jib crane, tool attachments, all types of fixtures, any and all set-up equipment, tool setter, tool holders, precision measuring instruments, power tools and any hand tools necessary for the fulfillment of job duties.

• Works with programmer to develop and test run programs. Proof reads programs and notifies supervisor/programmer of potential problems.

• Positions and secures work piece and fixtures on table.

• Obtains drawings and tools from the crib and verifies the tools are correct for the application and matches the tools called for in the program(s).

• Assembles tooling as required.

• Uses higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices.

• Directs and assists crane operator with the rigging and moving of parts to load and unload machine.

• Performs final inspection of features using both the inspection probe and precision measuring equipment.

• Cleans and deburrs job as necessary. Attaches seals and protective covers as required.

• Performs minor maintenance on machine, attachments, and tooling as required.

• Keeps equipment and work area clean and orderly.

• Verifies identity and physical characteristics of materials as required.

• Maintains necessary records and completes process documentation and any other production records as required. Identifies equipment and product as required.

## Minimum Requirements

• High school diploma or GED equivalency required.

• A minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience performing precision machining functions on large machines is desired. Journeyman level machinist designation or equivalent is preferred.

• Be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be open and available to working all shifts.

• Must be proficient with CNC controls, including G and M coded commands.

• Must be able to edit or modify programs as necessary. Must be able to write minor programs.

• Must have a working knowledge of feeds and speeds for all types of material.

• Must be able to work to .000" tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary.

• Must demonstrate ability to read and interpret geometric tolerancing per ANSI Y14.5

• Ability to demonstrate use of various measuring instruments, including dial bore gages, indicator snap gages, verniers, .0001 micrometers, and other specialty gaging equipment

• Possess skills necessary to maintain accurate documentation and the ability to follow complicated procedures and document accordingly.

• Must pass all pre-employment processes, to include skills assessments and mechanical comprehension testing, background check, drug screen, and physical examination.

## Physical Demands

While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required communicate verbally and with written information; to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and use ladders inside and outside of parts being machined. The employee is occasionally required to lift and move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Please note: This position pays $43.68 per hour and is complemented by a generous benefits package. Upon an offer, a relocation package is available for eligible candidates.

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking a Physiotherapist for the Canadian Forces Health Services Centre (Comox) to provide comprehensive consultation, assessment, and treatment in both the physiotherapy section, by booked appointment and walk-ins, and the Care Delivery Unit (CDU) via sick parade and/or consultation, as part of the collaborative practice model. They can benefit by treating clients who are generally very fit and motivated towards their recovery.

## Responsibilities

• Deliver physiotherapy and rehabilitation interventions using evidence-based approaches and best practices in accordance with applicable regulatory standards and scope of practice

• Carry a full orthopedic caseload of 12-15 patients per day (on average 8-10 new assessments per week), and typically 2 follow-up patients per hour

• Provide assessment and treatment of neuro-musculoskeletal conditions resulting mainly from sports and training injuries as well as work injuries and accidents

• Obtain and document informed patient consent for assessment and treatment through an accurate explanation and instruction

• Provide screening assessments, education and orthoses recommendations in a direct access setting such as CDU walk- ins

• Prescribe exercises to optimally rehabilitate and prevent injuries and promote fitness

• Provide manual therapy and soft tissue techniques for neuro- musculoskeletal conditions, scar tissue, muscle tension, circulatory disorders and lymphatic problems

• Utilize pain management techniques that may include acupuncture (needling below the dermis);

• Provide ergonomics education including the provision of on-site assessments in the patient’s workplace

• Provide physiotherapy related education to patients and members of the health care team in topics such as injury prevention and health promotion issues

• Perform Biomechanical Foot Assessments including orthotics fitting and fabrication

• Contribute to the design, preparation and provision of programs integral to the operation of the physiotherapy clinic as a member of the healthcare team for the purpose of education and rehabilitation such as programs specializing in proprioceptive rehabilitation, reintegration, or back pain self-management

• Participate in ongoing management of patient care by presenting cases during inter-disciplinary meetings, attending clinical rounds, conducting patient conferences, and in scheduling additional follow-up care

• Perform daily clinical documentation for all patient interactions in accordance with CF and provincial regulatory body clinical documentation and record keeping requirements

## Qualifications

• Current license in good standing from province of British Columbia

• Minimum of 7 years of experience working in orthopaedics or sports medicine; and either a Diploma of Advanced Orthopedic Manual and Manipulative therapy; or a Diploma of Mechanical Diagnosis and Therapy (McKenzie)

## Additional Requirements

• Must be able to obtain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level

• Hourly salary of $65.00 to $75.00 per hour

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

• 16 months starting May 2027 – August 2028

• Pay Range: $24-35/hr

Are you a dependable teammate who works best in a collaborative & cooperative environment?

Do you feel most engaged when you are learning and developing your skills every day?

Do you like solving puzzles and interesting problems?

Then we have the job for you!

This co-op position is an opportunity to work in the research and development team of a photonics & fibre optics company that is committed to meeting the needs of our customers.

You will carry out analysis on large sets of device data to propel improvement in our products. You will develop algorithms and methods that optimize the performance of our next generation of photonic modules, used both in long-haul networks as well as inside modern AI datacenters. You will be part of a hard-working and diverse team that is continually learning how to enhance our products.

In addition, students collaborate with the firmware, hardware, optical design and verification teams throughout their work terms. • Perform daily machine maintenance and housekeeping duties such as but not limited to maintain and adjust oil and coolant levels, monitor and adjust coolant concentration, clean machines, tooling parts, and surrounding work areas.

• Operate pendant crane and properly rig parts ranging from 5-1000lbs.

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Manager of DevOps Engineering to lead our DevOps function as a combination of Platform Team and Enabling Team, aligned to Team Topologies principles, across four product lines.

This role is responsible for defining and executing a modern DevOps strategy (≈60%), while remaining hands-on (≈40%) to actively guide engineers and development teams in adopting modern practices. The DevOps organization exists to enable fast flow, reduce cognitive load for product teams, and provide a reliable, self-service platform for delivery and operations.

The Manager of DevOps Engineering will lead 3+ full-time DevOps Engineers and coordinate external DevOps service providers, partnering closely with Architecture, Development Managers, QA/Test Automation, and Product Management to ensure DevOps capabilities are scalable, discoverable, and adopted across teams.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

DevOps Mission (Team Topologies Lens)

• As a Platform Team: Provide internal, self-service DevOps capabilities that product teams can use independently to build, deploy, and operate software safely and efficiently.

• As an Enabling Team: Temporarily embed with product teams to help them adopt modern DevOps practices, remove bottlenecks, and upskill teams—then step back once capabilities are internalized.

This role ensures the organization does not rely on DevOps as a centralized delivery gate but instead uses DevOps to accelerate all teams.

What You'll Do

Platform Leadership & Strategy (≈60%)

• Define and evolve a DevOps Platform strategy that serves four product lines with shared, reusable capabilities

• Establish platform standards and golden paths for:
• CI/CD pipelines and release orchestration

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

• Cloud architecture, scalability, and cost management

• Observability, logging, metrics, and alerting

• Secure-by-default environments and pipelines

• Ensure the platform minimizes cognitive load for development teams while enabling autonomy

• Partner with Architecture to align DevOps platform capabilities with long-term technical direction

• Prioritize platform investments based on flow efficiency, reliability, and developer experience

• Maintain a high standard of security awareness, ensuring data protection, compliance with company policies, and adherence to industry standards in all aspects of work.

Enabling Team Leadership (≈40% Hands-On)

• Lead by example through direct technical involvement and coaching

• Temporarily embed DevOps engineers with product teams to:
• Improve deployment pipelines and release safety

• Enable teams to own their services and environments

• Reduce manual steps and DevOps dependencies

• Teach and model modern DevOps practices rather than owning execution indefinitely

• Create documentation, templates, and automation that allow teams to self-serve

Team & Vendor Management

• Manage and develop 3+ full-time DevOps Engineers, emphasizing platform thinking and enablement behaviors

• Direct and coordinate external DevOps service providers, ensuring work aligns with platform and enablement goals

• Set clear expectations that DevOps success is measured by team independence, not ticket throughput

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, and learning

Metrics You'll Own

The Manager of DevOps Engineering owns and drives improvement in the following flow and reliability metrics, aligned to Team Topologies outcomes

• Deployment Frequency (partnering with QA and Test Automation)

• DORA Metrics
• Deployment Frequency

• Lead Time for Changes

• Change Failure Rate

• Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)

• Change Failure Rate

• Runtime of Updates (deployment and infrastructure update duration)

• Cycle Time to Perform a Release

• Reduction in DevOps-related handoffs and dependencies for product teams

What Success Looks Like

• Product teams deploy independently using shared DevOps platform capabilities

• DevOps engineers spend less time firefighting and more time enabling flow

• DORA and release metrics show sustained improvement across all product lines

• Reduced operational risk and faster recovery from incidents

• DevOps is viewed as a force multiplier, not a bottleneck

Who You Are

• 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering

• 3+ years of experience managing or leading engineers

• Strong hands-on experience with modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

• Expertise in:
• CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)

• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, etc.)

• Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, etc.)

• Experience supporting multiple product teams or product lines

• Demonstrated success improving delivery speed and reliability through enablement, not centralization

Nice to Haves (Assets)

• Practical experience applying Team Topologies concepts

• Experience building or evolving internal developer platforms

• Background in SaaS or B2B software environments

• Experience managing external vendors or managed service providers

• Strong communication and influence skills across technical and product leadership

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans the US and Canada)

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!

• Generous professional development budget

• RRSP/ 401k matching program

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at hr@caseiq.com.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/solink/364ddb8c.body: FIELD MARKETING SPECIALIST Location: Canada | Remote Department: Field Marketing Reports To: Jennifer Boutilier https://www.linkedin.com/in/jennifer-thomas12/ Type: Permanent | Full-Time ABOUT SOLINK At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video security into real-time operational insights. Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency. Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats. We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started! ABOUT THE ROLE Solink is looking for a Field Marketing Specialist to execute our trade show and field event program across North America. Our buyers: loss prevention leaders, operators, franchise owners, and IT decision-makers, show up in person at industry conferences, regional roadshows, partner events, and our own Solink Summit, and this is the role that makes sure we show up better than anyone else on the floor. You’ll own individual events end-to-end: contracts and deadlines, booth logistics, shipping, staffing plans, on-site set-up and tear-down, lead capture, and the post-event report. You’ll run the pre-show outreach and post-show follow-up that turn a booth into booked meetings, partner closely with Sales and SDRs on meeting targets by territory, and keep lead data clean enough that we can tell which events are actually worth the money. This role suits someone who thrives on logistics and deadlines but thinks like a marketer, the person who catches the shipping deadline everyone else missed, works autonomously within a defined calendar, escalates risks early rather than late, and comes to their manager with recommendations rather than just problems. Expect roughly 25–35% travel, concentrated in event season. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Event Execution - Own assigned trade shows, conferences, and field events end-to-end: contracts and deadlines, booth space and design, shipping and drayage, staffing plans, hotel blocks, giveaways, signage, AV, and demo stations. - Build the event brief for each show — goals, target accounts, messaging, staffing roster, run of show, and success metrics — so everyone attending knows what they’re there to do. - Travel to major events to lead on-site execution, including set-up and tear-down, booth staffing, troubleshooting, and keeping the team on schedule. - Maintain the event asset inventory — booth properties, collateral, demo hardware, branded merchandise — in show-ready condition between events. Pipeline & Follow-Through - Run pre-show outreach and meeting-booking campaigns in partnership with Sales and SDRs, including target account lists and talk tracks for reps working the booth. - Own lead capture and data hygiene end-to-end: scanner configuration, list cleanup, CRM and marketing automation routing, campaign attribution, and handoff to Sales within SLA. - Execute structured post-show follow-up sequences so leads don’t go cold between the show floor and the first call. - Deliver a post-event report on every show — cost per lead, cost per meeting, influenced and sourced pipeline, and a recommendation on whether to return. Vendors, Budget & Regional Support - Manage day-to-day relationships with booth vendors, shipping and fulfillment partners, promotional product suppliers, venues, and event organizers. - Track spend against the event budget, flag variances early, and find ways to stretch budget without diluting Solink’s presence. - Support localized programs that back specific territories — regional webinars, customer dinners, lunch-and-learns, and co-marketing activity with channel partners and integrators. - Support Solink Summit and other company-hosted events alongside the broader marketing team. A LITTLE BIT ABOUT YOU - 1–2 years of B2B field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation experience, including hands-on ownership of trade shows or conferences, ideally in SaaS or technology. - A track record of running multiple events in parallel without dropping details — deadlines, shipping windows, and vendor commitments are your responsibility and you don’t need reminding. - Comfort working autonomously within a defined calendar and playbook: you make day-to-day decisions yourself, manage your own deadlines, and escalate risks early rather than after they’ve landed. - Experience with CRM and marketing automation tooling (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and lead capture tools, with the discipline to keep event data clean and attributable. - Commercial instincts — you measure events by meetings and pipeline, not badge scans, and you can explain what a show returned. - Strong written and verbal communication; you can brief a sales team, write pre-show copy, and hold a vendor to a deadline with equal confidence. - Willingness to travel across Canada and the United States roughly 25–35% of the time, including occasional weekends during event season, with valid documentation to do so. NICE TO HAVES - Experience marketing to multi-location operators — restaurant, retail, convenience, or franchise businesses. - Familiarity with event management platforms (e.g., Cvent, Splash). - Exposure to channel or partner co-marketing, including MDF. - Background in security, loss prevention, or hardware-plus-software products. - Design familiarity (Figma, Canva, or Adobe) for quick turnarounds on signage and collateral. ROLE EXPECTATIONS This is a P2 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are intermediates who can go beyond the basics by working autonomously to make small decisions, work on projects, and make recommendations. They can effectively execute on tasks and initiatives with direction provided. In this role, you’ll be expected to: - Execute initiatives and tasks while receiving general direction from your manager. - Identify opportunities for increased team effectiveness, and identify, articulate, and propose solutions to problems. - Actively apply feedback to improve performance, anticipate potential issues, and take responsibility for delivering consistent, reliable outcomes. - Develop strong working relationships within your team and begin building cross-functional relationships, sharing knowledge and learnings with peers. - Seek input from relevant stakeholders to ensure quality work. - Manage your own deadlines reliably and escalate risks early. - Understand and respect team priorities versus personal tasks. What success looks like: - Events that run without surprises — deadlines met, assets on site, staffing covered, and your manager not having to ask where things stand. - Pre-show outreach and post-show follow-up executed consistently on every event, with booked-meeting targets hit and leads in the hands of Sales within SLA. - Event data clean and complete enough that the team can make real budget decisions from your post-event reporting. - Vendor and logistics issues handled at your level, with early flags to your manager on anything that could affect budget or presence. - Improvements you’ve spotted and proposed showing up in how the team plans events going forward. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada; - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. OUR VALUES We do things the Solink way: - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too. - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar. - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work. - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required. - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth. - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account. - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs. - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together. - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics. - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun. WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect: 1. Intro call with our Talent Team 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable) 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members 5. Reference Checks 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉 PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/solink/8aa3a4a0-fb6c-413b-a246-bfc3ad52f194https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/solink/8aa3a4a0-fb6c-413b-a246-bfc3ad52f194]. SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Security Assurance Associate to support Case IQ’s customer-facing security assurance process under the direction of the Director of Information Security. This remote-first role is a strong fit for an early-career professional who is interested in information security, customer assurance, documentation, and supporting enterprise sales within a growing security program.

In this role, you will help complete customer security questionnaires and due diligence requests, maintain an approved response and evidence library, keep the Trust Center current, and coordinate with Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering, IT, and Sales.

AI-Forward Ways of Working

At Case IQ, AI is part of how we build. We look for engineers who can use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows with strong technical judgment: defining clear intent and constraints, validating outputs, protecting customer data, and keeping humans accountable for production decisions. You will help establish practical patterns for responsible AI use across discovery, design, implementation, testing, observability, and operations.

What You'll Do

• Support customer security questionnaires, RFPs, due diligence requests, and follow-up questions using approved content and guidance

• Maintain an organized library of approved questionnaire responses, security documentation, and supporting evidence

• Coordinate with Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering, IT, and Sales to gather accurate answers and identify the right reviewers

• Track customer security requests, deadlines, owners, and outstanding items so requests move forward predictably

• Help maintain the Case IQ Trust Center by keeping published security and compliance information current and flagging gaps for review

• Prepare clear customer-facing responses and help route requests for documents such as policies, certifications, and privacy materials

• Learn Case IQ’s products, security practices, and compliance commitments well enough to recognize when a request needs specialist review

• Help document repeatable Customer Assurance workflows, response standards, and lessons learned

What Success Looks Like

• 30 Days: Complete onboarding and build familiarity with Case IQ’s products, security documentation, compliance commitments, customer assurance process, key stakeholders, and response standards. Shadow questionnaire and customer-request work, review the response library and Trust Center, and begin drafting straightforward responses for review.

• 60 Days: Support smaller and standard questionnaires and customer requests under close review, using approved responses and evidence. Keep request tracking current, help organize the response library, and contribute proposed Trust Center or documentation updates.

• 90 Days: Handle routine requests with regular manager review and confidently route complex or non-standard questions to the appropriate subject-matter expert. Maintain accurate status reporting and identify recurring customer questions, content gaps, or process improvements.

• 6 Months: Manage well-defined recurring Customer Assurance tasks with guidance, maintain accurate and current customer-facing security information, and contribute to smoother coordination between Sales and internal subject-matter experts.

• 1 Year: Operate as a reliable Customer Assurance partner for standard requests, keep the response library and Trust Center well organized, and support continuous improvement of the customer security review process while escalating complex matters appropriately.

Who You Are

• Early-career experience in a customer-facing, SaaS operations, security, privacy, compliance, sales operations, or related role; internships, co-op terms, or equivalent experience are welcome

• Strong written communication skills and care with detail, including the ability to turn technical input into clear, accurate customer-facing responses

• Good organizational and project-tracking habits, with the ability to manage several requests and deadlines with guidance

• Interest in information security, privacy, compliance, or enterprise software, and a willingness to learn Case IQ’s products and security program

• Comfort working with documents, spreadsheets, knowledge bases, and shared collaboration tools

• Ability to ask thoughtful questions, identify missing information, and escalate requests that need expert review

• Collaborative working style and the ability to build constructive relationships with Sales, Legal, Compliance, Security, Product, Engineering, and IT teams

• Basic understanding of common security and privacy concepts, such as access control, encryption, incident response, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or data protection

• Exercise the highest level of discretion in the handling and protection of all data and sensitive information

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience assisting with security questionnaires, RFPs, customer due diligence, or Trust Center content

• Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, or PIPEDA

• Exposure to SaaS sales, customer success, procurement, legal operations, or compliance work

Perks and Benefits

• Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries).

• Competitive company-paid benefits plan.

• Generous professional development budget.

• RRSP/ 401k matching program

• Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/808.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role - What You’ll Do

Be a Trusted Advisor, Not Just a Demonstrator

• Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies, and drive deals to closure.

• Educate customers on the value of event-driven architecture and agentic AI, challenging them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.

• Guide customers on industry best practices, integration patterns, and modernization strategies — including the convergence of Event Driven Architectures and multi-agent AI systems.

Champion Building & Customer Relationships

• Build and nurture deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, turning users into advocates for Solace.

• Conduct on-site visits, regular check-ins, and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving customer needs.

• Translate Solace's expanding platform capabilities — from the Solace Event Broker to Agent Mesh — into outcomes customers care about.

Technical Validation & Proof of Value

• Lead impactful demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and Proof of Value (PoVs) that resonate with customer objectives.

• Architect solutions that showcase the business impact of Solace's event-driven and agentic AI platform.

• Own and streamline the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials, and technical validations

Evangelize Event-Driven Architecture

• Demonstrate deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns, including publish/subscribe messaging, event sourcing, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), event streaming, and choreography vs. orchestration — applying these patterns to solve real customer architectural challenges.

• Articulate the strategic business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences alike — connecting real-time event streaming to tangible outcomes such as reduced time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI-powered applications on a live data fabric.

• Confidently position Solace Event Brokers against competing messaging and streaming technologies — including Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, and cloud-native brokers — articulating where Solace’s multi-protocol support, hybrid/multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS, and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation.

• Challenge customers to evolve beyond request/response and batch architectures, guiding them through an EDA maturity model — from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a fully distributed, event-driven enterprise capable of supporting real-time AI and autonomous systems at scale.

Solace Agent Mesh Subject Matter Expert

• Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI — bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.

• Demonstrate how Agent Mesh extends customers' existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI, reducing time-to-production for AI initiatives.

• Articulate the platform's horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging, and governance capabilities to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

• Engage use cases across industries — financial services, manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, defense and national security, and the public sector — where real-time event triggers drive autonomous AI agent actions.

Be the Broader Subject Matter Expert

• Stay ahead of trends in event-driven architecture, agentic AI, cloud computing, messaging, and microservices.

• Engage both technical teams and executive leadership, bridging the gap between technology and business outcomes.

• Confidently position Solace in competitive landscapes, articulating differentiation and ROI across PubSub+ and Agent Mesh.

Collaboration & Customer Advocacy

• Provide customer-driven insights to influence product roadmap decisions.

• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering to ensure customer success.

• Serve as a field voice for Agent Mesh adoption, feeding real-world use cases and objections back to product and GTM teams.

Federal, DoD & Public Sector Engagement

• Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across the U.S. Department of Defense (Department of War), the Intelligence Community, federal civilian agencies, and state, local, and education (SLED) customers, partnering with Account Executives, channel partners, primes, and systems integrators.

• Translate mission requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as command and control, ISR and sensor data distribution, logistics and sustainment, cyber and situational awareness, and real-time citizen and agency services.

• Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh, and Agent Mesh for disconnected, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth (DDIL) environments, edge-to-cloud deployments, and on-premises or air-gapped networks, including classified enclaves.

• Speak credibly to federal security and compliance requirements, including FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, RMF and ATO processes, DoD Cloud Computing SRG impact levels (IL4/IL5), STIGs, FIPS 140 cryptography, and zero trust architecture.

• Support government acquisition motions, including contributing to RFI and RFP responses, technical volumes, and compliance matrices, and working with program offices (PEOs/PMOs), contracting officers, and contract vehicles such as GSA Schedule, NASA SEWP, and partner-held vehicles.

• Align Solace with DoD and federal modernization priorities such as JADC2, data mesh and data-centric architectures, open standards and modular open systems approaches (MOSA), and responsible AI adoption.

• Enable and support partners, primes, and integrators so they can qualify, architect, and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.

Travel & On-Site Engagement

• Expect up to 35% travel, primarily across North America, for on-site workshops, deal closures, and industry events, including customer sites, government facilities, and the Washington, DC area as needed.

About you

Technical & Business Acumen

• You understand that real-time event streaming and agentic AI are strategic enablers for businesses, driving efficiency, responsiveness, and competitive differentiation.

• You can clearly articulate the business value of Solace — tying technical solutions to real-world business challenges, from modernizing middleware to deploying production-grade AI agents.

Customer-Centric Mindset

• You build strong, lasting relationships and know how to turn customers into long-term champions.

• You're a proactive problem solver who takes ownership and drives initiatives forward.

Smart, Driven, and Adaptable

• You thrive in fast-paced environments and continuously seek feedback to improve.

• You're a clear communicator who tailors messaging for both technical and business audiences.

• You bring energy, urgency, and enthusiasm to customer engagements, inspiring action and momentum.

Technical Expertise

• Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or event streaming platforms (e.g., Solace PubSub+, Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or MQTT brokers).

• Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks, LLM orchestration, and multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar).

• Working knowledge of A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Model Context Protocol) communication patterns is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes.

• Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and application integration patterns.

• Ability to design and lead technical workshops, demos, and proof-of-concept implementations.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

• 5+ years in a technical sales or solutions engineering role, selling complex enterprise software solutions.

• Strong ability to lead technical evaluations and effectively communicate business impact.

• Excellent presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

• Willingness to travel (up to 35%).

• Demonstrated experience supporting U.S. Government customers, including DoD, the Intelligence Community, federal civilian agencies, or state and local government, in a technical sales, solutions, or systems engineering capacity (directly or through primes, integrators, or channel partners).

• Working understanding of how the public sector buys technology, including RFI/RFP processes, program offices, and government contract vehicles.

Preferred

• Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming, or messaging middleware.

• Exposure to agentic AI, LLM application development, or multi-agent orchestration platforms.

• Programming knowledge in Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript.

• Familiarity with enterprise IT environments, including security, networking, and compliance considerations.

• Current or previously held U.S. security clearance at the Secret or Top Secret (TS/SCI) level. Active clearances are strongly preferred; a clearance that has lapsed or been held in the past is also valued. Candidates who are eligible to obtain a clearance are encouraged to apply.

• Prior military service or civilian experience within DoD, the Intelligence Community, or a defense contractor.

• Hands-on familiarity with government security and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, RMF/ATO, DoD Cloud Computing SRG, STIGs, FIPS 140) and with secure, air-gapped, or classified network environments.

• Experience with DoD and federal mission systems and data architectures, such as C2, ISR, tactical edge, DDIL, and message-based or open-standards integration.

• Experience deploying and operating software in government clouds (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Public Sector) and on-premises Kubernetes (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift).

• Experience writing or contributing to technical proposals, RFI/RFP responses, and compliance matrices.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, Security+, or cloud and Kubernetes certifications.

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

• Deliver impactful technical demonstrations and PoVs for key enterprise prospects across Solace Event Brokers and Agent Mesh.

• Build strong relationships with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering peers, and cross-functional teams.

• Develop fluency in Event Driven Architectures & Agent Mesh Enterprise positioning and its differentiation in the agentic AI market.

• Build working knowledge of the Solace federal and public sector go-to-market, including target agencies, partner ecosystem, contract vehicles, and security and compliance requirements.

In 6 Months

• Lead multiple successful PoVs — including Agent Mesh scenarios — and position yourself as a trusted advisor to customers.

• Influence internal best practices and refine technical sales motions around agentic AI and Event Driven Architectures.

• Lead at least one PoV or technical engagement with a DoD, federal, or public sector customer, including partner and prime enablement.

In 12 Months

• Play a key role in closing multimillion-dollar deals, helping expand Solace's enterprise footprint.

• Drive strategic adoption of event-driven architecture and Agent Mesh within enterprise customers, reinforcing Solace as the leader in real-time agentic AI infrastructure.

• Help establish Solace as a recognized event-driven and agentic AI platform within the federal and DoD community, contributing to pursuits, partner-led wins, and reference architectures for government environments.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking a Physiotherapist to work part time at the Canadian Forces Health Services Centre (Kingston) to provide comprehensive consultation, assessment, and treatment in both the physiotherapy section, by booked appointment and walk-ins, and the Care Delivery Unit (CDU) via sick parade and/or consultation, as part of the collaborative practice model. They can benefit by treating clients who are generally very fit and motivated towards their recovery.

## Responsibilities

• Deliver physiotherapy and rehabilitation interventions using evidence-based approaches and best practices in accordance with applicable regulatory standards and scope of practice

• Carry a full orthopedic caseload of 12-15 patients per day (on average 8-10 new assessments per week)

• Provide assessment and treatment of neuro-musculoskeletal conditions resulting mainly from sports and training injuries as well as work injuries and accidents

• Obtain and document informed patient consent for assessment and treatment through an accurate explanation and instruction

With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

## Position Overview:

The Project Manager will support one or more of BWXT’s advanced reactor development programs including BWXT’s Advanced Nuclear Reactor (BANR), the Janus Program, mPower development support, and nuclear maritime applications. The Project Manager is responsible for leading, coordinating, and executing project activities across a technically complex and multi disciplinary environment. This role ensures that program objectives are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with all contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements. The PM serves as a central point of contact for internal teams, external customers, and stakeholders supporting AT program initiatives.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, Virginia at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a Project Manager, Advanced Reactor Development:

• Serve as the primary liaison for project, proposal, and contract activities with internal and external customers.

• Lead development, coordination, and submission of proposals, ensuring compliance with technical, cost, and schedule requirements.

• Manage execution of contracts, internal work authorizations, subcontracts, and other formal project documents.

• Develop, maintain, and monitor project risk registers and action item tracking logs.

• Partner with functional groups to establish and maintain project controls, integrated schedules, budgets, performance metrics, and baselines.

• Track and manage project budgets, expenditures, and earned value against approved plans.

• Build and maintain project forecasts, including bookings, revenue, cost performance, and gross margin targets.

• Collaborate closely with technical leads, engineering teams, and supporting organizations to ensure project milestones remain on schedule and within budget.

• Coordinate timely and transparent communication across stakeholders, preparing and delivering technical and commercial briefings as needed.

• Provide proactive issue resolution, develop alternative strategies, and maintain alignment with evolving program and customer needs.

• Ensure all project activities adhere to regulatory, security, and quality requirements associated with the project.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics is required.

• A minimum of ten (10) years professional experience is required.

• A minimum of five (5) years project management experience is required.

• Must have experience using Oracle Primavera (P6) schedule management.

• Must have demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both internally and externally.

• Must have strong skills in analyzing, condensing, and developing technical and commercial project information.

• Must have proven ability to develop creative technical and commercial approaches to complex project challenges.

• Must have demonstrable adaptability and resilience in changing project environments.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working within nuclear, radioisotope, or highly regulated technical environments is strongly preferred.

• Experience creating and maintaining project schedules, resource loading, cost controls, and project baselines.

• Experience leading Agile development teams using the Scrum / Kanban process.

• Previous supervisory or mentorship experience is preferred.

• PMP certification and/or MBA is preferred.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

• Support periodic compliance risk assessments and leverage trends, investigation outcomes, employee concerns, and audit results to inform continuous program improvement.

• Develop and track compliance metrics and KPIs to assess program effectiveness and support reporting to senior leadership and the Board.

• Monitor evolving laws, regulations, enforcement priorities, and government expectations affecting federal contractors; recommend program enhancements as appropriate.

• Support assessments and benchmarking of the Ethics & Compliance program against government guidance and recognized industry practices.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Security Clearance.

• Experience working for, advising, or investigating federal contractors, ideally in defense, nuclear, aerospace, energy, or similarly regulated environments.

• Working knowledge of DOJ’s Evaluation of Corporate Compliance Programs.

• Demonstrated expertise in investigative practices, including evidence gathering, interviewing, analysis, documentation, and findings development.

• Strong understanding of corporate ethics and compliance program principles and expectations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal and regulatory issues.

• Proven judgment, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive and confidential matters.

Mattr delivers advanced material technologies and complex manufacturing expertise. Through a portfolio of brands, we offer highly engineered solutions, technology and products to support infrastructure markets worldwide.

DSG-Canusa has been developing and producing high-quality heat shrink tubing, cold-applied accessories and heat shrink equipment for over 50 years. Driven by our long-term commitment to the research and development of outstanding materials, products and technologies, our mission is to lead the industry in manufacturing superior heat and cold shrink products that meet CGA, UL and other industry approved certifications. We proudly manufacture in Europe, North America, and China to provide strong regional and global supply chain options for our customers.

## Impact of this Role

As a Maintenance Millwright, you will help maintain reliable plant operations by maintaining, diagnosing, repairing, calibrating, modifying, and testing mechanical and electro-mechanical equipment. You will also support Process Engineering in resolving mechanical-related problems while working as part of a team.

Schedule: Monday to Friday 4:00PM - 12:30 AM

## Pay Rate: $31.50 USD

## What Success Looks Like

• Install, troubleshoot, modify, repair, test, configure, commission, and maintain mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electrical plant manufacturing equipment.

• Diagnose and troubleshoot electromechanical production equipment.

• Use CMMS programs to conduct preventative maintenance inspections and related repairs on plant equipment as directed.

• Inspect and examine machinery and equipment to identify potential failures and eliminate unplanned downtime.

• Communicate maintenance needs and work status with Production, Shipping and Receiving, the Maintenance Supervisor, and third-party contractors as appropriate.

## What You Bring to the Role

• High school diploma

• 3–5 years of relevant experience.

• Strong mechanical troubleshooting skills, including identifying root causes, completing repairs, and disassembling/reassembling mechanical components.

• Experience using machine-shop tools and equipment, with competent electrical/electronics skills.

• Ability to read and interpret AutoCAD drawings, blueprints, and sketches.

• Basic knowledge of CMMS programs, computers, and Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and deliver quality workmanship.

• Ability to meet the role’s physical demands and work safely around manufacturing equipment and occasional workplace hazards.

## Preferred

• Industrial maintenance certification.

• 5–7 years of manufacturing experience.

• Routine welding and machining capabilities.

• Familiarity with PLCs, HMIs, drives, and schematic reading.

## Why Join Mattr?

• Multiple medical, dental & vision plan options (Blue Cross Blue Shield & VSP)

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with monthly company contributions

• 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar match, vested from day one

• Incentive bonus plans + paid vacation & sick leave

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Long-Term Disability insurance

• Wellness incentives

• Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Discounts on fitness, shopping & travel (Blue365, LifeMart & more)

• Year-round permanent work at one location with tools, PPE & safety training

• Onsite parking + staff social events

#IND1

You must apply from within SuccessFactors for your application to be considered. Please note your Supervisor may be contacted if you are selected for an interview.

Lumentum Canada was awarded the 2022 National Capital Region’s Top Employers for the 6th consecutive year and the 2022 Career Directory Canada’s Best Employers for Recent Graduates for the 5th consecutive year.

Position Title: Project Manager Analyst

Employment Type: Student – Co-op, existing vacancy

Location: Ottawa ON, Onsite

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

##

## The Opportunity

• 16 months (required) starting May 2027 - August 2028

• Pay Range: $24-35/hr

## Why You’ll Love This Role

Lumentum is seeking an enthusiastic and innovative student to join the Optical Communication Transport Engineering team in Ottawa, Ontario. As a member of the Program Management Office, you will be leading Release Management projects that will help maintain and grow our business. You will work with Lumentum engineers, as well as our overseas factories, suppliers and contract manufacturers to improve product cost, security of supply and manufacturing capacity.

You will be joining a company that is expanding and changing rapidly. Lumentum’s products are designed to make AI datacenters more power-efficient, thereby alleviating the industry’s current concerns about water consumption in a very significant way.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Take ownership of critical projects as the lead Project Manager, defining and documenting project scope, goals, budget, and deliverables with support from the Program Management Office and other stakeholders

• Develop and create the project structure and maintain thorough documentation in Confluence

• Support the development and implementation of a broad, coordinated set of plans and schedules to meet the goals and priorities of Lumentum

• Regularly collaborate with the Senior Program Manager to monitor and control project schedules with engineering teams and communicate project status (technical and programmatic) to stakeholders and management

• Effectively communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion by leading regular occurring meetings

• Support the development process by ordering and tracking the program’s material procurement through Oracle Enterprise Manager

• Actively participate in hiring and onboarding the next cohort of co-ops, and develop training resources

## What We’re Looking For

## Education:

• Working towards a bachelor’s degree in engineering or business with an interest in Project or Program Management, returning to school starting September 2028

## Skills:

• Excellent leadership skills, combining critical thinking with empathetic and diplomatic communication

• Excellent written and oral communication skills

• Strong organizational skills

• Ability to work in ambiguous situations and define a path to resolution

• Demonstrated ability to form collaborative and cooperative working relationships in all interactions

• Motivated team player, self-starter and detail-oriented

## The following would be considered an asset:

• Previous co-op experience

• Involvement in extra-curricular activities

• Working knowledge of Miro, Confluence, JIRA, Oracle, Agile, or Tableau

## Perks You’ll Love

• Free parking

• Free gym

• Cafeteria with subsidized meals and free coffee/tea

• Prayer room

• Games room

Candidates must be eligible to complete a background check as part of the hiring process

## Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

## Let’s Build a Brighter Future Together!

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

Please contact us at talentacquisition@lumentum.com to request accommodation.

Join us—your future starts here!

We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started! THE ROLE We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Go-to-Market to serve as a senior strategic partner to our GTM leadership team, helping solve the most complex and consequential challenges facing Solink's revenue organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, transformation, and execution across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, Revenue Operations, and the broader business. You'll take ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems, develop the systems and operating models required for Solink to scale, and lead high-stakes initiatives that shape how our GTM organization evolves. You'll operate with significant autonomy and influence, bringing together business performance, market context, customer insight, and external best practices to help senior leaders make better decisions. You'll also act as a thought partner and mentor across the organization, raising the quality of strategic thinking, problem solving, and execution around you. a real impact. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Drive GTM priorities: Translate company strategy into clear GTM objectives, priorities, and operating plans. - Own the GTM operating system: Lead leadership meetings, business reviews, QBRs, strategic planning, and the mechanisms that create accountability. - Lead strategic initiatives: Drive high-priority cross-functional programs from definition through execution, resolving dependencies and ensuring measurable outcomes. - Create executive leverage: Help the GTM leadership team prioritize attention, prepare critical decisions, synthesize complex information, and ensure follow-through. - Improve GTM effectiveness: Identify organizational, process, and operating gaps and partner with leaders across GTM and the broader company to solve them. ROLE EXPECTATIONS This is a P5 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are senior contributors who lead high-priority initiatives, set strategic direction within their area of expertise, and are trusted advisors on complex and high-impact decisions. They use their expertise to improve how teams operate, strengthen cross-functional collaboration, and raise the capability of those around them. In this role, you'll be expected to: - Drive major GTM initiatives and transformations with full ownership and autonomy, bringing structure and long-term vision to ambiguous problems that span multiple functions. - Influence VP- and C-level decisions through strong strategic judgment, clear points of view, and the ability to connect business performance, market context, and company priorities. - Build cross-functional systems, operating models, and frameworks that define how GTM prioritizes, makes decisions, and scales as Solink grows. - Lead alignment across senior stakeholders on high-stakes priorities, proactively resolving competing objectives, dependencies, and organizational barriers to execution. - Act as a company-wide mentor and thought partner, elevating the capability of leaders and senior contributors through coaching, advising, and sharing expertise. - Continuously bring relevant external insights into Solink, helping the organization anticipate market, technology, and operating shifts and translate them into practical strategic advantage WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - The GTM leadership team operate against a clear set of priorities and make faster, better-informed decisions. - GTM functions are aligned around shared company outcomes with clear ownership and accountability. - Strategic initiatives move consistently from decision to execution with measurable business impact. - Leadership has a reliable view of GTM performance, risks, opportunities, and required actions. - The GTM leadership has greater capacity to focus on the highest-value strategic, customer, and company priorities. WHAT YOU BRING Must-Have: - Significant experience in GTM strategy, Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a Chief of Staff role within a scaling B2B technology company. - Experience partnering directly with executives and influencing senior leaders across multiple functions. - A track record of translating strategy into clear priorities, operating plans, and measurable outcomes. - Strong business judgment, analytical ability, and comfort using financial and operational data to guide decisions. - Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues, challenge constructively, and create alignment without direct authority. Nice-to-Have: - Experience working directly with a GTM leadership. - Experience scaling a multi-function GTM organization through significant growth or transformation. - Experience across multiple GTM disciplines such as Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Channel, or Revenue Operations. - Experience with both direct and channel-led GTM models. - Experience in physical security, video intelligence, multi-location businesses, or hardware-enabled SaaS. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada; - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. COMPENSATION The salary range for this role is 150,000-190,000 CAD. We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role. Candidates hired closer to the top of the range will typically demonstrate proficient capability throughout the interview process. This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and competencies needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time. OUR VALUES We do things the Solink way: - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too. - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar. - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work. - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required. - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth. - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account. - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs. - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together. - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics. - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun. WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect: 1. Intro call with our Talent Team 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable) 4. Reference Checks 5. Offer & onboarding 🎉 PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward. NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION. SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.
