## ## Job Description

## Eligibility Requirement: US Citizenship Required

## Reduce Risk. Accelerate Remediation. Strengthen Infrastructure Security.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and reducing technology risk across complex cloud environments? Do you enjoy analyzing security vulnerabilities, partnering with technical teams, and driving remediation efforts that strengthen the security and resilience of critical systems?

We’re looking for two Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineers to help identify, prioritize, track, and remediate vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications within a cloud-based FedRAMP Moderate-compliant environment supporting US federal government requirements.

This role will focus on accelerating vulnerability remediation in alignment with applicable Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04 requirements, leveraging threat intelligence, exposure data, and cloud-based AI tools to help application and infrastructure teams address security risks efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidates bring hands-on vulnerability management experience, strong technical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk partners to drive vulnerabilities through resolution.

## The Opportunity

As an Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in reducing the organization’s technology risk by managing vulnerability remediation activities from identification through closure. You’ll analyze findings from vulnerability assessment tools, evaluate risk and exposure, coordinate remediation plans, and track progress through established systems of record.

You’ll work closely with application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to ensure vulnerabilities are prioritized appropriately and remediated within required time frames. You’ll also use cloud-based AI tools and established security practices to support vulnerability identification, improve remediation workflows, and contribute to reporting and continuous process improvement.

This role is ideal for a security professional who combines technical vulnerability analysis with strong coordination, communication, and reporting skills in a regulated cloud environment.

## ## Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead and coordinate vulnerability remediation activities across infrastructure and applications, ensuring identified vulnerabilities are tracked, prioritized, and resolved in accordance with established security requirements and remediation timelines.

Exposure-Based Risk Prioritization: Evaluate vulnerabilities using CVE and CVSS data, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack paths, exposure information, and other relevant risk indicators to help determine remediation priorities.

CISA Directive Alignment: Support vulnerability remediation activities aligned with applicable CISA BOD 26-04 requirements and other relevant federal cybersecurity directives, including monitoring remediation progress against required deadlines.

Infrastructure & Application Security: Support vulnerability assessment and remediation across Windows Server 2019 and above, Linux/RHEL 9.x and above, and application environments. Work with technical teams to identify appropriate remediation approaches, including patching, configuration changes, and other corrective actions.

Vulnerability Assessment Tools: Use tools such as Tenable Security Center, Nessus, and Qualys to review vulnerability findings, validate remediation status, identify outstanding exposures, and support ongoing vulnerability management operations.

Application & Infrastructure Team Collaboration: Partner with application owners, application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to communicate findings, clarify remediation requirements, resolve technical or process-related questions, and drive issues to closure.

Tracking & System of Record Management: Maintain accurate vulnerability records in ServiceNow or other designated systems of record. Update remediation status, document actions taken, track outstanding items, and ensure records reflect the current state of identified vulnerabilities.

Patch Management & Change Coordination: Coordinate patching and remediation activities with application and infrastructure teams, following established change management processes and supporting timely, controlled implementation of corrective actions.

Exception Management & Risk Response: Support vulnerability exception management, risk-based remediation decisions, incident-driven response activities, and escalation of overdue or unresolved vulnerabilities to the appropriate stakeholders.

AI-Assisted Vulnerability Analysis: Leverage cloud-based AI tools, where appropriate, to support vulnerability identification, analysis, prioritization, and remediation workflows while applying sound security judgment and established review processes.

Risk Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain periodic vulnerability management metrics and reports, including remediation progress, aging vulnerabilities, overdue findings, risk trends, and other indicators used to communicate exposure and remediation effectiveness.

Process Improvement & Documentation: Identify opportunities to improve vulnerability management procedures, remediation workflows, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency. Maintain clear documentation of findings, remediation activities, exceptions, and supporting processes.

## ## What You Bring to the Team

The Vulnerability Management Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in vulnerability management, vulnerability remediation, patch management, or a closely related infrastructure security role.

The Security Assessment Toolkit: Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment and management tools, including Tenable Security Center, Nessus, and Qualys.

The Windows Foundation: Working knowledge of Windows Server 2019 and later, including vulnerability remediation, security patching, and system configuration.

The Linux Foundation: Experience supporting Linux environments, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9.x and later, including security updates, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

The Risk-Based Approach: Understanding of CVE and CVSS analysis, vulnerability prioritization, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and exposure-based remediation practices.

The Remediation Mindset: Demonstrated experience coordinating vulnerability remediation and patch management activities, tracking findings through closure, and working with technical teams to resolve outstanding security issues.

The Change Management Discipline: Familiarity with change management processes and the ability to coordinate remediation activities while supporting operational stability and established controls.

The Service Management Skills: Experience using ServiceNow ticketing or similar systems to track vulnerabilities, document remediation progress, manage escalations, and maintain accurate records.

The Reporting & Analytics Capability: Strong Microsoft Excel and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze vulnerability data, track remediation metrics, identify trends, and communicate risk status clearly.

The Collaboration Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk stakeholders to drive remediation outcomes.

The Problem Solver: Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate technical findings, clarify remediation requirements, and manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

The Federal Security Awareness: Ability to work within a regulated cloud environment and follow established security, compliance, documentation, and risk management processes.

The Citizenship Requirement: Must be a US citizen.

## ## Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

• Federal Cybersecurity Frameworks: Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and federal cybersecurity compliance requirements.

• Threat Intelligence & Exploitation Awareness: Experience using CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) information and other threat intelligence sources to prioritize remediation based on active exploitation and emerging threats.

• Federal & DoD Environments: Experience supporting US federal government, Department of Defense (DoD), or other regulated enterprise environments.

• Automation & Scripting: Experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python to automate vulnerability analysis, reporting, patch management, or remediation workflows.

• Endpoint Management: Familiarity with ManageEngine Endpoint Central or similar endpoint management and patch deployment platforms.

• Virtualization & Directory Services: Experience supporting VMware environments and Active Directory infrastructure.

• Application Security Remediation: Experience identifying and coordinating remediation of application vulnerabilities, including web application security findings.

• Cloud Security & AI Tools: Familiarity with cloud security technologies and AI-assisted tools used for vulnerability analysis, security operations, and risk reduction.

• Continuous Improvement: A track record of improving vulnerability remediation timelines, strengthening reporting processes, and reducing technology risk through effective coordination and automation.

## Preferred Certifications

Relevant cybersecurity, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, or cloud security certifications are desirable.

Examples include CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), and other relevant security certifications.

## ## Why Join Us?

Meaningful Cybersecurity Impact: Help reduce technology risk and strengthen the security posture of cloud environments supporting critical federal government operations.

Mission-Critical Security Work: Contribute to vulnerability remediation activities aligned with federal cybersecurity directives and established compliance requirements.

Technical Problem-Solving: Work across infrastructure, applications, vulnerability assessment tools, and remediation processes to address complex security challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with application owners, infrastructure engineers, vendors, and risk stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in security and operational effectiveness.

Continuous Improvement: Help optimize vulnerability management practices, improve remediation efficiency, and strengthen risk reporting through automation, analytics, and emerging AI-assisted capabilities.

The pay range for this opportunity is from $127,100 to $133,400 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies.

• Creating a comfortable and safe environment that provides opportunities for privacy, dignity, autonomy, independence and individuality and maintenance of personal lifestyle and values.

• Participates in and attends in-service programs provided by the community as well as conferences, seminars, and workshops.

Hardware Lab Technician

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

About Us

Social networking, machine learning, and big data analytics demand ever-increasing network connectivity. RANOVUS, with operations in Ottawa, Canada, Nuremberg, Germany, and San Jose, USA, is a solution provider for the next generation data center infrastructures. We aim to deliver advanced technology that minimizes environmental impact through lower power dissipation. Working with world class fabrication partners, RANOVUS is the leader in the application of unique new technologies to fiber-optic communications products for data-centers.

About the Role
We are seeking a hands-on Hardware Lab Technician to support our engineering teams through hardware assembly, testing, equipment maintenance, and general lab operations. In this role, you will build and rework electronic assemblies, maintain lab infrastructure, support hardware validation activities, and ensure the lab remains safe, organized, and fully functional. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented technician with strong electronics skills and a passion for supporting product development.

What You’ll Do

• Assemble and test electronic circuit boards, prototypes, and test platforms

• Perform micro-soldering, including fine-pitch SMD (down to 01005)

• Build wire harnesses and support setup of test stations and laser safety workbenches

• Maintain lab equipment (UPS units, clean air hoods), coordinate calibrations, and manage repairs

• Support daily lab operations: stocking consumables, hazardous waste handling, organization, and safety checks

• Assist with hardware validation setups, debugging support, and ESD-compliant workflows

• Provide light network/IT support (router setup, device connectivity, basic troubleshooting)

• Maintain accurate documentation, inventory, SDS files, and asset records

What You'll Bring

• Electronics Technologist diploma with 2–4 years of relevant experience

• Strong electronics fundamentals, component identification, and troubleshooting skills

• Experience with electronics assembly, micro-soldering, and rework

• Familiarity with lab tools (multimeters, power supplies, soldering stations, microscopes, ESD equipment)

• Excellent organization, attention to detail, and commitment to lab safety

• Strong collaboration skills and ability to work independently on defined tasks

Assets

Experience in R&D or hardware labs, wiring harness assembly, SDS handling, basic networking support, and equipment calibration workflows.

Work Environment

Hands-on engineering lab with frequent use of small electronic components, fine soldering, chemicals (with PPE), and specialized tools, working closely with electrical, mechanical, optical test, software and IT teams.

You Belong At Ranovus

We appreciate the time you invest in exploring opportunities with us. At Ranovus, we believe diverse perspectives and a strong sense of belonging are essential to building innovative technology and resilient teams. If your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, growth, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity-deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process on request. Reach out to our Talent team at talent@ranovus.com for support.

We are committed to a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage. We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools help with consistency and efficiency, but they don’t replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in this role, an existing vacancy on our team. We look forward to connecting with you.

Laser Device Characterization & Automation

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

About Us

Ranovus is a semiconductor company with global operations helping power the data behind next generation AI and data center networks. We design and build advanced hardware that moves massive amounts of information quickly and efficiently between computer systems in data centers around the world. Our technology improves performance while reducing energy use and environmental impact, supporting the rapid growth of AI and cloud services. At Ranovus, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team that values learning, flexibility, and meaningful work with global impact.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Test Engineer to plan, prepare, and execute electrical, optical, environmental, and reliability testing of laser chips-on-carrier (CoC) devices and related optical assemblies. The successful candidate will develop test plans, prepare samples, perform device characterization, and analyze performance and reliability data.

This role will also involve developing test apparatus, implementing test automation using Python, and creating automated visual inspection processes to support product development and manufacturing. The engineer will work closely with device engineering, packaging, qualification and reliability teams, external packaging suppliers, and third-party test providers to ensure robust characterization and qualification of new products.

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning and Characterization

• Develop test plans and characterization strategies for laser chips-on-carrier devices and related optical assemblies.

• Prepare and manage test samples, including tracking configurations, build history, and test requirements.

• Perform electrical, optical, thermal, and environmental characterization of semiconductor laser devices.

• Execute performance testing including:
• LIV characterization

• Spectral measurements

• Wavelength and power stability testing

• High-speed modulation characterization

• Temperature-dependent performance testing

• Aging and reliability evaluations

• Maintain detailed records of test procedures, conditions, and results.

Device Qualification and Reliability

• Work closely with the Device Qualification and Reliability team to define and execute qualification plans.

• Support reliability programs including accelerated aging, temperature cycling, damp heat, storage, and other environmental stress testing.

• Analyze reliability data to identify degradation mechanisms and performance trends.

• Support failure analysis investigations and root-cause determination.

Test Development and Automation

• Design, develop, and commission test apparatus for characterization and reliability testing.

• Develop automated test systems and data acquisition software using Python and related engineering tools.

• Improve test throughput, repeatability, and data quality through automation and software enhancements.

• Integrate measurement instruments, motion systems, environmental chambers, and machine vision components into automated test platforms.

• Create and maintain software documentation, calibration procedures, and user guides for internally developed systems.

Automated Visual Inspection

• Develop, verify, and document automated visual inspection processes for laser devices.

• Implement machine vision and image analysis techniques for defect detection, dimensional measurement, alignment verification, and process monitoring.

• Establish inspection criteria and acceptance standards in collaboration with engineering and quality teams.

• Validate inspection performance through repeatability, reproducibility, sensitivity, and false-call analysis.

• Generate documentation supporting process qualification and manufacturing release.

Supplier and External Test Coordination

• Interface with external packaging suppliers regarding sample preparation, technical requirements, schedules, and issue resolution.

• Coordinate characterization, qualification, and reliability testing activities with external laboratories and service providers.

• Review externally generated test data and reports to ensure compliance with project requirements.

• Track sample flow, test progress, and deliverables across multiple suppliers and partners.

Data Analysis and Reporting

• Analyze experimental data using statistical and engineering methods.

• Generate technical reports and presentations summarizing test results and recommendations.

• Present findings to engineering and management teams.

• Drive continuous improvement of test methodologies, automation tools, and data analysis workflows.

Laboratory Support

• Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory characterization equipment.

• Develop and improve laboratory procedures, test fixtures, and documentation.

• Ensure testing activities comply with quality and safety requirements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Optical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in semiconductors, photonics, optoelectronics, or laser device testing.

• Hands-on experience characterizing semiconductor lasers or related optoelectronic devices.

• Experience with laboratory instrumentation such as:
• Source Measure Units (SMUs)

• Optical Spectrum Analyzers (OSAs)

• Power meters

• Oscilloscopes

• Temperature controllers

• Environmental test chambers

• Experience with Python programming for test automation, data acquisition, or data analysis.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple technical activities and external suppliers simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with InP-based photonic devices and semiconductor lasers.

• Experience developing automated test systems using Python or similar programming languages.

• Experience with machine vision, image analysis, or automated optical inspection systems.

• Familiarity with laboratory automation, instrument control, and data acquisition systems.

• Familiarity with Telcordia, JEDEC, or related device qualification standards.

• Knowledge of semiconductor device physics and failure mechanisms.

• Strong technical documentation and report-writing skills.

Personal Attributes

• Highly organized and detail oriented.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Hands-on approach to problem solving.

• Effective collaborator across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• Comfortable working with both internal stakeholders and external partners.

• Passion for developing innovative test and inspection solutions.

What You'll Do

You will play a key role in advancing next-generation laser products from development through qualification. By combining hands-on characterization, automation development, reliability testing, and machine vision inspection, you will help establish the data, tools, and processes needed to bring high-performance laser products into production. Working closely with R&D, qualification and reliability teams, packaging suppliers, and external test providers, you will contribute directly to the successful commercialization of cutting-edge photonic technologies.

You Belong At Ranovus

We appreciate the time you invest in exploring opportunities with us. At Ranovus, we believe diverse perspectives and a strong sense of belonging are essential to building innovative technology and resilient teams. If your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, growth, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity-deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process on request. Reach out to our Talent team at talent@ranovus.com for support.

We are committed to a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage. We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools help with consistency and efficiency, but they don’t replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in this role, an existing vacancy on our team. We look forward to connecting with you.

## CNC VBM Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

We are currently seeking qualified applicants to fill large machining center positions at our facility in Barberton, Ohio. Successful applicants will be able to set up and operate large, CNC Vertical Boring Machines (Vertical Lathes) , as well as any associated auxiliary equipment. Machining operations will include boring, facing, turning, grooving, contouring, taper turning, taper boring, grinding, and other operations to produce quality product in accordance with established procedures. Makes in-process changes to programs and edits/writes programs, as necessary, under the supervision of a programmer and/or immediate supervisor.

## Purpose

• Performs multi-axis machining operations with high precision. Operates equipment while utilizing right angle heads, facing heads, inspection probes, jib cranes, tool attachments, all types of fixtures, any and all set-up equipment, tool setters, tool holders, precision measuring instruments, power tools and any hand tools necessary for the fulfillment of job duties.

• Works with programmer to develop and test run programs. Proof reads programs and notifies supervisor/programmer of potential problems.

• Positions and secures work piece and fixtures on table.

• Obtains drawings and tools from the crib and verifies the tools are correct for the application and matches the tools called for in the program(s).

• Assembles tooling as required.

• Uses higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices.

• Directs and assists crane operator with the rigging and moving of parts to load and unload machine.

• Performs final inspection of features using both the inspection probe and precision measuring equipment.

• Cleans and deburrs job as necessary. Attaches seals and protective covers as required.

• Performs minor maintenance on machine, attachments, and tooling as required.

• Keeps equipment and work area clean and orderly.

• Verifies identity and physical characteristics of materials as required.

• Maintains necessary records and completes process documentation and any other production records as required. Identifies equipment and product as required.

## Minimum Requirements

• High school diploma or GED equivalency required.

• A minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience performing precision machining functions on large machines is desired. Journeyman level machinist designation or equivalent is preferred.

• Must be open and available to working all shifts

• Must be proficient with CNC controls, including G and M coded commands.

• Must be able to edit or modify programs as necessary. Must be able to write minor programs.

• Must have a working knowledge of feeds and speeds for all types of material.

• Must be able to work to ±.001" tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary.

• Must demonstrate ability to read and interpret geometric tolerancing per ANSI Y14.5

• Ability to demonstrate use of various measuring instruments, including dial bore gages, indicator snap gages, verniers, .0001 micrometers, and other specialty gaging equipment

• Possess skills necessary to maintain accurate documentation and the ability to follow complicated procedures and document accordingly.

• Must pass all pre-employment processes, to include skills assessments and mechanical comprehension testing, background check, drug screen, and physical examination.

## Physical Demands

While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required communicate verbally and with written information; to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and use ladders inside and outside of parts being machined . The employee is occasionally required to lift and move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is seeking an MES Technical Lead with hands-on experience configuring and implementing Manufacturing Execution Systems in a production environment. In this role, you will lead the design, deployment, and optimization of manufacturing information systems, ensuring seamless integration between MES and core enterprise systems such as ERP, QMS, and timekeeping.

You will serve as a technical owner and architect, translating manufacturing and business requirements into scalable MES solutions. This is a hands-on, system-focused role responsible for configuration, data migration, upgrades, system harmonization, and operational support. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners across Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and IT, while reporting to the Senior Manager, Information Technology, Commercial Operations.

Experience with iBASE‑t Solumina is strongly preferred, although candidates with other enterprise MES platforms—such as Siemens Opcenter, DELMIA Apriso, GE Proficy, Plex, FactoryLogix, or comparable systems—are encouraged to apply.

## Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities

## Technical Responsibilities

• Perform hands-on configuration of MES application modules; define and enforce MES configuration standards to ensure long-term stability and system health.

• Architect and design manufacturing system solutions, collaborating with infrastructure, network, and cybersecurity teams to ensure high availability, security, and operational continuity.

• Recommend and implement system optimization and harmonization across MES, ERP, QMS, timekeeping, and other integrated systems.

• Diagnose, troubleshoot, resolve, and test issues across production information systems, including SAP, MES, timekeeping platforms, and quality systems.

• Lead and support application consolidation, upgrades, data migration efforts, and new capability rollouts.

• Ensure data integrity, proper master data alignment, and accurate transaction flows throughout connected manufacturing systems.

## Leadership & Delivery Responsibilities

• Lead cross-functional technical and functional teams throughout project lifecycles.

• Collect, evaluate, and prioritize business and manufacturing requirements.

• Facilitate meetings with stakeholders, project teams, external partners, and system integrators.

• Drive process optimization and business process streamlining, aligning solutions with industry best practices and evolving business needs.

• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to internal team members.

• Coordinate and oversee external consultants and implementation partners.

• Ensure solution integrity through established quality assurance practices.

• Deliver end-user training and documentation to support adoption of new processes and system enhancements.

• Demonstrate strong project management practices, including experience collaborating with PMO and steering committees.

## Required Qualifications:

• ## Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant work experience in manufacturing IT, production systems, or MES-focused technical roles.

• ## MES Expertise

• Direct, hands-on experience with MES systems such as iBASE‑t Solumina — including system configuration, workflow design, troubleshooting, and integration activities.

• Strong knowledge of MES best practices and the ability to maximize out-of-the-box capabilities before pursuing customizations.

## Systems Integration & Solution Design

• Experience capturing business and technical requirements and translating them into MES solution designs.

• Proven experience planning and executing data migrations, driving information system harmonization, and contributing to portfolio shaping across enterprise manufacturing applications.

• Skilled in integrating MES with ERP, QMS, timekeeping, and other production‑centric systems

## Project & Organizational Leadership

• Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including waterfall and agile.

• Experience working with or presenting to a PMO, steering committee, or equivalent governance body.

• Demonstrated ability to create technical architecture documentation, support materials, executive-level diagrams, and system presentations.

## Communication & Documentation

• Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical information effectively across both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

## Security Requirements

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a DOE (Department of Energy) security clearance

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Relevant experience in iBASE-t Solumina.

• ERP, Timekeeping, and QMS systems knowledge.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## CNC VMC Operator - BWX Technologies, Inc. - Barberton, OH

We are currently seeking qualified applicants to fill large machining center positions at our facility in Barberton, Ohio. Successful applicants will be able to set up and operate large, CNC Vertical Machining Centers, as well as any associated auxiliary equipment. Machining operations will include boring, facing, turning, grooving, contouring, taper turning, taper boring, grinding, and other operations to produce quality product in accordance with established procedures. Makes in-process changes to programs and edits/writes programs, as necessary, under the supervision of a programmer and/or immediate supervisor.

## Purpose

• Performs multi-axis machining operations with high precision to operate and maintain machine, right angle heads, facing heads, inspection probe, jib crane, tool attachments, all types of fixtures, any and all set-up equipment, tool setter, tool holders, precision measuring instruments, power tools and any hand tools necessary for the fulfillment of job duties.

• Works with programmer to develop and test run programs. Proof reads programs and notifies supervisor/programmer of potential problems.

• Positions and secures work piece and fixtures on table.

• Obtains drawings and tools from the crib and verifies the tools are correct for the application and matches the tools called for in the program(s).

• Assembles tooling as required.

• Uses higher math and engineering theories to work with tooling engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices.

• Directs and assists crane operator with the rigging and moving of parts to load and unload machine.

• Performs final inspection of features using both the inspection probe and precision measuring equipment.

• Cleans and deburrs job as necessary. Attaches seals and protective covers as required.

• Performs minor maintenance on machine, attachments, and tooling as required.

• Keeps equipment and work area clean and orderly.

• Verifies identity and physical characteristics of materials as required.

• Maintains necessary records and completes process documentation and any other production records as required. Identifies equipment and product as required.

## Minimum Requirements

• High school diploma or GED equivalency required.

• A minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience performing precision machining functions on large machines is desired. Journeyman level machinist designation or equivalent is preferred.

• Must be a US Citizen.

• Must be open and available to working all shifts.

• Must be proficient with CNC controls, including G and M coded commands.

• Must be able to edit or modify programs as necessary. Must be able to write minor programs.

• Must have a working knowledge of feeds and speeds for all types of material.

• Must be able to work to .000" tolerance and microfinish 16 when necessary.

• Must demonstrate ability to read and interpret geometric tolerancing per ANSI Y14.5

• Ability to demonstrate use of various measuring instruments, including dial bore gages, indicator snap gages, verniers, .0001 micrometers, and other specialty gaging equipment.

• Possess skills necessary to maintain accurate documentation and the ability to follow complicated procedures and document accordingly.

• Must pass all pre-employment processes, to include skills assessments and mechanical comprehension testing, background check, drug screen, and physical examination.

## Physical Demands

While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required communicate verbally and with written information; to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and use ladders inside and outside of parts being machined. The employee is occasionally required to lift and move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Please note: This position pays $40.90 per hour and is complemented by a generous benefits package. Upon an offer, a relocation package is available for eligible candidates

What you bring: Required: 2–4 years of experience in Sales, Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role. Strong communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills. Experience conducting customer calls, trainings, or presentations. Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters RRSP/401k match and competitive compensation packages to invest in your future Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA. Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career Compensation range The salary range for this role is between $60,000 and $75,000 (CAD). Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package. Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region. Why Fullscript Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door. What to Know Before You Apply We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page. A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly. Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at accommodations@fullscript.com. All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws. We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S. Learn More www.fullscript.com @fullscriptHQon instagram @fullscripton YouTube FullScript on LinkedIn

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/809.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Solace is seeking a Director of Web to own solace.com as both a technical asset and a business driver. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, marketing, and design – someone who can understand a page's code, diagnose a Core Web Vitals problem, and just as comfortably read a conversion funnel and know why it's leaking.

You won't be writing site copy or designing pages yourself, but you'll be the person who pulls content, design, and dev work together into a site that performs — technically and commercially. You'll run the web the way a product manager runs a product: with a roadmap, a backlog, clear ownership, and a constant eye on the numbers. As the product owner for the web, you'll hold a senior seat at the table alongside PMM, Marketing Operations, and other stakeholders, and carry the SEO and AEO agenda for the site.

This is a lean team and a hands-on role for someone who wants real ownership without layers of process slowing them down — and who can guide and influence rather than block.

What You’ll Do

Roadmap & Prioritization

• Run intake and triage for all web requests across marketing, sales, product, and leadership, so every ask is logged, sized, and sequenced rather than handled ad hoc.

• Recommend a quarterly web roadmap based on impact vs. effort, balancing SEO/AEO opportunities, conversion work, technical debt, and stakeholder requests.

• Communicate trade-offs clearly — what's in, what's next, and what isn't making the cut this quarter.

Web Standards & Guardrails

• Act as the product owner for solace.com and the steward of its standards for performance, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, and SEO foundations.

• Serve as a pseudo gatekeeper for the web. With a lean team, the goal isn't to say no to everything; it's to make sure stakeholders know what's changing and to flag risks early.

• Monitor how changes affect site performance, and raise flags when key metrics move up or down so the team can respond quickly.

Product Management for Web Development

• Act as the Product Manager for web: scope and write tickets with clear requirements and acceptance criteria for internal and agency developers.

• Support QA and releases — helping validate work before launch and confirming it performs as intended once live.

• Partner with engineering/dev resources (internal or agency) to prioritize and ship fixes and improvements, and manage external vendors or agencies supporting web development as needed.

• Contribute hands-on to technical work only when it's the fastest path; the focus of this role is scoping and prioritization, not building.

SEO & AEO

• Help shape SEO and AEO strategy at a high level, working with content and agency partners to turn it into an executable plan.

• Bring depth on either the technical or the non-technical side of SEO; we'll pair you with the right resources to cover the other.

• Use technical SEO audits, log file analysis, and AI visibility tracking to identify issues and opportunities, and feed them into the roadmap.

Reporting & Analytics

• Report on the impact of web across the Sales and PLG funnels — even though web owns only one piece of each flow — covering traffic, conversion rate, page performance, and funnel drop-off.

• Partner with Marketing Operations and the other teams that own the rest of the funnel to build a connected, trustworthy view of the full customer journey.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Hold a seat at the table with PMM, MOps, and other marketing stakeholders through regular check-ins, representing web in planning and campaign conversations.

• Work closely with content and design contributors to plan, sequence, and launch new pages, campaigns, and site updates — without being the one drafting copy or comps.

• Act as the connective tissue between marketing, content, design, and engineering so web work moves quickly and nothing stalls in handoffs.

• Translate business and campaign goals into a clear website strategy, and bring a B2B SaaS lens to how the site should convert visitors into pipeline.

Testing & Experimentation

• Run A/B tests or landing page experiments per month on the highest-trafficked pages. This is a lighter-touch responsibility in the near term, with room to grow as the roadmap matures.

What You’ll Bring to this role

• 8-10 years of experience in a strategic web-focused role that understands the entire web development workflow.

• B2B SaaS experience required; startup or high-growth environment experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to move fast and prioritize without heavy process overhead.

• Working technical fluency: comfortable in HTML/CSS, familiar with modern web platforms (e.g., WordPress, or similar), and conversant enough in dev workflows to contribute or troubleshoot when needed.

• Strong grasp of web performance fundamentals — page speed, Core Web Vitals — and of technical SEO, including log file analysis.

• Working knowledge of AI visibility tracking and how AEO differs from traditional SEO.

• Experience acting as a product manager for web: scoping tickets, supporting QA, and shepherding releases with internal or agency developers.

• Experience reporting on funnel performance across sales-led and PLG motions, including where you own only part of the flow.

• Track record of using data (analytics, funnel metrics, A/B testing) to drive measurable conversion improvements.

• Experience managing a roadmap and competing priorities across multiple stakeholders, including triaging intake and prioritizing by impact vs. effort.

• Experience working closely with product marketing and product teams to understand strategic direction and translate it into web priorities.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong project management and prioritization skills.

• Comfortable operating as both an individual contributor and a cross-functional coordinator.

• Clear communicator who can translate technical issues for non-technical stakeholders and business goals for technical ones.

• Self-directed and biased toward action.

• Able to influence without authority — setting standards and raising flags rather than blocking work.

• Senior presence to hold a seat at the table with PMM, MOps, and other leaders and represent the web with confidence.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

ABOUT GIATEC:

Giatec Scientific Inc. is a global leader in smart concrete testing technologies, bringing real-time data, AI, and IoT solutions to jobsites worldwide. Our core products - SmartRock®, SmartMix®, and MixPilot® - support the full concrete lifecycle, from mix design and production to placement and performance monitoring, helping teams improve quality, efficiency, and sustainability while reducing concrete’s carbon footprint.

Giatec solutions have been used on 15,000+ projects across 85+ countries, and we’ve been recognized as one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies for three consecutive years. We believe our people are key to our success and are always looking for curious, driven individuals to help shape the future of construction technology.

The expected salary range for this role is between $75,000-$115,000. This role represents an existing vacancy within the organization.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

We're looking for an IT Operations Lead who believes great IT is invisible: people get what they need, it just works, and it's secure without getting in anyone's way. You'll lead IT at a fast-moving technology company that is all in on AI, with real room to rethink how we work, automate the repetitive stuff, and build systems our team actually enjoys using.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with 5 to 8 years of IT experience who is ready to own the function, lead and grow a small team, and take initiative without waiting to be asked.

WHO YOU ARE:

- You're an enabler. Your goal is to help people do their best work, and when a request comes in, you look for the secure way to say yes.
- You take security seriously without making it painful. MFA, conditional access and patching are non-negotiable, and you make them feel seamless.
- You take initiative. When something is broken or manual, you fix it or automate it before anyone has to file a ticket.
- You're a team player who brings good energy. You're approachable, patient with non-technical colleagues, and you enjoy a good laugh at work.
- You're curious about AI and already use it to work smarter.

IN YOUR FIRST SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL:

- Get to know the team and our systems, and become the trusted go-to person for IT
- Ship at least one automation that saves the team real time every week
- Test our disaster recovery plan end to end and close the gaps you find
- Set a clear IT roadmap that balances security, cost and a great employee experience

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

Everyday IT That Just Works
- Own day-to-day IT support as the senior escalation point, partnering with our IT team member to resolve issues quickly and keep people productive
- Run our core environment: Windows/macOS endpoints, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, networking, and office A/V
- Own the full user lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, role changes) and hardware, from procurement to retirement, and keep an eye on system health and uptime

Automation and AI
- Find the repetitive work and automate it: provisioning, password resets, ticket routing, self-service knowledge bases and more
- Build workflows with AI and scripting tools (PowerShell, Python, Bash, Power Automate, n8n, or similar)
- Bring new ideas to leadership as AI for IT operations evolves

Security That Enables, Not Blocks
- Build and maintain security practices (endpoint protection, MFA, conditional access, patching, awareness training) that protect Giatec while keeping people productive
- Own backup, disaster recovery and business continuity, and test them regularly so we know they work
- Run periodic security reviews, fix what you find, and work with our external security partners

Strategy, Projects and Leadership
- Lead IT projects such as SaaS rollouts, migrations, network upgrades and integrations, partnering with Engineering, Product, Sales and Operations
- Own IT policies, budgets, vendors and licensing, keeping things simple, well documented and cost-effective
- Lead, mentor and grow our IT team member, and build a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing

MUST-HAVES:
- 5 to 8 years of experience in IT systems administration, IT operations, or a related technical role
- Experience mentoring, leading, or coordinating IT staff
- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID/Azure AD)
- Proficiency in scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) with a track record of automating IT workflows
- Experience with endpoint management tools (Intune, Jamf, or similar MDM solutions)
- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall configuration, TCP/IP)

NICE-TO-HAVES:
- Experience designing and testing disaster recovery and backup solutions
- Familiarity with security frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, NIST, or ISO 27001)
- Experience with AI tools for IT operations (AIOps platforms, Claude or other LLM integrations, AI-powered monitoring)
- Cloud certifications (Azure Administrator, AWS SysOps, or equivalent)
- ITIL or other IT service management experience
- Experience managing SaaS integrations and SSO/SCIM provisioning
- Experience in a startup or scale-up environment where wearing multiple hats is the norm
- Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

PERKS AND BENEFITS:
- Competitive company-paid benefits plan
- Generous professional development budget
- Volunteer and Life Days that make work/life balance easier to achieve
- Your birthday off (because we want you to celebrate)
- RRSP matching program through RBC

TO APPLY:

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply - we value diverse experiences and would love to learn more about you. Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your interest in the role. Applications are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team; due to application volume, response times may vary. We appreciate your interest to be part of Giatec and understanding on this matter.

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

## What you need to know

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong economics and quantitative modelling expertise to help shape the future of economic research, policy analysis, and data-driven decision-making at the Bank of Canada. You will provide technical and methodological leadership in applying advanced analytics, machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI), and quantitative methods to complex economic research and policy challenges. Your work will influence analytical practices, strengthen organizational capabilities, and support evidence-based decisions across the Bank’s policy and research functions.

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Data Science, within the Department of Data and Digital Services (DDS), you will bring together economics, data science, and emerging technologies. Partnering closely with economists, researchers, business clients, and technology teams, you will develop and apply advanced analytical solutions, AI-enabled tools, and modelling capabilities that enhance the effectiveness, accessibility, and productivity of research, policy analysis, and decision-making. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how advanced analytics and AI are adopted across the organization, helping modernize research and analytical practices while contributing to high-impact initiatives that matter to Canadians. Through your expertise, you will contribute to building new, sustainable analytical capabilities that support the organization's long-term research, policy, and strategic objectives.

## What you will do

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead complex analytical initiatives that advance economic research, forecasting, policy analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. Drawing on expertise in economics, data science, and emerging technologies, you will provide technical and methodological leadership while strengthening the Bank’s AI and data science capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the design, development, validation, deployment, and operationalization of statistical, econometric, ML, and AI models that address complex economic, research, and policy questions.

• Building AI-enabled applications, analytical tools, reusable frameworks, and scalable data products that improve research, modelling, forecasting, and decision-making workflows.

• Partnering with economists, researchers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to identify, prioritize, and implement opportunities where data science and AI can improve analytical outcomes and operational effectiveness.

• Translating analytical findings into actionable insights and clearly communicating methodologies, assumptions, limitations, and results to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Providing technical and methodological guidance, mentoring team members, and supporting the successful delivery of complex analytical initiatives.

• Establishing and promoting best practices in reproducible research, model governance, responsible AI, model explainability, documentation, and analytical quality.

• Evaluating emerging AI, ML, and analytical methods and guiding their appropriate adoption to strengthen economic models, research methodologies, forecasting approaches, and decision-making workflows.

## What you need to succeed

You are a collaborative and innovative data scientist with strong expertise in economics and quantitative modelling. You combine deep technical knowledge and sound methodological judgment with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, influence stakeholders, and translate economic research and policy challenges into impactful analytical solutions.

You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and working in complex environments. You continuously expand your knowledge of emerging AI and data science methods and contribute to a culture of learning, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing.

You bring:

• Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical projects and delivering impactful business, policy, or research outcomes.

• Expertise in econometrics, forecasting, statistical modelling, ML, AI, and quantitative analysis.

• Experience applying large language models (LLMs), generative AI, agentic AI systems, or other emerging AI technologies to research, analytical, or decision-support use cases.

• Proficiency with programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or similar analytical computing tools.

• Experience working with cloud-based analytics platforms such as Azure, Databricks, or equivalent environments.

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience contributing to economic research, forecasting studies, policy papers, or other analytical publications that support evidence-based decision-making.

## Nice-to- Have

• Experience:

• designing enterprise analytical solutions or analytical platforms.

• supporting AI adoption initiatives and organizational capability development.

• leading cross‑functional collaborations involving business partners, researchers, and technology teams.

## Education and Experience

This position requires a master’s degree or higher in economics, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, or a related quantitative discipline, along with a minimum of six years of experience applying advanced quantitative methods, including ML, AI, statistical modelling, and econometrics, in support of economic policy, research, forecasting, or evidence-based decision-making. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may also be considered.

Aperçu du poste

L’analyste en dynamique de vol est un membre technique du groupe de dynamique de vol responsable de l’exécution et de la surveillance des opérations de maintien en orbite des satellites des clients et des systèmes de dynamique de vol (FDS). L’analyste en dynamique de vol veille à ce que les parties prenantes disposent de renseignements orbitaux à jour afin de soutenir le pointage des antennes des stations terrestres en bande S, la planification des opérations satellitaires, la planification et le traitement des données scientifiques et, au besoin, les opérations de contrôle orbital.

Responsabilités

• Développer ses connaissances et son expérience grâce à divers programmes de formation, notamment la formation en cours d’emploi et la formation sur appel.

• Soutenir les opérations courantes de dynamique de vol ainsi que la planification, l’exécution et la production de rapports liés aux opérations de suivi et de contrôle orbital des satellites. Cela peut comprendre :

• Soutenir l’analyse des données de suivi des satellites, surveiller la qualité des produits de planification du FDS, rendre compte du profil orbital du satellite et, au besoin, définir les paramètres des manœuvres orbitales et planifier l’exécution des activités de manœuvre afin de corriger la trajectoire orbitale du satellite et de respecter les exigences spécifiées.

• Soutenir l’analyse des alertes de rapprochement de satellites, évaluer le niveau de menace selon des critères prédéfinis, et élaborer et mettre en œuvre des manœuvres d’évitement afin de réduire la probabilité de collisions.

• Surveiller régulièrement l’orientation de la Terre et les prévisions relatives à l’environnement spatial afin de déterminer les impacts sur les événements orbitaux, notamment les éclipses solaires, les événements météorologiques spatiaux, les ajustements de secondes intercalaires, etc.

• Soutenir la surveillance de toutes les activités orbitales prévues afin d’évaluer l’état et l’efficacité de la propulsion du satellite ainsi que le carburant restant, et tenir à jour les registres.

• Soutenir l’enquête sur les anomalies satellitaires et la production de rapports, au besoin.

• Soutenir les résultats des analyses techniques et opérationnelles, les conclusions et les recommandations.

• Participer aux réunions courantes de coordination et de récupération après anomalie.

• Soutenir la production de rapports d’état à l’intention des parties prenantes de la mission afin de décrire les événements non nominaux et les mesures de récupération, et d’évaluer leurs impacts sur le satellite et les données scientifiques.

• Soutenir l’identification et la résolution des problèmes liés au FDS, aux plans d’exploitation et aux procédures manuelles lorsque de tels changements sont nécessaires pour maintenir ou améliorer la disponibilité ou la performance du satellite et soutenir adéquatement le reste de la mission de référence.

• Contribuer au maintien d’interfaces de travail efficaces avec les organismes externes et les clients.

• Fournir du soutien au superviseur de l’ingénierie satellitaire (SSE), au gestionnaire des opérations spatiales (MSO), au siège social des Technologies avancées ou aux clients, selon les besoins.

• Effectuer d’autres tâches, au besoin, dans le contexte du poste.

## Qualifications

• Diplôme universitaire en physique, physique spatiale, génie physique, génie aérospatial ou l’équivalent.

• La maîtrise de l’anglais parlé et écrit est requise en raison de la nature des fonctions et des communications liées aux opérations et aux missions. Le français est un atout.

• Des connaissances en mécanique orbitale acquises dans le cadre de cours pertinents ou d’une expérience professionnelle sont requises. Une expérience professionnelle en mécanique orbitale est considérée comme un atout.

• La connaissance d’un ou de plusieurs des éléments suivants est considérée comme un atout :

• Caractéristiques de l’environnement spatial

• Programmation en C, Perl, Java et Python

• Utilisation des environnements Windows et Linux

• Outils d’analyse de données tels que MATLAB

• Produits AGI (STK, ODTK, Astrogator)

Exigences supplémentaires

• L’analyste en dynamique de vol doit être admissible à l’obtention d’une cote de sécurité Secret de SPAC et être admissible à l’accès aux marchandises contrôlées.

• Le travail s’effectue principalement sur place dans les installations d’un client, pendant les heures normales de bureau, avec un soutien sur appel, selon un horaire rotatif.

Rémunération

$60,000–$80,000

## Position Overview

The Flight Dynamics Analyst is a technical member of the Flight Dynamics group responsible for conducting and monitoring orbit maintenance operations of customer satellites and the Flight Dynamics Systems (FDS). The Flight Dynamics Analyst ensures stakeholders receive up-to-date orbit knowledge to support S-Band ground station antenna pointing, satellite operations planning, science data planning and processing, and as required orbit control operations.

## Responsibilities

• Develop knowledge and experience through various training programs, including on-the-job and on-call training.

• Support routine flight dynamics operations, and the planning, execution and reporting of satellite orbit custody operations. This can include:

• Support the analysis of satellite close approach alerts, evaluate the threat level using pre-defined criteria, develop and implement avoidance manoeuvres to reduce the probability of collisions.

• Monitor Earth orientation and space environment forecasts on a regular basis to identify impacts to orbit events including solar eclipses, space weather events, leap second adjustments, etc.

• Support the investigation and reporting of satellite anomalies as required.

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

Avaya is on a mission to redefine the Customer Experience (CX) landscape. We are moving beyond the traditional contact center to a true connection center to power immersive, personalized, and AI-driven experiences for the world's largest financial institutions.

We are seeking a National Account Manager to join our APAC Team in Thailand. You will bridge the gap between trusted, secure legacy infrastructure and the future of Agentic AI and Composable CX. You will demonstrate how our "Innovation Without Disruption" strategy allows our customers agility without the risks of a "rip and replace" migration.

You will own the narrative to drive sales results with our customers and prospects through channel partners. Your goal is to protect the core voice business while aggressively expanding into new AI, Cloud, and Orchestration territories.

• Strategic Leadership: Act as the primary business consultant to customer C-suite executives. Lead high-stakes discussions focused on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), and the commercial justification for complex migrations.

• Commercial Strategy: Develop successful transition strategies for customers migrating from legacy environments. You will build the roadmap for modernizing their CX while ensuring compliance with strict financial security standards.

## Champion Avaya Infinity Architecture & Agentic AI

• Evangelize Agentic AI: Move clients beyond simple chatbots to adopting autonomous AI agents capable of executing complex workflows—such as loan processing, fraud detection, and wealth advisory—securely and at scale.

• The Infinity Value Proposition: Consult clients on how to overlay modern cloud technologies and digital channels onto their existing, robust voice core. Show them how to innovate immediately without disrupting mission-critical operations.

• Solution Design: Lead high-level business discovery to define the strategy for large-scale CCaaS solutions, creating seamless journeys across voice and digital channels (chat, email, social, secure messaging).

## Value Realization & Competitive Positioning

• High-Impact Demonstrations: Partner with engineering to deliver compelling Product Demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that showcase integrations with core banking applications (CRM, WFO, ERP).

• Market Intelligence: Maintain expert-level knowledge of the CCaaS competitive landscape (e.g., Genesys, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect). Effectively articulate Avaya’s superior differentiation—specifically our ability to innovate on top of existing investments.

5+ Years of Experience

Master Degree is preferred

## Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Global Payroll to lead the strategy, transformation, and evolution of Calian’s global payroll function. This is an opportunity to build a scalable global payroll operating model that supports a growing workforce across multiple countries, entities, employment models, and providers.

CareersInnerInfo
The successful candidate will establish the vision, governance, controls, technology roadmap, team structure, and delivery approach required to create a consistent and sustainable global payroll ecosystem. This role will be particularly well suited to an experienced payroll leader who enjoys solving complex problems, building from the ground up, and combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

## Responsibilities

• Define and implement Calian’s global payroll strategy, operating model, governance framework, and long-term roadmap.

• Lead payroll delivery across multiple jurisdictions, entities, and employment structures, ensuring payroll is accurate, timely, compliant, and well controlled.

• Assess and evolve the optimal payroll delivery model, including centralized, regionalized, outsourced, in-house, and hybrid approaches.

• Establish standards for payroll governance, controls, reconciliations, service delivery, reporting, escalation management, and employee support.

• Evaluate and optimize payroll processes, reducing complexity, strengthening controls, and driving standardization while recognizing local requirements.

• Lead payroll vendor and partner relationships, including service expectations, performance management, issue resolution, contract discussions, and continuous improvement.

• Partner with People Technology, HR Operations, Finance, and IT to assess, implement, and optimize payroll technologies, integrations, automation, reporting, and data quality.

• Lead payroll due diligence and integration for acquisitions, including risk assessment, transition planning, harmonization, and post-acquisition integration.

• Support international expansion, new-country launches, entity setup, EOR transitions, and workforce mobility initiatives.

• Partner with HR, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, Internal Audit, and external providers to manage payroll compliance and operational risk.

• Lead responses to payroll-related internal and external audits and maintain strong audit readiness.

• Lead, coach, and develop the payroll team while building the structure and capabilities required to support a growing global organization.

## Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive payroll leadership experience in a similar function.

• Demonstrated global payroll experience across multiple countries and jurisdictions within North America, Europe and Asia

• Proven experience building, transforming, or significantly evolving payroll functions, operating models, systems, or processes.

• Strong understanding of global payroll governance, tax, compliance, controls, and risk management.

• Experience evaluating payroll technologies, integrations, vendors, and different payroll delivery models.

• Demonstrated ability to create structure within fragmented or complex environments and develop a clear future-state strategy.

• Strong people leadership experience, including coaching, team development, capability building, and organizational design.

• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading significant cross-functional change.

• Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, payroll harmonization, international expansion, or entity integration.

• Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and balance strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving.

## Additional Requirements

• The ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level.

• A collaborative and thoughtful leadership style with the ability to navigate significant organizational and operational change.

• Strong change management skills and the ability to build trust while challenging existing processes with curiosity and positive intent.

• Resilience, creativity, and a practical approach to solving complex problems.

• A genuine interest in building and transforming a global payroll function rather than simply maintaining an established environment.

$140,000 to $150,000CAD base salary + STI.

We have 1 full-time, permanent position available.
