## Ciena's New Product Introduction team is seeking a highly motivated test development engineer to join their dynamic team. This role involves playing a key part in delivering cutting-edge automated calibration and verification solutions for Ciena's optical portfolio, with a primary focus on Ciena's Wavelogic Extreme high-performance coherent modems.

##

## We are seeking an exceptional candidate who exemplifies a strong technical acumen and a data-driven problem-solving approach. This individual should demonstrate proficiency in troubleshooting hardware and software-related issues with expertise and precision. Effective and concise communication skills are vital, as the candidate will be responsible for effectively conveying their work to diverse teams, including designers, product engineers, contract manufacturers, and operators. The role encompasses a broad spectrum of responsibilities, ranging from selecting test station instruments to developing automation code for both hardware and software components.

##

## As part of the job requirements, regular attendance at the office is necessary on a daily basis. Additionally, there may be occasional evening meetings that you will need to attend

##

## Primary Responsibilities

• ## Develop and support test automation for both new and existing production lines

• ## Support the R&D team with test tools during the prototype development

• ## Support the contract manufacturer partners in testing beta prototypes, pre-production, and high-volume production

• ## Analyze production statistics to improve test time and yields as production scales

• ## Support failure analysis, root cause identification and corrective action implementation of components, sub-system, and field failures

• ## Facilitate the smooth transfer of new products to high-volume production across multiple sites.

• ## Develop and document fault isolation troubleshooting tools and guides

## Required Skills

## Must Have

• ## Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Optical Engineering, Physics or Computer Science

• ## Experience using optical and radio frequency RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, attenuators)

• ## 3+ years test automation software development (C#, Python, or Matlab)

• ## A comprehensive understanding of the fundamental components of high speed modems such as CDMs (coherent driver-modulators), intradyne coherent-receivers (ICRs), semiconductor lasers and amplifiers, tunable filters, and others.

• ## Good understanding of statistics in a production environment (CPk analysis, paretos)

## Preferred

• ## Test engineering experience including offshore production and debug management

• ## Experience using source control tools such as git

• ## Experience using the Atlassian suite of tools (Bitbucket/Sourcetree/Jira/Confluence)

• ## Ability to travel up to 10% of the time outside of Canada

• ## Fluency in oral and written French is desirable

## The annual pay range for this position is CAD $82,900 - $165,700

##

Lumentum Canada was awarded the 2022 National Capital Region’s Top Employers for the 6th consecutive year and the 2022 Career Directory Canada’s Best Employers for Recent Graduates for the 5th consecutive year.

Position Title: Senior Information Security Analyst

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Ottawa (On-Site)

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## Why You’ll Love This Role

At Lumentum, we develop the technologies that power the world's most advanced communications, industrial and cloud infrastructure. Security is fundamental to everything we do, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Information Security Analyst to help protect our people, data and global operations.

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative cyber security team where you'll lead complex investigations, strengthen security controls and influence how we defend against an evolving threat landscape. You'll work across cloud, identity, endpoint, network and data security while partnering with technical and business teams to continuously improve our security capability.

If you enjoy solving challenging security problems, mentoring others and driving meaningful improvements, we'd love to hear from you.

## What You’ll Be Doing

## As a senior member of our Information Security team, you'll:

• Lead the investigation and response to complex cyber security incidents across cloud, endpoint, identity, network, email and application environments.

• Drive improvements to our Security Operations capability through enhanced detections, playbooks, automation and operational processes.

• Own and enhance key security controls, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ensuring they remain effective, measurable and aligned with business needs.

• Assess vulnerabilities, prioritise remediation activities and work with technology teams to reduce cyber risk across the organisation.

• Provide security assurance for new projects and technology changes, helping embed security by design.

• Produce meaningful security metrics and reporting for technical and business stakeholders.

• Coach and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge and raising security capability across the organisation.

• Translate complex technical issues into clear, practical recommendations that support informed business decisions.

## What We’re Looking For

You'll have experience in several of the following areas:

• Security Operations, Security Incident Response or Security Engineering.

• Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) technologies.

• Identity and Access Management, including MFA, Conditional Access and Privileged Access.

• Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and policy management.

• Vulnerability Management and security hardening.

• Security architecture reviews and technical assurance.

• Threat detection, investigation and root cause analysis.

• Security automation, scripting or workflow improvement.

• You'll also be comfortable working with recognised security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls or the NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework.

We're looking for someone who:

• Has significant experience within cyber security, information security or security operations.

• Enjoys leading investigations and solving complex technical challenges.

• Can influence stakeholders at all levels with clear, confident communication.

• Thinks strategically while remaining hands-on.

• Takes ownership and is driven by continuous improvement.

• Builds strong relationships and enjoys developing others.

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA are desirable but not essential if you can demonstrate equivalent experience.

## Perks You’ll Love

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

## Salary Range: $70,000 - $102,000 CAD (flexible).

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In line with our commitment to being a great place to work, Lumentum offers competitive total rewards which may include annual bonus, equity, and comprehensive health and welfare benefits.

## Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

## Let’s Build a Brighter Future Together!

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

## Please contact us at talentacquisition@lumentum.com to request accommodation.

## Join us—your future starts here!

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

Avaya is on a mission to redefine the Customer Experience (CX) landscape. We are moving beyond the traditional contact center to a true connection center to power immersive, personalized, and AI-driven experiences for the world's largest financial institutions.

We are seeking a National Account Manager to join our APAC Team in Austrailia. You will bridge the gap between trusted, secure legacy infrastructure and the future of Agentic AI and Composable CX. You will demonstrate how our "Innovation Without Disruption" strategy allows our customers agility without the risks of a "rip and replace" migration.

## Your Mission

You will own the narrative to drive sales results with our customers and prospects through channel partners. Your goal is to protect the core voice business while aggressively expanding into new AI, Cloud, and Orchestration territories.

## Trusted Executive Advisor & Commercial Architect

• Strategic Leadership: Act as the primary business consultant to customer C-suite executives. Lead high-stakes discussions focused on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), and the commercial justification for complex migrations.

• Commercial Strategy: Develop successful transition strategies for customers migrating from legacy environments. You will build the roadmap for modernizing their CX while ensuring compliance with strict financial security standards.

## Champion Avaya Infinity Architecture & Agentic AI

• Evangelize Agentic AI: Move clients beyond simple chatbots to adopting autonomous AI agents capable of executing complex workflows—such as loan processing, fraud detection, and wealth advisory—securely and at scale.

• The Infinity Value Proposition: Consult clients on how to overlay modern cloud technologies and digital channels onto their existing, robust voice core. Show them how to innovate immediately without disrupting mission-critical operations.

• Solution Design: Lead high-level business discovery to define the strategy for large-scale CCaaS solutions, creating seamless journeys across voice and digital channels (chat, email, social, secure messaging).

## Value Realization & Competitive Positioning

• High-Impact Demonstrations: Partner with engineering to deliver compelling Product Demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that showcase integrations with core banking applications (CRM, WFO, ERP).

• Market Intelligence: Maintain expert-level knowledge of the CCaaS competitive landscape (e.g., Genesys, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect). Effectively articulate Avaya’s superior differentiation—specifically our ability to innovate on top of existing investments.

## Qualifications

• Sales Expertise: 5+ years of successful CCaaS/CX/UCaaS sales experience, with a strong preference experience selling through channel partners

• Strategic Transformation: Proven history of managing complex legacy-to-cloud migrations and "Innovation without Disruption" strategies.

• Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, presentation, and whiteboarding skills. You must have the ability to command a room and lead strategic, value-focused discussions with C-level audiences.

• Performance: A demonstrated history of hitting and exceeding sales targets and growing global accounts.

• Travel: Ability to travel as required to achieve sales plans.

• Location: Virtual home office is Australia

In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

## French Translation

## (English Translation follows)

L’équipe Data Privacy Solutions (DPS) de Privacy Analytics est à la recherche d’un(e) coordonnateur(trice) de projet pour soutenir la prestation de services aux clients et la mise en œuvre du logiciel propriétaire de Privacy Analytics (la Plateforme Privacy Analytics), ainsi que pour contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques de gestion de projets au sein de l’équipe.

En tant que membre de l’équipe DPS, le ou la coordonnateur(trice) de projet sera responsable de la coordination des projets d’implantation de logiciels, du suivi des engagements et des exigences des clients, ainsi que du soutien aux initiatives stratégiques d’envergure ou complexes. Le poste contribuera également aux opérations internes en assurant le suivi des activités de projet, en facilitant les rétrospectives, en améliorant la documentation et les processus de l’équipe, et en veillant à une prestation de projets cohérente et de grande qualité.

Ce poste exige une personne qui fait preuve d’initiative, communique clairement, demeure organisée et est capable de relever des défis de façon autonome au sein d’un environnement de travail collaboratif et stimulant. La personne retenue aura un vif intérêt pour l’apprentissage ainsi que pour la protection de la vie privée, les données, la mise en œuvre de solutions logicielles et la gestion de projets auprès de clients. Une compréhension des solutions de confidentialité, de la livraison de services-conseils ou de l’implantation technologique constitue un atout. Une formation en coordination de projets sera offerte en cours d’emploi.

## Responsabilités :

• Veiller à ce que les projets de mise en œuvre de logiciels soient réalisés dans les limites de la portée définie et selon les échéanciers établis.

• Coordonner les équipes, notamment celles du soutien, de l’ingénierie logicielle et des finances, afin de favoriser la réussite des clients utilisant nos logiciels.

• Assurer le suivi des modalités contractuelles des licences logicielles des clients, notamment les dates d’expiration, les échéanciers de paiement et les conditions contractuelles.

• Contribuer à l’élaboration et au maintien des processus de réalisation des projets (p. ex. plans de projet, résumés internes de prestation) ainsi qu’à leur amélioration continue afin de favoriser la réussite des projets.

• Participer au maintien de la documentation interne des processus DPS et veiller à ce qu’elle soit à jour et accessible à tous les membres de l’équipe.

• Contribuer au suivi de l’avancement des projets DPS, à la surveillance des jalons et au respect des échéances.

## Qualifications essentielles :

• Diplôme d’études collégiales ou universitaires dans un domaine pertinent, ou expérience équivalente.

• Au moins un an d’expérience au sein d’une équipe, idéalement dans un environnement de services professionnels, de consultation, de technologie, de logiciels, de protection de la vie privée ou lié aux données.

• Excellentes aptitudes organisationnelles et capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches, priorités et projets.

• Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, incluant la capacité de présenter l’information de manière claire et concise aux parties prenantes internes et aux clients externes.

• Capacité démontrée à assumer la responsabilité du travail confié, à respecter ses engagements et à signaler adéquatement les questions ou les risques.

• Aptitude à travailler de façon autonome, à résoudre des problèmes avec le soutien approprié et à s’adapter à l’évolution des priorités et des exigences.

• Intérêt marqué pour l’apprentissage des concepts liés à la protection de la vie privée, aux données, à la livraison de logiciels et à la gestion de projets.

## Atouts :

• Diplôme d’études supérieures dans un domaine pertinent.

• Expérience en gestion ou en coordination de projets, notamment dans le suivi des jalons, des risques, des tâches ou des livrables.

• Expérience ou connaissances en implantation de logiciels, en déploiement technologique, en mise en œuvre de solutions TI ou en projets techniques réalisés auprès de clients.

• Connaissance de l’anonymisation, de la désidentification, du contrôle de la divulgation statistique, des lois sur la protection de la vie privée ou des concepts de gouvernance des données.

• Expérience liée aux données de santé, aux données financières ou à d’autres types de données sur les consommateurs.

## English Translation

The Privacy Analytics Data Privacy Solutions (DPS) team is seeking a Project Coordinator to support client delivery and implementation of Privacy Analytics’ proprietary software (the Privacy Analytics Platform) and to help drive effective project management practices across the team.

As part of the DPS team, the Project Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating software implementation projects, tracking customer engagements and requirements, and supporting large or complex strategic initiatives. The role will also contribute to internal operations by maintaining project tracking activities, facilitating retrospectives, improving team documentation and processes, and helping ensure consistent, high-quality project delivery.

This role requires someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, stays organized, and is comfortable working through challenges independently within a supportive and collaborative team environment. The successful candidate will be a keen learner with an interest in privacy, data, software delivery, and client-facing project work. An understanding of privacy solutions, consulting delivery, or technology implementation is an asset. On-the-job project coordination training will be provided.

Responsibilities:

• Ensure software implementation projects are completed within scope and defined timelines

• Coordinate teams, including Support, Engineering and Finance, to support success of our software customers

• Monitor software customer contractual license details, including expiry, payment schedule, and terms

• Support developing and maintaining processes for project delivery (e.g., project plans, internal delivery summaries) and contribute to process improvements to ensure successful project delivery

• Assist in maintaining internal documentation of DPS processes and ensuring it is up-to-date and accessible to all DPS team members

• Support in monitoring DPS project progress, tracking milestones, and helping to ensure project deadlines are met

Essential Qualifications:

• Degree or diploma in a relevant field, or equivalent experience

• 1 year of experience in a team role, preferably in a professional services, consulting, technology, software, privacy, or data-related environment

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and projects simultaneously

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information clearly and concisely to internal stakeholders and external clients

• Demonstrated ability to take ownership of assigned work, follow through on commitments, and escalate questions or risks appropriately

• Ability to work independently, figure things out with appropriate support, and adapt to changing priorities and requirements

• Interest in learning about privacy, data, software delivery, and project management principles

Asset Qualifications:

• Advanced degree in a relevant field

• Project management or project coordination experience, including experience tracking milestones, risks, tasks, or deliverables

• Experience or knowledge related to software implementation, IT implementation, technology deployment, or client-facing technical projects

• Familiarity with anonymization, de-identification, statistical disclosure control, privacy laws, or data governance concepts

• Experience with health, financial, or other consumer data

Shawflex is the market leader and a trusted brand in the Electrical Infrastructure industry with a wide variety of wire and cable solutions from common to custom. ##

## Regional Sales Manager, Nuclear

Location: Toronto or Vaughan, Ontario
Business Unit: Shawflex
Position Type: Permanent
Work Model: Hybrid (1 day per week onsite)
Travel: Approximately 50% across the assigned Canadian territory, mostly in Toronto

## Summary

As Regional Sales Manager, Nuclear, you will play a critical role in growing Shawflex's nuclear products and services business across Canada. Success in this role means expanding sales and gross margins, strengthening strategic customer relationships, winning new business with key industry stakeholders, and helping position Mattr as a trusted partner in Canada's evolving nuclear market. You will lead account growth initiatives, develop new market opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver technical and commercial solutions that support customer success and business growth.

## Responsibilities

## Drive Sales Growth and Account Development

• Grow sales and gross margins for nuclear products and services across the Canadian market.

• Develop and execute regional sales plans and account strategies.

• Expand and strengthen relationships with key accounts, including utilities, OEMs, EPCs, contractors, and distribution partners.

• Identify customer challenges, unmet needs, and opportunities to increase market penetration.

• Conduct customer visits, meetings, and technical presentations with engineering and decision-making stakeholders.

• Lead the preparation of customer quotations while ensuring alignment with pricing and approval requirements.

• Maintain a strong presence within the nuclear industry through networking, committees, industry associations, conferences, and trade events.

## Develop New Markets and Business Opportunities

• Pursue new opportunities within existing and emerging nuclear markets, including Small Modular Reactors (SMRs).

• Win new business from Tier 1 OEMs, EPCs, contractors, utilities, and channel partners.

• Build demand through end-user engagement and channel development strategies.

• Support distributor and end-user training initiatives.

• Evaluate market trends, competitive activity, product portfolios, pricing strategies, and channel opportunities to identify growth initiatives.

## Deliver Technical and Commercial Solutions

• Collaborate closely with Product Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Business Development teams to develop technical-commercial proposals.

• Support technical reviews and proposal development that meet customer requirements and nuclear quality standards.

• Translate customer needs into executable sales strategies and compliant commercial solutions.

• Influence internal and external stakeholders to support customer delivery and business objectives.

## Manage Pipeline, Reporting, and Strategic Projects

• Maintain and manage a healthy sales pipeline and forecast future opportunities.

• Track strategic projects and support successful execution following award.

• Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and bid information within Salesforce.

• Monitor and report on bid status, funnel maturity, win/loss activity, customer engagement, and account performance.

• Provide regular sales activity, customer, and market reporting.

## Support Strategic Planning, Quality, and Compliance

• Contribute to annual strategic and business planning activities.

• Develop and maintain market assessments and SWOT analyses.

• Identify opportunities that support long-term growth objectives.

• Ensure commercial activities comply with N299 and other applicable industry requirements.

• Support Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality programs and initiatives.

## Required

• University degree

• 5 to 7 years of professional experience in a sales-focused role

• Proven experience selling electrical components and/or products within the nuclear industry

• Strong experience in key account management, business development, sales planning, technical presentations, and proposal development

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, negotiate effectively, and work cross-functionally

• Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM systems for customer and sales pipeline management

• Ability and willingness to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory

## Preferred

• Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Materials, or Chemical Engineering, or Business Administration

• Direct experience within the Canadian nuclear sector supporting utilities, OEMs, EPCs, contractors, or distributors

• Knowledge of SMRs, MCR projects, and nuclear life-extension initiatives

• Experience securing product approvals and developing new nuclear markets

You are customer-focused, commercially driven, strategic, analytical, collaborative, and highly accountable. Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## ## About the Role

Avaya is looking for an entrepreneurial product leader to help identify, shape and build new opportunities across AI and enterprise platforms. This role is for someone who enjoys working at the beginning of a product journey—when the customer problem is becoming clear, but the product, business model and path to market still need to be defined. You willll work closely with Product, Engineering, customers and partners to explore opportunities, validate customer needs and turn promising ideas into products that can scale. We are looking for a builder: someone who combines enough technical depth to work effectively with engineering teams with strong product judgment and commercial instincts.

## ## What You'll Do

 Identify and evaluate new product and platform opportunities.
 Conduct customer and partner discovery to understand unmet needs and validate product hypotheses.
 Turn early ideas into product concepts, prototypes and experiments.
 Work closely with Engineering and Architecture to understand technical possibilities and tradeoffs.
 Define product requirements and prioritize initial capabilities.
 Develop a clear point of view on target customers, use cases and value propositions.
 Work across AI, platform and developer technologies to identify new ways Avaya can create value for
enterprise customers.
 Explore how emerging AI technologies and agentic experiences can be applied to enterprise
communications and customer experience.
 Work with ecosystem and technology partners to identify potential integration and distribution
opportunities.
 Develop pricing, packaging and go-to-market hypotheses.
 Define measures for adoption, usage, customer value and commercial success.
 Take successful concepts from early validation toward scalable products and services.

## ## What We're Looking For

 Strong product management experience with AI, enterprise platforms, developer products, APIs, cloud
services, communications technology or adjacent areas.
 Demonstrated experience taking new products from concept through customer validation and launch.
 A builder mentality and comfort operating in ambiguous environments.
 Strong understanding of cloud platforms, APIs and modern enterprise software.
 Working knowledge of modern AI technologies, including generative AI and AI agents.
 Strong commercial instincts and ability to connect technical capabilities with real customer problems.
 Experience working closely with engineering teams on technically sophisticated products.
 Ability to engage comfortably with customers, developers, partners and executives.
 Experience with product positioning, pricing, packaging or go-to-market strategy.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.

## ## Experience That Would Be Particularly Valuable

Experience with enterprise communications, CCaaS, CPaaS, conversational AI, real-time technologies, developer platforms, AI platforms or enterprise SaaS would be particularly valuable.

Experience incubating a new product or business inside an established organization would also be useful.

The pay range for this opportunity is up to $234,100 in total compensation, inclusive of base salary and bonus. Actual total compensation will vary based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

## Position Overview:

BWXT Advanced Technologies (AT) is seeking a Computer Vision / Machine Learning R&D Engineer with an interest in applications of computer vision to complex manufacturing processes. Your skills in machine vision, analytics, machine learning, sensors or robotics will support the research and development of a wide range of nuclear products for space applications, clean power, and propulsion.

## Location:

This position is based on-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office.

## Your Day to Day as a Computer Vision / Machine Learning R&D Engineer:

• Develop physics informed and constrained machine learning models that are integrated with machine vision classifiers, to identify and classify manufacturing defects and process variation.

• Work on image classifiers, object detectors, video understanding models, multi-modal classifiers, etc.

• Work to develop and improve sensor systems and hardware based directly on model performance.

• Work with engineering teams to implement model pipelines and deploy the services at scale.

• Collaborate with data analysts to understand and find data patterns.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, computer science, data science, or a related field is required.

• Must have exposure to computer vision and machine learning, with an understanding of deep generative models (e.g., GANs, VAEs, diffusion models).

• Must have knowledge of signal processing with demonstrated knowledge and application of signal processing techniques.

• Must be a self-starter and comfortable supporting multiple teams, systems and developing products.

• Travel (30-40%) domestic and international is required.

• Must be a US Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Location

On-site at the Naval Reactors Facility (NRF) near Idaho Falls, Idaho.

## Your Day to Day as a Project Manager

• Lead the planning and execution of medium and/or complex projects, including facility modifications, infrastructure improvements, equipment installations, system upgrades, and related capital projects.

• Manage project activities throughout the full project life cycle, including scoping, planning, design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.

• Maintain accountability for project cost, schedule, scope, quality, technical performance, and overall execution.

• Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, operations, quality assurance, safety, environmental, security, project controls, suppliers, and commissioning activities.

• Foresee project opportunities, risks, and issues and adjust project strategies to embrace opportunities or mitigate impacts.

• Apply an advanced understanding of the company’s business to improve project cost effectiveness, support change management, and improve project margin.

• Influence and negotiate business, technical, and scope issues with customers, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders on a regular basis.

• Ensure project and construction activities comply with approved designs, specifications, work packages, configuration-management requirements, nuclear-quality-assurance requirements, safety controls, and site procedures.

• Monitor contractor and subcontractor performance, including productivity, schedule adherence, quality, staffing, work planning, site coordination, and corrective actions.

• Manage project interfaces and integration risks among ongoing operations, facility systems, engineering organizations, project controls, suppliers, and site stakeholders.

• Lead project risk and opportunity management, including work sequencing, constructability, material availability, industrial safety, radiological controls, quality, and system turnover.

• Provide clear and timely project status reports and briefings covering progress, critical-path activities, cost and schedule performance, risks, quality issues, and recovery plans.

• Support readiness reviews, construction completion reviews, testing and commissioning, independent assessments, audits, lessons learned, and corrective-action implementation.

• Motivate project teams toward common goals, build respect across multiple disciplines, and lead project and/or discipline managers and other project personnel to achieve project objectives.

## Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, construction management, project management, business, or a related discipline. A degree is required for NOG positions.

• Typically requires at least 12 years of relevant experience with a technical degree or 16 years of relevant experience with a non-technical degree.

• Typically requires 8-15 years of project management experience.

• Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or an equivalent recognized project-management certification.

• At least 5 years of substantial experience executing construction projects in a nuclear environment, or another highly regulated environment with comparable safety, quality assurance, configuration management, work control, and documentation requirements.

• Demonstrated experience managing field construction execution, including contractor oversight, work planning, sequencing, schedule control, quality inspections, testing, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.

• Experience managing complex capital, facility, equipment, infrastructure, or environmental projects from design and procurement through construction and final acceptance.

• Experience coordinating construction activities involving radioactive and/or hazardous materials, waste generation, handling, treatment, storage, transportation, or disposal.

• Demonstrated experience with integrated scheduling, cost and schedule control, risk management, change control, contractor management, and performance reporting.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy “L” clearance.

• U.S. citizenship required; dual citizenship is not permitted for this position.

• Ability to obtain and maintain radiological dosimetry in support of the Naval Reactors Program.

• Ability to work effectively in a highly regulated, safety-conscious, security-sensitive environment and comply with applicable access, training, medical, and fitness-for-duty requirements.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Certification as a licensed professional.

• Experience working in the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program or another highly regulated nuclear, defense, energy, or federal environment.

• Experience leading nuclear facility construction, modification, modernization, deactivation, or infrastructure projects.

• Experience with nuclear construction work packages, field change control, quality verification, testing and commissioning, system turnover, and as-built documentation.

• Experience supporting DOE project reviews, life-cycle management, baseline development, EVMS implementation, or major-system acquisition activities.

• Knowledge of nuclear safety culture, quality assurance, radiological protection, environmental compliance, and hazardous-material controls.

• Experience managing projects with significant interfaces among government organizations, contractors, suppliers, regulators, and technical authorities.

## What We Offer:

Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Calian is seeking a Medical Device Reprocessing Technician (MDRT) to support the Dental Clinic at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Halifax. • Identify and report equipment malfunctions or process issues.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare team.

• Must be eligible to obtain a Government of Canada Security Clearance (Enhanced Reliability).

• Experience in a dental clinic setting is considered an asset.

Ciena is seeking a hands-on Senior Analyst, AI Operations & Governance to support the administration, operational management, and governance of enterprise AI platforms and services. Microsoft Copilot Administration: Administer and support Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and related Microsoft 365 AI services, including licensing, role and access management, configuration, service health, troubleshooting, and operational support.

AI Platform Operations: Monitor platform health, availability, adoption, and operational readiness; support onboarding, configuration management, release readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

LLM / AI Gateway Administration: Administer enterprise LLM and AI gateway services, including provider and model onboarding, authentication, access policies, routing, rate limits, quotas, usage controls, audit logging, and operational monitoring.

Agent Governance & AgentOps: Support the lifecycle governance of Copilot Studio and custom AI agents through registration, risk classification, approval, testing, deployment, monitoring, change control, recertification, and retirement.

• Experience monitoring AI or cloud platforms using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent platforms.

• Ability to analyze service health, latency, usage, token consumption, model costs, and policy-control events.

• Working knowledge of IT service management practices and tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.

• Automation skills using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, or workflow automation tools.

• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

## Must haves:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, Business Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Typically 5+ years of experience in enterprise platform administration, cloud operations, application support, AI operations, or a related technology role.

• Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 services and supporting enterprise SaaS or cloud platforms.

• Demonstrated experience with operational governance, service management, security controls, or compliance processes.

• Experience working with cross-functional technical and business stakeholders in a large enterprise environment.

• Ability to participate in production support and incident escalation activities as required by the operating model.

## The extras you bring:

• Microsoft certifications related to Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, Security, or Copilot.

• Experience implementing policy enforcement, model routing, failover, caching, rate limiting, virtual keys, token budgets, or audit controls through an AI or LLM Gateway.

• Experience governing Copilot Studio agents, custom agents, plugins, connectors, APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, or Model Context Protocol integrations.

## Job Description:

Shape the software foundation behind the next generation of intelligent, sensor-driven systems.

At QNX, our Sensor Framework team is developing a high-performance, scalable framework that enables applications to interact seamlessly with cameras and other sensors on QNX-based systems. Providing robust C/C++ APIs for technologies including cameras, LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU, the framework supports sophisticated applications across Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), robotics and medical devices.

We’re looking for an accomplished Senior Embedded Software Developer who thrives on solving complex, low-level engineering challenges and wants to take significant technical ownership within a sophisticated embedded environment.

This is an opportunity to work where embedded software, advanced silicon and sensor technology converge. You’ll tackle challenging engineering problems that require you to get close to both the hardware and software, while contributing to technology that can enable sophisticated systems across automotive, robotics and medical applications.

If you’re a senior embedded developer who enjoys solving the hard problems, influencing technical direction and building robust software for complex real-world systems, we’d love to hear from you.

## What you’ll do

As a senior member of the team, you’ll contribute to the design and evolution of the Sensor Framework, tackling complex integration challenges and helping deliver scalable, high-performance solutions across new sensors and hardware platforms.

## You will:

• Design, develop and maintain high-performance embedded software in C and C++

• Lead complex integrations for new sensors including cameras, LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU

• Enable and integrate new Image Signal Processors (ISPs) and serializer/deserializer (SerDes) technologies

• Drive the porting and adaptation of the framework to new hardware platforms and SoCs

• Design and evolve framework APIs, architecture and features with performance, scalability and robustness in mind

• Investigate complex system-level issues, perform root-cause analysis and drive problems through to resolution

• Develop and enhance sample applications and reference implementations

• Apply strong software engineering practices including static analysis and unit testing

• Collaborate closely with hardware vendors and internal engineering teams to solve integration challenges

• Share technical expertise and contribute to engineering discussions, design decisions and overall software quality

## What you’ll bring

You’ll have deep embedded software expertise and be comfortable moving between application-level requirements and the low-level behaviour of the underlying system.

## We're looking for:

• Strong expertise in embedded software development

• Advanced programming skills in C and C++

• Deep understanding of low-level systems programming, including memory management, interrupts, DMA and concurrency

• Hands-on experience with device driver development

• Strong understanding of hardware/software interactions and system-level debugging

• Experience with static analysis and unit test development

• The ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple layers of the software stack

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across engineering disciplines and with external technology partners

## Great to have

Additional experience in any of these areas would be valuable:

• QNX, Linux or Android based systems

• Computer vision, image processing or graphics pipelines

• Safety-critical software and standards such as ISO 26262

• Virtualization and hypervisor-based environments

• Sensor integration, camera systems or related embedded technologies

Ready for your next embedded engineering challenge? Apply and help us build the foundations for the next generation of sensor-driven systems.

## Job Description:

Shape the software foundation behind the next generation of intelligent, sensor-driven systems.

At QNX, our Sensor Framework team is developing a high-performance, scalable framework that enables applications to interact seamlessly with cameras and other sensors on QNX-based systems. Providing robust C/C++ APIs for technologies including cameras, LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU, the framework supports sophisticated applications across Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), robotics and medical devices.

We’re looking for an accomplished Senior Embedded Software Developer who thrives on solving complex, low-level engineering challenges and wants to take significant technical ownership within a sophisticated embedded environment.

This is an opportunity to work where embedded software, advanced silicon and sensor technology converge. You’ll tackle challenging engineering problems that require you to get close to both the hardware and software, while contributing to technology that can enable sophisticated systems across automotive, robotics and medical applications.

If you’re a senior embedded developer who enjoys solving the hard problems, influencing technical direction and building robust software for complex real-world systems, we’d love to hear from you.

## What you’ll do

As a senior member of the team, you’ll contribute to the design and evolution of the Sensor Framework, tackling complex integration challenges and helping deliver scalable, high-performance solutions across new sensors and hardware platforms.

## You will:

• Design, develop and maintain high-performance embedded software in C and C++

• Lead complex integrations for new sensors including cameras, LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU

• Enable and integrate new Image Signal Processors (ISPs) and serializer/deserializer (SerDes) technologies

• Drive the porting and adaptation of the framework to new hardware platforms and SoCs

• Design and evolve framework APIs, architecture and features with performance, scalability and robustness in mind

• Investigate complex system-level issues, perform root-cause analysis and drive problems through to resolution

• Develop and enhance sample applications and reference implementations

• Apply strong software engineering practices including static analysis and unit testing

• Collaborate closely with hardware vendors and internal engineering teams to solve integration challenges

• Share technical expertise and contribute to engineering discussions, design decisions and overall software quality

## What you’ll bring

You’ll have deep embedded software expertise and be comfortable moving between application-level requirements and the low-level behaviour of the underlying system.

## We're looking for:

• Strong expertise in embedded software development

• Advanced programming skills in C and C++

• Deep understanding of low-level systems programming, including memory management, interrupts, DMA and concurrency

• Hands-on experience with device driver development

• Strong understanding of hardware/software interactions and system-level debugging

• Experience with static analysis and unit test development

• The ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple layers of the software stack

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across engineering disciplines and with external technology partners

## Great to have

Additional experience in any of these areas would be valuable:

• QNX, Linux or Android based systems

• Computer vision, image processing or graphics pipelines

• Safety-critical software and standards such as ISO 26262

• Virtualization and hypervisor-based environments

• Sensor integration, camera systems or related embedded technologies

Ready for your next embedded engineering challenge? Apply and help us build the foundations for the next generation of sensor-driven systems.

We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! You’re as comfortable designing architecture as you are shipping code, and you care deeply about developer experience, scalability, and performance. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer on our Architecture team, you’ll help shape the foundation of how all our SaaS products are built and experienced. Our goal is to enable product teams to deliver faster, safer, and more consistent customer experiences, and you’ll play an instrumental role in that journey. You’ll collaborate with Senior Engineers, Product Managers, and UX Designers to create a cohesive frontend platform that unites multiple SaaS products into a single, scalable application. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: Part Architect, Part Builder, and Part Mentor. You’ll lead by example, designing reusable UI frameworks, modernizing legacy codebases, and guiding engineering teams toward better patterns, tooling, and practices. There are no people management requirements for this role. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada. Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. ## Position Overview

The Director of Contracts will lead the Contracts organization for BWXT Enrichment Operations (BWXT‑EO), ensuring business units and functional partners are equipped to maximize the value of all customer contracts. This role is responsible for managing all contracting activities within the BWXT‑EO Contracts department, supporting major proposal efforts and partnership agreements, and serving as a strategic advisor to internal stakeholders at all levels to advance business and financial objectives throughout the contracting lifecycle.

## Your Day-to-Day as Director of Contracts:

• Lead and develop the BWXT‑EO Contracts organization, overseeing all department functions. In partnership with Legal, draft, negotiate, and amend contracts and related agreements; resolve contract issues; review risks; and support proposals and cross‑functional initiatives.

• In collaboration with Business Development and Legal, participate in—and when requested, lead—contract and agreement negotiations that align with business goals, company policies, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Evaluate terms and conditions on new project solicitations, identifying risks, ambiguities, and conflicts that may require special consideration in proposals or contract negotiations.

• Work with proposal teams to shape winning strategies by streamlining approaches based on contract type and identifying relevant risks.

• Develop a thorough understanding of contract and project requirements and guide project personnel to ensure compliance and minimize company risk.

• Communicate project status and potential risk factors to BWXT‑EO leadership at all levels.

• Build and maintain effective relationships with customers to support balanced agreements that meet project objectives while managing company risk.

• Provide strategic guidance to Contracts and project staff and collaborate with Legal on innovative contract solutions that support business and project goals.

• Ensure the BWXT‑EO Contracts organization is properly staffed, trained, and equipped to support a growing business.

• Manage and develop reporting staff and oversee the cost center budget, building a contracts team capable of supporting rapid organizational expansion.

• Partner with leadership to ensure adherence to BWXT Corporate Policies and Contracting Guidelines, securing necessary approvals and developing new policies and procedures as needed.

• Support customer reviews, audits, and responses to financial audit inquiries, particularly those related to cost allowability.

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, management, economics, finance, operations, engineering, or a related field. Advanced or law degrees are a plus but cannot replace required experience. Project management experience is beneficial.

• At least 15 years of experience in contracts or a combination of contracts, procurement, project management, and/or financial support for complex contract actions involving government contracts. Experience managing budgets and direct reports is preferred.

• Experience with a wide range of contract types (CR, FFP, T&M, incentive-based, IDIQ, CRADA, FOA, grants, etc.) across all contracting phases from pre‑solicitation to closeout.

• Expertise in contract change management, including directed changes, particularly within FFP environments.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across multiple management levels and engaging with internal and external customers.

• Appuyer la transition des responsabilités de l’organisation ILSM vers l’organisation WSM

• Cote de sécurité valide du gouvernement du Canada – niveau Secret

• Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle en génie provenant d’un programme accrédité par le BCAPG (CEAB), ou un minimum de dix (10) ans d’expérience à titre d’ingénieur

• Expérience démontrée avec les politiques de navigabilité

• Expérience de participation et de contribution à des examens techniques

• Expérience dans la création, le développement ou la mise en œuvre d’un système de gestion des problèmes techniques (TPMS)

• Expérience dans le développement, la mise en œuvre ou la gestion d’un contrat de soutien en service basé sur la performance, incluant des honoraires de rendement, pour un contrat d’une valeur annuelle d’au moins 50 M$

• Expérience en gestion de la propriété intellectuelle

• Expérience dans la direction ou la contribution à la mise en œuvre d’un plan de gestion de la qualité

• Expérience dans la direction ou la contribution à la mise en œuvre d’un plan de gestion de la configuration du SES

• Expérience dans la direction ou la contribution à la mise en œuvre de LSA utilisant la norme S3000L

• Expérience dans la préparation de documents techniques pour des demandes de propositions (DP) tels que spécifications, énoncés des travaux (EDT/SOW), DID et CDRL

• Expérience à titre d’expert-conseil auprès d’une Autorité technique

• Expérience dans l’examen de livrables techniques afin d’assurer leur conformité

• Minimum de cinq (5) ans d’expérience dans au moins quatre (4) des domaines suivants :

• Minimum de un (1) an d’expérience avec DOORS

• Minimum de trois (3) ans d’expérience au cours des dix (10) dernières années à fournir un soutien direct à un projet d’acquisition d’immobilisations présentant un niveau de complexité et de risque 3 ou 4 et une valeur supérieure à 100 M$

• Minimum de deux (2) ans d’expérience avec les normes de système de qualité DND AF9000 Plus ou ISO 9000

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking a Senior Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) Specialist to assist our client in the planning, implementation, and oversight of key In-Service Support (ISS) initiatives for a high-profile aerospace project.

• Experience leading or contributing to the implementation of a Quality Management Plan

• Experience leading or contributing to the implementation of an ISS Configuration Management Plan

• Experience leading or contributing to the implementation of LSA using S3000L

• Experience preparing technical RFP materials such as specifications, SOWs, DIDs, and CDRLs

• Experience providing subject matter expertise to a Technical Authority

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience in at least four (4) of the following: weapon system management, maintenance management, logistics support management, continuing airworthiness management, in-service support contracting, design change, or configuration management

• Minimum of one (1) year of experience using DOORS

Location: Argentina (Remote) - Córdoba, Santa Fe, or Rosario
Business Unit: Xerxes
Employment Type: Permanent Full-Time

## Impact of this Role

As a Mechanical Designer on the Xerxes Design Support Team, you will play a critical role in shaping the customer experience by creating customized underground storage tank designs that support sales, engineering, and customer requirements. Working as an early point of contact with customers and sales teams, your work directly influences project success, first-time quality, and the market perception of Xerxes. You will help ensure customer requests are delivered accurately, on time, and in compliance with technical and regulatory requirements.

## Role Responsibilities

• Create accurate, high-quality technical sales drawings and 3D models for customized underground storage tank solutions using SolidWorks and AutoCAD. Support both fuel and water product lines while following document control and drawing review processes.

• Interpret customer requirements, site-specific specifications, and applicable regulatory standards to develop designs that meet customer needs and compliance requirements.

• Collaborate with sales representatives, distributors, product engineers, applications engineers, manufacturing teams, and customers to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues, and deliver responsive design support.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance first-time quality, productivity, process documentation, automation, and overall team effectiveness.

• Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong communication and customer service standards to ensure sales drawing requests are completed accurately and on schedule.

• Develop expertise in Xerxes products, processes, and customer applications through hands-on learning, mentorship, and collaboration with the broader engineering and commercial teams.

## What You Bring to the Role

• Technical education, coursework, or training related to SolidWorks, 3D design, drafting, or mechanical design.

• 0-3 years of experience, including new graduates eager to develop their engineering and design capabilities.

• Experience using SolidWorks.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.

• Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in mechanical design and engineering solutions.

• Confidence communicating in English and collaborating with cross-functional teams across engineering, sales, production, and customer-facing environments.

• A proactive, team-oriented mindset with the willingness to seek information, learn quickly, and contribute to a collaborative culture.

• Professional registration, SolidWorks certifications, automation experience, or industry experience related to underground storage systems are considered a plus.

## Why Join Mattr

At MATTR, you'll join a global organization focused on innovation, engineering excellence, and delivering solutions that support critical infrastructure around the world. You'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and designers, receive mentorship and training, collaborate with international teams, and build a long-term career while contributing to meaningful customer solutions.

## About this opportunity

Join our team in Ottawa as a Data Scientist and help apply data science, machine learning and generative AI to challenges in radio access network troubleshooting, testing, deployment and customer support. You will work with a multidisciplinary team to turn complex engineering data and promising ideas into practical, reliable solutions that support Ericsson’s global R&D environment.

## What you will do

• Lead data science initiatives from problem definition and data exploration through evaluation, deployment support and ongoing improvement.

• Develop machine learning solutions for anomaly detection, fault prediction, troubleshooting, recommendations, prioritization and engineering decision support.

• Design and assess generative AI solutions, including information retrieval, semantic search, language-model agents and domain-specific adaptation.

• Create evaluation methods, benchmarks, success criteria and approaches for analyzing errors.

• Apply statistical and experimental methods to identify insights, assess uncertainty and communicate evidence-based recommendations.

• Build prototypes, primarily in Python, and collaborate with software and data engineers to develop scalable, maintainable solutions.

• Partner with architects, developers, testers, product owners and subject-matter experts to address business and engineering challenges.

• Help ensure solutions meet information security, privacy, responsible AI and customer-data requirements.

• Support colleagues through mentoring, design reviews, documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Keep up with machine learning and generative AI developments and assess their relevance to Ericsson’s engineering environment.

## The skills you bring

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, statistics, mathematics or a related field.

• 6 years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, AI, advanced analytics or a related technical field.

• Strong Python skills and practical experience with data science and machine learning tools.

• Experience delivering data science solutions from problem definition and data preparation through evaluation and deployment.

• Knowledge of statistics, experimentation, uncertainty analysis and model evaluation.

• Experience with machine learning methods such as anomaly detection, clustering, classification, regression, time-series analysis, recommendation systems or natural language processing.

• Experience developing or evaluating generative AI applications using large language models, information retrieval, embeddings, vector search, prompt design or AI agents.

• Experience working with large datasets using SQL, Spark, PySpark, cloud analytics platforms or comparable tools.

• Good software development practices, including version control, testing, code review and documentation.

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Experience mentoring colleagues and contributing to technical direction.

• Ability to work effectively across disciplines.

• Telecommunications, RAN, LTE, 5G/6G, network analytics or large-scale R&D knowledge is an asset, but not required.

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

## Sales Director Enterprise Accounts – CX & AI (Infinity)

We are hiring a senior enterprise seller to drive growth of Avaya’s next-generation CX, AI and data orchestration platform (Infinity) within our existing customer base.
This role is focused on engaging senior decision-makers, identifying transformation opportunities, and expanding relationships through high-value, consultative sales. This is not a transactional role—it requires the ability to operate as a peer to VP and C-level leaders and translate business challenges into strategic outcomes powered by Infinity.

## What You’ll Do

Own and grow a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers based in the UK but covering accounts across Europe.

Build executive relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders across IT, CX, Operations, and Risk/Compliance to co-sell through Channel partners

Identify business risks, regulatory exposure, or operational inefficiencies and turn them into revenue opportunities

Create urgency by connecting real-world events (fines, outages, competitive threats, AI disruption) to executive priorities

Lead consultative sales motions focused on CX transformation, AI adoption, and operational improvement

Position Infinity as a CX orchestration layer that enhances and extends existing environments

Create and shape opportunities where no formal project exists

Drive complex, multi-threaded sales cycles across large organizations

Expand account footprint through strategic, multi-year expansion plans

Partner cross-functionally (solutions consulting, product, leadership) to win and grow accounts

## What You Bring

10+ years of enterprise SaaS / CCaaS / CX sales achievements including President's Clubs, etc.

Proven ability to expand existing accounts and close six- and seven-figure deals

Consistent track record of gaining access to VP and C-level stakeholders

Executive presence with the ability to lead peer-level conversations and challenge thinking

Strong consultative selling skills focused on business outcomes, not features

Experience navigating complex organizations and multi-stakeholder environments

Ability to create demand—not just respond to it.

## What Makes You Successful in This Role

You create opportunities by identifying real business risk or missed opportunity

You connect external events (regulation, fines, market shifts) to internal executive action

You get to the right executive quickly and establish credibility in the first conversation

You lead with insight and urgency, not product

You can turn a single high-impact problem into a broader platform sale

You think in terms of long-term account expansion and strategic value

## Success Metrics

Expansion revenue within existing accounts

Executive engagement (VP/C-level access and pipeline creation)

Pipeline coverage and quality

Deal size growth and multi-solution adoption

## Why This Role

Sell a strategic platform, not a point solution

Large, untapped opportunity within the existing customer base

High visibility and direct impact on a critical growth initiative

Ability to shape how Infinity is adopted across enterprise customers

Virtual home office in the UK near a major airport

#LI-CM1

## Experience

12+ Years of Experience

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

https://jobs.lever.co/magnetforensics/a0.body: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role OverviewWe’re looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who thrives on technical depth and broad influence. You’re as comfortable designing architecture as you are shipping code, and you care deeply about developer experience, scalability, and performance. You’ve likely led modernization efforts, built shared frameworks or design systems, and enjoy helping others adopt better patterns at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Artifacts Knowledge Team, you’ll play a pivotal role in defining our cloud-native data enrichment service, ensuring it meets the demands of performance, reliability, and future growth. You’ll collaborate closely with Senior Engineers, Technical Leads, and Product Managers to architect robust solutions, drive informed design decisions, and champion best practices. Beyond technical leadership, you’ll actively mentor and empower the team—multiplying their skills and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: Part Architect, Part Builder, and Part Mentor. You’ll lead by example, designing a scalable data enrichment service, and guiding engineering teams toward better patterns, tooling, and practices. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada. Magnet is proud to offer benefits such as: - Generous time off policies - Competitive compensation - Volunteer opportunities - Reward and recognition programs - Employee committees & resource groups - Healthcare and retirement benefits Indicators of Success We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. How We Work At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals. We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best! The Most Important Thing We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences: CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world. OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect. DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect. EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work. Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways. Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Duration: 8 - 12 months
Date: Starting January 4th,2027
