A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview:

Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technologist role is responsible for providing NDT support to manufacturing, operations, and maintenance. This position requires the use and knowledge of NDT methods to process products for inspection, perform testing on facility infrastructure, and develop operating and test procedures.

## Location:

On-site in Jonesborough, Tennessee

## Your Day to Day as an NDT Technologist:

• Establishes well-documented and appropriately executed NDT inspection techniques and methods for the verification of product attributes to working and design limits.

• Establishes well-documented and appropriately executed NDT inspection techniques and methods for the verification of facility infrastructure to working and design limits.

• Sets up and calibrates equipment, conduct tests with appropriate NDT techniques; interpret, evaluate, and document results.

• Develops and provides technical input for proposals and development activities. Reviews existing customer requirements and verifies NDT requirement conformance.

• Provides On-The-Job Training (OJT) to NDT trainees as well as NDT Level I and NDT Level II inspectors.

• Oversees or assists the qualification of new and/or updated NDT equipment and troubleshoots existing NDT inspection equipment.

• Develops and revises procedures to verify conformance to contract requirements.

• Reviews NDT inspection data to working and design requirements.

• Performs process monitoring for cognizant inspections.

• Supports procurement of support commodities as well as new production equipment.

• Interfaces with other departments and the Customer.

• Uses computerized systems, prepares documents, and interfaces with others.

• Supports customer audits and inspections; performs internal audits and inspections.

• Identifies and implements continuous improvement for NDT inspections.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

## Required Qualifications:

• Minimum of High School Diploma or equivalent plus four (4) years of relevant NDT experience or Associates Degree plus 2 years of relevant NDT experience.

• Prior certification as an NDT level II technician or equivalent certification with adequate experience to certify to Level III per NAS 410 standard in one or more of the following specialties required: Eddy Current (ET), Ultrasonic (UT), Penetrant (PT), Visual Testing (VT), Magnetic Particle (MT), Radiographic (RT), Infrared Thermography (IRT), and Additional methods (e.g., acoustic emission, leak testing).

• Must be familiar with the scope and limitation of the methods which certified and capable of directing the work of trainees, NDT Level I, and NDT Level II inspectors.

• Must be familiar with the codes, standards, and other contractual documents that control the NDT techniques.

• Must be capable of developing processes, procedures, and equipment specifications based upon customer specifications.

• Experience with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)

• Must possess strong technical writing skills.

• Strong verbal communication and teamwork skills for interaction with both hourly and salary personnel.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision or as part of a collaborative team.

• Demonstrated problem solving skills with a strong attention to detail.

• Must be a US Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense (DOD) and/or U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Job Description:

## About Radar

BlackBerry Radar is a rapidly growing IoT platform that enables real-time tracking and analytics for thousands of trailers, containers, and high-value assets across North America. Learn more.

Our platform has achieved strong market traction, with a fast-expanding device footprint and a lean, highly skilled engineering team tackling challenges in big data, cloud architecture, and performance optimization as adoption accelerates.

Radar is at a critical inflection point. We’ve established product-market fit, our install base is scaling quickly, and our platform processes more data each month than ever before. We’re investing heavily in next-generation architecture to support the next five years of innovation and growth.

## Why This Role Matters

Every new customer adds more devices, more data, and more opportunities to innovate. We’re expanding our engineering team to build the next generation of Radar’s cloud platform, focusing on:

• High-volume telemetry ingestion and big data pipelines

• Cloud re-architecture for scalability and resilience

• Advanced reporting and analytics

• API expansion and next-gen customer experiences

• Performance and reliability engineering

• Modern DevOps tooling in a microservices environment

## Tech Stack

• Backend: Node.js, Express, NATS

• Data: MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

• Reporting: Flink, Cube.js, StarRocks, Iceberg

• Cloud: AWS

• Frontend: React

• DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions

## What You’ll Do

• Build and optimize backend microservices using Node.js, Express, NATS, Redis, MySQL, and Elasticsearch on AWS

• Work on data-intensive, real-time systems ingesting telemetry at scale

• Contribute to front-end development using React

• Influence architectural decisions and technical direction across the platform

• Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability

• Collaborate in a high-trust, engineering-first culture where your work truly matters

## What You Bring

## Required:

• Strong backend development experience

• SQL + NoSQL experience (MySQL, Elasticsearch, Redis)

• Experience building microservices and event-driven systems

• Comfort with AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and modern cloud tooling

• Ability to design and reason about complex system architectures

• Curiosity, ownership, and willingness to dive into unfamiliar problems

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

## Preferred:

• Proficiency in JavaScript

• Advanced React experience

• Background in IoT, telematics, or large-scale distributed systems

## Why Engineers Love Working at Radar

• High impact — what you build directly drives customer value and product success

• Small team, big reach — startup-style ownership with enterprise stability

• Real engineering challenges — scaling a high-volume IoT platform is genuinely hard and deeply rewarding

## Scheduled Weekly Hours:
40

## Compensation Hiring Base Salary Range:
$108,750.00 - $152,250.00
Please be advised that the compensation hiring range indicated herein is provided solely as a good-faith estimate of expected base compensation for the position. The actual compensation offered will be determined at the time of hire and is contingent upon multiple factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and results of assessments conducted during the hiring process.

## Bonus:
The BlackBerry Variable Incentive Pay (VIP) program is an organization-wide bonus incentive program which aims to reward full-time eligible employees for their contribution to BlackBerry’s success. VIP payments are made in addition to base salary and factor in company’s performance as a way for employees to share in BlackBerry’s achievements.

## Benefits:
The BlackBerry Employee Benefits programs offer a wide range of benefits that support your physical, financial and personal well-being. BlackBerry remains committed to offering affordable benefits including coverage for medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, retirement, employee share purchase program and paid-time-off to those that meet the eligibility requirements.

## Disclosure of Position Status:
This is an active opening. We are seeking to fill this position immediately

We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of our recruitment process. All applications are reviewed and evaluated by our hiring team.

## JOB PURPOSE:

Leads the successful delivery of large, complex nuclear projects and services in the United States, with full accountability for safety, quality, cost, and schedule, while supporting business growth through customer engagement and effective project execution.

## JOB STRUCTURE & COMMUNICATIONS:

This role reports to the Executive Vice President, Projects & Field Services.

The position leads multidisciplinary project teams, including project managers, construction managers, engineers, project controls, and subcontractors, and provides mentorship to developing project managers.

The role interfaces regularly with:

• Internal leadership across BWXT and BWXT-Kinectrics

• Utility customers, EPC partners, OEMs, and suppliers

• Regulatory and industry stakeholders

Communication involves influencing, negotiation, and resolution of complex technical and commercial matters with senior internal and external stakeholders.

The role operates with a high degree of autonomy in managing project execution, including planning, resource coordination, financial performance, and customer interface, within established governance frameworks.

The role requires regular domestic and international travel to support project execution, customer engagement, and global program coordination.

## ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Accountability 1: Delivery of large, complex nuclear projects and services
Outcome: Projects are delivered safely, compliantly, on schedule, and within budget, meeting contractual and customer requirements.

• Lead all phases of project execution including proposal, planning, execution, and closeout

• Direct technical, cost, schedule, and quality performance across project scopes

• Ensure compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, safety standards, and BWXT governance processes

• Monitor and manage project performance, including schedule and cost metrics

Accountability 2: Financial and commercial performance of assigned projects
Outcome: Projects achieve targeted financial results, with effective management of contracts, risks, and changes.

• Develop project execution strategies that support cost effectiveness and margin improvement

• Lead proposal development, including pricing strategy and commercial positioning

• Negotiate contract terms, changes, and claims with customers and subcontractors

• Manage project billing, cost control, and financial forecasting

Accountability 3: Leadership of high-performing project teams
Outcome: Project teams are aligned, capable, and accountable for achieving project objectives.

• Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, construction, and project controls

• Set clear expectations, provide direction, and foster accountability and performance

• Mentor and support development of project management staff

• Promote a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence

Accountability 4: Customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement
Outcome: Strong, effective relationships that support successful project delivery and future opportunities.

• Serve as primary point of contact for customers on project-related matters

• Engage with customer stakeholders to align on requirements, resolve issues, and manage expectations

• Influence and negotiate complex technical and commercial matters

• Support business development efforts through ongoing customer engagement

Accountability 5: Management of project risk, change, and complexity
Outcome: Risks are proactively managed, and project changes are controlled to protect project outcomes.

• Identify, assess, and manage project risks and opportunities

• Lead change management processes, including scope, schedule, and cost impacts

• Manage complex contract changes, claims, and non-conformances

• Implement corrective actions to address performance gaps

Accountability 6: Contribution to continuous improvement and program alignment
Outcome: Project delivery practices are consistent, efficient, and aligned with organizational standards.

• Apply established project management methodologies, tools, and governance practices

• Contribute to the refinement of program management processes and reporting frameworks

• Support alignment with global project practices and knowledge sharing across regions

• Identify and implement improvements to enhance project performance and efficiency

## KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:

## Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or related technical discipline required

• 15+y ears of experience in the nuclear industry required

• Demonstrated experience leading large, complex nuclear projects or construction programs

## Technical and Professional Knowledge:

• Strong knowledge of nuclear project execution, construction management, and project controls

• Understanding of nuclear regulations, licensing requirements, and applicable codes and standards

• Experience with contract management, procurement, and supply chain practices in nuclear environments

• Knowledge of risk management, change management, and project governance processes

## Leadership and Business Knowledge:

• Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in complex, high-risk environments

• Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

• Experience supporting proposal development and customer engagement

## Preferred / Asset Experience:

• Experience with new-build nuclear projects (e.g., AP1000)

• Experience in field services, outage support, or plant modifications

• Experience working with EPCs, utilities, and Owner’s Engineer environments

• International project exposure

• Sitting: Frequently

• Standing/Walking: Occasionally

• Site visits with moderate physical activity: Occasionally

## Sensory Effort:

• High level of concentration: Frequently

• Switching between complex tasks: Frequently

## Working Environment:

• Travel (domestic and international): Frequently

• Exposure to construction or industrial environments: Occasionally

• Exposure to deadline and performance pressures: Frequently

Calian est fier de poursuivre une relation contractuelle de longue date avec le ministère de la Défense nationale (MDN) pour fournir des services de santé aux Forces armées canadiennes. Grâce au contrat de fournisseur de soins de santé, Calian emploie des professionnels de la santé à travers le Canada qui sont essentiels pour soutenir la santé et le bien-être de nos membres militaires.

CareersInnerInfo
À propos du rôle

Calian est actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) infirmier(ère) auxiliaire bilingue (français et anglais) afin de se joindre à son équipe des services de santé à temps plein au Centre de recrutement des Forces canadiennes (CRFC) de Montréal, QC.

Ce rôle offre une excellente conciliation travail-vie personnelle, avec des horaires réguliers de jour dans un environnement de soins primaires. Vous contribuerez directement au bien-être des membres des Forces armées canadiennes.

Horaire à temps plein: 7,5 heures par jour / 37,5 heures par semaine.

Responsabilités

• Effectuer des évaluations de triage pendant les consultations sans rendez-vous: antécédents médicaux, examens physiques, signes vitaux, tests d’acuité visuelle.

• Élaborer un plan de soins infirmiers, communiquer les changements ou résultats anormaux, et référer au médecin ou à un autre professionnel de santé si nécessaire.

• Administrer les médicaments selon les ordonnances et le champ de pratique provincial, tout en observant et documentant les effets thérapeutiques.

• Assister les médecins ou autres professionnels lors de traitements et procédures.

• Effectuer des injections thérapeutiques, soins de plaies, surveiller les thérapies respiratoires et IV, et préparer les patients pour des interventions mineures.

• Répondre aux questions des patients (par écrit ou par téléphone), préparer et gérer les dossiers médicaux.

• Gérer l’inventaire des fournitures médicales, commander et réapprovisionner au besoin.

• Nettoyer les zones de soins entre les patients, stériliser et emballer les instruments chirurgicaux.

## Qualifications

• Diplôme d’un programme de soins infirmiers pratiques reconnu.

• Membre en règle de l’Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers auxiliaires du Québec est obligatoire (OIIAQ).

• Le candidat ou la candidate doit posséder une excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. Cette compétence est essentielle à l’exercice des fonctions et constitue une condition d’admissibilité au poste.

• Certification RCR/SIR pour fournisseur de soins de santé ou RCR niveau C (ou volonté de l’obtenir).

• Minimum 1 an d’expérience à temps plein au cours des 3 dernières années dans un cadre de soins primaires ou ambulatoires auprès d’une population adulte.

• Le candidat retenu doit être admissible à l’obtention d’une cote de sécurité de niveau Fiabilité délivrée par Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).

Informations supplémentaires

• Poste contractuel avec possibilité de prolongation

• Poste à temps plein : 37,5 heures par semaine (7,5 h/jour)

• Horaire stable : du lundi au vendredi, de 7 h 30 à 16 h 00

• Veuillez noter que la personne retenue devra participer à une formation en présentiel, qui devrait se dérouler à la Base des Forces canadiennes (BFC) Borden, en Ontario. Nous vous invitons à vous assurer que vous êtes disponible et disposé(e) à vous déplacer afin de suivre cette formation obligatoire.

• Vacances payées et congés selon les normes en vigueur

• Avantages sociaux compétitifs

• Environnement de travail structuré, stimulant et axé sur la collaboration

• L’occasion de contribuer activement à la santé de ceux et celles qui servent notre pays

Prêt(e) à relever le défi?

Joignez-vous à une équipe qui valorise l’excellence, le respect et le service. Postulez dès aujourd’hui pour faire une réelle différence!

About Calian

Calian is proud to continue its long-standing partnership with the Department of National Defence (DND), providing healthcare services to members of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF). Through our Healthcare Provider Contract, Calian employs healthcare professionals across Canada who play a vital role in supporting the health, readiness, and well-being of military personnel.

## About the role

Calian is currently seeking a bilingual (French and English) Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to join its Health Services team in a full-time capacity at the Canadian Forces Recruiting Centre (CFRC) in Montréal, QC.

This position offers an excellent work-life balance, featuring consistent daytime hours in a primary care environment. In this role, you will make a meaningful contribution to the health and well-being of Canadian Armed Forces members.

Full-Time Schedule: 7.5 hours per day / 37.5 hours per week

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct triage assessments during walk-in clinics, including obtaining medical histories, performing physical assessments, taking vital signs, and administering visual acuity tests.

• Develop nursing care plans, communicate changes in patient condition or abnormal findings, and refer patients to physicians or other healthcare professionals as required.

• Administer medications in accordance with physician orders and provincial scope of practice, while monitoring and documenting therapeutic outcomes.

• Assist physicians and other healthcare professionals with treatments and clinical procedures.

• Perform therapeutic injections, wound care, monitor respiratory and IV therapies, and prepare patients for minor procedures.

• Respond to patient inquiries by phone or in writing, and maintain accurate medical records and documentation.

• Manage medical supply inventory, including ordering and restocking as required.

• Clean clinical treatment areas between patients and sterilize, package, and maintain surgical instruments.

## Qualifications

• Graduate of a recognized Practical Nursing program.

• Current registration and membership in good standing with the Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers auxiliaires du Québec (OIIAQ) is required.

• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Providers or CPR Level C certification, or willingness to obtain.

• Minimum of one (1) year of full-time experience within the past three years in a primary care or ambulatory care setting serving an adult population.

• Must be fully bilingual in both French and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.

• Must be eligible to obtain a Reliability Status security clearance issued by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC).

Additional Information

• Contract position with the possibility of extension

• Full-time schedule: 37.5 hours per week (7.5 hours per day)

• Stable daytime schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

• The successful candidate will be required to attend in-person training, which is anticipated to take place at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Borden in Ontario. Please ensure that you are available and willing to travel for this mandatory training.

• Paid vacation and leave in accordance with applicable standards

• Competitive health and wellness benefits

• Structured, collaborative, and rewarding work environment

Huawei Canada has an immediate 12-month contract opening for a Hardware & Embedded Systems Engineer.

## About the team:

The Huawei Human-Machine Interaction Lab unites global researchers, engineers, and designers to redefine human technology relationships through user centered, hands on research. We focus on agentic AI and multimodal interaction (voice, touch, vision, gesture) across smartphones, wearables, and emerging devices—advancing agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and intuitive human-AI interfaces. By tightly integrating sensing, algorithms, and systems, our prototype driven work ships directly to products, enabling seamless task delegation and human AI collaboration at scale.

## About the job:

• Design custom circuits and develop firmware for compact, resource-constrained electronic devices capable of running efficient localized AI algorithms.

• Integrate complex sensor suites including IMUs, displays/touch panels, microphones, optical/vision sensors, and low-power environmental sensors with proper signal conditioning and interface design.

• Implement wireless communication modules with RF circuit integration and antenna layout for standard protocols including Bluetooth (BLE), Wi-Fi, Zigbee, NFC, UWB, and RFID.

• Rapidly validate hardware concepts and implement Proof-of-Concepts using mainstream development platforms such as STM32, ESP32, NRF series, or Arduino ecosystems.

• Develop embedded firmware with ARM architecture and RTOS, writing and optimizing custom board-level device drivers using chip manufacturer SDKs (e.g., Nordic Semiconductor, STMicroelectronics).

• Debug and implement hardware communication protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, and CAN, performing independent board-level debugging and full functional verification of research prototypes.

• Maintain clean code, document schematics, write testing protocols, and compile structured technical reports to support cross-functional collaboration between researchers and software engineers.

• Collaborate closely with a Senior Hardware Engineer to ensure design excellence and continuously deepen technical mastery in a cutting-edge research environment.

• Travel frequently to China to coordinate with supply chain vendors, manufacturing partners, and co-development laboratories.

The total target annual compensation (based on 2,080 hours per year) ranges from $106,000 - $156,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Reporting directly to the CEO and President, the Vice President of Professional Services is responsible for leading, scaling, and continuously improving the end-to-end post-sales services organization for the Smart Security Solutions LOB (March Networks and Vivotek), including Professional Services, Technical Support, Network Operations Center (NOC), Cloud Services, Customer Success, Training, and Implementation. This executive will own the operating model, service delivery governance, technical enablement strategy, and financial performance of the services organization, ensuring that customer deployments, managed services, support operations, and adoption programs are delivered with high quality, predictability, and profitability.

The Vice President of Professional Services will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, recurring revenue retention, and business growth by evolving service delivery models, standardizing implementation and support processes, improving resource utilization, and embedding automation, analytics, and AI into the service lifecycle. This leader must also have demonstrated success leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones, establishing common operating standards, escalation frameworks, service-level accountability, and a cohesive culture while ensuring consistent execution and customer outcomes worldwide.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic, data-driven, and AI-enabled leader with deep experience transforming complex service organizations in SaaS, cloud, intelligent edge, IoT, or enterprise technology environments. This individual combines strong commercial judgment, technical fluency, operational discipline, and customer-centric leadership, and can align delivery excellence with strategic business objectives, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

## Key Responsibilities

## Strategic Leadership

• Develop and execute a multi-year services strategy and operating roadmap that advances the organization from reactive execution to standardized, metrics-driven, outcome-based delivery aligned with corporate growth objectives.

• Define the target operating model across Professional Services, Support, NOC, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and Training, including service catalog, engagement models, escalation paths, and ownership boundaries across the customer lifecycle.

• Lead the incorporation of AI, workflow automation, knowledge management, and analytics into core service motions such as case deflection, triage, onboarding, project delivery, health scoring, and incident response to improve efficiency, predictability, and customer experience.

• Partner with Product Management, R&D, IT, Security, and Sales leadership to ensure that product roadmap priorities, for serviceability, and ease of deployment architecture, as well as supportability requirements are reflected in both R&D commitments and execution.

## Operational Excellence

• Oversee the end-to-end delivery of all professional services engagements, implementation programs, onboarding activities, support operations, cloud service processes, and managed services commitments, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, in compliance with contractual obligations, and at target gross margin.

• Establish and enforce delivery governance mechanisms including stage gates, project reviews, technical design reviews, resource management disciplines, and executive escalation processes for high-impact strategic customer programs.

• Build scalable, repeatable delivery methodologies, statements of work, implementation playbooks, support runbooks, and training frameworks that increase scalability, improve quality, and shorten time-to-service.

• Automate ticket management, incident response, root-cause analysis, service restoration, and problem management disciplines, including clear ownership of SLA attainment, backlog aging, response times, and resolution times.

• Implement service performance dashboards and operating cadences that provide visibility into bookings, backlog, capacity, utilization, project margin, support case trends, renewal risk, and customer health.

## Financial Management

• Own services P&L performance, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, utilization, headcount productivity, subcontractor spend, and cost-to-serve.

• Develop robust forecasting, budgeting, and reporting frameworks for bookings, revenue recognition readiness, delivery backlog, staffing demand, and margin performance, enabling proactive business decisions and resource balancing.

• Lead disciplined change-order and scope-governance processes to ensure that out-of-scope work is identified early, documented, approved, priced appropriately, and converted into profitable revenue.

## Organizational Design

• Continuously evolve the organizational structure, role clarity, spans and layers, and regional coverage model across Customer Success, Technical Support, Managed Services, Cloud Operations, and Technical Training to support growth, specialization, and scalability.

• Create standardized operating procedures, knowledge transfer models, and tooling strategies across regions to ensure globally consistent execution between March Networks and Vivotek support staff.

• Work cross-functionally with R&D, Product Management, and IT to improve serviceability, observability, deployment automation, release readiness, and support transition processes, outlining a clear vision for transforming the current services and platform offering into a differentiated, scalable, and efficient operating model.

## Client, Partner Engagement & Vendor Management

• Serve as an executive sponsor and escalation point for strategic customers and complex deployments, building trusted relationships that support adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term account value.

• Partner closely with the Sales organization to strengthen the positioning, packaging, and attach rate of value-added services, recurring support, software, and managed offerings, while ensuring sold engagements are technically sound, commercially viable, and operationally deliverable.

• Optimize customer lifecycle motions across onboarding, implementation, adoption, support, training, and renewal readiness to improve customer outcomes and reduce churn risk. Common SaaS customer success metrics used to manage this include churn, retention, NPS, CSAT, CES, and customer health scoring.

• Manage strategic outsourcing, subcontracting, and service delivery partners, including partner selection, commercial terms, delivery governance, performance management, and compliance with quality and timeline expectations.

## Qualifications

## Education

Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. MBA or other advanced business or technical degree preferred.

## Experience

• Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in professional services, technical services, consulting, customer success, support operations, or managed services within the software, SaaS, cloud, IoT, or enterprise technology sector.

• At least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing complex, multi-function services organizations with global or multi-regional teams.

• Proven track record of transforming service delivery organizations to improve scalability, utilization, delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

• Strong experience with cloud operations, SaaS delivery models, subscription-based customer lifecycle management, and post-sales operating metrics.

• Demonstrated expertise in resource planning, backlog management, utilization management, project margin control, forecasting, and services financial management.

• Experience implementing or optimizing customer success programs, onboarding models, adoption frameworks, and retention strategies using measurable KPIs such as churn, retention, NPS, CSAT, CES, and health scores.

• Familiarity with AI, workflow automation, analytics, and knowledge-centered service strategies that improve support efficiency, delivery quality, and customer experience.

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with R&D, Product Management, IT, Security, Sales, and Finance.

• Experience managing third-party service providers, subcontractors, and global delivery models with clear governance and quality controls.

• Outstanding executive communication, stakeholder management, change leadership, and people development capabilities.

## Preferred Technical and Domain Experience

• Experience in intelligent video, video management systems, cloud video platforms, physical security, IoT-connected devices, edge-to-cloud architectures, or enterprise loss prevention technologies is highly desirable.

• Experience with service organizations supporting hybrid environments that include hardware, firmware, software, SaaS, networking, and cybersecurity considerations is strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with service management, CRM, and professional services automation platforms such as Salesforce, Service Cloud, Jira, ServiceNow, ConnectWise, Certinia/PSA, or equivalent tooling is an asset.

La fonction principale consiste à fournir un soutien spécialisé en ingénierie des systèmes avioniques et en matière de réglementation aux chefs de projet des unités DTAES 6 et DTAES 3, à la DGAEPM, à la DGMPD et à d’autres organisations du MDN et des FAC, à l’appui des flottes d’aéronefs du MDN et des FAC (pilotés et sans pilote).

CareersInnerInfo
Responsabilités:

• Effectuer des recherches et évaluer les modifications de conception, et mener des activités de certification de type d’aéronef ;

• Apporter une expertise en matière de systèmes avioniques lors de l’élaboration des bases de certification à l’appui des modifications de conception et de la certification de type d’aéronef ;

• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux systèmes en vue de leur utilisation future sur les aéronefs du MDN/des FAC ;

• Assurer la supervision des organismes accrédités qui mènent des activités techniques ou de maintenance et/ou qui procèdent à des vérifications de conformité dans le domaine des systèmes avioniques ;

• Apporter une expertise en matière de systèmes avioniques à l’élaboration et à la mise à jour des règles, normes et documents consultatifs destinés au Manuel technique de navigabilité ;

• Apporter une contribution dans le domaine des systèmes avioniques à l’élaboration et à la mise à jour des normes et des documents consultatifs du Manuel des normes de conception de navigabilité ;

• Rédiger ou contribuer à la rédaction de notes techniques, de procès-verbaux ou d’avis ; et

• Formuler des recommandations à l’intention de l’Autorité technique de navigabilité sur des questions liées au Comité d’examen de la navigabilité, à la gestion des risques, aux règles et normes du Manuel technique de navigabilité, etc.

Exigences obligatoires:

• Être titulaire ou être admissible à une cote de sécurité « Secret » (niveau II) délivrée par le gouvernement du Canada.

• Détenir un diplôme de premier cycle ou une maîtrise en ingénierie délivré par un établissement d’enseignement postsecondaire reconnu*. OU Avoir atteint le grade de capitaine ou un grade supérieur au sein de la classification des officiers en génie aérospatial (AERE) des Forces armées canadiennes (FAC).

• Posséder une formation et des qualifications spécialisées en sécurité des systèmes aéronautiques.

• Posséder au moins dix (10) ans d’expérience, dont au moins cinq (5) ans au cours des treize (13) dernières années, dans le domaine de l’ingénierie de la sécurité des systèmes.

• Justifier d’une expérience avérée dans au moins trois (3) des activités suivantes :

• Doit justifier d’au moins deux (2) ans d’expérience au cours des sept (7) dernières années dans l’évaluation pratique et théorique des fonctions avioniques critiques pour le vol.

• Posséder au moins trois (3) ans d’expérience pratique acquise au cours des sept (7) dernières années en certification des systèmes d’aéronefs, notamment dans le cadre de modifications majeures de conception ou de la certification de nouveaux aéronefs (y compris l’examen de la conception, les travaux liés à la base de certification, au plan de certification, aux programmes de conformité et à la documentation de conformité connexe). Une partie de cette expérience doit concerner des systèmes d’aéronefs critiques pour le vol.

The primary role is to provide specialist avionics systems engineering and regulatory support to DTAES 6, DTAES 3 project managers, DGAEPM, DGMPD and other DND/CAF organizations in support of the DND/CAF aircraft fleets (manned and unmanned).

## Responsibilities

• Research and evaluate Design Changes and conduct aircraft type certification activities;

• Provide avionic systems input in the development of the certification basis in support of Design Changes and aircraft Type Certification;

• Evaluate new technologies and systems for future use on DND/CAF aircraft;

• Conduct oversight of accredited organizations performing technical/maintenance activities and/or performing finding of compliance within the avionic systems specialty;

• Provide avionic systems input in the development and upkeep of Rules, Standards and Advisory Material for the Technical Airworthiness Manual;

• Provide avionic systems input in the development and upkeep of the Airworthiness Design Standards Manual Standards and Advisory Material;

• Prepare or assist in the preparation of Technical Notes, Minutes or Advisories; and

• Provide recommendations to the Technical Airworthiness Authority on matters related to the Airworthiness Review Board, Risk Management, Technical Airworthiness Manual Rules and Standards, etc.

Mandatory Requirements:

• Must currently hold or be eligible for Secret (Level II) clearance with the Government of Canada.

• Must have an undergraduate or master’s degree from a recognized post-secondary institution* in engineering. OR Must have obtained the rank of Capt or above within the Aerospace Engineering Officer (AERE) classification within the CAF.

• Must have specialist training and qualifications in aviation system safety.

• Must have a minimum of ten (10) years’ experience with at least five (5) years, within the past thirteen (13) years, related to system safety engineering.

• Have demonstrated experience with a minimum of three (3) the following activities:

https://ciena.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/Care.body:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Opportunity: 4-month work term, starting in January 2027.

Step into reliability engineering and contribute to evaluating the durability, performance, and lifespan of electronic components and circuit boards used in telecommunications technologies. The role combines hands-on laboratory testing, data analysis, and knowledge management using Excel, Python, and AI/RAG technologies.

## How you will make an impact:

• Investigate the durability and performance of discrete components and PCBAs through accelerated life testing and corrosion studies designed for harsh operating environments.

• Design and set up test circuits while monitoring critical electrical parameters and component behavior.

• Analyze the lifespan and reliability of electronic components on complex circuit boards using data-driven methodologies and Excel-based tools.

• Transform reliability data into accessible, searchable knowledge repositories using Excel, Python, and AI/RAG technologies.

• Gain hands-on experience in a collaborative lab environment, with onsite work at Ciena’s Ottawa campus required 3–4 days per week.

## The must haves:

• Education: Actively enrolled in a degree program in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or a related discipline,

• Strong working knowledge of Excel, Excel VBA, and Python.

• Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI/RAG frameworks.

As our DevOps & Security Engineer, you’ll own how Vantage DX and MPA are built, deployed, and secured. That means running the CI/CD pipelines, hardening our AWS and Azure environments, and driving vulnerability remediation. You’ll also supply the technical evidence behind our compliance commitments.
This is a hands-on role at a small company, so you’ll own a lot and your impact will be easy to see.

This is an Ottawa based hybrid role and you must reside in Ottawa at the time of hire.

Key Responsibilities

Build, test automation, release, and deployment

• Own CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure, & release automation covering cloud-hosted and on-premises delivery

• Maintain infrastructure as code & keep dev & production environments consistent

• Make releases repeatable, auditable, fast, and propose & deliver the build, test automation, and deployment improvements each product needs

• Remove verification bottlenecks that come with higher AI-driven code volume: automated security and quality gates on pull requests, AI-assisted review that feeds human review

• Help teams scale automated UI and regression testing (e.g. Playwright), so testing capacity grows with output.

• Implement technical controls for AI coding tools, such as secrets scanning, license and provenance checks, & audit logging

• Report delivery-flow metrics: pull request size, time to review, test cycle time, & escaped defects

Production monitoring and reliability

• Run monitoring, alerting, & incident response for production services

• Lead root cause analysis & lessons learned after customer-impacting events

• Track & improve deployment frequency, change failure rate, & mean time to recovery

Hosting and network security

• Secure cloud hosting, with AWS and Azure including
identity and access, secrets
management, network segmentation, firewall
and WAF rules, TLS, backups, and hardening

• Identity and access management including Keycloak single sign-on, OAuth/OIDC, and JWT handling

• Secrets handling, least-privilege access, safe processing of data

• Monitor services with OpenTelemetry, & track usage and cost

• Review network security configuration on a regular schedule & fix drift

• Run cloud infrastructure behind our applications: Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, & cloud-init deployments, nginx, & scheduled jobs

• Experience operating LLM or AI agent workloads, AWS Bedrock,
AgentCore, cost monitoring & guardrails

• Operate the vulnerability lifecycle across code, dependencies, & containers: scan, triage, and report. Set risk-based prioritization and severity-based remediation timelines, & drive down time to remediate

• Supply the technical evidence behind compliance work, such as scan results, remediation records, and SBOMs, for EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) reporting & customer security questionnaires

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in DevOps, site reliability, or platform engineering

• Hands-on CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions), containers, & infrastructure as code e.g., Terraform with experience delivering both cloud and on-premises software

• Deep production experience hosting and securing workloads on AWS (e.g, IAM, CloudFront, ALB, S3, and SSM, nginx, kubernetes)

• Working knowledge of vulnerability management: code, dependency, and container scanning (e.g.,
Trivy, Dependabot), triage, and remediation, including risk-based prioritization (e.g. severity scoring combined with exploitability data

• Network security fundamentals: segmentation, firewalls and WAF, TLS, VPN, least-privilege access

• Production monitoring, on-call, incident response, and root cause analysis experience

• Scripting and automation in Python, Bash, or PowerShell

• Exposure to compliance frameworks such as CRA, SOC 2 or ISO 27001

## Huawei Canada has an immediate 12-month contract opening for a Professor.

## About the team:

Welcome to the Advanced Wireless Technology Wireless Lab, an epitome of innovation located in Ottawa, Canada. Here, amid the dynamic panorama of technological progress, our team consists mainly of seasoned graduate computer engineers and computer scientists. With diverse experiences ranging from fresh perspectives to decades-long industry immersion, we are united by our fervour for pioneering wireless solutions.

## About the job:

• Provide expert technical consulting on advanced photonic device technologies for Radio-over-Fiber (RoF), mmWave, and sub-THz wireless communication systems.

• Conduct research and technical evaluation of next-generation surface-emitting DFB laser technologies to enable low-power, high-density RoF architectures.

• Assess the feasibility and performance of optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) technologies for low phase-noise mmWave and sub-THz signal generation.

• Investigate tunable injection-locked CW laser architectures and optical heterodyne techniques for high-frequency wireless applications.

• Evaluate and recommend improvements to tunable DML laser technologies and high-power photodiode solutions to enhance system performance.

• Deliver technical analyses, research findings, technical reports, invention disclosures, and patent contributions in support of project objectives.

• Provide technical recommendations during design reviews and collaborate with project teams to address key technical challenges and guide technology development.

• Support the AiM-RF project by prioritizing research activities on high-density, low-power surface-emitting DFB laser technology as the initial consulting focus.

## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are You The Person We're Looking For?

Are you passionate about systems software, open-source technologies, and solving complex technical challenges? Do you enjoy working at the intersection of operating systems, developer tools, AI, robotics, and embedded platforms? At QNX, we're on a mission to become the platform of choice for modern embedded software development through our QNX Everywhere initiative. We're building a rich open-source ecosystem that enables developers to leverage many of the technologies traditionally found on Linux, natively on the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). We're looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to help bridge the gap between QNX and the open-source community by bringing modern frameworks, AI/ML technologies, robotics platforms, and developer tools to QNX. You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy working across a broad technical stack, from operating systems and middleware to developer tooling, AI frameworks, and embedded platforms.

## What You'll Do:

##

• Develop Software with Broad Range of Technologies: C, C++, Python, and Rust for the QNX RTOS. Projects span a wide array of domains, including:
• System & Web Runtimes: Node.js, GTK, SQLite, Boost.

• Networking & Middleware: SOME/IP, MQTT, DDS, Zenoh.

• Physical AI & Robotics: ROS2, OpenPI, Google MediaPipe, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow.

• Target Platforms: Raspberry Pi, SBCs, QEMU, various robotics kits

• Integrate QNX and Open-Source: Integrate open-source projects with core QNX technologies (graphics, networking, USB, audio, sensors, and multimedia).

• Toolchain Support: Develop OS-specific abstraction layers, shims, and porting libraries; adapt cross-compilation build systems (CMake, Meson, Bazel, Cargo, GN/Ninja, BitBake) for QNX toolchains.

• Performance Optimization: Perform low-level profiling, memory footprint reduction, latency tuning, and performance optimization on embedded target hardware.

• Industry Events and Demonstrations: Develop, integrate, test, and maintain technology demonstrations that showcase QNX capabilities to customers, partners, and industry audiences, with a focus on Physical AI and robotics.

##

## What You Bring:

• Strong programming skills in C and C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python.

• Proven experience with Linux and/or QNX development environments.

• Solid understanding of operating system internals and POSIX APIs (pthreads, IPC, memory management, networking sockets).

• Excellent communication skills with an interest in collaborating within open-source developer communities.

• Self-motivated with a passion for building software ecosystems.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

## It Would Be Nice If You Had Any of the Following:

• Experience porting, building, or maintaining large open-source projects or Linux distributions.

• Experience or interest in Physical AI, Robotics, or Vision frameworks (e.g., ROS 2, OpenPI, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).

• Experience with GPU / Heterogeneous Compute stacks (NVIDIA CUDA/TensorRT, AMD ROCm, Vulkan Compute, OpenCL) on platforms like NVIDIA Thor/IGX or AMD silicon.

• Knowledge of embedded GUI engines (Qt, GTK), or automotive/industrial middleware (DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT).

• Hands-on experience with RTOS environments (QNX, VxWorks, FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or Linux kernel/driver internals.

• Familiarity with Rust and Cargo build targets for embedded or systems programming.

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

AVAYA has a unique opportunity for an experienced Government Account Manager to drive strategic growth across the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD)—including the U.S. Army and related defense organizations. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling enterprise communications, cloud, and/or cybersecurity solutions into complex federal environments and possess deep knowledge of the Department of Defense acquisition landscape.

This individual will be responsible for developing executive relationships, identifying and closing new business opportunities, expanding existing accounts, and positioning Avaya's secure communications portfolio—including FedRAMP IL2 and IL4 cloud voice and collaboration solutions—to support mission-critical operations.

##

## What you can expect to do

• Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve revenue targets across assigned Department of Defense accounts, with a strong focus on U.S. Army customers and related defense organizations.

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders across the U.S. Army, Program Executive Offices (PEOs), acquisition organizations, Army CIO/G-6, NETCOM, defense agencies, and industry partners.

• Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities while expanding Avaya's footprint within existing DoD and Army accounts.

• Position Avaya's secure communications portfolio, including FedRAMP IL2 and IL4 cloud voice, Unified Communications, Contact Center, and collaboration solutions.

• Navigate complex federal procurement processes, including FAR/DFARS requirements and applicable contract vehicles.

• Collaborate closely with Solution Engineering, Product Management, Contracts, Legal, Marketing, Customer Success, and Avaya's partner ecosystem to develop winning customer solutions.

• Develop and execute account strategies aligned with Army and Department of Defense modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and mission objectives.

• Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, opportunity forecasts, and executive account reviews using CRM tools.

• Develop relationships with prime contractors, systems integrators, and channel partners supporting Army and Department of Defense programs.

• Develop opportunities aligned with Army and DoD modernization priorities, budget cycles, acquisition strategies, and technology refresh initiatives.

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales pursuits from opportunity identification through contract award and deployment.

• Represent Avaya at Army, Department of Defense, and federal industry conferences, customer engagements, and technology events.

• Stay current on Army modernization priorities, federal technology initiatives, cybersecurity requirements, FedRAMP, Zero Trust, and evolving Department of Defense mission requirements.

##

##

## What you bring to the table

• 10+ years of successful CX/UC/CC technology sales experience supporting the U.S. Federal Government, with significant experience selling into the Department of Defense, U.S. Army, or other defense organizations.

• Demonstrated success managing complex, strategic Army and Department of Defense accounts and consistently exceeding sales objectives.

• Existing relationships within the U.S. Army, Department of Defense, defense agencies, federal systems integrators, or strategic defense contractors are strongly preferred.

• Experience selling enterprise communications, Unified Communications, Contact Center, CCaaS, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, or mission-critical communications solutions.

• Working knowledge of FedRAMP cloud environments, including IL2 and IL4, is strongly preferred.

• Experience supporting DoD acquisition programs, modernization initiatives, and technology procurement strategies.

• Strong understanding of FAR, DFARS, federal procurement processes, and government contract vehicles such as GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, and other acquisition vehicles.

• Demonstrated success collaborating with federal systems integrators, channel partners, and prime contractors to develop and close complex opportunities.

• Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, negotiation, presentation, and strategic account planning skills.

• Self-motivated, highly collaborative, and driven to deliver measurable customer outcomes.

• Ability to travel as required to support customer engagements, industry events, and executive meetings. This remote l position can be based anywhere in the Midwest, Northeast, New England or Southeast

• Active U.S. Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one is preferred

## Partner Delivery Project Manager

Ciena is transforming how technology enables its global partner ecosystem through simplified delivery processes, reliable infrastructure, trusted operational data, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable support capabilities. This role serves as the primary Project Manager for the Partner Delivery portfolio, partnering closely with Supply Chain, IT service owners, End User Support, external partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to define strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

## How you will make an impact:

You will lead the planning, execution, and transition of partner delivery initiatives supporting supply chain infrastructure, fulfillment delivery, and integrated systems. Working across IT service owners, Network, End User Support, Supply Chain, external partners, vendors, and technical teams, you will align scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, decisions, and operational handoffs.

• Lead end-to-end delivery of partner technology initiatives, ensuring agreed scope and business outcomes are delivered on schedule, within budget, and to established quality and operational-readiness standards.

• Partner with business owners, IT service owners, technical teams, and external partners to define project scope, objectives, success measures, deliverables, roles, and acceptance criteria aligned with business priorities and partner commitments.

• Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets, and monitor progress against key milestones, metrics, and deliverables.

• Identify and mitigate project risks and issues, and develop contingency plans as needed.

• Coordinate and facilitate cross-functional project teams, ensuring effective communication, collaboration, and alignment of resources.

• Manage project budgets, track expenses, and provide regular project status updates to stakeholders.

• Conduct post-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices, and implement process improvements for future projects.

• Process management & improvement defined, work a well-defined project management process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Project Management

• Drive AI enablement and continuous enhancement across partner delivery processes by identifying high-value use cases, coordinating adoption, measuring outcomes, and improving automation, efficiency, and the partner experience.

## The knowledge:

• Project and program management methodologies, governance practices, delivery lifecycle controls, and Agile or hybrid ways of working.

• Risk, issue, dependency, change, financial, resource, and stakeholder management across complex initiatives.

• Portfolio reporting, dashboards, collaboration platforms, financial tracking, and data-driven performance measurement.

• Operational readiness, change adoption, knowledge transfer, support-model design, and structured transition to operations.

• Endpoint technologies and support practices, including laptops, printers, scanners, device management, security controls, connectivity, software deployment, and lifecycle management.

• AI, automation, and digital productivity concepts, including use-case identification, responsible governance, adoption, outcome measurement, and continuous enhancement.

## The must-have experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Proven experience leading complex technology or partner-delivery initiatives across external partners, vendors, distributed teams, or global locations.

• Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, decisions, and operational handoffs.

• Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues into business impact and manage escalations constructively.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet commitments.

• Hands-on experience troubleshooting endpoint hardware, operating systems, applications, device management, network connectivity, and access issues, with the ability to coordinate resolution across support teams, vendors, and partners.

• Ability to lead through influence, build accountability across teams, and work effectively across technologies, partner organizations, cultures, and time zones.

• Experience supporting supply chain, manufacturing, endpoint, fulfillment, infrastructure, or other partner-operated environments.

• Experience enabling AI, automation, or digital productivity solutions and driving stakeholder adoption and measurable outcomes.

• Experience in change management, organizational transformation, or adoption of new technology and operating models.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Lumentum Canada was awarded the 2022 National Capital Region’s Top Employers for the 6th consecutive year and the 2022 Career Directory Canada’s Best Employers for Recent Graduates for the 5th consecutive year.

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## About the role

We’re looking for an engineer to build the automation and software our photonics manufacturing runs on: process automation, test automation, machine vision, data acquisition and analytics, modernizing the software we already depend on, and more. You’ll work where fiber optics, electronics, motion, and code all meet. This is primarily a software development role, but one that keeps you in the lab and on the manufacturing floor with the hardware you’re automating.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Own projects from requirements through to manufacturing deployment, working with the team to identify what’s needed, turning it into a clean and agreed set of requirements, producing a design that stands up to review, then implementing and documenting it

• Build test and process automation systems that integrate a wide array of test, measurement, and automation equipment -- motion control stages, power supplies, fiber optic and laser sources, optical and electrical instrumentation, cameras and vision systems

• Develop machine vision and inspection automation for manufacturing

• Develop the data acquisition and analytics layers that turn raw measurement into engineering and production insight

• Take on existing software: extend it, modernize it, keep it running

• Work alongside design, process, manufacturing, and production teams, and communicate requirements, designs, and results clearly to all of them

## What We’re Looking For

## Education:

Degree in Engineering physics, Electrical engineering, or similar

## Experience:
Core Requirements:

• 5+ years in automation, test, or software engineering in a hardware environment.

• Strong programming fundamentals. Our primary stack is C#/.NET on Windows, but we also use Python for a variety of applications, including Linux-based backend services, automation, and analytics. We also use various web technologies as the need arises. We care more about how well you program than which languages you’ve used, provided you’re comfortable working in ours.

• The ability to run a project with minimal direction: read a specification, ask the right questions, define the criteria, and deliver

• Hands-on comfort with hardware (instruments, motion systems, fiber, cabling, signals) and the patience to chase a problem that isn’t in the code

• An understanding of production realities: uptime, throughput, repeatability, and the difference between a working prototype and something production can rely on

• Device physics understanding is a major plus, as is fiber optics and photonics experience, although we’re glad to teach the optics to a strong engineer

## Perks You’ll Love

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $150,000 CAD. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In line with our commitment to being a great place to work, Lumentum offers competitive total rewards which may include annual bonus, equity, and comprehensive health and welfare benefits.

## Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

## Let’s Build a Brighter Future Together!

## Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

Please contact us at talentacquisition@lumentum.com to request accommodation.

Join us—your future starts here!

## Position Overview

We are looking for a Manager, Sales Governance & Operations to play a critical leadership role supporting the governance, operational effectiveness, and growth of the ITCS business. In this role, you will oversee sales governance processes, procurement and contracting activities, proposal and bid management, business reporting, operational improvement initiatives, and strategic business projects.

CareersInnerInfo
You will serve as a key liaison between Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Executive Leadership, ensuring compliance with corporate policies, Government of Canada procurement requirements, and industry best practices. This position provides oversight of contract vehicle administration, governance processes, sales operations reporting, business systems optimization, and strategic initiatives while supporting organizational continuity through the development and maintenance of critical business knowledge, documentation, and operational procedures.

Working closely with the Director, Sales Governance, you will support executive decision-making through operational analysis, reporting, and business insights. You will play a key role in reducing organizational risk, improving operational efficiency, enabling business transformation initiatives, and ensuring long-term continuity of critical governance, procurement, and operational functions.

## Responsibilities

• Lead and administer sales governance processes, including opportunity reviews, bid approvals, and governance checkpoints.

• Support proposal and bid response activities, ensuring compliance with solicitation requirements and internal approval processes.

• Coordinate cross-functional participation in proposal development and opportunity pursuit activities.

• Oversee the management and administration of government procurement vehicles, standing offers, supply arrangements, and partner programs.

• Monitor governance metrics, bid performance, contract vehicle utilization, and win/loss trends, providing recommendations for improvement.

• Support contract review, approval, and risk assessment activities in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and Sales leadership.

• Identify and mitigate governance, contractual, and compliance risks associated with pursuit activities and procurement vehicles.

• Develop, maintain, and improve business processes, governance documentation, policies, and standard operating procedures.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives related to business systems, workflow automation, and process optimization.

• Provide business ownership and oversight for CRM, ERP, and operational workflow processes, ensuring alignment with governance and business objectives.

• Oversee reporting and analytics activities supporting pipeline management, forecasting, operational performance, and business planning.

• Maintain governance of CRM and ERP systems to ensure data integrity, process consistency, and reporting accuracy.

• Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, integration, and standardization of business processes.

• Support leadership with operational analysis, executive reporting, and business insights.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

We are looking for a Contracts Administrator to join Solace's growing Legal team and keep our sales, customer, vendor and partner contracting moving. You will run contracts from intake through signature and renewal, maintain our records, and help make our contracting process faster and more consistent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, careful with detail and comfortable working with business teams. As a member of the Legal team, you will work closely with our Deal Desk and other internal stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Contract Administration

• Manage the contract request queue. Log, triage and route requests from Sales, Finance, Marketing and other teams.

• Prepare agreements from approved templates, including NDAs, order forms, statements of work and amendments.

• Review incoming contracts, identify deviations from our standard terms and route them to the appropriate Legal team member.

• Coordinate approvals and signatures, and file executed documents.

• Lead an initial clean-up and audit of our contract files and repository so agreements are accurately organized and easy to locate.

• Maintain accurate, complete contract records in our repository.

Contract Operations

• Administer our contract lifecycle management tools and help improve how we use them.

• Support contracting playbooks, guidance and approval workflows.

• Report on contract volume, turnaround times and upcoming renewals.

• Find routine tasks that can be streamlined or automated.

Business Partnership

• Act as the first point of contact for general Legal team questions from business teams, answering questions about our contracting process and directing other questions to the appropriate Legal team member.

• Support the Legal team on special projects as they arise and the business evolves.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 2+ years of experience in contracts administration, legal operations or a related role, ideally in technology, SaaS or another fast-paced environment.

• Familiarity with common commercial documents such as NDAs, order forms, statements of work and master agreements.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to manage a high volume of contracts at once and keep them moving.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Good judgment about what to handle independently and what to escalate.

• Comfortable working with colleagues who do not have a legal background.

Nice to have Skills

• Experience with a contract lifecycle management tool, contract repository, e-signature platform or AI-enabled contracting tool.

• A degree or diploma in legal studies, business or a related field, or paralegal or legal assistant training.

What Success Looks Like

• You handle a high volume of routine contracts accurately and on time.

• Requests move through the queue without avoidable delay.

• You spot issues early and escalate them clearly.

• Any contract and its key terms can be found quickly.

• The initial clean-up and audit of our contract files is completed, leaving the repository accurate and well organized.

• The business finds our contracting process easy to use.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

Role Status: NEW

Expected Salary Range: Expected salary range for this role is from $65-75,000. The final offer within this range will reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience.

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!
