About Giatec

Giatec Scientific Inc. is a global leader in smart concrete testing technologies, bringing real-time data, AI, and IoT solutions to jobsites worldwide. Our core products – SmartRock®, SmartMix®, and MixPilot® – support the full concrete lifecycle, from mix design and production to placement and performance monitoring, helping teams improve quality, efficiency, and sustainability while reducing concrete’s carbon footprint.

SmartMix (AI-driven concrete mix optimization) and MixPilot (in-transit slump sensing technology) are transforming how ready-mix concrete producers optimize operations, reduce waste, and improve quality. We’re headquartered in Ottawa with a growing North American sales organization.

At Giatec, we value innovation, creativity, agility, and integrity. We’re committed to creating a culture of openness and teamwork in which our employees can thrive and leverage their skills, all while making the world a smarter place to live in.

Who we’re looking for

You like getting to know people. You’d rather sit in a concrete plant office with a QC manager or talk with a concrete producer at a trade show booth, than send 200 templated emails. When someone tells you “not now”, it doesn’t knock you off course; you take it as information. And you’re curious enough about how things work to learn an industry deeply and speak its language.

If that sounds like you, we’d like to meet you.

The role

As our Business Development Manager for RMC (Ready Mixed Concrete) Solutions, you’ll open and grow relationships with ready-mix concrete producers across North America. You’ll be the person producers know and trust at Giatec.

You’ll build those relationships in several ways:

• At events: you’ll work trade shows and industry gatherings, and follow up so that conversations turn into meetings.

• On the phone and over video: you’ll reach out to plant managers, QC leaders, operations teams and owners.

• On site: you’ll visit plants to understand how producers work every day.

This isn’t a volume-dialing BDR job. You’ll book your own meetings, run discovery conversations, qualify opportunities, and often execute demos. You’ll hand a deal to our Account Executives only once it’s ready.

Compensation: This role comes with a salary range of $50,000–$70,000 plus variable compensation.

What you’ll do

• Build and grow a network of relationships with ready-mix producers, both new and existing accounts

• Represent Giatec at trade shows and industry events, and follow up after every conversation

• Run discovery conversations about concrete operations, quality control, in-transit monitoring, and fleet workflows

• Judge whether Giatec, or one of our partners, is the right fit, and be honest when it isn’t

• Book and lead your own discovery meetings, qualification calls and demos

## Job Responsibilities/Duties

Hanford Tank Waste Operations & Closure (H2C) delivers exceptional performance in safely removing, treating, and disposing of tank waste. H2C leads the nation’s largest and most complex radioactive waste cleanup, including closure of the legacy waste tanks at Hanford containing 56 million gallons of radioactive and chemical waste. Joining H2C means becoming part of a team dedicated to creating “The Solution Today for a Better Tomorrow.” At H2C, our culture is deeply rooted in our Vision, Mission, Values, and Behaviors, which guide our efforts on the Hanford Site and within our communities. Our vision to tackle the Department of Energy’s largest environmental challenge reflects our commitment to leaving a positive legacy for future generations. We strive to deliver exceptional performance in safely removing, treating, and disposing of tank waste. Our values emphasize living safely, acting with integrity, and working collaboratively as a team. We encourage innovation, personal accountability, and continuous improvement, fostering an environment where everyone is empowered to contribute to our mission and celebrate our achievements. By embracing these principles, you will be part of a forward-thinking organization dedicated to making a meaningful impact today and for the future. H2C is seeking an Integrated Supply Chain Manager (ISCM) responsible for integrating supply chain planning with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, and Acquisition Management to ensure the organization has the materials, equipment, and supplier capacity required to execute the mission safely, efficiently, and on schedule. This position reports to the Director of Business Services and provides forward-looking visibility of operational and project requirements, identifies opportunities to leverage demand and achieve economies of scale, and partners with procurement specialists to ensure an appropriate and capable supplier base is established to meet current and future procurement needs. The position complements existing functional authorities by providing end-to-end integration and accountability across the demand to delivery lifecycle.

## Key responsibilities include:

• Develop and maintain an integrated 12–24-month supply chain demand forecast based on project schedules, operational requirements, maintenance needs, engineering deliverables, and critical spares.

• Serve as the primary supply chain interface with Operations, Project Management, Engineering, Project Controls, and Acquisition Management.

• Facilitate early identification and development of procurement requirements to improve planning and reduce emergent acquisition activity.

• Monitor readiness of technical requirements, specifications, statements of work, bills of material, and other inputs necessary to support procurement execution.

• Identify and actively manage long lead, mission critical, single source, obsolete, and supply constrained materials and services.

• Partner with Acquisition Management to develop sourcing strategies aligned with forecasted mission demand, including opportunities for strategic sourcing, long term agreements, and demand aggregation to achieve better economies of scale.

• Coordinate strategic supplier planning and evaluate supplier capacity, capability, lead times, and other risks affecting future H2C requirements.

• Integrate critical spares planning with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and Acquisition Management to improve material readiness and reduce operational vulnerability.

• Establish and lead a recurring Integrated Supply Chain Review to identify constraints, assign actions, resolve cross functional issues, and escalate risks threatening mission milestones.

• Develop and maintain an integrated supply chain risk register and provide leadership with forward looking visibility of significant constraints and recovery actions.

• Refine performance measures focused on end-to-end supply chain effectiveness, including need date reliability, forecast accuracy, requirements readiness, procurement cycle time, supplier on time delivery, critical spares availability, and supply chain impacts to scheduled work.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives that focus on integration, economies of scale, simplifying processes, reducing administrative friction, and increasing supply chain predictability.

• Manage, coach, and develop team members to build a high-performing supply chain integration function.

• Provide direction, establish priorities, and set clear expectations for staff execution and professional development.

• Lead with a focus on collaboration, accountability, and cross-functional alignment. • Foster a positive, productive work environment that encourages innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

• Ensure team workload is balanced, performance is monitored, and resources are aligned with mission priorities.

• Grade 22: Bachelor’s degree in related discipline and 12 years’ directly related experience or equivalent combination of education and/or experience.

• Grade 23: Bachelor’s degree in related discipline and 14 years’ directly related experience or equivalent combination of education and/or experience.

• Note the essential duties for this grade level are like that of the previous grade level, however the scope of responsibility is larger, and the expected level of performance is increased.

• Demonstrated experience developing and managing forward looking supply/demand plans for complex projects or operational organizations.

## Welcome to BWXT!

Our teams operate with discipline, technical rigor, and a deep commitment to safety, quality, and national‑security excellence. Whether you’re building leadership experience or bringing advanced technical expertise, BWXT offers opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact.

Position Overview
The Lab Manager oversees all chemical laboratory operations supporting BWXT Ordnance’s quality and production activities. This leadership role manages chemists and chemical lab technicians, ensures all analytical testing meets strict regulatory and quality standards, and maintains laboratory capability, equipment reliability, and safe work practices. The Lab Manager provides technical guidance, drives continuous improvement, and ensures the laboratory consistently supports the plant’s production, compliance, and customer‑driven requirements.

Your Day to Day as Lab Manager
• Provide daily leadership, direction, and coaching to chemists and technicians; maintain high-performance and safety-focused work culture.
• Manage laboratory workflow, testing priorities, and resource allocation in support of production, quality assurance, and R&D needs.
• Oversee development, validation, and maintenance of analytical methods, test procedures, and laboratory documentation.
• Ensure compliance with all regulatory, environmental, safety, and quality requirements, including DU/hazardous material controls where applicable.
• Maintain training programs ensuring staff competency in analytical methods, chemical handling, equipment use, and laboratory safety.
• Oversee calibration, preventive maintenance, and performance verification of laboratory instruments and equipment.
• Lead investigations into test failures, discrepancies, and nonconforming materials; support root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Drive continuous improvement in laboratory processes, accuracy, efficiency, readiness, and safety performance.
• Partner with Quality leadership to support internal and external audits, customer requirements, regulatory inspections, and site initiatives.
• Ensure proper chemical inventory, storage, labeling, housekeeping, and compliance with EHS expectations for laboratory environments.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related scientific field.
• Minimum 5 years of leadership or supervisory experience within a laboratory or technical environment.
• Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, laboratory equipment, and standard chemical testing methodologies.
• Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, and team development skills.
• Strong organizational capability and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
• Demonstrated ability to interpret data, identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and ensure testing accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in regulated industries such as defense, nuclear, aerospace, or medical device manufacturing.
• Familiarity with ISO 17025 or similar laboratory quality systems.

Aperçu du poste

Calian Antenna Solutions, située à Vaudreuil-Dorion (Québec), conçoit et fabrique une vaste gamme de systèmes d’antennes de haute précision destinés aux communications par satellite, à la radioastronomie, à la recherche scientifique et aux applications de défense.

CareersInnerInfo
Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) ingénieur(e) mécanique intermédiaire. La personne retenue participera à la conception, à l’analyse, au développement, à la production, à la maintenance et à l’amélioration de systèmes d’antennes de grande envergure. Les projets comprendront notamment la conception et l’analyse de grandes structures mécano-soudées en acier, le dimensionnement et la conception de systèmes d’entraînement, ainsi que le développement de mécanismes complexes de petite taille.

Responsabilités

• Réaliser la conception mécanique et structurale à l’aide de logiciels de modélisation 3D.

• Effectuer des analyses structurales à l’aide de la méthode des éléments finis (MEF) et de calculs classiques.

• Valider et sélectionner les systèmes d’entraînement mécaniques.

• Sélectionner les matériaux et les composantes mécaniques appropriés.

• Produire des dessins détaillés de pièces, d’assemblages et des procédures techniques.

• Définir les méthodes et procédures de protection contre la corrosion.

• Analyser et vérifier les déformations de la structure des antennes.

• Assurer la liaison technique avec les équipes d’approvisionnement, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Fournir un soutien technique à l’équipe d’intégration des antennes.

À titre de membre de l’équipe d’ingénierie, vous devrez également :

• Contribuer aux propositions de projets et aux estimations de coûts.

• Participer à des projets de recherche et développement (R-D).

• Interagir directement avec les clients.

• Diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes à l’échelle du système, qu’ils soient ou non liés à la conception mécanique.

• Préparer et présenter des revues de conception.

• Effectuer occasionnellement des déplacements chez les clients au Canada, aux États-Unis et à l’international.

• Réaliser toute autre tâche connexe selon les besoins du poste.

## Qualifications

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique.

• Maîtrise d’un logiciel de CAO (SolidWorks de préférence).

• Minimum de 5 ans d’expérience avec diverses méthodes de fabrication (usinage, soudage, tôlerie, matériaux composites, etc.).

• Capacité à produire des dessins de fabrication clairs et détaillés.

• Aptitude à accompagner un produit de la conception jusqu’à la production, en collaboration avec les équipes d’approvisionnement et de gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement.

• Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de planification et de résolution de problèmes.

• Expérience dans la production de documentation technique.

• Admissibilité à travailler au Canada et capacité à obtenir une cote de sécurité.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais.

Atouts

• Expérience dans la conception de grandes structures mécaniques.

• Connaissance des servomoteurs et des systèmes d’entraînement.

• Expérience en analyse par éléments finis (FEA/MEF).

• Connaissance des différentes techniques d’inspection et de mesure.

• Bilinguisme (français et anglais) considéré comme un atout. L’anglais est toutefois requis. La personne retenue devra communiquer régulièrement avec des clients et des parties prenantes internes situés à l’extérieur du Québec et de l’Ontario, partout au Canada et à l’international. Dans le contexte d’une organisation mondiale, la capacité à communiquer efficacement en anglais est essentielle pour soutenir la collaboration, les relations avec les clients et la réalisation des projets.

Exigences supplémentaires

• Être admissible à l’obtention d’une habilitation de sécurité Contrôlé des marchandises (Controlled Goods Program).

• Être en mesure de travailler à partir du bureau de Vaudreuil-Dorion, QC.

Rémunération

78 000 $ à 118 000 $ par année

Postes à combler

Nombre de postes: 2

Calian Antenna Solutions, located in Vaudreuil-Dorion, QC, designs and manufactures a wide range of large precision antenna systems for satellite communications, radio astronomy, science and defense applications.

We are currently seeking a candidate for the position of Intermediate Mechanical Design Engineer. The successful candidate will participate in the design, analysis, development, production, maintenance and upgrades of large antenna systems. Projects will include everything from large steel weldment design and analysis, drivetrain sizing and design, and small intricate mechanisms.

## Responsibilities

• Mechanical and structural design using 3D modeling software

• Structural analysis using finite element modeling and classical calculations

• Drivetrain design validation and selection

• Selection of materials and mechanical components

• Producing detailed part and assembly drawings and procedures

• Defining corrosion protection methods and procedures

• Analysis and verification of antenna shape deformation.

• Engineering liaison with procurement, suppliers and subcontractors.

As part of the Engineering team you will:

• Support project proposals and estimation.

• Participate in R&D projects

• Interface with customers

• Debug system level problems that may or may not be rooted in mechanical design.

• Preparation and presentation of design reviews.

• Occasional travel to customer sites in the US and International

• Other duties as required within the context of the role.

## Qualifications

• Degree in Mechanical engineering

• Mastery of CAD software (Solidworks preferred).

• At least 5 years experience with a variety of manufacturing methods (machining, welding, sheet metal, composite, etc.)

• Capable of producing clear and detailed manufacturing drawings

• Able to take designs from the computer all the way to the production floor, including interfacing with procurement and the supply chain

• Good analytical, planning and problem-solving skills

• Proficiency with technical documentation production.

• Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada and be able to pass a security check.

• Very good communication skills in English, both verbal and written

Assets

• Experience with the design of large mechanical structure

• Knowledge of servo motors and drives

• Experience with Finite Element Analysis

• Familiar with various inspection and measurement techniques

• Bilingual in English and French is an asset, English is required. The successful candidate will regularly communicate with clients and internal stakeholders located outside of Quebec and Ontario, across Canada and internationally. As a global organization, the ability to communicate effectively in the English language is essential to supporting collaboration, client relationships, and project delivery.

• Must be eligible for government of Controlled Good Clearence

• Must be able to work out of our Vaudreuil-Dorion office

We have 2 positions available.

## How You Will Contribute

## Learning Enablement & Operations Program Management

## Business Systems & Process Coordination

· Support business systems, tools, data quality, user access, and operational processes used by GCN Services team and interface with wider.

· Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, identify process improvements, and drive operational efficiency initiatives.

· Document and manage business requirements, enhancement requests, user stories, and system defects through resolution.

· Coordinate testing, validation, and deployment of system enhancements and process changes.

· Track and document enablement requirements, assigned training, certifications, and readiness milestones.

· Support enablement events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

## Reporting & Analytics

· Generate recurring and ad hoc reports from learning, operational, and business systems.

· Support the collection and analysis of training, certification, and operational metrics. Identify data discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.

· Assist leadership with reporting and presentation preparation.

In addition to broader enablement responsibilities, you will coordinate the daily operation of the Services Early-Career Development Program and turn the program design into a consistent participant experience.

• Coordinate program readiness activities, including technology and workplace setup, required onboarding and preliminary training, orientation, mentor and buddy introductions.

• Manage the daily learning plan and participant schedule across the Common Services Core

• Monitor participant attendance, completion of required activities, assignment progress, learning evidence, and readiness risks; escalate issues when appropriate.

• 5+ years of experience in program management, learning or enablement operations, business operations, technical enablement, or delivery-focused roles, preferably within the telecom industry.

• Knowledge of telecom technology and products a plus.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to coordinate schedules, learning activities, participant records, and multiple stakeholders.

• Demonstrated program and project management experience, including cross-functional planning, governance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery accountability; PMP preferred.

• Strong technical, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.

• Ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across global and cross-functional teams.

• Initiative-taking and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Excellent collaboration skills, with experience working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/814.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

This position is for a Platform Engineer on the Cloud Infrastructure team within Solace's Engineering Platform group. You will help build, deploy, and operate the platform that runs Solace Cloud, with a particular focus on self-managed deployments: instances of Solace Cloud that run inside a customer's own cloud account, in a sovereign or regional cloud, or in a US Government environment such as a FedRAMP-authorized region.

The role blends two things. Day to day, you will work as a platform engineer alongside the rest of the Cloud Infrastructure team: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, Helm, CI/CD, secrets management, identity and access, and the automation that lets us provision and upgrade clusters reliably across AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will also carry a production engineering responsibility for the environments we deploy, which means owning their operational health, participating in incident response, and continuously improving runbooks, observability, and upgrade paths.

As Solace grows its footprint in regulated and government markets, this role is expected to move further toward a deploy-forward engineering profile: standing up and managing self-managed Solace Cloud deployments in government clouds, working through FedRAMP and related compliance requirements, and acting as the technical bridge between Solace engineering and the customer environments our platform runs in.

What You’ll Do

• Deploy, operate, and upgrade self-managed Solace Cloud environments in customer-controlled accounts, sovereign clouds, and US Government clouds (for example AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and GCP Assured Workloads), including air-gapped and egress-restricted deployments.

• Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code, Helm charts, and automation that provision Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE, and alternative Kubernetes distributions) and the platform services that run on them.

• Own the operational health of the environments you deploy: monitoring and alerting, capacity, patching, cluster lifecycle and Kubernetes version upgrades, database operations, and backup and recovery.

• Participate in production support and incident response, drive root-cause analysis, and turn findings into durable fixes, runbooks, and automation.

• Implement and maintain security baselines for regulated environments: hardened images, FIPS-validated cryptography, restricted RBAC, network segmentation, private connectivity (VPN, private link, hub-and-spoke routing), and secrets management with HashiCorp Vault.

• Contribute to FedRAMP and related compliance efforts by implementing technical controls, producing evidence, supporting audits, and keeping documentation current.

• Work directly with customer platform and security teams during deployments and upgrades, translating their constraints into supportable configurations and feeding what you learn back into the product.

• Build and extend CI/CD pipelines and automated test coverage for infrastructure and platform code.

• Contribute to platform microservices in Java / Spring Boot where infrastructure and application boundaries meet, following agile software development practices.

• Communicate with the team through design reviews, demos, and documentation, and mentor others on self-managed and government deployment patterns.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• Because this role supports US Government and FedRAMP-related work, candidates must be US citizens and eligible for Security clearance is required.

• BS degree in Software, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or production engineering roles, with hands-on ownership of production systems.

• Deep, practical Kubernetes expertise: cluster provisioning and lifecycle, networking (CNI, ingress, service mesh basics), storage (CSI), RBAC, autoscaling, and troubleshooting workloads in managed and self-hosted distributions.

• Proficiency with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and with packaging and deploying applications with Helm.

• Strong Linux fundamentals and cloud networking knowledge (VPC/VNet design, routing, load balancers, VPN and private connectivity, DNS, TLS/PKI).

• Experience in at least two of AWS, Azure, and GCP, including their government or sovereign variants, or a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on a new provider.

• Working knowledge of FedRAMP (Moderate or High), NIST SP 800-53, FIPS 140-2/140-3, and hardening standards such as CIS Benchmarks or DISA STIGs, and experience implementing or evidencing controls in a cloud environment.

• Experience managing secrets, credentials, and certificates with HashiCorp Vault or similar tools.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and writing automated tests for infrastructure and services (unit, integration, functional, performance).

• Comfortable scripting and coding in at least one general-purpose language (Go, Python, or Java); able to read and contribute to Java / Spring Boot services.

• Experience operating relational and search databases in production (for example MySQL and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).

• Comfortable working directly with customers and government stakeholders, explaining technical decisions clearly and concisely.

• A self-starter who thrives with ambiguity, documents as they go, and collaborates well within cross-functional teams.

• US citizenship is required for this position due to US Government and FedRAMP customer requirements.

Nice to have Skills

• Prior experience deploying or operating SaaS platforms inside customer-owned accounts, sovereign clouds, or air-gapped environments, including private container registry mirroring and offline image distribution.

• Hands-on experience with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP Assured Workloads, or DoD Impact Level environments.

• Experience supporting a FedRAMP authorization (3PAO assessment, SSP authoring, POA&M management, continuous monitoring).

• Experience with OpenStack-based or other non-hyperscaler Kubernetes platforms.

• Experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana, including operating them under data-residency constraints.

• Experience with event-driven architecture and event brokers such as Solace, Kafka, or SNS.

• Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Salt).

• Experience with microservices design patterns and REST API development.

• Experience with JavaScript client frameworks (React, Angular, Aurelia).

• Relevant certifications such as CKA, CKAD, CKS, or cloud provider professional-level certifications.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

Avaya has shifted the global enterprise customer experience (CX) landscape toward a unified, AI-driven, and open cloud architecture. We are seeking a highly accomplished Sales Engineer to be a primary technical driver in accelerating our Infinity platform adoption—focused on CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service), Omnichannel, AI/ML, Intelligent Orchestration, and Business Application Integration.

This role is for a strategic technologist and storyteller who can translate complex, multi-modal capabilities into tangible business outcomes. While foundational knowledge of legacy communications platforms is beneficial, success in this role is fundamentally tied to demonstrating expertise and driving adoption of our modern, open, and cloud-based CX solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will spend approximately 80% of their time focused on the strategic CCaaS, AI, and Orchestration portfolio, and 20% on migration strategies from legacy environments.

Solution Architecture & Design (CCaaS/Omnichannel): Lead the technical discovery and design of complex, large-scale CCaaS solutions, ensuring seamless integration of voice and digital channels (chat, email, social, messaging).

AI Integration & Orchestration: Architect and present solutions utilizing embedded and third-party AI/ML services for conversational AI, real-time agent assist, sentiment analysis, and intelligent workflow orchestration across the customer journey.

Demonstration & Proof of Value: Create, customize, and deliver compelling, high-impact product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly illustrate the business value of our platforms, showcasing integrations with core business applications (CRM, WFO, ERP).

Technical Expertise & Advocacy: Act as the trusted technical advisor to the sales team and customer executives, guiding discussions on security, compliance, API integration , cloud architecture, and total cost of ownership (TCO) for modern cloud CX solutions.

Competitive Strategy: Maintain expert-level knowledge of the CCaaS competitive landscape (e.g., Genesys, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect) and effectively position Avaya’s differentiation

## Qualifications

## Required Core Competencies & Skills

Experience: Minimum of 8 years in a technical pre-sales, solution consulting, or solution architecture role, with 5+ years of CCaaS/SaaS/Cloud contact center experience (Genesys, NICE, 8x8, Five9, Talkdesk, Calabrio, etc)

CCaaS Architecture: Deep, hands-on experience designing and presenting modern cloud contact center reference architectures, including knowledge of microservices, global multi-region deployments, and consumption models.

AI/Intelligent Automation: Proven ability to articulate the value of AI in CX (e.g., self-service containment, agent augmentation, journey analysis) and experience integrating conversational AI solutions (bots, NLP).

Omnichannel Journey Design: Expertise in mapping and designing end-to-end customer journeys that leverage digital channels and maintain context across channels and systems.

API/Integration Proficiency: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, Webhooks, and CPaaS concepts, with the ability to discuss business application integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) with technical teams.

Orchestration/Workflow: Practical knowledge of building and demonstrating sophisticated, data-driven workflows using orchestration tools or low-code/no-code platforms.

Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, presentation, and whiteboarding skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for C-level audiences.

Languages: Local languages and English are required

## Desired Differentiators

Traditional Avaya Stack Knowledge: Practical experience or strong familiarity with heritage Avaya on-premise portfolio, including Avaya Aura (CM, SM, SMGR), Elite, and relevant applications. This knowledge is valuable for advising customers on strategic, phased migration paths to the cloud.

Scripting/Development: Basic familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python) or development environments to rapidly prototype and demonstrate integration capabilities.

Certifications: Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure) or specialized CCaaS vendor certifications.

Travel Requirements : Willingness to travel to support business as required.

Please note: This postion is based in Japan and can be worked remotely from home. No virtual elsewhere or sponsorship is available for this position.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

BWXT is People Strong, Innovation Driven - be part of BWXT’s innovation hub. BWXT’s Advanced Technologies (AT) group researches, designs, and develops innovative new nuclear reactors, nuclear rocket propulsion systems, and radioisotope production systems for both internal and external customers.

If you are looking for a career where your experience is valued, innovative thinking is fostered, and barrier-free teamwork is embraced every day, then this opportunity is for you.

## Position Overview:

The R&D Nuclear Fuel Performance Engineer will support the design, analysis, and optimization of nuclear fuel systems by leveraging advanced multiphysics computational tools such as INL’s MOOSE/BISON. The role involves developing BWXT's fuel performance code set(s) predictive capabilities in evaluating fuel behavior under normal and off-normal conditions, and contributing to the engineering basis for licensing, fabrication, and operational decision-making. This position requires strong technical proficiency, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate across multi‑disciplinary teams in materials engineering, reactor physics, and thermal-hydraulics.

## Location:

Remote or on-site at the BWXT Innovation Campus site in Lynchburg, VA.

## Your Day to Day as an R&D Nuclear Engineer – Fuel Performance:

• Execute detailed fuel performance simulations using MOOSE/BISON and related frameworks to evaluate thermo-mechanical response, fission gas behavior, cladding deformation, and irradiation-driven material evolution.

• Support R&D-driven fuel design activities by integrating experimental data, advanced material models, and irradiation physics into engineering decisions.

• Develop and refine constitutive models for fuel and cladding materials, including creep, plasticity, swelling, phase transformations, and high‑temperature mechanical behavior.

• Analyze irradiation test results, PIE datasets, microstructural characterization, and thermophysical measurements to calibrate, validate, and improve fuel performance codes.

• Contribute to the design and evaluation of new fuel forms (e.g., ATF concepts, metallic fuels, composite claddings, advanced ceramics).

• Collaborate closely with reactor physicists, thermohydraulic analysts, materials scientists, fabrication engineers, and licensing specialists.

• Prepare technical analyses, R&D reports, and simulation documentation for internal use and regulatory interfaces.

• Maintain high-quality modeling workflows and support verification, validation, and uncertainty quantification activities.

## Required Qualifications:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Physics is required.

• A minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience is required; an advanced degree may be considered in lieu of experience.

• Demonstrated experience with multi-physics modeling, finite element analysis, or computational materials science tools.

• Experience and understanding of nuclear fuel behavior under irradiation (thermal, mechanical, and microstructural phenomena).

• Proficiency in scientific programming languages and engineering computation (FORTRAN, Python, C, C++, or similar).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a history of impactful technical contributions.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to clearly communicate technical findings.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree +4 years or Ph.D degree +2 years of experience in Nuclear Engineering, Material Science, Physics or related field.

• In-depth experience using INL MOOSE/BISON or similar multiphysics nuclear fuel performance codes.

• In-depth experience with oxide, nitride, carbide (UO₂, UN, UC), metallic (U‑Zr, U‑Mo), and advanced fuel concepts (TRISO, ATF coatings, SiC cladding, composite systems).

• Knowledge of reactor physics, fuel cycle engineering, or regulatory frameworks (NRC, DOE).

• Experience with HPC environments, parallel computing, and performance optimization.

• Ability to design and execute R&D experiments or modeling campaigns to test new fuel concepts or material behaviors.

• Experience with verification, validation, sensitivity studies and uncertainty quantification method development associated with fuel qualification.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## FSS Senior Analyst, Payment Systems Oversight Division

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

Did you know?
With the rapid changes in the payments landscape in Canada and globally, the Bank of Canada’s role in shaping the future of payments has expanded significantly in recent years. Part of the Bank of Canada’s mandate is to ensure that designated payment systems are adequately controlling risks, ensuring the safe evolution of the payments environment in Canada.

The Payment Systems Oversight Division in the Payments and Regulatory Oversight Department has oversight responsibility for systemically and prominently important payment systems in Canada. These critical payment systems enable individuals, businesses and financial institutions to make payments safely and efficiently, whether to purchase goods and services, invest in financial assets or settle financial obligations.

What you will do
Under the direction of the Director, Payment Systems Oversight, you will be a member of the team responsible for the oversight of payment systems designated by the Bank under the Payment Clearing and Settlement Act. You will apply your knowledge of risk management to assess designated systems against the Bank's risk-management standards across a broad range of areas, including governance and enterprise risk management, credit and liquidity risk, operational and cyber resilience, third-party risk, fraud risk, and participation and access. You will also review significant changes proposed by designated systems, such as changes to system design, rules and technology, and help identify where risk-management practices should be improved.

Beyond these assessments, you will analyze emerging risks and how they may affect the risk profiles of designated systems. These include risks arising from the growth of fintechs and new participants, the adoption of emerging technologies such as cloud computing, distributed ledger technology and artificial intelligence, and changing macro-financial conditions that can affect liquidity and other financial risks. You will engage with staff at regulated entities, contribute to the Division's analysis and policy advice, and represent the Bank with domestic and international authorities, including through cooperative oversight arrangements with other central banks and regulators.

## What you will need to succeed

• ability to work effectively with ambiguity and exercise sound judgment in a principles-based oversight environment

• knowledge of risk-based, outcomes-focused approaches to oversight or supervision, or the ability to develop it quickly

• ability to analyze trade-offs, weighing risks, costs and benefits, and to develop well-reasoned recommendations

• strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze economic, financial, and risk information and to propose, organize and conduct in-depth policy and analytical projects

• effective oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present to a variety of internal and external audiences and represent the Bank in your areas of expertise

• flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and balance multiple tasks, with self-motivation, initiative and strong attention to detail, often under tight deadlines

• ability to build and maintain a broad network of relationships with peers, your leader and internal and external stakeholders

## Nice-to-have

• experience supervising financial sector firms

• experience developing policy related to the financial, payments, or technology industries

• practical experience with, or knowledge of, risk management practices at financial institutions

• Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM) or Professional Risk Manager (PRM) designation or certification, or the completion of courses towards these designations or certifications

• knowledge of payment clearing and settlement systems (FMIs) and/or retail payments
experience participating in international or domestic inter-agency committees or working groups

Your education and experience
This position requires a master's degree in economics or finance with a minimum of four years of recent work experience related to risk management in the financial sector. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/815.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Solace is building Solace Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka® (SSK), by the creators of Nisshi. SSK builds on Nisshi Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka®, an open-source project licensed under Apache-2.0. Both implement the Apache Kafka® protocol and separate compute from storage. Stateless Protocol Engines scale out by adding more, and data is stored in object storage rather than on local disks.

Other systems depend on this platform, so writes must remain correct under heavy concurrent load. The work covers wire protocols, storage engines, and the coordination problems that arise in keeping order and consistency across stateless engines. The team focuses on scale, security, latency, and robustness, and tunes for tail latency, throughput, and cost per byte; object storage sets its own floor on latency. You will own pieces of the data path end to end, working in Rust. Part of that work takes place in public, in the Nisshi repository.

What You’ll Do

• Design and build core data-path components: request handling and storage, for a system that must hold strict ordering guarantees under load.

• Implement and evolve Apache Kafka® wire-protocol handling: parsing, framing, versioning, and backward compatibility with Apache Kafka® client libraries.

• Build and harden storage engines: offset and sequence coordination, compaction, retention, and correctness under concurrent access.

• Diagnose difficult defects: races, consistency edge cases, and security or robustness issues that surface only under real concurrent load.

• Profile and tune throughput and latency against measured production numbers.

• Work with the open-source community on Nisshi: review, discuss, and contribute.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

One of the Following, at a Deep Level:

• Hands-on experience building a high-throughput, log-based streaming or messaging system, such as Apache Kafka® or a comparable platform: wire protocols, client/server compatibility, and the internals of a system that can’t lose data.

• Deep experience with a database’s internals: storage engine, write-ahead-log or commit-log design, replication and consensus, or query execution. Any flavor counts (relational, graph, document, or otherwise). If you’ve solved these problems inside a database, you understand the ones we’re solving.

Both Paths Also Need:

• Strong systems-programming fundamentals (Rust, C++, Go, or Java).

• A track record of owning hard technical problems end to end, from design through production.

• Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, across time zones.

Preferred:

• Production experience in Rust.

• Working knowledge of the Apache Kafka® protocol, client libraries, and ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience working on the internals of a system like Apache Kafka®, Redpanda, Pulsar, WarpStream, NATS JetStream, or Solace Event Broker.

• Experience running one of these systems at production scale.

• Experience with security hardening, fuzzing, or performance engineering of network services.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

## FSS Senior Analyst, Payment Systems Oversight Division

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

Did you know?
With the rapid changes in the payments landscape in Canada and globally, the Bank of Canada’s role in shaping the future of payments has expanded significantly in recent years. Part of the Bank of Canada’s mandate is to ensure that designated payment systems are adequately controlling risks, ensuring the safe evolution of the payments environment in Canada.

The Payment Systems Oversight Division in the Payments and Regulatory Oversight Department has oversight responsibility for systemically and prominently important payment systems in Canada. These critical payment systems enable individuals, businesses and financial institutions to make payments safely and efficiently, whether to purchase goods and services, invest in financial assets or settle financial obligations.

What you will do
Under the direction of the Director, Payment Systems Oversight, you will be a member of the team responsible for the oversight of payment systems designated by the Bank under the Payment Clearing and Settlement Act. You will apply your knowledge of risk management to assess designated systems against the Bank's risk-management standards across a broad range of areas, including governance and enterprise risk management, credit and liquidity risk, operational and cyber resilience, third-party risk, fraud risk, and participation and access. You will also review significant changes proposed by designated systems, such as changes to system design, rules and technology, and help identify where risk-management practices should be improved.

Beyond these assessments, you will analyze emerging risks and how they may affect the risk profiles of designated systems. These include risks arising from the growth of fintechs and new participants, the adoption of emerging technologies such as cloud computing, distributed ledger technology and artificial intelligence, and changing macro-financial conditions that can affect liquidity and other financial risks. You will engage with staff at regulated entities, contribute to the Division's analysis and policy advice, and represent the Bank with domestic and international authorities, including through cooperative oversight arrangements with other central banks and regulators.

## What you will need to succeed

• ability to work effectively with ambiguity and exercise sound judgment in a principles-based oversight environment

• knowledge of risk-based, outcomes-focused approaches to oversight or supervision, or the ability to develop it quickly

• ability to analyze trade-offs, weighing risks, costs and benefits, and to develop well-reasoned recommendations

• strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze economic, financial, and risk information and to propose, organize and conduct in-depth policy and analytical projects

• effective oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present to a variety of internal and external audiences and represent the Bank in your areas of expertise

• flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and balance multiple tasks, with self-motivation, initiative and strong attention to detail, often under tight deadlines

• ability to build and maintain a broad network of relationships with peers, your leader and internal and external stakeholders

## Nice-to-have

• experience supervising financial sector firms

• experience developing policy related to the financial, payments, or technology industries

• practical experience with, or knowledge of, risk management practices at financial institutions

• Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM) or Professional Risk Manager (PRM) designation or certification, or the completion of courses towards these designations or certifications

• knowledge of payment clearing and settlement systems (FMIs) and/or retail payments
experience participating in international or domestic inter-agency committees or working groups

Your education and experience
This position requires a master's degree in economics or finance with a minimum of four years of recent work experience related to risk management in the financial sector. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “FSS Senior Analyst ”

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement.

QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

The QNX Service PSP Test Team is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Developer in Test to help validate and deliver next-generation QNX software technologies. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of software, hardware, automation, and embedded systems while solving challenging technical problems that directly impact product reliability and customer success. You'll design sophisticated test suites, build scalable automation frameworks, execute system-level validation on real hardware, and collaborate with world-class developers to identify and resolve issues before they reach customers. Every day offers new technical challenges, from debugging complex failures to improving automated test coverage and accelerating release quality. If you're energized by automation, passionate about quality, and enjoy working hands-on with hardware in a fast-paced engineering environment, we'd love to talk to you.

## What You'll Do

• Design, develop, optimize automated tests, test frameworks and test cases to continuously improve test coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.

• Execute software validation activities on both reference and customer hardware platforms.

• Debug complex software and hardware interactions, analyze failures, and perform root-cause investigations.

• Create and maintain detailed defect reports and verify fixes through rigorous regression testing.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test documentation based on product requirements.

• Generate high-quality test reports and communicate results clearly to development and leadership teams.

• Build, maintain, and improve automation lab infrastructure and testing environments.

• Collaborate closely with development, integration, and test teams to ensure product quality across the software stack.

• Reproduce and isolate field-reported issues using creative troubleshooting and validation techniques.

## What You Bring

• Experience developing automated test solutions for software or embedded systems.

• Must have strong programming skills in Python, C, and Shell scripting

• Must have a fundamental understanding of networking principles, including the TCP/IP model.

• Must demonstrate strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Hands-on experience with Linux and other Unix-like operating systems.

• Experience testing software features across multiple hardware platforms.

• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, validation strategies, and test automation best practices.

• Proven experience creating test plans, developing test cases, executing tests, and reporting results.

• Experience with modern development workflows and tools, including Git or SVN, Jira, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines

• Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and system validation skills in embedded software and hardware environments.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

## Nice to Have

• Experience working with AI technologies

• Knowledge of Hypervisor, Filesystem and Graphics.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. Trusted by over 36,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started! THE ROLE Solink is hiring a Director of Solutions Engineering to lead our two Solutions Engineering teams, covering SMB through Enterprise, and build a high-performing pre-sales technical organization across Solink’s software and hardware solutions. You will own how Solink engages customers technically throughout the sales process, from discovery and solution design through demos, pilots, technical validation, and technical close. Your SEs will be the technical leaders of the deal and speak the language of the customer—the priorities, workflows, and challenges of each industry and persona we serve. This role reports to the Senior Vice President of Revenue and partners closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Channel, and Implementation. The role will include occasional travel to events and customer sites across North America. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Lead the SE Organization: Lead, coach, and develop two SE teams and their leaders, with clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards. Run a consistent operating model across segments and focus SE capacity on the highest-value and most complex opportunities. - Drive Technical Sales Execution: Oversee technical discovery, solution design, demos, workshops, objection handling, competitive positioning, technical validation, closing, and clean handoff across the sales organization. - Build a World-Class Demo and Storytelling Culture: Set the standard for how Solink demonstrates its platform through customer use cases and business outcomes. Build repeatable demo frameworks and talk tracks by vertical and persona, and coach SEs on storytelling, executive presence, and technical credibility. - Design Solutions That Can Be Deployed: Ensure solutions account for customer camera, recorder, network, and POS infrastructure, including hardware needs, appliance sizing, bandwidth planning, site readiness, and deployment requirements. - Lead Technical Workshops & Pilots: Lead architecture discussions, site surveys, RFPs, security and compliance reviews, and pilot design, with clear success criteria and a path to full deployment. - Scale Technical Capability Beyond the SE Team: Partner with Sales Enablement to raise AE technical competency, help channel partners and installers become more technically self-sufficient, and define when partner-led scoping and installation is appropriate. - Partner with Product: Build a strong feedback loop with Product around recurring customer requirements, technical gaps, competitive intelligence, and field readiness for new launches. ROLE EXPECTATIONS This is an M4 level role. At Solink, leaders at this level are accountable for leading through managers and driving the execution of significant initiatives across their area. They operate with a high degree of autonomy, translate strategy into clear priorities for their teams, and partner with senior leaders to solve complex problems and make effective decisions. In this role, you’ll be expected to: - Set clear priorities and operating expectations across the Solutions Engineering organization, aligning team capacity and execution with broader Sales and company goals. - Lead and develop SE leaders and teams, creating accountability for performance while building capability, career growth, and succession within the organization. - Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve technical sales execution, customer experience, and the scalability of the Solutions Engineering function. - Identify technical, operational, and capacity challenges early, develop thoughtful solutions, and proactively resolve dependencies across Sales, Product, Channel, Customer Success, and Implementation. - Use business and team performance metrics to evaluate SE effectiveness, prioritize investments, and make decisions that improve deal progression, technical quality, and organizational efficiency. - Drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high performance. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Solutions Engineering operates with a clear and consistent model across SMB through Enterprise, with strong leadership, clear ownership, and effective allocation of SE capacity. - SE teams consistently deliver high-quality technical discovery, demos, solution designs, pilots, and handoffs that support strong sales outcomes and predictable deployment. - Customers receive compelling, persona- and industry-specific technical experiences that clearly connect Solink’s capabilities to their business needs and outcomes. - AEs and channel partners have stronger technical capability and know when and how to engage Solutions Engineering to maximize deal outcomes. - Solution designs can be deployed as sold, improving implementation predictability, customer experience, and margin protection. - The Solutions Engineering organization continuously improves through better processes, feedback loops, technical standards, and an AI-first approach that can scale with the business. These outcomes are directly grounded in the source JD’s stated success measures, particularly around operating consistency, demo quality, deployable solutions, increased AE/partner capability, and an AI-first approach. WHAT YOU BRING Must-Have: - Experienced Solutions Engineering Leader: You bring 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture, including 3+ years leading leaders. - Complex Technical Sales Experience: You have experience supporting complex B2B SaaS or technical sales within enterprise and multi-location environments. - Strong Technical & Commercial Acumen: You bring a strong technical discovery and solution design background, combined with excellent demo, storytelling, and executive communication skills. - Customer-Centric Solution Design: You can tailor technical messaging by persona, industry, and business outcome while maintaining strong commercial instincts. - Hardware + Software Experience: You have experience selling solutions that combine software and hardware, such as physical security, video, networking, or IoT. AI or computer vision experience is an asset. Nice-to-Have: - Experience leading Solutions Engineering teams across multiple customer segments. - Experience with physical security, video surveillance, networking, IoT, AI, or computer vision. - Experience working with channel partners and partner-led technical sales motions. - Experience scaling pre-sales organizations through periods of significant growth. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada; - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. COMPENSATION The salary range for this role is CA$279,504 – CA$349,380 On-Target Earnings (OTE). We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role. Candidates hired closer to the top of the range will typically demonstrate proficient capability throughout the interview process. This means they already have the knowledge, skills, and leadership capabilities needed to perform successfully in the role, can ramp up quickly, and are expected to become fully proficient in the position within a short period of time. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? Role-relevant task or case (if applicable) 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members 5. Reference Checks 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉 PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS.
