Titre du poste : Spécialiste junior en gestion du cycle de vie (Systèmes de communications navales)

CareersInnerInfo
Lieu : Gatineau, QC

Télétravail : Non

Unité d’affaires : Technologies avancées

Département : Ingénierie

## Type d’emploi : Temps plein

Aperçu du poste:

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) spécialiste junior en gestion du cycle de vie afin de soutenir l’Autorité technique (AT) du Directeur des communications externes des grands bâtiments de combat de surface dans la mise à jour, la maintenance et la gestion des équipements et systèmes liés aux communications radio VLF/LF/HF/VHF/UHF/SHF et EHF, pour toutes les classes de navires et bâtiments auxiliaires de la Marine royale canadienne.

Responsabilités:

Identifier et recommander le matériel de soutien requis pour les équipements et systèmes de communication.

Préparer des ébauches de spécifications et de descriptions d’achat.

Rechercher et vérifier les données d’approvisionnement et les descriptions d’articles.

Examiner les avis de catalogage et les demandes de confirmation.

Demander des numéros d’identification des Ordonnances techniques des Forces canadiennes pour la documentation de maintenance.

Examiner les demandes relatives au matériel réparable et recommander les mesures à prendre.

Examiner le contenu technique des listes de vérification du matériel réparable et formuler des recommandations aux gestionnaires d’articles.

Répondre aux demandes des gestionnaires d’approvisionnement et fournir des conseils techniques.

Examiner et modifier les spécifications relatives au matériel et aux équipements.

Formuler des recommandations concernant la disposition du matériel périmé.

Participer aux essais de mise en service.

Fournir un soutien d’ingénierie, technique et de maintenance aux Installations de maintenance de la Flotte (IMF).

Participer à la préparation des spécifications pour les carénages de troisième ligne et les procédures de réparation des équipements.

Préparer et traiter la documentation relative aux modifications techniques dans le cadre divisionnaire, aux fins d’approbation et de mise en œuvre des projets.

Élaborer des trousses d’orientation technique pour soutenir la préparation de spécifications techniques détaillées.

Examiner et annoter/corriger les spécifications techniques détaillées produites par les IMF ou d’autres agents de conception.

Élaborer, examiner et vérifier les fiches d’essai pour les équipements et systèmes en service.

Élaborer, examiner et vérifier les programmes d’essais pour les équipements et systèmes en service.

Élaborer, examiner et vérifier les calendriers de maintenance planifiée pour les équipements et systèmes en service.

Élaborer, examiner et vérifier les listes de soutien des équipements pour les équipements et systèmes en service.

Examiner, réviser et vérifier les publications techniques relatives aux équipements et systèmes en service.

Examiner et recommander les spécifications de réparation et de révision, les spécifications normalisées d’entretien et de réparation des navires ainsi que la documentation de formation.

Participer à la préparation des énoncés de besoins, des énoncés des travaux et des critères d’évaluation pour l’acquisition de nouveaux matériels et systèmes.

Produire la documentation relative aux modifications d’équipements navals (CANAVMOD) et les bulletins techniques (BT).

Participer à la préparation et à l’exécution des évaluations techniques et opérationnelles.

Examiner et identifier les équipements contenant des composants ou des matières dangereuses.

Examiner les enjeux liés à l’obsolescence des équipements et fournir des recommandations.

Fournir un soutien technique afin d’identifier les risques liés aux radiofréquences pour le personnel, les munitions et le carburant.

Fournir un soutien technique afin d’identifier les problèmes de compatibilité et d’interférence des radiofréquences liés aux installations d’équipements nouveaux ou existants.

Évaluer les rapports de conditions insatisfaisantes et recommander les mesures à prendre.

Effectuer toute autre tâche déterminée par l’Autorité technique afin de soutenir la maintenance des équipements radio.

## Qualifications

Être admissible à l’obtention d’une cote de sécurité Secret – niveau II (ou supérieur) du gouvernement du Canada, ou détenir une telle cote valide.

Posséder deux (2) années d’expérience, acquises au cours des dix (10) dernières années, dans le soutien aux fonctions de gestion du cycle de vie du matériel (GCVM) pour des systèmes de communications navales.

## Position Overview

We are currently looking for a Junior Life Cycle Management Specialist to support the Director of Major Surface Combatant External Communications Technical Authority (TA) in updating, maintaining and managing equipment and systems related to VLF/LF/HF/VHF/UHF/SHF and EHF radio communications on all classes of Royal Canadian Navy ships and auxiliary vessels.

## Responsibilities

• Identification and recommendation of supporting material for communications equipment and systems

• Preparation of draft specifications and purchase descriptions

• Research and verification of procurement data and item descriptions

• Reviewing cataloguing advice and confirmation requests

• Requesting Canadian Forces Technical Orders ID numbers for maintenance documentation

• Reviewing Repairable Material Requests and recommending disposition

• Reviewing Repairable Arising Checklist Sheets for technical content and make recommendations to Item managers

• Responding to queries from supply managers and providing technical advice

• Reviewing and modifying material/equipment specifications

• Advise on disposition of expired material

• Participate in set-to-work trials

• Provide engineering, technical and maintenance support to the Fleet Maintenance Facilities (FMF)

• Assist in preparing specifications for third line refits and equipment repair procedures

• Prepare and process Engineering Change documentation within the Divisional framework for project approval and implementation

• Develop technical guidance packages to support the development of detailed engineering specifications

• Review and redline-correct detailed engineering specifications produced by FMF or other Design Agents

• Develop, review and verify Test Sheets for in-service equipment and systems

• Develop, review and verify Trial Agendas for in-service equipment and systems

• Develop, review and verify Planned Maintenance Schedules for in-service equipment and systems

• Develop, review and verify Equipment Support Lists for in-service equipment and systems

• Review, edit and verify Technical Publications for in-service equipment and systems

• Review and recommend Repair and Overhaul specifications, Standard Ships Maintenance and Repair Specifications and training documentation

• Assist in the production of Statements of Requirement, Statements of Work and evaluation criteria for procurement of new material and systems

• Produce naval equipment modification documentation (CANAVMODS) and technical bulletins (TBs)

• Assist in preparation and execution of Technical Evaluations and Operational Evaluations

• Review and identify equipment containing hazardous components or materials

• Review and advise on equipment obsolescence issues

• Provide technical support to identify radio frequency hazards to personnel, ordinance and fuel

• Provide technical support to identify radio frequency compatibility and interference issues for new or existing equipment installations

• Evaluate and recommend responses to Unsatisfactory Condition Reports; and ae. Other tasks as identified by the TA in support of radio equipment maintenance

## Qualifications

• Must be elgible for or hold a valid Secret – Level II (or higher) Clearance with the Government of Canada

• Two (2) years of experience, within the last ten (10) years supporting Life Cycle Material Management (LCMM) functions for Naval Communications Systems

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

## How You Will Contribute:

The Wavelogic family of products are widely used in Ciena's optical fiber transmission solutions and are one of the main contributors to Ciena's success in the telecommunications industry. To further strengthen our team, we are looking for an enthusiastic digital design engineer who will be involved in the design of these products, working within a team of digital design engineers, verification engineers and architects.

Your role as a senior digital design engineer will be to propose innovative solutions, in order to design power and area optimized functional blocks for the Wavelogic family of products.

• As a senior digital design engineer, you are expected to read and understand the architecture and functional requirements specification document(s) and communicate and collaborate with systems engineers and architects

• You will produce an implementation specification document and have it reviewed by your team, architects, analog designers if applicable

• You are accountable for the creation and integration of new and existing RTL code, algorithms and functions

• You are held responsible for designer testing of your code as well as debugging of your code during simulation and regression verification

• You will assist the verification team in determining coverage and provide design assertions and waivers as needed

• You are held responsible for crafting timing constraints for your code, and will participate in synthesis log reviews, constraint reviews, timing report analysis, layout and backend reviews

• You will be involved in lab validation of the product and its prototype if applicable

• You are expected to report on status updates on a regular basis

## The Must Haves:

• Electrical or computer engineering, or other applicable scientific degree at the BEng/BSc or MEng/MSc level

• Experience: 5+ years using System Verilog for design

• Experience: 5+ years running digital design synthesis, STA, timing closure and asynchronous clock crossings

• A highly motivated self-starter, able to work independently, while being a team player

• Ability to methodically solve complex technical problems

• Excellent organization, written and oral (English) communication skills

• Familiarity with digital (including formal) verification methods

• Good understanding of timing/power/area analysis and trade-offs

## Assets:

• Experience with digital silicon design backend process

• Experience with digital design for low power

• Experience with standards and protocols such as OTN/FlexO/B100G, Ethernet (100GE+)

• Experience with using GIT for source code management and revision tracking

• Experience with using Jira for schedule planning, assignment tracking and bug reporting

• Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, Make, bash.

The annual pay range for this position is $111,900 - $178,700 CAD.

At Ciena, we are at the forefront of the telecommunications industry, and our Wavelogic modem family of products plays a crucial role in our success. As a Digital Verification Engineer (FEC), you will be an integral part of a team responsible for implementing innovative verification strategies in order to thoroughly simulate and validate functional blocks and subsystems for Ciena’s Forward Error Correction (FEC) IP. Reporting to the ASIC Senior Manager, you will collaborate with a team of Digital Design Engineers, Verification Engineers, and Architects to simulate and validate functional blocks and subsystems.

## Responsibilities:

• Read and understand the FEC architecture and functional requirements specification document(s) and communicate and collaborate with FEC designers, DSP modelers, FEC verifiers, systems engineers and architects.

• You will be responsible for developing verification, functional coverage and formal verification test plans.

• Thoroughly validate one or more architectural FEC functional blocks using a combination of simulation, formal, and coverage methods.

• Create testbench environments and components, agents, scoreboard, and test scenarios using System Verilog UVM and C++.

• Perform coverage-driven verification, monitor regressions, and debug failures with the support of the function's designer.

• Provide status updates on verification progress on a regular basis and communicate risks as needed.

• Mentor and supervise junior verification engineers requiring robust understanding of team outputs to foster peers’ technical and professional growth

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and effectively influence stakeholders

• We expect you to have:
• Detail-oriented – Deliver on objectives through meticulous, thorough, and comprehensive work.

• Problem solver – Analyze and solve complex technical problems using engineering principles.

• Commitment to learning – Keep abreast of technology developments and are keen to share your knowledge with others.

## The Must Haves:

• 10+ years of experience in verification.

• Minimum Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Computer or Software Engineering.

• Significant experience in using C/C++, System Verilog, UVM, SVA, and simulators from major vendors.

• Proven ability to determine comprehensive digital verification and coverage strategies

• Proven ability to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team via demonstrated leadership and communication capabilities

• Strong decision-making skills with the ability to analyze complex situations, evaluate options and implement effective solutions to meet deliverables.

## Assets:

• Experience with formal verification methods.

• Strong background in Forward Error Correction (FEC) and/or DSP.

• Familiarity with programming languages such as: Python, Make, bash, object-oriented programming, C, C++.

• Proficiency in bug tracking using Jira and source code management and revision tracking using GIT.

• Previous experience leading a team.

• Previous experience mentoring.

## What will you do at Ciena as a Analog Layout Engineer?

The Wavelogic family of products are widely used in Ciena's optical fiber transmission solutions and are one of the main contributors to Ciena's success in the telecommunications industry. Successful candidates will be joining a vibrant team with a proven track-record of success over 30-years of evolution and revolution in the advancement of high-speed circuits used in broadband fiber-optic modems. This team pioneered the introduction of the world’s first high-speed DAC and ADC analog macros that ushered in the era of coherent fiber-optic product solutions.

To further strengthen our team, we are looking for a hardworking analog layout engineer who will be working on advanced high-speed analog design circuits in the latest deep-submicron CMOS and/or BiCMOS technologies. Your role as an analog layout engineer will be to drive and implement best-in-class high-speed analog layouts that extract the highest performance from the world’s most advanced CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. These analog macros include electrical interface-facing DAC and ADC based SERDES solutions for 112G and 224G, optical-line-facing high-speed DAC and ADC circuits interfacing with optical modulators and detectors, transimpedance amplifiers, modulator driver circuits, and critical precision analog circuits for control and monitoring functions, etc.

## Responsibilities:

• Carry out layout feasibility studies on various circuit designs in collaboration with senior analog designers. The goal will be to find the best possible solution considering various trade-offs and discussions with team members.

• Create layouts of assigned analog blocks by adhering to the steps of floor planning, placement and routing.

• Conduct thorough verification checks such as DRC, ANT, LVS, PERC, EM, IR to ensure the final layout possesses the highest level of quality.

• Investigate new features within the layout tools and processes used for creating layouts with the aim of enhancing productivity.

• Provide regular status updates, participate in team meetings and share experiences with the rest of the group.

## What technical experience and personal skills are required for this role?

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, with 1-5 years of relevant industry experience.

• Experience in custom analog and mixed signal layout design with a strong knowledge of deep sub-micron CMOS devices (e.g. Finfet transistors).

• Highly motivated with strong team player skills, exhibits a positive can-do attitude and ability to seamlessly integrate into an existing team culture.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Experience in custom layout design of Analog/Mixed Signal designs (e.g. ADC, DAC, PLL, SERDES …)

• Proficiency in using industry-standard layout tools (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre, Ansys Totem …) and familiarity with layout design flows for advanced technology nodes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and address layout-related issues efficiently.

• Proficient in layout techniques for Floor Planning, device matching, minimizing parasitics, RF shielding, EM, IR drop, ESD and high-frequency routing.

## What will you do at Ciena as a Analog Layout Engineer?

The Wavelogic family of products are widely used in Ciena's optical fiber transmission solutions and are one of the main contributors to Ciena's success in the telecommunications industry. Successful candidates will be joining a vibrant team with a proven track-record of success over 30-years of evolution and revolution in the advancement of high-speed circuits used in broadband fiber-optic modems. This team pioneered the introduction of the world’s first high-speed DAC and ADC analog macros that ushered in the era of coherent fiber-optic product solutions.

To further strengthen our team, we are looking for a hardworking analog layout engineer who will be working on advanced high-speed analog design circuits in the latest deep-submicron CMOS and/or BiCMOS technologies. Your role as an analog layout engineer will be to drive and implement best-in-class high-speed analog layouts that extract the highest performance from the world’s most advanced CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. These analog macros include electrical interface-facing DAC and ADC based SERDES solutions for 112G and 224G, optical-line-facing high-speed DAC and ADC circuits interfacing with optical modulators and detectors, transimpedance amplifiers, modulator driver circuits, and critical precision analog circuits for control and monitoring functions, etc.

## Responsibilities:

• Develop block and macro level layouts including floor-planning, placement, routing and optimization.

• Carry out layout feasibility studies on various circuit designs in collaboration with senior analog designers. The goal will be to find the best possible solution considering various trade-offs and discussions with team members.

• Write automation scripts for layout flow improvements including pcells.

• Conduct thorough verification checks such as DRC, ANT, LVS, PERC, EM, IR to ensure the final layout possesses the highest level of quality.

• Debug ESD violations reported by PERC and suggest solutions.

• Investigate new features within the layout tools and processes used for creating layouts with the aim of enhancing productivity.

• Mentor junior layout team members as applicable who may assist with some aspects of the overall layout implementation

• Provide regular status updates, participate in team meetings and share experiences with the rest of the group.

## What technical experience and personal skills are required for this role?

• Bachelor's or higher degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, with 5+ years of relevant industry experience.

• Experience in custom analog and mixed signal layout design with a strong knowledge of deep sub-micron CMOS devices (e.g. Finfet transistors).

• Highly motivated with strong team player skills, exhibits a positive can-do attitude and ability to seamlessly integrate into an existing team culture.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Experience in custom layout design of Analog/Mixed Signal designs (e.g. ADC, DAC, PLL, SERDES …)

• Proficiency in using industry-standard layout tools (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre, Ansys Totem …) and familiarity with layout design flows for advanced technology nodes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and address layout-related issues efficiently.

• Proficient in layout techniques for Floor Planning, device matching, minimizing parasitics, RF shielding, EM, IR drop, ESD and high-frequency routing.

• Meticulous attention to details, ensuring the highest level of accuracy and quality in all layout designs.

• Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing processes and foundry technologies.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and adapt quickly to changing project requirements.

• Solid understanding of RC delay, electromigration, and coupling effects.

• Familiarity with guard rings, DNW, PN junctions, advanced process effects such as LOD, OSE, WPE etc.

• High level of proficiency in interpreting DRC, PERC, ANT, PAD, ERC and LVS

• Ability to identify failure-prone circuit and layout structures and proactively work with circuit designers to resolve problems.

• Scripting skills in PERL or SKILL are a plus, but not required.

• A history of successful analog circuit product deliveries.

We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We’re looking for an Implementation Lead to perform a pivotal role in driving a customer and value proposition centric approach to implementing and configuring our investigative case management SaaS offerings.

In this role, you will be the main point of contact for our customers during the implementation process and you will oversee project management, product configuration, integration and migration requirements gathering/documentation, user training, and post-launch adoption tasks for some of our largest customers. You will become a product and investigative process expert and leverage that knowledge to plan and execute high quality customer onboardings to ensure successful delivery of value to our customers.

What You'll Do

• Own the full implementation lifecycle from contract signing through go-live and early adoption for new and existing customers

• Lead multiple concurrent implementation projects, maintaining clear timelines, milestones, and documentation

• Gather and translate customer requirements into scalable configuration, integration, and migration solutions

• Configure and support integrations (APIs, webhooks, batch data transfers) and oversee data migration processes

• Develop deep expertise in our product and investigative workflows to guide customers toward best practices

• Deliver engaging user training and enablement to drive successful adoption and long-term value

• Act as a trusted advisor to customers, proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues and improve delivery

• Provide structured feedback on product gaps, contribute to requirements, and support testing of new features

• Analyze implementation performance and customer outcomes, surfacing insights and improvement opportunities

• Continuously refine implementation processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer impact

• Maintain and promote high standards of security, confidentiality, and compliance while handling company systems, customer information, and internal processes.

What Success Looks Like

• 45 days: Complete onboarding, role-specific training, and required security/compliance expectations. Build context on Case IQ's products, customers, systems, team processes, and role priorities.

• 60 days: Shadow or support active customer implementations, learn delivery tools/templates, and begin owning defined workstreams with support.

• 90 days: Manage implementation tasks or projects with increasing independence, clear customer communication, and accurate documentation

• 6 months: Contribute to predictable delivery, cleaner handoffs, reduced rework, and improved customer readiness for launch or adoption.

• 1 year: Serve as a trusted implementation partner who helps customers achieve successful launches and supports continuous improvement of delivery practices.

Who You Are

• Fournir un soutien en génie de la guerre aérienne aux flottes d'aéronefs, aux GSA, aux BGP et aux communautés opérationnelles.

• Assurer la liaison avec les intervenants internes et externes dans le cadre des initiatives liées à la GE.

• Préparer de la documentation technique, des rapports, des présentations, de la correspondance et des documents de breffage.

• Effectuer des évaluations des répercussions sur la guerre aérienne liées aux changements techniques, aux modifications et aux initiatives de conception.

• Examiner les propositions techniques et évaluer leur conformité aux exigences de navigabilité et aux exigences opérationnelles.

• Appuyer le perfectionnement et le mentorat du personnel du génie de la guerre aérienne.

• Participer à des études, à des projets et à des activités de développement des capacités à l'appui de la mission de GE des Forces armées canadiennes.

• Baccalauréat en génie, en sciences ou dans une discipline technique connexe.

• Expérience démontrée des systèmes et des technologies de guerre électronique aérienne.

• Solide compréhension des environnements de menace RF et/ou EO/IR, des contre-mesures et des concepts opérationnels de la GE.

• Expérience du soutien aux flottes d'aéronefs militaires, aux projets de défense ou aux organisations de navigabilité.

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking an experienced Electronic Warfare Specialist to support the Directorate of Technical Airworthiness and Engineering Support (DTAES 5) within the Royal Canadian Air Force. Working as part of the Air Warfare Engineering team, you will provide specialized technical expertise in Electronic Warfare (EW), including Radio Frequency (RF) and Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) warfare capabilities, supporting Canadian Armed Forces aircraft fleets and associated equipment.

This role involves close collaboration with Weapon System Managers (WSMs), Project Management Offices (PMOs), operational stakeholders, Defence Research and Development Canada (DRDC), and other defence organizations to ensure air warfare capabilities remain effective, compliant, and operationally relevant.

## Responsibilities

Assist the Air Warfare Engineering Manager in the development and implementation of Air Electronic Warfare capabilities, including RF and EO/IR domains

Investigate, analyze, and provide recommendations on complex EW technical and technological issues

Provide Air Warfare Engineering support to aircraft fleets, WSMs, PMOs, and operational communities

Support networking and collaborative activities with DRDC, Royal Military College of Canada (RMCC), and other defence organizations

Liaise with internal and external stakeholder communities on EW-related initiatives

Prepare technical documentation, reports, presentations, correspondence, and briefing materials

Conduct Air Warfare impact assessments related to engineering changes, modifications, and design initiatives

Review technical proposals and assess compliance with airworthiness and operational requirements

Support the development and mentoring of Air Warfare Engineering personnel

Participate in studies, projects, and capability development activities supporting the Canadian Armed Forces' EW mission

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 10 years of experience supporting Electronic Warfare, Aerospace Engineering, Defence Systems, or Military Aviation programs

Demonstrated experience with Air Electronic Warfare systems and technologies

Strong understanding of RF and/or EO/IR threat environments, countermeasures, and EW operational concepts

Experience supporting military aircraft fleets, defence projects, or airworthiness organizations

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing skills

Ability to engage effectively with military personnel, senior stakeholders, and industry partners

Experience reviewing technical documentation, engineering changes, and system integration activities

Knowledge of Canadian Armed Forces and DND engineering environments is considered an asset

The successful candidate will help position Calian as a relevant, differentiated, and trusted defence partner while bringing together expertise across the organization to support coordinated market engagement and business growth.

## Responsibilities

• Develop and execute the marketing and communications strategy for Calian's Defence business across Canada, NATO and allied markets.

• Support Defence growth and business planning by aligning marketing priorities and investments with customer needs, strategic pursuits, government engagement, and business development objectives.

• Define and evolve market positioning, value propositions, customer narratives, and messaging across Defence capabilities, technologies, and solutions.

• Maintain a strong understanding of defence policy, customer priorities, modernization programs, procurement environments, and emerging opportunities.

• Identify priority markets, customer segments, and key stakeholder audiences across military, government, industry, and partner ecosystems.

• Lead market and competitive intelligence activities and translate insights into actionable growth strategies.

• Develop integrated campaigns supporting priority Defence growth areas, strategic pursuits, technologies, and solutions.

• Partner with Business Development and Capture teams to support priority opportunities through messaging, positioning, customer insights, and market engagement.

• Collaborate closely with Government Relations to ensure coordinated customer communications, industry engagement, and market positioning.

• Build strong relationships with technical, operational, and military subject matter experts and elevate their expertise through campaigns, thought leadership, customer engagement, and events.

• Oversee the development of customer-facing materials that support the full customer journey, from awareness through post-award engagement.

• Develop thought leadership programs that strengthen Calian's market position and demonstrate expertise in the evolving defence environment.

• Lead marketing strategies for key defence trade shows, conferences, demonstrations, customer engagements, and industry events.

• Support the launch and commercialization of new capabilities, technologies, digital solutions, and strategic partnerships.

• Collaborate with strategic partners and industry ecosystem participants to strengthen Calian's position in priority markets.

• Develop Defence-specific sales and business development enablement tools and resources.

• Establish measurable objectives and leverage CRM, campaign, and market data to evaluate marketing impact and improve outcomes.

• Lead marketing integration planning and execution activities related to future acquisitions.

• Serve as a senior marketing advisor to Defence leadership and contribute to Defence growth, market planning, and business development forums.

## Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in marketing, business development, commercialization, strategic communications, or a related discipline.

• Direct professional experience within the defence sector.

• Strong understanding of the Canadian defence environment, including the Department of National Defence, Canadian Armed Forces, defence industry, and government procurement ecosystem.

• Knowledge of NATO and allied defence markets and the broader international defence and security environment.

• Experience marketing complex technologies, services, solutions, or capabilities to government and military customers.

• Understanding of defence business development, capture, and procurement cycles.

• Experience collaborating with Government Relations, Business Development, Capture, Communications, and technical subject matter experts.

• Experience working with senior business leaders, military or defence customers, technical experts, and operational leaders.

• Knowledge of military modernization priorities, emerging technologies, and defence industry trends.

• Experience developing B2B and B2G marketing strategies within complex, long-cycle markets.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical or operational concepts into compelling market narratives.

• Strong strategic marketing, communications, and business development expertise combined with the ability to operate effectively at strategic, tactical, and operational levels.

• Demonstrated ability to influence, collaborate, and build trust within a matrix organization.

• Strong executive presence and confidence working with leaders, customers, government stakeholders, partners, and industry representatives.

## Additional Requirements

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Canadian Armed Forces and Department of National Defence environment.

• NATO, Five Eyes, and allied defence markets.

• Defence procurement and major capability programs.

• Defence industry and industrial partnerships.

• Strong sense of urgency, accountability, and bias toward action.

• Highly collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable delivering outcomes through cross-functional teams.

• Ability to navigate competing priorities and coordinate stakeholders across business, functional, and geographic boundaries.

You’ll advise on commercial contracts, privacy and AI, employment, and corporate matters for our hardware-enabled SaaS business, often with significant independence. You’ll report to the Associate General Counsel. WHAT YOU’LL DO COMMERCIAL CONTRACTS - Draft, review, and negotiate enterprise agreements, including Master Services Agreements, Terms of Service, Data Processing Addenda, AI Addenda, Reseller Agreements, and vendor contracts. - Act as the first point of contact for Sales on routine contract questions and customer redlines. - Apply Solink’s contract standards and fallback positions, and escalate deviations outside approved thresholds. - Help update and maintain contract templates in our contract management system. PRIVACY AND AI GOVERNANCE - Support compliance with Canadian, US, and EU privacy laws, including Quebec’s privacy law, PIPEDA, CCPA, and GDPR. - Help run Solink’s privacy program, including its policies, procedures, and regular compliance reviews. - Help update internal privacy policies, such as data retention and access request procedures. - Help run Solink’s AI governance framework. - Track new privacy and AI laws, including the EU AI Act, and determine how they affect our products. - Support privacy incident response and answer customer and regulator privacy inquiries. EMPLOYMENT AND CORPORATE SUPPORT - Answer employment questions under Ontario’s Employment Standards Act and other applicable laws. - Draft and review internal policies, such as commission and HR policies. - Manage outside counsel on assigned matters. - Support other legal and compliance projects as needed. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL - Work with Sales, Finance, HR, Product, and Engineering to give clear, practical advice. - Explain legal and technical issues in plain terms to both technical and non-technical teams. - Turn legal analysis into short, actionable guidance the business can use right away. - Help build self-serve tools, such as playbooks, FAQs, and talk tracks, so teams can handle routine questions independently. - Promote privacy and security awareness across the company. ROLE EXPECTATIONS This is a P3 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level are highly autonomous contributors who own initiatives end-to-end with minimal direction. They proactively solve problems, collaborate across teams, and connect their work to broader team and business goals.. In this role, you'll be expected to: - Own legal matters from start to finish. Independently manage assigned contracts, advisory matters, and compliance initiatives, bringing in the Associate General Counsel when complexity or risk requires it. - Apply sound, practical judgment. Assess legal risks in the context of business goals, recommend a clear path forward, and distinguish between decisions you can make independently and those requiring escalation. - Anticipate issues and bring solutions. Identify recurring legal questions, process gaps, and emerging risks, and recommend improvements before they become larger problems. - Build strong cross-functional partnerships. Work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs, provide actionable advice, and help move decisions and initiatives forward. - Create scalable ways of working. Develop and improve templates, playbooks, guidance, and workflows that strengthen consistency and help teams handle routine matters confidently. - Manage competing priorities with accountability. Balance urgent requests with longer-term commitments, communicate timelines and trade-offs early, and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality work. Preferred Experience - In-house experience at a SaaS or technology company, ideally one with both hardware and software products. Law firm experience would be valued. - Experience with US and EU privacy laws (CCPA, GDPR), biometrics, or AI regulation (EU AI Act). - Ontario employment law experience. - Experience with Ironclad or another contract management system. WHAT YOU BRING Must-Have: - JD from an accredited Canadian law school. - Member in good standing of the Law Society of Ontario. - 3-7 years of post-call experience at a law firm, in-house, or both. - Experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, ideally SaaS or technology contracts. - Working knowledge of privacy law. - Strong attention to detail. - Clear, concise writing. - Sound judgment about when to make a call and when to escalate. - Ability to manage several urgent matters at once without losing quality. - A builder’s mindset. You’re comfortable creating processes and templates where none exist. - Based in the Toronto or Ottawa/National Capital regions Compensation The salary range for this role is $116,659 - $170,000 CAD plus equity. We determine compensation based on the experience, skills, and impact you bring to the role. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada; - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. OUR VALUES We do things the Solink way: - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too. - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar. - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work. - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required. - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth. - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account. - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs. - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together. - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics. - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun. WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect: 1. Intro call with our Talent Team 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager 3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable) 4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members 5. Reference Checks 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉 PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward. NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION. SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

Avaya is on a mission to redefine the Customer Experience (CX) landscape. We are moving beyond the traditional contact center to a true connection center to power immersive, personalized, and AI-driven experiences for the world's largest financial institutions.

We are seeking a National Account Manager to join our team in Dalian, China to cover accounts in Dalian and Korea. You will bridge the gap between trusted, secure legacy infrastructure and the future of Agentic AI and Composable CX. You will demonstrate how our "Innovation Without Disruption" strategy allows our customers agility without the risks of a "rip and replace" migration. You will fully utilize your deep cultural knowledge of China and Korea while conducting business in English.

## Your Mission

You will own the narrative to drive sales results with our customers and prospects through channel partners. Your goal is to protect the core voice and hardware business while aggressively expanding into new Infinity and Nexus AI, Cloud, and Orchestration territories.

## Trusted Executive Advisor & Commercial Architect

• Strategic Leadership: Act as the primary business consultant to customer C-suite executives. Lead high-stakes discussions focused on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Return on Investment (ROI), and the commercial justification for complex migrations.

• Commercial Strategy: Develop successful transition strategies for customers migrating from legacy environments. You will build the roadmap for modernizing their CX while ensuring compliance with strict financial security standards.

## Champion Avaya Infinity Architecture & Agentic AI

• Evangelize Agentic AI: Move clients beyond simple chatbots to adopting autonomous AI agents capable of executing complex workflows—such as loan processing, fraud detection, and wealth advisory—securely and at scale.

• The Infinity Value Proposition: Consult clients on how to overlay modern cloud technologies and digital channels onto their existing, robust voice core. Show them how to innovate immediately without disrupting mission-critical operations.

• Solution Design: Lead high-level business discovery to define the strategy for large-scale CCaaS solutions, creating seamless journeys across voice and digital channels (chat, email, social, secure messaging).

## Value Realization & Competitive Positioning

• High-Impact Demonstrations: Partner with engineering to deliver compelling Product Demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that showcase integrations with core banking applications (CRM, WFO, ERP).

• Market Intelligence: Maintain expert-level knowledge of the CCaaS competitive landscape (e.g., Genesys, NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect). Effectively articulate Avaya’s superior differentiation—specifically our ability to innovate on top of existing investments.

## Qualifications

• Sales Expertise: 5+ years of successful CCaaS/CX/UCaaS sales experience, with a strong preference experience selling through channel partners

• Strategic Transformation: Proven history of managing complex legacy-to-cloud migrations and "Innovation without Disruption" strategies.

• Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, presentation, and whiteboarding skills. You must have the ability to command a room and lead strategic, value-focused discussions with C-level audiences.

• Performance: A demonstrated history of hitting and exceeding sales targets and growing global accounts.

• Travel: Ability to travel as required to achieve sales plans.

• Location: Virtual home office is Dalian, China

• Languages: Writen and spoken fluency in Chinese, Korean and English

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. ## Position Overview:

Our Machinists in Mount Vernon work on large-scale, multi-axis CNC mills and lathes to machine one-of-a-kind precision components for naval nuclear reactors used in submarines and aircraft carriers.

This is a low-volume, highly-engineered manufacturing environment, where you’d be involved in the full life cycle of the build. You’ll work in a safe, clean, and highly-specialized manufacturing environment alongside a great team of skilled colleagues. This is unique work that will allow you to demonstrate your machining skills all while supporting the safety of our nation’s sailors.

Due to the importance of quality in our shop, all of our machinists start out with paid on the job training and mentoring prior to working alone. Overtime is required but flexible in how it is achieved. Additional overtime work is also available if desired. Our machinists receive shift premium for second shift work and premium pay like double time based on hours/days worked in a week. We are also currently offering a sign-on bonus of $4,000. Relocation assistance is available for qualified applicants.

The job will start with training on day shift and then transition to a three (3) day weekend schedule, twelve (12) hour shifts, Friday through Sunday. The pay will be for forty hours, three days per week.

## Location:

On-site in Mt. Vernon, Indiana

## Your Day to Day as a CNC Machinist:

In this role, you will set up and operate CNC machine tools to perform various types of machining operations such as milling, drilling, tapping/thread milling, boring, and turning in order to meet print specifications. Additionally, you would:

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify products meet customer requirements and product specifications

• Work to ±.001” tolerance and 16 microfinish when necessary

• Write/edit programs using both G and M coded controls (experience with Siemens and Fanuc controls preferred)

• Troubleshoot challenges with support of on-site engineering

• Routinely read and comprehend written instructions, technical procedures, prints, sketches, and bills of material

• Work in a team environment by assisting the CNC Programmer as necessary to develop and/or test run programs

• Use advanced mathematical skills to calculate proper speed and feed rates

• Operate crane or assist with the rigging and moving of parts

• Maintain clean work area and daily housekeeping duties

• Collaborate and communicate with opposite shift through face-to-face carryover and log books

• Work with tooling application engineers to devise optimum tooling design and practices

• Work in accordance with all applicable company procedures, policies and rules

## Required Qualifications:

• High school equivalency with a minimum of four (4) years relevant experience.

• Associate’s of Applied Science degree in Machining Tool and Die or equivalent training plus two (2) years of on-the-job experience may be considered in lieu of experience.

• Experience with grinders, tool setters, jacks, clamps, bolts, shims, jigs, fixtures, angle plates, rules, micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, gages, levels, protractors, verniers, and light hand tools.

• Ability to maintain detailed records; ability to complete process documentation and other production records.

• Ability to work any shift, to include nights and weekends.

• U.S. citizenship is required for this position.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience machining parts greater than 8-feet diameter and 10-tons is preferred.

• Experience with different machining attachments (i.e. right angle, universal, offset milling) is preferred.

• Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) is preferred.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

• We are also currently offering a sign-on bonus of $4,000!

As Senior Buyer, you will manage purchasing activities supporting one of our tank production facilities, with responsibility for spend across raw materials, parts, services, MRO, and other requirements. ## Senior Security Analyst

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Security Threat Monitoring, Screening and Access Programs, you will be the Bank's senior technical specialist for complex personnel security assessments and risk analysis. You will handle highly sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment, following privacy, confidentiality, information-handling and need-to-know requirements.

You will assess high-risk screening cases, including adverse information, unresolved security concerns, Resolution of Doubt, Reviews for Cause and enhanced screening.

You will provide expert advice to support personnel security decisions, working alongside Screening Analysts and the Screening Manager. You will also support Threat Monitoring and incident response when demand increases.

Specifically, you will:

Lead Complex Personnel Security Assessments

• Assess complex, escalated personnel security cases involving adverse information, elevated risks or unresolved concerns.

• Gather, verify and analyze information from authorized internal and external sources to identify concerns, credibility issues, vulnerabilities and mitigating factors.

• Evaluate risks based on duties, access and organizational exposure, and provide evidence-based recommendations to management.

Conduct Security Interviews

• Plan and conduct fair, objective security screening and Resolution of Doubt interviews tailored to identified risks.

• Verify information, assess the credibility and consistency of responses, and document findings for assessments and recommendations.

Support Resolution of Doubt

• Analyze criminal, financial, association, credibility and behavioural concerns to support Resolution of Doubt.

• Develop assessment and interview plans, and coordinate information gathering with internal and external partners.

• Ensure assessments follow applicable policies, standards, procedural fairness and personnel security principles.

Conduct Advanced Open-Source Intelligence Research and Analysis

• Conduct advanced open-source intelligence (OSINT) research to verify information and identify personnel security concerns and emerging risks.

• Evaluate source credibility, reliability and limitations, and document research methods, findings and conclusions.

• Provide OSINT expertise for personnel security, threat assessments and complex work across teams.

Prepare Findings, Assessments and Recommendations

• Prepare clear, accurate and defensible assessment reports, case summaries and briefings that meet applicable policies and standards.

• Present balanced, evidence-based recommendations to decision-makers on risks, mitigation measures, conditions, monitoring and organizational impacts.

Provide Technical Leadership

• Advise analysts and management as the technical expert on complex personnel security assessments, interviewing and risk analysis.

• Review complex, sensitive or precedent-setting files, identify quality gaps and improve standards, procedures and tools.

• Mentor and coach Screening Analysts to strengthen analytical, interviewing and risk assessment skills.

Support Threat Monitoring and Incident Response

• Support Threat Monitoring during heightened threats, major events, incidents, employee safety concerns or increased demand.

• Use OSINT and internal and external information to assess emerging threats, actors and behaviours affecting the Bank, its employees, operations, assets and reputation.

• Prepare threat assessments, intelligence reports and briefings, and provide rapid analysis, escalation and decision support during incidents and crises.

• Stay current on evolving threats and tactics, and improve monitoring, analytical methods and intelligence sharing.

## What You Need to Succeed

You are an experienced security professional with expertise in personnel security screening, assessing adverse information, risk analysis and security interviews.

You use sound judgment to balance security risks, organizational needs, privacy, procedural fairness and risk-management principles when making recommendations.

You demonstrate:

• Advanced knowledge of personnel security screening processes, standards, and practices.

• Advanced knowledge of personnel security risk assessment methodologies.

• Experience supporting Resolution of Doubt activities, enhanced screening reviews, and Reviews for Cause processes.

• Experience conducting security screening interviews and fact-finding interviews.

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.

• Advanced OSINT research and analytical capabilities.

• Experience preparing assessment reports, security assessments, risk assessments, briefing notes, and recommendations for management.

• Strong written communication, briefing, and presentation skills.

• Exceptional judgment, discretion and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to protect highly sensitive personal and security information and share it only on an authorized need-to-know basis.

• Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.

• Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to others.

• Ability to influence decisions through expertise, rigorous analysis and professional credibility, without formal authority.

## Nice-to-Have

• Experience conducting complex personnel security assessments.

• Experience supporting Reviews for Cause and other personnel security review processes.

• Experience conducting OSINT activities related to personnel security or threat assessment matters.

• Knowledge of Government of Canada security screening standards and best practices.

• Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence, regulatory, or security partners.

• Experience developing assessment methodologies, procedures, or analytical frameworks.

Education and Experience
This position requires a bachelor's degree in Criminology, Security Studies, Intelligence Studies, Psychology, Sociology, Law, Public Administration, Political Science, International Relations, Business Administration or a related discipline and a minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in personnel security screening or assessments, security risk assessment, intelligence analysis, threat assessment, law enforcement, regulatory investigations or related security functions. An equivalent combination of education and experience may also be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Top Secret

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $111,051 to $130,649 (job grade 17)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 7 to 10% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (5%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health and dental coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service

## Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Senior Engineer.

## About the team:

The Computing Data Application Acceleration Lab aims to create a leading global data analytics platform organized into three specialized teams using innovative programming technologies. This team focuses on full-stack innovations, including software-hardware co-design and optimizing data efficiency at both the storage and runtime layers. This team also develops next-generation GPU architecture for gaming, cloud rendering, VR/AR, and Metaverse applications. One of the goals of this lab are to enhance algorithm performance and training efficiency across industries, fostering long-term competitiveness.

## About the job:

As a Senior System Engineer, you will drive core compute operator development and distributed scaling performance across foundation model pre-training and post-training workloads on Ascend NPUs. You will identify computational and communication bottlenecks, implement high-performance kernels using AscendC, Triton, and TileLang, and optimize distributed acceleration suites (MindSpeed / open-source training frameworks).

• Ascend High-Performance Kernel Development: Design, implement, and tune core operators (FlashAttention variants, FP8/MXFP8/W4A8 GEMM, Fused RMSNorm, dynamic MoE routing/dispatch) using AscendC, with explorations in Triton (Triton-Ascend backend) and TileLang.

• Pre-training & Post-training System Optimization: Architect, scale, and optimize distributed pre-training and RL post-training pipelines using MindSpeed (MindSpeed-LLM / MindSpeed-MM) alongside upstream frameworks (Megatron-LM / Megatron-Core, PyTorch FSDP, veRL, vLLM, Ray).

• Distributed Parallelism & Training Efficiency: Tune multi-dimensional hybrid parallelism (TP, PP, CP, EP, ZeRO/FSDP) and RL rollout/actor pipelining on Ascend NPU clusters, achieving optimal MFU and compute-communication overlap.

• Low-Precision & Numerical Parity: Implement low-precision training/inference schemes (FP8, MXFP8, mixed-precision), guaranteeing numerical stability, batch-invariance, and strict precision parity between training and serving runtimes.

• Profiling & Hardware-Aware Tuning: Conduct deep performance profiling on Ascend hardware using Ascend Profiler (msprof), msprobe, and PyTorch Profiler to eliminate pipeline bubbles, AICore/AIVector stalls, and HCCL communication overhead.

• Open Source & Ecosystem Enablement: Contribute high-performance operators, bug fixes, and acceleration features to open-source Ascend communities and upstream AI acceleration projects.

The total target annual compensation ranges from $127,000 to $225,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Our 5G Radio Access Network (RAN) solutions are already connecting billions of devices, and we are actively shaping the evolution toward 6G. Within this context, our L1 Software Development team in RCE RAN Performance designs and implements the Physical Layer baseband functions – the signal‑processing engine at the heart of 5G.

We are looking for a curious, driven junior developer who is passionate about high‑performance embedded software, low‑level programming, and cloud‑ready systems. If you are excited by innovation and want your code to help power networks around the world, we’d like to hear from you.

Within our organization, we work on two Ericsson products, our purpose-built multi-core ASIC and newly deployed, Cloud based Radio Access Network. Our mission is twofold:

• Develop high‑quality L1 features that grow our customers’ businesses and improve network performance.

• Secure the product’s future through cutting‑edge technology, cloud‑native architectures, and continuous innovation.

You will join a collaborative, international team that works closely with global RAN and platform experts, using modern development practices to deliver robust, performant software.

• Designing, developing, and testing L1 software components on Ericsson’s 5G processing platform and related cloud/COTS environments.

• Implementing and enhancing Physical Layer baseband features across a range of deployment scenarios and frequency bands defined by 3GPP.

• Performing continuous analysis, clarifying requirements, and contributing to technical solutions that balance performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Working in both manual and highly automated environments to integrate new software modules and algorithms, and to troubleshoot complex issues.

• Applying real‑time software development practices and knowledge of wireless communication protocols (for example NR/5G, LTE, WCDMA, WLAN).

• Developing and maintaining test coverage to ensure new changes do not degrade existing functionality.

• Exploring cloud‑native platforms and learning how to optimize L1 software for containerized and virtualized environments.

• Using AI/ML tools and techniques where appropriate to accelerate development, improve performance, or enable intelligent automation.

• Contributing to a modern, agile way of working, including sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement activities.

• Documenting system analysis, software designs, and test plans in line with internal standards.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Communications Systems, AI/ML, or a related field.

• 0–4 years of professional experience in a relevant domain.

• 2+ years of experience with embedded software, low‑level programming, and cloud‑ready systems

• Experience with software development and systems programming, with a strong desire to grow into a technical expert in wireless and L1.

• 3+ years of experience with C/C++, with a focus on embedded or systems‑level software.

• Experience with wireless communication fundamentals, such as quadrature modulation, channel coding, OFDMA, and receiver theory.

• Experience in developing L1 software for major wireless standards (for example NR, LTE, WCDMA, WiMAX, WLAN).

• Comfort working in a Linux development environment.

• Experience with software configuration and delivery tools such as Git, Gerrit, and Jenkins (or similar).

• Awareness of cloud concepts and platforms, and enthusiasm to learn how to build and optimize cloud‑native solutions.

• Curiosity about how AI and machine learning can be applied to software development and wireless systems.

• Strong analytical and critical‑thinking skills, with a methodical approach to debugging and problem solving.

• Clear verbal and written communication skills and a collaborative mindset, comfortable working in a diverse, international, multi‑site team.

• Adaptability and ownership: able to work in a fast‑paced agile environment, respond to changing priorities, and take responsibility for delivering high‑quality results.

## Join our Team

Location: Ottawa, ONT

## About this opportunity:

Join our RP Test Management team and help shape software test for Ericsson’s embedded and cloud-native platforms, supporting today’s 5G and tomorrow’s 6G technologies.

You will play a key role in evolving our RAN software test procedure through Agentic AI-driven approach, such as autonomous agents, intelligent automation, observability, and pipeline optimization. Working closely with your team and development teams across the organization, you will provide technical leadership, apply your automation expertise, and drive continuous improvement. You will challenge existing ways of working and turning innovative ideas into measurable improvements that accelerate delivery, strengthen software quality, and create a better developer experience.

## What you will do:

• Drive the design, development and deployment of Agentic AI solutions for test, such as AI agents for test analysis, test case selection and generation and etc

• Deploy, operate and scale AI solutions on AWS or other cloud platforms, in close collaboration with tools, CI/CD and infrastructure teams

• Drive test analysis of 5G and 6G RAN features from study through execution: set and communicate test scope, and secure test coverage and quality.

• Identify the impact and risks of new features on test tools, forecast test environment requirements and follow up their implementation.

• Educate and support the organization on test strategy, efficient testing and the use of AI agents in the test flow

## The skills you bring:

• University education M.Sc/B.Sc in Telecommunication/Electrical Engineering /Computer Science or equivalent experience

• Hands-on experience building Agentic AI systems in test or design, e.g., LLM-based agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, or similar

• Hands-on experience deploying AI solutions on AWS (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3) or another cloud platform (Azure, GCP), including containerization, Infrastructure as Code and cloud security fundamentals

• Knowledge of telecommunications, 3GPP specifications relevant to 5G NR and RAN software development is an asset.

• Ability to communicate effectively to articulate and convey complex technical information effectively to stakeholders

• Strong problem-solving skills to devise innovative solutions for testing challenges, and analytical abilities to troubleshoot complex issues

• Advantages for this position:

• Knowledge and hands on experience in Agentic AI solution in test

• Production-grade AI engineering practice: agent evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost optimization and MLOps/LLMOps

• AWS or other cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning / AI Practitioner)

• Python proficiency and experience integrating AI agents with test tools, CI/CD pipelines and RAN lab environments

AmerCable is an ISO 9001:2015-certified manufacturer of jacketed electrical power, control and instrumentation cables. The company’s core markets, mining, oil and gas, and industrial, require complex cable designs that can operate reliably over long periods of time in harsh operating environments.

As a customer-focused company, AmerCable’s top priority is to help its customers be more productive and profitable with high-quality cable products and services, fast reliable delivery, field engineering support and outstanding customer service.
All cable products are made in El Dorado, Arkansas or Katy, Texas.

## Impact of this Role

The Lead Extruder Operator supports the production of high-quality cable by setting up and operating the lead extruder according to order specifications. This role helps maintain product quality and operator/machine efficiency while ensuring cable moves successfully to the next stage of the manufacturing process.

• Set up, operate, and tear down the lead extruder according to work instructions, SOPs, and order specifications.

• Apply the lead jacket to cable and check and measure the lead pipe during operation to ensure adherence to item specifications.

• Collect data and maintain run recordings during machine operation.

• Make and verify cable marking tape according to order requirements.

• Monitor product quality and operator/machine efficiency.

• Produce product on time according to the current work schedule.

• Assist the Lead Stripper and Tuber Operator as needed.

• Follow all safety rules, housekeeping practices, Nexans AmerCable Safety Standards, Safe Work Practices, and applicable ethics and business conduct standards.

## What You Bring to the Role

• High school diploma or GED.

• Good reading comprehension and basic math skills.

• Basic mechanical abilities.

• Ability to take, calculate, and record readings using calipers, micrometers, and diameter tapes.

• Ability to operate the lead extruder and workstation computer.

• Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled environment.

• Ability to physically move material, potentially up to 50 lbs.

• Ability to work extended hours as needed, including weekends and holidays.

• Ability to complete required training, including ISO 9000 principles.

• Multiple medical, dental & vision plan options (Blue Cross Blue Shield & VSP)

• 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar match, vested from day one

• Wellness incentives

## AUKUS Engineer 1

Responsible for routine engineering assignments applying standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria under guidance of a manager or experienced engineer. Assignments are designed to develop professional work knowledge and abilities. Works under close supervision. Manager screens assignments for unusual or difficult problems and selects techniques and procedures to be applied on non-routine work.

Onsite in Erwin, TN

• Assistance is furnished on unusual problems and work is reviewed for application of sound professional judgment.

• Prepare written reports, drawings/sketches, technical documents (Technical Basis, Change Requests, Equivalencies, Set Points, etc.).

• Designs and conducts tests or experiments, evaluate and correlate data, organize and plan work.

• Applies understanding of manufacturing technology, technical process specifications, Engineering policies and procedures, QC procedures, department goals, customer needs and contract requirements.

• Develops ability to interpret technical specifications, conduct meetings, deal with customer, vendor, and other department representatives, prepare time and cost estimates.

## Required Qualifications:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. No experience required.

• Ability to effectively communicate complex technical information in writing and verbally.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a multifunctional team.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Senior Developer, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada.
