You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

About the position
We are seeking an innovative and skilled Senior Developers to join our new mandates team! The Bank of Canada is advancing technology solutions to support two new mandates: Stablecoin and Consumer-driven Banking. These initiatives will establish new regulatory and supervisory capabilities for emerging payment services and open banking, requiring the development of modern applications and digital services to support registration, supervision, compliance, and related operational processes.

Lead by the Director, Supervision Portfolio, you will join a dynamic and highly skilled team working together to design, develop, and support our regulatory IT platform built on the Power Platform.

Further, you will have the full support of your leader and teammates to enhance your skills, experiment, and further your career through our customizable Learning & Development programs across various domains (IT, Programming, Architecture, Analytics, etc.) and relevant certifications.

What you will do
As a Senior Developer, you will design, build, test, and deliver modern applications and services supporting the Stablecoin and Consumer-Driven Banking mandates. Working within an Agile delivery team, you will translate evolving business and regulatory requirements into secure, scalable solutions, contribute to technical design and integration decisions, troubleshoot complex issues, and help establish development practices that support the long-term maintainability and evolution of these new platforms.

More specifically, you will:

• Contribute to the development of the Power Platform application and peripheral technologies

• Analyze, design and implement enhancements to meet business requirements

• Maintain collaborative relationships with internal clients and external counterparts

• Perform technical and root-cause analysis on issues and make recommendations for correction

• Create working procedures and documentation on solutions and populate knowledge databases, testing plans and results

• Apply a continuous improvement mindset, by identifying innovative ways of doing or providing services to our clients; changing or reconfiguring approaches to improve efficiency and capacity

• Ensure compliance with audit requirements during the support and maintenance of applications

• Provide second and third-line support, including evening and weekend paid overtime work as required

What you need to succeed
You have a strong attention to details with the ability to rank tasks per priority, meet deadlines and perform multiple tasks concurrently. You also can communicate effectively and maintain co-operative working relationships with the other project members and IT teams

In addition, you have:

• Experience building custom APIs and Plug-ins

• Proven experience with C# programming language and .NET Framework

• Proven experience with web portal development in a Microsoft or equivalent environment

• Experience developing and maintaining HTML5, CSS, JavaScript web portal applications

• Experience working with business analysts or user experience (UX) designers to creatively translate business requirements and designs into interactive web portal functionality

• Experience and understanding of source control systems essential, including advanced branching and merging techniques.

• Experience developing within Dynamics 365 and Power Platform

## Assets

• Experience with Liquid or equivalent templating engine

• Experience in writing programming scripts using PowerShell

Your education and experience
Your combined education and work experience demonstrate that you have the proficiencies and skills for the role. We are ideally seeking candidates with a relevant degree/diploma and 7+ years of relevant experience.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

## Language requirement

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Description

Avaya has shifted the global enterprise customer experience (CX) landscape toward a unified, AI-driven, and open cloud architecture. We are seeking a highly accomplished Solution Sales Engineer to be a primary technical driver in accelerating sales of our Infinity platform adoption—focused on CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service), Omnichannel, AI/ML, Intelligent Orchestration, and Business Application Integration.

This role is for a strategic technologist and storyteller who can translate complex, multi-modal capabilities into tangible business outcomes. While foundational knowledge of legacy communications platforms is beneficial, success in this role is fundamentally tied to demonstrating expertise and driving adoption of our modern, open, and cloud-based CX solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• The successful candidate will spend approximately 80% of their time focused on the strategic CCaaS, AI, and Orchestration portfolio, and 20% on migration strategies from legacy environments.

• Solution Architecture & Design (CCaaS/Omnichannel): Lead the technical discovery and design of complex, large-scale CCaaS solutions, ensuring seamless integration of voice and digital channels (chat, email, social, messaging).

• AI Integration & Orchestration: Architect and present solutions utilizing embedded and third-party AI/ML services for conversational AI, real-time agent assist, sentiment analysis, and intelligent workflow orchestration across the customer journey.

• Demonstration & Proof of Value: Create, customize, and deliver compelling, high-impact product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly illustrate the business value of our platforms, showcasing integrations with core business applications (CRM, WFO, ERP).

• Technical Expertise & Advocacy: Act as the trusted technical advisor to the sales team and customer executives, guiding discussions on security, compliance, API integration , cloud architecture, and total cost of ownership (TCO) for modern cloud CX solutions.

• Competitive Strategy: Maintain expert-level knowledge of the CCaaS competitive landscape (e.g., Genesys, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect) and effectively position Avaya’s differentiation.

## Requirements

Required Core Competencies & Skills

• Experience: 8+ years in a technical pre-sales, solution consulting, or solution architecture role, with 5+ years of CCaaS/SaaS/Cloud contact center experience (Genesys, NICE, 8x8, Five9, Talkdesk, Calabrio, etc)

• CCaaS Architecture: Deep, hands-on experience designing and presenting modern cloud contact center reference architectures, including knowledge of microservices, global multi-region deployments, and consumption models.

• AI/Intelligent Automation: Proven ability to articulate the value of AI in CX (e.g., self-service containment, agent augmentation, journey analysis) and experience integrating conversational AI solutions (bots, NLP).

• Omnichannel Journey Design: Expertise in mapping and designing end-to-end customer journeys that leverage digital channels and maintain context across channels and systems.

• API/Integration Proficiency: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, Webhooks, and CPaaS concepts, with the ability to discuss business application integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) with technical teams.

• Orchestration/Workflow: Practical knowledge of building and demonstrating sophisticated, data-driven workflows using orchestration tools or low-code/no-code platforms.

• Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, presentation, and whiteboarding skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for C-level audiences.

• Languages: Local languages and English are required

Desired Differentiators

• Traditional Avaya Stack Knowledge: Practical experience or strong familiarity with heritage Avaya on-premise portfolio, including Avaya Aura (CM, SM, SMGR), Elite, and relevant applications. This knowledge is valuable for advising customers on strategic, phased migration paths to the cloud.

• Scripting/Development: Basic familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python) or development environments to rapidly prototype and demonstrate integration capabilities.

• Certifications: Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure) or specialized CCaaS vendor certifications.

• Travel Requirements : Willingness to travel to support business as required.
Please note: No sponsorship is available for this position.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Digital ASIC Verification Engineer to join our top-level team. You will play a key role in verifying complex, highly integrated digital ASICs, with a particular focus on top-level functionality, cross-IP interactions, and system-level use cases.

In this role, you will take ownership of complex verification activities, working closely with digital designers, architects, and verification engineers to develop verification strategies, create functional test environments and scenarios, debug challenging failures, and drive verification toward closure.

• Clearly communicate verification status, risks, issues, and recommendations to the broader ASIC development team.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in digital ASIC/SoC verification, with demonstrated experience independently verifying complex designs.

• Experience developing verification plans and translating design and architectural requirements into testcases.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

• Experience with formal verification, including property checking, assertion-based verification, formal applications, or formal coverage techniques.

## Join us at Entrust

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.

Entrust's values are a cornerstone of who we are, our future business growth and how our people grow through it. We model our values by demonstrating that Customer Trust Is Earned, moving with purpose because Speed Is Intentional, taking accountability because We Own the Outcome, and building a collaborative culture where One Entrust Wins Together.

## Get to Know Us

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.

## Position Description:

As a QA Specialist in our Ottawa office, you will help validate the quality, reliability, usability, and security of Entrust software solutions used by government, enterprise, and financial services customers. You will work as part of a cross-functional engineering team to plan, execute, and document testing across web applications, APIs, integrations, cloud and on-premises deployments, and complex customer workflows. This role is hands-on and collaborative, combining structured manual testing, exploratory testing, defect investigation, regression testing, and practical test automation to help deliver secure, dependable products from our Ottawa engineering centre.

## Responsibilities:

• Plan, design, execute, and maintain functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end test cases for Entrust software products and customer workflows.

• Test web applications, APIs, services, integrations, installers, and supported deployment configurations across cloud and on-premises environments.

• Configure and validate representative test environments, including identity, directory, database, network, browser, operating system, and application dependencies.

• Create, update, and execute automated tests using approved QA automation tools and frameworks where automation provides sustainable release value.

• Investigate, reproduce, document, and track defects with clear steps, logs, screenshots, expected results, actual results, severity, and business impact.

• Collaborate daily with developers, product owners, technical leads, project managers, support, and other QA team members to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, risks, and release readiness.

• Contribute to sprint planning, story refinement, test estimation, release planning, defect triage, and retrospectives in an Agile development environment.

• Review requirements, design notes, user stories, and customer scenarios to identify test coverage gaps, edge cases, quality risks, and opportunities for earlier feedback.

• Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools, including GitHub Copilot where appropriate, to support test-case drafting, automation scripting, documentation, and regression analysis while validating outputs with sound QA judgment.

• Help improve QA practices, test documentation, reusable test assets, release metrics, and team approaches that increase product quality and reduce manual rework.

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking Social Workers with interest in providing mental health services to Canadian Armed Forces members in their exclusive outpatient clinic located at CFB Edmonton.

This role is ideal if you have an interest in treating the military population, operational trauma, and occupational health. This is a rewarding position where you’d make a difference in the lives of the men and women who serve our country and keep us safe.

We're seeking a part-time Social Worker, 28.12 hours per week. In addition to a competitive hourly rate this position comes with a comprehensive benefits package.

## Responsibilities

• Managing crisis interventions and conducting risk assessments for individuals and families

• Conducting intakes and completing bio-psychosocial assessments for a wide range of presenting issues such as work-related stress, depression, anxiety, substance abuse, suicide ideation, relationship struggles, family stress, somatic complaints, personality disorders and PTSD

• Providing treatment through a variety of approaches including individual therapy, couples therapy, and group treatment therapy followed by evaluation of the treatment and therapeutic outcome

• Presenting the clients’ care with recommendations to the inter-disciplinary healthcare teams to develop an individualized treatment plan

• Analyzing the clients’ needs and provide information and advice to them and their families related to access to appropriate services and resources

• Facilitating educational activities and group interventions such as pre-deployment briefings, psychosocial services overview presentations, and group psycho-education sessions

• Implementing new interventions or treatment approaches such as telemedicine and virtual reality therapy

• Distributing local outreach material such as mental health awareness material to bases and units

• Creating and maintaining confidential client reports on treatment services

## Qualifications

• Must have a Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Social Work from a recognized university

• Must have a minimum of 3 years post-graduate experience with an adult population administering assessments, creating treatment plans, and delivering counselling services for individuals, couples, and groups

• Must hold a current membership certificate with the Alberta College of Social Workers, and be authorized to provide Psycho-Social Interventions

• Current certification or willingness to obtain CPR Level C with AED

## Additional Requirements

• Must be able to obtain a Government Security Clearance at the Reliability level

Want to start or continue your career development, working in one of the most exciting and innovative industries? Your qualities and values are characteristics that Ericsson strongly encourages, as well as respect for colleagues. Our People and Customers are what drives us forward and underpins everything that we do.

The role of System Test Analyst is located in Ottawa. Ericsson promotes and supports a hybrid workplace environment. This is a full-time, and permanent based position within the Systems, Product & Security (SPS) organization. Your main focus will be testing, troubleshooting, and delivering Ericsson RAN Access Network (RAN) products to our global Customers. You will also be expected to develop your Cloud Native and AI skills to a strong level, while developing innovative solutions that move Ericsson further, along the Digitalization pathway.

The ideal candidate should embody the qualities highlighted earlier, together with an engineering background, where one is able to demonstrate strong and proven analytical skills. • Deliver software assessments based on a data-driven and analytical approach. Which parts of the data are critical to my decision?

• Participate in customer validation tests. How well did our tests address the system requirements?

• Develop competence in the technical domain. Am I continually upskilling myself?

## You will bring

• Logical and critical thinking skills

• Self-motivation, and have a can-do attitude

• Strong team & interpersonal skills

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

• Knowledge of, or experience of RAN, NR & LTE is desired

• Awareness of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

• UE simulator test tool knowledge

• Knowledge of Cloud Native principles

• Experience working with, or good exposure to Agentic AI, LLMs and Generative AI solutions

Position Title: Electronics Engineer

Employment Type: Full-time, Existing vacancy

Location: Ottawa (On-Site)

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## Why You’ll Love This Role

At Lumentum, we are searching for Canada’s brightest young minds engineers and innovators who want to build the next generation of optical technology. If you are driven by curiosity, eager to solve real-world challenges, and excited about developing groundbreaking optical systems, this is your opportunity.

Join us in designing the future of optical cloud & networking technology our advanced photonic modules power the world’s voice and internet traffic, and we need your expertise to take them to the next level. This is not just another job; this is your chance to define & design what’s next in photonics.

Lumentum is seeking a talented senior Electronics Engineer to develop leading edge electro-optic optical cross connect switch PCBAs. The successful candidate will be capable of priming complex PCBA designs, working independently and with teams to define, simulate and deliver winning and manufacturable products. In this capacity, the candidate will possess detailed knowledge of analog/digital design techniques, PCBA design, team leading skills, simulation and applicable technologies.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Lead the design and development of advanced hardware for optical systems, from concept to production.

• Lead extended team during development process.

• Define and evaluate components (amplifiers, transistors, uC, ADC/DAC, etc) and circuitries for the analog designs such as Laser drivers, TIAs, power supplies, etc.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including software, firmware, optical, MFG, and mechanical.

• Conduct rigorous hardware testing and validation to ensure performance and reliability.

• Define and develop test requirements and support the product through the NPI lifecycle.

• Create detailed schematics, guide PCB layouts, and perform simulations using industry-standard CAD tools (Cadence, Ansys)

## What We’re Looking For

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field and minimum 10 years of applicable experience.

• Expertise in complex PCBA design.

• Expertise in leading a small team (layout, junior designers, verification engineers)

• Proficiency in hardware design and simulation tools such as Cadence and Ansys.

• Hands-on experience with testing equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers).

• Proficiency in a low frequency analog and mixed signal.

• Extensive knowledge of electronic components and circuits property, fabrication processes, assembly processes.

• Experience in a power/digital design and in control systems is an asset.

• Knowledge of optical architectures and systems is an asset.

• Knowledge of DC power circuitry would be an asset.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with teams, both local and remote.

## Perks You’ll Love

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

## Salary Range: $110,625 - 149,675 CAD (flexible).

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In line with our commitment to being a great place to work, Lumentum offers competitive total rewards which may include annual bonus, equity, and comprehensive health and welfare benefits.

## Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

Calian is proud to continue a long-standing contractual relationship with the Department of National Defence (DND) to provide healthcare services to the Canadian Armed Forces. Through the Health Care Provider Contract, Calian employs health care professionals across Canada who are integral to supporting the health and wellbeing of our military members.

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

Calian is seeking a full-time Registered Practical Nurse to join the team at CFB Trenton. This is a rewarding position where you would make a difference in the lives of the men and women who serve our country and keep us safe.

The position is on a full-time, temporary basis, covering a short maternity leave until the end of the year. It requires 37.5 hours per week, with a standard schedule of 7.5 hours per day during clinic operational hours, Monday to Friday.

## Responsibilities

• Perform triage assessments of patients during walk-in hours and patient assessments, which include medical or incident history, physical examinations, vitals signs measurement, and vision acuity testing

• Perform nursing interventions such as taking vital signs, applying aseptic techniques such as sterile dressing and ensuring infection control, and conducting specimen collection

• Developing a nursing care plan based on the result of the assessments, communicating any changes or abnormal findings of the patients’ condition or status, and referring to a physician or other health care provider as required

• Administering medications as per doctor’s orders and provincial scope pf practice while observing and documenting therapeutic effects, assist in treatments and procedures with physicians or other health care providers

• Perform therapeutic injections and wound care, administer and monitor established respiratory therapy and IV therapy, and prepare patients for minor surgery procedures

• Provide health education to patients including pre-operative and post-operative patient teaching such as clinical and procedural instructions and comfort care

• Perform administrative tasks such as written or telephone responses to patient queries, preparation of medical files for physicians or other health care providers, and return of the medical files to the health record department

• Monitor all medical supplies and inventory including ordering and replenishing

• Clean all patient care areas between patients, and clean, sterilize, and package surgical instruments

## Qualifications

• Graduate from a Practical Nursing Program and licensed and in good standing as a Registered Practical Nurse with the College of Nurses of Ontario

• Current BLS for Heath Provider or CPR Level C Certification

• 1 year of full-time experience in the last 3 years in nursing practice conducting patient assessment and providing direct nursing care for a broad range of diseases in an adult population in a primary care setting or ambulatory care setting

Pay reate: $35-$40/hr

## Additional Requirements

• You must be able to obtain a Government of Canada Security Clearance (Enhanced Reliability)

## Senior Geotechnical Applications Engineer

## Edmonton, Alberta | Hybrid

## Impact of this Role

As a Senior Geotechnical Applications Engineer with Xerxes, you will be a key technical resource supporting the application, installation, and field performance of underground storage tank systems. Your civil and geotechnical expertise will help ensure site-specific applications are technically sound, installation risks are understood, and customers and internal teams receive clear, practical engineering guidance.

You will influence decisions across Applications Engineering, Product Engineering, Operations, Sales, Quality, and Field Service while also representing Xerxes in technical engagement with standards organizations, regulators, listing agencies, and other external technical bodies. Your work will help translate site conditions, field experience, regulatory requirements, and engineering analysis into better technical decisions and a consistent customer experience.

## What Success Looks Like

• Review site-specific underground tank applications and confidently evaluate burial depth, groundwater conditions, surface and traffic loads, site constraints, anchoring requirements, and other installation parameters against Xerxes requirements and applicable standards.

• Prepare, review, and approve buoyancy, anchoring, soil, and backfill analyses, applying civil and geotechnical engineering principles to assess groundwater, shoring, load distribution, excavation geometry, foundation support, and installation risks.

• Provide clear and timely technical recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders, including support for complex or highly customized installations.

• Lead field investigations and root cause failure analyses, own the technical outcome, document findings, and develop practical corrective and preventive recommendations in partnership with Quality, Product Engineering, Operations, and Field Service.

• Lead Xerxes technical engagement with standards organizations, listing agencies, regulators, and authorities having jurisdiction, communicating changes, interpretations, and emerging requirements to Engineering and Operations.

• Independently manage and prioritize technical requests through the customer support process, balancing customer expectations, business priorities, technical risk, and established service expectations while maintaining clear and traceable documentation.

• Identify recurring issues and turn lessons learned into improved guidance, procedures, training, and continuous improvement actions that strengthen the quality and consistency of Applications Engineering support.

## What You Bring to the Role

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline. Graduate education in Geotechnical Engineering is preferred.

• At least 7 years of relevant experience, with more than 10 years preferred.

• Professional Engineer registration.

• Demonstrated civil and geotechnical engineering experience involving soil behavior, backfill, groundwater, buried structures, foundations, buoyancy, anchoring, load distribution, and site-specific installation assessment.

• Strong understanding of underground structures. Experience with underground storage tanks, fiber-reinforced polymer products, water and wastewater infrastructure, fuel systems, or other buried infrastructure is strongly preferred.

• Experience interpreting and applying engineering codes, industry standards, product listings, and regulatory requirements, including engagement with regulatory bodies and authorities having jurisdiction.

• Demonstrated experience leading field investigations, failure and root cause analysis, technical reporting, and the development of corrective and preventive actions.

• Strong technical judgment, prioritization, stakeholder management, and customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain complex engineering requirements to technical and non-technical audiences.

• The ability to work proactively and independently while collaborating respectfully within an established team and influencing change tactfully.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Excel, Outlook, and Word. Experience with customer support portals, enterprise resource planning systems, and engineering calculation or analysis tools is advantageous.

• Ability to travel to customer sites, manufacturing facilities, and industry or regulatory meetings as required.

## Why Join Mattr

• Flexible health, dental & vision benefits with HSA rollover

• Employer-paid Life, AD&D, and Disability insurance

• Attractive incentive bonus plans

• 24/7 Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP)

• Wellness and mental health support programs

• Exclusive discounts (Perkopolis & GoodLife Fitness)

Are you interested in wireless technology and curious about how 5G networks connect millions of people? Join our RAN System Verification Test Area Capacity team and contribute to testing and improving the performance and capacity of Ericsson's 5G solutions, while gaining exposure to emerging 6G technologies.

This role is well suited to recent graduates and early-career professionals looking to build expertise in telecommunications, software, testing, data analysis, or systems engineering. No prior deep knowledge of 5G or RAN is required — we welcome people who are curious, enjoy problem-solving, and want to grow within a collaborative engineering team. • Investigate problems collaboratively with experienced engineers and development teams

• Learn to use network test equipment, simulators, logs, traces, and analysis tools

• Contribute to test automation and explore how Python, Java, data analytics, and AI can improve verification efficiency

• Collaborate with colleagues across verification, software development, integration, and customer teams

• Build expertise in 5G while gaining exposure to 6G, Cloud RAN, automation, and AI-assisted engineering

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

• An interest in wireless communications, 5G/6G, networking, software, testing, automation, or data analysis

• A curious mindset and willingness to learn new technologies

• Analytical thinking and an interest in understanding how complex systems behave

• Basic programming or scripting knowledge (e.g., Python), or a genuine interest in developing these skills

• Strong communication and teamwork skills

• An ability to collaborate with people from diverse technical and cultural backgrounds

• Proficiency in Linux and Git (required)

• Exposure to any of the following is an asset: LTE/5G, test automation, data analysis, AI/ML, Wireshark, cloud technologies, containers, or Kubernetes.

This role offers an opportunity to develop practical expertise in:

Market Insights - Stay informed on trends impacting restaurants, including labor challenges, margin pressure, loss prevention, technology adoption, off-premise ordering, and operational efficiency. - Serve as a strategic voice for the restaurant vertical by identifying emerging trends, influencing cross-functional priorities, and helping shape Solink’s long-term growth strategy within the industry. - Maintain a strong understanding of restaurant technology ecosystems, including POS, video security, payments, workforce tools, and operational platforms. WHAT YOU BRING Restaurant Industry Expertise - Experience selling into restaurants, ideally across QSR, fast casual, casual dining, or multi-unit franchise environments. - Strong understanding of franchise models, multi-unit operations, and how restaurant buying decisions are made. Enterprise Sales Experience - 5+ years of success in B2B enterprise sales, preferably in SaaS, restaurant technology, security, POS, payments, loss prevention, or operations technology. - Proven track record of exceeding quota and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals. - Experience managing long sales cycles, pilots, procurement, legal review, and executive negotiations. - Ability to build strategic account plans and move large opportunities from prospecting to close. Relationship Builder - Strong existing network within the restaurant industry. - Confident building trust with C-level executives, owners, operators, and functional leaders. - Skilled at turning relationships into qualified opportunities and long-term account growth. - Comfortable using industry events, referrals, and partner relationships to create momentum. Strategic & Commercially Minded - Strong ability to identify high-potential accounts and understand where buying power sits. - Comfortable navigating franchisor, franchisee, corporate, and private-equity-backed restaurant structures. - Skilled at building ROI-driven business cases and aligning Solink to customer priorities. - Disciplined in qualification, forecasting, follow-up, and deal management. Driven & Accountable - Competitive, self-motivated, and energized by building new business. - Consistent high performer with a desire to be at the top of the leaderboard. - Comfortable with travel for customer meetings, industry events, and strategic deal support. - Coachable, collaborative, and committed to continuous improvement. - Share industry expertise, enterprise selling strategies, and market insights with peers to strengthen team performance and contribute to the success of the broader sales organization. Tool-Enabled & Process-Savvy - Uses data, call review, account research, AI-powered tools, and sales process to continuously improve performance and effectiveness. - Experience using tools like SalesForce, Gong, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and sales enablement platforms. - Strong pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, and clear next-step discipline. - Uses data, call review, account research, and sales process to improve performance. NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling to large franchisee groups or multi-brand restaurant operators. - Existing relationships with QSR, fast casual, or casual dining brands. - Experience selling security, video, POS, payments, loss prevention, workforce management, or operations technology. - Familiarity with restaurant conferences, associations, franchise groups, or industry events. - Experience selling into organizations with hundreds or thousands of locations. TARGET CRUSHER - You don’t just meet goals — you aim for President’s Club every year. - You are motivated by winning, energized by strategic enterprise sales, and excited by the opportunity to help Solink become the leading video intelligence platform for the restaurant industry. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire; - Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada; - Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards. Just outcomes, built together. - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care. These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow. WHY SOLINK? At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this crucial role, you will act as the subject matter expert and process owner for the assigned heat treatment process area or areas while collaborating with manufacturing, welding, tooling and quality engineers and project management who own product delivery. Your responsibilities will include providing daily engineering support and ensuring compliance with contract requirements and technical procedures through training, process audits, process improvements, procedures, work instructions, and drawings. This position also offers the opportunity to take on special assignments as deemed necessary, making it an excellent opportunity to further enhance your engineering career in a collaborative environment.

## Location:

On-site in Mount Vernon, Indiana

## Your Day to Day as a Manufacturing Engineer:

• • Serve as the primary point of contact and provide daily engineering support to the operations team

• Ensure that all BWXT heat treatment procedures, work instructions and furnace thermocouple layouts comply with customer requirements and update these documents as required

• Monitor quality performance for heat treatment process areas

• Conduct continuous improvement activities for heat treatment process areas

• Lead readiness and startup activities for new equipment installation and post maintenance return to service for heat treatment process areas

• Lead implementation of new technology or First of a Kind Activities (FOAK) where applicable for heat treatment process areas

• Develop or improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) or Work Instructions for assigned heat treatment process areas

• Support Operator Training Development for heat treatment process areas

## Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Nuclear, Civil or Welding Engineering; Mechanical or Nuclear Engineering Technology; Physics or Engineering Physics. Degrees from ABET-accredited programs are preferred.

• The ability to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance is required

• US Citizenship is required.

• Two or more years engineering experience required

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience providing engineering support in a heavy manufacturing environment.

• Prior process ownership

• Proficiency with Autocad or Autocad lite for 2-D sketch generation

• Lean / OpEx Kaizen/DMAIC training is desired

• Proficiency in MS Office

• Familiarity with SAP preferred

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

Pay: $76,000 - $119,000.00

The base salary range for this position in Indiana (US-IN) at the start of employment is expected to be between $76,000 and $119,000.00 per year. However, the base salary offered is based on local job market factors, and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to these considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, such as an annual cash incentive in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and/or other benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided at such time the selected job candidate receives an offer of employment. If hired, the selected job candidate will be employed 'at-will,’ unless employed at a location and in a position subject to a collective bargaining agreement. Position Title: FPGA Designer

Employment Type: Full-time, Existing vacancy

Location: Ottawa (On-Site)

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## Why You’ll Love This Role

At Lumentum, we are searching for Canada’s brightest young minds engineers and innovators who want to build the next generation of optical technology. If you are driven by curiosity, eager to solve real-world challenges, and excited about developing groundbreaking optical systems, this is your opportunity.

Join us in designing the future of optical cloud & networking technology our advanced photonic modules power the world’s voice and internet traffic, and we need your expertise to take them to the next level. This is not just another job; this is your chance to define & design what’s next in photonics.

## What You’ll Be Doing

While the primary focus of this role is FPGA design, you will also support simulation and lab testing activities to ensure comprehensive design validation.

In addition to working closely with the rest of the FPGA team, you will collaborate with other R&D engineering groups, including hardware, firmware, algorithms, and product verification.

• FPGA design: Implementation of control and datapath logic. IP core configuration and integration.

• Verification: Support test plan creation & simulation environment development. Assist with debugging activities. Review coverage reports and provide guidance to improve simulation coverage.

• Lab validation & debugging: Collaborate with hardware and firmware engineers for cross-functional integration and lab validation to ensure system-level performance goals are met. Develop and execute scripts for automated testing.

• Synthesis & optimization: Constraints implementation and optimization, thorough analysis of build and timing reports to ensure robustness.

• Documentation: Create and maintain high-quality design and test documentation, contributing to project knowledge bases and future reference.

## What We’re Looking For

## Required Qualifications:

• Experience in ASIC or FPGA design and simulation using Verilog/SystemVerilog

• Experience with synthesis, constraints, timing analysis, clock domain crossing.

• Experience with AMD(Xilinx) or Altera FPGAs and tools.

• Collaborative team player who works effectively with cross-functional groups and contributes to multi-designer projects.

• Clear, robust, and well commented coding style.

• Problem solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.

• Thorough and detail-oriented approach.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

## Assets:

• Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions, advanced verification methodologies, and coverage analysis.

• Experience with embedded processor SoC design

• Experience with PCIe, DDR memory, and AXI interfaces

• Knowledge of digital signal processing concepts

• Familiarity with VHDL, C, Csh, Tcl, Python, Perl

• Experience developing in a Linux environment

## Perks You’ll Love

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

## Salary Range: $93,400 - $133,400 CAD (flexible).

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In line with our commitment to being a great place to work, Lumentum offers competitive total rewards which may include annual bonus, equity, and comprehensive health and welfare benefits.

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

## Job Description

How You Will Contribute:
At Ciena, we are at the forefront of the telecommunications industry, and our Wavelogic modem family of products plays a crucial role in our success. As a Digital Verification Engineer (FEC), you will be an integral part of a team responsible for implementing innovative verification strategies in order to thoroughly simulate and validate functional blocks and subsystems for Ciena’s Forward Error Correction (FEC) IP. Reporting to the ASIC Senior Manager, you will collaborate with a team of Digital Design Engineers, Verification Engineers, and Architects to simulate and validate functional blocks and subsystems.

## Responsibilities:

• Read and understand the FEC architecture and functional requirements specification document(s) and communicate and collaborate with FEC designers, DSP modelers, FEC verifiers, systems engineers and architects.

• You will be responsible for developing verification, functional coverage and formal verification test plans.

• Thoroughly validate one or more architectural FEC functional blocks using a combination of simulation, formal, and coverage methods.

• Create testbench environments and components, agents, scoreboard, and test scenarios using System Verilog UVM and C++.

• Perform coverage-driven verification, monitor regressions, and debug failures with the support of the function's designer.

• Provide status updates on verification progress on a regular basis and communicate risks as needed.

• Mentor and supervise junior verification engineers requiring robust understanding of team outputs to foster peers’ technical and professional growth

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and effectively influence stakeholders

• We expect you to have:
• Detail-oriented – Deliver on objectives through meticulous, thorough, and comprehensive work.

• Problem solver – Analyze and solve complex technical problems using engineering principles.

• Commitment to learning – Keep abreast of technology developments and are keen to share your knowledge with others.

## The Must Haves:

• 10+ years of experience in verification.

• Minimum Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Computer or Software Engineering.

• Significant experience in using C/C++, System Verilog, UVM, SVA, and simulators from major vendors.

• Proven ability to determine comprehensive digital verification and coverage strategies

• Proven ability to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team via demonstrated leadership and communication capabilities

• Strong decision-making skills with the ability to analyze complex situations, evaluate options and implement effective solutions to meet deliverables.

## Assets:

• Experience with formal verification methods.

• Strong background in Forward Error Correction (FEC) and/or DSP.

• Familiarity with programming languages such as: Python, Make, bash, object-oriented programming, C, C++.

• Proficiency in bug tracking using Jira and source code management and revision tracking using GIT.

• Previous experience leading a team.

• Previous experience mentoring.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

We are hiring a business-minded Senior Corporate Counsel to join Solace's growing Legal team and own our corporate legal affairs. You will manage governance for the parent company and its international subsidiaries, support board and executive activity, and help build our corporate compliance practices.

You will be a key member of our Legal team and work closely with the Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary and with external counsel on complex and often strategic matters. This is a hands-on, senior legal role. You will advise on today’s and tomorrow’s corporate legal strategy and recommend where to build in-house capability and where to lean on outside counsel.

What You’ll Do

Corporate Governance and Corporate Affairs

• Own day-to-day corporate governance, statutory compliance and corporate records for the parent company and its domestic and international subsidiaries.

• Prepare and coordinate board and committee materials, including agendas, resolutions, minutes and written consents.

• Maintain minute books, registers and statutory records. Oversee annual filings, director and officer appointments and changes to corporate structure.

• Manage corporate service providers and local counsel across jurisdictions.

• Support the formation of new subsidiaries and advise on the legal requirements of entering new jurisdictions, working with local counsel.

• Handle ownership, beneficial ownership and KYC requests from banks, landlords and other counterparties.

• Own and manage Solace’s compliance calendar and work cross-functionally to meet compliance requirements.

• Manage Solace’s insurance program (including renewals) and office leases, and support Finance on tax planning, financial statements, and employee equity program.

Corporate Transactions and Strategic Initiatives

• Support reorganizations, acquisitions, divestitures, financings and other strategic initiatives.

• Run corporate due diligence. Keep records transaction-ready, organize diligence materials and coordinate with internal teams and external counsel.

• Prepare and review transaction resolutions, approvals and consents.

• Advise on securities law requirements for private financings and employee equity grants, with external counsel as needed.

Compliance and Risk Management

• Develop, maintain and improve corporate policies, procedures and internal guidance.

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments and assess what they mean for the business.

• Work with Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, and other teams to identify and address compliance risks.

• Support compliance reviews and reporting. Develop and deliver compliance training for employees.

• Escalate material legal and compliance risks with practical recommendations.

General Legal and Business Support

• Give practical legal advice on corporate and operational matters.

• Manage external counsel, including instructions, scope and cost.

• Provide support on HR and other legal matters as needed.

• Keep the senior leadership team informed of significant developments, emerging risks and material compliance issues.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• LL.B. or J.D., and membership in good standing with the Law Society of Ontario.

• 10+ years of corporate law experience in private practice, in-house or both.

• Strong knowledge of corporate law, corporate governance and statutory compliance.

• Working knowledge of securities law as it applies to private company financings and equity plans.

• Hands-on experience with subsidiary governance, board documentation and ongoing corporate obligations.

• Experience supporting reorganizations, financings, acquisitions or similar transactions.

• Strong drafting, analytical and project management skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and see matters through with minimal supervision.

• Clear communicator who can explain legal requirements to non-lawyers and recommend practical solutions.

• Sound judgment on when to escalate or bring in specialist advice.

Nice to Have Skills

• Experience with international subsidiaries or multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience in compliance, regulatory or risk management frameworks and programs, including export controls and trade compliance.

• Experience with employment law and advising on HR matters.

• Experience in a technology company or other complex corporate environment.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

Role Status: NEW

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Design, code, secure and evolve cloud-native platforms across Azure, GCP, AWS and hybrid environments. Build platform capabilities with Terraform, Kubernetes, GitOps and software engineering—and actively advance agentic platform development, from AI-assisted design and code creation to reusable agents and tool-integrated engineering workflows. Security, compliance and operational rigor are integral to delivery. Thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like engineering environment with rapid delivery, high ownership, hands-on problem solving and disciplined production quality.

## What you will build

• Design and implement reusable Terraform modules, cloud landing-zone components, provisioning and lifecycle workflows across Azure, GCP and AWS; engineer resilient multi-region and dedicated-instance patterns.

• Build and maintain production Kubernetes foundations: clusters, node pools, networking, autoscaling, storage, workload identity, capacity, upgrades and recovery.

• Develop GitOps delivery platforms using Argo CD, Helm, GitHub Actions and automated validation, promotion, rollback and drift detection.

• Own platform services and their integration: Istio/service mesh, Keycloak/OIDC, cert-manager/PKI, API gateways, ingress/egress, DNS, secrets management and cloud-native networking.

• Engineer private networking, routing, firewall policy, WAF, VPN/private interconnect, TLS/mTLS, segmentation, load balancing and end-to-end connectivity troubleshooting.

• Codify zero-trust and least-privilege controls across identities, workloads, environments, networks, secrets, administrative access and service-to-service communication.

• Design and automate technical safeguards, traceable changes, evidence capture, continuous monitoring, vulnerability response and environment separation supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS and SOC 2 requirements. Partner with GRC/Security to map implementations to applicable control obligations; do not equate platform features with certification or authorization.

• Engineer the observability stack end to end using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy and OpenTelemetry: metrics collection, long-term retention, centralized logs, alerting, dashboards, telemetry pipelines, capacity signals and incident diagnostics.

• Deploy, scale, tune, secure and troubleshoot stateful platform components—including Kafka, Redis, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MariaDB) and document databases (e.g., MongoDB)—covering operators, persistence, replication, backup/restore, upgrades, availability, throughput and recovery.

• Own secure API gateway and ingress architecture: authentication and authorization, TLS termination, rate limiting, routing, API lifecycle integration, firewall/WAF policy, and service-mesh connectivity.

• Develop platform tooling in Python, Go or Bash; eliminate recurring operational toil with durable engineering fixes and self-service capabilities.

• Develop and integrate agentic platform-development capabilities—not just production-operations agents—including AI-assisted Terraform/module and Helm/chart authoring, platform API and controller development, architecture analysis, code review, test generation, infrastructure-plan validation, safe change proposals, developer-facing tools, and reusable agent workflows integrated with GitOps/CI/CD.

• Use and extend agentic development workflows across the full engineering lifecycle—architecture exploration, Terraform/Helm authoring, code reviews, automated tests, environment validation, pull requests and release readiness—not only production diagnosis and remediation.

## ## About The Requirements

## Required experience

• 8+ years in software, cloud, DevOps/SRE or platform engineering, with substantial hands-on design and implementation.

• Advanced Terraform and Kubernetes skills; production experience with Argo CD, GitOps, Helm and CI/CD.

• Deep experience with Azure plus GCP or AWS; ability to transfer architecture patterns across cloud providers.

• Strong Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, PKI, routing, firewall, IAM/RBAC and distributed-system troubleshooting.

• Hands-on with several platform components such as Istio, Keycloak, cert-manager, API gateways and secrets management, with ability to learn the others.

• Practical deployment, scaling, hardening and operational troubleshooting of Kafka, Redis and relational/document databases in Kubernetes or managed cloud services; experience with API gateways and secure API exposure.

• Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy or equivalent metrics/logging pipelines, including cardinality, retention, alert quality and production troubleshooting.

• Demonstrated experience implementing security controls in regulated environments and supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS, SOC 2 or comparably rigorous programs.

• Coding ability in Python, Go or equivalent; evidence of shipping automation and reusable engineering components.

• Ability to reason from application behavior through cluster, identity, certificate, network and cloud dependencies.

• Demonstrated ownership in a fast-paced, startup-like environment: rapid iteration, shifting priorities, independently driving work to production and balancing speed with security and reliability.

• Compliance-as-code, automated audit evidence, policy engines, vulnerability scanning and supply-chain security.

• Hands-on experience building or extending agentic development workflows, agent tool integrations or shared engineering capabilities for infrastructure and Kubernetes—not only using AI coding assistants.

• Deliver reusable cloud/Kubernetes capabilities that reduce custom environment work and deployment variability.

• Remove material gaps in security posture and make evidence collection and drift detection more repeatable.

• Improve deployment safety, platform upgradeability and production diagnostics with measurable outcomes.

• Build or substantially improve deployment, resilience, scaling and observability for Kafka, Redis, relational and document databases and gateway services; reduce operational bottlenecks.

• Build and share agentic platform-development workflows that help engineers design, implement, test and evolve secure infrastructure faster, with measurable quality and review controls.

• Flow and metrics literacy; demonstrated continuous-improvement follow-through

• Strong stakeholder communication and conflict navigation under delivery pressure

• Comfort using AI tools to support facilitation and metrics prep, with human accountability for decisions and board accuracy

• Predictable flow with consistent throughput and minimal blocked work

• Trustworthy, current Jira/Zephyr data

• Continuous improvement that is visible and actionable

• Sprint objectives supported through strong process facilitation — without the SM becoming a task manager, delivery owner, or people manager

• Continuous Improvement: Improve CI/CD release automation, runbooks, and documentation—leveraging AI tools to accelerate workflows while maintaining human judgment.

• Individual Contributor: Direct focus on coordination and execution with no people management duties.

• Follow-the-Sun Support: Paired with a stateside Release Manager to maintain near 24-hour coverage.

• Cross-Functional Orchestrator: Coordinates delivery across Product Managers, Delivery Leads, Tech Leads, CloudOps, Support, QA, and Security without directly managing the development teams.

## ## What You’ll Bring

• Experience: Strong background in DevOps, release management, or engineering operations managing multi-stream release calendars (cycles, service packs, hotfixes).

• Communication & AI: Strong written and verbal communication for asynchronous team handoffs, and comfort using AI-assisted productivity tools (e.g., Cursor).

• Experience with enterprise communications or high-availability software platforms (e.g., Avaya or similar contact-center/UC platforms) - (Nice to have)

• Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM), Azure Monitor, ITIL/CAB experience.

• Scripting capability in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

• Collision-Free Cadence: Mid/End-Cycle and Service Pack release trains remain consistently on schedule.

• Rapid Remediation: Urgent hotfixes ship rapidly without breaking planned release trains.

• Low Risk: Deployments are auditable, low-risk, and well-communicated to operations and support teams.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/820.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

This position is for a Senior Technical Writer in a highly technical role. You'll write and deliver documentation for docs.solace.com that's closely aligned with developer documentation: APIs, configuration references, and procedures for engineers and developers. You're expected to read code and to use AI-assisted coding or automation in your work. You'll represent customers in conversations with engineering and help define how we write content for AI agents while keeping it clear for human readers.

We're looking for a systems thinker with opinionated product taste and real command of the technical writing craft: someone who blends traditional writing with AI-native techniques and solves documentation problems at scale, not one page at a time.

What You’ll Do

Content

• Create and modify existing customer-facing documentation for Solace event brokers, Solace Agent Mesh, APIs, and other Solace products.

• Deliver documentation on the release schedule to docs.solace.com in MadCap Flare (XML) and Markdown.

• Ensure content provides a positive experience for both human readers and AI agents.

• Collaborate with content providers and senior members of the writing team to update, revise, reorganize, and restructure existing documentation.

• Improve the style guide with the writing team and enforce it through automated checks and guardrails including contributions to quality metrics.

Product and Engineering Enablement

• Interview PLM/POs, SMEs, and contributors to understand features and fill knowledge gaps, and verify details against the source code.

• Work closely with product management, UX, and architecture teams to ensure information is presented in a clear, user-friendly manner.

• Mentor and train writers and other documentation contributors, including guiding developers on how to structure their documentation for reusability and clarity.

AI and Documentation Systems

• Use AI daily in content development and engineering workflows, including drafting new topics where the content suits it.

• Use AI-assisted coding or automation to build scripts and tools that solve content problems at scale.

• Help shape the structure and navigation of docs.solace.com to align with SEO and AEO best practices.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 7+ years writing technical documentation for software/cloud products with delivery in an Agile environment.

• Experience defining editorial standards or site structure for a large documentation set.

• Hands-on experience to set up environments and configure features, with working knowledge of IP networking and operating systems, enterprise software (installation, configuration, administration and API) to ensure accurate documentation.

• Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to converse with engineers and sort through complex information. This includes the ability to read and review code.

• A track record of scaling documentation through templates, reuse, contributor guidelines, or automation. Experience writing AI prompts or skills that improve a content workflow.

• Docs-as-code Git, GitHub, pull requests, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

Role Status: EXISTING

Expected Salary Range: Expected salary range for this role is from $100,000 to $130,000 per year. The final offer within this range will reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience.

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Lumentum Canada was awarded the 2022 National Capital Region’s Top Employers for the 6th consecutive year and the 2022 Career Directory Canada’s Best Employers for Recent Graduates for the 5th consecutive year.

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## Why You’ll Love This Role

Lumentum is developing the next generation of Optical Circuit Switch (OCS) platforms for optical networks. We are looking for a hands-on senior developer to take technical ownership of embedded Linux application software from design through implementation, integration, and verification. You will work closely with software, hardware, systems, and verification teams to deliver reliable products used in demanding optical networking environments.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Own the design and implementation of embedded application software for OCS product features, including technical decisions for assigned components.

• Work with multidisciplinary teams to define requirements, author and review designs. Plan and execute implementation.

• Develop, maintain, and review production code and unit/integration tests; support integration and system verification.

• Investigate software issues on target hardware using logs, debugging tools, and collaboration with hardware and verification teams.

• Review code and designs, communicate technical risks and trade-offs, and guide less experienced developers.

## What We’re Looking For

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

## Experience:
Core Requirements:

• At least 4 years of hands-on embedded C/C++ development on Linux for Arm and/or x86 platforms, with demonstrated ability to design and deliver software independently.

• Solid understanding of multithreaded software design, source control using Git, and systematic troubleshooting and debugging.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working across software and hardware teams.

• Hardware-facing development or lab debugging using interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, UART, ADCs, or DACs; JTAG debugging and schematic reading

• Embedded Linux build and development tools such as Yocto, cross-compilation, Python, Go, or shell scripting.

## Skills:

• Linux networking or network management software, including experience with one or more of SONiC, OpenConfig, YANG, gNMI, gNOI, SNMP, or NETCONF.

• Distributed or service-based software using technologies such as Redis, Docker, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers.

## Perks You’ll Love

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is $115,000 - $145,000

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In line with our commitment to being a great place to work, Lumentum offers competitive total rewards which may include annual bonus, equity, and comprehensive health and welfare benefits.

## Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.
