## Senior Accounting Analyst

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do
As a Senior Accounting Analyst, you will help safeguard the integrity of financial information for the Bank of Canada, its pension trust funds, and the Government of Canada domestic debt and foreign asset portfolios. You will take ownership of complex accounting and reporting matters, apply professional judgment, and connect activities across the Bank to their accounting and financial reporting impacts to understand and explain the Bank’s overall financial position and the underlying business, market and policy drivers.

Working under the general direction of a Senior Manager in Accounting Operations, you will serve as a senior subject-matter resource with a broad understanding of how activities across the Bank flow through financial systems, accounting processes and reporting. You will strengthen controls, resolve complex or non-standard issues, identify broader impacts and dependencies, and shape improvements to accounting processes, systems and reporting.

Specifically, you will:

• Own financial analysis and reporting. Lead the oversight and analysis of significant balances, transactions, estimates and variances; challenge assumptions and data quality, assess whether results are reasonable and complete; and connect balance sheet movements to the underlying activities, decisions and drivers across the Bank.

• Exercise accounting judgment. Research and assess complex or non-standard transactions, recommend appropriate treatment under IFRS, PSAS and Bank policies, and consider the impacts across financial statement line items, systems and reporting processes when developing and documenting conclusions.

• Safeguard financial control and account integrity. Oversee key reconciliations and controls; assess material or persistent differences, determine appropriate resolution or escalation, and identify issues or dependencies that could affect the completeness, accuracy and integrity of financial information.

• Lead the resolution of complex accounting and operational issues. Investigate issues spanning Bank operations, accounting processes and systems, identify root causes and downstream financial impacts, and work with internal and external partners to implement sustainable solutions.

• Drive modernization and continuous improvement. Identify opportunities, define accounting and business requirements, and support the design, testing and implementation of process and system changes, including assessing broader accounting, system and financial reporting impacts and dependencies across the Bank.

• Develop and maintain accounting documentation. Maintain documentation of key accounting procedures, business rules and system integrations, ensuring it reflects procedural and system changes and preserves critical accounting knowledge.

• Provide expertise, guidance and advice. Act as a senior subject-matter resource to colleagues and stakeholders, bringing a broad understanding of the Bank’s activities and their accounting and financial reporting implications to complex issues, providing technical guidance and coaching, and representing Accounting Operations’ requirements and perspectives.

## What you need to succeed

We are looking for someone who:

• Demonstrates strong analytical skills and professional judgment, with the ability to assess complex issues, challenge assumptions, evaluate risk and materiality, draw sound conclusions, and recommend practical solutions.

• Demonstrates strong data literacy, using financial systems, analytical tools and structured data to evaluate results, identify relationships and trends, and support decision-making.

• Has strong and broad accounting knowledge and experience, including accounting operations, financial close and reporting, reconciliations, internal controls, and the practical application of IFRS and/or PSAS, with the ability to understand significant financial statement line items and the activities across the Bank that drive them.

• Thinks beyond individual accounts and processes, understanding how Bank activities, transactions, financial statement line items, systems and accounting processes are interconnected, and assessing the broader financial reporting implications of changes, issues and decisions.

• Works independently and demonstrates initiative, proactively identifying issues, seeking the right information, managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work within established timelines.
Communicates complex information clearly and effectively, using strong listening skills and adapting accounting, financial and system information for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Builds strong collaborative relationships, bringing together different perspectives, providing constructive challenge and influencing stakeholders to resolve issues and achieve shared outcomes.

• Builds capability and improves ways of working, sharing expertise, providing technical guidance and coaching, and identifying opportunities to strengthen processes, systems and team knowledge.

## Nice to have

• Experience in accounting operations or financial reporting within a financial institution, central bank, investment organization or similarly complex environment.

• Knowledge of financial instruments, including valuation, amortization, income recognition, foreign exchange and related accounting considerations.

• Experience with SAP, Blackline, portfolio or custody platforms, and data analytics or visualization tools such as Microsoft Fabric or Power BI.

• Experience assessing and documenting internal controls and supporting internal or external audits.

• Experience supporting significant system or business change, including business requirements, user acceptance testing and implementation.

Your education and experience
This position requires a CPA designation in good standing, a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration or a related field, with at least five years of relevant experience in accounting operations, financial close, financial reporting or a comparable environment. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## About the Payments and Regulatory Oversight Department

The payments landscape in Canada and globally is evolving rapidly, driven by technological advancements that are introducing innovative ways for consumers and businesses to make payments. Under the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), the Bank of Canada is responsible for registering retail payment service providers (PSPs) that perform retail payment activities, maintaining a public registry of PSPs, and supervising PSPs’ compliance with operational risk management, fund safeguarding and reporting requirements.

## What you will do

As a Senior Supervisor in the Risk Supervision team, you will play a crucial role in shaping the Bank’s retail payments supervisory framework in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Being at the forefront of Canada’s rapidly evolving payments landscape, you will strengthen resilience and help protect the integrity of the payments ecosystem.

You will apply your knowledge of cyber and information security risk management practices to help implement the Bank’s framework for PSP supervision, and assess the compliance of PSPs with their regulatory obligations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Assessing PSPs' cyber and information security risks,vulnerabilities, and control effectiveness

• Analyzing PSP reporting related to cyber and information security incidents

• Communicating with PSPs on ongoing risk assessment activities

• Collaborating with colleagues on supervisory assessments and actions

• Developing and maintaining business documentation and information repositories

• Contributing to the development of processes and policies to optimize the Bank’s approach to PSP risk supervision

## What you need to succeed

• Strong understanding of cyber security principles and risk management practices

• Knowledge of cyber defence mechanisms and industry best practices.

• Experience assessing, managing or supervising cybersecurity practices, ideally in regulatory , consulting or second or third line of defence roles.

• Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of IT and cyber risk including risk identification evaluation and mitigation.

• Understanding of risk management frameworks such as the NIST cybersecurity framework, ISO 27001 etc.

• Cybersecurity landscape awareness

• Regulatory compliance knowledge

• Cyber tools knowledge

You are able to synthesize complex information and provide high quality analysis while considering multiple factors and perspectives often within contexts of ambiguity and evolving information.

You are flexible and able to adapt to an evolving work environment and changing priorities. Furthermore, you are able to organize and balance a variety of tasks. You have a proven ability to communicate clearly and adapt your communication style for a wide range of audiences, including senior management and external stakeholders.

You are equally comfortable working collaboratively within a team, or independently. You develop and maintain harmonious relationships with a wide range of business contacts and build supportive working relationships with peers, your leader, as well as internal and external stakeholders.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, NSE, BSE, Airtel, HDFC, SBI , PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology and your hard work!

About the Role

As an Agentic AI Senior Consultant, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on builder, owning the successful design, implementation, and production adoption of agentic AI solutions built on Solace Agent Mesh and the Solace Platform in complex enterprise environments.

This role carries the same delivery ownership, autonomy, and customer leadership expectations as our Senior Consultant role, with a primary focus on agentic AI. You will work directly with customer engineering and business teams to identify high-value agentic use cases, design multi-agent architectures, and write the code that takes them from pilot to production. Just as the SDLC anchors software delivery, the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) anchors how you build, evaluate, release, and operate agents. You will combine deep software engineering skills, applied AI expertise, and a strong grounding in event-driven architecture to deliver agentic systems that are secure, observable, governed, and built to scale.

What You’ll Do

• Own the post-sales technical success of customers’ agentic AI initiatives, from use case discovery and solution design through build, production rollout, steady-state operations, and ongoing advisory services

• Lead use case discovery and prioritization workshops that translate customer business goals into realistic, measurable agentic workflows

• Design and build multi-agent solutions with Solace Agent Mesh, including agent decomposition, orchestration and delegation patterns, tool design, memory and state management, and human-in-the-loop controls

• Write, review, and troubleshoot production-quality code in Go (our preferred language, in which Solace Agent Mesh is built) or Python where customer requirements call for it, for agents, tools, plugins, and integrations, and deploy them on Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms

• Connect agents to customer systems and data using MCP servers, A2A protocol, REST APIs, and event-driven integration through the Solace event mesh, bridging AI with existing enterprise applications and legacy platforms

• Implement retrieval and context strategies (RAG, vector stores, knowledge bases, and real-time event context) so agents have the right information at the right time

• Apply the ADLC end to end to move solutions from prototype to production, including requirements and design, evaluation pipelines, testing, versioning, release management, monitoring, and operational runbooks

• Establish observability, guardrails, and governance for agentic systems, covering tracing, quality and accuracy evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control at the tool boundary, auditability, and responsible AI practices

• Advise customers on LLM selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, including prompt design, token and cost management, and model trade-offs

• Act as a long-term trusted advisor, proactively identifying new agentic use cases and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI adoption

• Deliver recurring technical reviews, health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned to customers’ annual planning cycles

• Enable customer engineering teams to understand, extend, and take ownership of the solutions you build through pairing, workshops, and high-quality documentation

• Codify field learnings into reusable patterns, reference implementations, accelerators, and best practices that make future engagements faster and raise delivery quality across Professional Services

• Represent the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering, sharing real-world feedback that shapes the Solace Agent Mesh roadmap

• Work closely with the Solace Agent Mesh engineering team, collaborating on complex customer issues, validating new capabilities in real customer environments, and contributing reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators back to the Solace Agent Mesh ecosystem

• Act as a technical leader and mentor, building agentic AI capability across the Professional Services team

• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, explaining AI trade-offs, risks, and value in plain language and managing expectations

• Travel as required based on customer needs (including occasional international travel)

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required Experience & Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in professional services, consulting, system integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development

• 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying LLM-based and agentic AI solutions, with at least one solution taken into production

• Proven experience applying a disciplined delivery lifecycle to agentic solutions (ADLC), with a strong foundation in SDLC practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management

• Strong proficiency in Go or Python, with Go strongly preferred

• Practical experience with multi-agent systems (task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making) and agent frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar

• Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including MCP and A2A protocols and designing APIs as agent tools

• Solid understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings and vector databases, prompt engineering, and context management

• Experience implementing AI evaluation, observability, and guardrails for LLM applications in enterprise environments

• Solid understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, and integration design patterns

• Hands-on experience deploying distributed systems on Cloud-based platforms and hyperscalers like AWS, Azure, or GCP, using Docker and Kubernetes

• Knowledge of enterprise security and identity patterns relevant to AI, such as OAuth 2.0, RBAC, secrets management, and data privacy

• Ability to work independently, lead customer engagements, and make sound technical decisions with minimal guidance in a fast-evolving technology space

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including running workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders

• Professional fluency in English and in Spanish or Italian (written and verbal)

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with Solace Agent Mesh or the Solace Platform

• Proficiency in both Go and Python

• Experience with messaging technologies such as Solace, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, or TIBCO

• Working knowledge of LLM platforms such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini/Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Foundry

• Experience with LLMOps/MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring

• Familiarity with AI governance and responsible AI frameworks and regulated-industry requirements (e.g., financial services, healthcare, public sector)

• Experience using AI-assisted and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and teaching these practices to others

• Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns

• Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Machine Learning or Generative AI, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer

• Prior experience creating workshop collateral, reference architectures, or technical content (blogs, talks, demos) on agentic AI

What Success Looks Like

• Customers move agentic AI solutions from pilot to production and realize measurable business value, not just successful demos

• Agentic systems you deliver follow the ADLC and are reliable, secure, observable, and governed, with clear evaluation criteria and operational ownership

• Customers view you as a trusted advisor on agentic AI and event-driven architecture, and bring you into their AI strategy and architecture decisions

• Customer teams are enabled to operate and extend the solutions independently after handover

• Proactive recommendations lead to new use cases, expanded adoption of Solace Agent Mesh, and broader use of the Solace Platform

• Risks around data access, security, cost, and model behavior are identified early and addressed before they affect delivery or production

• Strong customer relationships contribute to renewals, expansion, and long-term partnership

• Reusable agent patterns, accelerators, and ADLC assets are created and adopted across the Professional Services organization

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need
accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

We are seeking a Principal Engineer (Physical AI - System Modeling) to join the Pathfinding Studio within the Engineering Innovation Office. As a technical thought leader and principal contributor, you will define and lead research in foundation model training and fine-tuning, vision-language-action models, reinforcement learning, and generative models. You will lead multidisciplinary work spanning virtual system modeling, data curation, learning, perception, planning, control, and translation of research into hardware implementations. With broad latitude to define objectives and technical approaches, you will solve critical problems under uncertainty, guide long-term technology and intellectual property initiatives and deliver outcomes that influence multiple functions and future products.

## Responsibilities:

· Define the long-term Physical AI research direction and system architecture for humanoid and industrial robotics to guide next generation technology and product strategy.

· Identify emerging methods and lead foundation model training and fine-tuning, VLA development, reinforcement learning, and generative modeling, connecting perception, planning, control, and manipulation in end-to-end robotic systems.

· Architect, develop, and maintain virtual system world models including articulated hands and arms, sensors, robot dynamics, contact interactions, and environments.

· Own the technical architecture of Physical AI data curation pipelines, spanning simulation, synthetic data generation, real-world collection and teleoperation, multimodal synchronization, schemas, quality checks, dataset versioning, and reproducible training and evaluation.

· Lead imitation-learning, reinforcement-learning, domain-randomization, sim-to-real, and real-to-sim workflows; establish evaluation criteria, analyze failure modes, and resolve complex model and controller issues with limited information.

· Translate research into hardware implementations through algorithm–hardware co-design.

· Define and evaluate system-level performance and resource trade-offs to guide deployment decisions and long-term technical priorities.

· Mentor engineers and researchers across domains.

· Extensive relevant research and engineering experience, including 8 years of related experience with a Ph.D.

· Strong expertise in foundation model training and fine-tuning, vision-language-action models (VLAs), reinforcement learning, and generative and world models targeting Physical AI systems such as humanoids and industrial robotics.

· Strong background in mathematics, physics, and software engineering, with the ability to apply rigorous modeling, analysis, and engineering methods to complex robotic systems.

· Knowledge in Neuromorphic and in-memory computing and modeling will be considered an advantage.

· Knowledge with foundation model development and finetuning for specification to hardware generation (e.g., schematics, RTL) will be considered an advantage.

· Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, and similar physics-based simulation and virtual system modeling platforms.

· Deep expertise in robotics algorithms and system modeling, including kinematics, dynamics, perception, planning, control, grasping, manipulation, trajectory generation, and contact-rich interaction.

· Experience designing and implementing Physical AI data curation pipelines, including simulation and real-world data collection, teleoperation, synthetic data, multimodal data quality, and sim-to-real and real-to-sim workflows.

· Prior experience translating research into hardware implementations, including algorithm–hardware co-design and validation against system-level requirements.

· Experience in digital ASIC design and verification and in collaborating across research, system architecture, RTL design, and verification disciplines.

· Strong software development experience in Python and C/C++ using CPU- and GPU-based environments, version control, testing, and reproducible experimentation.

· Publications in reputed conference and journals related to robotics

· Demonstrated technical thought leadership and recognized expertise within the function and relevant external communities; ability to serve as a principal advisor, influence long-term technical strategy, and resolve critical multidisciplinary problems independently.

## Education:

Ph.D. in Robotics, Engineering Science, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field is the minimum educational requirement.

We are seeking a Staff Engineer (Physical AI - System Engineering) to join the Pathfinding Studio within the Engineering Innovation Office. In this role, you will develop and validate technologies related to Physical AI systems models and dataflow for humanoid and industrial robotics. The role combines hands-on design, virtual and hybrid system modeling, algorithm–hardware co-design, experimental validation, and cross-disciplinary collaboration to achieve project milestones.

## Responsibilities:

· Contribute to Physical AI related technology development for humanoid and industrial robotics, translating requirements into hardware, mechanical, compute, and software design choices.

· Design, prototype, integrate, and validate humanoid hardware and mechanical subsystems, including articulated hands and arms, actuator and sensor integration, and electromechanical interfaces.

· Develop and evaluate learning-based perception, planning, control, and manipulation workflows, including foundation models, vision-language-action models, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning as appropriate to project objectives.

· Develop and maintain virtual system models and robotics hardware and software infrastructure for the lab environment.

Job Family: Research and Development

## ## About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Lead AI Application Engineer to join our core AI team. This pivotal role will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying advanced Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI applications across high-throughput, real-time streaming environments . You are an engineer’s engineer, someone who spent years training, tuning, and deploying models at scale, and who has spearheaded Generative and Agentic AI over the last 3–4 years. This is an exceptional opportunity for an individual who thrives on building sophisticated, production-grade Autonomous AI systems and wants to make a significant impact.

## ## Key Responsibilities

## Technical Architecture & System Design

• Architect and operationalize end-to-end autonomous agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, dynamic tool-calling, reflection, planner-executor loops, and persistent state management).

• Design robust LLM runtime infrastructure, including hybrid retrieval architectures (Advanced RAG, graph-based context grounding, vector databases, re-rankers, semantic routing).

• Establish scalable evaluation, guardrail, and observability frameworks (latency optimization, cost governors, hallucinations/drift detection, alignment checks, red-teaming).

• Make high-stakes architectural decisions regarding model topologies (proprietary frontier models vs. distilled/fine-tuned SLMs, LoRA, quantization, self-hosted vs. managed endpoints).

##

## Hands-On Execution & Prototyping

• Lead from the front: write high-leverage production code, design critical framework primitives, and rapidly de-risk zero-to-one concepts via functional PoCs.

• Bridge cutting-edge research and production engineering, ensuring systems are resilient, fault-tolerant, secure, and performant at scale.

##

## Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence

• Partner directly with the Head of AI, Product leadership, and VP-level stakeholders to chart the AI technology roadmap and identify transformative capability unlocks.

• Lead the exploration and application of Large Language Models, Agentic AI and Generative AI, venturing into new areas within these fields.

• Represent the company’s AI thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical papers, conferences, or industry forums.

## Other Responsibilities

• Architect, Design and Build robust, scalable, and efficient AI systems leveraging a variety of AI/ML, data science, deep learning, and agentic AI frameworks.

• Drive the integration of complex Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, ensuring seamless interaction and optimal performance.

• Design and implement scalable and efficient AI/ML systems, architectures, and pipelines that can handle large volumes of data and deliver accurate and timely results.

• Regularly self-educate while mentoring and provide technical leadership to other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

## ## Who we are looking for -

• Experience: 15+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years actively building and deploying Generative AI and Agentic AI applications in production.

• Core Engineering & AI Building: Hands-on builder capable of independently architecting, coding, and deploying custom AI tools, autonomous agents, and bots from scratch.

• Programming Mastery: 8+ years writing production-grade code in Python or similar languages with deep expertise in scalable software design, APIs, and microservices.

• Agentic Frameworks & Tools: Deep proficiency with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Auto-GPT, CrewAI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent coordination.

• LLMs & Fine-Tuning: Practical experience with frontier models (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude), fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and custom agentic tool-calling workflows.

• ML/DL Foundations: Background in training, tuning, and running models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn in high-throughput environments.

• Inference & Acceleration: Familiarity with inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and cloud ML infrastructure (NVIDIA GPUs, TPUs).

• Data & Memory Infrastructure: Experience building low-latency vector search indices, in-memory caching layers, streaming pipelines (Kafka/Flink), and NoSQL datastores to power real-time agent context and memory.

• Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

## Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Autonomous Execution: Proven track record as a senior IC who takes total ownership—from zero-to-one prototyping to production rollout.

• Cloud & DevOps: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP environments with modern containerized deployment (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Domain & Communication: Experience in contact center/telecom/CX platforms is a plus; excellent technical communication skills required.

12+ Years of Experience

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred in Computer Science or Related Field

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/821.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

At Solace, reliability is a feature we build deliberately. Our customers run critical systems such as financial trading platforms, airlines, factories, and supply chains on Solace, and they expect it to behave correctly no matter what the world throws at it. As a Senior Chaos Engineer on our R&D team, you’ll own how we prove that. You’re a systems-level thinker who starts from the problems our customers are trying to solve, builds a clear model of how the whole system should behave, and designs the experiments that reveal where reality and expectation diverge. You’ll set the direction for chaos engineering across our platform, bring deep expertise in fault injection tooling, and chase hard, multi-system failures down to their root cause. You treat AI as a force multiplier and lead the team toward an AI-native way of working, from experiment design to root cause analysis. You’ll partner with squads across R&D to turn findings into fixes that make Solace more resilient for the enterprises that depend on it.

What You’ll Do

• Own the chaos engineering strategy for the Solace platform, deciding which failure modes matter most based on how customers deploy and depend on our products

• Build a deep understanding of customer use cases and translate them into explicit expectations of how the system must behave under failure

• Design, implement, and execute chaos experiments, and other cloud-provider fault injection services, covering infrastructure, network, storage, and application faults and their combinations

• Verify that the system behaves correctly under failure, not just that it stays available

• Debug complex, multi-system failures with rigor and curiosity, tracing issues to their root cause

• Leverage AI to scale experiment design, augment and largely automate analysis, and accelerate root cause investigations, and lead the team toward AI-native ways of working

• Partner with engineering squads and product across R&D to drive remediation, influence designs early, and embed resilience thinking into how we build and operate

• Define reliability metrics and report outcomes in terms of customer impact, turning results into concrete recommendations and priorities

• Mentor engineers and raise the bar for how the team reasons about failure, risk, and quality

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 7+ years of experience in software engineering, system-level engineering, or chaos engineering, including significant time testing or operating distributed systems in production

• Strong systems thinking, with the ability to reason about the whole system end to end and predict how failures combine and cascade

• A customer-first mindset: you start from what customers are trying to achieve and define correct behavior from there

• Proven experience designing and leading chaos engineering programs with Chaos Mesh and/or cloud-provider fault injection services such as AWS Fault Injection Service, Azure Chaos Studio, or GCP fault injection testing

• Deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts and failure modes, ideally in event-driven architectures

• Exceptional debugging and root cause analysis skills; you don’t stop until you understand why

• Solid expertise in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Kubernetes, and observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces)

• Ability to build and evolve experiment tooling, workload generators, and verification harnesses, with AI doing much of the coding and you owning the design and the judgment

• Enthusiasm for AI as a native part of how you work, and the ability to bring that mindset to the people around you

• A track record of influencing across teams without direct authority, communicating risk clearly, and mentoring other engineers

• Experience with messaging systems or event streaming technologies (Solace, Kafka, MQTT, AMQP, JMS) is a strong asset

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

Role Status: NEW

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

## Departmental Business Coordinator

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

About the Position
Reporting to the Deputy Managing Director (DMD), Corporate Services (CS), the Departmental Business Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the Managing Director (MD), the DMD, and the department’s broader coordination and participation preparedness for the Executive Leadership Team (ELT). The position combines executive support with departmental coordination and business operations support, ensuring that day-to-day operations, governance logistics, and administrative processes enable CS leaders and the department to operate efficiently and effectively.

Working closely with the MD, DMD, Organizational Effectiveness Lead, and extended management team, the Departmental Business Coordinator plays a pivotal role in maintaining effective operational coordination, governance deliverables, communications, and management routines across CS.

The position also supports the MD in fulfilling the Bank’s Chief Security Officer (CSO) accountabilities, including coordination of the Bank’s participation in domestic and international security networks and the associated briefings, correspondence, agreements, commitments, and follow-up. The role requires exceptional organizational skills, sound judgement, attention to detail, and a service-oriented approach to support CS’s strategic execution and operational needs.

## What You Will Do

Executive and Governance Coordination

• Manage the MD and DMD’s calendar and executive commitments, and coordinate priorities, schedules, and materials to support the readiness of both the MD and DMD for internal and external engagements.

• Coordinate, track, and ensure the completeness and timeliness of briefing materials, presentations, correspondence, and governance deliverables for Executive Council, ELT, Board, and committee meetings, in alignment with departmental priorities and content direction.

• Liaise with Executive and Legal Services (ELS), internal partners, external stakeholders, and CS business lines to ensure timely and accurate submission of materials and effective follow-up on executive and governance requirements.

• Anticipate the operational and logistical needs of the MD and DMD offices, manage incoming requests, coordinate inputs, and identify matters requiring leadership attention or escalation.

Departmental Operations and Logistics

• Oversee and continuously improve administrative and departmental coordination processes, ensuring CS support activities operate efficiently and effectively.

• Collaborate with business support resources across CS to ensure consistency, quality, and smooth operations across the department’s leadership offices.

• Collaborate with the Organizational Effectiveness Lead and other partners to manage logistics and materials for key departmental and ELT-related meetings and events, including scheduling, documentation, decisions, and follow-up.

• Lead or participate in departmental initiatives related to process optimization, document and records management, and administrative innovation, including the adoption of new tools and practices.

• Maintain and manage CS departmental SharePoint access permissions and filing systems, ensuring access, information handling, and records management comply with Bank standards, confidentiality requirements, and departmental needs.

• Support onboarding, offboarding, and other departmental HR and operational processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and escalating issues to management as required.

• Maintain tracking systems for governance deliverables, leadership decisions, commitments, and action items, ensuring visibility, accountability, follow-up, and timely completion in alignment with departmental priorities.

Collaboration, Communication, and Engagement

• Serve as a liaison between CS and other departments to clarify requirements, coordinate inputs, align deliverables, and support adherence to Bank governance and process standards.

• Foster strong relationships within CS, across the Bank, and with external security partners to support efficient collaboration, timely responses, and effective information flow.

• Support CS work environment, engagement, and departmental communication initiatives, including employee recognition, wellness, town halls, and social events.

• Manage travel arrangements and prepare expense claims for the MD and DMD in compliance with Bank policies.

## What You Need to Succeed

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex workflows, competing priorities, and tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

• Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving skills — able to synthesize information, identify key issues, and recommend effective solutions.

• Excellent relationship management and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and all levels of the organization.

• High degree of initiative, professionalism, and discretion, especially when handling sensitive or confidential information.

• Strong organizational and anticipatory skills, able to think several steps ahead and proactively address operational needs.

• Positive, “can-do” attitude with the confidence and flexibility to take ownership, adapt to change, and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Demonstrates maturity, tact, and composure under pressure, and represents the offices of the MD and DMD with professionalism and credibility.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams), SharePoint, and Artificial Intelligence tools.

• Continuous improvement mindset, eager to learn, enhance existing processes, and contribute to a culture of excellence and collaboration.

## Nice-to-have

• Experience supporting senior executives, such as a Managing Director, Chief Security Officer, or other senior executive equivalent, in a complex, fast-paced environment.

• Experience in corporate services, security, corporate governance, government, or another complex operational organization.

• Experience leading or supporting process improvement and administrative innovation initiatives.

Your Education and Experience
This position requires a post-secondary diploma or degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field, and a minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience providing executive or departmental coordination support. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Innovative Mindset
We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

## What you need to know

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

Hybrid Work Model
The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $74,981 to $88,213 (job grade 14)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 5 to 7% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (3%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health, dental disability and life and/or accident insurance coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Indexed, defined-benefit pension

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

Welcome to BWXT
We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

Position Overview: The Welding Specialist is a key technical role focused on providing expert guidance and support in welding operations within a manufacturing setting. This position entails following detailed manufacturing plans while supporting shop personnel to ensure adherence to quality standards and procedural compliance during critical welding activities.

## Location:

On-site in Barberton, Ohio

## Your Day to Day as a Welding Specialist (Back Shift):

• Supports site wide initiatives for streamlining manufacturing for welding related applications (standardization or work scopes, work cell development/ownership, process improvements, etc.).

• Programs welding parameters on programmable equipment.

• Trains and assists welders/operators in production welding environment on process, welding equipment, qualification requirements, etc.

• Follows detailed manufacturing plans, providing direction to shop personnel and supervision.

• Support equipment related improvement projects such as identifying and procuring new welding equipment, coordinating PM activities for existing equipment, evaluating spare parts inventory, etc.

• Prepares and reviews welding/fabrication support material and training aids (i.e., bead placement sketches, setup sheets, welding instructions)

## Required Qualifications:

• High school graduate, or equivalent.

• Ideal applicant has 3 – 5 years of welding experience in a shop environment

• Applicants should have a good understanding/working knowledge of manual, semi-automatic, and mechanized/automatic welding processes such as the following: SMAW, GTAW, AGTAW-CW/HW, AGMAW, SAW, SA-GMAW.

• Hands-on welding experience not required but is desirable to aid in training of shop personnel

• Ability to work on a PC, using Microsoft Office applications (Outlook (email), Word, Excel, etc.)

• Ability to work well with various departments such as hourly personnel, shop supervision, Engineering support, etc.

• Ability to follow detailed manufacturing plans and provide direction to shop personnel

• Ability to demonstrate superior written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Availability to work overtime, some daily and occasional weekend support.

• Must be a U.S. citizen with no dual citizenship.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Formal welding technical education is a plus but not required (i.e. trade school)

• Experience with robotic welding is plus

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## AUKUS Office Architect

## Position Overview:

Develop and maintain discrete resource loaded schedule using P6. Provide variance analysis reports using earned value management. ## Position Overview

The Intermediate Analyst plays a critical role in supporting project and operational success within Nuclear. Working under minimal supervision, the incumbent contributes to complex projects through coordination, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder engagement, while continuing to develop subject matter expertise within the nuclear industry. The role serves as a key liaison between operational, technical, and project teams, providing insights and support that enable safe, compliant, and efficient project execution.

CareersInnerInfo
Initially assigned to support operations at the Central Storage Facility (B44), this role is responsible for coordinating logistics activities that support critical path project milestones, ensuring the safe and efficient movement of materials, tooling, and containers within a nuclear environment. Acting as the IronSight Single Point of Contact (SPOC), the incumbent supports logistics data accuracy, job validation, scheduling visibility, reporting, and issue escalation while collaborating closely with operations, logistics, radiation protection, engineering, and trades personnel. Through analysis, coordination, and continuous improvement initiatives, the Intermediate Analyst helps drive operational performance and supports the broader success of Calian Nuclear projects

## Responsibilities

Logistics Coordination, Analysis & Planning

• Coordinate logistics activities at the Central Storage Facility (B44) to support project schedules, operational priorities, and critical path milestones.

• Support planning and execution of inbound and outbound shipments, including tooling transfers, container movements, and material handling activities.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of container storage and stacking strategies within designated storage areas.

• Monitor logistics activities for compliance with radiation protection requirements, floor loading limits, container stacking capacities, and applicable site procedures.

• Identify scheduling constraints, operational risks, and process improvement opportunities, escalating concerns and providing recommendations to senior team members as required.

• Ensure assigned work is completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements and customer expectations.

IronSight Coordination & Operational Support

• Serve as the primary coordinator and point of contact for IronSight-related logistics activities, supporting adherence to established processes and governance requirements.

• Review logistics jobs for completeness, data accuracy, documentation requirements, carrier assignments, load securement, and regulatory compliance.

• Verify container locations, off-gassing requirements, seal records, and alignment with related systems and records.

• Monitor logistics data and scheduling information to identify discrepancies, conflicts, or emerging issues and support resolution efforts in collaboration with operations, logistics, and project teams.

• Escalate issues through established project and operational channels when required.

• Collect, organize, and communicate user feedback to support continuous improvement initiatives and future system enhancements.

• Provide guidance and day-to-day support to system users, including onboarding assistance and troubleshooting of routine issues.

Operational Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement

• Participate in daily operational and project coordination meetings, providing updates on logistics activities, shipment status, schedule impacts, and constraints.

• Coordinate with operations, logistics, engineering, radiation protection, trades, and project stakeholders to support safe and efficient execution of work.

• Assist with next-day shipment planning and readiness activities in partnership with logistics service providers and internal teams.

• Support Zone 2 workgroups with tooling verification, shipment readiness reviews, container layouts, and logistics coordination activities.

• Present information, status updates, and recommendations to project teams, customers, and management as required.

Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

• Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly logistics and operational reports.

• Analyze shipment performance, schedule adherence, resource utilization, and operational trends to support planning and decision-making.

• Develop reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.

• Provide analysis, recommendations, and supporting information to senior team members and leadership to assist with operational and project decisions.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, workflows, and system utilization, and support implementation of approved improvements.

Team Contribution & Professional Development

• Demonstrate a high level of productivity and professionalism while delivering quality work that meets project and customer expectations.

• Support knowledge sharing, mentoring, and guidance for junior team members and new users of logistics systems and processes.

• Continue developing technical, operational, and analytical expertise within the nuclear industry.

• Contribute to business and project growth by identifying opportunities to improve services, processes, and team capabilities.

Other duties as required within the context of the role.

## Qualifications

• Post-secondary education in Business, Supply Chain, Project Management, Engineering, Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in logistics, project coordination, operations, materials management, data analysis, or a related role within a regulated, industrial, utility, or nuclear environment.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively coordinate multiple priorities and support complex operational or project activities in a fast-paced, high-compliance environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, evaluate options, and provide recommendations to support operational and project decision-making.

• Experience preparing, reviewing, and maintaining technical, operational, or project documentation and reports.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to procedural compliance, quality, and data accuracy.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting and analytics tools.

• Working knowledge of logistics, inventory, scheduling, or asset management systems; experience with IronSight and/or CribMaster is considered a strong asset.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and build positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

• Understanding of radiation protection principles, PPE requirements, and nuclear safety protocols is considered an asset.

• Ability to support and guide less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

## Additional Requirements

• Must be eligible to obtain government of Canada security clearance and customer site clearances.

• Must be willing and able to work fully onsite in Tiverton, Ontario

Compensation

$90,000 - $105,000 per annum

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. To be successful, the Intern must be able to communicate well, take direction and learn new skills quickly. • Ensure all applications are functional, secure, and compliant with company policies and standards.

• Perform other essential duties as assigned.

• Experience with Object-Oriented programming.

• Familiarity and experience with C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET.

• Familiarity with SQL Server and database design.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and on a team.

• Ability to work under guidelines and procedures.

• Demonstrable attention to detail and time-management skills.

• Effective oral and written communication skills.

• Enthusiasm for solving problems and contributing to the success of the team and the company.

• Ability to effectively prioritize tasks.

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

You will turn product and engineering goals into practical designs, implement critical functionality, and carry improvements through testing, deployment, and production operation.

• Show initiative: identify gaps, gather context, propose practical solutions, and move work forward with appropriate coordination.

• Balance speed with quality, explain tradeoffs, and verify that the result solves the intended problem.

• Remain accountable after release: investigate failures, incorporate feedback, and improve reliability and maintainability.

• Design across component boundaries. Translate ambiguous needs into clear designs, evaluate tradeoffs, define interfaces, and consider the effects on the wider system.

• Use AI agents effectively. Break work into clear tasks, supply relevant context and constraints, review generated changes, and verify behavior including failure scenarios.

• Learn unfamiliar systems. Use code, documentation, experiments, AI tools, and collaboration to become effective across languages and codebases.

• Evolve software thoughtfully. Improve maintainability and delivery speed while managing compatibility, rollout, and operational risk.

• Contribute across the stack. Work with APIs, client integrations, and user interfaces when needed to deliver a complete outcome.

• Provide hands-on technical leadership. Communicate decisions, coordinate across teams, mentor peers, and help others deliver.

• Experience with automated testing, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting.

• Practical use of AI coding agents for substantial engineering work, with the ability to explain decisions, identify mistakes, and independently verify results.

• Curiosity and demonstrated initiative to learn unfamiliar technologies and investigate beyond a single component or specialty.

• Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering teams.

As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

Ciena’s Asset on Loan (AOL) program enables Research & Development (R&D) teams to borrow the latest hardware and products from manufacturing for activities such as soak testing, product verification, and new hardware and software program development.

As a Reload Technician, you will play an important role in managing, testing, reloading, and recertifying these units before they are returned to Ciena’s finished goods inventory for future customer orders. You will gain hands-on experience working with Ciena’s latest R&D tools, testing processes, and lab infrastructure while contributing to product quality, inventory accuracy, and operational efficiency.

This role combines technical testing and scripting with inventory management and hardware handling.

The open position requires some afternoon shifts for swaps on weekly basis.

## Key Responsibilities

Your time will be divided approximately as follows:

• 60% Technical Activities: Reloading, retesting, recertifying, scripting, and updating software loads on hardware units.

• 40% Inventory Management: Receiving, tracking, scanning, relocating, swapping, boxing, and packaging hardware units.

## General Activities

Technical Testing and Recertification

• Perform manual and automated reload, retest, and recertification activities using Linux-based tools and scripting languages such as Python and Perl.

• Execute reload and recertification tests according to established engineering documentation and procedures.

• Configure and update software loads and perform traffic and system testing as required.

• Record test results and maintain accurate reload and recertification logs in the appropriate databases.

• Identify hardware and software failures, troubleshoot issues, and document and report problems to the appropriate teams.

• Conduct physical inspections of cards and perform minor repairs as needed.

## Inventory and Hardware Management

• Receive and manage AOL hardware units and cards, including lab swaps and deployments.

• Perform regular lab inventory scans and update equipment locations to maintain accurate inventory records.

• Track hardware movements and ensure units are properly accounted for throughout the loan and return process.

• Repack and re-box hardware to meet Ciena’s Class A packaging standards before returning units to finished goods inventory.

## The Must Haves:

• Previous experience with laboratory equipment inventory management and tracking.

• Exposure to telecommunications labs and a basic understanding of telecommunications equipment.

• Strong scripting skills, particularly in Python; familiarity with Perl is an asset.

• Familiarity with Linux environments and basic software or system testing is an advantage.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

## What You’ll Gain

• Hands-on experience with telecommunications hardware and R&D lab operations.

• Practical exposure to scripting, software loading, system testing, and product recertification.

• Experience with inventory control, hardware lifecycle management, and quality assurance.

• The opportunity to contribute to the processes that help ensure Ciena products are ready for customer delivery.

Pay Range: Our Technician's are paid hourly, for this role the hourly range is $28/hr - $45/hr

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.
