## Reduce Risk. Accelerate Remediation. Strengthen Infrastructure Security.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and reducing technology risk across complex cloud environments? Do you enjoy analyzing security vulnerabilities, partnering with technical teams, and driving remediation efforts that strengthen the security and resilience of critical systems?

We’re looking for two Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineers to help identify, prioritize, track, and remediate vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications within a cloud-based FedRAMP Moderate-compliant environment supporting US federal government requirements.

This role will focus on accelerating vulnerability remediation in alignment with applicable Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04 requirements, leveraging threat intelligence, exposure data, and cloud-based AI tools to help application and infrastructure teams address security risks efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidates bring hands-on vulnerability management experience, strong technical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk partners to drive vulnerabilities through resolution.

## The Opportunity

As an Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in reducing the organization’s technology risk by managing vulnerability remediation activities from identification through closure. You’ll analyze findings from vulnerability assessment tools, evaluate risk and exposure, coordinate remediation plans, and track progress through established systems of record.

You’ll work closely with application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to ensure vulnerabilities are prioritized appropriately and remediated within required time frames. You’ll also use cloud-based AI tools and established security practices to support vulnerability identification, improve remediation workflows, and contribute to reporting and continuous process improvement.

This role is ideal for a security professional who combines technical vulnerability analysis with strong coordination, communication, and reporting skills in a regulated cloud environment.

## ## Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead and coordinate vulnerability remediation activities across infrastructure and applications, ensuring identified vulnerabilities are tracked, prioritized, and resolved in accordance with established security requirements and remediation timelines.

Exposure-Based Risk Prioritization: Evaluate vulnerabilities using CVE and CVSS data, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack paths, exposure information, and other relevant risk indicators to help determine remediation priorities.

CISA Directive Alignment: Support vulnerability remediation activities aligned with applicable CISA BOD 26-04 requirements and other relevant federal cybersecurity directives, including monitoring remediation progress against required deadlines.

Infrastructure & Application Security: Support vulnerability assessment and remediation across Windows Server 2019 and above, Linux/RHEL 9.x and above, and application environments. Work with technical teams to identify appropriate remediation approaches, including patching, configuration changes, and other corrective actions.

Vulnerability Assessment Tools: Use tools such as Tenable Security Center, Nessus, and Qualys to review vulnerability findings, validate remediation status, identify outstanding exposures, and support ongoing vulnerability management operations.

Application & Infrastructure Team Collaboration: Partner with application owners, application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to communicate findings, clarify remediation requirements, resolve technical or process-related questions, and drive issues to closure.

Tracking & System of Record Management: Maintain accurate vulnerability records in ServiceNow or other designated systems of record. Update remediation status, document actions taken, track outstanding items, and ensure records reflect the current state of identified vulnerabilities.

Patch Management & Change Coordination: Coordinate patching and remediation activities with application and infrastructure teams, following established change management processes and supporting timely, controlled implementation of corrective actions.

Exception Management & Risk Response: Support vulnerability exception management, risk-based remediation decisions, incident-driven response activities, and escalation of overdue or unresolved vulnerabilities to the appropriate stakeholders.

AI-Assisted Vulnerability Analysis: Leverage cloud-based AI tools, where appropriate, to support vulnerability identification, analysis, prioritization, and remediation workflows while applying sound security judgment and established review processes.

Risk Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain periodic vulnerability management metrics and reports, including remediation progress, aging vulnerabilities, overdue findings, risk trends, and other indicators used to communicate exposure and remediation effectiveness.

Process Improvement & Documentation: Identify opportunities to improve vulnerability management procedures, remediation workflows, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency. Maintain clear documentation of findings, remediation activities, exceptions, and supporting processes.

## ## What You Bring to the Team

The Vulnerability Management Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in vulnerability management, vulnerability remediation, patch management, or a closely related infrastructure security role.

The Security Assessment Toolkit: Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment and management tools, including Tenable Security Center, Nessus, and Qualys.

The Windows Foundation: Working knowledge of Windows Server 2019 and later, including vulnerability remediation, security patching, and system configuration.

The Linux Foundation: Experience supporting Linux environments, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9.x and later, including security updates, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

The Risk-Based Approach: Understanding of CVE and CVSS analysis, vulnerability prioritization, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and exposure-based remediation practices.

The Remediation Mindset: Demonstrated experience coordinating vulnerability remediation and patch management activities, tracking findings through closure, and working with technical teams to resolve outstanding security issues.

The Change Management Discipline: Familiarity with change management processes and the ability to coordinate remediation activities while supporting operational stability and established controls.

The Service Management Skills: Experience using ServiceNow ticketing or similar systems to track vulnerabilities, document remediation progress, manage escalations, and maintain accurate records.

The Reporting & Analytics Capability: Strong Microsoft Excel and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze vulnerability data, track remediation metrics, identify trends, and communicate risk status clearly.

The Collaboration Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk stakeholders to drive remediation outcomes.

The Problem Solver: Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate technical findings, clarify remediation requirements, and manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

The Federal Security Awareness: Ability to work within a regulated cloud environment and follow established security, compliance, documentation, and risk management processes.

The Citizenship Requirement: Must be a US citizen.

## ## Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

• Federal Cybersecurity Frameworks: Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and federal cybersecurity compliance requirements.

• Threat Intelligence & Exploitation Awareness: Experience using CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) information and other threat intelligence sources to prioritize remediation based on active exploitation and emerging threats.

• Federal & DoD Environments: Experience supporting US federal government, Department of Defense (DoD), or other regulated enterprise environments.

• Automation & Scripting: Experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python to automate vulnerability analysis, reporting, patch management, or remediation workflows.

• Endpoint Management: Familiarity with ManageEngine Endpoint Central or similar endpoint management and patch deployment platforms.

• Virtualization & Directory Services: Experience supporting VMware environments and Active Directory infrastructure.

• Application Security Remediation: Experience identifying and coordinating remediation of application vulnerabilities, including web application security findings.

• Cloud Security & AI Tools: Familiarity with cloud security technologies and AI-assisted tools used for vulnerability analysis, security operations, and risk reduction.

• Continuous Improvement: A track record of improving vulnerability remediation timelines, strengthening reporting processes, and reducing technology risk through effective coordination and automation.

## Preferred Certifications

Relevant cybersecurity, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, or cloud security certifications are desirable.

Examples include CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), and other relevant security certifications.

## ## Why Join Us?

Meaningful Cybersecurity Impact: Help reduce technology risk and strengthen the security posture of cloud environments supporting critical federal government operations.

Mission-Critical Security Work: Contribute to vulnerability remediation activities aligned with federal cybersecurity directives and established compliance requirements.

Technical Problem-Solving: Work across infrastructure, applications, vulnerability assessment tools, and remediation processes to address complex security challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with application owners, infrastructure engineers, vendors, and risk stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in security and operational effectiveness.

Continuous Improvement: Help optimize vulnerability management practices, improve remediation efficiency, and strengthen risk reporting through automation, analytics, and emerging AI-assisted capabilities.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

## What you need to know

We are seeking a Data Scientist with expertise in economics, quantitative modelling, and emerging AI technologies to support economic research, policy analysis, and data-driven decision-making at the Bank of Canada. You will apply data science, machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI), and quantitative methods to challenging economic and research problems, helping economists and researchers make effective use of modern analytical techniques and technologies.

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Data Science, within the Department of Data and Digital Services (DDS), you will work at the intersection of economics, data science, and emerging technologies. Working closely with economists, researchers, business clients, and technology teams, you will develop analytical solutions, AI-enabled tools, and quantitative models that improve research, forecasting, policy analysis, and decision-making.

This role offers an opportunity to apply modern data science and AI approaches to meaningful economic and policy problems while contributing to the development of reusable analytical capabilities. You will work on high-impact initiatives, experiment with emerging methods and technologies, and help modernize analytical and research workflows across the organization.

## What you will do

As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to analytical initiatives that support economic research, forecasting, policy analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. Drawing on your knowledge of economics, quantitative methods, and data science, you will work across the analytical lifecycle to develop practical, high-quality solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing, developing, testing, and implementing statistical, econometric, ML, and AI models to address economic, research, and policy questions.

• Developing AI-enabled applications, analytical tools, reusable components, and data products that improve research, modelling, forecasting, and analytical workflows.

• Applying LLMs, generative AI, and emerging AI approaches to practical research and analytical use cases, including prototyping, experimentation, evaluation, and implementation.

• Working with structured and unstructured data, including preparing, transforming, validating, exploring, and analyzing datasets for modelling and research.

• Collaborating with economists, researchers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to understand analytical needs and translate them into effective data science solutions.

• Communicating analytical findings, methodologies, assumptions, limitations, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Applying sound practices for reproducible research, model validation, responsible AI, explainability, documentation, and analytical quality.

• Exploring and evaluating emerging AI, ML, and analytical techniques and applying them where they can improve economic analysis, research methods, forecasting, or productivity.

## What you need to succeed

You are a collaborative and curious data scientist who enjoys using quantitative methods and technology to solve challenging analytical problems. You combine strong technical skills with an understanding of economic and research contexts and can translate analytical questions into practical solutions.

You are comfortable working independently on complex assignments while collaborating closely with economists, researchers, data scientists, and technology specialists. You are an analytical problem solver and continuous learner who can adapt methods and tools as technologies and research needs evolve.

You bring:

• Hands-on experience designing and delivering econometric and economic models using statistical, ML, and AI techniques to support economic research, policy analysis, forecasting, and other quantitative applications.

• Strong knowledge of quantitative methods, with experience in areas such as econometrics, forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning, or AI.

• Experience applying large language models (LLMs), generative AI, or other emerging AI technologies to analytical, research, or decision-support use cases.

• Proficiency with programming languages or analytical computing environments such as Python, MATLAB, R, or similar tools.

• Experience working with modern analytics platforms such as Azure, Databricks, or equivalent environments.

• Experience working across the data science lifecycle, including data preparation, exploration, modelling, evaluation, and implementation.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain analytical approaches and results to technical and non-technical audiences.

## Nice-to-Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Economic research, forecasting, policy analysis, or quantitative economic modelling.

• Time-series analysis, econometric estimation, or simulation methods.

• Building AI-enabled analytical applications or research tools.

• Working with economists, researchers, business partners, and technology teams in multidisciplinary environments.

## Education and Experience

This position requires a master’s degree or higher in economics, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, or a related quantitative discipline, along with a minimum of four years of relevant experience applying quantitative methods, including statistical modelling, econometrics, ML, AI, or related analytical techniques, in support of economic research, policy analysis, forecasting, or evidence-based decision-making. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may also be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement
The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

## What you need to know

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• Relocation assistance may be provided, if required

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is “Data Scientist ”

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

• • Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $96,077 to $113,032 (job grade 16)

• The Bank offers an incentive for successfully meeting expectations at 5 to 7% of your base salary. The Bank offers additional performance pay (3%) for those who exceed expectations. Exceptional performers who far exceed expectations may be eligible for higher performance pay.

• Flexible and comprehensive benefits so you can choose the level of health and dental coverage that meets your needs

• Extra vacation days (up to five each year) that you can purchase to add to your vacation entitlement

• Option to join the indexed, defined-benefit pension plan after 24 consecutive months of service

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

## Job Title: Radiological Controls Supervisor

BWSR, a partnership led by BWXT, is the site remediation and overhaul subcontractor at the Naval Reactors Facility (NRF) in Idaho Falls, Idaho. BWSR performs remediation of legacy nuclear and environmental materials, including work involving historical research facilities, building demolition, and characterization of site infrastructure.

## Welcome to BWXT

At BWXT, we believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that supports growth and collaboration. Our teams perform important work in nuclear operations, environmental restoration, and other critical industries. We welcome candidates with a range of skills and experience who are interested in contributing to this work.

## Position Overview:

The Radiological Controls Supervisor is an exempt, working supervisor who reports to the Radiological Controls Manager. This position leads Radiological Control Technicians (RCTs), coordinates daily assignments, and provides technical and on-the-job supervision. The supervisor also spends part of the time performing or supporting the work being supervised. The role works autonomously within established procedures, sets priorities, applies sound judgment to resolve issues, and is accountable for the quality of the team’s work and services.

## Location:

On-site at the Naval Reactors Facility in Idaho Falls, Idaho.

## Your Day to Day as a Radiological Controls Supervisor:

• Assign RCTs to tasks, coordinate daily work, and provide technical direction and on-the-job supervision.

• Provide radiological oversight and leadership to ensure work meets applicable radiological standards, controls, and procedures.

• Review and approve radiological monitoring reports prepared by RCTs.

• Interpret radiological control requirements, participate in task scoping, and provide technical review of work documents.

• Serve as a primary contact for customer radiological and operations management on radiological issues.

• Guide the proper handling and documentation of radioactive material and sources.

• Address daily administrative, employee relations, and disciplinary matters involving RCTs.

• Act as alternate Radiological Controls Manager when needed and serve as the primary person in charge at the scene of radiological casualties.

• Perform other duties as assigned by management.

## Required Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Typically, a minimum of five years of applicable experience. This role requires five years of Naval Reactors Program experience as an RCT supervisor or senior radiological technician.

• A two-year college degree in math or science. Relevant experience in place of the degree may be considered with customer approval.

• Ability to qualify as a supervisory RCT under Section 106.2 of LAB-RC-0288.

• Ability to obtain and maintain respirator qualifications.

• U.S. citizenship; dual citizenship is not permitted.

• Ability to obtain and maintain radiological dosimetry in the Naval Reactors Program.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE “L” clearance.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Current DOE “L” clearance.

## Pay: $65,000 - $103,000

The total compensation package may include an annual cash incentive in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and other benefits. Details of participation in benefit plans will be provided when the selected candidate receives an offer of employment. If hired, the selected candidate will be employed at-will, unless employed at a location and in a position subject to a collective bargaining agreement. The company reserves the right to modify base salary and other discretionary compensation or benefit programs at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or department/team performance, and other market factors.

This position requires U.S. citizenship with no dual citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a DOE security clearance. Job Description: We are seeking a Staff Engineer (Physical AI - System Engineering) to join the Pathfinding Studio within the Engineering Innovation Office. Master’s degree (PhD preferred) in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related field.

## ## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## Job Information

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

## ## Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on software engineer who can take end-to-end technical ownership of a significant software subsystem or product capability within Avaya's enterprise communications and contact center portfolio. You will translate product goals into sound designs, drive implementation, coordinate integration with other teams, and deliver reliable, maintainable software.

You will remain accountable for the technical quality and evolution of the software you own. The role requires independence, initiative, and sound judgment: defining the work, making tradeoffs, addressing dependencies, and carrying commitments through to a useful outcome.

AI-assisted development is central to the role. We value engineers who use coding agents to accelerate delivery and learn unfamiliar technologies, while retaining the understanding needed to verify, maintain, and troubleshoot the systems they build.

## ## Responsibilities

• Own a subsystem from design through production. Take responsibility for its technical direction, implementation, interfaces, testing, operational readiness, and ongoing improvement.

• Turn product goals into clear designs and achievable delivery plans. Define interfaces and data flows, explain tradeoffs, identify dependencies, and raise risks and blockers early.

• Personally implement critical functionality and resolve difficult technical problems. Work across backend services, APIs, messaging, and data, with user-facing components where relevant to the subsystem.

• Establish clear integration contracts with adjacent systems. Address compatibility, failure behavior, and the effect of changes on other teams and users.

• Use AI coding agents for substantial engineering work. Define tasks and constraints, provide context, challenge generated solutions, and verify results through tests, measurements, and targeted code review.

• Build quality into the subsystem. Address security, performance, resilience, and maintainability through automated tests and validation of realistic failure scenarios.

• Carry work through release and production use. Establish observability and safe rollout and rollback practices with operating teams, investigate failures, and follow through on improvements.

• Collaborate with product, engineering, and operations partners. Document decisions, share knowledge, review code, and help others contribute to and support the subsystem.

## ## Required Experience

• 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical depth and end-to-end ownership of production software.

• Ownership of a substantial production service, subsystem, or product capability, with personal contributions to design, implementation, integration, and ongoing improvement.

• Strong backend engineering skills in at least one production language, such as Go, Rust, Node.js with TypeScript, Java, or a comparable language.

• Ability to reason about distributed systems, concurrency, state, APIs, asynchronous messaging, data storage, and failure handling.

• Experience with automated testing, deployment, observability, performance analysis, and production troubleshooting.

• Practical use of AI coding agents for substantial engineering work, with the ability to explain decisions, identify mistakes, and establish confidence in the result.

• Ability to work independently through ambiguity, learn unfamiliar technologies, and coordinate technical decisions and delivery dependencies across teams.

• Clear communication and the ability to move between system design and implementation details.

## ## Preferred Experience

• Production development in Go or Rust.

• Event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or comparable technologies.

• Modernizing existing services while preserving compatibility and customer behavior.

• Contact center, telecommunications, or other real-time applications with demanding reliability and latency requirements.

• Delivery across backend services and modern frontend applications.

• Production AI integrations involving tool use, retrieval, orchestration, or evaluations.

## ## Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

## ## Pay Transparency

The pay range for this opportunity is from $179,127 to $234,100 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

## ## Sponsorship and Equal Opportunity

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location.

## Application Development Lead - Artificial Intelligence

## Take a central role

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

What you need to know
We are seeking an Application Development Lead who is passionate about building the next generation of AI-powered developer experiences. In this role, you will lead the development, configuration, and implementation of advanced Code Engineering capabilities across GitHub Copilot, AI foundry and Microsoft Fabric technologies, and enable teams to work more efficiently through automation and modern AI platforms.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how AI augments application development at the Bank, working alongside multidisciplinary teams to build secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready AI solutions that enhance productivity while maintaining the Bank’s strong standards for governance, reliability, and operational excellence.

What you will do
As the AI Application Development Lead, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, build, integration, and operationalization of AI-Enablement model for FMBO Application Development activities. Working closely with the FMBO AI Principal Consultant, you will translate AI strategies, reference architectures, and solution roadmaps into secure, scalable, production-ready capabilities that improve how FMBO designs, delivers, and supports its business applications.

More specifically you will:

• Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of AI-enabled application capabilities, including solution design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Partner with the FMBO AI Principal Consultant to implement AI reference architectures, development patterns, lifecycle controls, and guardrails that align with enterprise technology, security, risk, and responsible AI expectations.

• Guide developers in building, configuring, and maintaining AI agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, and application integrations using AI platforms and modern software engineering practices.

• Define and oversee testing approaches for AI-enabled applications, including automated testing, model and agent evaluation, regression testing, data validation, security testing, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, and fit for business use.

• Provide technical leadership across Agile delivery teams, helping estimate work, manage technical complexity, remove delivery blockers, and ensure that AI solutions are reliable, secure, maintainable, and measurable.

• Collaborate with product owners, solution architects, cybersecurity, infrastructure, data, and operational support teams to embed AI into FMBO application development and support processes while reducing technical debt and improving operational resilience.

What you need to succeed
You are a strong technical lead with deep application development experience and a practical understanding of how AI can be embedded into enterprise systems. You are comfortable moving between architecture, hands-on development, delivery leadership, and operational support. You communicate clearly, make sound technical decisions, and help teams adopt new AI development practices in a secure and disciplined way.

In addition, you have experience with:

• Leading application development teams through the full software development lifecycle, including solution design, coding standards, peer reviews, testing, deployment, and production readiness.

• Designing and implementing AI-enabled application solutions using modern development languages, cloud services, APIs, data integration patterns, and secure enterprise platforms.

• Working with AI development approaches such as prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agentic workflows, model integration, evaluation, monitoring, and guardrail implementation.

• Establishing testing and quality assurance practices for AI-enabled applications, including evaluation criteria, test automation, regression testing, validation of AI outputs, defect management, and production-readiness assessments.

• Applying Agile, DevOps, test-driven development, continuous integration, release management, and operational support practices to deliver maintainable and production-ready solutions.

• Collaborating across technical and non-technical teams, translating AI and application development concepts into clear delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and decision-ready recommendations.

• Coaching developers and promoting engineering practices that support secure AI adoption, reusable patterns, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

## Nice-to-have

• Experience with AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI services, or comparable enterprise AI tooling.

• Experience designing or integrating AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, vector search, knowledge grounding, or secure data retrieval patterns.

• Familiarity with responsible AI, model risk management, AI safety guardrails, observability, or controls for regulated environments.

Your education and experience
This position requires a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a relevant field with a minimum of 7 years of recent, relevant experience in application development, including experience leading technical delivery teams. System Test Engineer / Ingénieur(e) en tests système

CareersInnerInfo

## Position Overview

We are seeking a System Test Engineer to design and execute system-level tests, develop automation scripts, and apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) principles to ensure our solution meets all requirements. In this role, you will create and implement comprehensive test plans, simulate real-world conditions, and identify potential defects or issues that could impact user experience and system performance.

## Responsibilities

• Design and execute system-level tests to validate telecom platforms (e.g., provisioning, eSIM, Enterprise 5G Connect) under real-world conditions.

• Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Cucumber (BDD) integrated with frameworks like Playwright or Selenium.

• Collaborate with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and Development Teams to define acceptance criteria and translate them into Gherkin scenarios.

• Develop and maintain automated tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation and quality assurance.

• Analyze test results, identify root causes, and report defects using JIRA/Xray, ensuring traceability between user stories, test cases, and automation scripts.

• Design and implement BDD test scenarios using Cucumber and Gherkin syntax.

• Perform functional, integration, regression, and performance testing for web, API services, and cloud-based applications.

• Leverage strong coding skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python for test automation and custom tooling.

• Utilize testing tools such as Xray Test Management, Playwright, Selenium, and Postman.

• Work with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/Google Cloud) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for deployment and testing.

• Validate High Availability and Geo-Redundant Systems for telecom-grade reliability.

• Apply domain knowledge in SIM and eSIM technologies, especially provisioning flows.

## Qualifications

• Strong experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, Behave) and Gherkin syntax.

• Proficiency in JavaScript, type script, or Python for automation scripting.

• Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, or similar UI automation tools.

• Familiarity with API testing tools like Postman.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and test management tools (Jira, Xray).

• Preferred exposure to cloud-native architectures (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experience with Windows OS, EntraID, Intune, IOS. In particular with eSim provisioning and activation.

Compensation

• $50-80/hour

Lumentum Canada was awarded the 2022 National Capital Region’s Top Employers for the 6th consecutive year and the 2022 Career Directory Canada’s Best Employers for Recent Graduates for the 5th consecutive year.

## About Lumentum

At Lumentum, we’re building the tech behind the world’s fastest networks and most advanced systems. Our optical and photonic solutions power everything from AI and cloud computing to data centers, telecom, and advanced manufacturing.

We’re a global team of innovators working where light meets technology, solving big challenges that keep the world connected and moving forward. If shaping the future of connectivity excites you, you’ll fit right in.

## Why You’ll Love This Role

Lumentum is seeking a Senior Embedded Security Developer to design, implement, and validate security features for next-generation optical circuit switch platforms. This role focuses on device identity, secure provisioning, network management security, and hardware-rooted trust across the product lifecycle—from manufacturing and deployment through operation and recovery.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Design, implement, and maintain gNSI security services and their operational commands and workflows, including authorization, path authorization, credential rotation, and certificate management.

• Implement secure zero-touch provisioning (Bootz) and device enrollment workflows, including bootstrap identity, credential issuance, trust establishment, and recovery.

• Develop device attestation capabilities using TPM-backed identity and measured-boot evidence, including collection and validation of platform measurements.

• Implement and harden TLS and mutual TLS for control, telemetry, and management planes, including certificate issuance, rotation, revocation, and trust-bundle updates.

• Build security tests and automation; investigate defects; and support internal and external security reviews.

## What We’re Looking For

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

## Experience:
Core Requirements:

• 5+ years of embedded software development experience, including substantial work on security-sensitive systems.

• Strong Python or Go development skills; familiarity with C or C++.

• Experience developing for Linux-based embedded platforms; RTOS experience is a plus.

• Practical experience with cryptography, PKI, TLS, and mutual TLS.

• Understanding of network-device security and management protocols, such as gRPC, gNMI, or gNSI.

• Experience designing or integrating secure provisioning, enrollment, credential management, or certificate lifecycle workflows.

• Strong debugging skills and the ability to work across software and platform boundaries.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document designs and explain security decisions.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience implementing or operating gNSI services such as authz, pathz, credentialz, or certz.

• Experience with secure zero-touch provisioning, device attestation, TPM 2.0, measured boot, or hardware-backed device identity.

• Knowledge of secure boot chains, hardware roots of trust, or manufacturing security.

• Experience in telecom, networking, optical systems, or other embedded infrastructure.

• Familiarity with security testing, automation, and vulnerability review processes.

## Perks You’ll Love

• Flexible time off

• Health and wellness benefits (physical and mental)

• Tuition reimbursement and career growth support

• A workplace built for you: free gym, games room, prayer room

• Subsidized meals, free coffee/tea

• Employee stock options and incentive plans

• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture

Salary Range
The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. In line with our commitment to being a great place to work, Lumentum offers competitive total rewards which may include annual bonus, equity, and comprehensive health and welfare benefits.

## Join a Team That’s Shaping the Future

At Lumentum, we’re more than just a workplace—we’re a launchpad for creativity and innovation. We’re committed to celebrating your unique talents and helping you grow. Our guiding principles—Innovate, Engage, Deliver, Excel, and Win—aren’t just words; they’re the heart of what we do.

## Let’s Build a Brighter Future Together!

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. Your uniqueness makes us stronger, sparks creativity, and drives our success.

## Please contact us at talentacquisition@lumentum.com to request accommodation.

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

You will assess readiness to implement workflows and recommend a plan to get us there, while continuing to build/maintain technical content using existing processes to keep pace with releases.

Working Arrangement

The documentation and training work in this role is 30–40 hours a week. We’re open to a contract, permanent position or other arrangement that works for both. ## Museum Interpreter (part-time)

## Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process.

Did you know?
The Bank of Canada Museum is both a traditional museum and an interpretive centre blending history, art, science… and fun! As a public outreach arm of the Bank’s Communications department, the Museum has a mission to clarify for Canadians the key functions of the institution. In addition, through the National Currency Collection the Museum interprets our monetary heritage, both Canadian and international. Educational programming is also a key initiative.

What you will do
You provide high-quality service to visitors at the Museum. Under the supervision of the Manager, Visitor Services, you contribute to the mandate of the Museum by offering public activities for visitors, such as guided tours and school visits. In addition, you participate in the development and execution of scheduled Museum activities.

NOTE - Candidates must be available to work a minimum of 14 hours and a maximum of 37.5 hours per week from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm, time may vary (Monday to Sunday), including holidays. Preference will be given to candidates who are available to work weekends. Evening shift availability may be requested for special events.

More specifically you will:

• meet and greet visitors at the front desk, answer questions about all aspects of the Museum and gather visitor data

• raise public awareness of the roles and responsibilities of the Central Bank

• interpret history and the themes of the Museum through dialogue with visitors

• facilitate guided tours, family activities at special events and school programs in person and virtually

• assist in the Museum boutique

• work on various visitor services projects as required

## What you will need to succeed

• strong communication and presentation skills, both virtually and in-person in front of audiences

• proven interpersonal skills with the ability to be a great teammate

• ability to creatively and enthusiastically engage with visitors, while confidently presenting information to groups of varying sizes and backgrounds

• ability to quickly build an understanding of the Museums history, heritage, and mission

• experience providing exceptional customer service by addressing questions, providing assistance, and ensuring guest comfort and satisfaction

## Nice-to have

• knowledge of the Bank of Canada

• experience in Museology or Education

• experience using virtual presentation platforms

• previous experience in Customer Service/Guest Services

Your education and experience
This position requires one to two years of relevant work experience with the public, preferably in museum or education (i.e., as a guide, interpreter or teacher)

Please note that this poster may be used to fill several positions throughout the posting period.

## What you need to know

• Language requirement: Service to External – PLR 5

• Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Reliability

• There will be no relocation assistance provided

• Please save a copy of the job poster. Once the closing date has passed, it will no longer be available.

• The official title for this position is "Museum Guide".

What you can expect from us
This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team.

• Salaries are based on qualifications and experience and typically range from $25.96 to $30.54 (job grade 10)

We wish to thank all applicants for their interest and effort in applying for this position. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

CareersInnerInfo

Calian is seeking a full-time Registered Practical Nurse to join the team at CFB Trenton. This is a rewarding position where you would make a difference in the lives of the men and women who serve our country and keep us safe.

• Perform triage assessments of patients during walk-in hours and patient assessments, which include medical or incident history, physical examinations, vitals signs measurement, and vision acuity testing

Job Code: 00194005

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

## ## Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced test automation engineer to drive end-to-end software quality and operational reliability across our high-scale cloud, contact-center, and real-time communications solutions. You will be responsible for engineering robust, CI/CD-integrated automation frameworks that evaluate key quality dimensions including API integrity, protocol signaling, audio/video media performance, and infrastructure capacity. Operating in an innovative, fast-paced environment, you will combine agentic AI development tools with advanced problem-solving methodologies to optimize validation pipelines and elevate production excellence.

## ## Responsibilities

• Design, code and maintain Playwright test suites for application UI and API journeys; add contract, integration, cross-service and end-to-end validation with reliable fixtures, test data and deterministic assertions.

• Wire automated suites into GitHub Actions/Jenkins pipelines and GitOps/Argo CD release flows; implement parallelization, selective test execution, environment readiness checks and post-deployment sanity gates.

• Develop automated voice/media/contact-center scenarios including SIP call setup/teardown, RTP/SRTP media, WebRTC, IVR, queues, agent workflows, transfer/hold/conference, recording and relevant messaging journeys.

• Build synthetic tests and continuous traffic generation to validate golden journeys, detect regressions and generate meaningful signals under routine and failure conditions.

• Implement performance/load/stress/soak testing; model concurrency and transaction rates, analyze p95/p99 latency, throughput, packet loss, jitter, media quality and service saturation.

• Implement safe chaos tests for pod/node failures, network degradation, dependency failures and failover; prove recovery behavior and regression protection.

• Build AI-assisted/agentic automation for test-authoring, failure clustering, flaky-test investigation, triage and proposal-based self-healing; maintain human review, audit trails and strong assertions.

• Troubleshoot failures end-to-end using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Alloy, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes events, API logs and packet/traffic traces; identify whether failures arise in tests, products, infrastructure or networks.

• Work closely with engineering, SRE, platform and security peers to improve system testability, resilience and secure handling of sensitive test data.

## ## Required Experience

• 8+ years in software development in test, quality engineering or test automation with substantial recent hands-on coding.

• Strong TypeScript/JavaScript or Python and Playwright; robust UI/API automation, integration testing, async/event-driven behavior and CI/CD.

• Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling or Locust; ability to interpret traffic, telemetry and actual bottlenecks.

• Working knowledge of real-time communications or contact-center testing, including SIP, RTP or WebRTC and troubleshooting call or media flows.

• Cloud-native debugging skills: Kubernetes, Linux, containers, HTTP, DNS, TLS, API gateways, networking and distributed services.

• Ability to use observability dashboards, traces and logs to isolate problems and convert findings into durable regression tests.

• Practical use of AI coding agents or agentic automation to improve engineering output, validated against objective test results.

## ## Preferred Experience

• Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy and OpenTelemetry instrumentation; traffic capture with Wireshark/tcpdump.

• Cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS); Terraform, GitOps/Argo CD, Helm, Kafka, Redis and relational/document databases.

• Chaos tooling and controlled failure injection; synthetic monitoring and production-like traffic simulations.

• Security and compliance aware testing for zero trust, identity, TLS/mTLS, FedRAMP, PCI DSS or SOC 2 environments.

• Measures of success

• Automated suites detect meaningful regressions quickly and are trusted by developers and release teams.

• Critical voice, media and contact-center journeys have continuous, observable automated validation.

• Performance and resilience tests surface capacity or failure-mode issues before production impact.

• Agentic enhancements accelerate diagnosis and maintenance without hiding product defects or weakening coverage.

## ## Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

## ## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## ## Position Overview

Build the software and cloud foundations that make Avaya Infinity analytics reliable, secure, and useful. We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can lead system design across services, data, and infrastructure, then personally carry critical work through implementation and production operation.

You will partner with product, data, AI, platform, and operations engineers to deliver complete capabilities. Agentic development is central to the role: you will use coding agents to accelerate substantial engineering work while retaining the understanding and judgment needed to verify, maintain, and improve the systems you build.

## ## Ownership and Delivery

• Take responsibility from problem definition and proof of concept through deployment, production adoption, and ongoing operation.

• Show initiative, make tradeoffs explicit, surface blockers early, and drive ambiguous work to a useful result.

• Stay accountable after release. Investigate incidents, implement permanent fixes, share what you learn, and help colleagues deliver.

## ## Responsibilities

• Translate product goals into practical architecture, clear interfaces, and achievable delivery plans. Implement critical services and integrations yourself.

• Build reliable APIs and event-driven services, preserving data correctness, tenant isolation, compatibility, and predictable behavior during failures.

• Design and maintain production infrastructure as code with Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, environment configuration, and safe lifecycle changes.

• Author, troubleshoot, and improve GitHub Actions workflows for infrastructure and application delivery, including automated tests, secure cloud authentication, artifact promotion, and controlled releases.

• Lead changes that span services and infrastructure. Define integration contracts, coordinate dependencies, and validate complete user and operational outcomes.

• Improve performance, resilience, observability, and cloud cost through measurements and production investigation.

• Provide technical leadership through design decisions, code review, mentoring, and reusable engineering practices, including effective use of coding agents.

## ## Required Experience

• Substantial hands-on software engineering experience, with personal ownership of architecture and implementation across a production platform or multiple services.

• Deep backend development in a production language such as Go, Rust, Java, or a comparable language, with practical Python and SQL skills and the ability to learn adjacent technologies.

• Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, API contracts, asynchronous messaging, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Hands-on production Terraform and infrastructure-as-code experience. You can explain module design, remote state and locking, drift, reviewable plans, and safe changes to existing resources.

• Hands-on GitHub Actions workflow engineering. You have authored and debugged reusable workflows, managed dependencies and artifacts, integrated tests and deployment controls, and implemented secure credentials or workload identity.

• Production cloud experience on Azure or GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, identity, networking, and storage. Ability to become effective across both clouds.

• Experience with automated integration testing, secure authorization, observability, incident diagnosis, and controlled rollout and recovery.

• Clear communication and a record of influencing technical decisions through evidence, implementation, and collaboration.

## ## Agentic Development Experience

• Demonstrated delivery of a substantial feature, service, integration, or engineering tool from proof of concept into production using coding agents, such as Codex, Cursor, or comparable tools.

• Ability to decompose work, provide repository context and constraints, coordinate parallel tasks, review and integrate generated changes, and maintain reusable agent instructions.

• Independent understanding of the resulting code. You can explain errors you caught, debugging decisions, automated tests, security and performance checks, deployment, rollback, and verified production outcomes.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems with AI assistance and establish effective engineering practices through your own hands-on work. Tool familiarity or autocomplete alone is insufficient.

## ## Preferred Experience

• Production Go or Rust and high-volume event or data-processing services.

• Kafka, NATS, Redis, Delta Lake, Databricks, Trino, or comparable messaging and analytics technologies.

• Multi-tenant SaaS, secure cloud identity, dependency management, and software supply-chain controls.

• Incremental modernization of operating platforms and measurement of reliability, latency, or cost improvements.

• Analytics, contact-center applications, or secure integration of AI capabilities into enterprise products.

## ## Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

The pay range for this opportunity is from $179,127 to $234,100 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

What you will do
As a Senior Network Support Specialist, you will provide ongoing technical support, maintenance and improvement to the Bank’s networking solutions and work with the Ottawa team or partners to fix issues, related to Microsoft’s Office 365 Cloud platform (SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, MS Teams, OneDrive etc.) You will also be providing support the evolution of the Bank’s tools and monitor our Office 365 platform’s performance meanwhile ensuring appropriate follow-ups are done with relevant stakeholders to address arising issues.

You will be responsible to assist tuning and capacity planning of various solutions as well as be responsible for the coordination and implementation of changes to the production and test environments systems and products.

You will work closely with the network infrastructure group and the other collaboration tool and platform groups ensuring the highest level of systems support to the Bank.

More specifically, you will also:

• Participate in the planning, design and implementation of relevant architecture, hardware, software.

• Work autonomously to analyze diagnostic information and/or resolve uncommon or complex problems in a multi-functional setting, assessing and communicating technological issues that affect the functional or corporate level, and recommend solutions to more senior colleagues.

• Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with internal and external counterparts (partners, clients and suppliers) to support operational objectives

• Participate in functional and user experience testing.

What you need to succeed
You bring an advanced understanding of network platforms and internetworking architectures. You also have experience in performance and capacity monitoring for critical servers. You possess the ability to rank tasks per priority, meet deadlines and perform multiple tasks concurrently with strong relationships skills.

In addition, you have:

• Knowledge of Cisco IOS, Cisco Nexus OS, F5 load balancers and Infoblox DNS appliances

• Expert knowledge of VLAN, routers, switches, network protocols; e.g. IP, MPLS, IPSec

• Experience in supporting Enterprise Networks in an operational role

## Nice-to-have

• Routing, Switching, and Load Balancing Experience

• Microsoft’s Office 365 Cloud platform

• Cisco ASA Firewall

Your education and experience
This position requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline with a minimum of five years supporting critical cisco-based network environments or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

## Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. Although the position language requirement is English or French essential, we do encourage everyone to improve their second language proficiency for future career growth and to contribute towards fostering a bilingual environment.

• • Priority will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents

• Security level required: Be eligible to obtain Secret

• There will be no relocation assistance provided

## Hybrid Work Model

The Bank offers work arrangements that provide employees with flexibility, enable high-performing teams, and support an excellent workplace culture. Most employees can telework from home for a portion of each month as part of the Bank’s hybrid work model, and they are expected on site at the Bank location a minimum of 12 days per month to help build connections between colleagues. You must live in Canada, and within reasonable commuting distance of the office.

This is a great opportunity to join a leading organization and be part of a high-performing team. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to meet your needs at every stage of your life and career. For more information on key benefits please visit A great deal to consider.

## Position Overview:

As our Structural Mechanical Engineer, you will design and analyze structural systems related to facility infrastructure and equipment to ensure they are safe, stable, and compliant with applicable codes.

## Location:

On-site in Lynchburg, VA at the Advanced Technologies Office

## Your Day to Day as a Structural Mechanical Engineer:

• Design complex structural systems related to facility infrastructure and equipment.

• Perform structural evaluations and design for foundations, structural components, below the hook lifting, etc.

• Support production, equipment, and facilities upgrades, improvements, or new installations.

• Coordinate design interfaces with mechanical and electrical disciplines.

• Create design models and detailed drawings using CAD software and other design methods.

• Develop engineering calculations and specifications in accordance with nuclear and commercial standards.

• Support engineering procurement efforts.

• Analyze structural design of concrete, steel, and aluminum structures using applicable design codes.

• Analyze natural phenomena loading on structures (seismic, wind, precipitation, thermal, etc.).

• Analyze soil mechanics to determine soil loading on structures and structural settlement analysis.

## Required Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in engineering and physics is required.

• A minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience is required.

• Must have a strong mechanical aptitude.

• Must have high-quality workmanship.

• Must be able to provide clear, concise, accurate, and timely written and verbal communication.

• Must have experience in application of natural phenomena loads (Seismic, Wind, Snow, Thermal) on structures.

• Must be a strong team player with the ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers.

• Must have previous experience with industrial/facility infrastructure design and industrial equipment.

• Must have demonstrable skills and knowledge of 3D CAD Design and Drawings utilizing CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, SolidWorks).

• Must have demonstrable skills and knowledge of qualification software (ANSYS and/or GTStrudl).

• Must possess knowledge of Piping Support Qualifications (ASME B31.1, B31.3 or NF).

• Must possess knowledge of Piping Analysis Qualification using NQA-1 Software (AutoPipe or similar).

• Must possess knowledge of Concrete Analysis (ACI 318).

• Must possess knowledge of Structural Steel Analysis (AISC Steel Construction Manual required), AISC N690 preferred.

• Must possess knowledge of establishing Design Loads and Design Specifications.

• Must be highly self-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.

• Must be able to travel (<10%) domestic and international.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications:

• Registered Professional Engineer preferred.

• Microstation CAD, SolidWorks and/or Revit knowledge.

• Previous experience with industrial/facility infrastructure design and industrial equipment.

• A working knowledge of 29 CFR 1910 OSHA General Industry Regulations and Standard.

• Experience in nuclear plant licensing applications.

• Knowledge of ACI-349 nuclear concrete structures.

• Knowledge of ANSI/AISC N690 steel safety related nuclear structures.

• Knowledge of ASCE Seismic Analysis Standards (ASCE-4, ASCE-43)

• Knowledge of ASME BPVC Section III, Div 2 containment analysis experience.

• Experience performing seismic analysis of structures, tanks, piping using response spectra or time history response analysis methods.

• Experience with structural analysis programs (ANSYS, GTSTRUDL, SAP2000, RISA, RAM Connection).

• Experience with Piping analysis programs (AutoPipe).

• Experience performing impact and impulsive loading analyses.

• A Master’s degree in structural engineering.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## Worker Sub-Type:
Regular

## Job Description:

QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

## Are you the person we are looking for?

The QNX Sensor Framework team develops a middleware software framework that simplifies access to cameras and sensors for automotive, robotics, industrial and embedded applications. The framework facilitates access to cameras and other sensors such as LiDAR, radar and GPS/IMU through simple C APIs.

As a member of the team, you'll help deliver production-quality software used by some of the world's leading technology companies. This is an excellent opportunity for new graduates and junior developers to gain hands-on experience with embedded software, real-time operating systems, sensor technologies, and modern software development practices while being mentored by experienced engineers.

## What you will do:

• Develop embedded software written primarily in C and C++

• Add support for new cameras, sensors, and hardware platforms

• Design and implement new framework features and APIs

• Create and enhance sample applications, tools, and utilities

• Investigate and root-cause complex technical problems

• Work directly with hardware including cameras, LiDAR, radar, GPS, and IMU sensors

• Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and collaborative software development

• Support customers integrating sensors and cameras into their products

• Learn from experienced engineers while contributing to production software used worldwide

## What we are looking for:

• Programming skills in C and C++

• Analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills

• Knowledge of operating system fundamentals, computer architecture, and embedded systems concepts

• Effective verbal and written communication skills

• Self-motivated with a passion for learning and building high-quality software

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline

## It's great if you have:

• Experience with embedded software development, could be project, coops or professional

• Experience with QNX, Linux or other embedded operating systems

• Experience with device driver and low-level software development

• Familiarity with computer vision, image processing, graphics, or machine learning

• Experience working with cameras, sensors, robotics, or automotive systems

## Why join us?

• Work on technology that makes a real-world impact

• Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge embedded systems

• Learn from experienced engineers while building production software

• Tackle challenging technical problems and broaden your expertise

The work we’re doing is not incremental—it’s foundational, and it’s accelerating the industry. Come join us!

## Job Description:

QNX® is a trusted supplier of safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, frameworks and development tools, and provides authoritative support and services for building the world’s most critical embedded systems. We are the embedded authorities. BlackBerry QNX was born in embedded, and provides time-tested and trusted foundation software, including our deterministic micro kernel real-time operating system (RTOS), safety-certified products, middleware and security solutions, all purpose-built for embedded systems.

With the evolving landscape of safety (ISO2626) and security (ISO21434) required standards, QNX is in need to increase its developer productivity by scaling internal processes to benefit from more automation.

As a successful candidate, you will be a member of a dedicated, passionate product development team which builds, delivers, and supports Blackberry QNX. Your role will provide you with exciting opportunities to define, optimize and improve developer infrastructure to make processes more efficient and streamlined.

The QNX Build team supports the broader QNX developer community by maximizing the effectiveness of the company's build infrastructure. Our automation, packaging, and maintenance forms the basis for continuous stability and improvement of QNX products, including the QNX real-time operating system.

As a member of our team, you will contribute to the management of the build infrastructure, development of build processes, support of continuous integration techniques, and handle configuration management for a suite of continuously evolving QNX products.

## What you will do:

• Work with the QNX engineering and process teams to drive the evolution of QNX’s tool-based process (code build, static analysis, automated testing, release automation.)

• Develop tooling (in Python, Groovy, Bash and a variety of other languages) to improve the build, packaging, and release processes for software (particularly C/C++)

• Develop pipelines using Jenkins and Gitlab.

• Maintain build team infrastructure using IaC approaches (Docker, Terraform, Ansible)

• Manage internal customers

• Mentor team members

## What you will need:

• An Information Technology, Computer Science or Engineering degree, or equivalent work experience

• Experience with languages such as Python, groovy, bash

• Experience with source code management tools such as Git, SVN (branching, merging, tagging)

• Experience with pipeline languages (E.g. Jenkins, Gitlab)

• Experience with Containerization, Virtualization and container orchestration (E.g. Docker, docker swarm, kubernetes)

• Experience with cloud solutions such as AWS, OpenStack

• Hands-on experience working with automated CI/CD environments such as Gitlab, Github and Jenkins

• Proven ability to take ownership of problems and see them through to resolution

• Great verbal and written communications skills

• A love for automating tasks and problem solving

## Interesting skills you have:

• Experience with embedded software development

• Experience with Artifact Repositories such as Artifactory or Nexus

• Familiar with GNU make and makefile syntax

• Experience compiling C/C++ projects using the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC)

• Experience with building CRUD apps and REST APIs

• Experience with building simple web pages

• Experience creating packages for a package manager.
