Laser Designer

Ottawa, ON, Canada | Full-Time | Ranovus

About Us

Ranovus is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, developing next-generation co-packaged optics (CPO) solutions for AI and data center interconnects. Our Odin optical engine integrates a Quantum Dot Multi-Wavelength Laser, Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC), and ASIC into a single co-packaged module – delivering the performance and density required by hyperscale AI infrastructure.

The Role

We are hiring a Laser Designer to design and simulate the next generation of III-V laser and photonic devices. This is an on-site role at Ranovus in Ottawa, suited to a recent PhD graduate or an engineer with up to 3 years of industry experience.

You will work across the full device design cycle: from active-region and cavity simulation, through passive photonic structures such as edge couplers and tapered waveguides, to supporting fabrication and test. You will work closely with external vendors for epitaxy and fabrication, and with internal packaging, characterization and qualification teams, and your designs will go into real products.

What you'll do

• Design and simulate semiconductor diode lasers, including DFB lasers, SOAs and EAMs, covering gain, optical modes, thermal behaviour and high-speed performance.

• Run FDTD and other electromagnetic simulations of photonic structures such as edge couplers, spot-size converters and tapered waveguides, and optimize them for coupling efficiency and fabrication tolerance.

• Translate simulation results into mask layouts and design rules and hand designs off to external epitaxy and fab vendors, working with them on process capabilities, wafer specifications and run results.

• Compare simulated and measured device data, find the root cause of gaps, and feed lessons back into the next design spin.

• Build and maintain Python tools for simulation automation, parameter sweeps and data analysis, versioned and reviewed in Git.

• Document designs clearly and present results in design reviews.

What you'll bring

• PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Engineering Physics or a related field, with 0 to 3 years of post-PhD industry or research experience.

• Hands-on experience with diode laser device simulation (for example Laser MOD, PICS3D, Harold or equivalent tools).

• Experience with FDTD and 2D mode solver analysis of photonic structures such as edge couplers or ridge waveguides (for example Lumerical FDTD, Ansys or Synopsys tools).

• Experience with optical analysis of multilayer dielectric coatings, such as AR and HR facet coatings.

• Working knowledge of DFB lasers, semiconductor optical amplifiers (SOAs) and electro-absorption modulators (EAMs).

• A solid background in III-V semiconductor physics and materials, such as InP or GaAs material systems.

• Proficiency in Python for scientific computing, automation and data analysis.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working on-site with cross-functional teams.

Nice to have

• Experience with photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design, mode solvers (FDE/EME) or beam propagation methods.

• Exposure to device fabrication, wafer-level test or laser characterization (L-I-V, spectra, RIN, small-signal response).

• Familiarity with mask layout tools such as KLayout, gdsfactory or Nazca.

• Knowledge of datacom or telecom applications, such as O-band and C-band transceivers or co-packaged optics.

• Publications or patents in semiconductor lasers or integrated photonics.

• Experience with collaborative software development using Git.

You Belong At Ranovus

We appreciate the time you invest in exploring opportunities with us. At Ranovus, we believe diverse perspectives and a strong sense of belonging are essential to building innovative technology and resilient teams. If your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, growth, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Ranovus is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences, including those from equity-deserving and underrepresented communities. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process on request. Reach out to our Talent team at talent@ranovus.com for support.

We are committed to a respectful and transparent candidate experience, with clear and timely communication at every stage. We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools help with consistency and efficiency, but they don’t replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by people, guided by care, context, and fairness.

Thank you for your interest in this role, an existing vacancy on our team. We look forward to connecting with you.

https://solace.bamboohr.com/careers/823.body:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

The Event Integration Platform team is looking for an Integration Software Developer to help build and evolve the Micro-Integration Platform, the various components and libraries used to create the micro-integrations built on it. Micro-integrations are small, focused integrations that connect a Solace event broker to a third-party system (databases, cloud messaging and storage services, legacy message brokers, and more). Each one is delivered on Solace Cloud and/or as a customer-managed (self-managed) deployment.

This team does full cycle development, from architecture and design through development and support, for all platform side features for micro-integrations. The team builds on an open source tech stack using industry standard tooling and libraries (e.g. Spring Boot, Apache Camel, Maven, Docker, etc). You will work closely with other developers in the team and with other teams to integrate the platform features as part of the overall solution. The other teams include Micro-Integration Cloud Management, DevOps, and support teams.

What You’ll Do

As an Integration Software Developer, you will own well-scoped pieces of the platform and ship them to production alongside the team.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain the Micro-Integration Platform and its various components and libraries, which are used to create micro-integrations: the shared message-processing core that handles transformation, acknowledgment bridging between producers and consumers, error handling, and runtime configuration for every micro-integration

• Develop and maintain connection libraries to the third-party vendors (and to the Solace event broker), including health indicators, metrics, and message conversion between vendor formats and the Spring messaging model

• Build and improve common platform capabilities such as retry and dead-message handling, payload format support, and message transforms

• Support and develop solutions that are scalable using standard contracts between the different components of the overall solution

• Write unit, integration, and performance tests (including Testcontainers-based tests against real brokers and vendor systems) and keep documentation accurate and current

• Participate in design discussions and code reviews, and help keep platform changes backward compatible for the micro-integrations that depend on them

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• Professional software development experience building backend or integration software

• Strong proficiency in Java, with hands-on experience in Spring Boot (Spring Cloud Stream or Spring Integration a plus)

• Solid understanding of messaging and event-driven architecture: publish/subscribe, queues, acknowledgments, delivery guarantees, retries, and error handling

• Experience building or consuming integrations with third-party systems such as message brokers, databases, or cloud services, and an understanding of why message formats, ordering, and failure modes differ between them

• Experience with Maven (multi-module projects, parent POMs, dependency management) and CI/CD pipelines

• Comfort with Docker and containerized deployments; familiarity with Kubernetes and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

• A deep understanding of the various integration patterns used in enterprise solutions, and the pros and cons of each pattern when building large-scale systems

• Experience working in an AI-native environment and organization that uses AI to help develop and deliver software while keeping ownership on the developer

• A disciplined approach to automated testing (unit, integration, and containerized tests) and to code review

• Clear written communication: you document what you build so others can use it without asking you

• Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude, and AI tooling such as agents and skills, to speed up design, development, and testing, and knowing how to use AI responsibly to keep a well maintained system. All bugs are resolved by the team, and the team owns the solution end-to-end

Nice to Have

• Experience with Apache Camel components or Spring Cloud Stream

• Hands-on experience with Solace PubSub+, JMS, or another broker such as Kafka, IBM MQ, TIBCO EMS, or MQTT

• Experience with change data capture and file/object cloud storage solutions

• Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and Snowflake

• Experience building reusable frameworks, SDKs, or shared libraries that other teams depend on, including managing backward compatibility

• Experience with performance testing and tuning of message-processing applications

• Experience shipping software that is deployed both as a SaaS service and in customer-managed environments

Who You Are

• A hands-on developer who enjoys building the foundations other engineers build on

• Careful about compatibility, reliability, and security, because many micro-integrations and customers depend on what you change

• Interested in scaling a solution to support multiple flavours (for example Solace Cloud and self-managed, many vendor systems, many micro-integrations), and you see balancing the different capabilities it must meet as a challenge worth solving, such as:

• Scalability: handling growth in message volume, workflows, and the number of micro-integrations

• Maintainability: keeping a shared codebase understandable and easy to change

• Compatibility: evolving the platform without breaking micro-integrations that depend on it

• Reliability and performance: delivery guarantees, error handling, and throughput

• Security: protecting credentials and sensitive configuration, including vulnerability management and patch management, knowing what they are and how they work in an SDLC

• Operability: health, metrics, and supportability in both cloud and customer-managed environments

• Curious about how different systems behave, and patient enough to work through their differences

• Able to see how features and solutions can improve developer experience and user experience by creating less toil for developers and for end-users of the platform

• Passionate about improving the various stages of verification, with the ability to develop and contribute to improved tools for easier and more thorough verification

• Collaborative, open to feedback, and comfortable asking questions

• Pragmatic and continuously learning, including with new AI development tools

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.

• Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

Role Status: NEW

Expected Salary Range: Expected salary range for this role is from $95,000 to $135,000. The final offer within this range will reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience.

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Join the Coherent Receiver team and contribute to the integration, calibration, and verification of receiver optical-to-electrical modem subsystems within coherent optical networking products. This role collaborates with a multidisciplinary engineering team to advance electro-optic technologies in a research and development laboratory environment. The position focuses on modem subsystem testing, data analysis, factory procedure development, and continuous improvement of receiver performance.

• Design, test, and verify receiver optical-to-electrical modem subsystems within coherent optical modem products.

• Collaborate with systems, test, ADC, DSP, PCB, firmware, production, and product engineers to integrate modem technologies.

• Develop Matlab code to calibrate and perform design verification testing for prototype and early production modem subsystems.

• Create, debug, improve, and optimise calibration and verification procedures within an existing Matlab codebase.

• Investigate receiver hardware and test station issues, develop instrumentation drivers and algorithms, and analyse manufacturing data to improve yield and throughput.

• Experience coding in a language such as Matlab or Python for the purposes of simulation, test automation, and/or data analysis.

• Experience in data collection and statistical analysis.

• At least a basic working knowledge of photonic devices and systems.

• At least a basic working knowledge of software version control (Git).

• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills; excellent written and verbal communication in English; assertiveness to drive design and test engineers; initiative, enthusiasm, and a good sense of humour.

• Knowledge of fiber optic communications and/or DSP theory.

• Hands-on experience in design, integration, and/or test of high-speed electro-optic components.

• Experience with electro-optic/RF test methods and equipment in a lab environment.

• Silicon photonics component design knowledge or experience.

• Knowledge of photodetector physics.

• Experience with statistical analysis of large datasets.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer (Physical AI - System Modeling) to join the Pathfinding Studio within the Engineering Innovation Office. As a principal contributor, you will define and lead research in foundation model training and fine-tuning, vision-language-action models, reinforcement learning, and generative models. You will lead multidisciplinary work spanning virtual system modeling, data curation, learning, perception, planning, control, and translation of research into hardware implementations. With broad latitude to define objectives and technical approaches, you will solve critical problems under uncertainty, guide long-term technology and intellectual property initiatives and deliver outcomes that influence multiple functions and future products.

## Responsibilities:

· Define the long-term Physical AI research direction and system architecture for humanoid and industrial robotics to guide next generation technology and product strategy.

· Identify emerging methods and lead foundation model training and fine-tuning, VLA development, reinforcement learning, and generative modeling, connecting perception, planning, control, and manipulation in end-to-end robotic systems.

· Architect, develop, and maintain virtual system world models including articulated hands and arms, sensors, robot dynamics, contact interactions, and environments.

· Own the technical architecture of Physical AI data curation pipelines, spanning simulation, synthetic data generation, real-world collection and teleoperation, multimodal synchronization, schemas, quality checks, dataset versioning, and reproducible training and evaluation.

· Lead imitation-learning, reinforcement-learning, domain-randomization, sim-to-real, and real-to-sim workflows; establish evaluation criteria, analyze failure modes, and resolve complex model and controller issues with limited information.

· Translate research into hardware implementations through algorithm–hardware co-design.

· Define and evaluate system-level performance and resource trade-offs to guide deployment decisions and long-term technical priorities.

· Mentor engineers and researchers across domains.

· Extensive relevant research and engineering experience, including 8 years of related experience with a Ph.D.

· Strong expertise in foundation model training and fine-tuning, vision-language-action models (VLAs), reinforcement learning, and generative and world models targeting Physical AI systems such as humanoids and industrial robotics.

· Strong background in mathematics, physics, and software engineering, with the ability to apply rigorous modeling, analysis, and engineering methods to complex robotic systems.

· Knowledge in Neuromorphic and in-memory computing and modeling will be considered an advantage.

· Knowledge with foundation model development and finetuning for specification to hardware generation (e.g., schematics, RTL) will be considered an advantage.

· Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, and similar physics-based simulation and virtual system modeling platforms.

· Deep expertise in robotics algorithms and system modeling, including kinematics, dynamics, perception, planning, control, grasping, manipulation, trajectory generation, and contact-rich interaction.

· Experience designing and implementing Physical AI data curation pipelines, including simulation and real-world data collection, teleoperation, synthetic data, multimodal data quality, and sim-to-real and real-to-sim workflows.

· Prior experience translating research into hardware implementations, including algorithm–hardware co-design and validation against system-level requirements.

· Experience in digital ASIC design and verification and in collaborating across research, system architecture, RTL design, and verification disciplines.

· Strong software development experience in Python and C/C++ using CPU- and GPU-based environments, version control, testing, and reproducible experimentation.

· Publications in reputed conference and journals related to robotics.

## Education:

A Ph.D. in Robotics, Engineering Science, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.

Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model. It's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real time, event driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide, including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more, have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology, and your hard work!

About the Role

Ready to kick off a career in tech sales, right at the frontier of agentic AI? We're growing our London SDR team and looking for someone hungry, curious, and ready to hustle.
You bring the energy,
we'll bring the training. You will learn what Solace does and why it matters, work both inbound and outbound leads through cold calls, LinkedIn, and email, team up with Account Executives to crack into major enterprise accounts, and turn research into real conversations with the people building the AI powered enterprise of tomorrow.

What You'll Do

• Prospect into target accounts using a mix of outbound and inbound strategies

• Engage with potential customers via email, phone, LinkedIn, and events

• Qualify leads and book meetings for Account Executives

• Clearly articulate Solace's value proposition to technical and business stakeholders

• Maintain accurate activity and pipeline data in CRM tools

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and the wider GTM team

What You'll Bring to the Role

Must Haves

• Professional fluency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Strong communication skills and a confident, professional presence

• A proactive, curious mindset with a desire to learn and grow in sales

• Ability to thrive in a fast paced, high growth environment

Why You'll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we're all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance: our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry

• Balance matters: we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around

• Hybrid first: flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered

• Values driven: we live and breathe our core values, craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience

• Growth mindset: our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast

• Customer obsessed: we're proud of our world class customer lineup (we're not shy about it)

• Keep it fun: we're social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time

• Creative culture: we've got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!)

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

• Health & Dental benefits program

• Continuous learning and growth so you have the skillset needed to succeed and take on new challenges

## Position Overview:

The Technical Procurement Engineer provides specialized technical expertise to support strategic sourcing, supplier development, and the procurement of complex, highly engineered materials and services. As a key technical resource within BWXT Supply Chain, this position reports directly to Senior Management. The role partners closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Program Management to ensure that all procured materials, components, and services meet technical, quality, regulatory, cost, and schedule requirements. The position primarily supports BEO and contributes to broader Tennessee Operations initiatives as business needs evolve.

## Location:

On-site in Oak Ridge, TN

## Your Day-to-Day as a Technical Procurement Engineer:

• Support strategic sourcing, negotiation, and procurement of materials and services, including:
• raw materials

• machining

• fabrication

• forgings

• welding materials

• other technical commodities.

• Conduct supplier assessments in the form of audits, competency evaluations, qualification activities, and ongoing surveillance.

• Develop, review, and issue procurement specifications, technical packages, statements of work, subcontractor submittal requirements, and inspection and testing plans.

• Review supplier proposals, technical exceptions, manufacturing plans, inspection results, calibration records, and certifications to ensure full compliance with requirements.

• Serve as the primary engineering interface with suppliers for subcontracted components, ensuring fabrication processes meet all technical and quality standards. Lead and contribute to internal technical teams evaluating supplier performance and resolving issues involving discrepant or degraded materials.

• Collaborate with engineering, purchasing, and quality teams to identify, evaluate, and qualify new suppliers. Support the development of cost estimates and contribute to program efficiencies through process improvements.

• Apply independent judgment to resolve complex technical procurement challenges while meeting cost, schedule, and compliance expectations.

## Required Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.

• At least 4 years of experience in technical procurement, materials management, or purchasing.

• Experience with supplier qualification, ASME NQA-1, FAR/DFAR/DEAR regulations, and DOE facility operations.

• Strong technical understanding of engineering principles, manufacturing processes, quality control, and failure analysis.

• Strong negotiation, communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, interpret complex technical requirements, and prepare detailed procurement documentation.

• Must be a U.S. citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Q clearance.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Flexible work schedules and paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

## ## The Opportunity

Enterprise software should be as intuitive, engaging, and seamless as the consumer experiences people use every day. At Avaya, we’re bringing that standard to enterprise customer experience by transforming Avaya Infinity into a next-generation Connection Center—one that goes beyond traditional contact center workflows to create more intelligent, connected, and personalized customer interactions.

Our vision is built around three principles: Connections, Context, and Insights. By bringing together real-time data, customer history, and AI-powered capabilities, Avaya Infinity will help organizations deliver more meaningful interactions across web, desktop, mobile, and AI-driven workflows.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Designer – AI & Enterprise UX to help define and bring this vision to life. This is an opportunity to shape the experience of a strategic enterprise platform—not only designing new capabilities, but reimagining existing workflows, modernizing the user experience, and establishing the design systems and standards that will guide the platform forward.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll operate at the intersection of product strategy, design, and engineering. You’ll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences, use rapid prototyping and AI-enabled design tools to accelerate decision-making, and partner closely with engineering to translate design intent into high-quality products. Your influence will extend beyond individual features to the overall usability, consistency, and evolution of Avaya Infinity.

## ## What You'll Do

• Shape the Avaya Infinity Experience: Translate the vision for Connections, Context, and Insights into intuitive, human-centered experiences across web, desktop (Windows/Mac), and mobile—raising the bar for enterprise software usability and design.

• Design New Capabilities and Modernize Existing Experiences: Lead UX and product design for key Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives while identifying and addressing usability gaps, outdated workflows, and inconsistencies across the platform.

• Accelerate Innovation Through Rapid Prototyping: Use interactive prototypes, AI-enabled design tools, and iterative testing to validate concepts early, clarify requirements, and help engineering teams move from idea to implementation faster.

• Build Scalable Design Systems and Engineering Workflows: Establish and evolve Figma components, variables, design tokens, and handoff standards in close partnership with engineering. Ensure designs translate effectively into production across React, Electron, and native applications while minimizing rework and improving implementation quality.

• Design the Next Generation of AI-Powered Experiences: Create intuitive ways to incorporate real-time agent assistance, automated interaction summaries, predictive routing, and generative AI capabilities—making complex information actionable without overwhelming users.

• Lead UX Strategy Across Product and Engineering: Own the UX roadmap for Avaya Infinity, influence product priorities, and advocate for user-centered design in executive reviews. Partner across Product Management, Solution Architecture, and Engineering to align design decisions with customer needs, technical feasibility, and business outcomes.

## ## What You Bring

• Enterprise Product Design Experience: Significant experience designing complex B2B software across web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Experience with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, or other enterprise SaaS products is highly valued.

• A Strong UX Portfolio: Demonstrated ability to transform complex workflows and information-dense interfaces into intuitive, modern experiences. Your portfolio shows how you balance usability, visual design, and business requirements to simplify the user experience.

• Strategic Thinking and Hands-On Execution: Ability to move seamlessly between defining a long-term UX vision and delivering high-quality designs for immediate product priorities. You know how to modernize existing experiences while building a foundation for future capabilities.

• Advanced Figma and Design Systems Expertise: Strong command of Figma, including variables, design tokens, component libraries, auto-layout, and reusable design patterns. Experience establishing scalable design systems and integrating design workflows with frontend development is essential.

• Rapid Prototyping and AI-Enabled Design: Experience using interactive prototyping, iterative testing, and emerging AI-powered design tools to validate concepts quickly, resolve ambiguity, and accelerate product development.

• Close Collaboration with Engineering: Proven ability to partner with frontend engineers to evaluate technical feasibility, communicate design intent, and deliver implementation-ready specifications across modern web, desktop, and native applications.

• Product and Customer Experience Acumen: Understanding of complex customer interaction workflows, omnichannel experiences, real-time data, and analytics. You connect design decisions to customer needs, product strategy, and measurable business outcomes.

• Accessibility and Inclusive Design: Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and experience incorporating inclusive design principles into complex enterprise applications from the outset.

##

## Preferred Experience

• Experience designing AI-powered product experiences, including real-time agent assistance, contextual recommendations, automated summaries, or generative AI workflows.

• Familiarity with React, Electron, native application architectures, and design-to-code workflows.

• Experience leading design strategy and influencing product and engineering decisions as a senior individual contributor in a cross-functional environment.

## ## How Success Is Measured

• Design Delivery and Engineering Velocity: Deliver high-quality, implementation-ready designs for Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives on schedule. Use rapid prototyping, clear specifications, and close engineering collaboration to target a 25–30% improvement in design-to-code velocity.

• Platform Modernization and UX Improvement: Evaluate existing Infinity experiences, identify the highest-impact usability challenges, and establish a prioritized UX improvement roadmap. Reduce friction in legacy workflows while improving consistency, usability, and scalability across the platform.

• Design System Adoption and Handoff Quality: Establish consistent Figma components, design tokens, and design-to-code workflows across web, desktop, and mobile. Reduce ambiguity, minimize developer rework, and improve the fidelity of implemented designs.

• Measurable User Experience Impact: Improve usability through measurable reductions in cognitive load, unnecessary interaction steps, and task completion time. Track progress through usability testing, System Usability Scale (SUS) scores, and agent satisfaction (Agent CSAT), where applicable.

## ## Why Join Avaya?

At Avaya, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise customer experience—not simply refine existing interfaces. You’ll help transform Avaya Infinity into a modern, AI-enabled Connection Center that brings together Connections, Context, and Insights to make customer interactions more intuitive, intelligent, and meaningful.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you can influence product strategy, establish the UX direction for a strategic platform, and see your work move from concept to production. You’ll combine creative ownership and hands-on design with close collaboration across Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering.

If you’re energized by simplifying complex technology, challenging legacy design conventions, and using emerging AI capabilities to create better user experiences, Avaya offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on software that supports customer interactions around the world.

The pay range for this opportunity is up to $187,800 in total compensation, inclusive of base salary and bonus. Actual total compensation will vary based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

## Position Overview:

Develop, implement and audit Quality Assurance and Quality Control to assure compliance to customer requirements or national standards. Maintain the quality of specific products; control (and be knowledgeable of) procedures, analysis, documents and system requirements for the products. Perform system evaluations to assure compliance with customer, regulatory or internal specifications. Bachelor of Science OR Bachelor of Arts degree with two additional years of experience in QA/QC.

• The Teldio brand and story: voice, positioning, and how we show up everywhere

• Content across the funnel, and the structure that makes it findable: blog, case studies, decks, and product messaging

• Paid, email, and the analytics that tell you what's actually working

• Social and channel/partner marketing, including alongside our key partners

• Trade shows and events, at home and abroad

• Sales enablement: decks, sequences, and the knowledge base

• Graphic design and video, produced in-house

• The AI systems and internal tools that let a small team do extensive work

## Huawei Canada has an immediate 12-month contract opening for a Researcher.

## About the team:

The Software-Hardware System Optimization Lab focuses on research and innovation in power efficiency and performance optimization for consumer devices. By leveraging the talents and capabilities of local academia and our team, we aim to build system-optimization capabilities for software and hardware across edge AI, multimedia, graphics, mobile gaming, and system software domains, thereby enhancing the user experience and performance competitiveness of Huawei's consumer device products.

## About the job:

• Conduct cutting-edge research on high-performance embodied AI systems, with a focus on robotic manipulation and autonomous decision-making.

• Develop novel reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and learning-from-demonstration algorithms to improve the safety, robustness, and generalization of embodied agents.

• Design and evaluate methods for leveraging negative data, failure cases, human feedback, and corrective demonstrations to improve policy learning.

• Develop and study Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and embodied AI agents for embodied intelligence and robot learning applications.

• Implement, train, and evaluate state-of-the-art models in both simulation and real-world robotic environments.

• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate research ideas into scalable systems and internal technology prototypes.

• Stay current with the latest advances in reinforcement learning, robot learning, embodied AI, and foundation models, and contribute technical insights to the team's research roadmap.

Grow your career with us! If you are interested in test, strategies, and a challenging technical leadership career, you've come to the right place. Product Engineering Group RAN Performance, PEU-RP, is a unit at Ericsson which is at the forefront of 5G and 6G development, including application of innovative technologies such as Cloud and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Test Manager in PEU-RP you will as a technical leader develop and use agentic AI as tool to drive and define test analysis of new 5G and 6G RAN features, to secure the most efficient and effective testcoverage, which ensures product quality and an optimized product flow. Additionally, you will continuously optimize legacy test coverage using several methods for an appropriate risk level. In this context, you will work closely with a wide network including other technical leaders, program organization, product owners, Systems/Design/Test/Customer Support teams etc., and play an active role in inspiring and educating the test community on test strategies and test practices, to secure all the assigned test activities across product test flow are within approved cost, time, and quality frame.

We emphasize team work, communication and co-operation. We expect you to be a strong team player and thereby contribute to the teams’ successes. We expect you to be willing to step forward and take responsibility and actively drive issues as well as taking part in all aspects of the Test Manager role. We also expect you to live by Ericsson core values professionalism, respect, perseverance and integrity. We provide an open working climate and diversity where all opinions and contributions are appreciated as well as a possibility to work with the latest technology telecommunication development.

## What you will do:

• Drive test analysis of 5G and 6G RAN features from study through execution: set and communicate test scope, and secure test coverage and quality.

• Identify the impact and risks of new features on test tools, forecast test environment requirements and follow up their implementation.

• Drive the design, development and deployment of Agentic AI solutions for test, such as AI agents for test analysis, test case selection and generation and etc

• Deploy, operate and scale AI solutions on AWS or other cloud platforms, in close collaboration with tools, CI/CD and infrastructure teams

• Educate and support the organization on test strategy, efficient testing and the use of AI agents in the test flow

## The skills you bring:

• University education M.Sc/B.Sc in Telecommunication/Electrical Engineering /Computer Science or equivalent experience

• Minimum 8 years of experience in 5G RAN development or deployment (e.g., from Systems, Design, Feature Verification, System Verification, CI/CD or Customer Support)

• Hands-on experience building Agentic AI systems in test or design, e.g., LLM-based agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, or similar

• Hands-on experience deploying AI solutions on AWS (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3) or another cloud platform (Azure, GCP), including containerization, Infrastructure as Code and cloud security fundamentals

• Ability to communicate effectively to articulate and convey complex technical information effectively to stakeholders

• Strong problem-solving skills to devise innovative solutions for testing challenges, and analytical abilities to troubleshoot complex issues

## Advantages for this position:

- Production-grade AI engineering practice: agent evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost optimization and MLOps/LLMOps

- AWS or other cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning / AI Practitioner)

- Python proficiency and experience integrating AI agents with test tools, CI/CD pipelines and RAN lab environments

## ## About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.avaya.com

## ## Position Overview

We are seeking a hands-on, forward-thinking Principal Platform Engineer to pioneer the integration of Agentic AI into our core engineering ecosystem. In this role, you will design, build, and scale reusable agentic systems that fundamentally transform both platform development and day-two operations.

Rather than treating AI agents merely as production-operation assistants, you will embed these intelligent capabilities into the very fabric of our engineering lifecycle. By extending established cloud-native practices with secure agent tooling and rigorous evaluation frameworks, you will establish a scalable blueprint for autonomous operations across the entire organization. This position demands a rare combination of startup-like urgency, hands-on technical ownership, and an unyielding commitment to security, compliance, and systems reliability.

## ## Responsibilities

• Create a coherent agentic platform engineering approach: shared tool interfaces, reusable skills/workflows, coding conventions, evaluation harnesses, telemetry and adoption patterns.

• Develop agents and tools integrated with Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo CD/GitOps, cloud APIs, CI/CD, API gateways, Kafka, Redis, relational/document databases, observability and change-management systems.

• Accelerate platform development with AI-supported module/chart creation, code review, infrastructure plan interpretation, test generation, dependency analysis and safe pull-request workflows.

• Engineer day-two agents for health and drift detection, incident triage, correlated diagnostics, root-cause hypotheses, capacity analysis, upgrade readiness, runbook assistance and recovery verification.

• Build agentic development workflows for Kafka, Redis, relational/document database deployment and scaling, schema/configuration checks, upgrade planning, performance diagnosis, capacity assessments and secure API gateway changes.

• Use Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy and OpenTelemetry as operational signal sources; engineer safe telemetry retrieval, correlation, retention-aware queries and verifiable diagnostic recommendations.

• Build controlled operational workflows progressing from read-only diagnosis to recommended actions, gated changes and policy-authorized execution where justified.

• Enforce scoped identity, least privilege, environment isolation, secrets protection, prompt/tool-injection resistance, input/output validation, human approvals, audit trails, timeouts, budgets, kill switches and rollback boundaries.

• Implement evaluation of agent correctness, false positives, tool behavior, failure handling, security conformance and outcome quality before production rollout.

• Embed compliance requirements into agent workflows: explainable decisions, traceable evidence, approved change paths, data minimization and continuous control validation for FedRAMP/PCI DSS/SOC 2 environments.

• Partner with security, SRE/CloudOps and platform teams to define where agents may observe, recommend or act; document accountable owners and escalation paths.

• Coach engineers through pairing, playbooks, examples and metrics so agentic development becomes a team capability rather than one specialist’s project.

• Lead adoption by embedding agentic development into real platform delivery in a fast-paced environment; pair with engineers, ship working patterns quickly and improve them through measurement and feedback.

• Measure adoption and value through cycle time, manual toil removed, diagnostic lead time, quality, safe automation rate and reliability; avoid rewarding unchecked autonomy.

## ## Required Experience

• 7+ years in software/platform engineering, DevOps or SRE with production Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps depth.

• Strong Python or Go software engineering, API design, testing, integration and debugging skills.

• Hands-on building agentic workflows with LLM APIs, tool/function calling and orchestration; ability to explain working systems, evaluations and failure cases.

• Working understanding of Azure/GCP/AWS, identity, Kubernetes APIs, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability and change processes.

• Practical knowledge of Kafka, Redis, relational and document databases, API gateways and Kubernetes networking/security; ability to reason about scaling, deployment failures, observability and day-two recovery.

• Experience integrating with Prometheus/Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Alloy or comparable metrics, logging and telemetry backends to build reliable diagnostic workflows.

• Strong security judgment for privileged tools, least privilege, zero trust and data access in regulated enterprise environments.

• Ability to coach technical peers, standardize patterns and introduce new practices across teams without sacrificing operational reliability.

• Proven comfort with startup-like pace, ambiguous requirements, rapid iterations and shipping measurable engineering outcomes rather than demonstrations.

## ## Preferred Experience

• MCP and agent-tool protocols, retrieval where useful, event-driven systems, policy engines, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop workflows.

• Experience with FedRAMP, PCI DSS, SOC 2 technical evidence requirements and auditable automation.

• Cloud networking and platform services such as Istio, Keycloak, cert-manager, API gateways and DNS.

• Built or operated agents for diagnosis, remediation, deployment safety or infrastructure change at scale.

## ## Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

## ## Pay Transparency

The pay range for this opportunity is from $179,127 to $234,100 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location.

This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

You will deliver features across a React/TypeScript desktop and Go/Rust backend services, applying strong computer science fundamentals to state management, client/server coordination, messaging, and media integration. We expect hands-on experience with agentic AI development, using tools such as Codex or Cursor to move from rapid prototypes to well-designed, verified production software.

## ## Responsibilities

• Build features across the agent desktop and supporting services, partnering with product, design, and platform teams.

• Define where state belongs and how clients and services synchronize, recover from failures, and preserve user work.

• Design session and media ownership across tabs, browsers, virtual desktops, and embedded clients, preventing conflicting actions.

• Develop real-time communication and media integrations, selecting appropriate APIs, streaming, and messaging patterns.

• Build extensibility and CRM integrations with clear contracts for lifecycle, shared context, permissions, and failure isolation.

• Make observability part of the experience through connection and media health indicators, useful diagnostics, and correlated client/backend telemetry.

• Deliver accessible, responsive, secure applications with meaningful tests covering critical workflows, concurrency, and recovery.

• Use AI agents effectively, contribute to architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and support production systems.

## ## Required Experience

• Computer science fundamentals and first-principles reasoning: strong understanding of concurrency, networking, and distributed systems, with the ability to explain tradeoffs and turn designs into production software.

• Full-stack delivery: experience building complex, stateful applications across clients and services. Hands-on backend experience, with Go/Rust proficiency or demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.

• Front-end engineering: strong React, TypeScript, and browser fundamentals, including asynchronous behavior, component architecture, state synchronization, performance, and accessibility.

• Real-time reliability: experience with persistent connections, concurrent sessions, state ownership, event ordering, idempotency, reconnects, and partial failures.

• Integration design: experience with APIs, event-driven interfaces, modular applications, authentication and authorization, and working knowledge of databases and caching.

• Observability and quality: ability to investigate issues across browser, network, and service boundaries using logs, metrics, traces, and automated tests.

• Cloud delivery: experience with automated build and deployment pipelines, containers, and working familiarity with Kubernetes.

• Collaboration and ownership: ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, coordinate across teams, and own software through production operation.

## ## Agentic AI Development

• Prior hands-on experience with coding agents is required, along with the ability to rapidly deepen that capability.

• Work prompt-first, providing clear requirements, codebase context, architectural constraints, and verification criteria.

• Choose the right approach for the task: AI pair programming, delegated implementation, multiple agents, or rapid prototyping and spikes.

• Guide agents through implementation and testing, critically evaluate their output, and rework prototypes into production-grade designs.

• Own the correctness, security, maintainability, and performance of delivered software, following company policies for AI use.

## ## Preferred Experience

• Contact-center or other real-time communications applications, including voice and digital interaction workflows.

• WebRTC and browser media integration, including diagnostics for jitter, packet loss, and latency.

• Multi-instance coordination, Citrix environments, desktop extensions, client SDKs, or CRM integrations such as Salesforce.

• Production Go or Rust; WebSockets, SSE, NATS, or comparable messaging technologies.

• OpenTelemetry, AKS/GKE, and on-premises deployments.

## ## Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth, collaboration, and technical excellence. At our Oak Ridge, Tennessee Enrichment Operations site, you will join teams working at the forefront of advanced nuclear manufacturing, precision engineering, and mission‑critical national security programs. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, you’ll find opportunities to challenge yourself, partner with seasoned experts, and contribute to innovation shaping the future of nuclear technology. Our work requires a wide range of skills, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who share a passion for meaningful impact and technical advancement.

## Position Overview

The Manager, Risk Management leads the program-management risk and opportunity management framework for BWXT Enrichment Operations. This role establishes risk governance, ensures consistent identification and assessment of uncertainty, and provides leadership with clear, decision-oriented analysis. The Manager works across program management, engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, safety, finance, and security to integrate risk management directly into planning and execution. This role requires strong analytical capability, facilitation skill, executive communication, and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively in a regulated nuclear environment.

## Your Day to Day as Manager, Risk Management

• Own and maintain the EO risk-management framework, including methods, standards, templates, review cadences, scoring, and escalation thresholds.

• Lead portfolio-level risk identification, aggregation, and analysis; ensure systemic, correlated, or cross-project risks are surfaced early.

• Facilitate risk reviews, assumption reviews, supplier-risk assessments, and readiness-risk sessions for complex or high-consequence initiatives.

• Ensure risks are well-defined with clear causes, probability, impact, triggers, owners, and actionable mitigations.

• Lead qualitative and quantitative risk analysis (cost, schedule, Monte Carlo, scenario modeling) when uncertainty materially affects decisions.

• Ensure mitigation plans have clear actions, owners, dates, and are integrated into schedules, budgets, procurement plans, readiness plans, and resource plans.

• Partner with Project Controls and Finance to integrate risk exposure into forecasts, contingency, reserves, and management reporting.

• Provide clear, decision-focused risk reporting including trends, major drivers, mitigation status, exposure summaries, and required leadership actions.

• Conduct deep dives when exposure is unclear, mitigation is ineffective, or forecasts conflict with risk signals.

• Lead opportunity-management processes that identify ways to improve cost, schedule, safety, reliability, or long-term business value.

• Ensure risk-management practices align with safety, security, quality, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

• Coach Program and Project Managers in risk identification, analysis, mitigation, escalation, and risk-informed decision-making.

• Maintain risk-management tools, dashboards, and data quality; promote consistent risk definitions and information structures across EO.

• Support the Director, Program Management with independent risk assessments, readiness reviews, major decisions, recoveries, and portfolio exposure analysis.

## Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Project/Program Management, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.

• A minimum of ten (10) years of related experience is required.

• Significant experience in project/program management, project controls, risk management, engineering, operations, or finance.

• Demonstrated experience establishing or leading structured risk-management processes for complex technical programs or projects.

• Strong knowledge of qualitative and quantitative risk-analysis methods.

• Demonstrated ability to integrate risk with scope, schedule, cost, forecasting, technical planning, and executive reporting.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and executive‑presentation skills.

• Strong analytical capability and judgment; able to challenge assumptions constructively.

• Ability to lead and influence across a matrixed organization.

• Must meet BWXT employment, security, and regulatory requirements.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) or Department of Defense (DOD) security clearance, whichever is required.

## Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Program/Project Management, Finance, Operations Research, Statistics, or related field.

• PMP, PMI-RMP, AACE certification, or equivalent.

• Experience in nuclear, DOE, enrichment, defense, chemical processing, or other high-consequence regulated industries.

• Experience with Monte Carlo, cost/schedule risk analysis, sensitivity analysis, or probabilistic forecasting.

• Experience managing or developing risk analysts, project-controls staff, or project managers.

• Experience leading risk reviews for capital projects, construction, facility mods, commissioning, or major operational transitions.

## What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Flexible schedules and paid time off (as applicable).

• Professional development and continuing education opportunities.

• A mission-driven culture focused on safety, accountability, and nuclear excellence.

• Opportunities for long-term career growth across BWXT.

## Team Lead, Talent Acquisition

Reports to: Manager, Talent Acquisition
Team scope: 3 direct reports

## About the Role

The Team Lead, Talent Acquisition is a hands-on people leader, trusted talent advisor and operational driver accountable for strengthening recruitment execution, leader partnership and team discipline across Mattr Infrastructure Technologies. This role requires someone who can lead complex talent conversations with diplomacy, credibility and data; model the standards expected of the team; and help hiring leaders understand what best-in-class talent acquisition looks like in practice. The ideal candidate is data and metrics-driven, commercially aware and able to think strategically about how talent acquisition must evolve to support business growth.

## What You’ll Do

• Act as a working lead on full-cycle searches when required, while building and maintaining scalable recruitment strategies that attract, assess and secure high-quality talent.

• Continuously challenge current practices, identify opportunities for improvement and bring modern talent acquisition practices into the team’s day-to-day work.

• Track and report on recruitment activity, vendor invoicing, talent data, key performance indicators and hiring trends.

• Support employer brand initiatives, including career fair planning, recruitment marketing activities and talent funnel development.

• Build trusted relationships with leaders, HR business partners, candidates and vendors through diplomacy, sound judgment and data-informed recommendations.

• Inform and influence hiring leaders on best-in-class talent acquisition practices, including intake discipline, market realities, candidate experience and structured assessment.

• Use recruitment data, market insight and practical experience to challenge assumptions, surface risks and recommend hiring strategies.

## How You’ll Lead

• Lead by example with ownership, preparation, follow-through and professionalism in every interaction.

• Provide guidance and direction to Talent Partners and hold the team accountable for meeting performance goals, service expectations and process standards.

• Coach Talent Partners and hiring leaders through challenging searches and reinforce what a best-in-class recruitment experience looks like.

• Help the team focus on quality outcomes, stronger shortlists, stakeholder alignment, candidate experience and disciplined execution.

## What You Bring

• At least eight years of relevant Talent Acquisition or Human Resources experience; recruitment or HR designation preferred.

• At least three years of progressive leadership experience, including performance management.

• Previous third-party agency experience combined with in-house corporate recruitment experience is preferred.

• Demonstrated experience identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities across multiple business units, and developing standardized, scalable solutions that improve consistency, streamline operations, and support continuous improvement.

• ATS implementation experience is considered an asset.

• Strong relationship-building, communication, influencing and coaching skills, with the ability to lead talent conversations with diplomacy and confidence.

• Demonstrated ability to use recruitment metrics, market data and experience to guide leaders, prioritize work and make practical decisions under pressure.

## Success in This Role

You will be successful when the Talent Acquisition team operates with clear priorities, consistent process discipline and strong accountability, while hiring leaders experience credible partnership, practical guidance and timely communication.

This role is a remote work, with up to 20% travel.

## Health, Safety & Environment

Every worker is expected to cooperate in protecting their own health and safety and that of others at the work site. The Team Lead also helps ensure team members understand and follow their health and safety responsibilities.

## Procurement Manager

March Networks is an established global leader in the video surveillance industry and works with the world’s largest retailers and banking institutions. Our goal is to create a positive working environment where all of our employees can thrive. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance, as well as the professional development opportunities needed to advance your career. At March Networks, we value your hard work, creativity and your passionate desire to deliver only the best to our customers, partners and each other.

## Role overview

This role leads strategic procurement for March Networks and Vivotek hardware (SSS LOB). The Procurement Manager leads and develops a small procurement team, builds and manages a world‑class supply base, leads supplier and contract manufacturer commercial negotiations, and manages component risk and lifecycle to enable successful product hardware build strategies with our global Contract Manufacturing partners, including Delta and Sanmina. The role works in close partnership with the Senior Manager, S&OP, who owns demand, supply, and inventory planning.

## Key responsibilities

## Leadership and team management

• Lead, coach, and develop a small team, setting clear goals, priorities, and performance expectations aligned with SSS LOB objectives.

• Allocate commodity, supplier, and project ownership across the team to balance workload and support NPI and volume production schedules.

• Conduct regular one‑on‑ones, performance reviews, development planning, and provide ongoing feedback and recognition.

• Build team capability in strategic sourcing, negotiation, cost modeling, and supply risk management through mentoring and targeted training.

• Take part in recruiting, selecting, and onboarding team members as the function grows.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex supplier, commercial, and cross‑functional issues.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous‑improvement culture, and represent the procurement function in leadership and cross‑functional forums.

## Strategic procurement for SSS LOB

• Provide advanced procurement support to the Hardware Engineering organization throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept through volume production, for the Taipei, Poland, Milan, and Ottawa design teams.

• Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships across key hardware commodities, including Memory/SOC/ICs/processors, PCBs, connectors, fans, and electro‑mechanical components.

• Lead supply risk management, including geopolitical, sanctions, tariff, lifecycle, allocation, and single‑source component risks, while developing mitigation strategies.

• Act as the primary business interface between supply partners, Hardware Engineering, Product Line Management, and Operations.

• Lead component price negotiations and manage commercial release milestones to meet build schedules, cost, and margin objectives.

• Evaluate supplier capability, reliability, capacity, financial health, and cost competitiveness to support both NPI and long‑term supply strategies.

## Contract manufacturing and outsourcing

• Support global contract manufacturing partners, including Delta, Sanmina, and future partners across North America, Europe, and Asia, on commercial and sourcing matters.

• Drive and negotiate cost models with existing and new outsource partners to maximize the SSS LOB’s margin contribution.

• In collaboration with the Technical Operations team, engage contract manufacturers early and formally in DFM/DFA by conducting joint design reviews, BOM rationalization, and component risk assessments to ensure manufacturability, test strategy, and lifecycle/obsolescence considerations are built in.

## BOM analysis, risk, and lifecycle management

• Drive component portfolio rationalization across all four design teams to reduce the number of suppliers and components being supported.

• Perform in‑depth Bill of Materials (BOM) analysis to inform procurement and S&OP decisions, including long lead‑time risk and early‑purchase recommendations.

• Drive end‑of‑life (EOL) component analysis, Product Change Notification (PCN) reviews, and dual‑sourcing strategies to protect continuity of supply.

• Assess manufacturing cost structures for NPI designs and provide component‑level and finished‑goods cost models to Product Line Management and Finance.

• Support the S&OP team in resolving material shortages impacting builds, pilot runs, and volume product builds by working directly with suppliers on recovery.

## Commercial and contractual leadership

• Lead procurement contract, NDA, and commercial term negotiations with key suppliers in alignment with corporate policies and risk appetite.

• Conduct business and financial reviews of potential and existing suppliers to support sourcing decisions and S&OP risk reviews.

• Manage pricing updates and verification for Engineering, Product Line Management, and Finance to ensure alignment of standard costs with S&OP assumptions and financial plans.

## Stakeholder engagement

• Present procurement strategies, supply risks, and savings opportunities to leadership and in S&OP reviews.

• Participate in Product Line readiness and gate reviews, clearly articulating sourcing status, risks, mitigation plans, and commercial implications.

• Lead efforts to elevate strategic sourcing maturity, including process improvements and tool adoption.

## Performance management and governance

• Monitor procurement KPIs, including material cost variance, savings, supplier on‑time delivery, and supplier and component consolidation, and hold the team accountable to these targets.

• Ensure that sourcing strategies and pricing are accurately reflected in ERP data, material masters, and procurement records.

• Drive continuous improvement in sourcing and NPI commercialization, quantifying financial benefits (e.g., cost reductions, lower obsolescence, better margins).

## Qualifications and experience

• 7+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, or procurement in the high‑tech / networking or electronics industry.

• 2+ years of people leadership experience, including direct management, coaching, and performance management of procurement or supply chain professionals.

• Hands‑on experience with NPI processes and BOM analysis, including cost modeling, lifecycle/risk assessment, and supplier selection.

• Demonstrated success negotiating complex commercial agreements, including pricing, contracts, and NDAs with semiconductor and electronics suppliers and contract manufacturers.

• Working knowledge of MRP/MPS and how procurement decisions connect to S&OP and financial planning.

• Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., SAP or similar), sourcing tools, and advanced Excel/analytics; experience with product lifecycle or Agile/PLM systems is an asset.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills; proven ability to influence cross‑functional stakeholders and suppliers.

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including cost analysis and supply risk mitigation.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; a procurement designation (e.g., CSCMP, CPSM, SCMP) is an asset.

Why Work at March Networks?

· Global Exposure

· Medical/Dental benefits offered immediately from Day 1

· Health club reimbursement

· Professional development support

· Company holiday closure

March Networks is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Applicants can make their accommodation needs known to us in their application.

Please note March Networks uses AI as part of the recruitment process.

About the role
Solace is looking for an HR Advisor to join our HR team in London and play a key role in how we support and grow our people across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. This is a high-impact, hands-on position with a path to grow into an HR Business Partner for the leaders based in the EMEA and APAC regions.

You will be the HR contact for managers and employees initially in the EMEA region, with support for APAC expected to be added over time, reporting to our HR Director, EMEA & APAC. You will partner closely with leaders across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Technical Support, Production Engineering, Field Marketing, and others, and work alongside our HR colleagues in Canada who cover recruitment, HR operations and employee engagement.

Who You Are

A proactive advisor: you anticipate problems rather than only react to them, and you bring solutions, not just questions.

Curious about the business: you want to understand how a fast-moving tech company runs, and how people decisions support its goals.

Trusted and collaborative: you handle sensitive matters with discretion and build credibility with managers quickly and communicate with clarity, context and good judgement.

Ambitious: you're motivated to grow into an HR Business Partner and ready to take on ownership as your scope expands.

What You'll Do

• Be the first point of contact for employee relations queries across EMEA, which may include contracts, absence, leave, performance and conduct, escalating required cases to the team in Canada or the HR Director with a clear summary and recommendation.

• Partner with managers to bring HR into people decisions early, coach them on good practices and policies, and help them anticipate issues before they escalate.

• Run HR operations requirements, including timesheet reviews and approvals, absence and leave, and accurate employee records in BambooHR.

• Support hiring and onboarding by being part of the final interview process, clarifying candidates’ and new joiners’ questions regarding compensation, payroll schedule, benefits, etc., and holding check-ins with new joiners.

• Help manage employment compliance across jurisdictions, working with payroll, local advisors and legal counsel.

• Execute people actions agreed between business leaders and HR, such as role and compensation changes, promotions, transfers, restructures and exits, preparing the letters, documentation and communications and making sure each follows a compliant, consistent process.

• Contribute to HR projects such as policy updates, onboarding improvements, benefits changes, leadership development, and reorganisations, taking on growing ownership over time.

• Over time, extend your support to employees and managers in APAC as the role grows.

What You Bring

• 3-5 years of HR experience, ideally in an HR Advisor, HR Generalist or similar role in a technology or fast-growing international business.

• Solid working knowledge of European, especially France and Germany, and UK employment law and ER processes, including disciplinary, grievance, absence and performance management.

• Comfort working with local advisors, payroll providers and counsel.

• Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage a varied workload and work independently.

• Good Microsoft 365 skills and experience with an HRIS (we use BambooHR).

• Curiosity about AI and comfort using it in your daily work, with good judgment about accuracy and the confidentiality of company and personal data.

• Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the judgement to advise managers in a practical, solutions-focused way.

• Available to work in our London office 2 days per week.

• Flexibility and the ability to work across various time zones, as required.

• Right to work in the UK.

Why You'll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we're all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

• Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.

• Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.

• Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.

• Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.

• Growth mindset – For this role, growth includes a defined development path towards an HR Business Partner
position.

• Customer Obsessed – We're proud of our world-class customer lineup (we're not shy about it).

• Keep it fun – We're social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.

• Make an impact – Help advance how organisations serve customers and give back to the community.

We are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process. To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening – including interviews and final hiring – are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let's Talk

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

## About the team

Established in 2012, the Central Media Technology Institute (CMTI) is Huawei's center for media technology innovation and engineering, enhancing the technical competitiveness of media products. • • Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance mobile software applications across multiple engines and platforms (iOS and Android).
