The Systems Security Architect strengthens security across Ciena optical networking products by embedding secure architecture and Secure Software Development Lifecycle practices from design through operations. This role shapes product security requirements, testing, governance, vulnerability management, and secure-by-design implementation while partnering with cross-functional teams on the existing portfolio and next-generation products.

• Lead Static Application Security Testing targets and coverage, and review new and existing free and open-source and commercial software for security vulnerabilities and upgrade recommendations.

• Lead vulnerability triage and mitigation, coordinate responses and security advisories for externally reported vulnerabilities, and define compliance requirements for secure-by-default and secure-by-design policies.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Knowledge of networking protocols, software technologies, and architectures.

• Application of Software Development Lifecycle methodologies and security frameworks.

• Knowledge of vulnerability management, security testing tools, secure coding principles, and threat modelling.

• Background in embedded and application software development, testing and validation, and hardware and software integration.

• Problem-solving and analytical skills applied to critical analysis and solution development.

• Communication, collaboration, independent work, multitasking, and task prioritization in cross-functional, deadline-driven environments.

## Fabrication FLM

## Welcome to BWXT

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We required a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.

## Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced supervisor to lead a dynamic team of welders and production techs in a heavy equipment manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will practice visible leadership on the floor, providing technical oversight and ensuring operational efficiency through effective communication and collaboration. If you are passionate about leading by example, fostering a strong safety culture, and driving productivity while supporting team development, we invite you to apply and become an integral part of our operations.

## Location:

On-site in Mt. Vernon, Indiana

## Your Day to Day as a Fabrication Supervisor (FLM) - Weekend Shift

• Practices visible leadership on the floor providing technical and administrative oversight of work through observations and floor surveillance.

• Encourages a questioning attitude to ensure a safe work environment and the highest quality standards.

• Clearly communicates job expectations and performance requirements to welders and production techs.

• Manages employee performance through the evaluation of expectations and objectives, including safe working practices, quality of work, compliance to procedures, and productivity.

• Coaches employees to improve and/or correct unacceptable performance.

• Manages employee attendance, training and production records through electronic systems.

• Serves as a liaison between shop floor personnel and management.

• Leads production communication and safety meetings.

• Schedules department resources to meet established scheduling deadlines.

• Works closely with engineering to develop/modify processes to exceed efficiency requirements and optimize welding productivity/performance.

• Ensures timely availability of required materials for the operations being performed.

• Schedules overtime according to needs.

• Performs monthly risk assessments of work area, identifying vulnerabilities and taking action for immediate correction.

• Through coordination with engineering ensures personnel maintain the proper weld qualifications.

• Takes an active role in continuous improvement initiatives with their area of responsibility.

• Leads weekly department level discussion at visual performance boards, receives critique and/or feedback, and provides constructive improvement paths.

## Required Qualifications:

• High School diploma or equivalent plus 2 years of direct supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment. Supervisory experience includes but is not limited to leading teams, assigning individual work, performance management, work evaluation, issuing disciplinary actions and coaching/mentoring employees.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and professionally, contribute to technical teams, and establish effective working relationships with other departments.

• Demonstrated computer skills (i.e. data entry, Word and Excel, timekeeping systems, etc.)

• Work schedule will be Friday, Saturday and Sunday 4 AM - 4 PM. Employee must be willing to work one designated weekday (Monday through Thursday) to receive business updates and provide effective support for the weekend shift.

## What We Offer:

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.

• Paid time off to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.

• An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.

• The chance to be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.

• Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!
